notes.title: Weekend Highlights | 14.8 #3
notes.content:
[h2]10-Year Interactive Timeline[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b8595bc6024c1469578a8699a6681a863ea9cdf2.jpg[/img]
[b]Happy anniversary[/b], Captains! This week marks 10 years since World of Warships was released on September 17, 2015. 

Take a look at the interactive timeline page we've prepared for the occasion—you'll be flooded with memories from all of our good times together!

[url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/general-news/tenth-anniversary-landing/ style=button][b]Click Here[/b][/url] 

[h2]Anniversary YouTube Marathon[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8c0fd4892049da455acfbbe18e3d81688ee6f121.jpg[/img]
Tune in to the World of Warships YouTube channel this Saturday for a 10-hour marathon of videos that we’ve published over the years. Naval Legends, Armada, Ship Comparison… You can watch all the classics and get rewarded while doing so!

Every hour of the marathon, we'll share 10 bonus codes, and the fastest viewers to redeem them will enjoy rewards like a [b]Special Ship X container[/b], [b]Rare Bonuses container[/b], or "[b]Like and Subscribe" permanent camouflage[/b]. If your knowledge of naval history is sharp enough, you could even win a [b]lifetime subscription to the MagellanTV[/b] documentary streaming service! 

Check out our article for more details:

[url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/general-news/happy-anniversary-world-of-warships-celebrates-10-years/ style=button][b]Click Here[/b][/url] 

[h2]Anniversary Activities and Rewards[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/596ccba3633281d09f15635199d4420ef80e1a05.jpg[/img]
Just because the anniversary date has passed, it doesn't mean the celebrations are over—far from it! Get the most out of the ongoing Update 14.8 by taking part in a wide range of in-game activities that you can read all about in our dedicated article:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/wows-is-celebrating-its-tenth-anniversary/ style=button][b]Click Here[/b][/url] 

[h2]Asymmetric Battles, Brawls, and Blast From the Past![/h2]

Asymmetric Battles—the battle type where a group of players faces off against a numerically superior but lower-tier bot force—has returned to the game this week, and it's here to stay until Update 15.2!

Also be sure to partake in the weekly Brawl session, which adopts a 2v2 format with Tier IX ships this week.

To round it all off, Update 14.8's unique callback to the game's history in the form of a battle type—Blast From the Past—is still available to play. Experience it while you still can!

[h2]Dev Blog Review[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/0c1560bc1539b35c19b8197d6d34d04622c12cb4.jpg[/img]
The past few weeks have seen some interesting Development Blog posts published about upcoming ships, map rebalancing, and a new map that's currently in the works. 

[i]Please note: The Development Blog is published only in English.[/i]

[url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/final-closed-testing-of-the-new-map style=button][b]Final Testing of a New Map[/b][/url] 

[url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/closed-test-ongoing-maps-rebalance-in-random-battles style=button][b]Existing Maps Rebalanced[/b][/url] 

[url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/closed-test-149-new-ships-devblog style=button][b]New Ships Announced[/b][/url]

notes.title: Weekend Highlights | 14.8 #2
notes.content:
[h2]Get Early Access to New German Cruisers![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/345cd70dbbc38ae26f51099c8805d5df1abad4d0.jpg[/img]
A new Tech Tree branch of German cruisers is making its debut in our waters ahead of their full release in Update 14.10. Don't miss the boat—find out how to take part and become one of the first Captains to sail these behemoths into battle.

[b]Deutschland[/b] (Tier VI), [b]Admiral Scheer[/b] (Tier VII), [b]Knesebeck[/b] (Tier VIII), [b]Manteuffel[/b] (Tier IX), and [b]Prinz Adalbert[/b] (Tier X) have as their main distinguishing feature the ability to assume manual control of their secondary battery—a useful tool to brandish when the ships' large-caliber main guns are in the process of reloading.

You'll find all the information you need—about the Early Access event, how these newcomers perform in battle, and the best tactics to utilize aboard them—in a dedicated article. Click the link to find out more!
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/new-german-cruisers-early-access/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/general-news/new-german-cruisers-early-access/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/general-news/new-german-cruisers-early-access/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]The Grand Voyage Continues[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6ec28fc7083813f5a475ee154c208b5e2c9bdfc0.jpg[/img]
Update 14.7 launched the multi-update Grand Voyage event. Spanning several months and ultimately set to lead us into the New Year, the event includes a variety of long-term activities, special missions, and valuable rewards.

Update 14.8 gives you the opportunity to continue your journey toward rewards like U.S. Premium destroyer [b]GQ Johnny[/b] and Voyage Tokens. During the event, you can [b]exchange up to 32,000 Voyage Tokens at a 1:1 rate for Doubloons or Steel[/b]!

Learn more on the event page:
[url=https://armory.worldofwarships.eu/category/anniversary/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://armory.worldofwarships.com/category/anniversary/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://armory.worldofwarships.asia/category/anniversary/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]Brawls[/h2]

The first Brawl session of Update 14.8 goes live this weekend. Format:
[list]
[*]3v3; Tier X ships
[*]No more than 1 destroyer per team
[*]No aircraft carriers or submarines allowed
[*]Divisions of up to 3 players
[/list]

[h2]Public Test for Update 14.9[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6235d6b0eec0be73aae30c3b9872712758bff0b0.jpg[/img]
The first round of public testing for the game's next update is happening now! Click the link to find out how you can be a part of it and earn some extra rewards in the process:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/work-in-progress-149/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/public-test/work-in-progress-149/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/public-test/work-in-progress-149/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 14.9
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ead6990ac32e7576b6fd3d4330265e6ee3772bfa.jpg[/img]

This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 14.9. For more information, visit the relevant link:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/work-in-progress-149/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/public-test/work-in-progress-149/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/public-test/work-in-progress-149/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[i][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.[/i]

Captains!

Our 10th Anniversary update is finally here, but our development team are also already steaming ahead with more new content to come in Update 14.9. It's time for a sneak peek!

Here's a quick breakdown of some of the most notable new content coming in 14.9:
[list]
[*][b]Liberty Harbor:[/b] In honor of the 250th birthday of the U.S. Navy, we invite you to build your own Naval Base—Liberty Harbor. Each structure serves a specific purpose, so choose your build order carefully. Complete combat missions, and once the whole base is finished, you can claim new U.S. cruiser [b]Bridgeport[/b] for free, in addition to Commander [b]David Farragut[/b] for assembling a dedicated collection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b3fcb30842b20c91e19d9128331dbdf710814f0b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ad9c31eae42f3bafdac95ac4a7d6da0b40ed0563.jpg[/img]
[*][b]Dockyard: Lüshun B:[/b] We're starting Black Friday early this year! You'll soon be able to build the black version of Pan-Asian destroyer [b]Lüshun[/b]—a ship that first graced the Dockyard in the form of her standard version in Update 12.7. Complete 35 shipbuilding phases—30 of which can be finished via combat missions—to unlock this rapid-firing, deepwater torpedo-launching machine!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b815c9d816f2bf32fe7e1b4849d7ca8c612d88bc.jpg[/img]

[*][b]German Reunification Event Pass:[/b] Our Event Pass this update is dedicated to the reunification of East and West Germany, a historical event that's celebrated every year in October. The first progression line will net you, among others, statuesque Commander [b]Goldelse[/b]. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/4ca024ab2f163e816334dad407dbb4d03c5283bb.png[/img]

The second progression line offers rewards such as the Infernal permanent camouflage for Tier VIII and X ships, and Commander [b]Delphius Ora-cle[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/78031a7a41f541f215020ba9195a1aef043693ca.png[/img]
[/list]

If you want the full, detailed breakdown on these features and more, check out our dedicated article on our website! Click through to it right here:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/work-in-progress-149/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/public-test/work-in-progress-149/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/public-test/work-in-progress-149/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

notes.title: Weekend Highlights | 14.8 #1
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to Our 10th Anniversary Update![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f6301ea1f341e0367b79402519fdcaf8f753c99b.jpg[/img]

In Update 14.8, we're celebrating [b]World of Warships' 10th Anniversary[/b]! Before you dig in to the feast of celebratory activities, consider having a look through our update article for the full change log. You'll find info about:

[list]
[*]Various [b]Anniversary activities[/b], including special login rewards, Festive Rewards for activating Battle Performance Bonuses, and an [b]interactive new Port.[/b]
[*]The Early Access event for a [b]new branch of German cruisers[/b] with manually controlled secondary guns.
[*]The return of [b]Asymmetric Battles[/b] and the introduction of a nostalgia-inducing new temporary battle type—[b]Blast From the Past![/b]
[*]Gameplay changes, including a rework of how ship modules take damage and the introduction of submarines to Operations.
[*]And more!

[/list]


[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-14-8-a-decade-at-sea/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url]

[h2]Relive the Old Days in Blast From the Past![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/17d8201031c125c5350a38b6870bc86f0c91a306.jpg[/img]

For our 10th Anniversary, we're harking back to a simpler time when the virtual seas were populated only by battleships, cruisers, and destroyers—[b]no carriers or subs[/b]!

The battle type is structured into six chapters, with the first five themed around specific years in the game's life. Each chapter restricts gameplay to only the ships and maps available up to that particular year. 

The final chapter features the current full selection of maps and nearly all available ships, but a new layer of restrictions specifically targets ships possessing advanced mechanics.

For more info, check out this dedicated article:
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/blast-from-the-past/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url]

[h2]Anniversary Activities[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ef269e09b1bdf8e74e580f4d63b20a24f608aaa3.jpg[/img]

Activities—and rewards—abound in Update 14.8! You can get started by simply logging in to claim your daily bonus, which may be a Supercontainer, Coal, days of Warships Premium Account, or Festive Tokens!

[b]What are Festive Tokens?[/b] They're an Armory currency you can use to unlock Festive Rewards, which include new Japanese cruiser [b]Kushiro[/b], up to 130 Supercontainers, and the This Is Fine enemy destruction effect.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/0f2b2f794ba2850e47790ba248762c048a61803f.png[/img]

You can earn a large number of Festive Tokens by activating [b]Battle Performance Bonuses[/b], and to do that, you'll need to earn cumulative Base XP on each of your ships, with the amount needed depending on the ship tier.

And finally, be sure to check out the [b]Decade Dock Port[/b]—plenty of Easter eggs and interactive elements are waiting to be discovered!

You'll find more info about these and other 10th Anniversary activities in a dedicated article:
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/wows-is-celebrating-its-tenth-anniversary/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url]

[h2]Recruiting Station Anniversary Blowout![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ecb32ac76d95f080c26586f3f9df2c8202ac6450.jpg[/img]

What better time to invite your friends to play World of Warships than during our gift-laden 10th Anniversary update!

[h3]Recruiting Station Changes[/h3]
Thanks to brand-new changes to the Recruiting Station mechanics, it's now easier than ever to invite new and former players to become your Shipmates. Now, every player with fewer than 100 battles on record is eligible for recruitment!

On top of that, all the first-time rewards you get as a Recruiter have been reset! That means seasoned Recruiters can once again claim rewards for performing these simple actions:

[list]
[*]First login to the Recruiting Station
[*]First invite link share
[*]Three invite link shares
[*]First Shipmate
[/list]

[h3]Recruiting Surge Event[/h3]

Take advantage of these quality-of-life changes to [b]accumulate Expedition Tokens[/b] in the new Recruiting Surge event, which offers guaranteed rewards for completing simple Recruiting Station actions. Get involved and celebrate the game's 10th Anniversary in-battle with your Shipmates to earn even more! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/294f87365561382f74996b86f1b90718f1e639d7.jpg[/img]

More info is available in a dedicated article:
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/sales-and-events/recruiting-runup-campaign-anniversary-ahoy/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url]

[h2]Take the 14.8 Survey![/h2]

Enjoying the new features introduced by Update 14.8? Let us know what you think via the survey link below!

[url=https://surveys.wargaming.net/s3/UPD14-8 style=button][b]Take Survey[/b][/url]

notes.title: Update 14.8 | A Decade at Sea, New German Cruisers, and Anniversary Celebrations
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a4ac12ceb46233b6fadd46b3ec00aa506089ee46.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=h4vpGT6nS9Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Here's an overview of the major highlights introduced in Update 14.8. Be sure to check out the full details on our website:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-14-8-a-decade-at-sea/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-14-8-a-decade-at-sea/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-14-8-a-decade-at-sea/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]A Decade at Sea[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a60e4e0bbc60f19779cd2e9f04be1a4643fce841.jpg[/img]

Celebrate World of Warships' 10th Anniversary with an event packed with rewards!

[list]
[*][i]Battle Performance Bonuses return, giving you the chance to earn Festive Tokens or Steel (for superships).[/i]
[*]Festive Tokens can be exchanged for new Japanese Tier X cruiser Kushiro, bonus packages for Tier X ships, Supercontainers, the "This Is Fine" enemy destruction effect, and containers from historic collections that unlock unique Commanders.
[*][i]Log in during Update 14.8 for a guaranteed Tenth Anniversary Gift container, which drops a Tier VI Premium ship.[/i]
[*]Updated Honorable Service: Players with 5 years in the game receive a Premium Ship VIII Elite container, and those with 10 years receive a Special Ship X Elite container [i](minimum 25 battles required).[/i]
[*]Exclusive thank-you rewards for Alpha and Beta Testers.
[/list]

[h2]Decade Dock Port & Update Navigator[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/fe8e55a40aee3d4dc7ab14ecc9fb8e7b03ccbb21.jpg[/img]

Jump into the anniversary celebrations!

[list]
[*][i]Explore the interactive Decade Dock Port, offering tons of Easter eggs and a 10-year commemorative journal.[/i]
[*]The brand-new Update Navigator feature provides a digest of current update content.
[*][i]Your Battle Record appears in the Navigator, showing personalized stats like battles played, most-used ships, and combat performance, with a shareable link.[/i]
[*][u]Available until Update 14.11.[/u]
[/list]

[h2]The Grand Voyage Continues[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6ec28fc7083813f5a475ee154c208b5e2c9bdfc0.jpg[/img]

The multi-update journey goes on!

[list]
[*][i]Earn Voyage Tokens to exchange for Doubloons and Steel.[/i]
[*]Continue progressing toward [u]unlocking GQ Johnny for free.[/u]
[*][i]The Grand Voyage runs until January 1, 2026.[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Tenth Anniversary Event Pass[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ef269e09b1bdf8e74e580f4d63b20a24f608aaa3.jpg[/img]

Packed with anniversary rewards across two progression lines.

[list]
[*][i][u]First progression line:[/u] Earn the "A Decade at Sea" flag, Blue Explosion enemy destruction effect, Commander Mikhail Orlov, and a Premium Ship VII container.[/i]
[*][u]Second progression line[/u] (2,500 Doubloons): Unlocks Commander Doktor von Roth immediately. Rewards include the "Blazing Ray" and "Cold Ray" camouflages, new Italian Tier VII cruiser Optio, and "This Is Fine" enemy destruction effect.
[*][i]Extra levels reward 1x More Signals container (first line) or 1x Rare Bonuses container (second line).[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Blast From the Past[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/73063ca79d0e83bfa45f1eda8bcf2b052b58d073.jpg[/img]

Relive the history of World of Warships in a special battle type!

[list]
[*][i]Six chapters recreate different eras of the game's development: 2015, 2017, 2019, 2020, 2022, and a final modern-restriction chapter.[/i]
[*][b]Surface ships only: [u]No submarines or carriers.[/u][/b]
[*][i]12v12 Domination and Standard battles with year-based restrictions on maps and ships.[/i]
[/list]

[h2]New German Cruisers: Early Access[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/77a79fcb7c8689d9f5ba413af9a11ae092e4eeb4.jpg[/img]

A brand-new cruiser branch arrives!

[list]
[*][i]Deutschland, Admiral Scheer, Knesebeck, Manteuffel, and Prinz Adalbert join Early Access.[/i]
[*]Brawling playstyle with large-caliber, short-range guns and manually controlled secondaries.
[*][i]Heavy armor and improved Hydroacoustic Search, but low agility.[/i]
[*]Permanent camouflages available for Knesebeck, Manteuffel, and Prinz Adalbert.
[*][i]Sequential bundles unlock in the second week of Update 14.8.[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Asymmetric Battles Return[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/42604f81a2f933f320424f85eab562f2d1efd862.jpg[/img]

Back and here for longer than ever!

[list]
[*][i]Available from mid-September through Update 15.2 (five months).[/i]
[*]Classic format: 5 human players vs. 12 AI-controlled ships, two tiers lower.
[*][i]Playable on Tier VI–X ships and superships.[/i]
[*]Expanded map pool that includes over 25 maps.
[/list]

[h2]"In the Name of Tomorrow" Continues[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/67af33044ccbadb75298a884dd7e0a23ea3bd33e.jpg[/img]

Narrative Operations return for two more weeks.

[list]
[*][i]Participate in Arctic Convoy, Tokyo Express, and Pacific Offensive Operations (Tier VII–IX ships).[/i]
[*]Earn Stars through tasks to progress the campaign of U.S. Navy officer Robert Adams.
[*][i]Final reward: Tier VIII San Diego.[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Improvements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e30f70131f93f3a373873a590f25e86cafbb93b5.jpg[/img]

Polished mechanics and new options.

[list]
[*][i]Module Damage Rework:[/i] Modules can no longer be permanently destroyed. Instead, they enter a new "Critically Damaged" state before automatically recovering. Reloads now pause instead of resetting.
[*]Submarines are now playable in Operations, with increased mobility, Call Patrol Bomber support, and enabled torpedo shotgunning.
[*][i]Clan Battles Season 31 "Mahi-Mahi" begins, plus Ranked Battles and three new Brawls across September and October.[/i]
[/list]

[h2]The Laffey Dockyard Continues[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b4205789da8d700df28945d54b2424518635c979.jpg[/img]

Build the iconic destroyer!

[list]
[*][i]20 Dockyard phases (18 via missions, 2 with Doubloons).[/i] 
[*]Available until the start of Update 14.9.
[/list]

[h2]10th Anniversary Wishing Wharf[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/eddf7bb5b98a5ce52e89e991c99eb571170ee38f.jpg[/img]

Try your luck in a limited-time Armory event!

[list]
[*][i]Spend Tries to roll from a large pool of rewards.[/i] 
[*]Available throughout the anniversary celebrations.
[/list]

This is just the beginning, so dive into Update 14.8 and celebrate a decade of World of Warships! Read the full update article here:

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 14.8
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ead6990ac32e7576b6fd3d4330265e6ee3772bfa.jpg[/img]
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 14.8. For more information, visit the relevant link:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/work-in-progress-148/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/public-test/work-in-progress-148/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/public-test/work-in-progress-148/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[i][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.[/i]

Captains!

With Update 14.7 now out, Update 14.8 is next in line! And 14.8 is not just any old update—it'll play host to our game's 10th Anniversary megacelebration, complete with fun activities, new ships, and lots and lots of gifts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7c648a06fdd4a732a2f702182371b0cae2bc2d5e.jpg[/img]

Here's a quick breakdown of some of the most notable new content coming in 14.8:
[list]
[*][b]A Decade at Sea:[/b] We've got a whole host of activities and rewards ready to go for our 10th Anniversary celebration, including Battle Performance Bonuses that can net you rewards like Tier X Japanese cruiser Kushiro; a new Port and personalized battle record to honor the game's history and the mark you left in it; and expanded log-in rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/17e5eec7be825b8cfa103b8bb09debfdeb6be734.jpg[/img]
[*][b]Blast From the Past:[/b] A new temporary battle type available for all in 14.8 goes out to our most hardened veterans. This nostalgic experience unfolds over six chapters, each representing different epochs in our game's history with the appropriate ship restrictions. In addition to this, the return of Asymmetric Battles will round off the battle types introduced in this update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f33415856ea472fdc9ac27f3d20a9d0687d008b4.jpg[/img]
[*][b]New German cruisers in Early Access:[/b] Cruisers Deutschland, Admiral Scheer, Knesebeck, Manteuffel, and Prinz Adalbert are entering Early Access! Built for close-quarters combat, these ships stand out for their ability to manually control their secondary batteries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e3cf5ed3e6cd41957b810b713d4e0db1c943273a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6e29c353d479bdd8f49bcccbc87c95e74b11bcdc.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e00ba68a521c3ca72be32031dc9beaf0ea401e1d.jpg[/img]
[/list]

If you want the full, detailed breakdown on these features and more, you'll have to check out our dedicated article on our website! Click through to it right here:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/work-in-progress-148/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/public-test/work-in-progress-148/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/public-test/work-in-progress-148/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

notes.title: Weekend Highlights | 14.7 #1
notes.content:
[h2]Update 14.7 Is a Go![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a0b2d736fbf9571edaa8136b0250346c1204124e.jpg[/img]

The arrival of Update 14.7 promises an August full of new content, fun events, new ships, and improvements. Let's get into it…

[list]
[*]The [b]"In the Name of Tomorrow"[/b] event, which encompasses historically inspired Operations, a narrative campaign, and a new collection.
[*]Unsinkable USS [b]Laffey[/b], now available for construction at the [b]Dockyard[/b].
[*][b]10th Anniversary: Grand Voyage[/b]—a multi-update celebration bringing Doubloons, Steel, and a free GQ Johnny for our 10th Anniversary and all the way through to the New Year!
[*][b]Changes to aircraft carriers[/b] and general aviation gameplay, including changes to detectability ranges.
[/list]

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-14-7-in-the-name-of-tomorrow/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url]

[h2]In the Name of Tomorrow[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b4473cd835d7ffee09e657d405f87c86ba973d45.jpg[/img]

80 years ago this month, World War II came to an end. We're commemorating it with an update-long event where you can follow a [b]narrative-driven campaign[/b] about a U.S. naval officer who experiences the war from its sudden beginning to its hard-won end.

Take part in [b]weekly Operations[/b] inspired by chronologically unfolding events of the war, and earn Stars to progress through the story's stages. You can earn up to 70 Victory Tokens—enough to purchase up to seven of the new [b]War Is Over containers[/b], which can drop historical Premium ships like new [b]Barfleur[/b], [b]Arkhangelsk[/b], and [b]Royal Sovereign[/b]. 

Completing all the campaign stages will bring you cruiser San Diego herself as the final reward. This historically celebrated vessel was the first Allied ship to enter Tokyo Bay after the end of hostilities. 

More info:
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/sales-and-events/in-the-name-of-tomorrow-offers-unlocked/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url]

[h2]10th Anniversary: Grand Voyage[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ca89a16f863a69a0b95b884c194f4815cfebd14c.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=ZpNL5y6jMkc;full][/previewyoutube]

Update 14.7 marks the beginning of the massive Grand Voyage event in World of Warships! Join us for a multi-update celebration that will allow you to earn destroyer GQ Johnny and up to 32,000 [b]Voyage Tokens[/b] that can be exchanged for Doubloons or Steel at a 1:1 rate.

The event starts with three different activities:

[list]
[*][b]Welcome Bonus[/b]: Just log in to activate a special series of missions that simply require you to fight one battle per day to earn 350 Voyage Tokens each day. The mission can be completed up to 24 times, and you'll earn a bonus reward of 1,600 Voyage Tokens for doing that! 
[*][b]Daily Reward[/b]: A battle a day will earn you 150 Voyage Tokens, and the more days you play, the more rewards you'll get—up to a total of 22,000 Voyage Tokens just for fighting a single battle daily until the event ends.
[*][b]Free GQ Johnny[/b]: Fight three battles per day to get 1 GQ Johnny Token, and then fight two more battles on that day to get another Token. Fill the event progress bar with 180 GQ Johnny Tokens, and you'll obtain the ship herself!
[/list]

More info:
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/10th-anniversary-grand-voyage/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url]

[h2]Dockyard: Laffey[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b4205789da8d700df28945d54b2424518635c979.jpg[/img]

Update 14.7 lays the keel of a new ship at the Dockyard—you can add U.S. Tier X destroyer [b]Laffey[/b] to your fleet by building her!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2aa9f3b6d7f8bfda6a02003530c5f11eab4a446a.png[/img]

To build your Laffey, you need to progress through 20 Dockyard phases. Of these, [b]18 can be completed via dedicated combat missions[/b] that offer additional valuable rewards, including the Underwater Explosion enemy destruction effect.

More info:
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/laffey-at-the-dockyard-147/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url]

[h2]Take the 14.7 Survey![/h2]

Enjoying the new features introduced by Update 14.7? Let us know what you think via the survey link below!

[url=https://surveys.wargaming.net/s3/UPD14-7 style=button][b]Take Survey[/b][/url]

[url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/a-decade-at-sea-closed-test-148 style=button][b]Click Here for the Full Dev Blog Post[/b][/url]

notes.title: Update 14.7 | In the Name of Tomorrow, Laffey Dockyard, and Grand Voyage!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a0b2d736fbf9571edaa8136b0250346c1204124e.jpg[/img]

Here's an overview of the major highlights introduced in Update 14.7. Be sure to check out the full details on our website:

[previewyoutube=a4WtG-x72dE;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-14-7-in-the-name-of-tomorrow/#down-content style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-14-7-in-the-name-of-tomorrow/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-14-7-in-the-name-of-tomorrow/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]In the Name of Tomorrow: Special Operations[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b4473cd835d7ffee09e657d405f87c86ba973d45.jpg[/img]

Take part in three cinematic, historically inspired Operations with unique rewards and gameplay!

[list]
[*][i]Each Operation runs for a week, with all returning to rotation after 3 weeks.[/i]
[*]Seven-player teams fight waves of bots; no submarines.
[*][i]Tier and nation restrictions apply; rentals available.[/i]
[*]Earn Stars by completing main and secondary objectives.
[*][i]Unlock a narrative campaign featuring Commander Robert Adams, historical story videos, and themed rewards.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/982ae8357622fe319a2651b695f0bdf3b939d46f.jpg[/img]
[*]Grand prize: Tier VIII Premium cruiser [b]San Diego[/b]; compensation in Doubloons if already owned.
[*]Complete the campaign to unlock discounted Missouri bundles in the Armory and her Festive permanent camouflage.
[/list]

[h2]80 Years Since Victory: Event Pass[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/03edf68c956198a287544dafa6563aa0e1f90b8c.jpg[/img]

Two progression lines with WWII-themed rewards.

[list]
[*][i][u]First progression line:[/u] 2x War Is Over containers, the 80 Years Since Victory flag, and the Stormy Sky permanent camouflage for Nebraska.[/i]
[*][u]Second progression line[/u] (2,500 Doubloons): Offers the Traditions of the North permanent camouflage for Skåne, De Grasse with Port slot, the Underwater Explosion enemy destruction effect, 2x War Is Over Premium containers, and finishes with the Traditions of the North camo for Östergötland.
[*][i]Extra levels reward 1x More Signals container (first line) or 1x Rare Bonuses container (second line).[/i]
[*]Full compensation is provided in Credits if you already own any of the key rewards.
[/list]

[h2]Dockyard: Laffey[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b4205789da8d700df28945d54b2424518635c979.jpg[/img]

Construct U.S. Tier X destroyer Laffey—"The Ship That Would Not Die."

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2aa9f3b6d7f8bfda6a02003530c5f11eab4a446a.png[/img]
[*][i]20 construction phases; 18 can be completed via missions.[/i]
[*]Starter Packs (2 and 6 phases) available for Doubloons early on.
[*][i]Laffey is a gun-focused destroyer with Burst Fire, strong concealment, a unique Smoke Generator, and an enhanced Specialized Repair Teams consumable.[/i]
[*]Includes the Underwater Explosion enemy destruction effect.
[*][b]Dockyard ends with the release of Update 14.9.[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Grand Voyage: 10th Anniversary Begins[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ca89a16f863a69a0b95b884c194f4815cfebd14c.jpg[/img]

Celebrate the WoWS 10th Anniversary with our long-term event!

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e44834bc6629e186fa955e9d75bcaac1dedc8d7f.jpg[/img]
[*][i]Play daily to earn up to 32,000 Voyage Tokens—exchangeable 1:1 for Doubloons or Steel.[/i]
[*]Earn iconic ship [b]GQ Johnny[/b] (USS Johnston with battle damage) by fighting daily battles.
[*][i]Missed days won't ruin progress—complete at your own pace.[/i]
[*]Special missions and milestones, including Welcome Bonus and Daily Rewards.
[*]Voyage Token exchange available in the Armory and on the event web page.
[/list]

[h2]Aircraft Carrier & Aviation Changes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7151f253d0bd019b22079ba5440d6c188e2588a1.jpg[/img]

Refinements to detection, fire mechanics, and secondary battery controls.

[list]
[*][i]Fires on ships now increase air detectability by 2 km (was 3 km)[/i]
[*]All aircraft now share detectability of 10 km; spotting range increased to 20 km.
[*][i]Manual control added for carrier secondaries with adjusted stats.[/i]
[*]Standardization of air detectability and spotting across ship types.
[*][i]Fires on carriers burn longer but deal less damage; Damage Control Party cooldown reduced.[/i]
[*]HP lost to aircraft and submarine torpedoes can now be restored by the same amount regardless of hit location.
[/list]

[h2]Ongoing Early Access: American Destroyers[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8f61b94715366724568bba99c191c2f2ce604215.jpg[/img]

American Token bundles return with artillery–focused destroyers.

[list]
[*][i]Obtain Hughes, Osborne, Christopher, and Burrows via sequential bundles.[/i]
[*]American Tokens are available in Doubloon bundles.
[*][i]Includes permanent camos: "The Righteous" (Christopher) and "The Wanted" (Burrows).[/i]
[*]Unused Tokens will be converted into Credits (1:15,000) in Update 14.8.
[/list]

[h2]Brawls[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3baebf40ccad6ac9b3880670c5e341a63145fb20.jpg[/img]

Three new Brawls with unique formats!

[list]
[*][i][b]Brawl #1:[/b] 3v3; Tier VII; no destroyers, max 2 cruisers per team.[/i]
[*][b]Brawl #2:[/b] 3v3; Tier IX; mixed teams, max 2 of each ship type.
[*][i][b]Brawl #3:[/b] 2v2; Tier X; max 1 battleship + 1 cruiser per team, no carriers or submarines.[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Armory Updates[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3ca207c9480b2a1297435366ec2d8d7583262c20.jpg[/img]

New additions and major expansion of the content rarity system.

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5ee302c4aaa3d106b21ed7875c72ad47b3214f51.jpg[/img]
[*][i][b]New ship:[/b] Amiral Lartigue (31,000 Steel)—French hybrid with accurate guns and skip bombers.[/i]
[*]Content rarity system expanded to Armory items, Captain's Logbook, and Container Barge rewards.
[*]Filter by rarity added for easier browsing.
[/list]

This is just the beginning—dive into Update 14.7 and explore it all! Read the full update article here:

[h2]Early Access Guide: New U.S. Destroyers[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e635eb6d0d876f81a470dffa2d026c2c50cc57c8.jpg[/img]

The most fearsome gunslingers this side of the mighty Mississippi have drifted into Port out of a mysterious cloud of smoke. Meet [b]Hughes[/b], [b]Osborne[/b], [b]Christopher[/b], and [b]Burrows[/b]—four new destroyers coming soon to the U.S. Tech Tree—but [b]you don't have to wait to try them out[/b]!

[previewyoutube=EqbjlV5GqQk;full][/previewyoutube]

The main features of the ships are: 
[list]
[*][b]Their fearsome guns[/b], which have long range, high damage per minute, and the ability to fire both HE and SAP shells
[*]A unique [b]Smoke Generator with a time pool[/b] instead of the usual "charge" concept—a flexible tool for both defensive and offensive actions.
[/list]

You can get these destroyers from sequential bundles available in the Armory for [b]American Tokens[/b], with Burrows available for Doubloons.

You can get [b]American Tokens[/b] by purchasing random bundles with Doubloons, by completing levels of the U.S. Destroyers Event Pass, and by completing personal challenges throughout the update.

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 14.7 Round 3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ead6990ac32e7576b6fd3d4330265e6ee3772bfa.jpg[/img]
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 14.7. For more information, visit the relevant link:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/work-in-progress-147/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/public-test/work-in-progress-147/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/public-test/work-in-progress-147/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[i][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.[/i]

Hey, Captains!

We hope you're enjoying all the content in Update 14.6, but doesn't it all just make you wonder what's coming in Update 14.7? Don't worry—we've got you covered with our new Work in Progress article.

Here's a quick breakdown of some of the most notable new content coming in Update 14.7:
[list]
[*][b]In the Name of Tomorrow:[/b] Immerse yourself in historically inspired weekly Operations that weave together to tell the story of the run-up to the end of World War II on this, its 80th anniversary.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/bcf8c368ecfbea9643925548d051cfb23d8fbdb3.jpg[/img]

[*][b]Aircraft Updates:[/b] A substantial first wave of changes to aviation mechanics and aircraft carriers are coming in 14.7, including manual control of secondary guns on carriers and standardization of aerial detectability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7a13bec0a5daaa605b2661b37f7fa831be48ae9e.jpg[/img]

[*][b]Laffey at the Dockyard:[/b] U.S. Tier X destroyer Laffey, AKA “The Ship That Would Not Die” due to her reputation for robustness during World War II, will be available to construct at the Dockyard!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b508bb9e5bf4630b5232aa31621b00c6b9da0a41.jpg[/img]

[/list]

If you want the full, detailed breakdown, you'll have to check out our dedicated article on our website! Click through to it right here:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/work-in-progress-147/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/public-test/work-in-progress-147/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/public-test/work-in-progress-147/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

notes.title: Weekend Highlights | 14.6 #1
notes.content:
[h2]Update 14.6 Arrives With New American Destroyers in Tow![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f202711b794b4cc244a205a4168eb0b51e1a1590.png[/img]

A refreshing splash of new World of Warships content is here to add a touch of cool to the blazing summer heat! Read the [b]Update 14.6 changelog[/b] via the link below to learn all about:

[list]
[*]Early Access to a gunslinging new branch of smokey [b]American destroyers[/b].
[*][b]Leaderboard events[/b] to give experimental ships and Operations with Flagships a proper send-off as they leave the game.
[*][b]Graphical updates[/b] to facilitate smoother edges, crisper motion, and visual stability.
[*]Introduction of a [b]content rarity system[/b] to make rare and exclusive items easily identifiable.
[*]Season 24 of [b]Ranked Battles[/b].
[*]And more!
[/list]

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-14-6-new-american-destroyers/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-14-6-new-american-destroyers/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-14-6-new-american-destroyers/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]Say "Farewell" to the Experimental Ships With a Lucrative Leaderboard![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f829226eb663a579228db76b774dcc91ab326343.jpg[/img]

During the first week of Update 14.6, you can join a leaderboard event dedicated to Tier X cruiser [b]Varese[/b] from the second group of experimental ships. Compete against other players to achieve the highest total damage in a single Random Battle. If you rank in the top 25, you'll earn famous destroyer USS [b]Johnston[/b], with the following 75 places granting large sums of Coal.

Everyone who [b]fights at least one Random Battle at the helm of Varese[/b] and deals damage will not only be considered as participants of the leaderboard, but they will also receive the guaranteed participation reward: 40,000 Elite Commander XP.

More info:
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/final-update-for-time-limited-mechanics/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url]

[h2]New Ranked Battles Season[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a0d74bdb1b2612214501c288898c9ab86d95ddac.jpg[/img]

A new Ranked Battles season is already in session! Gear up now and remember—the road to the cusp of Gold League is paved with sweet, sweet [b]Steel[/b]!

[list]
[*]Bronze League: 6v6; Tier VII–VIII ships
[*]Silver League: 6v6; Tier IX–X ships; no submarines allowed
[*]Gold League: 6v6; Tier X ships; no aircraft carriers allowed
[/list]

[h2]Unbreakable Line Respawns in Update 14.6![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8961a02e85d40d36971b3188e86d7eb22e315332.jpg[/img]

Unbreakable Line, a battle type that lets you quickly return to the battle if your ship is sunk, is still available in Update 14.6! The rules remain mostly the same as in the previous iteration. The main change is that this time, you can sail Tier IX and X cruisers, battleships, and destroyers into the action.

[h2]Take the 14.6 Survey![/h2]

Enjoying the new features introduced by Update 14.6? Let us know what you think via the survey link below!

[url=https://surveys.wargaming.net/s3/UPD14-6 style=button][b]Take Survey[/b][/url]

notes.title: Update 14.6 | American Destroyers, Event Pass, and Major Improvements!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/366c1cd1c943d93a9452436287ed2b3bed9dfd64.jpg[/img]
Here’s an overview of the major highlights introduced in Update 14.6. Be sure to check out the full details on our website:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-14-6-new-american-destroyers/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-14-6-new-american-destroyers/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-14-6-new-american-destroyers/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[previewyoutube=5Iu9qQDj-84;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Early Access: American Destroyers[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f202711b794b4cc244a205a4168eb0b51e1a1590.png[/img]

Welcome a new line of American destroyers with a focus on main battery firepower!

[list]
[*][i]Tier VII Hughes, Tier VIII Osborne, Tier IX Christopher, and Tier X Burrows feature HE and SAP shells.[/i]
[*]Starting from Tier VIII, they carry high-DPM 137 mm guns and have larger HP pools.
[*][i]Minimal torpedo armament, low concealment capacity. These ships favor mid- to long-range engagements.[/i]
[*]Unique toggleable Smoke Generator mechanic adds tactical flexibility.
[*]Available via sequential bundles for American Tokens and Doubloons during Early Access.
[/list]

[h2]Event Pass: American & French Flair[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/47da375a601b833620f80bf78f7e75695003a1ed.jpg[/img]

Collect new content through this classic two-line Event Pass!

[list]
[*][i][u]First progression line:[/u] 400 American Tokens, 3 days of Premium Account, 2x French Squadron containers, and the "Go Navy!" permanent camouflage for Cleveland.[/i]
[*][u]Second progression line[/u] (2,500 Doubloons): West Virginia permanent camouflage (immediate), West Virginia '41 herself, 4x French Squadron containers, 1x Journey to the West Premium container, and the French Navy permanent camouflage for Le Fantasque..
[*]Extra levels reward 1x More Signals container (first line) or 1x Rare Bonuses container (second line).
[/list]

[h2]Personal Challenges Return[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7a148214a2c0115cc26efee9e408f1bedc27dcea.jpg[/img]

Back as part of Early Access for destroyers!

[list]
[*][i]Runs until Update 14.7, in two sprints of two weeks each.[/i]
[*]Earn American Tokens through Base XP milestones.
[/list]

[h2]Massive Graphics & Interface Updates[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2b59be0c5ae79ef70925fe3a679606e12ccd8860.jpg[/img]

Enjoy a smoother, cleaner look!

[list]
[*][i]WG Temporal Super Sampling (TSS) enhances anti-aliasing and image stability.[/i]
[*][b]Container barge now features:[/b]
[*][i]Faster access to container lists from the main screen.[/i]
[*]Reward previews with drop chances.
[*][i]Guaranteed reward counter.[/i]
[*]New options for mass opening with safety confirmations.
[*]Barge animations can now be disabled.
[/list]

[h2]Content Rarity System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/75ca9533865fe7076b2a107f08cebd22874b3ac6.jpg[/img]

Understand exclusivity at a glance!

[list]
[*][i]Ships, camouflages, and effects now show rarity grades: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary.[/i]
[*]Pricing across the game aligns with these categories.
[*]Clarifies effort vs. accessibility, but does not indicate power level.
[/list]

[h2]Ship Rotation System[/h2]

Streamlining the Armory and Premium Shop.

[list]
[*][i]Popular ships stay available; others rotate on a scheduled basis.[/i]
[*]First rotation: Brisbane, Almirante Grau, Nottingham, and Numancia (for Doubloons); Nottingham also for Coal.
[*]San Diego and Leone removed, but San Diego returns in Update 14.7’s event collection; Leone remains in the Italian Destroyers collection.
[/list]

[h2]Final Update: Experimental Ships & Classified Documents[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8961a02e85d40d36971b3188e86d7eb22e315332.jpg[/img]

Closing chapters on temporary mechanics.

[list]
[*][i]Operations with Flagships and experimental ships end with Update 14.6.[/i]
[*]Classified Documents now upgradeable to Level 11.
[*][i]Complete experimental ship research now for final rewards in Update 14.7.[/i]
[*]Leaderboards are live, so check your standings!
[/list]

[h2]Blue Archive Collaboration: Chapter Two[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/19ac4a07d4dd0ca0b921891ccb91fe9db82d75b7.jpg[/img]

Class is back in session on the high seas!

[list]
[*][i]Four new Blue Archive ships and exclusive camouflages.[/i]
[*]Four new themed commanders with individual voiceovers.
[*]Sail in style with Kivotos-themed flair and charm!
[/list]

[h2]Grand Trial – Public Test Challenge[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ead6990ac32e7576b6fd3d4330265e6ee3772bfa.jpg[/img]

The summer phase continues!

[list]
[*][i]Earn rewards by completing tasks across test phases of Updates 14.6–14.8.[/i]
[*]Main reward for Update 14.6: 1x Soviet Era container and 1x Soviet Era Premium container.
[*]Complete all seasonal phases for the ultimate annual prize.
[/list]

This is just the beginning, so dive into Update 14.6 and explore it all. Read the full update article here:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d534d40f1d970887b4cdd30d5acc4963d747330a.png[/img]

The stage is set for a brawl-filled weekend! We hope you like [b]Tier X ships[/b], because they are running the show this session in a [b]5 vs. 5[/b] format.

If you have a handful of buddies on standby, we suggest lassoing them into a Division for maximum coordination and efficiency. Just remember the [b]ship restrictions[/b]: No more than 1 aircraft carrier, 3 battleships, 4 cruisers, and 3 destroyers per team.

[h2]Join the Respawn-a-Thon![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/181345cad90656819646e294d7045afe66e69fad.jpg[/img]

In Unbreakable Line, all destroyed ships respawn after a short delay, and teams fight for victory by earning points. This means that wiping out the enemy team entirely is not an available path to victory. Battles are fought in a 7 vs. 7 format with Tier IX–X destroyers, cruisers, and battleships.

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 14.6 Round 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ead6990ac32e7576b6fd3d4330265e6ee3772bfa.jpg[/img]
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 14.6. For more information, visit the relevant link:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/work-in-progress-146/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/public-test/work-in-progress-146/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/public-test/work-in-progress-146/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[i][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.[/i]

Hey, Captains!

With Update 14.5 in full swing, it's now time to cast our eyes forward and take a sneak peek at the fun new features Update 14.6 will be delivering in just a few short weeks!

Here's a quick breakdown of some of the most notable new additions:
[list]
[*][b]New U.S. destroyers:[/b] Ships of the new branch are great gunslingers and have a unique new feature—a Smoke Generator that can be toggled on or off!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e9b9b328109a58063fa135d66a665e0120260605.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f90f4a467e11d3802be6f996f34699552cea2acd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/94bee02adb33ad945ee8102099fd32710af9f862.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b6633fe4402792831778b19f72f597c910fb5b8c.jpg[/img]
[*][b]Graphical improvements:[/b] Enabling the WG Temporal Super Sampling setting in your game client will deliver sharper visuals and smoother edges without significantly impacting performance.
[*][b]Rarity system:[/b] It'll soon be a lot more intuitive to understand just how unique in-game content is thanks to a new system of visual rarity for ships, camos, and beyond. This improvement goes hand-in-hand with a standardized pricing model for direct sales based on this system.
[*][b]Container Barge improvements:[/b] This package of changes aims to improve your experience on the container-opening screen, with the introduction of an animation skip, better container content breakdowns, more flexible options for bulk opening, and an integrated guaranteed drop counter!
[/list]

If you want the full and detailed breakdown, check out a dedicated article on our website! Click through to it right here:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/work-in-progress-146/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/public-test/work-in-progress-146/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/public-test/work-in-progress-146/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

notes.title: Weekend Highlights | 14.5 #1
notes.content:
[h2]Update 14.5 Changelog[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/541fd50598417a7f28b0518642e4cdfae54d77a7.jpg[/img]

A new update has just been rolled out, Captains! Be sure to take the time to give our changelog publication a once-over to learn all about the new features, ships, battle types, and events that you can interact with in the weeks to come. You'll find it in all its glory via this link:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-145-summer-festival/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url]

[h2]New Experimental Ships & Oregon Leaderboard Event[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f829226eb663a579228db76b774dcc91ab326343.jpg[/img]

New experimental ships [b]Protector[/b], [b]Hotaka[/b], and [b]Varese[/b] have splashed into the game, joining the first round of ships—Metz, Vyazma, and Oregon—introduced earlier this year. The newcomers stand out for their close-range specialty that's complemented by their unique experimental feature: their secondary battery firing range and reload time improve relative to the damage they take.

[h3]Compete to Win Destroyer Johnston[/h3]

A new 1-week Leaderboard event has begun! Climb aboard experimental ship [b]Oregon[/b] and try your best to [b]inflict the most damage possible in a single battle[/b]. The top 25 players will win [b]U.S. Premium destroyer Johnston[/b], and the next 75 players will receive bundles of Coal.

Everything you need to know about the new experimental ships and Oregon leaderboard is available via this link:
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/second-group-of-experimental-ships/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url]

[h2]Familiar Battle Types Return![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/0dbb5b6909294382e39900c18ec37a3ef1ac5170.jpg[/img]

Two familiar temporary battle types have entered the game for Update 14.5—have a go at both this weekend!

[list]
[*][b]Asymmetric Battles[/b]: The tried-and-true battle type that pits a smaller team of players against a larger team of lower-tier bots.
[*][b]Unbreakable Line[/b]: A more recent addition to the roster of temporary battle types. The main feature of these player vs. player confrontations is that when you're destroyed, you respawn!
[/list]

[h2]Team League X Tournament Streams[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6b08249eb18924d10922fddece187b87dd4013f0.jpg[/img]

It's back—the popular community tournament where World of Warships Twitch streamers create their own teams from pools of players of all skill levels, then pit them against each other!

Tune in for some fun shenanigans by [b]watching any of the 12 participating streamers[/b]' channels to get unique views of all the action and take part in [b]giveaways[/b]. There's also a [b]dedicated Twitch Drop[/b] going on during the tournament, so keep an eye out!

More info and the full list of streamers can be found via this link:
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/community/streamer-team-league-10/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/community/streamer-team-league-10/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/community/streamer-team-league-10/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]Steam-O-Rama[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ea0a40bc0095e590f3931aa3b5c3deed74b0e30d.jpg[/img]

Gear up for 3 weeks of high-profile raffles, featuring rewards such as a bundle with [b]German Steam-chan[/b], [b]Premium ship containers[/b], and [b]lots of other goods![/b] Simply opt in and complete weekly combat missions, and don't miss out on the special Flag-o-Rama event to gain access to the largest raffle of them all!

Join the event via this link:
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/steam-o-rama/ style=button][b]Participate[/b][/url]

[h2]World Ocean Day Event[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/37f383cc74d1800b83e8e578cf08e7decca3b2bf.jpg[/img]

We're raising awareness this June for the noble cause of ocean conservation, together with our partners [b]Bunq[/b] and [b]Fisher Space Pen[/b], as well as the non-profit organization, [b]FORCE BLUE[/b].

Take part in an in-game Base XP earning contest and multiple raffles for a chance to win [b]Amazon vouchers[/b], [b]high quality pens[/b], and valuable [b]in-game goodies[/b].

Learn how to participate in our dedicated article:
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/world-ocean-day-win-prizes-and-help-save-our-seas/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] 

[h2]Take the 14.5 Survey![/h2]

Enjoying the new features introduced by Update 14.5? Let us know what you think via the survey link below!

[url=https://surveys.wargaming.net/s3/UPD14-5 style=button][b]Take Survey[/b][/url]

notes.title: Update 14.5 | Summer Festival, Asymmetric Battles, and More!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/541fd50598417a7f28b0518642e4cdfae54d77a7.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=0tpNlioUJ9U;full][/previewyoutube]

Here’s an overview of the major highlights introduced in Update 14.5. Be sure to check out the full details on our website:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-145-summer-festival/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url]

[h2]Summer Festival Event Pass[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/aaafcf2f1fbdff0959710455955ea3f70d276025.jpg[/img]

Dive into summer with our vibrant new Event Pass!

[list]
[*][u]First line rewards:[/u] 3 days of Premium Account, the "Boom!" enemy destruction effect, and Commander Marina Carmen Fernández with 10 skill points and an individual voiceover.
[*]Unlock the second line for 2,500 Doubloons to instantly receive the Pin-Up Summer permanent camouflage.
[*]Earn Italian Tier VI Premium cruiser Duca d’Aosta and 150 Summer Tokens to spend in the Armory event.
[*]Extra levels award More Signals containers (first line) and Rare Bonuses containers (second line).
[/list]

[h2]Asymmetric Battles Return[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/99db0738249dcbd9e2e9a31d8256dde07b24638c.jpg[/img]

Take on a team of bots in this fan-favorite battle mode!

[list]
[*]5-player teams face off against 12 bots, with a one-tier difference limit.
[*]Playable with Tier VI–X ships and superships.
[*]Bots are two tiers lower than player ships (excluding submarines).
[*]Form Divisions with up to 5 players. Limited to 1 aircraft carrier, 2 battleships, 2 cruisers, 2 destroyers, and 1 submarine.
[/list]

[h2]Unbreakable Line Returns – [u]Now With Tier X![/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e1297f9fe36a4246e6c344ad7cdacf38b05d90c5.jpg[/img]

The action-packed respawn mode is back with changes!

[list]
[*]7v7 battles with Tier IX–X cruisers, battleships, and destroyers.
[*]12-minute battles on smaller maps with respawns 15 seconds after destruction.
[*]Victory by reaching 1,000 points or finishing the battle in the lead. No points are lost for ships sinking!
[*]Temporary buffs on respawn; consumables do not refresh.
[*]Expanded map pool: Big Race, Hotspot, Land of Fire, Sea of Fortune, Trident, Loop, Sleeping Giant, and Greece.
[/list]

[h2]Second Group of Experimental Ships[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b6f5d16f8ee65d83b084298c6989cf1c250e788f.jpg[/img]

Three new close-range brawlers enter testing!

[list]
[*]Protector – U.S. Tier VIII cruiser
[*]Hotaka – Japanese Tier IX battleship
[*]Varese – Italian Tier X cruiser
[*]Powerful secondaries gain range and firing rate as HP decreases.
[*]Find out how to unlock the newcomers in a dedicated article on our website.
[/list]

[h2]Clan Battles: Man o’ War and Classified Documents[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/de4677f5f5ae1881984af289a106682a6a50db19.jpg[/img]

The new Clan Battle season introduces a tactical edge!

[list]
[*]Classified Documents grant specific advantages against enemy ships.
[*]Select up to 2 per ship before battle (fewer for overperforming ships).
[*]Aims to improve balance without banning popular ships.
[/list]

[h2]Updated Operations with Flagships[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/0c4f6056dfddc4ef2a78be44af49e9e87a711bbe.jpg[/img]

More power, more upgrades!

[list]
[*]Classified Documents can now be upgraded to Level 8.
[*]Earn Intel Tokens from various battle types to level up.
[*]Be more effective against powerful flagship enemies.
[/list]

[h2]Armory Highlights[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3ca207c9480b2a1297435366ec2d8d7583262c20.jpg[/img]

Big updates and returning favorites!

[list]
[*]Battle of Paso de Patria containers now available for Coal—get Commander Joaquim Marques Lisboa!
[*]Trade-In event lets you exchange Premium ships for Doubloon discounts.
[*]Get Johnston and her damaged replica, GQ Johnny, via bundles or direct purchase.
[*]Complete the Still Standing collection for Commander Ernest E. Evans and more.
[/list]

[h2]Star Trek Collaboration Returns[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e4e95ffeba3913dfa6eb3ef651528460be50058c.jpg[/img]

Beam aboard new and returning items!

[list]
[*]Earn "To Boldly Go" or Assimilated camouflages, a Star Trek Port, and Premium containers.
[*]Complete missions and browse the Armory and Premium Shop for themed rewards.
[/list]

[h2]Grand Trial – Public Test Challenge[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7a148214a2c0115cc26efee9e408f1bedc27dcea.jpg[/img]

Take part in this year-long Public Test event!

[list]
[*]Complete seasonal tasks for rewards across four phases.
[*]The Spring Phase (14.3–14.5) offers the Grand Trial flag and patch.
[*]Main reward for Update 14.5: 1x German Squadron container and 1x German Squadron Premium container.
[*]Finish all four phases to earn a Premium Ship VIII Elite container!
[/list]

This is just the beginning, so dive into Update 14.5 and explore it all! Read the full update article here:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-145-summer-festival/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url]

[h2]Take the Update 14.5 Survey![/h2]

Enjoying the new features? Let us know your thoughts via the survey link below!

[url=https://surveys.wargaming.net/s3/UPD14-5 style=button][b]Take Survey[/b][/url]

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 14.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ead6990ac32e7576b6fd3d4330265e6ee3772bfa.jpg[/img]
Check out this short overview of the planned features for Update 14.5. For more information, visit the link for your region:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/work-in-progress-145/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/public-test/work-in-progress-145/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/public-test/work-in-progress-145/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[i][b]IMPORTANT![/b] This update is still being tested. The information in this article reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication and is subject to change. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.[/i]

[previewyoutube=iqHUGJ1SmZA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Asymmetric Battles[/h2]

This fan-favorite battle type is returning in Update 14.5! Asymmetric Battles pit 12 lower-tier bots against a 5-player team of higher-tier ships.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/38c086a8e738187cac0360dcfa942bad7a54a273.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/09c74b6a95a3a1041f2c9fd7fb1bb551e93c4726.jpg[/img]

In these battles, five players take on twelve bots, with the following setup:
[list]
[*]You can play Tier VI–X ships and superships.
[*]Bot teams consist of ships that are two tiers lower than each tier in the players' team, with exclusion of submarines.
[/list]

[h2]New Experimental Ships[/h2]

New Experimental Ships [b]Protector[/b], [b]Hotaka[/b], and [b]Varese[/b] are entering the game—the second group of these ships, following Metz, Vyazma, and Oregon that dropped anchor in our game earlier this year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/69b79633093b4ec9c2790b47b38049912ec35b26.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/204fd8fb8791cd74de1f7fc841456f568b6f34fa.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/961384c41eeeee3315d3d54571da42323899e692.jpg[/img]

These newcomers are built for close to medium-range brawls with strong secondary battery performance. As they lose HP, their secondary guns gain an improved rate of fire and range.

[h2]Summer Festival Event Pass[/h2]

In Update 14.5, get ready to dive into the spirit of the season with the Summer Festival Event Pass! Celebrate under the sun with exclusive new rewards that capture all the fun and energy of summer.

[list]
[*]In the [b]first progression line[/b], you’ll find rewards such as 3 days of Warships Premium Account, the "Boom!” enemy destruction effect, and Commander Marina Carmen Fernández with an individual voiceover.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b8383f9ecd72a791fa6839b1af497c9911cc3b41.png[/img]
[*]Unlocking the [b]second progression line[/b] brings the Pin-Up Summer permanent camouflage, cruiser Duca d’Aosta, and a total of 150 Summer Tokens that can be used to progress through the dedicated event in the Armory.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c4d5b376cbbc5cc7017727347ad02ddf414743d5.png[/img]
[/list]

[h2]And More![/h2]

To read more about everything planned for Update 14.5 in World of Warships, check out our dedicated article, where you can learn about the next updates to Operations with Flagships, a new season of Clan Battles, and more:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/work-in-progress-145/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/public-test/work-in-progress-145/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/public-test/work-in-progress-145/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

notes.title: Weekend Highlights | 14.4 #1
notes.content:
[h2]Update 14.4 Changelog[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/85f74edc50d51c2690bed7bbe2a4b36a994af6e3.png[/img]
Before diving headlong into battle, take a moment to read up on what's new in the new game update! You'll find the full breakdown of new features, balance changes, and more via the link:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-144-perilous-route/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-144-perilous-route/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-144-perilous-route/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]The Longest Night of Museums[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/bed3071754475d3e553a646fb17ebe56631f62ce.jpg[/img]
The fifth annual Longest Night of Museums [b]historical megastream[/b] is set to go live this weekend, Captains! Tune in for hours upon hours of live tours made of naval and maritime museums around the world, including special guest appearances, fun activities, and—of course—[b]rewards for viewers[/b]!

Take a look at the full schedule via the link:
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/longest-night-of-museums-2025/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/general-news/longest-night-of-museums-2025/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/general-news/longest-night-of-museums-2025/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]Travel a Perilous Route![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e826139d2a753f8a3413e15c58854005a8f6f2e6.jpg[/img]
A new temporary battle type titled [b]Perilous Route[/b] has appeared in our waters! Inspired by the Convoy battles that you may remember from past updates, you'll be tasked with escorting a damaged [b]command ship[/b] across the map to its destination. 

But it's not as simple as that—along the way, the [b]command ship[/b] will make stops for repairs, during which time, you and your team will be tasked with completing any one of several [b]randomly-chosen sub-objectives[/b]. Once the command ship is fully operational, you'll face off against the bot team in a final standoff!

For more details, check out our dedicated article:
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/perilous-route-in-144/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/general-news/perilous-route-in-144/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/general-news/perilous-route-in-144/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]Get Started on the New Event Pass[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/02f4ec04e544818fd23be680b17f99c9f6cbaabd.jpg[/img]
Update 14.4's Event Pass is themed around Operation Dynamo—commonly known as the Dunkirk evacuation.

[list]
[*]The [b]first progression line[/b] offers rewards such as 5x Operation Dynamo containers, the Monochrome enemy destruction effect, the [b]British Coastal[/b] permanent camouflage, 3 days of Warships Premium Account, and the [b]Industrial[/b] permanent camouflage for [b]Duncan[/b] (the final reward).
[*]The [b]second progression line[/b], which you can unlock with Doubloons, grants the [b]Industrial[/b] permanent camouflage for [b]Hawke[/b], British cruiser [b]London[/b], and 3x Operation Dynamo Premium containers, among other rewards. The final reward of the line is the [b]Industrial[/b] permanent camouflage for [b]St. Vincent[/b].
[/list]

See a more in-depth breakdown of the available rewards via this link:
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/event-pass-144-operation-dynamo/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/general-news/event-pass-144-operation-dynamo/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/general-news/event-pass-144-operation-dynamo/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]Ragnar Lodbrok Reporting for Duty![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6720b5acbcbf7c10708fd539891a5fed1303783f.jpg[/img]
Three new Viking Commanders—or, rather, three aspects of one character—have made it into the game! The famed Viking raider of legend, Ragnar Lodbrok, is available to unlock via combat missions with either a [b]Danish[/b], [b]Norwegian[/b], or [b]Swedish[/b] voiceover—[b]the choice is up to you[/b]! 

Check out our dedicated article and click the link to choose which one you want to enlist!

notes.title: Update 14.4 | Perilous Route, Operation Dynamo & More!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c340b43975e6d74b8a71842d76947b8d4bcd104c.jpg[/img]
Here’s an overview of the major highlights introduced in Update 14.4. Be sure to check out the full details on our website:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-144-perilous-route/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url]

[previewyoutube=U5p26gxmdQA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Perilous Route – A New Temporary Battle Type[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e826139d2a753f8a3413e15c58854005a8f6f2e6.jpg[/img]

In this thrilling new battle type, your mission is to escort a damaged Command Ship along a perilous path while defending it from AI attackers. As the Command Ship is repaired, prepare for an epic final showdown!

[list]
[*]Battle type supports 7 players per team in Tier VIII–IX ships.
[*]All ship types [b]except submarines[/b] are allowed.
[*]Each match features two mandatory tasks of scouting, capturing, or engaging enemies. Plus randomized secondary objectives.
[*]Activate the new “Coordinated Fleet Support” consumable to restore allied HP, with stacking effects if used by multiple players. 
[*]Join solo or as a Division of up to 7 players.
[/list]

[h2]Operations with Flagships – More Dangerous Than Ever[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/bd4a10666b18a80697cd5cf256061a09bbcac39b.jpg[/img]

Flagships are tougher than ever, and each ship type now boasts special powers! For example, battleship flagships summon waves of torpedo boats when spotted.

[list]
[*]New strategic layer: act fast before reinforcements arrive or return!
[*]Classified Documents can now be upgraded using Tokens earned via Combat Missions.
[*]Expect a separate article detailing all upgrades and strategies.
[/list]

[h2]Operation Dynamo Event Pass – Commemorate Dunkirk[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/02f4ec04e544818fd23be680b17f99c9f6cbaabd.jpg[/img]

Two rewarding progression lines honor the legendary evacuation:

[list]
[*][u]First line rewards:[/u] 5 Operation Dynamo containers, British Coastal camouflage, 3 days of Premium Account, the Monochrome destruction effect, and an Industrial camouflage for Tier IX battleship Duncan.
[*]Extra levels award More Signals containers.
[*]Unlock the second line for 2,500 Doubloons and receive: Industrial camo for Tier VIII Hawke, Tier VI Premium cruiser London, 3 Operation Dynamo Premium containers, and the final prize the Industrial camouflage for Tier X St. Vincent.
[*]Advance via combat missions or pay 750 Doubloons per level. Extra levels give Rare Bonuses containers.
[/list]

[h2]Dunkirk 1940 – Strategic Port Activity[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7ca43ebd52d785958bd9c71bb1c744702280e63b.jpg[/img]

Play through a tactical card-based event inspired by Operation Dynamo and earn epic rewards!

[list]
[*]Use ship cards to overcome enemy cards in strategic battles.
[*]Advance through multiple missions of increasing difficulty.
[*]Earn Credits, Dynamo containers, and ultimately the Tier VI Royal Navy destroyer Gallant.
[*]30 ship cards total, with the first 4 unlocked at the start and more available via mission completion.
[*]Apply card effects, buffs, and modifiers to outplay your opponents!
[/list]

[h2]Azur Lane – Wave 7 Has Arrived![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/bc10d7bd5f14ae8ec7226ec2647e70a45022f0cf.jpg[/img]

4 dazzling new shipgirls and 5 unique Commanders take the seas by storm:

[list]
[*]Exclusive voiceovers, themed camouflages, flags, and a patch.
[*]Available in the Armory and Premium Shop.
[/list]

[h2]Warhammer 40,000 – The Warp Opens Once Again[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c6ff89b77fc06f7c8b5c9a29b92fe77381c635e8.jpg[/img]

Fan favorites return with epic flair:

[list]
[*]Ships: Cross of Dorn, Ship Smasha, Ragnarok, and Ignis Purgatio.
[*]Commanders: Augustin Riegerwald, Grotmaz Smart, Arthas Roqthar the Cold, and Justinian Lyons XIII.
[*]Bundles include themed camouflages, flags, and patches.
[/list]

This is just the tip of the iceberg! Dive into Update 14.4 and explore everything it has to offer. Read the full update article here:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-144-perilous-route/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url]

Enjoying the new features? Let us know your thoughts via the survey link below!

[url=https://surveys.wargaming.net/s3/UPD14-4 style=button][b]Take survey[/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c1d46069e14fbacfa8c68ba7088a81e261ec0d4a.jpg[/img]

Join us on an interactive historical adventure through two of the most dramatic episodes of the early days of World War II—events that cracked open the "Phoney War" and unleashed the full power of the Axis and Allies in Europe: the battles of Narvik and the Dunkirk evacuation.

The in-game event will play out over the course of 6 weeks—starting this week—and feature special rewards like British destroyer [b]Eskimo[/b] and Commander [b]Victor Crutchley[/b], among a number of other rewards available in the Armory for [b]Adventure Tokens[/b]. notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8f8d3b9c0582cb7d06a3856dd53bc852767abfdd.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Captains![/b][/h1]

World of Warships prides itself on being not only the ultimate game for fans of naval combat simulation but also one of the top free-to-play online experiences available on Steam. Help us spread the word to the wider Steam community by applying the tags [b]"Action"[/b] and [b]"Free-to-play"[/b] to the game's main page and enjoy a full day of enhanced in-game earnings with Warships Premium Account!

[h1]How to Take Part[/h1]

Just follow these simple steps:

1. Find the "Popular user-defined tags for this product" section on the right-hand side of World of Warships' Steam STORE page, either in your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/552990/World_of_Warships/?tags=&tags] web browser[/url] or in the Steam app.

2. Click the "+" symbol.

3. Find the tags "[b]Action[/b]" and "[b]Free-to-play[/b]" in the pop-up window's list of popular tags, then click the "+" symbol beside both of them. [b]If you don't see these tags[/b] on the list, type them into field on the right side of the window, then click the "Add" button. 

4. Leave a comment below this news post letting us know that you've completed the task.

You're done! Exactly 7 days later, [b]24 hours of Warships Premium Account*[/b] will be applied to your account. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ffe37c13d08a4a7d984fcccaa75b777ab2f697f1.gif[/img]

[i]Stay tuned for more activities and good luck in battle, Captains![/i]

[color=#FF2400]Event starts: 24 April 2025[/color]
[color=#dd6b25]Event ends: 29 April 2025[/color]

[h2][i]Let's Get Ready to Respaaawn![/i][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/fa290ac7d0f38780df07662debc671250bf37d74.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=kU7VSpK_MAs;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Unbreakable Line[/b] is ready to play! In this new temporary battle type, you will have the ability to—brace yourself—[b]respawn after being sunk[/b]!

Climb into the bridge of your favorite Tier VIII–IX battleship, cruiser, or destroyer and respawn to your heart's content on small, specially crafted 7v7 maps. Given that it's impossible to sink the entire enemy team, you'll have to play the game mode domination style to achieve victory.

And while you'll only be out of the battle for 15 seconds after being destroyed, don't get too reckless! The enemy team will still gain points for sinking your ship.

For more information about Unbreakable Line, visit our dedicated article:

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 14.4 Round 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ead6990ac32e7576b6fd3d4330265e6ee3772bfa.jpg[/img]
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 14.4. For more information, visit the relevant link:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/work-in-progress-144/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/public-test/work-in-progress-144/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/public-test/work-in-progress-144/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[i][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.[/i]

[h2]Perilous Route: A New PvE Experience [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/406bc2ba2faea46b99e71c5dee961b2fb999f1bf.jpg[/img]

A new temporary battle type hits the Live Servers in Update 14.4! Inspired by the Convoy battle type from past updates, Perilous Route sees you and your team escort a damaged [b]command ship[/b] across the map as it slowly repairs itself.

Along the way, the command ship will make two stops, where your team will receive randomized objectives to complete before continuing the journey.

Stay alert—along the way, you'll encounter hostile bot ships eager to hamper your progress! To aid in your fight against them, you'll have access to the [b]Coordinated Fleet Support[/b] consumable, which restores a portion of all allied ships' HP when activated.

[h2]Dunkirk 1940: A Strategic Card Game Steeped in History[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d7e96ca8084d03f255dd0dd209542be046dce74c.jpg[/img]

As we near the anniversary of one of the most remarkable events of World War II—Operation Dynamo—we invite you to step into the shoes of a fleet commander, managing not just a single ship but an entire fleet of warships and civilian vessels in a new card game that will be available to play in World of Warships.

Advance through the event by completing key missions and fulfilling the operation's objectives. [b]Each mission can be thought of as a puzzle that you need to solve using the available cards[/b]. Each card represents a ship under your command, while enemy cards represent different obstacles like aircraft or coastal artillery.

The activity offers rewards like Credits, Operation Dynamo containers, and British Premium destroyer [b]Gallant[/b] (the final reward).

[h2]And More![/h2]

Take a moment to read more about what we have planned for Update 14.4 in our dedicated article. It has all the details on coming changes to Operations with Flagships, details on the Operation Dynamo Event Pass, and more:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/work-in-progress-144/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/public-test/work-in-progress-144/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/public-test/work-in-progress-144/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]
