notes.content:
[h2]Read the Update 14.3 Changelog[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a7378459bad9e18861dcc1d211db63e8e523f39d.jpg[/img]

The new update is now LIVE in World of Warships, featuring:

[list]
[*]Two distinct [b]Event Passes[/b] that bisect the 6-week-long update.
[*][b]Dockyard[/b] event to construct German cruiser [b]Blücher[/b].
[*]New [b]Unbreakable Line[/b] battle type, revolving around an exciting new [b]respawn mechanic[/b].
[*][b]Efficiency Badges[/b]—a novel way to earn marks of personal pride and prestige for performance aboard individual ships.
[/list]

But that's not all! Get the full breakdown of new features, balance changes, and more via the link:
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-143-dockyard-and-unbreakable-line/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-143-dockyard-and-unbreakable-line/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-143-dockyard-and-unbreakable-line/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]Get a Load of All These Temporary Mechanics![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/4f9486e6654d83d41874e6a8a3f83b242090dd1b.jpg[/img]

Since 14.2, we've been introducing features intended to stick around only for a limited-time window lasting several updates. These include experimental ships and Operations with Flagships, but the list will continue to grow! Keep track of all these mechanics on a dedicated page on our website, and make sure you experience all of them before they disappear:
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/time-limited-mechanics/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/content/time-limited-mechanics/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/content/time-limited-mechanics/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]Operation Ten-Go Event Pass[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/534806e7f48e33d66159bb46f57c4244f5800d22.jpg[/img]

On April 7, 1945, legendary Yamato was attacked and sunk by waves of American carrier-borne aircraft. This year, we're commemorating the fate of the largest battleship in history with a full-fledged 3-week Event Pass.

The [b]first progression line[/b] offers the [i]Final Voyage[/i] permanent camouflage for [b]Yamato[/b] herself as the final reward, while the [b]second progression line[/b] yields historical Commander [b]Seiichi Itō[/b] with an individual voiceover, Premium cruiser (and Ten-Go companion!) [b]Yahagi[/b], and the [i]Defender of the Pacific Ocean[/i] permanent camouflage for [b]Essex[/b].

For more information about Update 14.3's Event Passes, see our dedicated article:
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/event-pass-143-operation-ten-go/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/general-news/event-pass-143-operation-ten-go/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/general-news/event-pass-143-operation-ten-go/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]Blücher at the Dockyard[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/03892ff00170416d370c4351331ae40b695ee230.jpg[/img]

The gates to the Dockyard have swung back open, and historical German cruiser [b]Blücher[/b] awaits you on the stocks, as well as Commonwealth cruiser [b]Gambia[/b] as an intermediate reward!

The shipbuilding process comprises 20 phases, 18 of which can be progressed through by completing Dockyard combat missions, while the rest can be completed for Doubloons. Each phase can be finished for 2,000 Doubloons, and there are also Starter Packs of two and six phases available for 3,200 and 7,800 Doubloons, respectively. 

For more info about the ship, event rewards, and timeframe, visit our dedicated article:
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/blucher-at-the-dockyard-143/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/general-news/blucher-at-the-dockyard-143/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/general-news/blucher-at-the-dockyard-143/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]Take the 14.3 Survey![/h2]

Enjoying the new features introduced by Update 14.3? Let us know what you think via the survey link below!

[url=https://surveys.wargaming.net/s3/UPD14-3 style=button][b]Take Survey[/b][/url]

notes.title: Update 14.3 | Dockyard, Unbreakable Line. & More!
notes.content:
Here’s an overview of the major highlights introduced in Update 14.3. Be sure to check out the full details on our website:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-143-dockyard-and-unbreakable-line/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] 

[previewyoutube=hsEhjpWMdQs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Blücher Dockyard[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/03892ff00170416d370c4351331ae40b695ee230.jpg[/img]

Build mighty German Tier IX cruiser Blücher! Complete 20 Dockyard phases, 18 of which you can finish via combat missions, and earn powerful Commonwealth Tier VII cruiser Gambia along the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/402045c3e77aad62eb235d82cd2764e193615c1a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b274d331e1ccf582e6ac2290e194c4c2884bdc7c.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]Blücher boasts fearsome guns with improved dispersion, enhanced AP shell performance, and devastating HE shells.
[*]Gambia, Fiji’s sister ship, features AP and HE shells plus Short Burst Smoke Generator to evade enemies and strike back.
[*]Two Starter Pack options are available to accelerate progress.
[*]The Dockyard will stay open throughout Update 14.4 but close its doors with the release of Update 14.5.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=rVeMY3t-uT8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Two Event Passes:[/b] Operation Ten-Go & Golden Month[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/534806e7f48e33d66159bb46f57c4244f5800d22.jpg[/img]

For the first time since Wonders of the Arctic, we’re bringing two consecutive Event Passes! You can earn up to 1,170 Points via daily and weekly missions, and it takes 450 Points to complete one Pass, 900 to complete both. Any remaining Points will go to finishing extra levels!

[h3]Operation Ten-Go[/h3]

Celebrate the 80th anniversary of this historic battle!

[list]
[*][u]First line rewards:[/u] Splinters permanent camouflage, 3 days of Premium Account, and the stunning Final Voyage camouflage for Yamato.
[*]Unlock the second line for 2,000 Doubloons to receive new historical Commander Seiichi Itō with enhanced skills and an individual voiceover.
[*]Claim Tier V Premium cruiser Yahagi and the historic Defender of the Pacific Ocean camouflage for Essex as ultimate rewards.
[/list]

[h3]Golden Month[/h3]

Inspired by Japan’s Golden Week holidays, this pass offers vibrant rewards:

[list]
[*][u]First line rewards:[/u] Splinters permanent camouflage, 3 days of Premium Account, and the stunning Final Voyage camouflage for Yamato.
[*][u]Final reward:[/u] The breathtaking Japanese Lacquer permanent camouflage for Kongō.
[*]Unlock the second line for 2,000 Doubloons to instantly receive the Golden Week permanent camouflage for Mogami.
[*]Earn the Silver Ray enemy destruction effect and British Tier V Premium battleship Agincourt as the final reward.
[/list]

[h2]Unbreakable Line – [u]A New Battle Type![/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/775d5fa8d4f3223f70560ff29bda90e3ef82ebe2.jpg[/img]

Love intense action? In this new 7v7 clash, ships respawn after destruction, keeping the fight going!

[list]
[*]15-minute battles featuring Tier VIII–IX battleships, cruisers, and destroyers.
[*]Domination-style capture points—reach 1,000 points or sink enough enemies to win!
[*]Ships respawn with fully reloaded armaments (excluding torpedoes) but retained cooldowns on consumables.
[*]Temporary buffs to speed, maneuverability, and concealment will help you quickly rejoin the fight.
[/list]

[h2]Efficiency Badges—Show Off Your Skills[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a036c54d88e16cd07c6dcac92d7a3ea329a38a29.jpg[/img]

Earn Efficiency Badges to prove your battle prowess!

[list]
[*]Available for all Tier V and above ships in Random Battles.
[*]Badges are awarded based on Base XP performance compared to global averages.
[*][u]Four Badge tiers:[/u] Expert (Top 1%), 1st Grade (Top 5%), 2nd Grade (Top 20%), 3rd Grade (Top 50%).
[*]Earned [b]Badges cannot be lost![/b]
[*]View Badges on player profiles and the post-battle statistics screen.
[/list]

[h2]Transformers Return![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a51f16284ddf12bbb9ee33be2db17395d3b4eb07.jpg[/img]

Autobots and Decepticons roll out once again! Expect themed camouflages, Commanders, containers, and more as part of this exciting World of Warships x Transformers collaboration! 

This is just the tip of the iceberg! Dive into Update 14.3 and explore everything it has to offer. Read the full update article here:

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 14.3 Round 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ec7176867476d8c319497711a4429bf6dd9bd3c6.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=TFPcT4pLOdo;full][/previewyoutube]

This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 14.3. For more information, visit the relevant link:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/work-in-progress-143/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/public-test/work-in-progress-143/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/public-test/work-in-progress-143/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[i][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.[/i]

[h2]Unbreakable Line[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/10bb811416e9985cbffc1cf9be94067ade3f3240.jpg[/img]

Update 14.3 introduces a new temporary battle type featuring a novel mechanic in World of Warships: [b]respawning![/b] It means that when your ship gets destroyed, you'll be spared a trip back to Port and will be sent back into action aboard the same ship you sailed into battle.

[b]Format:[/b]
[list]
[*]7v7
[*]Tier VIII and IX; battleships, cruisers, and destroyers
[*]Maximum battle duration: 15 minutes
[*]Battles take place on maps of reduced size
[/list]

[h2]Blücher at the Dockyard[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9d2c679389bf20236f4b4292fd9d6b79d97980e0.jpg[/img]

Historical [b]German cruiser Blücher[/b] will soon be available to construct at the Dockyard! The ship stands out for her deadly accuracy and strong AP shell performance, which together help her tear through enemy broadsides like a can opener.

The ship's construction consists of 20 Dockyard phases; 18 of these will be completable through in-game combat missions. Individual phases can be purchased for Doubloons, and as usual, there are two starter pack options to get a head start.

At Phase 8, you'll pick up [b]Commonwealth cruiser Gambia[/b] as an intermediate reward. Unlike her sister ship Fiji, Gambia has access to HE shells and Short-Burst Smoke Generator, making her a brutal combatant against enemy battleships.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/cb1d22eb0ce8ed1366652c95fa23eb9f27de63b1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Efficiency Badges[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/17128fcc2a59fd3af73a25f6bbad11bf40b45acd.jpg[/img]

With Update 14.3, you'll be able to earn Efficiency Badges as a mark of personal pride for your performance aboard individual ships. After each Random Battle you finish, the Base XP you earned is tracked and compared against the recent average performance of other players globally aboard the same ship that you just played. Depending on how well you performed in comparison to your fellow players, you can receive an Efficiency Badge with one of four ranks.

You can view the Efficiency Badges for each of your ships in your profile summary, as well as on the post-battle statistics screen for the ship you sailed into battle. Only the highest-ranked badge for each of your ships will be displayed, meaning that if you upgrade a badge, it will replace the old one.

[b]For more information about these and more features, check out our dedicated article:[/b]
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/work-in-progress-143/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/public-test/work-in-progress-143/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/public-test/work-in-progress-143/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

notes.title: Weekend Highlights | 14.2 #1
notes.content:
[h2]Read the Update 14.2 Changelog[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f34a81976c74400ce5eb30170e033872972a0fa2.jpg[/img]

This week saw the launch of a game update so packed with content that you'll be spoiled for choice on how to spend your time on the waves this weekend and the coming ones!

From new [b]experimental ships[/b] to a new branch of [b]Soviet submarines in Early Access[/b], plus the return of [b]Operations with Flagships[/b] and a pirate-themed [b]Bounty Hunt[/b], Update 14.2 truly has something for everyone.

Get a comprehensive breakdown of all the new features and changes in our dedicated article:
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-142-experimental-ships/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] 

[h2]Experiment With New Experimental Ships[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1a2f0a022212304637214881c09af2ca639a04ab.jpg[/img]

From now until August 2025, you'll have free rein to play around with some quirky new ships subject to quirky new mechanics. For now, in Update 14.2, you can unlock and play cruisers [b]Metz[/b], [b]Oregon[/b], and [b]Vyazma[/b].

These three ships have access to what we're calling "[b]Fight or Flight[/b]"—a mechanic where your ship becomes stronger the more damage it takes. The trio also has access to a [b]limited stockpile of AP shells[/b] with improved characteristics that can be fired using [b]Burst Fire mode[/b].

You can unlock experimental ships by researching their components in exchange for a combination of Credits and [b]Action Reports[/b], the latter of which are obtainable via special combat missions.

For more information about experimental ships, see our dedicated article:
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/experimental-ships-article/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] 

[h2]Dive Back Into Operations with Flagships[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a4802c0204dd8b84e967d1d08433363cbd8805a8.jpg[/img]

Back by popular demand, Operations with Flagships have received a few tweaks in Update 14.2 to make them that much more engaging.

Now, [b]three enemy bot flagships of two different types[/b] with different effects and vulnerabilities await you on the battlefield. The flagships will be randomly selected, and you'll see which ones you'll be up against at the start of the battle.

You can now also equip one [b]Classified Document[/b] per battle to customize your ship's capabilities against certain ship types, working both against ordinary bots and the flagships themselves. This special mechanic will make your ship more effective in encounters with specific enemies.

All details about the tweaks to this battle type can be found via this link:

All three submarines are available in sequential bundles in the Armory, purchasable for [b]Soviet Tokens[/b]. You can obtain the Tokens by completing combat missions or purchasing random bundles.

notes.title: Update 14.2 | New Mechanics, Experimental Ships, and Soviet Submarines!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=sfVW6wPJvq0;full][/previewyoutube]
Here’s an overview of the major highlights introduced in Update 14.2. Be sure to check out the detailed article on our website:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-142-experimental-ships/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-142-experimental-ships/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-142-experimental-ships/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]Experimental Ships[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8637aac21c2f5c2aae641bf464491730bf4e72ff.jpg[/img]

Three new ships with unique mechanics are sailing out on our seas! Designed for bold Captains, these vessels bring high-risk, high-reward gameplay:

[list]
[*]These experimental ships start each battle with reduced HP but can heal over time. Where it gets very interesting is that their main battery accuracy and rate of fire improve as their HP decreases. Will you choose the security of HP or the risky but satisfying firepower route?
[*]Armed with a limited stock of AP shells with improved characteristics and Burst Fire mode.
[*]They have no module upgrades, their economic earnings are similar to same-tier Tech Tree ships, and Commanders assigned to experimental ships do not require retraining.
[/list]

You can unlock experimental ships by researching components with Credits and Action Reports from combat missions, and get a special mission chain that offers Coal as a reward.

These ships will be removed with Update 14.7, and commemorative rewards will be bestowed on players who successfully unlock all three.

[h2]Operations with Flagships & Classified Documents[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6bc02d11d8bf491aa338e2fab05395d2aa63cb43.jpg[/img]

Operations with Flagships return with reworked mechanics, introducing varied flagship encounters and greater strategic diversity.

New mechanics have been integrated to enhance combat effectiveness in specific scenarios:

[list]
[*]Equip one Classified Document in Operations with Flagships for survivability and damage boosts.
[*]All Classified Documents have been added to player accounts automatically and can be selected before each battle, with a limited time for changes.
[/list]

[h2]Soviet Submarines & Event Pass[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2b0ef47b6e230dc0aa8e4c254517644a898d624b.jpg[/img]

Comrades, the Red Fleet is growing mightier! The arrival of submarines S-1, L-20, and K-1 introduces a new Soviet playstyle:

[list]
[*]Powerful, fast, and long-range unguided torpedoes, plus homing torpedoes with low damage, speed, and range.
[*]Fast surface speed but limited dive capacity. They are also equipped with long-range Submarine Surveillance and Fast Damage Control Team.
[/list]

Celebrate the Soviet expansion with the Soviet Navy Event Pass!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/fb627d56136b4cc04a6a5b895eee0f9d9b645e8c.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]The [b]first progression line[/b] features 5x Soviet Era containers, Commander Aleksey Statsenko, and a Soviet permanent camouflage for Tallinn.
[*]Unlock the [b]second progression line[/b] for 2,500 Doubloons to earn additional rewards, including Soviet permanent camouflages for Riga and Petropavlovsk, 10x Soviet Era containers, and cruiser Molotov. Captains who already own these items will be compensated in Credits.
[/list]

[h2]Pirate-Themed Bounty Hunt[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1a1b1212c2b0875b556472dfdd67d1120d1ad291.jpg[/img]

Hoist the black flag and engage in thrilling Random Battles:

[list]
[*]Play as a Hunter (Tier V–X ships) or Bounty (Tier VI–X battleships, cruisers, and destroyers) to earn Bounty Tokens for themed Commanders and permanent camouflages.
[*]The Bounty status is available for free in the Armory and lasts 24 hours or until the main mission (sink 5 enemy ships) is completed.
[*]Random bundles hold new ship Monmouth, with direct purchase options available until the release of Update 14.3.
[/list]

That's just a glimpse of what's new in this fresh update! Read our full article linked below to learn more.

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-142-experimental-ships/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-142-experimental-ships/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-142-experimental-ships/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

notes.title: Tag Barrage: Earn Free Premium Account in Just a Few Seconds!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8f8d3b9c0582cb7d06a3856dd53bc852767abfdd.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Captains![/b][/h1]

World of Warships prides itself on being not only the ultimate game for fans of naval combat simulation but also one of the top free-to-play online experiences available on Steam. Help us spread the word to the wider Steam community by applying the tags "Strategy" and "Co-Operative" to the game's main page and enjoy a full day of enhanced in-game earnings with Warships Premium Account!

[h1]How to Take Part[/h1]

Just follow these simple steps:

1. Find the "Popular user-defined tags for this product" section on the right-hand side of World of Warships' Steam STORE page, either in your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/552990/World_of_Warships/?tags=&tags] web browser[/url] or in the Steam app.

2. Click the "+" symbol.

3. Find the tags "[b]Strategy[/b]" and "[b]Co-Operative[/b]" in the pop-up window's list of popular tags, then click the "+" symbol beside both of them. [b]If you don't see these tags[/b] on the list, type them into field on the right side of the window, then click the "Add" button. 

4. Leave a comment below this news post letting us know that you've completed the task.

You're done! Exactly 7 days later, [b]24 hours of Warships Premium Account*[/b] will be applied to your account.

notes.title: Update 14.1 | Celebrate the Lunar New Year With Exciting Events!
notes.content:
Here’s an overview of the major highlights introduced in Update 14.1. Be sure to check out the detailed article on our website:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-141-lunar-new-year/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-141-lunar-new-year/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-141-lunar-new-year/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]Lunar New Year Event Pass[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2860ce9b9b7214e95f9a54c7ca2fec8e8eac91f9.jpg[/img]

Welcome 2025 with the Lunar New Year Event Pass! Journey through two progression lines and earn rewards sprinkled with moondust:

[list]
[*]The [b]first progression line[/b] features the "Safe Trip Wherever You Fare" flag, 3 days of Warships Premium Account, Coal, Steel, and historical Commander Yuchi Gong with 10 skill points and an individual voiceover. Completing each extra level provides 2x More Signals containers.
[*]Unlock the [b]second progression line[/b] for 2,500 Doubloons to immediately receive Commander Qin Shubao with 10 skill points and an individual voiceover. Progress further to earn Tier VI Huanghe with a Port slot, the Lunar New Year and Menshen permanent camouflages, and additional Coal and Steel. Completing each extra level provides 1x Rare Bonuses container.
[/list]

[h2]Remembrance of Ming's Past Adventure[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/0981d0529c4135daf274a9f6364abb0a45036137.jpg[/img]

Celebrate the Seven Voyages of Zheng He with this new adventure running through Updates 14.1 and 14.2. Complete missions to earn rewards:

[list]
[*]Ming's Legacy flag and Zheng He’s Voyages patch.
[*]Adventure Tokens to exchange for containers and Ming’s Voyage Tokens.
[*]Unlock thematic rewards, including Tier IX Taihang, the Chinese Treasure Ship permanent camouflage, and Commander Zheng He. Obtain enough Ming’s Voyage Tokens through exchange and Armory bundles to claim Taihang for free!
[/list]
Smaller events tied to Adventure Tokens will also unfold in Update 14.1 for added convenience.

[h2]Finest Hour Collection and Unique Dutch Commander[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/36d7c1d56531065f280703ed5cd7770d2b08730a.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]Obtain collection elements from Finest Hour standard and Premium containers, purchasable with Adventure Tokens.
[*]Complete the collection to earn enough Tokens for Dutch unique Commander Conrad Helfrich, or save them for Tier IX Taihang.
[*]Tokens from missions and bundles won’t cover both rewards, so choose wisely!
[/list]

[h2]Battle of the Java Sea[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/460d158f8d7fb515b658f195e9a0b6eab2bfbe04.jpg[/img]

Mark the anniversary of the 1942 Battle of the Java Sea!

[list]
[*]Obtain up to 5x Battle of the Java Sea containers for Adventure Tokens.
[*]These containers may drop ships that participated in the battle: Minegumo, Yūdachi, Jupiter '42, and Perth.
[/list]


This is just a glimpse of what's new in this—the most wonderful update of the year! Read our full article linked below to learn more.

notes.title: Tag Barrage: Earn Free Premium Account in Just a Few Seconds!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8f8d3b9c0582cb7d06a3856dd53bc852767abfdd.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Captains![/b][/h1]

World of Warships prides itself on being not only the ultimate game for fans of naval combat simulation but also one of the top free-to-play online experiences available on Steam. Help us spread the word to the wider Steam community by applying the tags "Strategy" and "Co-Operative" to the game's main page and enjoy a full day of enhanced in-game earnings with Warships Premium Account!

[h1]How to Take Part[/h1]

Just follow these simple steps:

1. Find the "Popular user-defined tags for this product" section on the right-hand side of World of Warships' Steam STORE page, either in your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/552990/World_of_Warships/?tags=&tags] web browser[/url] or in the Steam app.

2. Click the "+" symbol.

3. Find the tags "[b]Strategy[/b]" and "[b]Co-Operative[/b]" in the pop-up window's list of popular tags, then click the "+" symbol beside both of them. [b]If you don't see these tags[/b] on the list, type them into field on the right side of the window, then click the "Add" button. 

4. Leave a comment below this news post letting us know that you've completed the task.

You're done! Exactly 7 days later, [b]24 hours of Warships Premium Account*[/b] will be applied to your account.

[h2]World of Warships Account System Update[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d63e6d0e772067a16be672ef3e68ef5cd7bb6a9d.jpg[/img]

Last year, we announced changes to how the account system worked. These were aimed at helping players manage their accounts while providing greater flexibility for future technical improvements by our developers.

In case you missed it, that first update enabled players with multiple accounts across different regions to use a single set of credentials to log in, play, and manage all of their linked Wargaming accounts.

These changes only affect account management, and don't provide any regional crossplay functionality or affect your accounts' in-game progress.

Players affected by these changes first began receiving notices in late October 2024, prompting them to resolve detected account conflicts, as our system had identified other owned accounts with overlapping credentials.

As outlined in our initial article, these prompts were not mandatory initially, but they will become so later, when the next system update is deployed in the first half of February 2025. We took this approach to give affected players time to be notified, then identify and resolve any conflicts with their accounts.

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/wows-account-system-update/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url]

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 14.1 Round 2.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c6aa57ee0b76275e624e0f94820e310f8afc4362.jpg[/img]

This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 14.1. For more information, visit the relevant link:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/public-test/work-in-progress-141/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] 

[b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

[h2]“Remembrance of Ming's Past” Adventure[/h2]

The Seven Voyages of Zheng He are famous across China. Sent by the Ming dynasty to improve relations with foreign powers and bolster trade, Zheng He commanded huge fleets loaded with expensive gifts and trade goods to such far places as Hormuz in the Persian Gulf and Mogadishu in Africa. We are honoring this famous explorer in a new adventure that will run through Updates 14.1 and 14.2 and will provide many opportunities to earn your own World of Warships riches along the way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/15ae6951bde38a9509c4e8c636605ac6add6abe1.jpg[/img]

During this adventure, completing missions will earn you the new "The Ming Legacy" flag and Zheng He's Voyages patch, as well as some Adventure Tokens that you can spend on various containers in the Armory. Alternatively, you can exchange them for Ming's Voyage Tokens that you can use to obtain thematic rewards: new IX Taihang
, the Chinese Treasure Ship permanent camouflage for her, and Commander Zheng He himself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1a442e238f1e0c580480532411a82a388f27bc1f.jpg[/img]

[h2]"The Finest Hour" Collection and a New Unique Dutch Commander[/h2]

Conrad Helfrich was a lieutenant admiral of the Royal Netherlands Navy and overall commander of the Dutch naval forces in Southeast Asia during World War II. In the first stages of the Pacific War, he was one of the most successful Allied commanders in that theater. We honor this military juggernaut with a special collection dedicated to his memory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d79fe6a5c993339fc5c8aebd86867853686f3bbd.jpg[/img]

You can get collection elements from the "The Finest Hour" standard containers, which you can obtain in exchange for Adventure Tokens earned from adventure missions. It’s possible to earn enough Adventure Tokens to complete the collection in its entirety.

Note that you must make a choice to either get the unique Dutch Commander for Adventure Tokens or save them and spend on IX Taihang
after the Adventure ends. Tokens obtainable from missions and bundles for resources in the Armory can’t cover both rewards.

notes.title: Weekend Highlights | 14.0 #1
notes.content:
[h2]New Year, New Experiences: Update 14.0![/h2]
If you haven't had time to take to the sea this week, you may have missed that Update 14.0 is live. Check out our video to learn more about what's in store this month!

[h2]The Trident Awards[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2b723804d3099d1e0b7aa903b577f6dcb3afee4e.jpg[/img]

[b]The Trident Awards[/b] is an [b]Awards Ceremony[/b] spanning numerous categories that you, the players, can vote on. Some categories allow you to submit your own candidates as well. 
Cast your votes on the Official Discord between [b]January 10th[/b] and [b]January 24th[/b].

[url=https://discord.com/channels/669128285527080961/1326884891488682074 style=button][b]Discord[/b][/url]

[/list] 

[h2]That’s not all for Special Events this Update and month![/h2]
Accompanying the Awards will be a new Leaderboard Event for Discord Users. Full details will be shared in a dedicated article, but we can share some of the exciting rewards you will compete for.

On top of all this, those Discord users who are authenticated as of this weekend will receive their 40 Event Pass Points, this weekend. Those who authenticate after will receive theirs with the regular Discord Drops.

[previewyoutube=5hBdPFluC2g;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Early Access to Dutch Cruisers[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/490e7cece3ca4faa2579dfe1b7d682a46e2f336a.jpg[/img]

Early Access to a new line of Dutch light cruisers begins with the start of Update 14.0.
Branch highlights
[list]
[*]This line features 128 mm main battery guns with good range and ballistics.
[*]For this caliber, their AP shells can deal good damage, while their HE shells have good penetration capabilities but leave much to be desired in terms of damage and fire-starting chances.
[*]The ships are also armed with a signature Dutch Airstrike with a fast cooldown, long range, and the ability to reach the target relatively quickly. On the flip side, the squadron size is only small.
[*]The line boasts good concealment and strong AA defenses, and the ships also come equipped with Engine Boost and a Repair Party with a short cooldown.
[*]As for their weaknesses, ships of the line have small HP pools and weak armor.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/109b5f888178138c9b8a0a33a6d6aeef03868d1c.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d3278e610a2efc54496b38ae43fb201a0daf86fc.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6036535977907ecb8fc8340621a3bdfb251f6c7a.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9f459a5bea762d8bf16b14d04c1e52a3bdafbfa4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Dutch Cruisers Event Pass[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1fa4f38386fa874e9eb080ba47e25a4e88c3b777.jpg[/img]

To celebrate the arrival of these three beauties in our virtual seas, we've prepared a Dutch-themed Event Pass for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ac8e69c1a7bc9bbb027bc1ca07855c4ff810dc20.jpg[/img]
The first progression line offers rewards like the Flying Dutchman permanent camouflage, Royal Netherlands Navy permanent camouflages for 
VII Eendracht, VIII Haarlem, and newcomer cruiser VIII Jaarsveld as the final reward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1390405db95395f0718db3cdd26a1e8a7d984f99.jpg[/img]
Unlocking the second progression line for 2,500 Doubloons will allow you to claim even more themed items. You’ll immediately receive the Lion's Heart permanent camouflage for 
VIII Jaarsveld, and progressing down the line will bring you Royal Netherlands Navy permanent camouflages for IX Johan de Witt and X Gouden Leeuw.

[h2]Operations with Flagships[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a1b586a4b769f94a38c9dfe4c974cd738d264a30.jpg[/img]

Throughout Update 14.0, you can participate in Operations with flagships, available as a separate battle type. There are three types of flagships—Incendiary Specialist, Torpedo Master, and Iron Fist—all boasting increased HP and provide bots in the nearby area with particular effects.
Taking down these formidable flagships will require you to take advantage of the knowledge that each of them is particularly vulnerable to a certain type of damage. Make sure to choose which ship to deploy in each battle carefully, based on the enemy's weaknesses. When making your choices, keep in mind that you'll only face flagships of a specific type per week for the first 3 weeks. Your most versatile ships will be best suited for the battles of the fourth week, as you'll face all three types of flagships!

[h2]And Much, Much More![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/51522235f0406d37c62ca7b5d08fc3c0466e4ff2.jpg[/img]

This is not even close to all of the new features added in this update. Read our full update article via the link below to learn about:
[list]
[*]Bjorn's Ballad Adventure
[*]Hamburg Dockyard Continues
[*]The Creatorverse Is Back 
[*]Brawls 
[*]Armory 
[*]Game Balance Changes 
[*]And more!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8f8d3b9c0582cb7d06a3856dd53bc852767abfdd.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Captains![/b][/h1]

World of Warships prides itself on being not only the ultimate game for fans of naval combat simulation but also one of the top free-to-play online experiences available on Steam. Help us spread the word to the wider Steam community by applying the tags "Strategy" and "Co-Operative" to the game's main page and enjoy a full day of enhanced in-game earnings with Warships Premium Account!

[h1]How to Take Part[/h1]

Just follow these simple steps:

1. Find the "Popular user-defined tags for this product" section on the right-hand side of World of Warships' Steam STORE page, either in your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/552990/World_of_Warships/?tags=&tags] web browser[/url] or in the Steam app.

2. Click the "+" symbol.

3. Find the tags "[b]Strategy[/b]" and "[b]Co-Operative[/b]" in the pop-up window's list of popular tags, then click the "+" symbol beside both of them. [b]If you don't see these tags[/b] on the list, type them into field on the right side of the window, then click the "Add" button. 

4. Leave a comment below this news post letting us know that you've completed the task.

You're done! Exactly 7 days later, [b]24 hours of Warships Premium Account*[/b] will be applied to your account. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2cd98e5344408b246f326a640e28c4a494f34411.gif[/img]

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 14.0 Round 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c6aa57ee0b76275e624e0f94820e310f8afc4362.jpg[/img]

This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 14.0. For more information, visit the relevant link:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/work-in-progress-140/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/public-test/work-in-progress-140/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/public-test/work-in-progress-140/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

[h2]Operations With Flagships[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/28a585b7fdea98aae1a2b8c8fa8973ab40245ff0.jpg[/img]

After a great year for Operations, get ready for a 2025 with even more exciting additions to the battle type!

Throughout Update 14.0, you can experience special versions of six Operations, now for high-tier ships. They feature [b]new enemies known as "Flagships"[/b], with increased hit points and the ability to influence nearby allies. You'll find these formidable units difficult to take down unless you identify and focus on their specific vulnerabilities.

Three Flagships, each with distinct mechanics, will individually set sail on the virtual seas, one per week, during the first 3 weeks of the update. In the fourth week, things will really heat up when you face all three!

[h2]New Dutch Cruisers in the Tech Tree[/h2]

Update 14.0 ushers a new branch of ships into Early Access! Welcome Dutch light cruisers [b]Jaarsveld[/b] (Tier VIII), [b]Menno van Coehoorn[/b] (Tier IX), and [b]Utrecht[/b]  (Tier X).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/53e2e568d1809fa8584540a5af4e7b351354eb9f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/cd81b135e4cc8303e8e3d8d08a6201e895ab9a2e.jpg[/img]

Features:
[list]
[*]Numerous low-caliber [b]main battery[/b] guns with good range and ballistics
[*]Improved HE shell penetration and great AP shell damage
[*]Access to small [b]Airstrike[/b] squadrons with long range, fast cooldown, and relatively fast bomb arrival time
[*]Access to Engine Boost and a fast-cooling Repair Party
[*]Weak armor and a small hit point pool 
[/list]

[h2]Adventure of Bjorn Stormbreaker[/h2]

A new adventure awaits you with the release of Update 14.0. Travel with famed adventurer [b]Bjorn Stormbreaker[/b] as he battles six powerful fantastical sea creatures!

Stay tuned for more information about how you can earn Bjorn as a Commander, as well as our new Forsaken Chest containers.

[h1][b]Captains![/b][/h1]

World of Warships prides itself on being not only the ultimate game for fans of naval combat simulation but also one of the top free-to-play online experiences available on Steam. Help us spread the word to the wider Steam community by applying the tags "Simulation" and "Massively Multiplayer" to the game's main page and enjoy a full day of enhanced in-game earnings with Warships Premium Account!

Just follow these simple steps:

2. Click the "+" symbol.

3. Find the tags "[b]Simulation[/b]" and "[b]Massively Multiplayer[/b]" in the pop-up window's list of popular tags, then click the "+" symbol beside both of them. [b]If you don't see these tags[/b] on the list, type them into field on the right side of the window, then click the "Add" button. 

4. Leave a comment below this news post letting us know that you've completed the task.

You're done! Exactly 7 days later, [b]24 hours of Warships Premium Account*[/b] will be applied to your account.

notes.title: Update 13.11 | Happy Holidays!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d24f978565fa7c2c8dd9e6dd3ee0ce968f928ec7.jpg[/img]
This is a short overview of some of the content introduced in Update 13.11. You'll find more information in a dedicated article on our website:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-1311-holiday-celebrations/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-1311-holiday-celebrations/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-1311-holiday-celebrations/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]Claim Your Free Ship: Expedition to the North Pole[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/4cbef8cfa309186cfee851c654c8256683abedf2.jpg[/img]

Destination reached, Captain! With the arrival of December comes the end of the Expedition to the North Pole event. The next step is claiming your gift! 

If you've actively participated in the Expedition this autumn, you can receive a Tier X Tech Tree ship along with some extra rewards; and if you're only just hearing about it now and haven't earned any Expedition Tokens at all, you can still claim a Tier VIII Tech Tree ship—guaranteed!

To claim it, just log in to the game from December 1. If you choose a ship that you already have in your Port, you'll receive Free XP as compensation instead.

[h2]Wonders of the Arctic[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/bdf377c7066b45021f140680ec27479f56fe1c48.jpg[/img]

We’ve prepared a special celebration as another year comes to a close, so you can be sure that Update 13.11 will bring lots of gifts and activities.

[list]
[*][b]Nordlyshavn Port[/b]: a magical new Port will light your way through the new update. Keep an eye out for interactive elements, including a Christmas Tree that you can decorate by completing a set number of battles each day. Hang enough ornaments, and you'll even earn a [b]Santa's Gift container[/b]!
[*][b]Advent Calendar[/b]: From December 1 through 25, you can open one of the Calendar’s cards each day and claim the gift it hides. 
[*][b]Festive Rewards[/b]: A holiday tradition in World of Warships, you can now once again collect rewards for earning Base XP on your Tier V and higher ships. The rewards include Festive Certificates, which you can exchange for both types of Santa's Gifts containers in the Armory!
[*][b]Update to Santa's containers[/b]: Only two types of containers are available this year—Santa’s Gift and Santa’s Mega Gift. We’ve removed 23 older ships from the drop list and added 18 new ones. They can also drop a special new Golden Gift container, which holds ships [b]Chikuma II[/b], [b]Prins van Oranje[/b], and [b]Georg Hoffmann[/b], as well as their golden versions!
[*][b]Niord and Kalmar Dockyard[/b]: The construction of European battleship [b]Niord[/b] has commenced at the Hamburg Dockyard! This year, you can also unlock new European destroyer [b]Kalmar[/b] as an intermediate reward at the 8th shipbuilding phase of the Dockyard!
[/list]

[h2]Event Pass: East and West[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/55852736bb5109723645738e76601481dbf1d451.jpg[/img]

Update 13.11 features two themed Event Pass chapters dedicated to our two explorers, Li Wei and Olaf Lundgren. Each chapter lasts for 3 weeks, features 25 levels, and functions as a standalone Event Pass.

[list]
[*][b]Chapter 1[/b]: In the first progression line, you'll find Commander Li Wei with a unique voiceover, along with the Butterfly Kaleidoscope enemy destruction effect, the Avid Explorer patch, and some Santa's Gift containers. The second line offers the Adventure's Call flag, the Eastbound permanent camouflage, Santa's Gift containers, 1x Santa's Mega Gift container, and Pan-Asian Tier VII battleship Teng She with a festive permanent camouflage!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/65487271619233b611ebac360f8aa7afb32b5053.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e125092c7d2baca1819270369436d1e5bd444b8f.jpg[/img]
[*][b]Chapter 2[/b]: The first progression line will reward you with the Polar Pursuit patch, Commander Olaf Lundgren with an individual voiceover, the Avalanche enemy destruction effect, and Santa's Gift containers. The second line offers the Echoes of the Past flag, the Westbound permanent camouflage, Santa's Gift containers, 1x Santa's Mega Gift container, and European Tier VII battleship Lugdunum with an icy permanent camouflage
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d15b456553c5605f94f49b86eb2cbb523a6e5711.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/94482bd0a9d44a8a3dc0a2287f9130c8871343e8.jpg[/img]
[/list]


[h2][i]STAR TREK[/i]: Final Operation[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e472c1e7f95ab3343eb2e9534e6020b7d5492d26.jpg[/img]

The final of the three [i]STAR TREK[/i] Operations is unfolding during the first two weeks of Update 13.11. 

The invasion is intensifying and the Vulcans are in imminent danger—only through the combined efforts of Starfleet's finest can we ensure their survival. Ready your ships by raising shields and going to red alert, and rally your crews to join the fight and protect Vulcan from assimilation!

If her drone minions fail, the Borg Queen herself will join the battle to crush the united forces of the Federation, Klingons, Romulans, and Vulcans. Will you emerge victorious in the face of her wrath?

[h2]And Much, Much More![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/30c4d268034f7405a72659f455799b6af0c58bc2.jpg[/img]

This is not even close to all of the new features added in this, the most wonderful update of the year! Read our full update article via the link below to learn about:

[list]
[*]The return of [b]Asymmetric Battles[/b]
[*]The [b]removal of the detonation mechanic[/b]
[*]The new [b]Clan Patrols[/b] activity
[*]A new season of [b]Clan Battles[/b]
[*]Five new rounds of [b]Brawls[/b]
[*]The [b]Steel Will[/b] Armory event
[*]And more!
[/list]

[b]Visit the Update 13.11 article at the relevant link:[/b]
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-1311-holiday-celebrations/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-1311-holiday-celebrations/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-1311-holiday-celebrations/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

notes.title: Weekend Highlights | 13.10 #4
notes.content:
[h2]Claimable Missions Expire Soon![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/60bbd44ad7942ba5fdc46c5b232d454dac00fb7c.jpg[/img]

We're in the final week of Update 13.10, Captains, but you still have a little time to complete some of the missions laid out in the Combat Mission Calendar!

3. Find the tags "[b]Simulation[/b]" and "[b]Massively Multiplayer[/b]" in the pop-up window's list of popular tags, then click the "+" symbol beside both of them. [b]If you don't see these tags[/b] on the list, type them into field on the right side of the window, then click the "Add" button.

You're done! Exactly 7 days later, [b]24 hours of Warships Premium Account*[/b] will be applied to your account.

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 13.11 Round 3
notes.content:
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 13.11. For more information, visit the relevant link:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/work-in-progress-1311/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/public-test/work-in-progress-1311/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/public-test/work-in-progress-1311/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

[h2]Wonders of the Arctic[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38188069/e2c0a9f1177b397881e83c01a5dd1f5cdf5a300a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38188069/fe3aba1ac3ec10454a6f269989f8dcc1047a8856.jpg[/img]

13.11 is our New Year update, so we've naturally prepared a festive atmosphere for you to enjoy both in your Port and on the battlefield.

[list]
[*]You'll visit the new Port of [b]Nordlyshavn[/b], where you can decorate your very own Christmas Tree with ornaments that can be unlocked by completing missions.
[*]A special [b]Advent Calendar[/b] will replace the standard daily rewards from December 1 through 25.
[*]You can earn [b]Festive Rewards[/b] for all the Tier V+ ships in your Port!
[*]Unwrap [b]Santa's Gift containers[/b], streamlined to two types—Santa's Gift and Santa's Mega Gift—both stuffed with a new rotation of ships!
[*]Light your enemies up like a Christmas Tree with three new holiday-themed [b]enemy destruction effects[/b].
[/list]

[h2]Removal of Magazine Detonation[/h2]

Based on player feedback, we've decided to change our stance on the magazine detonation mechanic and are going to remove it from the game entirely starting with Update 13.11

This change goes hand-in-hand with another series of changes, including the [b]removal of the Juliet Charlie signal[/b], which will be replaced with the [b]new Charlie Kilo signal[/b], increasing ship HP and squadron HP by +5% and +2.5%, respectively. The [b]Magazine Modification 1[/b] upgrade will be removed entirely, and all of its owners will automatically receive full compensation in Credits.

[h2]Event Pass[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38188069/b66b3c58dbff74de76ffc1ebfd692921ca1fa06b.jpg[/img]

Our heroes [b]Li Wei[/b] and [b]Olaf Lundgren[/b] are nearing the end of their expedition to the North Pole! Update 13.11 features two themed Event Pass chapters, each dedicated to an explorer you’ve already met in a previous update.

Advancing through the Event Pass levels will bring you Commanders Li Wei and Olaf Lundgren, plus various awesome rewards like ships!

Each Event Pass chapter lasts for 3 weeks, features 25 levels and functions as a standalone Pass. This means that once the first chapter ends, you won’t be able to complete it retroactively!

[h2]Star Trek Operation—Queen's Rage[/h2]

The final chapter of our [i]STAR TREK[/i] Operations unfolds in Update 13.11. At the beginning of the Operation, you must defend three control points at risk of falling to the Borg. You’ll face three enemy waves, each led by a powerful minion.

If you successfully defeat all the Borg Queen's minions, she'll have no choice but to join the fight herself…

The third phase of the Star Trek Operation reward track offers Steel, Free XP, Elite Commander XP, special and rare economic bonuses, signals, Star Tokens, and collection items.

[h2]Dockyard: Niord[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38188069/c89af567bd662a85c1412ae40394510b9165266e.jpg[/img]

Construction of European Tier IX battleship [b]Niord[/b] is commencing at the Hamburg Dockyard. The ship features eight accurate 380 mm main battery guns with a fast reload. She also boasts 20 torpedo tubes with a tight spread, fast speed, and long range.

One of the intermediate rewards is European Tier V destroyer [b]Kalmar[/b], which can be found at the 8th shipbuilding phase.

The Dockyard construction process consists of 20 phases, 18 of which you can advance through via combat missions, while the rest can be purchased for Doubloons. Each shipbuilding phase costs 3,000 Doubloons. Starter packs of two and six phases can be purchased for 5,000 and 12,600 Doubloons, respectively. 

[h2]Asymmetric Battles[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38188069/1c29a1317b724297d090ffd56bc1edb663e12453.jpg[/img]

The beloved battle type where you fight as a team of five against superior bot-controlled forces has returned!

[list]
[*]You can play Tier VI–X ships and superships
[*]Five ships to a team on the player side
[*]Maximum difference of one tier between the ships
[*]You can play any ship type
[/list]

[h2]Clan Patrols[/h2]

Update 13.11 also delivers a temporary new activity—Clan Patrols—available for all Clan members. Inside the special Patrol window under the Clan tab, you can choose a battle type for Patrols and receive extra rewards just by playing it!

notes.title: Beam Down to Planet Vulcan for a Second Wave of STAR TREK Content!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e44fd50aa550b298e6f865510b676940e8db8167.jpg[/img]

[i]STAR TREK voyages further into World of Warships with new Operations, Commanders, camouflages, and more![/i]

[b]Beloved characters from the longest-running sci-fi television franchise have warped back into World of Warships, and they’ve brought company! [/b]

The second wave of our collaboration with STAR TREK is officially in effect! Take advantage of exclusive space-age content for Captains on Steam, including a combat mission chain to earn some Steam cosmetics and a brand-new STAR TREK permanent camouflage of your choice, as well as special DLC packs to unlock even more new permanent camouflages at a discount!

[h2]Exclusive Combat Mission: Fight for a Free Permanent Camouflage![/h2]

[i]This free mission is available to unlock until November 11[/i]

To the Holodeck! All you have to do is finish 10 battles and then earn 200 ribbons playing the new STAR TREK-themed Operations, and you’ll get the Steam patch symbol and background, as well as your choice between one of the new STAR TREK permanent camouflages: the Starfleet-themed “To Boldly Go” or the Borg’s own “Assimilated.”

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/552990/view/4454716097180991564

[h2]Deals on Themed Permanent Camouflages[/h2]

[i]DLC available to purchase until December 12[/i]

Turn your ships into starships with just a few clicks! Purchase a new DLC pack containing one of each type of new STAR TREK-themed permanent camouflage and give your fleet the spacefaring makeover it deserves. A second pack is also available containing double the content at a 25% discount!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3311850/World_of_Warships_x_STAR_TREK__Borg__Starfleet_Cosmetic_Pack/?beta=1

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3311860/World_of_Warships_x_STAR_TREK__Borg__Starfleet_Cosmetic_Value_Pack/?beta=1

[h2]STAR TREK Second Wave Content in World of Warships![/h2]

Set phasers to “fun,” and get ready for enough new content to fill the void of space! This time, in addition to four more individually voiced [b]Commanders[/b] and dazzling permanent [b]camouflages[/b], we’re excited for you to play all-new STAR TREK [b]Operations[/b] as they unfurl on a new battle map and gather elements of a themed [b]collection.[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]PvE Operation:[/b] Descend into the atmosphere of Vulcan and help the Federation and its allies fend off a ruthless Borg invasion on the planet’s alien seas.
[*] [b]4 New Commanders:[/b] USS Enterprise’s officers Riker and Worf, together with their Starfleet colleague Captain Janeway of USS Voyager and the personification of the Borg hivemind—the Borg Queen, enter the game, each with an individual voiceover.
[*] [b]Permanent camouflages:[/b] Unlock the Borg-themed Queen’s Diamond permanent camouflage for Yamato and the U.S.S. Voyager permanent camouflage for Salem, as well as “To Boldly Go” and “Assimilated” permanent camouflages that can be mounted on any ship.
[*] [b]STAR TREK collection:[/b] Crack open “Space, the Final Frontier” Premium containers and gather elements of a new themed collection! Completing it will reward you with themed camouflages, patches, and the "Space, the Final Frontier" achievement. 
[/list]

Learn more about the collaboration via the relevant link:

[url=https://cpm.wargaming.net/x1ihjefb/?&pub_id=startrek style=button] [b]DISCOVER MORE[/b] [/url]

notes.title: Tag Barrage: Earn Free Premium Account in Just a Few Seconds!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8f8d3b9c0582cb7d06a3856dd53bc852767abfdd.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Captains![/b][/h1]

World of Warships prides itself on being not only the ultimate game for fans of naval combat simulation but also one of the top free-to-play online experiences available on Steam. Help us spread the word to the wider Steam community by applying the tags "Simulation" and "Massively Multiplayer" to the game's main page and enjoy a full day of enhanced in-game earnings with Warships Premium Account!

[h1]How to Take Part[/h1]

Just follow these simple steps:

1. Find the "Popular user-defined tags for this product" section on the right-hand side of World of Warships' Steam STORE page, either in your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/552990/World_of_Warships/?tags=&tags] web browser[/url] or in the Steam app.

2. Click the "+" symbol.

3. Find the tags "[b]Simulation[/b]" and "[b]Massively Multiplayer[/b]" in the pop-up window's list of popular tags, then click the "+" symbol beside both of them. [b]If you don't see these tags[/b] on the list, type them into field on the right side of the window, then click the "Add" button. 

4. Leave a comment below this news post letting us know that you've completed the task.

You're done! Exactly 7 days later, [b]24 hours of Warships Premium Account*[/b] will be applied to your account. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/0cad5a84859b10b161c71d928028e74cfa2c7e2e.gif[/img]

*Please note that this reward can only be granted once per month, per player.

[i]Stay tuned for more activities and good luck in battle, Captains![/i]

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 13.10
notes.content:
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 13.10. For more information, visit the relevant link:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/work-in-progress-1310/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/public-test/work-in-progress-1310/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/public-test/work-in-progress-1310/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

[h2]STAR TREK Operations[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a303b0dbeaf3be74514e86791d1b15c05256218b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5a459e3bf720b927b8e22e0dd164fab0cb84a522.jpg[/img]

In the second wave of our collaboration with [b]STAR TREK[/b], you can dive into three exciting Operations, each lasting 2 weeks, spanning Updates 13.10 and 13.11.

The Operations unfold on the planet Vulcan during an attack from the Borg Collective. You must take control of ships representing the Federation,  the Federation, Vulcan, Klingon Empire, and Romulan Star Empire factions.

In the new STAR TREK Port, you can follow your reward track progress, upgrade your ships, and explore a [b]themed collection[/b]. Iconic STAR TREK memorabilia will grace your Captain's quarters, and collecting its elements will provide battle bonuses for the event's Operations.

New weapons and shield mechanics are available, with phasers, pulse phasers, and photon torpedoes. The event introduces a [b]unique system for upgrading your ships[/b], with the use of unlockable modules affecting primary weapons, secondary weapons, hulls, and shields. [b]Combining the different modules in various ways will change the configuration[/b] of ship stats, armaments, and consumables; or even unlock Combat Instructions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ac8a6d1a0ab3b6b8d4b2aabd0908e8bf686693b3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c9c0b6a745713a0ef4701a492264d53e5e45e325.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1911aa6e459553377401f07da27b1d43af9f4113.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c3184f2b267f749ee72f49ce5e21890ff17154c7.jpg[/img]

[h2]Black Friday Event Pass[/h2]

It's getting to that time of the year! This year, we've got even more ships, containers, Coal, Steel, and a new custom enemy destruction effect—Monochrome!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/cbc13e3f7be2d6af45b743e518841349c8e8948b.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]The [b]first progression line[/b] brings Black Friday 2024 Premium and standard containers, 3 days of Warships Premium Account, economic rewards, and a new enemy destruction effect.
[*]The [b]second progression line[/b] brings French battleship Dunkerque B, French Commander Jeremie Noel with 10 skill points, even more Black Friday 2024 Premium and standard containers, and other valuable rewards.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/deb0e1190480fae978e9541d3ad305cf948d2233.jpg[/img]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3399151c701193abe1ace8342375f0eba43d94e3.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3a9edc7b29fef44b0d3ecdfa05ecc4085b36ece3.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d62d19cc99b04975d8d9256f6f45c03536be3383.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2fbf6df5c9623e82faa1e4797807545e6b4d11aa.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/235d8555aa89a7d73a94180d3c9fc2cb16c35beb.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8ba56319c9d532a429e558cc75ff489b0f2c03a9.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/4b5c8c05cd4cf2eb7b1a574ec8412b7b9c5d850d.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c972a52532f130908442bf4bca2c4850e7c2e6f5.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Arena[/h2]

A new high-stakes Brawl event is coming your way! During the first week of the event, a special mission chain will become purchasable in the Armory for 10,000 Coal. After making the purchase, you can proceed to 3v3 Brawls playing Tier IX battleships, cruisers, and destroyers. Every victory will earn you rewards!

[list]
[*]You must win seven times to complete the mission chain.
[*]You can lose an occasional battle, but no more than three battles in total.
[*]Completing the chain will bring you the final reward—500 Steel.
[*]If you lose more than three times, the chain will break, you'll be rewarded with 3x More Coal containers, and you'll have to start from scratch by purchasing another mission chain.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 13.9: Red October
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b699c4debf5f98d5060751143f30bf8edb037366.jpg[/img]
This is a short overview of some of the content introduced in Update 13.9. You'll find more information in a dedicated article on our website:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-139-red-october/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] 

[h2]Mode Shuffle 2.0[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/738b2620f8c34ae176c0ce639d456af2667aaeae.jpg[/img]

The dynamic battle type that randomly places you in one of three different game modes has returned for Update 13.9, with some interesting changes. Alongside [b]Convoy[/b] and [b]Airship Escort[/b], you could land in a game of [b]Epicenter[/b], which has had a fair few tweaks to its points system, and that is taking the place of Arms Race from our previous iteration of Mode Shuffle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9691b8b5ebf6123b31c3fa4d3066974db9e6f5ce.jpg[/img]


[h2]German-Themed Event Pass[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7841152ad1bcaf5220b04f197b96820bb113a25f.jpg[/img]

Update 13.9's event pass, titled "Unity, Justice, Freedom" pays homage to Germany's Reunification Day both in name and in content:

[list]
[*]The [b]first progression line[/b] includes "Black, Red, and Gold" and "Black, White, Red" permanent camouflages, the German Navy permanent camouflage for Prinz Heinrich, and the German Eagle permanent camouflage for Prinz Rupprecht
[*]The [b]second progression line[/b] can be unlocked with 2,500 Doubloons, and grants tier VI destroyer [b]Karl von Schönberg[/b] immediately, followed by the German Navy permanent camouflage for Zieten, Commander Willie Neumann, 1x German Squadron Premium container, and the German Eagle permanent camouflage for Schlieffen
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/fac4d1f1139f9cfa451fce7645262af2cd46e2cb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e4701616d59ef035b35162533f2586aba78cbf70.jpg[/img]


[h2]Red October Bounty Hunt[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3edad7fc65c1ad9fcfa79b2064cb612f75ab6311.jpg[/img]

Will you sign up to be a Bounty, or will you be a dedicated hunter? Either way, you can take home some Soviet-themed rewards for taking part in our latest Bounty Hunt event!

The [b]Bounty status[/b] can be purchased up to 80 times from the Armory for 100,000 Credits, with the first three purchases being free. You lose the Bounty status when your ship gets destroyed or the event ends.

You can get a temporary currency called [b]Red Tokens[/b] if you earn special achievements, as well as for destroying ships while having the Bounty status active. You can spend Red Tokens on variety of rewards including Soviet Era containers, which can drop new Soviet cruiser [b]Kozma Minin[/b] among other things!

[h3]Red October Leaderboard[/h3]

During the first week of the event, we'll be tracking progress on a leaderboard—sink as many Bounties as possible to claim valuable rewards, depending on your final ranking:

[list]
[*]1-10: tier VIII submarine [b]S-189[/b]
[*]11-25: get 3x Soviet Era Premium containers
[*]26-50: 1,000 Steel
[/list]

[h2]The Battle of Leyte Gulf[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/daa15ad7b70d55b997164f5ed739b82da5969550.jpg[/img]

We're marking the 80th anniversary of the largest naval encounter of World War II with an interactive adventure and opportunities to get legendary Tier VIII carrier [b]Enterprise[/b] and new tier VIII battleship [b]Tennessee[/b]!

As you advance through the adventure, you will learn the history of this battle as you complete missions and earn new Leyte Gulf containers and Leyte tokens, the latter of which you can exchange for containers guaranteed to drop Tier VI–IX Premium ships, the "I Shall Return" permanent camouflage for Tennessee, the Ghost of the Pacific permanent camouflage for Enterprise, as well as eight 10-skill-point historical Commanders, and more

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f120da214f05a83baf272e74bf6e89757bfab612.jpg[/img]

[h3]Take the Update 13.9 Survey![/h3]

Enjoying the new features introduced by Update 13.9? Let us know what you think via the survey link below!

Captains!

notes.title: Work in Progress: Update 13.9 Round 2
notes.content:
This is a short overview of the planned features for Update 13.9. If you want to participate in the Public Test for the coming update and read more about its features, visit the dedicated article on our website:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/work-in-progress-139/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] 

[b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this article is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live.

[h2]Mode Shuffle Returns![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/334e888541e11741efff86f61e822be428fc9646.jpg[/img]

You may remember the Mode Shuffle temporary battle type that randomly placed you in either an Airship Escort, Convoy, or Arms Race battle back in Update 13.6. Well, it's returning in 13.9, but with one important change—[b]Arms Race will be removed[/b] from the rotation in favor of the [b]Epicenter[/b] mode, which we last saw on the Live Server back in Update 0.11.4!

Not only is Epicenter making a reappearance, but its team point-earning system has been updated to better reward risk takers who venture into the inner Key Areas, as well as make the endgame more interesting.

[h2]German Unification Day in the Event Pass[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/670e3a324c79e48b46cb86b656abf9a2f4fc20cc.jpg[/img]

Update 13.9's Event Pass is dedicated to an important German holiday that celebrates the reunification of East and West Germany after the end of the Cold War.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f6a76637cba4c759be6d8626c8612a179569f7e1.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*][b]The first progression line[/b] rewards "Black, Red, and Gold" and "Black, White, Red" permanent camouflages, along with the German Navy permanent camouflage for [b]P. Heinrich[/b] and the German Eagle permanent camouflage for [b]P. Rupprecht[/b].
[*]Unlocking the [b]second progression line[/b] will let you get your hands on Premium destroyer [b]Karl von Schönberg[/b], the German Navy permanent camouflage for [b]Zieten[/b], the German Eagle permanent camouflage for [b]Schlieffen[/b], German Commander [b]Willie Neumann[/b], and a German Squadron Premium container.
[/list]

[h2]"Red October" Bounty Hunt[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9068aef89fcb35239192e703856de6bfec46dab5.jpg[/img]

The dynamic Bounty Hunt experience is returning to the seas of World of Warships, this time with a Soviet-themed coat of paint.

The goal is to sink Bounty ships or earn the Bounty achievement in Random Battles. If you choose to take on the Bounty status for yourself, your goal will be to sink ships and earn achievements.

You can get the Bounty status in the Armory in exchange for 100,000 Credits, and each player can purchase up to 80 Bounty statuses during the event, with the first three being free. The Bounty status will be removed once your ship is destroyed or the event ends.

Rewards include Soviet Era containers, Victory Banner permanent camouflages for several Soviet ships, Victory permanent camouflages, and Coal. 

During the first week of the event, you'll be able to track the total number of Bounties destroyed and earn various goodies in the exciting and rewarding Leaderboard competition. The top 10 players in each region will receive Premium Tier VIII submarine [b]S-189[/b], or 5,000 Steel if they already have this ship in their fleet. The top 11–25 will get 3x Soviet Era Premium containers, and the top 26–50 players will get 1,000 Steel.

notes.title: Weekend Highlights | 13.8 #1
notes.content:
[h2]Patch Notes: Update 13.8[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1ad1f972c991649ae243ab2566191c2fc451b246.png[/img]
The World of Warships Anniversary Update begins here! Before you dive head-first into battle, be sure to give our dedicated Update publication a quick look to get the read on all the in-game celebrations and new features you can expect.

[b]Read Patch Notes:[/b]

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-138-9th-anniversary/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-138-9th-anniversary/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-138-9th-anniversary/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]Unlock Festive Rewards Through Battle Performance[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/95a5586c65cfefdbfad282a83dbddc5ab90ca052.jpg[/img]
Celebrate World of Warships' 9th anniversary with Festive Rewards! Throughout the update, you can unlock special rewards for achieving certain [b]Base XP thresholds[/b] aboard any and all Tier V+ ships in your Port. And this year, we've made it easier than ever!

These rewards consist of [b]Festive Tokens[/b]—a currency that you can exchange in the Armory for Tier VIII American cruiser [b]Rochester[/b], Battle of Paso de Patria containers, the Stellar Pioneer permanent camo for [b]Benson[/b], Supercontainers, and much, much more!

[b]More info:[/b]

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/world-of-warships-9th-anniversary/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/general-news/world-of-warships-9th-anniversary/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/general-news/world-of-warships-9th-anniversary/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]Unlock Pan-American Battleships in Early Access[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b481018abe679670823d977cc432ac3655be8cda.jpg[/img]
Pan-American Tech Tree Battleships Ipiranga, Los Andes, and Libertad have been unleashed on our virtual battlefields in Early Access! If your idea of a battleship involves [b]guns, guns, and more guns[/b], then these bad boys will be right up your alley. A key feature of these ships is their access to [b]Combat Instructions[/b], which improves the range, damage, and reload time of the secondary battery when activated.

[list]
[*][b]Ipiranga[/b] is the final reward in the first progression line of the Update 13.8 Event Pass.
[*][b]Los Andes[/b] is available in a sequential bundle in the Armory that can be unlocked with Pan-American Tokens.
[*][b]Libertad[/b] can be obtained at the end of the sequential bundles in exchange for Doubloons.
[/list]

As part of this event, you'll also be able to unlock [b]permanent camouflages[/b] for each of these ships, inspired by the ship's country of origin.

For more information about the new ships, camouflages, and Pan-American Tokens, see our dedicated article below:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/early-access-to-pan-american-battleships/ style=button][b]EU[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/general-news/early-access-to-pan-american-battleships/ style=button][b]NA[/b][/url] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/general-news/early-access-to-pan-american-battleships/ style=button][b]ASIA[/b][/url]

[h2]Battle of Paso de Patria Collection and Joaquim Marques Lisboa[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c9537e7375f9c136ee7d5f38ccea02ce5b9e004a.jpg[/img]
With the release of the new Pan-American line, there's no better time to introduce a themed collection with a [b]unique Commander[/b] for the in-game nation. [b]Joaquim Marques Lisboa[/b], a historical 19th-century commander of the Brazilian Navy, comes with the [b]enhanced Survivability Expert[/b] skill when sailing destroyers, cruisers, and aircraft carriers, as well as the [b]enhanced Brisk[/b] skill for battleships. 

He can also activate two unique talents in battle:

[b]Relentless Firing[/b]:
[list]
[*]Condition: Hit enemy ships 175 times with main/secondary battery shells.
[*]Bonus: Reduces the reload time of the main battery, secondary battery, and torpedo tubes.
[/list]

[b]Master and Commander[/b]:
[list]
[*]Condition: Use Combat Instructions twice.
[*]Bonus: Raises the minimum Combat Instructions progress and increases ship speed.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 13.8: World of Warships Anniversary!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/10ad804367ef903b961dc1150efa0c4b6983a8db.jpg[/img]
This is a short overview of some of the content that is introduced in Update 13.8. You'll find more information in a dedicated article on our website:

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-138-9th-anniversary/  style=button][b]EU[/b][/url]

[h2]Anniversary Celebrations![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b8d3289d7c9af6ccf906556d23d76c76b6181a95.jpg[/img]

World of Warships will be turning 9 years old this month! In our usual fashion, we are throwing an all-out party full of Festive Rewards and events for our players!

[h3]Festive Rewards[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/95a5586c65cfefdbfad282a83dbddc5ab90ca052.jpg[/img]

As is tradition, throughout our Anniversary update you can unlock special rewards for achieving certain [b]Base XP thresholds[/b] aboard any and all Tier V+ ships in your Port. And this year, we've made it easier than ever!

Your rewards will consist of [b]Festive Tokens[/b], a currency that can be exchanged in the Armory for Tier VIII American cruiser [b]Rochester[/b], Battle of Paso de Patria containers, the Stellar Pioneer permanent camouflage for [b]Benson[/b], Supercontainers, and much, much more!

[h3]New Collection[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c9537e7375f9c136ee7d5f38ccea02ce5b9e004a.jpg[/img]

It's been a long time coming and now it's finally here! To celebrate our anniversary, we have a brand-new in-game puzzle collection for you to complete! 

There are 60 elements in total, which you can get from Battle of Paso de Patria standard and Premium containers. The final reward for completing the collection will be new unique [b]Pan-American Commander Joaquim Marques Lisboa[/b].

[h3]Aquatica Fair[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/0979855bfaabab52d50be520ad8a86f4388fb6e1.jpg[/img]

A new event has entered the Armory! In the Aquatica Fair event, you'll spend Tries to earn items from a large reward pool that includes new Tier IX Spanish battleship [b]Victoria[/b], Tier IX European battleship [b]Karl XIV Johan[/b], Tier VIII German battleship [b]Anhalt[/b], the Galactic Wanderer permanent camouflage for Victoria, and other anniversary-themed permanent camouflages from past years. 

[h2]Pan-American Battleships in Early Access[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b481018abe679670823d977cc432ac3655be8cda.jpg[/img]

Be the first to try out the first Pan-American line of battleships in the game with our latest Early Access event! Battleships [b]Ipiranga[/b], [b]Los Andes[/b], and [b]Libertad[/b] are awaiting your command, each with a large number of guns they can bring to bear. 

To complement this setup, the ships have access to a [b]Combat Instructions[/b] mechanic that, when activated, improves the range, damage, and reload time of their secondary batteries. To charge the Combat Instructions meter, you must either score hits with your main battery guns or accumulate potential damage.

In addition, the Pan-American battleships have access to an [b]enhanced Repair Party[/b] consumable that restores a higher amount of HP.

As for downsides, gun-for-gun, their main batteries have lower range and firepower than the equivalent ships of other nations, and their citadels are vulnerable to enemy shells when the ships' broadsides are exposed.

[h2]Operations Battle Type Update[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2a1ada51a9193d27d8e7236ed6de6c7aa6d9dcf7.jpg[/img]

Update 13.8 will introduce changes to Operations. These changes will affect Naval Station Newport, Raptor Rescue, The Ultimate Frontier, Hermes, Aegis, and Cherry Blossom. [b]We have expanded the range of tiers[/b] that can participate in these 6 Operations, allowing you to bring your Tier VI–X ships and superships into battle.

[h2]More Novelties and Changes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/db3ae586646e34d26b052961542d6c4606ce7cc6.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*][b]New Season of Ranked Battles[/b]: Season 19 begins this week with the Bronze, Silver, and Gold Leagues in a 6 vs. 6 format on Tiers VI and VII, VIII and IX, and X and superships, respectively.
[*][b]New Clan Battles Season[/b]: Codenamed "Asp," the new season of this competitive battle type will be played in a 7 vs. 7 format aboard Tier VIII battleships, destroyers, and cruisers.
[*][b]Expedition to the North Pole[/b]: The road to the New Year begins here! Leading up to December, complete special combat mission chains during each update, then collect rewards such as ships and Santa's Gift containers as you progress.
[*][b]Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles[/b]: Get ready to welcome new Commanders, totally rad permanent camouflages, Pizza Time Premium containers, and more themed content later in Update 13.8. Stay tuned for more information!
[*][b]System Requirements Update[/b]: We've updated the system requirements for World of Warships based on our latest performance tests to provide our players with the most optimal hardware configurations. Game client performance should not change for current users.
[/list]
