[h2][b][h1=battle-of-the-somme-collection][/h1]Battle of the Somme Collection[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e9974578-2218-11ee-a9b1-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Thu. 27 Jul. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Thu. 24 Aug. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

A week after the release of Update 12.6, a new collection—Battle of the Somme—will become available. It commemorates one of the most immense battles of World War I, which took place from July 1, 1916 through November 18 of the same year on both banks of the River Somme. It was a confrontation between the armies of the British Empire and French Third Republic on one side and the forces of the German Empire on the other side.

To complete this collection, you'll need 60 different elements that the new Battle of the Somme containers can drop. These containers can be obtained in the Armory in exchange for Doubloons and in the Premium Shop. They are also rewarded for completing combat missions, and the number of containers you can earn this way will be sufficient to complete the entire collection. The exchange rate for duplicate elements is 2:1.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/392b56aa-2189-11ee-a7fb-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
We'll reveal the contents of this container on [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/contents-and-drop-rates-of-containers/]our website[/url] with the release of Update 12.6.

The rewards for completing the collection are [b][img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Somme[/b][/b], a ship that's kin to [b][img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Jutland[/b][/b], with the unique "Lest We Forget" permanent camouflage and a Commander with 10 skill points.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/392f2744-2189-11ee-b382-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][h1=economic-changes][/h1]Economic Changes[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e9ab6e04-2218-11ee-9cc3-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]

Starting with Update 12.6, we'll be adding Operations to the majority of combat missions. Due to the specifics of this battle type, it's easier to fulfil the requirements of some combat missions in Operations; so as not to change the difficulty of missions in other battle types, results achieved in Operations will be reduced by a certain factor.

For certain metrics, the progress in combat missions and Personal Challenges will be halved when playing in Operations. For example, if a mission requires you to earn two "Destroyed" ribbons, you’ll need to earn four such ribbons if you decide to go for it in Operations. Another way to complete this mission would be by earning one ribbon in a Random Battle and two ribbons in Operations.

When the reduction factor is applied to combat missions, the Operations icon will display a special indication.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/430f31fa-2215-11ee-85d7-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][h1=brawls][/h1]Brawls[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ea413f24-2218-11ee-9275-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]

Update 12.6 features four Brawls in different formats.

[h3][i]Brawl 1[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Start:[/b] [b]Fri. 21 Jul. 10:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

Format: 5 vs. 5 playing Tier IX ships; no more than two battleships and three destroyers. You can participate in a Division of up to five players.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Brawl 2[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
Format: 4 vs. 4 playing Tier VIII submarines, destroyers, cruisers, and battleships; no more than one submarine, two battleships, and two destroyers. You can participate in a Division of up to four players.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Brawl 3[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
Format: 4 vs. 4 playing Tier X battleships. You can participate in a Division of up to two players.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Brawl 4[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
Format: 3 vs. 3 playing Tier X ships; no more than one submarine, one aircraft carrier, two destroyers, two cruisers, and two battleships. You can participate in a Division of up to three players.
[/expand]

[h2][b][h1=division-star][/h1]Division Star[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/385e91e8-222d-11ee-aee2-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]

The Division Star is a special event in which you can earn extra rewards by playing together with your Clanmates.
[list][*]You can earn a Division Star by playing in a Division with your Clanmates.
[*]Stars can be earned in all battle types, except for Training Battles.
[*]Certain numbers of earned Stars unlock access to various rewards.
[*]If you switch Clans, any Stars and rewards you previously received remain with you.[/list]

By playing together with your Clanmates, you can earn a total of up to three Stars—one for each fulfilled requirement:
[list][*]Winning a battle.
[*]Earning the "Shoulder to Shoulder" Division achievement.
[*]Earning the "Coordinated Attack" Division achievement.[/list]  [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/42e1eb3c-2215-11ee-bbd0-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][h1=technical-improvements][/h1]Technical Improvements[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/eabdf00a-2218-11ee-a48d-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Settings Menu Improvements[/h2]
In Update 12.6, we've completely reworked the Settings menu interface.

All available parameters are now divided into [b]eight sections[/b]: Display, Graphics, Audio, HUD, Camera, Mouse, Keyboard/Controls, and Other. Certain settings have been removed, while others have been merged together.

The interface changes introduced in this update aim to enhance user experience by providing a simpler and more convenient way to personalize the game to your liking! Furthermore, "under the hood" enhancements have been implemented so that we can seamlessly add new settings in the future.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9132b392-2216-11ee-939c-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Recruiting Station Combat Missions[/h2]
Update 12.6 delivers missions with requirements specifically designed for Recruiters and their Shipmates. Team up in Divisions to progress through them and earn rewards!

[quote][i]Only Division members who are in a "Recruiter-Shipmate" relationship with at least one other Division mate will have their progress towards the Recruiting Station combat missions counted.[/i][/quote]

[h2]Replay Improvements[/h2]
[list][*]We've added the post-battle statistics screen to the end of replays.
[*]We've also added a "Watch Again" button.[/list]
[h2]Twitch Drops[/h2]
Twitch Drops are back in Update 12.6. We took advantage of this break to make a technical improvement that will allow users to request and receive Twitch Drops without the need to re-log into their accounts.

[h2][b][h1=game-balance-changes][/h1]Game Balance Changes[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/380ed8a6-222d-11ee-bec1-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]

We’re tuning the balance of certain ships based on our analysis of their combat effectiveness and your feedback. The changes will affect U.S. researchable hybrid battleships and British cruiser [b][img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Hawkins[/b][/b].

[h3][b]Tier V British cruiser Hawkins[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The shell ballistics have been changed and are now characterized by a flatter trajectory.
[*]The armor penetration capabilities of AP shells have been improved.[/list]
[h2][b][h1=content-additions-and-changes][/h1]Content Additions and Changes[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ea69cb06-2218-11ee-85d7-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]

The game will feature:
[list][*]Commanders [b]José Prudencio Padilla[/b] and [b]Pavel Nakhimov[/b]
[*]Commanders [b]Fyodor Apraksin[/b], [b]Murat Serezli[/b], and [b]Hua Hu[/b] with individual voiceovers[/list]  [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/28f9bca2-2217-11ee-a48d-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]200 Years of the Colombia Navy and Telnyashka flags[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/28c72562-2217-11ee-8115-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]200 Years of the Colombian Navy patch[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/284989ea-2217-11ee-9275-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Four emblems for Pan-American ships[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/2966392c-2217-11ee-a9b1-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Prince Dmitry Pozharsky permanent camouflage for [b] [img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Dmitry Pozharsky[/b][/b][/list]  [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a7f2aca2-224f-11ee-b31b-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]An individual voiceover for Commander [b]Minakami Shiori[/b][/list]
[quote][i]In Update 12.7, Ranked and Clan Tokens will be removed from the game, and players will receive compensation in the form of Steel. As long as that Update is live, camouflages that are available in exchange for Ranked and Clan Tokens will also be available for Steel. More info on these changes will follow at a later date.[/i][/quote]

[h2]Container Changes[/h2]

[h2][b][h1=other-changes-and-improvements][/h1]Other Changes and Improvements[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/384338da-222d-11ee-9518-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]

[h2][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-126-spanish-cruisers/#concealed-maneuvers][/url]Lantern Lights[/h2]
We’ve prepared a chain of combat missions to celebrate the traditional Japanese Obon Festival.

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list][*]The starting number of points in the updated Domination mode in Co-op Battles has been increased from 150 to 200.
[*]Fixed the behavior of AI-powered bots in the following Operations: Aegis, Raptor Rescue, Narai, and Defense of Naval Station Newport.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the sonar indicator to be displayed incorrectly on a target that was hit by a sonar ping.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the text input field in the game chat to stop working when switching between Armory tabs.
[*]Fixed an issue in Operation Killer Whale that could prevent a battle from finishing in defeat when all player ships were destroyed after completing the initial primary task but prior to receiving the second one.
[*]Removed visual artifacts on the following maps: The Faroe Islands, Fault Line, and Seychelles.
[*]Removed visual artifacts in the following Ports: Saint Petersburg, Zipangu, and Naval Base.
[*]Fixed an issue that affected the Epic Games Store overlay loading and the friend list display.
[*]Fixed an issue that made it impossible to switch to the Binocular View when opening the game menu or hovering over the Minimap while pressing [b]Shift[/b].
[*]Updated the historical descriptions of U.S. ships.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused Commander [b]Michiel de Ruyter[/b] not to be marked as "Historical" in the Captain's Logbook.
[*]Fixed an issue that prevented players from getting a reward for completing a global mission chain.
[*]Fixed a bug that made it impossible to activate Combat Instructions with the Airstrike or torpedo armaments selected.
[*]We've added tooltips to the conditions of combat missions to be completed to earn certain achievements.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused excessive CPU load when loading the game.
[*]Fixed the incorrect display of deep-water torpedo tech specs when a Commander's skills were in effect or when equipment was active in combat.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused [b] [img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_9f372d47b4fa5b5bbd79a3aaac816cb8d5343fa93949cce8934d94b84751b88e.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Manfred von Richthofen[/b][/b]'s catapults to be misaligned.
[*]Fixed the incorrect sigma parameter for Hull B of [b][img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] North Carolina[/b][/b]. Now, it's the same as for Hull A and amounts to 2.05 instead of 2.0.
[*]Reduced the cost of shells for [b][img]https://wows-gloss-icons-pt.wgcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Cheshire[/b][/b] from [b]275[/b] to [b]250[/b] Credits.[/list]

Captains!

What part of World of Warships captivates you most? Is it the global multiplayer environment? The gritty naval setting? Or is it perhaps the realistic ship models? Tell us what draws you to the game by applying tags here on Steam, and we'll grant you [b]a full day of Warships Premium Account[/b]!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/552990/World_of_Warships/?tags][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/552990/extras/Steam_tags.gif?t=1574441033[/img][/url]

notes.title: Embrace the Cuteness: Welcome the Anime Commander to Your Fleet!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/288276a717003acfbb2636df8a1192c3c59cf222.png[/img]

Captains! 

A new Commander will soon be making waves in World of Warships! She is big on costumes, so she’ll be dressing up to take command of Japanese, Pan-Asian, and American ships wearing one of three [b]different styles that YOU can vote for![/b] But more on that in a bit. 

First, a little bit about her personality:

[table noborder=1][tr][td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/bd4c2d21ffa2cc4171ac157d1688e760d3b1241d.png[/img]
[/td][td]
[i]I'm a gamer girl who loves exploring different games but my favourite one is World of Warships. 

When I'm not strategizing in battles, you can find me immersed in the world of anime and gaming. I'm a tsundere at heart, but don't let that scare you away. I'm witty, independent, and always up for a good challenge. Looking for someone who can handle my competitive spirit and share my passion for gaming![/i]
[/td][/tr][/table]
[h1]Vote: What should she look like?[/h1] 
At the moment our new Commander is on a quest to find the perfect outfit to suit her future naval duties. Be a tiebreaker and help her choose which one matches each nation best! 

And if you have any suggestions for her name should be, kindly submit it on the voting page! We will pick the most suitable name, and the player who creates it will be granted with all three Commanders after their implementation to the game. 

[table noborder=1][tr][td]
[url=https://checkbox.wargaming.net/Anime-Commander-voting.survey style=button]Vote![/url]
[/td][td]
[b]Voting open:[/b] June 29, 00:00 UTC - July 9, 23:59 UTC. [/td][/tr][/table]

In one of the future updates we will implement these Commanders into the game wearing the most-voted appearance she will be representing. 

More details about how to obtain these new Commanders in her three different versions will be shared at a later date.

notes.title: Asymmetric Battles
notes.content:
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/89d16360-0ea6-11ee-99b0-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[b]Asymmetric Battles will return in Update 12.5. This battle type is inspired by historical battles that typically involved an unequal number of ships on each side.[/b]

In this new installment of Asymmetric Battles, players will face a team of bots that outnumbers them in ships but falls short in terms of firepower.

[table][tr][th][b][url=#rules-and-format]Rules and Format[/url]
[url=#game-maps-and-modes]Game Maps and Modes[/url]
[url=#combat-missions-and-rewards]Combat Missions and Rewards[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b][h1=rules-and-format][/h1]Rules and Format[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Thu. 22 Jun. 11:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Thu. 20 Jul. 02:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[quote][i]Asymmetric Battles are only available during the Prime Time period each day. This will speed up the process of assembling teams for battle.[/i][/quote]

[h3][i]Team: Players[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[list][*]Tiers: IX and X
[*]Number of ships: 5[/list]
[h3][b]Restrictions[/b][/h3]
[list][*]No more than one aircraft carrier and one submarine
[*]No more than three battleships, three cruisers, and three destroyers[/list][/expand]
[h3][i]Team: Bots[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[list][*]Tiers: VII and VIII
[*]Number of ships: 12[/list]
[h3][b]Restrictions[/b][/h3]
[list][*]No more than one aircraft carrier and one submarine
[*]Between four to five battleships and cruisers each
[*]Between two to three destroyers[/list][/expand]
[list][*]Asymmetric Battles are available to players who have Tier IX and/or Tier X ships in their Port. Divisions aren't allowed.
[*]Bots will have improved AI for Asymmetric Battles. They will take up more advantageous positions, rush into close combat less often, and distribute themselves more effectively around Key Areas.
[*]Asymmetric Battles offer higher rewards in terms of XP and Credits compared to Co-op Battles; however, they're not as lucrative as Random Battles in this regard.
[*]Due to the specifics of Asymmetric Battles, players won't be able to earn achievements in this battle type.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7e372340-0b91-11ee-a08d-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7e39575a-0b91-11ee-9738-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7e36eb32-0b91-11ee-bb04-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7e38d0d2-0b91-11ee-887b-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2][b][h1=game-maps-and-modes][/h1]Game Maps and Modes[/b][/h2]
[list][*]North, Hotspot, Islands of Ice, and Trident in the Domination mode with three Key Areas, and in the Standard Battle mode
[*]Trap and Shards in the Domination mode with three Key Areas[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/604ae90a-0ea9-11ee-8403-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/60490ca2-0ea9-11ee-8f09-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5e93a19c-0ea9-11ee-a5a0-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/60449ef6-0ea9-11ee-9d54-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/604a7650-0ea9-11ee-9ce1-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/604bf7f0-0ea9-11ee-95cf-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/60490eaa-0ea9-11ee-9372-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6047b280-0ea9-11ee-b012-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6049654e-0ea9-11ee-8f48-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/60497746-0ea9-11ee-bd94-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2][b][h1=combat-missions-and-rewards][/h1]Combat Missions and Rewards[/b][/h2]
Players will have access to special weekly and daily combat missions that can only be completed in Asymmetric Battles. Players will be rewarded with Community Tokens for winning battles and earning Base XP.

notes.content:

[b]Captains![/b]

Joining the Public Test is a great way to earn containers with Premium ships, permanent and expendable camouflages, and other valuable items. This time, we're providing you with an opportunity to obtain [b]European Tokens[/b]—you'll need these to unlock Early Access to European destroyers! You'll also be able to try out new destroyers [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_66b735f7c63b1fbc05c33f9f6289a5c5151eb9f7829f407ed4a9966188f19ff4.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Grom[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_66b735f7c63b1fbc05c33f9f6289a5c5151eb9f7829f407ed4a9966188f19ff4.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Split[/b][/b] on the Public Test Server after you complete one of the available missions.

[quote][i]All information on how to join the Public Test is available on a [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/pt-guide/]dedicated page[/url] of the official website.[/i][/quote]

The forthcoming Update 12.5 brings a new iteration of Asymmetric Battles, improved bot AI, and other new features. Check out our [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/bulletin-125/]Developer Bulletin[/url] and get involved. See you on the Public Test Server!

[h1][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/additional-public-test-rewards-124/ style=button]More Rewards for Public Test 12.4[/url][/h1]

[url=https://forum.worldofwarships.eu/forum/485-public-test/ style=button]Leave Feedback[/url]

[table][tr][th][b][url=#round-2-schedule]Round 2 Schedule[/url]
[url=#special-features-of-the-test]Special Features of the Test[/url]
[url=#combat-missions-and-rewards]Combat Missions and Rewards[/url]
[url=#starting-bonuses]Starting Bonuses[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table][hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=round-2-schedule][/h1]Round 2 Schedule[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Thu. 08 Jun. 18:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Tue. 13 Jun. 07:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

Captains, thank you for participating in the first round of the Public Test for Update 12.5! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Balance changes were applied to some ships. Details are available in a post on our [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/448]Development Blog[/url].
[*]Changed ship spawning positions in Asymmetric Battle. Now there will always be 2 ships on each flank.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the icing visual effect to be displayed incorrectly on a number of ships.
[*]Fixed a bug that could disable Secondaries in battle.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused destroyed ships to continue playing AA gun sounds and animations.
[*]Fixed several other issues.[/list][hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=special-features-of-the-test][/h1]Special Features of the Test[/b][/h2]
You can participate in Asymmetric Battles on the Public Test Server! They will be available between the following times: 06:00–05:00 UTC.

Starting with Update 12.5, it will be possible to set restrictions for ship types and specific ships in each league in Ranked Battles. These restrictions can be changed during the course of a season.

To test these changes, a special season of Ranked Battles will be held on the Public Test Server. Battles in all leagues will be fought with Tier X ships of all types. Teams will consist of three to six players, depending on the number of players in queue. Ranked Battles will be available on the Public Test Server between the following times: 00:00–23:30 UTC.

[quote][i][b]Please note:[/b] Due to the technicalities of the Public Test, ship restrictions don't apply to bots in Ranked Battles on the Public Test Server.[/i][/quote]
[quote][b]From the start of Ranked Battles on the Public Test server, it will not be possible to enter battles aboard [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_afff8f2e1e23cdf6b9314f80cca4fb85af40cfbe7812a9ccc707fd24ed207557.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Shikishima[/b][/b]. notes.title: Apply a Tag — Get 1 Day of Warships Premium Account
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8f8d3b9c0582cb7d06a3856dd53bc852767abfdd.jpg[/img]

Captains!

What part of World of Warships captivates you most? Is it the global multiplayer environment? The gritty naval setting? Or is it perhaps the realistic ship models? Tell us what draws you to the game by applying tags here on Steam, and we'll grant you [b]a full day of Warships Premium Account[/b]!

[h2]How to take part:[/h2]
[olist][*]Find the "Popular user-defined tags for this product" section on the right-hand side of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/552990/World_of_Warships/?tags]the main page[/url] of the game.
[*]Click the "+" symbol.
[*]Select a tag (or create your own) that’s applicable to World of Warships. To select an existing tag from the list, click the "+" symbol next to the tag of your choice.
[*]Share your list of tags in the comments of this news item.[/olist]
Voilà! Your Warships Premium Account will be activated precisely 7 days later.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/552990/World_of_Warships/?tags][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/552990/extras/Steam_tags.gif?t=1574441033[/img][/url]

[b]Attention![/b] The reward can only be granted once a month per player, regardless of the number of tags applied.

Good luck in battle, Captains!

Now, a real legend has decided to pay us a visit… Please welcome [b]Popeye the Sailor Man™[/b] to World of Warships! Let's get straight to the point—I'll tell you why they say Popeye is always strong to the finish! Popeye is tough, he’s fit, and he’s got grit—he yam what he yam—a rugged sailor who never backs down and doesn’t hesitate to speak his mind. [h2][b][h1=save-the-oceans][/h1]Save the Oceans![/b][/h2]
World of Warships and Popeye the Sailor Man both share an infinitely deep passion for the oceans. Our common goal is to prevent the mysterious and endlessly beautiful source of our admiration from dying, so we're pleased to announce that together with Force Blue we're going to do our best to help the cause. You can find out what we're preparing in a special article!

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/a92c6d94-0047-11ee-b1a5-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/wargaming-and-force-blue-for-ocean-month/ style=button]Save the Oceans![/url]
[h2][b][h1=who-is-popeye][/h1]Who Is Popeye?[/b][/h2]
An underdog with bulging forearms, a mean uppercut, and a love of canned spinach, Popeye is a defender of the weak and protector of those he loves (including the oceans). Unassuming, unsophisticated, and undeterred by a challenge, Popeye inspires us all to work hard and be persistent. He stands up for what’s right and stays strong to the finish… with the help of a hefty amount of leafy greens, of course!

The Popeye the Sailor Man franchise is a global pop-culture icon owned by King Features Syndicate. From the moment he first appeared in a comic strip series by E.C. Segar in 1929, Popeye captured the hearts of millions of fans worldwide. As the star of his own comics strips and animated content on the big screen and small, Popeye became quickly ingrained in American culture and today remains one of the most recognizable icons in the world. Popeye is an iconic naval-themed IP and a truly entertaining character, very tightly associated with the U.S. Navy and with high nostalgia value, especially for older generations of naval enthusiasts in the West.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0ee5256a-feed-11ed-afe4-ac162d70f4e4.png[/img]
[h3]© 2023 King Features Syndicate
™ Hearst Holdings, Inc.[/h3]

notes.title: The Return of Convoy in Update 12.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/84b92a52d456ff416beb356cde109e5cc873a291.jpg[/img]
[b]The Convoy temporary battle type is back in the game in Update 12.4.[/b]

You're once again tasked with defending or attacking transport ships that are en route to their destination point with essential supplies.

The principles behind the Convoy battle type are based on real historical events. In the past, sea battles didn't only involve warships clashing and aerial assaults. A significant aspect of naval confrontations involved defending or attacking the shipping lanes that were being used to transport strategically important cargo.

[quote][i]Convoy will be available throughout Update 12.4.[/i][/quote]

[table][tr][th][b][url=#what-has-changed]What Has Changed[/url]
[url=#rules]Rules[/url]
[url=#rewards]Rewards[/url]
[url=#combat-missions]Combat Missions[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=what-has-changed][/h1]What Has Changed[/b][/h2]
Update 12.4 delivers the following changes:
[list][*]We've added one more map—you'll be fighting tooth and nail on Haven.
[*]We've updated the behavior of bot ships—transport ships will now change their speed to avoid torpedoes instead of changing course.
[*]We've improved the battle type interface.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5d0b8b34-f962-11ed-a358-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5d3fda74-f962-11ed-b1f0-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5d099d60-f962-11ed-ad3c-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5d3bf0b2-f962-11ed-b64e-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=rules][/h1]Rules[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Thu. 25 May 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Thu. 22 Jun. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[h3][i]Defending and attacking[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
Two teams participate in each battle—one is tasked with escorting cargo ships, and the other is tasked with attacking them. Players are randomly distributed between the two teams. You can enter each battle either alone or as part of a Division of up to three players.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Team missions[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
The defending team needs to escort convoys of cargo ships as they sail along a defined route. The defending team wins if at least one convoy ship reaches her destination point or the entire enemy team is sent back to Port. The mission of the attacking team is to completely destroy either the convoy or its defenders.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Transport ships[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
All convoys are made up of Liberty-class transport ships. They have little HP and weak armor. On the other hand, they can deploy smoke screens and change speed to avoid enemy torpedoes. In addition, these ships are armed with two main battery guns and twelve secondary battery guns that are capable of firing at approaching opponents. They also have AA defenses to repel air attacks.
[/expand]
[h3][b]Format[/b][/h3]
[list][*]12 vs. 12 with Tier VIII—X ships.[/list]
[h3][b]Maps[/b][/h3]
North, Hotspot, Trap, Two Brothers, Tears of the Desert, Haven, Crash Zone Alpha.

[quote][i]Depending on the map, the convoys can follow two or three routes at the same time, leading to one or several destinations.[/i][/quote]

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5fea7e7e-f961-11ed-8407-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5fed10bc-f961-11ed-a514-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5fead536-f961-11ed-90d1-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5fecf546-f961-11ed-bf5a-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5feadaa4-f961-11ed-ab2b-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5fea7e7e-f961-11ed-ad3c-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5feccbb6-f961-11ed-881c-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5febae5c-f961-11ed-9733-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=rewards][/h1]Rewards[/b][/h2]
[h2]Achievements[/h2]
Your successes in Convoy will be rewarded with special themed achievements:
[table][tr][th][b][b]Achievement Name[/b][/b][/th][th][b][b]Condition[/b][/b][/th][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9d86f7b8-ebd8-11ec-822f-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img] [b]Living Shield[/b][/td] [td]Receive two torpedo hits from the opponent while being within a 2-kilometer radius of an allied ship.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9d86c1c6-ebd8-11ec-8e96-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img] [b]Neat Job[/b][/td] [td]Win by destroying all the transport ships and without losing any allied ships. At the same time, damage caused to enemy ships should amount to at least 50% of your ship's base HP.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9ddc5c12-ebd8-11ec-9882-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img] [b]Safe Route[/b][/td] [td]Win a battle and save all transport ships. At the same time, damage caused to enemy ships should amount to at least 50% of your ship's base HP.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9d8a9972-ebd8-11ec-a75f-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img] [b]Nerves of Steel[/b][/td] [td]Win and survive in a battle while at least twice as many enemy ships remain. At the same time, damage caused to enemy ships should amount to at least 50% of your ship's base HP. Can be completed while playing for any team.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9d8f7dac-ebd8-11ec-ac73-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img] [b]Raider[/b][/td] [td]Destroy two transport ships in a single battle.[/td][/tr][/table]
[quote][i]Due to the specifics of the battle type, these are the only achievements you can earn in Convoy.[/i][/quote]

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a334687e-f962-11ed-bf5a-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a334db74-f962-11ed-b318-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a3342ddc-f962-11ed-ad3c-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a3343ffc-f962-11ed-ab9d-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=combat-missions][/h1]Combat Missions[/b][/h2]
You've been granted access to some [b]special combat missions[/b] that can only be completed in Convoy. Win and earn Base XP to obtain [i]Community Tokens[/i].

[h3][b]Daily Combat Mission[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Win a Convoy battle.
[b]Reward:[/b] [b]30[/b] Community Tokens.[/list]
[h3][b]Weekly Combat Missions[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Earn 5,000 Base XP in Convoy.
[b]Reward:[/b] [b]350[/b] Community Tokens.
[*]Earn 15,000 Base XP in Convoy.
[b]Reward:[/b] [b]400[/b] Community Tokens.
[*]Earn 50,000 Base XP in Convoy.
[b]Reward:[/b] [b]550[/b] Community Tokens.[/list]
[quote]In addition to the daily and weekly missions, you'll be granted access to [b]five combat mission chains[/b] that require you to earn Base XP—one chain per ship type. [b]Reward for completing each chain[/b][b]—[/b][b][b]350[/b][/b]Community Tokens.[/quote]
[quote][i]You can find more details about the special mission completion criteria in the game client.[/i][/quote]

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a334848a-f962-11ed-8407-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a334f83e-f962-11ed-b64e-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a3342fb2-f962-11ed-a358-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]

notes.title: Camouflage Contest: Japanese Battleship Yumihari
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d3b524d2efbdc597d1a7d68c14e3518483fe7f0a.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Captains![/b][/h3]
As we’ve just announced, a new branch of Japanese battleships is on its way! Following our long-standing tradition, we want to celebrate its upcoming release with a community camouflage contest! Download the template below and draw up a design for a permanent camouflage that you would like to see grace the Tier VIII representative of the branch—Yumihari. The winner of the public vote will have their camouflage implemented in the game, and the [b]top 10 artists will win Premium Ship containers[/b]!

[table][tr][th][b][url=#details]Contest Details[/url] ● [url=#how-to]How to Participate[/url] ● [url=#prizes]Prizes[/url] ● [url=#rules]Rules[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]

[*]The top 10 submitters will receive the winning camouflage and a Premium Ship container.
[*]50 bundles of 3x Distant Voyages containers will be distributed randomly among contestants who submit an eligible design.
[*]The winning camouflage will be obtainable later in 2023—stay tuned for more information about its distribution![/list] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=how-to][/h1]How to Participate[/b][/h2]
Just download one of the blank ship templates below and create your design on it.

To download the template, first click on the image with the left mouse button, then on the "Download" button below it.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/48184e6a-f57a-11ed-9332-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/481a5b60-f57a-11ed-917c-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[url=https://discord.gg/wows style=button]Discord (EVENTS)[/url]

[url=https://forms.gle/tPAmZh5XPhRmkRHp7 style=button]Google Survey[/url]

In order to submit a design on Discord, you’ll first need to authenticate your account. To do so, please follow the instructions below.

[h3][i][h3][b]Instructions[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
[b]Step 1[/b]: Accept our invitation to the World of Warships Discord server by clicking this button:

[url=https://discord.gg/wows style=button]Accept Invitation[/url]

[b]Step 2[/b]: In the #welcome-lobby channel, you’ll see a message from the Wargaming.net Bot welcoming you to the server. Click the button below the message and you’ll receive another personalized message prompting you to authenticate your account by logging in via a special link.

[b]Step 3[/b]: Click the login button and follow the instructions to complete the authentication of your account.

[h2][b][h1=prizes][/h1]Prizes[/b][/h2] [table][tr][td][b]Place[/b][/td] [td][b]Reward[/b][/td][/tr] [tr][td]1[/td] [td]

[b]Labor Day[/b] is an international holiday celebrated on May 1. It's also known as International Workers' Day in many countries. This is the day of international solidarity of working people and a public holiday in many countries worldwide.

[b]A chain of global combat missions[/b] awaits you. Successfully completing it will bring you signals, expendable economic bonuses, and the International Workers' Day commemorative flag. A special giveaway will also be held that will award [b]70 random players[/b] who fought at least 15 battles in the Random, Ranked, Co-op, Operations, and Brawl battle types while the global combat mission was active.
[table][tr][td][b]Number of random winners[/b][/td] [td][b]Reward[/b][/td][/tr] [tr][td]10[/td] [td][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/reward_icons/PCL074_EPICstd8_27a552f58b51f90a5abc3e44b87557e75eea51dc9d94e3666b3fd1cc92d4e6e7.png[/img] 1x Premium Ship VIII container[/td][/tr] [tr][td]10[/td] [td][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/reward_icons/PCL072_EPICstd7_e2e7e2b43c2fdbd0e3c379bb4722a357aac0fa926d88256b05c6067b78ecd733.png[/img] 1x Premium Ship VII container[/td][/tr] [tr][td]50[/td] [td][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/reward_icons/PCL005_Epic_ff759cae80769e9496bc6a232b30d1f6c7ddf99f8b8297c4cdb8ccecfa66742a.png[/img] 1x Supercontainer[/td][/tr][/table]

notes.title: Public Test of Update 12.4: Round 1
notes.content:
[url=steam://run/1248250][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38188069/8495af204654afb129f8a12c44c02d0c2e13176d.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]Captains![/b]

Joining the Public Test is a great way to earn permanent and expendable camouflages, containers that drop Premium ships, and other valuable items. This time, you have a chance to obtain [b]reworked Italian Cruisers containers[/b]. All information on how to join the Public Test is available on a [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/pt-guide/]dedicated page[/url] of the official website.
[url=steam://run/1248250 style=button][h3]Click here to join the Public Test with rewards for the main account![/h3][/url]

Update 12.4 brings the return of the Convoy battle type, European destroyers in Early Access, repeated battle entry with the same ship, and other new features. Take a look at the [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/bulletin-124/]Developer Bulletin[/url], and welcome to the Test! See you on the Public Test Server!

[h1][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/additional-public-test-rewards-124/ style=button]More Rewards for Public Test 12.4[/url][/h1]

[url=https://forum.worldofwarships.eu/forum/485-public-test/ style=button]Leave Feedback[/url]

[table][tr][th][b][url=#round-1-schedule]Round 1 Schedule[/url]
[url=#special-features-of-the-test]Special Features of the Test[/url]
[url=#combat-missions-and-rewards]Combat Missions and Rewards[/url]
[url=#starting-bonuses]Starting Bonuses[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table][hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=round-1-schedule][/h1]Round 1 Schedule[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Thu. 27 Apr. 18:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Tue. 03 May 07:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=special-features-of-the-test][/h1]Special Features of the Test[/b][/h2]
A test Clan Battles season will be held on the Public Test Server. The format and restrictions will be similar to those in [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/440]Season 21[/url].
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=combat-missions-and-rewards][/h1]Combat Missions and Rewards[/b][/h2]
Progress through combat missions on the Public Test Server to earn Community Tokens. These Tokens can be exchanged for various rewards in the Armory, including rare permanent camouflages, containers, and other in-game items.

[quote][i]The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.
[b]Please note:[/b] The Battle Pass rewards on the Public Test Server differ from the rewards on the 12.4 Live Server.[/i][/quote]
[table][tr][th][b]Round[/b][/th][th][b][/b][/th][th][b][/b][/th][/tr] [tr][th][b]1[/b][/th][th][b]2[/b][/th][th][b][/b][/th][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/da1e988a-6907-11ea-90ba-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/da1e988a-6907-11ea-90ba-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4efeead2-d037-11eb-b12c-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td]
Earn 250 Base XP in a single Random or Co-op Battle.

[b]Reward on the Live Server:[/b] 100 Community Tokens.
[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/da1e988a-6907-11ea-90ba-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/da1e988a-6907-11ea-90ba-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4efeead2-d037-11eb-b12c-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td]
Earn 1,000 Base XP in Random Battles.

[b]Reward on the Live Server:[/b] 200 Community Tokens.
[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/da1e988a-6907-11ea-90ba-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/da1e988a-6907-11ea-90ba-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e10b88f8-4b11-11ed-9c61-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td]
Earn 8,000 Base XP in Random Battles and Convoy.

[b]Reward on the Live Server:[/b] 1x Tactical Special container.
[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/da1e988a-6907-11ea-90ba-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4efeead2-d037-11eb-b12c-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td]
Complete a special combat mission chain playing superships.

[b]Reward on the Live Server:[/b] 1,000 Community Tokens.
[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/da1e988a-6907-11ea-90ba-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/da1e988a-6907-11ea-90ba-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4efeead2-d037-11eb-b12c-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td]
Fight five Convoy battles and deal at least 50,000 damage in each battle.

[b]Reward on the Live Server:[/b] 500 Community Tokens.
[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/da1e988a-6907-11ea-90ba-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/da1e988a-6907-11ea-90ba-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4efeead2-d037-11eb-b12c-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td]
Earn 500 "Secondary battery hits" ribbons in Random Battles, Co-op Battles, and Convoy.

[b]Reward on the Live Server:[/b] 450 Community Tokens.
[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/da1e988a-6907-11ea-90ba-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/da1e988a-6907-11ea-90ba-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/03c8df0e-6745-11ed-8f5d-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td]
Receive 3,000,000 potential damage in Random Battles, Co-op Battles, and Convoy.

[b]Reward on the Live Server:[/b] 7x Pioneer expendable camouflages.
[/td][/tr][/table]
When you first enter the 12.4 Public Test Server during Rounds 1 and 2, you will be credited with [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]750[/b] Coal and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]100[/b] Doubloons on the Live Server for each round.

[quote]Public Test 12.4 includes special missions that will bring you rewards on the Live Server.[/quote]
[h3][i][h3][b]Recurring Combat Missions[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
Earn 12,000 Base XP in Convoy, Random Battles, and Co-op Battles playing Tier VI–X ships and superships.

[b]Reward on the Live Server:[/b] [b]1,600[/b] Community Tokens.
[hr][/hr]
Earn 1,000 Base XP in Random and Co-op Battles.

[b]Reward on the Live Server:[/b] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]1,000[/b] Coal; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]2,500[/b] Free XP; [b]200[/b] Community Tokens; and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]500,000[/b] Credits.

[quote][i]This combat mission will only be available on the [b]second[/b] and [b]third days[/b] of each round of the Public Test. The mission [b]refreshes[/b] at 02:00 UTC.[/i][/quote]

[h3][b]Combat Mission Chains[/b][/h3]
[h3][i][h3][b]First Chain[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
Deal damage, earn Base XP, and obtain "Destroyed" ribbons. You can find more details about the chain in the Public Test client.

[quote][b]Reward on the Live Server:[/b] 1x Tactical Special container and 6x Italian Cruisers containers.[/quote]
[quote][i]You can complete the combat mission chain in Random and Co-op Battles, as well as in Convoy, playing Tier VI–X ships and superships. The chain will be available for completion throughout the entire duration of Public Test 12.4.[/i][/quote]

[h3][i][h3][b]Second Chain[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
Gain victories, earn Base XP, deal damage, and obtain "Destroyed" ribbons. You can find more details about the chain in the Public Test client.

[quote][b]Reward on the Live Server:[/b] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]5,000[/b] Free XP; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]700[/b] Coal; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]800,000[/b] Credits; and [b]10,000[/b] Elite Commander XP.[/quote]
[quote][i]You can complete the combat mission chain in Random and Ranked Battles, as well as in Convoy, playing Tier VI–X ships and superships. The chain is [b]available for completion three times per day[/b] between the following times: 11:00–15:00 UTC; 17:00–21:00 UTC; and 22:00–02:00 UTC. You can complete all the missions three times and also obtain the rewards three times during each day of the Public Test.[/i][/quote]

[quote][i]You can find more details about the chains in the Public Test client.[/i][/quote]

Players who join the 12.4 Public Test Server will also receive the following rewards on the Live Server: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]250[/b] Doubloons, [b][/b]2x More Coal containers, and [b][/b]1x Tactical Special container.

[quote]In total during Public Test 12.4, you can obtain up to [b]7,500[/b] Community Tokens; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]25,100[/b] Coal; [b][/b]4x Tactical Special containers; [b][/b]2x More Coal containers; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]450[/b] Doubloons; [b][/b]6x Italian Cruisers containers; 14x Pioneer camouflages; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]150,000[/b] Free XP; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]24,400,000[/b] Credits; and [b]280,000[/b] Elite Commander XP.[/quote] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=starting-bonuses][/h1]Starting Bonuses[/b][/h2]
[list][*]The research prices for ships and ship modules will be substantially discounted.
[*]You'll be able to reset Commander skills free of charge.[/list]
If you're joining the Public Test for the first time since Update 12.3 release, you'll be awarded the following additional bonuses:
[list][*]All researchable Tier VI and VIII ships with 21-skill-point Commanders
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]500,000,000[/b] Credits; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]30,000[/b] Doubloons; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]250,000[/b] Coal; and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]90 days of Warships Premium Account[/b]
[*]50 signals and sets with expendable economic bonuses[/list]
[quote]If you fought at least one battle on the Public Test Server during the 12.3 Public Test, your account will be copied from the Live Server to the Public Test Server.[/quote]

[h3][b]Update 12.3 delivers the following new features:[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Easter Egg Hunt: Collect Portal Chips for Guaranteed Rewards!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ddd371d26d0d13756d0cd26fc8f77259cd669782.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Baskets at the ready, Captains![/b][/h3]
It’s time for a good old-fashioned Easter egg hunt, but this time, the eggs are Portal Chips and the rewards are great and abundant! Complete various repeatable in-game tasks to accumulate as many Portal Chips as you can and win guaranteed rewards, such as economic bonuses, Supercontainers, and a haul of Coal! We also have some [b]random giveaways of Premium ships equipped with glorious permanent camouflages[/b], so keep your ears to the ground!
[quote]Players with the most Portal Chips accumulated throughout the event will also win valuable [b]physical prizes[/b], including some shiny new gaming gear! [/quote]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#how-to]How to Participate[/url]
[url=#random-giveaways]Random Giveaways[/url]
[url=#top-performance-prizes]Top Performance Prizes[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=how-to][/h1]How to Participate[/b][/h2]
To participate in this event, you need to open the article on our web portal ([url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/sales-and-events/easter-egg-hunt-2023/]Europe[/url], [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/sales-and-events/easter-egg-hunt-2023/]America[/url], [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/sales-and-events/easter-egg-hunt-2023/]Asia[/url]) and click the “Participate” button, OR activate the bonus code STEAMINGTHROUGHEASTER ([url=https://eu.wargaming.net/shop/redeem/]Europe[/url], [url=https://na.wargaming.net/shop/redeem/]America[/url], [url=https://asia.wargaming.net/shop/redeem/]Asia[/url]).

Once you’ve done that, you can start earning [b]Portal Chips[/b] by completing the repeatable challenges shown below.
[table][tr][td][b][b]Destroy at least 1 enemy ship in a battle[/b][/b][/td][/tr] [tr][td]Random and Ranked Battles; Brawl[/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/49598efe-042e-11ec-9c17-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]3 Portal Chips[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Co-op Battles[/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/49598efe-042e-11ec-9c17-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]1 Portal Chip[/td][/tr] [tr][td][b][b]Win a battle[/b][/b][/td][/tr] [tr][td]Random and Ranked Battles; Brawl[/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/49598efe-042e-11ec-9c17-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]4 Portal Chips[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Co-op Battles[/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/49598efe-042e-11ec-9c17-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]1 Portal Chip[/td][/tr] [tr][td][b][b]Finish a battle in your team’s top 3 by Base XP[/b][/b][/td][/tr] [tr][td]Random and Ranked Battles[/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/49598efe-042e-11ec-9c17-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]4 Portal Chips[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Co-op Battles[/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/49598efe-042e-11ec-9c17-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]2 Portal Chips[/td][/tr] [tr][td]
[quote][b]Ship restrictions: Tiers V–X and Superships[/b][/quote]
[/td][/tr][/table]
Your goal is to accumulate enough Portal Chips to reach certain milestones (50, 100, 200, and 400 [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/49598efe-042e-11ec-9c17-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]Portal Chips, respectively). After reaching each of these milestones, you will secure a guaranteed reward that will be credited to your account within the following few days.
[table][tr][td][/td] [td][b][b]2x Special Economic Bonuses of Each Type[/b][/b][/td] [td][b][b]1x Award Container[/b][/b][/td] [td][b][b]10,000 Coal[/b][/b][/td] [td][b][b]1x Supercontainer[/b][/b][/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/49598efe-042e-11ec-9c17-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][b]50[/b][/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/da1e988a-6907-11ea-90ba-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][/td] [td][/td] [td][/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/49598efe-042e-11ec-9c17-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][b]100[/b][/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/da1e988a-6907-11ea-90ba-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/da1e988a-6907-11ea-90ba-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][/td] [td][/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/49598efe-042e-11ec-9c17-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][b]200[/b][/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/da1e988a-6907-11ea-90ba-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/da1e988a-6907-11ea-90ba-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/da1e988a-6907-11ea-90ba-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/49598efe-042e-11ec-9c17-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][b]400[/b][/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/da1e988a-6907-11ea-90ba-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/da1e988a-6907-11ea-90ba-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/da1e988a-6907-11ea-90ba-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/da1e988a-6907-11ea-90ba-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
Any Portal Chips you earn will be recorded in the [b]counter at the top of this article[/b]. Please be aware that the counter won’t always update instantaneously and may take some time to catch up with your current balance.

[quote][i]You must be logged in for the counter to display your Portal Chip balance.[/i][/quote]

[h2]Sprints[/h2]
The event is divided into [b]two Sprints[/b]. After the first Sprint ends, there will be a break in activity for a few days. During this time, two things will happen:
[list][*]You’ll receive the prizes you earned for the milestones reached during the first Sprint.
[*]Your Portal Chip counter will be reset to 0 in preparation for the second Sprint.[/list]
When Sprint 2 begins, you’ll be able to earn the prizes a second time by completing the same challenges and once again reaching the milestones indicated above. Prizes for the second Sprint will also be distributed within a few days of it ending.

notes.title: Apply a Tag — Get 1 Day of Warships Premium Account
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8f8d3b9c0582cb7d06a3856dd53bc852767abfdd.jpg[/img]

Captains!

What part of World of Warships captivates you most? Is it the global multiplayer environment? The gritty naval setting? Or is it perhaps the realistic ship models? Tell us what draws you to the game by applying tags here on Steam, and we'll grant you [b]a full day of Warships Premium Account[/b]!

[h2]How to take part:[/h2]
[olist][*]Find the "Popular user-defined tags for this product" section on the right-hand side of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/552990/World_of_Warships/?tags]the main page[/url] of the game.
[*]Click the "+" symbol.
[*]Select a tag (or create your own) that’s applicable to World of Warships. To select an existing tag from the list, click the "+" symbol next to the tag of your choice.
[*]Share your list of tags in the comments of this news item.[/olist]
Voilà! Your Warships Premium Account will be activated precisely 7 days later.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/552990/World_of_Warships/?tags][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/552990/extras/Steam_tags.gif?t=1574441033[/img][/url]

[b]Attention![/b] The reward can only be granted once a month per player, regardless of the number of tags applied.

Good luck in battle, Captains!

notes.content:

[b]Captains![/b]

You can earn containers with Premium ships, permanent and expendable camouflages, and other valuable items by participating in the Public Test. New Golden Week containers are in the mix of rewards this time! All information on how to join the Public Test is available on a [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/pt-guide/]dedicated page[/url] of the official website.
[url=steam://run/1248250 style=button][h3]Click here to join the Public Test with rewards for the main account![/h3][/url]

Update 12.3 heralds the return of the Kure Dockyard, the new Seychelles map, and a whole lot more. Take a look at the [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/bulletin-123/]Developer Bulletin[/url], and welcome to the Test! See you on the Public Test Server!
[h1][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/additional-public-test-rewards-123/ style=button]More Rewards for Public Test 12.3[/url][/h1]

Captains, thank you for participating in the first round of the Public Test for Update 12.3! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Fixed visual errors in the Kure Dockyard, the Seychelles map, and the Zipangu Port.

notes.title: Developers Answer: Ship Modeling and Design
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/03437577ab58e9444057c9bdd10787fbf55f350f.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Captains![/b][/h3]
In February, our developers took part in a special Q&A session on our official [url=https://discord.gg/wows]Discord server[/url] on the topic of ship modeling and design in World of Warships. We’re here to deliver the results!

[table][tr][th][b][url=#design-and-technicque]General design and Technique[/url] ● [url=#research]Research[/url] ● [url=#ship-specific]Ship-Specific Questions[/url] ● [url=#misc]Miscellaneous[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table][hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=design-and-technicque][/h1]General design and Technique[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/d2e5bc98-cd76-11ed-8229-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]

[b]1. What software do you use for modeling ships?[/b]

[i]The exact set of programs depends on the particular team and task, but our "go-to kit" is Autodesk Maya, Adobe Photoshop, and Substance Painter.[/i]

[b]2. To what extent is physics involved in the ship design process?[/b]

[i]We have a professional team of constructors, most of whom have solid experience working in shipyards and designing real ships. Virtual ships are designed on the same principles as real ships.[/i]

[i]Since the designing of a whole ship from keel to mast is a topic worthy of a separate publication, we will only look at the example of designing the hull:[/i]

[i]During the early stages of the design process, we accommodate the key equipment on board the ship: the main and auxiliary propulsion plants, armament and magazine sections, armor layout, aircraft hangars, catapults, lifeboats, etc. To do that, we create sketch plans for the ship's decks, holds, superstructures, and inboard profile. Those sketch plans are subsequently supplemented and finalized to be later used as the basis for final plans and drawings.[/i]

[i]We need to do this in order to ensure that all the equipment fits within the hull we've designed. For that purpose, we calculate mass loads and verify the correspondence between the weight of the equipment and the water displacement of the hull.[/i]

[i]The ship's hull is designed taking into account all the equipment to be placed within it. If the data doesn’t match, we either make changes to the composition of the ship's equipment and its characteristics or, if that’s not the best available option, we change the hull.[/i]

[i]In the case of aircraft carrier Hakuryū, for example, we had to make the ship 20 m longer and 5 m wider compared to her prototype, G-15, so that the carrier could, in fact, "carry" her entire air group. The resulting increase in water displacement forced us to adopt a different propulsion plant—one that we had to find.[/i]

[i]We figure out the seafaring characteristics of the ship's hull, its water displacement, the position of the center of buoyancy, and other hydrostatic parameters.[/i]

[b]3. When creating new Tech Tree ships, is there some sort of "budget" related to the modeling of historical ships? Like, "this upcoming Tech Tree should have this number of historical ships at the very least."[/b]

[i]We have no such "budget," but there is a general rule of giving priority to historical ships if they fit the planned gameplay of the branch.[/i]

[b]4. When modeling obscure "paper" ships or even fantasy ones, do you put any thought into how their superstructure model will affect their turret angles and, subsequently, their future state of balance?[/b]

[i]When designing a ship, there are many factors that affect gun angles and gun placement. The key ones are the requirements for ship balance from our game designers and the prototype designs on which the ship is based on.[/i]

[i]We never intentionally make a ship worse in terms of angles, quite the contrary; however, this is always a back-and-forth process and a search for compromises.[/i]

[i]For example, Plymouth: This is the original version of the improved Town class. She is, in fact, a Town-class ship with quadruple-gun turrets, which were developed for that specific ship. By installing a larger turret on an existing ship with set superstructure dimensions, you automatically get cut horizontal aiming angles. In this case, we chose the most optimal design because there were other variants that had even worse aiming angles.[/i]

[b]5. When you design your own ships from scratch such as Celebes and Haarlem, why is there no system in place to ensure the designs are not without cases of missing directors or directors without guns to direct? And why aren’t they fixed?[/b]

[i]On Celebes, the number and type of directors are inspired by De Ruyter's. Additionally, a director was added in front of the bow superstructure to control the АA guns located on the platform between the funnels.[/i]

[i]About Haarlem: She has the original Dutch gun fire-control system, and it is assumed that it was modified for the German main battery guns. As for AA gunnery, while working on the ship, we considered the fate of HNLMS "Willem van der Zaan." Upon arrival to Britain, this ship had her Bofors guns and Hazemeyer gun mounts with their fire-control system removed for study, and they were replaced with British pom-poms. Haarlem (in her version of the story) got the Bofors back, but there was no way to get a new fire-control system from the occupied Netherlands.[/i]

[b]6. Roughly how much effort is required for the various types of ship models? For instance, a battleship is large and complex with many animated features like AA guns, while a submarine is just a cylinder. Is there a rough ratio for design time/effort for carriers, battleships, cruisers, destroyers, and submarines?[/b]

[i]Submarine, destroyer, cruiser, battleship, aircraft carrier, hybrid ship—the design time increases exponentially in that order. The more complex the ship in terms of structure, the more time it takes to design her. Hybrids are the most complex. On average, it takes 3 to 6 months to design a ship.[/i]
[h2][b][h1=research][/h1]Research[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/d257e33c-cd76-11ed-8196-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]

[b]7. Where do you get ship plans from?[/b]

[i]We’ve collected blueprints and photos from archives and museums around the world. For this purpose, we organized research expeditions, the purpose of which was to collect materials that in the future could be used to create several branches of specific nations. During such trips, we would visit museum ships, archives, and naval museums; order and copy drawings and photos; and purchase professional and academic literature. We are constantly working to find and purchase the latest publications on naval history and updating our database with contact details of private collectors. A few years of isolation due to the pandemic, of course, forced some changes: We had to reduce the number of trips and shift to working more with local professional historians. In addition, every year, archives provide more and more exhaustive lists of services to order materials remotely.[/i]

[i]In previous years, we organized expeditions to the USA, Japan, Germany, France, Italy, Great Britain, Sweden, and the Netherlands. We cannot list all of our sources, but as a notable example, it is worth mentioning the Bundesarchiv in Germany, which we regularly order materials from. The Ship Modeling Society of Bologna also helped us a lot with excellent quality blueprints during the collection of materials for the Italian branches. We are very grateful to the staff of archives and museums for their help and extremely friendly attitude to our inquiries.[/i]

[b]8. To what extent is research done on the naval philosophies and design tendencies of the country of origin in order to determine themes for a custom ship, retrofit, mechanics (e.g., Airstrike), or the overall flow of a researchable Tech Tree line?[/b]

[i]Any ship of any nation is designed with the general trends of the nation's shipbuilding school in mind. Accordingly, research is done in full, and trends are taken into account in the whole model's appearance. However, gameplay mechanics can be designed and developed independently of the creation of the ship model itself.[/i]

[b]9. Where did the idea come from to model the funnels of Eendracht, Haarlem, Johan de Witt, and Gouden Leeuw into more rounded shapes, as well as to remove Gouden Leeuw's forward superstructure and introduce Celebes' "forehead"?[/b]

[i]This shape was chosen because a lot of actual Dutch ships also had a rounded funnel shape.[/i]

[i]As for Gouden Leeuw's superstructure, the ship was based on Project 1047, which was abandoned before the superstructure design phase began. So, we applied our own superstructure design. In such cases, we create designs based on actual ships of the period or at least viable blueprints.[/i]

[i]About Celebes: The German roots of the project influenced the design and architecture of the ship. The original plan was to have a superstructure of the type later realized on De Ruyter, but as a tribute to her roots, she was designed with some influence from the German school—in particular, the Deutschland class.[/i]
[h2][b][h1=ship-specific][/h1]Ship-Specific Questions[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/d2806618-cd76-11ed-918b-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]

[b]10. Are there any plans to remodel older lines in a similar fashion to the remodeling of the American destroyers that happened in 2022?[/b]

[i]There will be no major ship model updates this year. In the future, we will most likely look at doing this, but we will focus on individual ships rather than whole branches at once.[/i]

[b]11. Is there a reason why the Japanese Premium ships (except Mikasa) don't get a nameplate on their aft like the other nations' Premiums?[/b]

[i]These ships were added to the game in the early days of our project. Back then, we had a rule—add a nameplate only if it was present on the ship in reality; however, very few photos of Japanese ships from the period have survived, so at the time we did not know if name plates were placed on certain Japanese ships. Our processes have changed since then and we now add nameplates to most Premium ships if nameplates were present on them at least in some historical period.[/i]

[b]12. Would it be possible to enable the rotating funnel on the A Hull of Richelieu, Alsace, and République?[/b]

[i]This feature is in development right now. In fact, we already made some tech changes in the game code to support this functionality, but there's still work to be done.[/i]

[b]13. What determines the number of benches added to a French ship design and why doesn't Jean Bart have any benches on her?[/b]

[i]On real ships, the benches are installed based on historical references, such as photographs. For paper ships, we install benches of our own taste as a kind of "signature" of the nation. In the case of Jean Bart, there were no benches in her photos, so there are none in our game.[/i]

[b]14. Why did De Ruyter get fictional AA guns that weren't in use by the Dutch navy?[/b]

[i]This was done for balance reasons. In our game, we sometimes change the armament for the researchable ship to be more appropriate to its gameplay and tier, even if it is not exactly historical.[/i]

[b]15. Why is the superstructure of Zieten so extremely ugly and completely out of line compared to the other German battlecruisers?[/b]

[i]For Zieten, we used an adapted version of the superstructure from pocket battleships. From a design point of view, it was quite suitable for this ship.[/i]

[b]16. On Tokachi, what was the reasoning behind modeling the ship with 127 mm guns instead of the 140 mm guns from the original scout cruiser design?[/b]

[i]Tokachi was not based on any real scout cruiser designs. It is our interpretation of a rearmed version of Furutaka; the caliber of the guns was chosen for gameplay reasons.[/i]

[b]17. What was the thought process in using Nakhimov, a what-if conversion for a Sovetsky Soyuz hull, as the Tier X Soviet carrier instead of basing the Tier X off of Project Konstrominov or one of the many different designs of the era?[/b]

[i]The main problem with most of those designs that have survived to this day is that they are extremely incomplete, which makes it difficult to create an entire ship based on them. So, we decided to use current Nakhimov's design, which perfectly suits the general progression of the branch.[/i]
[h2][b][h1=misc][/h1]Miscellaneous[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/d33520ee-cd76-11ed-b05e-ac162d70f4e4.png[/img]

[b]18. Will you be releasing more models adapted for 3D printing on Printables like you did for St. Louis?[/b]

[i]So far, there are no such plans; however, if there is big interest from the community on this topic, we will consider the idea.[/i]

[b]19. Where do the plane models come from? Are they coming straight out of World of Warplanes or are they custom-made for World of Warships?[/b]

[i]We make our own planes for World of Warships, since our game contains mostly carrier-based aircraft.[/i]

[b]20. What are the criteria for ships to receive Easter eggs? If a decision is made to add a little fun reference within a ship model, when does that happen? Is it at the beginning or end of the modeling process?[/b]

[i]We have no clear criteria. It's just that sometimes while designing a ship, someone on the team will come up with an idea for a little joke to please the curious players. Then it is coordinated between colleagues and brought to life.[/i]

[b]21. Will you animate the lifts of other aircraft carriers or will Béarn be the only one to have this?[/b]

[i]We have the ability to add animations like this, so we may do so in the future; however, right now, we cannot tell you if and when it will happen.[/i]

[b]22. Are there any plans to add unique ASW animations and models for ships that have a helipad on them, like Petropavlovsk?[/b]
[b] Are the anchor chains modeled as part of the ship mesh or can they be moved without affecting the rest of the ship? It would be very very cool to have your ships with a dropped anchor while they're in Port.[/b]

[i]We do not have such plans, but it is quite possible that we will implement something similar in the future.[/i]

[b]23. How do you determine when and whether to do a line split? We now have the 3rd American battleship line and, as an example, no Japanese battleship or American destroyer line split. Does the popularity of a line/nation have an impact on when to do a line split?[/b]

[i]When choosing a new branch to develop, our main priority is to maintain the variety of nations and ship types. At the same time, there are already a lot of nations in the game, but the number of branches we release per year is limited. So, situations like the one described in the question may sometimes arise.[/i]

[i]Nevertheless, if we see that a certain ship type or a certain nation is lacking ships, it's more likely that a new branch may appear there in the future. At the same time, the presence or absence of splits in a branch is not a priority factor. For example, in the case of American battleships, we wanted to add researchable hybrid ships to the game, and among several candidates for the branch, the American battleships were the most convenient to refit into hybrid battleships and versatile in terms of gameplay, which made them a good choice among other branches.[/i]
