notes.title: Trouble in the Hot Tub: Dead Serious
notes.content:
[url=https://youtu.be/KVNY6yc3khs][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/67e06a166871271db3235c3e0ac31d564c0541ec.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]To celebrate April 1st, hot tub battles are making their return to the game in Update 12.2![/b]

Pick one of six rubber duckies and engage in bubbly battles on the updated Hot Tub map. Use stylized weapons, including a new one—[i]splashy mines[/i]. Have fun colliding with other ducks and obstacles on the map to experience the special rubber-like collision physics.

[h1]WORLD OF WARSHIPS X PLACID PLASTIC DUCK SIMULATOR[/h1]
To celebrate the event, we’ve teamed up with [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1999360/Placid_Plastic_Duck_Simulator/]Placid Plastic Duck Simulator[/url][/b] to give you the full quackin’ experience with an exclusive offer on Steam. Pick up the “World of Placid Plastic Duckships” bundle to get the Placid Plastic Duck Simulator base game together with the “World of Warships — Quacken Unleashed!” DLC for World of Warships, which includes all the paraphernalia you’ll need to emulate a rubber duck in any game mode.
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30571/

[table][tr][th][b][url=#rules]Rules[/url]
[url=#duck-features]Duck Features[/url]
[url=#rewards]Rewards[/url]
[url=#duck-tales]Duck Tales[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=KVNY6yc3khs;full][/previewyoutube] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=rules][/h1]Rules[/b][/h2]
You can participate in [b]Trouble in the Hot Tub[/b] battles only during the specified time period.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Thu. 23 Mar. 10:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Thu. 20 Apr. 01:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

The battles will take place on the updated Hot Tub map. Animated elements now surround the map, and the water has become transparent. Learn more about these and other features of the map [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/developer-diaries-trouble-in-the-hot-tub/]here[/url].

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/77f1a332-c4bc-11ed-9690-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/77f11ec6-c4bc-11ed-bd62-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/77f1887a-c4bc-11ed-be5e-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/77f1a77e-c4bc-11ed-a976-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[quote][i]Battles utilize a 7 vs. 7 format with Domination mode rules.[/i][/quote]
[quote][b]Trouble in the Hot Tub is only available between the following times: [b]09:00 – 00:00 UTC[/b][/b][/quote]
[h2][b][h1=duck-features][/h1]Duck Features[/b][/h2]
A total of six rubber duckies of different types are available—two destroyers, two cruisers, and two battleships.
[list][*]All players will immediately receive one ducky of each type—[b] [b][b]X[/b] Don de la DuQue[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]X[/b] Luigi McQuacci[/b][/b], and [b] [b][b]X[/b] Quackaducko[/b][/b].
[*]Earn 20,000 Base XP on each starter duck of the corresponding type to gain access to the remaining duckies—[b] [b][b]★[/b] Duck Punchis[/b][/b]; [b] [b][b]★[/b] Furo[/b][/b]; and [b] [b][b]★[/b] D.U.C.K.[/b][/b][/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/13e3f7d2-c4bc-11ed-a916-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/13e23f32-c4bc-11ed-8ce3-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/12ae4c0a-c4bc-11ed-92b6-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/13e3fb06-c4bc-11ed-bd62-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1401c5f0-c4bc-11ed-979a-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/13e2cefc-c4bc-11ed-a976-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
All rubber duckies have a new type of armament—[i]splashy mines[/i]. Laying these mines is similar to dropping depth charges; however, the mines do not submerge underwater. The mines explode a little while after being laid or upon contact with other duckies, and they can cause flooding.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/77f0b9f4-c4bc-11ed-92b6-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
In addition to mines, the rubber duckies are armed with familiar weapons that have been specifically stylized for the event. The exact armaments depend on the duck type:
[list][*]Destroyers are armed with fizzy torpedoes and high-explosive bubbles.
[*]Cruisers are armed with high-explosive bubbles.
[*]Battleships are armed with armor-piercing bubbles.[/list]
High-explosive bubbles don't cause fires, but they do have chances of causing flooding.

[quote][i]Since the duckies are made of rubber, they won't take any ramming damage. If they collide with each other or other objects on the map, they will simply bounce off, gaining a speed boost.[/i][/quote]

[h3][b]All ducks also have special equipment.[/b][/h3] [table][tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5f011bea-c733-11ed-83ac-ac162d70f4e4.png[/img][/td] [td]
[h3][b]Sticky Bandage[/b][/h3]
Stops flooding; prevents the spread of bacteria. It's not a medicine and it has limitations. Consult with a specialist before using.
[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5efd4d1c-c733-11ed-9fce-ac162d70f4e4.png[/img][/td] [td]
[h3][b]Air Pump[/b][/h3]
Partially restores the duck's HP and lifts its spirits.
[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5f2ea34e-c733-11ed-8e1c-ac162d70f4e4.png[/img][/td] [td]
[h3][b]Engine Whoosh[/b][/h3]
Increases the duck's maximum speed and determination.
[/td][/tr][/table]

[h2][b][h1=duck-tales][/h1]Duck Tales[/b][/h2]
[h3][i]Don de la DuQue[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/f045579e-c731-11ed-8888-ac162d70f4e4.png[/img][b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_c00ae03bb6b6afedd442ab8f5fe510fb23735730bf8b7c863e5e8121610e1ac4.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Don de la DuQue[/b][/b] comes from a wealthy and influential duck family, and his fate has been closely intertwined with Fishy since the moment of her birth. Sophisticated Don de la DuQue is famous for his high speed and maneuverability, but only a few know that he has torpedoes and mines, as well as Engine Whoosh with a long action time.

During the day, he is an aristocrat with clean feathers and graceful manners, a master of small talk; at night, he is a duck avenger in an elegant suit. He takes bread from the geese and gives it to the ducks.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Luigi McQuacci[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/f03531e8-c731-11ed-af82-ac162d70f4e4.png[/img]High speed and a great firing rate, as well as his evident skill with high-explosive bubbles and splashy mines, distinguished [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_c00ae03bb6b6afedd442ab8f5fe510fb23735730bf8b7c863e5e8121610e1ac4.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Luigi McQuacci[/b][/b] at the police academy. Years have passed, and the legendary mallard has long abandoned the police badge, said goodbye to Cap's team, and enjoyed resting in his home pond.

But his plans changed when Luigi McQuacci learned that a gang of wild geese were causing a ruckus in the city and had kidnapped the lady duck of his heart. Luigi McQuacci is ready to do anything to save her. He's even willing to fire up his Engine Whoosh once again!
[/expand]
[h3][i]Quackaducko[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/f02f32c0-c731-11ed-bea0-ac162d70f4e4.png[/img][b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_c00ae03bb6b6afedd442ab8f5fe510fb23735730bf8b7c863e5e8121610e1ac4.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Quackaducko[/b][/b], a special-purpose mallard, left his service in Cap's elite unit and had been enjoying a peaceful life as an exemplary family man and raising his daughter to the best of his abilities. But now, he's been forced to take up arms again after his daughter was kidnapped by a former goose dictator who had been once overthrown by Cap's squad.

Quackaducko inspires fear in even the toughest geese with his survivability and salvo weight, while armor-piercing bubbles and splashy mines give him the necessary firepower to emerge victorious from any fight. Hiding from him won't work either, for he's equipped with Engine Whoosh, albeit with a short duration time.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Duck Punchis[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/f04bd6fa-c731-11ed-99fd-ac162d70f4e4.png[/img]As a representative of the law, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_c00ae03bb6b6afedd442ab8f5fe510fb23735730bf8b7c863e5e8121610e1ac4.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b][b]★[/b] Duck Punchis[/b][/b] uses martial arts and montage magic to show the bad guys what mallard-style justice looks like. Duck Punchis is so fast and maneuverable that geese don't even attempt to flee from him. What's the point in trying when his torpedoes and mines leave no chance for escape? And they don't even know about his enhanced Engine Whoosh with its long duration time.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Furo[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/f03e46a2-c731-11ed-905d-ac162d70f4e4.png[/img]The First Duck-Goose Skirmish gave rise to the legend of a fast duck, feared for his high firing rate, high-explosive bubbles, and splashy mines. Only Cap and Fishy know that this is no legend but a true tale of their battle-proven friend—[b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_c00ae03bb6b6afedd442ab8f5fe510fb23735730bf8b7c863e5e8121610e1ac4.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b][b]★[/b] Furo[/b][/b]. And he can move even more swiftly with his Engine Whoosh. When the veteran returned to action looking to find his old friends, the local geese suggested to him that it might not be the best idea to linger in the hot tub. But Furo doesn't play by anyone else's rules, and the real hunt has begun.
[/expand]
[h3][i]D.U.C.K.[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/f03531fc-c731-11ed-bcef-ac162d70f4e4.png[/img]A cyborg mallard has come under Cap's command from the future to save a mallard family. Brought up on the most delicious bread, his creators have become too fat. Such gluttony caused the decline of duck civilization, and the long-running battle with the geese was lost. Cyborg mallard [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_c00ae03bb6b6afedd442ab8f5fe510fb23735730bf8b7c863e5e8121610e1ac4.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b][b]★[/b] D.U.C.K.[/b][/b] must destroy all bread stocks and figure out when the ducks crossed the point of no return.

He's armed with armor-piercing bubbles and mines, has Engine Whoosh with a short duration, and is renowned for his high survivability and salvo weight.
[/expand]

notes.title: Public Test of Update 12.1: Round 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38188069/1e16ea670055ebff5ca8b6f3860499f92bdd6664.jpg[/img]
[b]Captains![/b]

Participation in the Public Test will give you the opportunity to earn containers that hold Premium ships, permanent and expendable camouflages, and other valuable items. All information on how to join the Public Test is available on a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2716184589232191867]dedicated page[/url] of the official website.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/552990/World_of_Warships/#purchase_note][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b7f94ab03e93079a00e137bcc4d263f4d9352ae3.png[/img][/url]

Update 12.1 delivers Early Access to British submarines, global combat missions, updated Domination mode settings, and a whole lot more. Take a look at the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/3645135724571694364]Developer Bulletin[/url], and welcome to the Test! See you on the Public Test Server!
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/3645135724571755816
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/3645135724571694364
[url=https://forum.worldofwarships.eu/forum/485-public-test/ style=button]Leave Feedback[/url]

[h2]Round 2 Schedule[/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Thu. 02 Feb. 17:30 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Tue. 07 Feb. 06:30 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

Captains, thank you for participating in the first round of the Public Test for Update 12.1! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Balance changes applied to Unique Upgrades. Details are available in a post on the [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/414]Development Blog[/url].
[*]The settings of the updated Domination mode have been adjusted: the starting number of points for teams is 150; the reward for destroying an enemy ship is 40 points; and the penalty for losing an allied ship is 25 points.
[*]Fixed a bug due to which the client could crash during the start or end of a battle.
[*]Fixed a bug with the position of the ship in the port of Fjords.[/list]
[h2]Special Features of the Test[/h2]
Brawl test stages will be available on the Public Test Server.

[h3][b]Brawl 1[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Tier VIII ships in a 1 vs. 1 format.
[*]All ship types are available.[/list]
[h3][b]Brawl 2[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Tier X ships in a 3 vs. 3 format.
[*]All ship types are available.
[*]You can participate in a Division of up to three players.[/list]
[quote][i]Restrictions: No more than one aircraft carrier, one submarine, two cruisers, two destroyers, and two battleships.[/i][/quote]

[h2]Combat Missions and Rewards[/h2]
You can earn Community Tokens by progressing through combat missions on the Public Test Server. These Tokens can be exchanged for various rewards in the Armory, including rare permanent camouflages, containers, and other in-game items.

[quote][i]The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.
[b]Please note:[/b] The Battle Pass rewards on the Public Test Server differ from the rewards on the 12.1 Live Server.[/i][/quote]

In our fresh Waterline episode, we take a look at the new features that have been released since the previous episode, cover the changes that have occurred in our team, and share our development plans for World of Warships in the first half of 2023.

During each of those testing rounds, we'll carefully consider your feedback and opinions. Now, let's get down to the details! To reveal the information, click on the respective blocks.[/i][/quote]

[h2]Events[/h2]
[h3][b]Halloween[/b][/h3]
Update 0.11.9 saw the return of themed Operations Saving Transylvania and Sunray in the Darkness. It also brought back Twilight Battle, where players had an opportunity to stand at the helms of Twilight Fleet ships and try out their consumables with unique characteristics.

[h3][b]Velos Adventure[/b][/h3]
This themed adventure on our website provided players with an opportunity to follow in the footsteps of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_66b735f7c63b1fbc05c33f9f6289a5c5151eb9f7829f407ed4a9966188f19ff4.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Velos[/b][/b], the first Greek ship in the game. Players earned Greek Tokens by completing combat missions. They could spend those Tokens on sequential bundles that held the destroyer herself and her Greek Trireme permanent camouflage.

[h3][b]Battle Pass[/b][/h3]
The Battle Pass was introduced in Update 0.11.10. A new Battle Pass starts with the release of each update and offers updated rewards each time. The Battle Pass replaced daily, weekly, and monthly combat missions. The total value of the Free Battle Pass rewards is comparable to the value of the rewards that were obtainable from recurring combat missions prior to the release of Update 0.11.10. Even more useful in-game items can be obtained with the Premium Battle Pass.

[h3][b]Graphics Update[/b][/h3]
In Update 0.11.10, another massive graphics update was implemented into the game. High-detail textures were added to the Mountain Range, North, Strait, Estuary, and Northern Lights maps. We also added a surf effect and dynamic reflections to all surfaces, improved vegetation models, and the effect of water being displaced sideways by moving ships.

[h3][b]New Year Celebrations[/b][/h3]
Festive Update 0.11.11 delivered loads of activities! These included battle performance bonuses, a new Dockyard, the Carol Clash competitive event, and much more.

Battle performance bonuses were available for all Tier V and higher ships. Depending on the ship tier, they rewarded players with Coal, Steel, New Year Certificates, or Research Points. Just like during the celebration of the game's anniversary, players with many ships in their Ports were able to receive rewards from several ships per battle.

At the time of this article's publication, the construction of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_8f3e3f4bb152e80cc8fb2cc34d426c6d85d57b72014c768883384055a2c2f3f7.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Admiral Schröder[/b][/b] is still ongoing at the Dockyard. The main battery artillery of the new ships has a good firing range but not the highest damage per minute. A squadron of bombers that carry HE bombs acts as their aircraft armament. The bombers are not available at the beginning of battle and require considerable preparation time. The large number of aircraft in each flight will allow you to deal decent damage to enemy ships. The aircraft do not return to the deck after delivering an attack, and the entire squadron needs to recovered.

Only one type of torpedoes is available to the new submarines—acoustic homing torpedoes. These torpedoes have a large count per salvo and reload quickly but deal low damage. All submarine artillery guns fire SAP shells.

British submarines enjoy high dive capacity, but their maneuverability is low. They will be able to stay underwater for a long time; however, it will be difficult for them to quickly change direction or retreat if spotted. You should be especially careful when attacking enemy ships because the HP pools of the new submarines are small even compared to submarines of other nations.

[h2]Events[/h2]
[h3][b]Airship Escort[/b][/h3]
Update 12.0 brings the Airship Escort (previously, "Dirigible Derby") temporary battle type back to the game. When it previously appeared in the game in Update 0.11.1, it was popular among players and received extremely positive feedback. Now, we're getting ready to present its improved version.

It's no secret that we regularly test new mechanics in temporary modes with an eye on introducing them into the game on a permanent basis, and this is also the case for Airship Escort. If the updated mode performs well this year, Airship Escort will most likely be a prime candidate to be introduced into Random Battles in the future.

[h3][b]Lunar New Year[/b][/h3]
Every year just wouldn't be the same without the traditional Lunar New Year celebrations.

This time, we've prepared "The Age of Sa Zhenbing" themed collection. [b]Sa Zhenbing[/b], a new unique Commander for Pan-Asian ships, is the reward for completing the collection.

He has special personalization, talents, and improved skills for different ship types.

[h3][b]Introduction of New Unique Upgrades[/b][/h3]
As we've already announced in the [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/389]Development Blog[/url], we're commencing testing of new unique upgrades for Tier X ships. Two upgrades for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_52727a3d376751ca3c4547750d0330100c08052581a387a7acadde7503a76463.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Venezia[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_66b735f7c63b1fbc05c33f9f6289a5c5151eb9f7829f407ed4a9966188f19ff4.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Halland[/b][/b]
[url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/392]have already been released[/url] for closed testing.

[h3][b]New Aircraft Carrier Branches[/b][/h3]
Former carriers from uneven tiers that were removed from the game during the rework of the carrier gameplay in Update 0.8.0 will be reintroduced later. We previously announced that we were going to elaborate their concept and planned to focus on their interaction with allies.

However, based on the testing results and feedback analysis, we've understood that new carrier branches should be able to deal some damage directly, even though it isn't their primary task in battle. We mean that they will still be the carriers you're already familiar with, but with new mechanics that are more focused, among other things, on closer cooperation within teams. We're currently working out the mechanics of minefields that can be deployed by aircraft for these carriers. Besides that, we still intend to provide the carriers' squadrons with Smoke Generator to give them the ability to conceal allied ships from the enemy.

[h3][b]Changes to the Domination Mode Settings[/b][/h3]
The [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/406]Development Blog[/url] has already announced that the reworked Domination mode for Random Battles will be tested this winter. We'll review the starting points at the beginning of battle, as well as the number of points credited to one team and withdrawn from the other one when a ship is destroyed.

These changes are aimed at eliminating extreme situations where battles are too long or too short. We're going to check them during the Super Test and Public Test of Update 12.1. If they demonstrate good results, the changes will be implemented on the Live Server with a low probability of being in place for battles so that we can make a decision on the final fate of the Domination mode.

[h3][b]Global Combat Missions[/b][/h3]
We're working on a new activity—global combat missions.

Global combat missions are missions with special conditions that require the joint effort of the entire server to be completed. They will be completed like typical combat missions but will be common for all players on the server, and every participant will make their contribution to the overall progress. If players manage to complete a global combat mission in time, each player who was actively involved will receive a reward.

Global combat missions are going to be introduced into the game as soon as at the beginning of 2023!

[h3][b]In-game Sound Update[/b][/h3]
A major overhaul of the sound component of the game is planned in 2023. Improvements will be implemented throughout the entire year. For now, we would like to share the plans for the first half of 2023.
[list][*]We're working on new interactive music for submarines that corresponds to the special gameplay of this ship type.
[*]Sounds of aircraft and flying shells will be updated—they'll be more detailed and of a higher quality.
[*]Sound effects for remote events will be improved. Shots and explosions that occur far from the player will sound more realistic.[/list][hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=spring-2023][/h1]Spring 2023[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/64dd138e-a096-11ed-a9d4-ac162d70f4e4.png[/img]

[h2]Ships[/h2]
[h3][b]Pan-American Cruisers[/b][/h3]
The testing of the Pan-American cruiser branch commences in Update 12.0!

Ten new ships will be added to the game: [b] [b][b]I[/b] Hércules[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]II[/b] Almirante Barroso[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]III[/b] Vicente Guerrero[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]IV[/b] Córdoba[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]V[/b] La Argentina[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]VI[/b] Almirante Cochrane[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]VII[/b] Coronel Bolognesi[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] Ignacio Allende[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]IX[/b] Santander[/b][/b], and [b] [b][b]X[/b] San Martin[/b][/b].

From Tier VI, the new ships have access to Combat Instructions. For fire adjustment, Pan-American cruisers need to hit their target with their main guns a certain number of times. The activation of Combat Instructions significantly reduces the ships' consumable cooldown time.

[h3][b]European Destroyers[/b][/h3]
A second branch of European destroyers was announced in the previous Waterline episode and [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/391]Development Blog[/url].

The ships of the new branch will represent such countries as Turkey, Norway, Poland, Yugoslavia, and Greece. Six ships will be added to the game: Muavenet, Stord, Grom, Split, Lambros Katsonis, and Gdańsk. Please note that the branch is still under development, and its concept may change during testing that's planned for the first half of 2023.

In their current concept, the new ships are artillery destroyers equipped with Smoke Generator. At Tiers VIII–X, they also have access to Surveillance Radar. Besides that, all ships of the branch have Engine Boost. Their main guns can inflict good damage per salvo and, starting from Tier VII, the ships enjoy flat-trajectory ballistics, enabling them to easily shoot accurately at long ranges.

The torpedoes of all ships of the branch are fast, but their number per salvo is small. Compared to the first branch of European destroyers, they inflict higher damage but have a shorter range. The modes for launching torpedoes are as standard: wide and narrow spreads.

Starting from Tier VII, the new ships are fast; and from Tier VIII, they enjoy large HP pools; however, their AA defenses are not the strongest, and their concealment is mediocre.

[h3][b]Spanish Cruisers[/b][/h3]
This spring, Spanish cruiser branch will be released for closed testing. It will be the first full-fledged Spanish branch in the game! At the moment, it's still too early to speak about a specific concept or specific characteristics, but their primary feature will be their ability to fire a series of salvos, and the caliber of their guns will increase from 120 mm at low tiers to 254 mm at Tier X.

[h3][b]New Superships[/b][/h3]
Two new superships, Novosibirsk and Devastation, will be put to the test in spring. They will continue the branches of [b] [b][b]X[/b] Petropavlovsk[/b][/b] and [b] [b][b]X[/b] Conqueror[/b][/b].

[h3][b]A Hybrid Destroyer[/b][/h3]
Halford, one of the Fletcher-class destroyers, will be released for closed testing. Her primary feature is the availability of an aircraft catapult. She will be the first hybrid destroyer in our game.

[h3][b]West Virginia '44[/b][/h3]
In our message to the community published [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/wows-team-shout-out-to-game-community/]in September 2021[/url], we promised to release West Virginia '44 in 2023. We're now ready to confirm that the ship will be released for closed testing this spring.

[h2]Events[/h2]
[h3][b]The New Dockyard[/b][/h3]
Although the construction of [b] [b][b]IX[/b] Admiral Schröder[/b][/b] is still in progress at the Hamburg Dockyard, we're already preparing the next ship, [b] [b][b]IX[/b] Daisen[/b][/b], to be laid down this spring.

[b] [b][b]IX[/b] Daisen[/b][/b] is a fast battleship armed with powerful artillery and torpedoes. She inherited a number of archaic features from projects developed in the 1910s, including the placement of secondary battery guns in casemates.

The battleship is notable for her accurate main battery guns, but the number of those guns is small. Her armament also includes torpedo launchers with long-range torpedoes that inflict massive damage. The battleship is very fast but has a large turning circle radius.

[h3][b]Repeated Battle Entry With the Same Ship[/b][/h3]
We're working on an improvement that will allow players to enter a new battle with a ship that was just destroyed without having to wait till the previous battle concludes. This way, you'll be able to fight more battles playing your favorite ship during a game session. This option should help speed up your game progress on your favorite ships.

[h3][b]April Fools' Day[/b][/h3]
The first day of April will be highlighted with a special temporary battle type. We're not ready to share the details yet, but we can say that while preparing this activity, we drew on inspiration from one of the former temporary battle types that previously featured in the game.

[h3][b]Seychelles Map[/b][/h3]
A new map, Seychelles, was released for closed testing in the summer of 2022While developing it, we were inspired by the real geographical area of the Seychelles region. We had to introduce some changes in the process of testing to ensure the map balance was optimal and to deliver a high-quality gaming experience, but a clear reference to the real Seychelles can still be seen. We plan to add the map to the Live Server this spring.

[h3][b]Improvement of the Equipment Window[/b][/h3]
Our work on improving user interaction with the interface is ongoing. We plan to improve the Equipment window. Recommended upgrades will be added for all ships, much like how the Commander Skills window is currently displayed. We're also going to add a button for mounting a set of recommended upgrades, similar to the currently available button for mounting recommended signals.

[h3][b]Other Improvements[/b][/h3]
In our previous Waterline episode, we announced changes to notifications and the settings window that were to be implemented by the end of 2022. Due to unforeseen circumstances, we had to move these plans to spring 2023. Let's recall what exactly will be improved:
[list][*]Notifications for players in the Port will be updated. A number of improvements will make notifications more structured and informative.
[*]The Settings menu will be updated. The interface design will become more convenient; settings will be stored on the server; and we'll be able to easily add new settings when necessary, thanks to "under-the-bonnet" improvements.[/list]

notes.title: Developer Bulletin for Update 12.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/65f0d999cae1abdb52333471d0f6123bf53c6219.jpg[/img]
[quote][b][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.[/b][/quote]

[quote][i]Please note: The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/i][/quote]

[table][tr][th][b][url=#early-access-to-british-submarines]Early Access to British Submarines[/url]
[url=#shared-combat-missions]Global Combat Missions[/url]
[url=#domination-with-new-settings]Domination With New Settings[/url]
[url=#technical-updates]Technical Updates[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=early-access-to-british-submarines][/h1]Early Access to British Submarines[/b][/h2]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/91b5417c-98a5-11ed-af9b-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/91a29b62-98a5-11ed-88ef-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/91b14dec-98a5-11ed-b231-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
British submarines hit the seas in Early Access in Update 12.1. To celebrate the occasion, the Iron Resilience permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_d6308791bceab9314e41018c12d68f2f809d8f92296e77459708373cd6a94113.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Submarine/standard_261525e5aae827700eaad3b5c3ab72d1721446ecab80226394fd30e9186d8a2d.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Sturdy[/b][/b] and the Victoria Cross permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_d6308791bceab9314e41018c12d68f2f809d8f92296e77459708373cd6a94113.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Submarine/standard_261525e5aae827700eaad3b5c3ab72d1721446ecab80226394fd30e9186d8a2d.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Thrasher[/b][/b], as well as the British Submarines commemorative flag, have been added to the game.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/36eae83a-98a7-11ed-903d-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cb94ff1c-98a6-11ed-b231-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cba5c57c-98a6-11ed-903d-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[quote][i]The British submarines will not be available on the Public Test server.[/i][/quote]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=shared-combat-missions][/h1]Global Combat Missions[/b][/h2]
Global combat missions are being introduced into the game in Update 12.1. Their goal will be common to all players on the server, and each participant will contribute to the mission progress. Global combat missions can be represented both by chains and individual missions.

After completing a global combat mission, all players who participated in it will receive the final reward. It's possible to complete global combat missions before their official deadlines. If this happens, only those players who actually contributed to the mission progress will receive the reward.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/55c68850-98a6-11ed-8900-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/55d177b0-98a6-11ed-9a98-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/55d02e82-98a6-11ed-903d-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=domination-with-new-settings][/h1]Domination With New Settings[/b][/h2]
During Public Test 12.1, you will be able to try out the modified Domination mode with three Key Areas for Random Battles. The new settings are aimed at eliminating situations where battles are too long or too short.

[h3][b]New Settings[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Starting number of points at the beginning of battle: [b]200[/b]
[*]Points when destroying an enemy ship: [b]+40 [/b]for all ship types
[*]Points when losing a ship: [b]–32[/b] for all ship types[/list]
The modified Domination mode will be added to the following maps: New Dawn, Fault Line, Shards, Trident, Neighbors, Crash Zone Alpha, Northern Waters, and Faroe Islands. We will decide on the final fate of the modified Domination based on the results of testing the new settings.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3739ce78-98a7-11ed-9911-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/376c87aa-98a7-11ed-8900-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=technical-updates][/h1]Technical Updates[/b][/h2]
Added interactive music for submarines. It will match the special stealthy gameplay of submarines. The music will change depending on several factors:
[list][*]Combat situation
[*]Actions performed by the submarine or her opponents
[*]Location of the submarine—on the surface or underwater[/list]
The new music will be active in Dynamic and Mixed modes.

Updated the display of squadrons on the decks of aircraft carriers in the Port and in battle. Aircraft carrier decks now display all types of squadrons available on the ship. The number of aircraft of each squadron on deck is equal to the size of the attacking flight.

[td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/71e4e224-98a7-11ed-88ef-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/71e4e224-98a7-11ed-88ef-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr]

notes.title: Airship Escort in Update 12.0
notes.content:
[url=https://youtu.be/ELoYdW4K-i0][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3dbb9f83343c92115f6ac98116a4bfb951991543.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]The battle type that tasks you with escorting airships returns to the game with some improvements and a new name.[/b]

Airships historically carried intelligence agents bearing important messages and diplomats traveling to conduct secret negotiations in neutral territories.

Your objectives are to delay the hostile airship while also making sure that your allied airship is the first to reach the destination point.

[table][tr][th][b][url=#rules]Rules[/url]
[url=#rewards]Rewards[/url]
[url=#maps]Maps[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=ELoYdW4K-i0;full][/previewyoutube] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=rules][/h1]Rules[/b][/h2] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/6ea297b6-9666-11ed-a5fb-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Restrictions[/b][/h3]
The battle type involves Tier VIII–X ships of all types fighting in teams of 12.

[h3][b]The Task[/b][/h3]
Lead your allied airship to its destination before the opposing team does or destroy all hostile ships.

Ships can affect the speed of the allied or opposing airships by staying within an interactive zone near each one:
[list][*]Airships move at a standard speed if there are no players within its interactive zone.
[*]Airships accelerate if only allied ships are within the borders of their interactive zones.
[*]Airships slow down if at least one opposing ship is within the borders of their interactive zones.[/list]
If your team simultaneously speeds up the allied airship and slows down the opposing airship, the allied airship now receives additional acceleration. This change will help prevent situations that previously occurred where battles continued for too long when one of the teams was able to gain a serious lead over the opposing team. At the same time, the base airship speed has been reduced to prevent battles between equal teams from ending too quickly.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/53a1bb68-91bb-11ed-a5e9-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5302aeec-91bb-11ed-9210-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5302706c-91bb-11ed-bf11-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/53a7887c-91bb-11ed-b837-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/52fcb5aa-91bb-11ed-924c-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/52f38958-91bb-11ed-95c1-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
While staying within the interactive zone of any airship, players earn acceleration and slowdown points, plus some extra Credits and XP per battle.

The interface of the battle type has been revamped:
[list][*]New hints that pop up in battle have been added, and the old ones have been updated.
[*]The airship icons and movement progress bar have been changed.
[*]The display of airship routes on the Minimap has been updated.
[*]We've added new quick commands that can be activated by clicking the icon on the airship movement bar.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/52fc5754-91bb-11ed-b6e7-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=rewards][/h1]Rewards[/b][/h2]
Complete special daily and weekly combat missions to obtain Community Tokens.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0126e752-95b0-11ed-9766-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]
[h3][i]Daily mission[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
Win an Airship Escort battle.
[list][*][b]Reward:[/b] [b][b]30[/b][/b] Community Tokens[/list][/expand]
[h3][i]Weekly missions[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
Earn 5,000 base XP in Airship Escort.
[list][*][b]Reward:[/b] [b][b]350[/b][/b] Community Tokens[/list]
Earn 15,000 base XP in Airship Escort.
[list][*][b]Reward:[/b] [b][b]400[/b][/b] Community Tokens[/list]
Earn 50,000 base XP in Airship Escort.
[list][*][b]Reward:[/b] [b][b]550[/b][/b] Community Tokens[/list][/expand]
[h3][b]The most skilled players can unlock special achievements.[/b][/h3] [table][tr][td][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/2AIRSHIPS_VICTORYCLAIMED_69f3f26161a92dd6a92c2b17a89f4855d27bcd27edbb186526e63f6731e1a70a.png[/img][/td] [td]
[h3]Snatched Glory[/h3][/td] [td]Win by destroying all opposing ships when the opposing airship is near the very end of its route.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/2AIRSHIPS_STOPPER_3aeaa3429f32b9e28bffaeeccb5a935f63d4cd64a21243aae2b7822dbd7317f9.png[/img][/td] [td]
[h3]Held at Bay[/h3][/td] [td]Continuously slow down the opposing airship for 1 minute.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/2AIRSHIPS_5MINUTESWINNER_35b0206a2d60ffa59bba9efe2147cb9e03aa509450db536e8e8e2dcefbe4e54c.png[/img][/td] [td]
[h3]Relentless[/h3][/td] [td]Win by constantly staying close to the allied airship over the last 5 minutes of a battle.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/2AIRSHIPS_PHOTOFINISH_7615de9bed90f541457240ea4f3a170edf51d628a1efab890076fe931cb1b772.png[/img][/td] [td]
[h3]Photo Finish[/h3][/td] [td]Win by bringing your allied airship to the destination point with a slight lead over the opposing airship while also speeding up the allied airship or slowing down the opposing airship at the end of the battle.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/2AIRSHIPS_INCENTER_1bc8a7b88d570ac4fd77ce3eb1a1f5ec5835bc49d912a978cbf3ae1562666793.png[/img][/td] [td]
[h3]Push Ahead, Hold Them Back[/h3][/td] [td]Simultaneously speed up your allied airship and slow down the opposing airship.[/td][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=maps][/h1]Maps[/b][/h2]
We've updated the routes for several old maps and added several new ones.
[list][*]Battles will be fought on the following maps: Shards, Sea of Fortune, Trident, Warrior's Path, Estuary, Hotspot, Islands of Ice, North, and Shatter.
[*]The routes for maps Trident, Warrior's Path, Estuary, Hotspot, and Islands of Ice have been updated.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/85db3b2a-95b4-11ed-b327-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/85dc5e92-95b4-11ed-a98c-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/85dfab42-95b4-11ed-a441-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/85db59d4-95b4-11ed-b6c2-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/867b9782-95b4-11ed-8ce6-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/86794cf2-95b4-11ed-80f6-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/868f8fb2-95b4-11ed-b8f2-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8690d7be-95b4-11ed-b682-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/85df61c8-95b4-11ed-979e-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]

notes.title: [EVENT END] 5 USD Bounty Challenge
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c146c3b36e4348683d81175ea3aedc1a64f2ea18.png[/img]
[b]Captains![/b]

Last month we kicked off the celebrations for our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/3517903236760401956]5[i]th[/i] Anniversary on Steam[/url] with a major event here on the platform—[b]the 5 USD Bounty Challenge[/b]. Now, after 30 days of giving new players the opportunity [b]to win $5 in Steam Credit[/b] by winning battles, the event has come to a close—and we’re happy to say that it was a resounding success, with over [b]$214,490[/b] awarded!

If you’re one of the winners who managed to earn the Warrior and/or Amateur achievements in the game client during the event’s time frame, [b]$5[/b] will land in your Steam Wallet [i]no later than December 27[/i].

We want to thank everyone who participated in the event, and we hope you enjoyed the ride toward collecting the bounty! We look forward to seeing you again soon on the waves of World of Warships.

[h3][b][b]Action stations![/b][/b][/h3]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8f8d3b9c0582cb7d06a3856dd53bc852767abfdd.jpg[/img]

Captains!

What part of World of Warships captivates you most? Is it the global multiplayer environment? The gritty naval setting? Or is it perhaps the realistic ship models? Tell us what draws you to the game by applying tags here on Steam, and we'll grant you [b]a full day of Warships Premium Account[/b]!

[h2]How to take part:[/h2]
[olist][*]Find the "Popular user-defined tags for this product" section on the right-hand side of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/552990/World_of_Warships/?tags]the main page[/url] of the game.
[*]Click the "+" symbol.
[*]Select a tag (or create your own) that’s applicable to World of Warships. To select an existing tag from the list, click the "+" symbol next to the tag of your choice.
[*]Share your list of tags in the comments of this news item.[/olist]
Voilà! Your Warships Premium Account will be activated precisely 7 days later.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/552990/World_of_Warships/?tags][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/552990/extras/Steam_tags.gif?t=1574441033[/img][/url]

[b]Attention![/b] The reward can only be granted once a month per player, regardless of the number of tags applied.

Good luck in battle, Captains!

notes.title: UPDATE: The 5 USD Bounty Challenge Just Got Easier!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/19b78fa043402380837d56f9dbf379f49be0eb41.png[/img]

Happy December, Captains!

To celebrate the huge popularity of our[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/552990/view/6368678185299597546] 5th Anniversary event[/url]—and in the spirit of the holiday season—we’ve prepared a surprise update for all our new players hunting the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/552990/view/6368678185299597546]5 USD Steam Credit bounty[/url].

[h3] Now it's 5 times easier to get your free credit — you just need to get the “Amateur” achievement! This achievement is granted whenever you win your [b] first 10 Random Battles![/b] [/h3]

You’ll know you’ve qualified to win when you’ve earned the “Amateur” achievement in the game client, which in total should take you no more than 3 to 4 hours of playtime.

And one last thing: to honor our most active players, we will send [b]1 Santa's Gift container[/b] and [b]1 Steam Container[/b] to all players who have earned the Warrior achievement at the event end!


[b]Terms and conditions:[/b]

[expand type=showmore ]
[list]
[b][*]If you already had the “Amateur” achievement before November 17th, you can still get 5 USD earning the “Warrior” achievement for winning 50 Random Battles.
[*]If you didn't have the “Amateur” achievement before November 17th and earned both the “Amateur” and the “Warrior” achievements, you will get a Steam container and a Santa container as a bonus.[/b]
[*]The achievement must be unlocked in the game client in your World of Warships account in order to be validated. This is not to be confused with the Steam Achievements.
[*]While the achievement must be unlocked during the event’s duration, not all progress toward the achievement needs to occur in the same time frame.
[*]The Warrior achievement can only be earned once.
[*]The reward will be issued only once per user, no later than 1 week after the event ends.
[*]By participating in the event, you accept the applicable Rules of the World of Warships game and Clans. All winners will be subject to anti-bot checks before prizes are distributed. Duplicate accounts will not be rewarded.
[*]By participating in the event, you accept the "5 USD Bounty Challenge" promotion rules available below. Please note that if you win a reward, your Steam ID will be shared with Valve Corporation to enable crediting of the reward to your Steam Wallet account.
[/list]

Detailed rules of the event can be found [url=https://eu-wotp.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/document/promotion_rules_wows_english_edit.pdf]here[/url].[/expand]


[b]Happy anniversary, Captains![/b]

notes.title: Hamburg Dockyard: Admiral Schröder
notes.content:
[url=https://youtu.be/BXG7PP1ukRU][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f74e412f2f15cc66df6ead229fb2754474533bba.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]Update 0.11.11 brings back the Dockyard![/b]

The Hamburg Dockyard kicks off the construction of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Admiral Schröder[/b][/b].

The ship is armed with eight 305 mm guns housed in four main battery turrets. She is well suited for combat at medium and short ranges due to her quite solid durability and decent armor protection for a cruiser. Closing in on a hostile ship will trigger her powerful, long-range, and accurate secondary guns.

To repel torpedo attacks, the "trademark" German Hydroacoustic Search consumable will come in handy. The cruiser has good concealment and is able to quickly change flanks and take up any position as needed owing to her Engine Boost with improved characteristics.

[table][tr][th][b][url=#event-rules]Event Rules[/url]
[url=#combat-missions]Combat Missions[/url]
[url=#rewards]Rewards[/url]
[url=#completing-construction-of-the-ship]Completing Construction of the Ship[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=BXG7PP1ukRU;full][/previewyoutube] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=event-rules][/h1]Event Rules[/b][/h2]
[list][*]The construction process at the Dockyard comprises 30 phases.
[*]The combat missions span 6 weeks of Update 0.11.11 and the first 2 weeks of 0.12.0. The Dockyard itself will remain in your Ports until the start of Update 0.12.1.
[*]In total, you can progress through 26 out of 30 shipbuilding phases by completing combat missions.
[*]You can advance through shipbuilding phases by completing Dockyard missions or spending [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,750[/b] Doubloons to pass through each phase.
[*]If you want to complete shipbuilding phases [b]at a discount[/b], you can obtain Starter Packs: ten shipbuilding phases in exchange for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]10,000[/b] Doubloons and four shipbuilding phases in exchange for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]5,000[/b] Doubloons. However, these packs will only be available prior to the point in time when you complete four shipbuilding phases by finishing combat missions.[/list]
[quote][i]If you decide to complete the construction of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Admiral Schröder[/b][/b] by spending Doubloons, you'll still be able to progress through the Dockyard combat missions. In that case, instead of the usual rewards for completing the shipbuilding phases, you'll get [b]250[/b] Steel for each completed phase.[/i][/quote]

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f03b1fd8-718a-11ed-9fb0-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f08af120-718a-11ed-9b2d-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f0875524-718a-11ed-8322-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/806f2d24-718b-11ed-aa20-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/807beb68-718b-11ed-9b2d-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/807a508c-718b-11ed-84ba-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8082122c-718b-11ed-881d-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=combat-missions][/h1]Combat Missions[/b][/h2]
The new game event tasks you with completing 70 combat missions spread across seven groups. The first group will become available with the release of Update 0.11.11, while those that follow will be unlocked each week.

Completing the first two groups will progress you through three shipbuilding phases each—two phases for accomplishing certain missions and one for finishing the group.

Completing each of the remaining five combat mission groups will progress you through four shipbuilding phases—three for accomplishing certain missions and one for finishing the group.
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=rewards][/h1]Rewards[/b][/h2]
By progressing through the Dockyard combat missions only, you can complete 26 out of 30 shipbuilding phases at the Dockyard and obtain the following rewards:
[list][*][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/dbe362c0-669f-11ed-9528-ac162d70f4e4.png[/img]30x New Year Sky camouflages
[*][b]60,000[/b] Elite Commander XP
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]8,000[/b] Coal
[*][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e745b506-6428-11ed-82c4-ac162d70f4e4.png[/img]1x Santa's Gift container
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]4 days of Warships Premium Account[/b]
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]32,500[/b] Free XP
[*][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e745b506-6428-11ed-82c4-ac162d70f4e4.png[/img]2x Santa's Big Gift containers
[*][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e745b506-6428-11ed-82c4-ac162d70f4e4.png[/img]4x Special Bonuses containers
[*][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e745b506-6428-11ed-82c4-ac162d70f4e4.png[/img]10x Rare Bonuses containers
[*]20x expendable economic bonuses of each of the following types: "Credits [b]+40%[/b]," "Ship XP [b]+200%[/b]," "Commander XP [b]+200%[/b]," and "Free XP [b]+600%[/b]"
[*]12x expendable economic bonuses of each of the following types: "Credits [b]+160%[/b]," "Ship XP [b]+800%[/b]," "Commander XP [b]+800%[/b]," and "Free XP [b]+2,400%[/b]"[/list]
[quote][i]Completing the 19th phase will reward you with [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Renown '44[/b][/b] along with a 6-skill-point Commander and Port slot. This warship is in many ways similar to her counterpart, researchable British battleship [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Renown[/b][/b]. However, the gameplay of Renown '44 is somewhat different from her researchable analog and places more focus on close combat.[/i][/quote]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/93ed0b32-724e-11ed-965f-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=completing-construction-of-the-ship][/h1]Completing Construction of the Ship[/b][/h2]
To complete the shipbuilding process entirely, in addition to progressing through all the combat mission groups, you'll need to spend Doubloons to finish any four shipbuilding phases.
[list][*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]10,000[/b] Coal for completing phase 27.
[*][b]4,000[/b] Research Points for completing phase 28.
[*][b]2,000[/b] Steel for completing phase 29.
[*]Upon completing the 30th shipbuilding phase, you'll receive [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Admiral Schröder[/b][/b] clad in her War Paint permanent camouflage, a Port slot, Commander with 10 skill points, and a commemorative flag.[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/080e1e26-7249-11ed-b1bd-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/76e17bfa-718a-11ed-899d-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[quote]Join the construction of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Admiral Schröder[/b][/b] at the Dockyard and receive rewards for completing shipbuilding phases![/quote]

notes.title: Steam Awards 2022: Nominate World of Warships!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/steamawards/nominations/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/86c01ab095571213af6d0378873aa9aef448f8c2.png[/img][/url]

Ahoy, Captains,

The time has come for the Steam Community to issue their nominations for the 2022 Steam Awards, and guess what — World of Warships is in the running for the “Labor of Love” category!

If you believe World of Warships fits the bill, it goes without saying that we would be thrilled if you would lend us your vote! You can do so by visiting the page linked below, where you’ll be able to nominate games for a variety of categories. Each category you nominate a game for will bring you one random Trading Card.


[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/steamawards/nominations/]Nominate Us![/url][/h3]
When you’re done, you can share your list of nominations with your Steam friends and encourage them to have their say!
If World of Warships receives enough nominations, it will be considered to enter the final Steam Community vote that will determine the winners.

[h3]Get Unique Steam Badges[/h3]
After nominating World of Warships for the “Labor of Love” category, you can upgrade a special Steam badge by completing a series of small tasks:
[list]
[*] Play the game
[*] Leave a review for the game
[*] Nominate a game in each category of the Steam Awards
[/list]

notes.title: 5 Years on Steam: 5 USD Bounty Challenge, Free DLCs, and More!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wowsanniversary5][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c146c3b36e4348683d81175ea3aedc1a64f2ea18.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Happy anniversary, Captains![/h1]

It has already been 5 whole years since World of Warships was first put afloat on Steam. And now, on the anniversary of when it all began 5 years ago, we’re going all-out in celebrating with a [b]5 USD bounty challenge, free DLCs, giveaways[/b],  a marathon for our [b]Steam-themed permanent camouflage[/b], and more fun activities for our loyal Captains!

5 years on, we’re proud to state that there’s truly never been a better time to climb aboard and start playing World of Warships on Steam. That’s why we’re organizing a major event for our new and less experienced Captains—an opportunity to [b]get 5 USD sent to your Steam Wallet just for playing World of Warships[/b]!

[h1=five] 5 USD Bounty Challenge[/h1]

[b]Event starts:[/b] November 18, 2022, 00:00 UTC
[b]Event ends:[/b] December 17, 2022, 23:25 UTC
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8af6b0f4f51b04f38e72220ac49dafb68ed709ea.png[/img]

We’re giving away [b]5 USD in Steam Wallet credit to new and inexperienced players[/b] who manage to gain only one in-game achievement!

To secure your 5 USD credit, all you have to do is [b]earn the Warrior achievement[/b] (win 50 Random Battles) within the event's time frame.

[b]Terms and conditions: [/b]
[list][*]The achievement must be unlocked in the game client in your World of Warships account in order to be validated. This is not to be confused with the Steam Achievements.
[*]While the achievement must be unlocked during the event’s duration, not all progress toward the achievement needs to occur in the same time frame. For example, if you had 45 wins in Random Battles before the event started, you would only have to win five more Random Battle to get your 5 USD. 
[*]The Warrior achievement can only be earned once.
[*]The reward will be issued only once per user, no later than 1 week after the event ends.
[*] By participating in the event, you accept the applicable Rules of the World of Warships game and Clans. All winners will be subject to anti-bot checks before prizes are distributed. Duplicate accounts will not be rewarded.
[*] By participating in the event, you accept the "5 USD Bounty Challenge" promotion rules available below. Please note that if you win a reward, your Steam ID will be shared with Valve Corporation to enable crediting of the reward to your Steam Wallet account. [/list]
Detailed rules of the event can be found [url=https://eu-wotp.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/document/promotion_rules_wows_english_edit.pdf]here[/url].

[i]Please note that the rules were updated on December 08, 2022, due to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/552990/view/3639501150891422770]$5 USD Bounty Challenge change.[/url][/i]

[b]FAQ:[/b]

[expand style=more] 
[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Question[/th]
        [th]Answer[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]How will the prizes be distributed?[/td]
        [td]5 USD will be added directly to your Steam Wallet.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]When will the prizes be distributed?[/td]
        [td]The prizes will be distributed a week after the event ends.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]What if my Steam Wallet's currency is not USD?[/td]
        [td]5 USD will automatically be converted to your Wallet's currency. The currency rate is determined by Steam.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Do I absolutely need a Steam account to participate?[/td]
        [td]Yes, your game account needs to have been created in the Steam version of World of Warships. The prize can only be added to your Steam Wallet; it's not possible to receive it in any other form.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]How winners will be determined if the prize pool gets exhausted?[/td]
        [td]The prizes will be distributed to those who unlocked the achievement earlier in time.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Am I eligible if I had accumulated some of the necessary victories for the achievement before the event?[/td]
        [td]Yes, you only need to complete the achievement during the event.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Am I eligible if I had unlocked the achievement before the event?[/td]
        [td]Unfortunately, no. The achievement needs to be unlocked during the event.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Are there any country limitations?[/td]
        [td]Any Steam user with World of Warships in their Steam Library can participate.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]How many times can I receive the prize?[/td]
        [td]The prize can be received only once per Steam account. [/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]What can I spend the 5 USD on?[/td]
        [td]It can be used for anything you normally can spend Steam Wallet funds on; there are no additional limitations.[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
[/expand]

[h1]Free DLCs[/h1]

[h3] World of Warships—Starter Pack: Dreadnought [/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1880790/World_of_Warships__Starter_Pack_Dreadnought/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2206520/World_of_Warships__FREE_Steam_Anniversary_Party_Kit/

Remember the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/3344499520730737781]camouflage contest[/url] we held earlier this year where we asked you to get creative and come up with a Steam-themed camouflage pattern that we could implement into the game? Well, it’s ready! The winning design, created by [i]Jav9th[/i] from the North America server, is available as a permanent camouflage for British battleship King George V. The camo can be earned through a special mission marathon that will also see you gaining some more expendable Steam camos and economic bonuses.

notes.title: Apply a Tag—Get 1 Day of Warships Premium Account
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8f8d3b9c0582cb7d06a3856dd53bc852767abfdd.jpg[/img]

Captains!

What part of World of Warships captivates you most? Is it the global multiplayer environment? The gritty naval setting? Or is it perhaps the realistic ship models? Tell us what draws you to the game by applying tags here on Steam, and we'll grant you [b]a full day of Warships Premium Account[/b]!

[h2]How to take part:[/h2]
[olist][*]Find the "Popular user-defined tags for this product" section on the right-hand side of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/552990/World_of_Warships/?tags]the main page[/url] of the game.
[*]Click the "+" symbol.
[*]Select a tag (or create your own) that’s applicable to World of Warships. To select an existing tag from the list, click the "+" symbol next to the tag of your choice.
[*]Share your list of tags in the comments of this news item.[/olist]
Voilà! Your Warships Premium Account will be activated precisely 7 days later.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/552990/World_of_Warships/?tags][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/552990/extras/Steam_tags.gif?t=1574441033[/img][/url]

[b]Attention![/b] The reward can only be granted once a month per player, regardless of the number of tags applied.

Good luck in battle, Captains!

notes.content:

[b]Captains![/b]

Participation in the Public Test will allow you to earn containers with Premium ships, permanent and expendable camouflages, and other valuable items. All information on how to join the Public Test is available on a [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/pt-guide/]dedicated page[/url] of the official website.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2716184589232191867
Update 0.11.10 brings Early Access to new Japanese cruisers, graphics improvements, the Battle Pass, and other new features. Take a look at the [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/bulletin-01110/]Developer Bulletin[/url], and welcome to the Test! See you on the Public Test Server!

[url=https://forum.worldofwarships.eu/forum/485-public-test/ style=button]Leave Feedback[/url]

[h2]Round 2 Schedule[/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Thu. 20 Oct. 18:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Tue. 25 Oct. 07:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

Captains, thank you for participating in the first round of the Public Test for Update 0.11.10! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Made balance changes to some ships. Details are available in our [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/380]Development Blog[/url].
[*]Fixed an error in the description of the "Enhanced Rudder Gears" consumable — the parameter previously called “Speed underwater” has now been correctly relabeled “Dive and Surface speed.”
[*]Fixed a bug due to which the description of the "Main Battery Reload Booster" consumable did not include the exact bonus applied to main battery reload time when the consumable is active.
[*]Fixed animations and graphical errors in the Naval Base port.
[*]Fixed bugs on the maps North, Northern Lights, Mountain Range, Estuary, and Strait.[/list]
[h2]Combat Missions and Rewards[/h2]
You can earn Community Tokens by progressing through combat missions on the Public Test Server. These Tokens can be exchanged for various rewards in the Armory, including rare permanent camouflages, containers, and other in-game items.

[quote][i]The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/i][/quote]
