notes.title: Halloween: Twilight Battle
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/59c5156bc068b0b9f4c4babd785f5660ad392d9b.jpg[/img]
[b]Have you already succeeded in Saving Transylvania and fending off malevolent forces in Operation Sunray in the Darkness? The Halloween activities don't end there![/b]

Now, you yourself can stand at the helm of one of the ships of the Forces of Darkness and feel their ominous power. The Twilight Battle—something you may well be familiar with from the Halloween 2018 celebrations—is back with a reworked interface and visual effects.

[table][tr][th][b][url=#rewards]Rules[/url]
[url=#twilight-fleet]Twilight Fleet[/url]
[url=#ships-of-the-twilight-fleet]Ships of the Twilight Fleet[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=uMxOYcJALok;full][/previewyoutube] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=rewards][/h1]Rules[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Wed. 19 Oct. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Wed. 02 Nov. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/20f4b30e-4eb9-11ed-af6f-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Two teams of seven players each clash against each other playing Twilight Fleet ships equipped with unusual consumables. Battles are fought on the map from Operation Sunray in the Darkness. The key objective is to destroy all enemy ships.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4615c81c-4ec8-11ed-80c8-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4625aa0c-4ec8-11ed-b9e6-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/46196878-4ec8-11ed-990c-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/461f38de-4ec8-11ed-a794-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
The water area is gradually being consumed by the Filth, and the safe zone for ships is continuously shrinking. Ships outside the safe zone take varying amounts of continuous damage, depending on the ship type.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/20fa7dd0-4e31-11ed-97ed-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/210cc170-4e31-11ed-ad49-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/21a002f0-4e31-11ed-a39a-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/219cd634-4e31-11ed-9c0a-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/210f3fa4-4e31-11ed-aa17-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=twilight-fleet][/h1]Twilight Fleet[/b][/h2]
From the outset, the following ships will be available to you:
[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_2b26ad239bcad2d1d2b4edc931b3f763104edf4f364c2378ea113250b619ef05.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Ghoul[/b][/b] under the command of [b]Dr. Van Schubs[/b].
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_2b26ad239bcad2d1d2b4edc931b3f763104edf4f364c2378ea113250b619ef05.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Octopus[/b][/b] under the command of [b]David Jones[/b].
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_2b26ad239bcad2d1d2b4edc931b3f763104edf4f364c2378ea113250b619ef05.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Leviathan[/b][/b] under the command of [b]Max Strauss[/b].[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/53ce7964-4eb8-11ed-b9fd-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/53b8d532-4eb8-11ed-8aa8-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/53b2f414-4eb8-11ed-af6f-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5529aaae-4eb8-11ed-add4-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/53c45d30-4eb8-11ed-993d-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5463aaa2-4eb8-11ed-990c-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
To obtain the other five ships and Commanders, you'll need to complete special combat missions in the Twilight Battle:
[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_2b26ad239bcad2d1d2b4edc931b3f763104edf4f364c2378ea113250b619ef05.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Razorworm[/b][/b] with Commander [b]Boris Veber[/b] will become available if you earn 5,000 Base XP playing Ghoul.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_2b26ad239bcad2d1d2b4edc931b3f763104edf4f364c2378ea113250b619ef05.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Scarab[/b][/b] with Commander [b]Rick H. O'Tep[/b] will become available if you earn 5,000 Base XP playing Octopus.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_2b26ad239bcad2d1d2b4edc931b3f763104edf4f364c2378ea113250b619ef05.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Varg[/b][/b] with Commander [b]J.G. Mephisteufel[/b] will become available if you earn 5,000 Base XP playing Leviathan.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_2b26ad239bcad2d1d2b4edc931b3f763104edf4f364c2378ea113250b619ef05.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Steel Rat[/b][/b] with Commander [b]James D. Breese[/b] will become available if you earn 10,000 Base XP.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_2b26ad239bcad2d1d2b4edc931b3f763104edf4f364c2378ea113250b619ef05.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Rasputin[/b][/b] with Commander [b]Chernomor[/b] will become available if you earn 25,000 Base XP.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b0a31c1c-4eb8-11ed-94f3-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b0a717ea-4eb8-11ed-9204-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b0b145b2-4eb8-11ed-8aa8-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b18b7110-4eb8-11ed-a91f-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b014055e-4eb8-11ed-993d-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b0b18f40-4eb8-11ed-aa76-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b01508f0-4eb8-11ed-af6f-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b0170b00-4eb8-11ed-a91f-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b003e0a2-4eb8-11ed-92f1-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b002bd9e-4eb8-11ed-990c-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[quote]All Commanders come with 21 skill points. The Commanders earn Elite Commander XP, which can be spent on training Commanders of the regular in-game nations.[/quote]
[quote][i]With the release of Update 0.11.10, all Twilight Battle ships and Commanders will be removed from your accounts. Any XP accumulated on the special ships will be transfered to [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]I[/b] Orlan[/b][/b].[/i][/quote]

In addition to [b]Damage Control Party[/b], ships of the Twilight Fleet are equipped with special consumables. Almost all of these have special color indications and visual effects, depending on their functions.
[list][*][b]Yellow[/b] indicates defensive consumables.
[*][b]Green[/b] indicates consumables that restore HP.
[*][b]Red[/b] indicates consumables that restore a ship's HP when dealing damage to enemy ships.
[*][b]Turquoise[/b] indicates consumables that enhance ship characteristics.
[*][b]Orange[/b] indicates consumables that place certain limitations on the target.
[*][b]Consumables[/b] that can be used in regular battles have no color indication.[/list]
[quote][i]If your remaining allies are fewer in number than the enemy ships, the efficiency of HP-restoring consumables with [b]red[/b] and [b]green[/b] indications doubles.[/i][/quote]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=ships-of-the-twilight-fleet][/h1]Ships of the Twilight Fleet[/b][/h2]
[h2]Ghoul[/h2]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_2b26ad239bcad2d1d2b4edc931b3f763104edf4f364c2378ea113250b619ef05.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Ghoul[/b][/b] is a stealthy destroyer with long-range but slow torpedoes. She is perfect for raiding deep behind enemy lines.
[table][tr][td]
[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/ability/PXY301_Immortal_PVP_f4af38604c68bbac3b474976709f02ee226abf5076bb62f3395f5d0edc573433.png[/img]
[/td] [td][b]Covert Repair[/b] reduces the ship's detectability by half and restores 100 HP per second as long as she remains undetected by the enemy.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]
[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/ability/PXY319_SpeedBooster_PVP_c9f27db0ed04d6e4eee032fc63d63750bd205c2c30ce2b37f0690e6a31812995.png[/img]
[/td] [td][b]Invincible Engine Boost[/b] temporarily increases the ship's maximum speed. While this consumable is active, the ship cannot be destroyed. It also provides temporary protection against the Filth effects.[/td][/tr][/table]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/09ce12c6-4e30-11ed-9c0a-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Razorworm[/h2]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_2b26ad239bcad2d1d2b4edc931b3f763104edf4f364c2378ea113250b619ef05.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Razorworm[/b][/b] is an artillery-focused destroyer with short-range torpedoes. She can develop tremendous speed, making her a perfect flank fighter. Thanks to her special consumables, Razorworm can be a hard target to hit.
[table][tr][td]
[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/ability/PXY314_TurnAround_PVP_dab2bc0dacd919fb2eb7fdef1b8bb41b509d1dbc71545727e4a5ef5dc19317d2.png[/img]
[/td] [td][b]Clubhaul[/b] immediately makes the ship take a U-turn and recovers 2,000 HP.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]
[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/ability/PXY305_MindControl_PVP_45e449039d868beda4ddee3692107113f279641a0b76b30f8b9a5cf54799e349.png[/img]
[/td] [td][b]Dispersion System[/b] reduces the accuracy of any enemy ships firing at you with main battery guns.[/td][/tr][/table]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/09da898e-4e30-11ed-87f7-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Steel Rat[/h2]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_2b26ad239bcad2d1d2b4edc931b3f763104edf4f364c2378ea113250b619ef05.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Steel Rat[/b][/b] is a support destroyer. When close to other ships, she can put up a smoke screen to obscure them or refill their consumable charges. She's also capable of restoring the allies' HP with her main battery shells and quick torpedoes.
[table][tr][td]
[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/ability/PXY302_HealShell_PVP_3712be874d3084a14466dc54713875c402951034313202666b7b7674bcfcd7f4.png[/img]
[/td] [td][b]Restoration Charge[/b] reduces the reload time of the ship's main battery guns by a factor of four. Each time you hit an ally while the consumable is active, you restore 1,000 HP for the allied ship you hit and 500 HP for Steel Rat herself.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]
[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/ability/PXY303_AddConsumable_PVP_b8eb1052aa9c489759eb824752b30a57e1ae169e2a1ec2471f64e23607e96cea.png[/img]
[/td] [td][b]Emergency Reserve[/b] provides all allies within a 5 km radius with an additional charge of each consumable mounted on their ships.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]
[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/ability/PXY315_SmokeGenerator_PVP_032ab19880a2c469d885b365bcb9cf0d0f1ce1b1edd7a978e8c00efd29f021d7.png[/img]
[/td] [td][b]Smoke Generator[/b][/td][/tr][/table]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/09daa5b8-4e30-11ed-ad49-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Octopus[/h2]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_2b26ad239bcad2d1d2b4edc931b3f763104edf4f364c2378ea113250b619ef05.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Octopus[/b][/b] is a cruiser with long-range main battery guns, a slow rate of fire, and high chances of setting the enemy on fire with her shells.
[table][tr][td]
[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/ability/PXY308_HealAll_PVP_689e15a7aac936b62d5793d0baf8702cf2dd8b4bf73e4624707c2a2ac2b310a1.png[/img]
[/td] [td][b]Heal Radiance[/b] restores 10,000 HP for all allied ships.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]
[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/ability/PXY318_RLSSearch_PVP_fa3af1e777a35913d958431fa95b52ddde2b2e467e29715f211075ee50074665.png[/img]
[/td] [td][b]Surveillance Radar[/b] with great action range.[/td][/tr][/table]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0a7908ca-4e30-11ed-b9e2-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Scarab[/h2]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_2b26ad239bcad2d1d2b4edc931b3f763104edf4f364c2378ea113250b619ef05.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Scarab[/b][/b] is a close-quarters combat cruiser equipped with Hydroacoustic Search. With proper and timely use of her consumables, Scarab is very difficult to destroy due to her ability to quickly restore her HP.
[table][tr][td]
[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/ability/PXY306_Vampiric_PVP_cd62221a4470f02ce196e25b9977858e1cbe4f41223e89cc31251c8dff2a3aed.png[/img]
[/td] [td][b]Grim Vampire Drain[/b] restores 1,000 HP for her each time she hits an enemy ship.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]
[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/ability/PXY307_LivingArmor_PVP_9b779cc93541845cac5939fa8f1c150f9dbac3e875d2cafbc3ada5a9046952ee.png[/img]
[/td] [td][b]Damage Converter[/b] converts all incoming damage into restored HP while active.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]
[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/ability/PXY317_SonarSearch_PVP_4b044921fd093f0cef40a83d2c30a4d349fa2a5833b120730c5d9ce70c496f12.png[/img]
[/td] [td][b]Hydroacoustic Search[/b][/td][/tr][/table]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/09d9f78a-4e30-11ed-a2d1-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Leviathan[/h2]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_2b26ad239bcad2d1d2b4edc931b3f763104edf4f364c2378ea113250b619ef05.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Leviathan[/b][/b] is a battleship that boasts high accuracy at long ranges, turning her into an extremely dangerous opponent for all ship types. It's advisable to keep her close to allies so you can restore her own and allies' HP using her Repair Zone consumable when the situation requires.
[table][tr][td]
[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/ability/PXY309_Sniper_PVP_6ef1dc2a6e24db94a6802607f2fbcaad6e4efb97257ec105bdbb74fe463710b1.png[/img]
[/td] [td][b]Infernal Accuracy[/b] significantly increases the firing accuracy of the ship's main battery guns.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]
[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/ability/PXY310_HealZone_PVP_7b57f5d7c2bbb630b6ebba15e43cde074d81a4c3ecc2878222b2d60aa9203fea.png[/img]
[/td] [td][b]Repair Zone[/b] creates a repair zone within a 5 km radius from the ship that recovers the ship's own HP and any allied ships' HP at the rate of 500 HP per second.[/td][/tr][/table]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0aa9b538-4e30-11ed-bd93-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Varg[/h2]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_2b26ad239bcad2d1d2b4edc931b3f763104edf4f364c2378ea113250b619ef05.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Varg[/b][/b] is a close-quarters combat battleship with powerful secondary guns. She can become invulnerable to enemy shells and quickly restore her own HP. The more enemies that are nearby, the stronger Varg becomes.
[table][tr][td]
[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/ability/PXY321_Invulnerable_PVP_846d56fb75d66f64138888271a3a0874e76ae4a9ac4e012bfa60a3b268eec90b.png[/img]
[/td] [td][b]Energy Shield[/b] makes the ship temporarily invulnerable to any type of damage, except for damage from the Filth.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]
[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/ability/PXY311_LifeDrain_PVP_343986cf76e1ff7661139fa2179b703de79c005704a11d529a4ba43f218c4b41.png[/img]
[/td] [td][b]Matter Restorer[/b] improves the ship's maneuverability and creates a zone with a radius of 5 km around the ship that restores 300 HP each second. Every enemy ship located within the zone adds 300 more hit points to the restoration bonus.[/td][/tr][/table]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0a778144-4e30-11ed-8ae9-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Rasputin[/h2]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_2b26ad239bcad2d1d2b4edc931b3f763104edf4f364c2378ea113250b619ef05.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Rasputin[/b][/b] is a battleship with a solid HP pool. She cannot boast of having a great firing range or high main battery gun traverse speed and is therefore inefficient in countering long-range ships and destroyers at the initial stages of battle. However, when the safe zone shrinks, her enemies will be forced to come closer, and they will have a really tough time in this situation.
[table][tr][td]
[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/ability/PXY312_FilthPower_PVP_bce0029859b4338274ff1fbd1212ee545c396d9a58032c41c391a3a65e911102.png[/img]
[/td] [td][b]Ghastly Vampire Drain[/b] restores her HP by 50% of damage dealt to the enemy.[/td][/tr] [tr][td]
[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/ability/PXY313_Silence_PVP_90052743b8c15a076d3d765da61a3061f749d53c8696ee6bacba713675897e6d.png[/img]
[/td] [td][b]Signal Jamming Generator[/b] prevents enemy ships from activating their consumables.[/td][/tr][/table]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/09d9ec90-4e30-11ed-aa17-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]

Commanders!

We’re holding a special and easy-to-enter giveaway — 5 lucky winners will be picked at random.

[h1]How to participate:[/h1]
[olist][*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2875030440]Click here[/url]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2875030440
[h1]Rules:[/h1]
[list][*]Winners will be picked at random from the pool of participating unique users—only one comment per user will be taken into consideration.
[*]Any comments that break the discussion rules may be deleted or excluded.[/list]
[h1]The prize:[/h1]
[list][*]1x Premium Ship VIII container[/list]
We wish you good luck and following seas!

notes.title: It’s time to make a decision!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9d859672818308a81e3adb6d8de8d2c685af8fc0.png[/img]

Commanders! 

The final stage of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/6028653879558863966]the account transfer[/url] will start today! This campaign has been designed [b]specifically for players in CIS realm[/b] in order to give them an opportunity to move their accounts to the EU realm and continue playing World of Warships on the Steam. All the other regions remain without any changes (e.g. in terms of this campaign you cannot transfer your account from NA to EU, or from ASIA to NA etc.). 

Starting today, the following will happen:
[olist]
[*]CIS server will be no longer available on Steam
[*]When you try to log in to your CIS account, you will be offered the option to transfer your account data to the EU server* and continue playing via Steam
[*]You will not be able to use your CIS account on Steam until you decide for the transfer to the EU server
[/olist][i]*Check the additional information by clicking on this [url=https://worldofwarships.ru/ru/news/general-news/account-transfer-start]link[/url].[/i]

The account transfer allows the player to move their account data from one server to another while retaining all vessels, purchases, resources, statistics etc. After the transfer, the original account on the CIS server will be blocked and then deleted [b]in 59 days[/b]. During this time period, every transferred player has [b]a one-time opportunity to change their decision[/b]. 

The transfer procedure is available for [b]all players that have an account on the CIS realm[/b]. 

[h3]Transfer: The Process[/h3]

Let’s go through the process of moving your account to the EU server:
[olist]
[*] Find World of Warships in your library, update the game to the latest version and press “Play”
[*] You will see a screen prompt informing you that you cannot use your CIS account anymore and you need to make a decision about the transfer
[*] Click on the big button “Transfer Account” 
[*] The system will then check your account data:
[list]
[*] If you have not completed the registration on your account (you don't have an email and password bound to your account), you will be offered to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/4174225702959905780?snr=2_9_100003_]complete the registration[/url] in Account Management. This is required to ensure that the transfer process goes correctly, and you have access to your transferred account on the EU server after the procedure.
[*] If you have completed the registration, you will proceed to the next stage.
[/list][*] The system will then check your account for any conflicts. At this stage, we have three possible options:
[list]
[*] You already have an EU account registered using the same Steam account. Since you cannot have two accounts on the same server bound to the same Steam ID, you will be offered to unbind your existing EU account from your Steam ID via Account Management and try again.
[*] You already have an EU account registered using the same email as your CIS account. In this case the system will ask you for a new email and password for your transferred account. 
[*] You do not have any conflict and you proceed to the next stage
[/list][*] After you’ve settled any possible conflicts, the account transfer process will start. Usually, it processes all the data in just a few minutes, but in rare cases it can take up to a couple of hours, so don’t worry if it lasts longer than you expected.  
[*] As soon as the procedure is finished, you will get a message that the transfer has been completed, and you can immediately log in to your account on the EU server and play the game! 
[/olist]

Welcome to the EU-server! [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/ru/news/general-news/welcome-to-eu-news/]Here is more info[/url] that helps you to adapt faster.

Please note that if your store settings in Steam account are selected as Russia or Belarus, then in case you uninstall World of Warships from your library, you will not be able to install the game on Steam again.

[quote=author] [url=https://worldofwarships.ru/ru/news/general-news/account-transfer-faq/]FAQ[/url] [/quote][b]P.S.:[/b] if you still get logged to CIS server after the transfer — open the file [b]currentrealm.txt[/b] in the game's folder and change the contents to [code]eu[/code]

notes.title: Halloween: Nightmare Operations
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/40baf6035d99da18e9afb32efe153ce20be96c0c.jpg[/img]
[b]Halloween is at our doorstep, and that can only mean one thing—the Forces of Darkness are preparing to slink out from the shadows and drench the world in fear! You are the only one that can stand in their way![/b]

Celebrate Halloween this year by getting involved in the following activities:
[list][*]Operations Saving Transylvania and Sunray in the Darkness.
[*]The Twilight Battle temporary battle type (you may remember this from Halloween 2018!). Twilight descends upon us 2 weeks after the release of Update 0.11.9.[/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#saving-transylvania]Saving Transylvania[/url]
[url=#sunray-in-the-darkness]Sunray in the Darkness[/url]
[url=#rewards]Rewards[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
In this article, we're going to take a closer look at the Operations. You can expect more details about the Twilight Battle to come in a separate dedicated article.

Operation Saving Transylvania will be available as Operation of the Week in the first week of the update; Sunray in the Darkness—in the second week. Players will also have an opportunity to team up with their friends in a Division and fight evil throughout the entirety of Update 0.11.9! Both Operations will be available at the normal difficulty level only.

[quote][i]During Update 0.11.9, the standard Operations are available only for players in Divisions. With the release of Update 0.11.10, Random Operations will become available again.[/i][/quote]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/404bcfbe-43c7-11ed-b9bf-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[i]In the game client, Operations of the Week will be displayed as Active Operations.
[/i]
[h2][b][h1=saving-transylvania][/h1]Saving Transylvania[/b][/h2]
The main task in this Operation is to escort a ship called Transylvania on her winding route to safe harbor. On the way, you must protect her from attacking catapults and Zikasa ships possessed by the Darkness. At the end of the route, players will face the final boss—the menacing battleship Rasputin.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1381c5fc-433a-11ed-958c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
For Operation Saving Transylvania, players can look forward to helming the following special ships manned by Commanders with 21 skill points:
[list][*]Destroyer [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_2b26ad239bcad2d1d2b4edc931b3f763104edf4f364c2378ea113250b619ef05.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b][b]III[/b] Blade[/b][/b] with Commander [b]Abraham V. Hellsinger[/b]
[*]Battleship [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_2b26ad239bcad2d1d2b4edc931b3f763104edf4f364c2378ea113250b619ef05.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b][b]III[/b] Jackal[/b][/b] with Commander [b]Henry J. Hide[/b]
[*]Cruiser [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_2b26ad239bcad2d1d2b4edc931b3f763104edf4f364c2378ea113250b619ef05.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b][b]III[/b] Igor[/b][/b] with Commander [b]Victor F. Einstein[/b][/list]
[quote][i]Halloween Commanders earn Elite Commander XP, which can be spent on training Commanders of the in-game nations.[/i][/quote]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e213083e-4332-11ed-afeb-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/774c74ca-4334-11ed-bf41-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/775029ee-4334-11ed-a0fe-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/77421a5c-4334-11ed-a177-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h3][b]Primary task[/b][/h3]
Escort and protect Transylvania during her escape through the Portal.

[h3][b]Secondary tasks[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Transylvania must not lose 50% or more of her HP during the voyage.
[*]Destroy at least 16 Zikasa ships.
[*]Neutralize all catapults on the map.
[*]Transylvania must not stop until reaching the end of the route. To ensure that this condition is completed, at least one player should always remain near the ship.
[*]Sink battleship Rasputin.[/list]
[quote][i]Each secondary task fulfilled increases the reward for completing the primary task.[/i][/quote]

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/41909270-433a-11ed-958c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/41a41322-433a-11ed-9c9f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/41d543f2-433a-11ed-a648-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/41a86738-433a-11ed-9578-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=sunray-in-the-darkness][/h1]Sunray in the Darkness[/b][/h2]
Transylvania and her saviors have returned to their home waters of the Silver Spear Archipelago, but the Forces of Darkness are coming after them by breaking through the Portal. Your task is to hold the undead off!

Security towers will help you in battle and try to seal the Portal. You need to protect the towers from enemy ships. Along with monsters, the Filth—a dense fog—is leaking through the Portal and endangering life itself. Be careful: while in the Filth, your ship takes damage each second. The amount of damage you receive depends on your ship type. Besides this, visibility and ship detectability decrease significantly in the Filth. At the same time, the Filth benefits your boss enemies—battleship Rasputin and aircraft carrier The Great Gorgon—by restoring their hit points and reducing the amount of damage they take.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1389e2b4-433a-11ed-9578-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Our Seventh Anniversary Celebration Activities Are Ongoing!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ffc918e11f5ff76fe08f7d02306c9f47f4075d9b.jpg[/img]
[b]Greetings, Commander! We're the World of Warships Content Team.[/b]

[b][i]We want to address you directly and thank you for being with us for these 7 action-packed years! During this time, we've been working hard on our mission to elevate your experience in the game and make our beloved World of Warships even more enjoyable to immerse yourself in.[/i][/b]

[i][b]Together with you, we make a perfect team![/b] Your valuable insights and feedback give us important prompts about the areas we need to develop further. We've become more open and eager to inform you in detail about not only the game updates but also about our development plans for the months ahead. We thoroughly read all of your comments, and these help us come to what we hope are the correct conclusions about how to improve the game. We hope that you might appreciate this closer interaction and that the fruits of our labor will bring you greater satisfaction and enjoyment in the game.[/i]

World of Warships is celebrating its Seventh Anniversary right now! It's quite a respectable age for the world of online games, which is pretty much always moving at the speed of light. But World of Warships is much more than just a game, right? For us, it's the community that makes it so special. In other words—you and your many fellow Captains from around the world! To celebrate this special occasion, we've prepared loads of birthday activities and gifts. Read on to find out what you can still look forward to!
[list][*]Explore the [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/sales-and-events/wows-anniversary-2022/#treasure-map]Treasure Map[/url] and journey across the game, our official website, and [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/worldofwarshipscom?sub_confirmation=1]YouTube channel[/url] to obtain the final reward and take part in a superprize raffle.
[*]Take advantage of battle performance bonuses on all ships starting from Tier V. You'll now be able to receive several gifts per battle!
[*]Take a fresh look at our historical Ports. Learn fascinating facts about 16 well-known Ports in World of Warships. Gather elements of the collection, enter Ports, find hidden numbers, and obtain a bonus code. And if you're wondering what the code is for... Look for the answer from [b]FairPlayer_I[/b]!
[*]Immerse yourself in the tense atmosphere of the Warship Strike minigame, where the opposition's ships are invisible and the first shells are pretty much fired at random. You'll find Warship Strike in the Armory!
[*]Complete a chain of combat missions to obtain up to seven Thetis expendable camouflages, up to three Common Bonus containers, and Commander Master of the Seven Seas with 6 skill points for European ships.
[*]Earn Base XP, complete a combat mission, and receive a Seven Seas commemorative flag.[/list]
You can read the full details about World of Warships' Anniversary activities in a [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/sales-and-events/wows-anniversary-2022/]special article[/url] on our website. Stay on course—let's sail into the future together, Commander!

notes.title: The Recruiting Station: A Simple Guide
notes.content:
[url=https://youtu.be/f0NFbygy8Sc][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/405d5977ef051e4566fb7c3f5c25ae551ed87fe9.jpg[/img][/url]
[h3][b]Have you ever used the Recruiting Station? If not, then you’ve probably at least heard of it.[/b][/h3]
As the name suggests, the Recruiting Station is World of Warships’ referral program, and it’s actually much simpler to take advantage of than you might think. In essence, what happens is that a player sends invitations to people who they think would enjoy World of Warships. The inviting player receives rewards when the people they invite accept their invitations and play the game.

[table][tr][th][b][url=#getting-recruits]Getting Recruits[/url] ● [url=#benefitting-from-recruits]Benefitting From Recruits[/url] ● [url=#spending-community-tokens]Spending Community Tokens[/url] ● [url=#rewards-for-recruits]Rewards for Recruits[/url] ● [url=#anniversary-recruiting-event]Anniversary Recruiting Event[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=getting-recruits][/h1]Getting Recruits[/b][/h2]
The Recruiting Station revolves around the relationship between the Recruiter and their Recruits.
[list][*]A [b]Recruiter[/b] can be any player with at least 15 battles fought on their account
[*]A [b]Recruit[/b] (a.k.a. Shipmate) is a person who either:

[list][*]Doesn’t have a World of Warships account
[*]Has fewer than 15 battles on record
[*]Has an account but hasn’t played in 90+ days[/list][/list]
If you fit the criterion to be a Recruiter and you know someone who fits the criteria to be a Recruit, then just send them an invitation through the Recruiting Station interface—either on our website or from your in-game Port screen.

[url=https://friends.worldofwarships.eu/about style=button]Recruiting Station[/url]

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/97f41b02-3906-11ed-af26-ac162d70f4e4.gif[/img]

[list][i]You can send as many invitations as you want to as many people as you want—there’s no downside.[/i][/list]
[table][tr][td]
[h3][b]Did you know…?[/b][/h3]
If you’re new to the Recruiting Station, you can claim a [b]FREE Recruiting Station container[/b] with minimal effort. Here’s how:
[olist][*]Log in to the [url=https://friends.worldofwarships.eu/about]Recruiting Station[/url] page
[*]Share a referral invitation three times[/olist]
Regardless of whether the recipients accept the invitations or not, you will automatically get a Junior Recruiting Station container as a welcome!
[/td][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=benefitting-from-recruits][/h1]Benefitting From Recruits[/b][/h2]
Once somebody accepts one of your invitations, they become tied to your account as your Recruit. [b]What does that mean for you?[/b]

[h3][b]Community Tokens[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]For every single battle[/b] your Recruit fights alone, [b]10 Community Tokens[/b] will be credited to your account, up to a limit of 1,500 Community tokens per week.
[*][b]For every single battle you fight in a Division [/b]with one or two of your Recruits, [b]18 [/b]or[b] 22 Community Tokens[/b] will be credited to your Account, respectively, plus bonus amounts if these battles end in victory.[/list]
[h3][b]Premium Account[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The first time your [b]Recruit fights a battle playing a Tier VI ship[/b], [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]3 days of Warships Premium account[/b] will be credited to your account.[/list]
[h3][b]Doubloon Cashback[/b][/h3]
[list][*]You will receive 10% of the total value of [b]every purchase made by your Recruits[/b] in the Premium Shop in the form of [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]Doubloons[/b].[/list]
[list][i]As you can see, you can pick your own pace. You can actively support your Shipmates in progressing faster and get higher rewards, or you can just send the invite, sit back, and reap the regular Recruit battle rewards without having to lift a finger. The choice is yours![/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=spending-community-tokens][/h1]Spending Community Tokens[/b][/h2]
So, you’ve recruited an entire gang of Shipmates and you’re swimming in Community Tokens. [b]What now?[/b]

[h3][b]Armory[/b][/h3]
Community Tokens are first and foremost an Armory currency.

Head to the [url=https://armory.worldofwarships.eu/category/community]Naval Community tab[/url] in the Armory interface and take your pick—from signal flags and economic bonuses to Premium ship containers, special Commanders, and Supercontainers.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/85836f26-3907-11ed-b9c4-ac162d70f4e4.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Invest in your Recruits![/b][/h3]
But Community Tokens are not just [i]any[/i] Armory currency.

They have a unique property that allows you to spend them in the [url=https://friends.worldofwarships.eu/goods/]REWARDS[/url] section of the Recruiting Station interface. There, you can exchange Community Tokens for special bundles of two of each type of Recruiting Station container at a discount. What’s special about these bundles is that while one of the containers goes to your account, the second goes to the Recruit of your choice. It offers a welcome chance for them to obtain one of the valuable rewards inside these containers, including Premium ships.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/85e24d8e-3907-11ed-b376-ac162d70f4e4.gif[/img]
[table][tr][td]
[h3][b]Did you know…?[/b][/h3]
The Recruiting Station is not the only source of [b]Community Tokens[/b] in World of Warships.
[list][*][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/twitch-connect/]Twitch Drops[/url]: Simply link your account to Twitch and watch World of Warships livestreams.

The Recruiter isn’t the only one who benefits from this special relationship. So, [b]what do Recruits get?[/b]

notes.title: Divisions in World of Warships: Play with Friends
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/37c2ec0b407e82ce06d24b8263478a60f3e19163.jpg[/img]
[b]Well-coordinated actions are especially important when it comes to team play. World of Warships is a game that encourages players to coordinate their actions with those of their allies to secure victories in battle. But is this possible in a team composed of random players? If you doubt it, there's a solution—create a Division![/b]

Divisions allow two or three players to join together and fight in battle. You can play with your friends and cover one another like partners do in your favorite action movies, try different combat tactics, have lots of fun, and generally enjoy the game together. If you don't have any friends in the game yet, Divisions will help you find some. You just have to take the first step, or in this case—simply click a couple of buttons!

[table][tr][th][b][url=#how-to-create-a-division]How to Create a Division[/url]
[url=#communicating-in-a-division]Communicating in a Division[/url]
[url=#tactics-for-playing-in-a-division]Tactics for Playing in a Division[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=how-to-create-a-division][/h1]How to Create a Division[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Division menu[/b][/h3]
You can find the Division menu in the Port to the left of the [b]Battle![/b] button. By opening it, you'll see a list of your contacts, as well as the nicknames of players who are currently looking for a Division. Click a player's nickname to instantly invite them to your Division. After that, all you need to do is select ships and head into battle. You can also use the "Looking to Join a Division" button in the Division menu. Click it, and your nickname will become visible to other players who will be able to invite you to a Division.

[h3][b]Chat in Port[/b][/h3]
The chat button can be found in the bottom-left corner, under the ship carousel. One of chat channels is specifically dedicated to searching for Divisions. Enter this channel and introduce yourself.

[h3][b]In battle[/b][/h3]
Found a player with admirable skill? Invite them to your Division right in the heat of battle! Press the [b]Tab[/b] key to open the Divisions tab, where you can quickly create a Division or submit a request to join an existing one. Divisions created right in battle are called "dynamic."

[h3][b]External channels[/b][/h3]
To look for Divisions, you can use a special section of our official forum or a separate channel on [b]Discord[/b]. The advantage of this option is that you can be more thorough in choosing your brothers and sisters in arms by communicating with them in advance of banding together.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fbf18288-35a6-11ed-9d9a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Your friends[/b][/h3]
If you have a friend who's eager to play, it's even simpler— just add them to your contacts using a dedicated button in the bottom-left corner of the Port and invite them to your Division by clicking their nickname. If your friend doesn't have a World of Warships account yet, send them a referral link via the Recruiting Station program. By registering with this link, your friend will receive loads of in-game presents, and both of you will obtain rewards for playing together afterwards.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fcef7c1c-35a6-11ed-a42c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=communicating-in-a-division][/h1]Communicating in a Division[/b][/h2]
Not everyone likes communicating in battle. When fighting in a Division, theoretically, you can work together without direct communication and use quick commands instead. But communication is one of key advantages of playing in a Division. It helps improve interaction like nothing else. For this purpose, Division members can use:
[list][*]A separate text chat both in the Port and in battle.
[*]Internal voice chat.[/list]
In general, you can use any means of communication, including [b]Discord[/b] (vacant rooms are always readily available on our server).
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=tactics-for-playing-in-a-division][/h1]Tactics for Playing in a Division[/b][/h2]
We've already made a passing mention of the wide variety of tactics that you can use in battle as one of main advantages of playing in a Division. These are not just mere words. There's straight logic here—each ship type in World of Warships has its weak spot. But a reliable ally will help you keep it protected, and you'll form a versatile power. In a Division, you can apply this tactic in every battle.
[list][*][i]A cruiser + a destroyer with Smoke Generator[/i]. In this tandem, the destroyer's smoke will provide cover for the cruiser while she delivers targeted artillery salvos to strike opposing ships spotted by the destroyer.
[*][i]A destroyer + a battleship[/i]. Enemy targets are spotted by the destroyer, and crushing artillery fire is delivered to them from the battleship's guns. The same applies to cooperation between a battleship and an aircraft carrier. The latter is generally perfect at conducting reconnaissance; the former can deliver the sinking blow.
[*][i]An aircraft carrier + a destroyer[/i]. The aircraft carrier can both perform reconnaissance and cover the destroyer from air attacks. This leaves the destroyer more free to capture Key Areas and cause other problems for the opposing team.
[*][i]A Division of battleships[/i]. This combination allows you to bring devastating concentrated fire to bear on your targets. For spotting purposes, the Division can be enhanced with a destroyer or aircraft carrier.[/list]
[list]These are just a few of the many tactics that you can exploit playing in a Division. Try it for yourself, and you'll find effective combinations that will bring you victory in many battles![/list]

notes.title: Account Transfer has started!
notes.content:
[b]Dear players! [/b]

Now, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/552990/view/6028653879558475801]the transfer procedure[/url] begins! Starting from this date, you can transfer your account data to the EU server* and continue playing via Steam. 

[i]*Check the additional information by clicking on this [url=https://worldofwarships.ru/ru/news/general-news/account-transfer-start/]link[/url].  [/i]
 
[h2]Transfer: General Information [/h2]

This transfer campaign has been designed specifically for CIS realm players in order to give them the opportunity to move their accounts to the EU realm and continue playing World of Warships on Steam. All the other regions remain without any changes (e.g. in terms of this campaign you cannot transfer your account from NA to EU, or from ASIA to NA etc.).  

The transfer allows the player to move their account data from one server to another while retaining purchases, resources, statistics etc. After the transfer, the original account on the CIS server will be blocked and then deleted in 59 days. During this time period, every transferred player has [b]a one-time opportunity to change their decision[/b].  

The transfer procedure is available for [b]all players that have an account on the CIS realm[/b].  

In order to use the transfer option, you need to have [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/4174225702959905780?snr=1_2108_9__2107]an email address and password added to your World of Warships account[/url][/b].  

We fully understand that this decision might not be an easy one and you might have a lot of extra questions about the transfer. We will try our best to cover as much information as possible in this article. Let’s dive into the details!

[h2]Transfer: Frequently Asked Questions [/h2] 
 
[olist]
[*] [b]Q: How do I prepare for the transfer?[/b]
A: Generally, you don’t need to do anything, but you can make a couple of actions beforehand to make sure that everything goes smoothly: 
[list][*] Check if you have completed the account registration. If not, make sure to add an email and a password to your account. 
[*] Check if you have another account on EU registered using the same Steam account. If yes, then you will need to unbind it from your Steam ID.[/list]
[*] [b]Q: What will happen to my progress and in-game property when I transfer to the EU server?[/b]
A: All your in-game items are transferred to the new EU account, with the exception of cruiser Bagration and its permanent camouflage. Your game statistics may be partially unavailable for certain time periods. All progress made on your account up to the point the decision to transfer your account is taken will be preserved. 

[*] [b]Q: Once transferred, can I go back to the RU Server?[/b]
A: If you transferred your account to the EU region and then changed your mind, you will have 59 days to decide to return to the RU region. The process includes the following steps: 14 days after a successful account transfer to the EU region, an account in the CIS region will be automatically marked for deletion. Account deletion will take place 45 days from the date the deletion request was made. After a CIS region account is deleted, a return to the RU region is no longer possible. That is, you will have 59 days to change your mind and cancel the removal request, and then remove the restrictions on the game through the CPC. The request for deletion can be canceled by the player themself in the Account page. 

[*] [b]Q: Will I be able to make purchases/payments? If so, what will the prices be like?[/b]
A: For players from the Russian Federation or the Republic of Belarus, after the transfer to the EU region, payment in the Premium Shop will not be available (from the date the account transfer procedure is opened). The exception is the case of changing the country of the account if there are grounds for this. 
For players not from the Russian Federation or the Republic of Belarus, after the transfer of the account to the EU region, all payment methods will be available as normal. The pricing approach will be similar to that in the CIS region. 

[*] [b]Q: What will happen to my nickname?[/b]
A: Your EU account is assigned a nickname according to the following rules: if the your former nickname on the CIS server is not taken in the EU region, it will be transferred as is. If it is being used by a previously-existing account on EU, the system will generate a placeholder nickname and you will be given the ability to change it for free. 

[*] [b]Q: What will happen to my clan? [/b]
A: If you were a clan commander in the CIS region, then a new clan will be automatically created for you in the EU region. If the clan’s name or tag is already in use in the EU region, the clan will be assigned a random name and tag, which you can change for free. Clan buildings, oil and treasury will be transferred, but not all clan achievements will be. You will be able to distribute resources from the treasury 14 days after the successful account transfer. The clan in the CIS region will be disbanded and its name and tag will be blocked from use by other players for 30 days. 

[*] [b]Q: Will my ping change after moving to the EU region? [/b]
A: This depends on the individual in question’s ISP and physical location. In some cases, ping may improve, in others it may deteriorate significantly. For players from Ukraine specifically, the connection should be more comfortable on the EU server. 
[/olist]

We hope that this article will be useful for everyone who wants to learn more about the transfer before making a decision. We understand that this is a big change for our players, and we will do everything we can to make sure that your gaming experience on a new realm will be enjoyable and fun! 

Hope to see you on EU soon!

notes.title: Unsinkable Sam
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e139c9c4314db3b79c19d3bda7919434233c7394.jpg[/img]
[b]Unsinkable Sam is one of the most famous cats in the navy and a favorite of our Captains.[/b]

This remarkable cat managed to survive the demise of three ships—German battleship Bismarck, British destroyer Cossack, and aircraft carrier Ark Royal. We suggest delving into his story!

[table][tr][th][b][url=#cats-have-nine-lives]Cats Have Nine Lives[/url]
[url=#unsinkable-sam]Unsinkable Sam[/url]
[url=#premium-containers]Premium Containers[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=idKSwn5UiIs;full][/previewyoutube] [hr][/hr]

To do so, you'll need to secure damage upon your spotting, earn various ribbons and XP with all modifiers applied, deal damage to enemies using main battery guns, and win battles.
[list][i]You can complete the combat mission chain playing Tier V–X ships and superships in Random, Ranked, and Co-op Battles, as well as in Operations and Brawls.[/i][/list]
[list]Complete seven 7-day challenge combat missions to receive [b]an extra[/b] Unsinkable Sam container.[/list] [hr][/hr]

notes.title: Public Test of Update 0.11.9: Round 1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38188069/1e16ea670055ebff5ca8b6f3860499f92bdd6664.jpg[/img]
[b]Captains![/b]

Joining the Public Test is a great way to earn containers with Premium ships, permanent and expendable camouflages, and other valuable items. All details on how to join the Public Test are available on a [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/pt-guide/]dedicated page[/url] of the official website.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2716184589232191867
Update 0.11.9 brings U.S. and German submarines to Early Access; Operation Wolfpack; Halloween celebrations; and other new features. Check out the [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/bulletin-0119/]Developer Bulletin[/url], and welcome to the Test! See you on the PT Server!
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/6028653879545055813
[url=https://forum.worldofwarships.eu/forum/485-public-test/ style=button]Leave Feedback[/url]

[h2]Round 1 Schedule[/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Thu. 15 Sep. 18:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Tue. 20 Sep. 07:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[h2]Combat Missions and Rewards[/h2]
You can earn Community Tokens by progressing through combat missions on the Public Test Server. Exchange these Tokens for various rewards in the Armory, including rare permanent camouflages, containers, and other in-game items.

With the start of the Public Test, you’ll have the following items credited to your PT account: U.S. and German Tier VI, VIII, and X submarines, as well as ships for the Twilight Battle and Operations Saving Transylvania and Sunray in the Darkness.

[list][i]The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/i][/list]

[list][i]The combat mission chain can be completed in Random Battles or Operations and is available for completion three times per day at the following times: 11:00–15:00 UTC; 17:00–21:00 UTC; and 23:00–03:00 UTC. You can complete the mission all three times and obtain the rewards three times during the day.[/i][/list]

[h2]Starting Bonuses[/h2]
[list][*]The research prices for ships and ship modules will be substantially discounted.
[*]You will be able to reset Commander skills free of charge.[/list]
If you're joining the Public Test for the first time since Update 0.11.8, you'll be awarded the following additional bonuses:
[list][*]At the start of the Public Test, every participant will have all researchable Tier VI and VIII ships, helmed by Commanders with 19 skill points, credited to their PT accounts.
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]500,000,000[/b] Credits; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]30,000[/b] Doubloons; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]250,000[/b] Coal; and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]90 days of Warships Premium Account[/b].
[*]Sets with expendable economic bonuses and 50 combat signals.[/list]
[list]If you played at least one battle on the Public Test Server during the 0.11.8 Public Test, your account will be copied from the Live Server to the Public Test Server.[/list]

notes.title: Developer Bulletin for Update 0.11.9
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/65f0d999cae1abdb52333471d0f6123bf53c6219.jpg[/img]
[list][b][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.[/b][/list]
[list][i]Please note: The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/i][/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#early-access-to-submarines]Early Access to U.S. and German Submarines[/url]
[url=#personal-challenges]Personal Challenges[/url]
[url=#operation-wolfpack]Operation Wolfpack[/url]
[url=#technical-updates]Technical Updates[/url]
[url=#halloween]Halloween[/url]
[url=#other-changes]Other Changes[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=early-access-to-submarines][/h1]Early Access to U.S. and German Submarines[/b][/h2]
We are pleased to introduce a new ship type—submarines! We worked hard to prepare submarines for their eventual release during their time in testing. We've tweaked their mechanics and the ways they interact with other ship types based on the test results, statistics, and player feedback.

Following the latest round of changes to this ship type, we're confident that submarines in their current state fit well into the gameplay of World of Warships and are ready to be introduced into the game on a permanent basis. U.S. and German submarines will be the first full-fledged representatives to emerge (or submerge!) in the game.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cedb1ae8-329f-11ed-9f00-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cee6857c-329f-11ed-bd80-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cedec652-329f-11ed-a759-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cee40bf8-329f-11ed-9a9a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]Early Access[/h2]
German and U.S. Tier VI and VIII submarines will arrive in Early Access. They can be obtained from sequential bundles in the Armory in exchange for [b]Submarine Tokens[/b].

The Tokens can be obtained by completing Personal Challenges that await you in Update 0.11.9; in exchange for Community Tokens; and from random bundles for Doubloons.

Submarines can also be obtained from the new Submarines containers.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/86c1cd88-32a4-11ed-aed8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list]You'll be able to reset all of your Commanders' skills if you so wish and remove upgrades free of charge during the first 2 weeks after Update 0.11.9 goes live. To automatically reset skills of all your Commanders for free, you'll need to click a button in a special article on our website.[/list]
For several updates after the release of Update 0.11.9, we don't plan to make significant changes to the gameplay of submarines, their settings, and the way they interact with other ship types, unless there is a critical need to do so. This will allow them to catch on in the game and give players an opportunity to acclimatize to the new ship type. In the meantime, we'll be able to collect the most up-to-date and accurate statistics. At the same time, small balance changes will still be made when necessary.
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=personal-challenges][/h1]Personal Challenges[/b][/h2]
Personal Challenges will become available again during Update 0.11.9. For this iteration, we've updated the interface, as well as diversified the mission completion criteria.

As before, Personal Challenges are divided into two stages of 2 weeks each. During the first stage, you need to earn ribbons; during the second stage, you need to earn Base XP. In future iterations, new conditions will be added, such as damage dealt.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/97f27d52-32ac-11ed-ad45-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/96d4c038-32ac-11ed-874d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list]As a reward for completing missions, you'll earn Submarine Tokens, which are required to obtain submarines in Early Access, as well as Coal.[/list] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=operation-wolfpack][/h1]Operation Wolfpack[/b][/h2]
Special Operation Wolfpack is dedicated to the release of submarines. It will allow players to get to grips with the new ship type and its gameplay.

The Operation is inspired by real World War II events—submarines hunting for convoys.

[h2]Rules[/h2]
Players fight at the helms of Tier VI and VIII submarines in a team of seven.

An enemy convoy with strategic cargo breaks through neutral waters. A combat squadron rushes to help the convoy.

[b]Your objective[/b] is to break through the lines of escorting warship groups and destroy the transport ships before they reach their destination point and meet with reinforcements. During the Operation, the submarine squadron will be provided with air support from allied aircraft.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3a0749a-32ac-11ed-b68b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3cb9abc-32ac-11ed-90be-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3b432d2-32ac-11ed-8fe0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=technical-updates][/h1]Technical Updates[/b][/h2]
We've returned the movement effect of sonar pings emitted by submarines. It was good at drawing the attention of both the targeted player and their allies to the attacking submarine. Combined with the ping launch effect that appears on the surface of the water, it will allow you to locate a submarine more accurately and attack her more effectively.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6fca6dc8-32a5-11ed-aed8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Added new ribbons for depth charges. They will more clearly show the effectiveness of dropping bombs on submarines:
[table][tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/36e2dbfa-32a3-11ed-aed8-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td]The "Hit" ribbon is awarded when a submarine receives full damage from a depth charge.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/37048c5a-32a3-11ed-a3f6-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td]The "Splash Damage" ribbon is awarded when a submarine receives partial damage from a depth charge.[/td][/tr][/table]
[h2]Adding Automatic ASW for Aircraft Carriers[/h2]
All aircraft carriers of Tier VI and above will receive a variant of Depth Charge Airstrike that functions automatically. It will not serve as a tool for hunting submarines; it will only give aircraft carriers a means of defense against submarines that deploys even when the ship's Captain is controlling squadrons.

Depth Charge Airstrike will activate if a submarine or signs of her presence, such as oil spots on the water or the effect of using sonar, are detected within the armament's range. An airstrike will be carried out taking any necessary lead into account. At the same time, the submarine will have the opportunity to evade if she effectively maneuvers in time.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c967a6fc-32a5-11ed-9729-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=halloween][/h1]Halloween[/b][/h2]
Operations Saving Transylvania and Sunray in the Darkness await players this year as part of the Halloween celebrations.

Operation Saving Transylvania will be available as Operation of the Week in the first week of the update; Sunray in the Darkness—in the second week. Players will be able to complete them as part of a Division throughout Update 0.11.9. Both Operations will be available at the normal difficulty level. Standard Operations will be available for completion during Update 0.11.9 as part of a Division only. With the release of Update 0.11.10, Operations of the Week will be replaced by Random Operations again.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/554d8632-32a6-11ed-9729-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/55526044-32a6-11ed-af91-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/94b7c224-32a6-11ed-8d29-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
The update also brings back the Twilight Battle temporary battle type, which is familiar to players from Halloween 2018, with minor visual improvements. Let's take a refresher on the key rules of this event!

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/29d3e35c-32a6-11ed-87c3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/29db1d02-32a6-11ed-bd80-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2a2b47dc-32a6-11ed-8c0b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
Two teams of seven players each clash against each other playing special ships on the map from Operation Sunray in the Darkness. The [b]key objective[/b] is to destroy all enemy ships. At the same time, the water area is gradually taken over by the Filth, and the safe zone for ships continuously shrinks. Ships outside the safe zone receive damage depending on the ship type.

[list][i]Twilight Battle will become available 2 weeks after Update 0.11.9 goes live.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=other-changes][/h1]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
[h2]Changes to Commanders, skills, and upgrades[/h2]
A number of unique Commander talents, skills, and upgrades have been updated to bring them to a better balance and increase their versatility. More details are available on our [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/367]Development Blog[/url].

We've also made improvements to the interface of the Commander Skills screen and Skills in Detail section. It's now possible in the Reserve to view the available Commanders of all nations, regardless of whether Captains have ships of those nations or not.
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-ru.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e6f17136-32a9-11ed-a6d6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-ru.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e6c6551e-32a9-11ed-b06b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-ru.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e6dde62a-32a9-11ed-874d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]

notes.title: Waterline: Development Plan Updates – Fall 2022
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/97754cd023acddbecf394417a1efafd4c7dc34df.jpg[/img]
[b]Captains![/b]

In today's Waterline episode, we're going to recall the new features that have been released since the previous episode and tell you about the game development plans for late 2022 — early 2023.
[list][i]Please note that all of the information contained in this document is preliminary. Any changes and new features that we announce may change several times during tests. During each of those testing rounds, we'll carefully consider your feedback and opinions. Now, let's get down to the details! To reveal the information, click on the respective blocks.[/i][/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#whats-already-done]What's Already Done[/url]
[url=#fall-2022]Fall 2022[/url]
[url=#winter-2022-23]Winter 2022/23[/url]
[url=#2023]2023[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=uzk2POuzqOE;full][/previewyoutube] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=whats-already-done][/h1]What's Already Done[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ca3ca31a-2ef5-11ed-b5fc-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

[h2]Ships[/h2]
[h3][b]Large French Cruisers[/b][/h3]
The main feature of the new ships is their large-caliber guns (relative to the ship type) mounted on their bows. While they reload slowly, this is compensated for by the Main Battery Reload Booster consumable. The new ships are capable of achieving high speeds with the help of the improved "French-specific" Engine Boost consumable. The ships' armor does a great job in protecting their citadels against medium-caliber AP shells, but the cruisers are quite vulnerable against HE and SAP shells. Medium and long ranges are optimal for engagements, but with the help of the improved accuracy of their 139 mm secondary battery guns, the new ships can also show their worth in close-range encounters.

[list][i]New ships: [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] Cherbourg[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]IX[/b] Brest[/b][/b], and [b] [b][b]X[/b] Marseille[/b][/b].[/i][/list]

[h3][b]British Battleships[/b][/h3]
A new branch of British battleships was added to the game in the summer. Equipped with torpedoes and main guns that don't have a particularly long range of fire, the new sea giants will show their worth at medium- to knife-duel distances. The Repair Party consumable they have on board can regenerate a significant amount of any lost HP.

The battleships carry HE shells with a standard penetration capacity, and the AP shells they fire have a typically British short fuse time. They are also less likely to cause overpenetration and are, therefore, more efficient against lightly armored targets. The guns have a solid caliber—up to 457 mm at Tier X. Starting from Tier V, the ships are equipped with Engine Boost; from Tier VI—with Defensive AA Fire; and from Tier IX, Repair Party is replaced with Specialized Repair Teams.

[list][i]New ships: [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img]
