St. Vincent[/b][/b].[/i][/list]

[h3][b]Superships[/b][/h3]
The supership flotilla is expanded with [b] [b][b]★[/b] Patrie[/b][/b] and [b] [b][b]★[/b] Edgar[/b][/b], which arrived in Early Access.

[b] [b][b]★[/b] Patrie[/b][/b] is a battleship armed with twelve 431 mm main battery guns. The ship's AA defenses comprise systems designed in the 1950s.

[b] [b][b]★[/b] Edgar[/b][/b] is a further development of the Minotaur-class cruiser project with an increased number of main battery guns, as well as more advanced and effective anti-submarine and AA weaponry that was developed in the 1950s and 1960s.

[h2]In-Game Events[/h2]
[h3][b]Updated Convoy[/b][/h3]
Update 0.11.5 saw the return of the Convoy temporary battle type. We made a number of changes to Convoy in its new iteration. The battle format was reworked. Aircraft carriers, destroyers, cruisers, battleships, and submarines were allowed to participate. There were more maps with various routes on them. We also updated the interface and tactical tips in battle.

[h3][b]New Team Competition[/b][/h3]
Along with the release of the new British battleship branch into Early Access, a new event started that was dedicated to the shipbuilders of foggy Albion. The [b]Chatham[/b], [b]Elswick[/b], and [b]Clydebank[/b] shipyards competed for the right to be called the best shipbuilder serving the needs of the Royal Navy. Players made their choices and supported one of the shipyards, earning valuable themed rewards along the way.

[h3][b]Web Campaigns[/b][/h3]
Our game has featured two web campaigns since the previous Waterline episode.

The first one was dedicated to the Pacific War. During this event, USS [b] [b][b]IX[/b] Black[/b][/b] returned to the game and subsequently became available in the Armory in exchange for Coal.

The second campaign brought us onboard a ship uncovering the secrets of the mysterious Navigators. One of the main new features in the Armory during this event was [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] Hampshire[/b][/b] with a themed camouflage and Commander.

[h3][b]Anniversary[/b][/h3]
Right now, we're celebrating the 7th Anniversary of World of Warships. Open the Treasure Map elements and participate in the draw of an all-inclusive seven-day cruise for two! All of the details are available [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/sales-and-events/wows-anniversary-2022/]here[/url].

You can also enjoy battle performance bonuses. For performing well in battle, you can now receive several rewards and pick up rewards for ships in your Port even without playing them.

The Warship Strike minigame and a new collection are now available in the game.

[h3][b]Dockyard[/b][/h3]
[b] [b][b]X[/b] Puerto Rico[/b][/b] is back in the World of Warships' virtual Dockyard. One of the Dockyard's free rewards is [b] [b][b]VII[/b] Huron[/b][/b].

[h2]New Map and Other Enhancements[/h2]
[h3][b]Faroe Islands[/b][/h3]
The Faroe Islands map was added to the game. The appearance of this map was selected by players at the end of last year.

[h3][b]Arms Race[/b][/h3]
We are in a never-ending search for new modes that could be added to Random Battles. The Arms Race mode played well during several temporary events and even a whole Ranked Battles season, and players loved it. That's why we decided to add it to Random Battles on a permanent basis, and it replaced Epicenter there.
[h3][b]Reworked Operations[/b][/h3]
In Update 0.11.8, we reworked all Operations in our game for players to have the opportunity to take part in Operations playing more of their favorite ships and earning valuable rewards along the way.

Now, Tier VI to VIII ships can be matched in battle at the same time, and the final team lineup has an effect on the strength of the bots and post-battle earnings. Besides this, the 30-minute restriction for re-entry into battle playing the same ship was removed.

The Operations economy changed as well. Previously, players earned Stars for completing an Operation, and the rewards could only be obtained once. We removed Stars altogether, and the rewards can now be earned by progressing through dedicated daily and weekly combat missions specifically designed for Operations. As rewards for completing these missions, players can earn Community Tokens and even a Supercontainer, and completing secondary missions in successful Operations brings more Credits and XP.

We also decided to try out a new approach and improve the diversity of Operations for players who participate in them regularly. In Update 0.11.8, Operation of the Week is replaced with random Operations with automatic ally selection. The option to select an Operation of players' liking is still available when they are part of a Division.

[list]The following three Operations are back for the revamped game mode: The Ultimate Frontier, Hermes, and Cherry Blossom.[/list]
[h3][b]Battle Camera[/b][/h3]
We introduced a number of changes to the battle camera in the summer to make it more convenient for all players. We also implemented additional settings to help customize the camera.
[list][*]We changed the default base viewing angle in the Port and in battle. The camera is now focused more directly on the player's ship.
[*]Aiming when using Spotting Aircraft was changed. To make it more comfortable, we now offer two camera positions to choose from: lower and upper.
[*]New "Field of view" and "Camera height" settings were added, allowing players to raise and move the camera away from the ship.
[*]The camera viewing angle in the torpedo launcher view is now similar to that in the main battery view. Transitioning between them is now smoother. The torpedo launcher viewing angle was expanded to make it easier to assess the battle situation.
[*]The camera now moves more smoothly when tracking flying shells. Shell models were also updated.[/list]
[h3][b]Other Changes[/b][/h3]
We improved AI for bots in Training and Co-op Battles and updated the Minimap and quick commands. On the barge, we implemented the option to view and open any available containers. New descriptions of ship features were added in the Armory. We also introduced many other improvements.
[h2][b][h1=fall-2022][/h1]Fall 2022[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/411e6a28-2ecd-11ed-9a2a-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

[h3][b]Submarines in Early Access[/b][/h3]
Since submarines arrived in testing, we've checked various concepts and looked for unique gameplay for this ship type. Almost all elements of submarine gameplay have undergone significant changes during closed and open tests. The dive capacity system was completely reworked, most surface ships were equipped with anti-submarine weapons, alternative torpedoes were added, and some submarines even received controllable guns. Interaction between surface ships and submarines, as well as between submarines, also changed.

We started testing submarines in Random Battles last year. It was a big step and crucially important for our game. Development reached its final stage where we started polishing mechanics, fixing problems, and fine-tuning submarines to bring them to the final shape in which they would be introduced into the game.

Over recent months, we've implemented lots of fixes and improvements based on your feedback.
[list][*]We reworked the submarine matchmaker and combined their queue with that of the destroyers.
[*]We updated the visual and audio effects for sonar pings
[*]and split Hydrophone into two separate consumables.
[*]We reduced the submarine speed under water and added dispersion for torpedo tubes, which made it harder for submarines to carry out sudden attacks from a short distance.[/list]
[list][i]You can read about these and other changes in our [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/]Development Blog[/url].[/i][/list]
We're now sure that submarines in their current state fit well into the World of Warships gameplay and are ready for the next step—their full release in the game.

So, we announce that Update 0.11.9 will bring Early Access to this ship type. From the start, players will be able to get Early Access to U.S. and German submarines, and U.S.S.R. submarines will be added in spring 2023. Besides this, British submarines Undine, Sturdy, and Thrasher will be put to the test in the fall.
[list]For two weeks following the arrival of submarines in Early Access, players will have the possibility to reset skills and demount upgrades for free. Also, there will be a button on the website for resetting skills for all Commanders.[/list]
Many of you welcomed submarines in Convoy and asked us to add a separate mode for this ship type. To celebrate the arrival of submarines in Early Access, we'll release a new Operation, especially for the new ship type. The Operation is inspired by real World War II events—submarines hunting for convoys. The new Operation will help both new and experienced Captains become familiar with the new ship type as well as its gameplay features.

[h3][b]Japanese Cruisers[/b][/h3]
Just recently, the testing of a new branch of Japanese cruisers has started.

These ships perform best in medium and long-range encounters. They boast a good firing range, carry a significant number of main guns, and are equipped with long-range torpedoes that can inflict decent damage. These cruisers enjoy good concealment, which helps them escape encounters or, when necessary, sneak up on enemy ships to strike first.
[list][i]New ships: [b] [b][b]V[/b] Agano[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]VI[/b] Gokase[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]VII[/b] Omono[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] Shimanto[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]IX[/b] Takahashi[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]X[/b] Yodo[/b][/b], and [b] [b][b]VII[/b] Tokachi[/b][/b].[/i][/list]

[list][*]Tier V and VI ships received 152 mm main battery guns, Tier VII ship is armed with 155 mm guns, and high-tier cruisers carry numerous dual-purpose 150 mm guns.
[*]All cruisers have powerful, long-range, but slow, 610 mm torpedoes.
[*]Torpedo tubes of Tier VII and higher cruisers have turning mechanics, previously presented on new British battleships. Torpedoes can be launched at angles to which torpedo tubes are physically unable to turn. Right after launch, the torpedoes turn to the selected direction and follow a straight line to the set course.
[*]Starting with Tier VI, Hydroacoustic Search or Defensive AA Fire is available in one slot, and Fighter is available in a separate slot.
[*]Tier IX–X cruisers have access to the Repair Party consumable.[/list]
[h3][b]New Superships[/b][/h3]
[b] [b][b]★[/b] Patrie[/b][/b] and [b] [b][b]★[/b] Edgar[/b][/b] will leave Early Access very soon. [b] [b][b]★[/b] Dalarna[/b][/b] and [b] [b][b]★[/b] Clausewitz[/b][/b], that you're probably already familiar with, will join them in a while. Two new ships, [b] [b][b]★[/b] Sekiryu[/b][/b] and [b] [b][b]★[/b] Admiral Ushakov[/b][/b] were put to the test in Update 0.11.8.

[b] [b][b]★[/b] Dalarna[/b][/b] is a classic representative of the European destroyer branch with powerful torpedo armament, strong AA defenses, lack of smokescreens, and decent main battery armament that enables fighting back at the enemy in an artillery duel. The main difference between the super destroyer and her predecessor, [b] [b][b]X[/b] Halland[/b][/b], is an additional main battery turret. Besides this, Dalarna can use two types of torpedoes in battle. Her consumables comprise Engine Boost, Repair Party, and Defensive AA Fire.

[b] [b][b]★[/b] Clausewitz[/b][/b] is a heavy cruiser designed for long-distance raids and featuring twelve 210 mm guns and powerful anti-aircraft and torpedo armament. From a gameplay perspective, Clausewitz is a development of Tier X cruiser [b] [b][b]X[/b] Hindenburg[/b][/b]. She has more HP, better armor protection, higher firepower, and more torpedoes. Notably, Clausewitz doesn't have any unique mechanics, which is compensated for by the significant enhancement of her characteristics compared to Hindenburg.

[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.png[/img][b][b]★[/b] Sekiryu[/b][/b] is a super aircraft carrier representing a further development of the Taiho class. She significantly surpasses her predecessor in terms of dimensions, hangar capacity, and AA defense power. The project is reinforced with tactical jet squadrons and continues the branch in the Tech Tree next to [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_9f372d47b4fa5b5bbd79a3aaac816cb8d5343fa93949cce8934d94b84751b88e.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Hakuryū[/b][/b]. The main feature of her squadrons is the high maximum aircraft speed that allows them to quickly cover substantial distances and carry out lightning-fast attacks against enemy ships.

[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b][b]★[/b] Admiral Ushakov[/b][/b] is a large ship with a full displacement of over 100,000 tons, one of the draft designs for a post-war battleship (Project 24) carrying nine 457 mm guns as the main battery. In the Tech Tree, she follows Kremlin and inherits the key features of her predecessor. A large HP pool and strong armor protection have an impact on the ship's maneuverability. The ship boasts good main gun accuracy at short distances and carries numerous secondary battery mounts. Carrying out successful adjustment fire activates Combat Instructions—an alternative firing mode that provides a temporary boost in battle.

[h3][b]Halloween[/b][/h3]
Traditional Halloween celebrations await players this fall, bringing back Operations Sunray in the Darkness and Saving Transylvania. Besides this, temporary themed Twilight Battle mode will be available.

[h3][b]Cross-Realm[/b][/h3]
This fall, we're going to conduct large-scale testing of the cross-realm matchmaker technology that enables players from different regions to fight together in one battle. Implementation of a technology like this involves a number of difficulties and risks, and we'll only use it in matchmaker for new players at first. As it happens, the problem with quickly assembling teams is the most pressing for this player cohort. The number of newcomers playing at the same time is frequently not enough to assemble proper teams, and they have to fight battles with lots of bots.

The specific character of matchmaker for newcomers will allow us to quickly and efficiently test the new feature and resolve potential technical issues. If the experiment is successful, we'll consider the possibility of implementing this technology into other modes and battle types, where needed.

[h3][b]Black Friday[/b][/h3]
In the fall, the traditional Black Friday event will return. You can expect lots of tempting offers and new Black ships. We're ready to share the list of these new ships with you today:
[list][*]Napoli B
[*]Kearsarge B
[*]Mainz B
[*]Chkalov B
[*]Shinonome B[/list]
[h3][b]Interface Changes[/b][/h3]
We plan to introduce a number of improvements to the Commander interface. For example, we'll add filters and a possibility to view Commanders in reserve. We'll also rework tooltips.
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=winter-2022-23][/h1]Winter 2022/23[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/a4d9cb20-2ef5-11ed-bc44-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

[h3][b]New Map[/b][/h3]
We're currently working on a new Seychelles map. The peculiar feature of the map is that the shape and location of the islands on it are modelled after a real-world cluster of islands. This is a new experience for us because in-game mechanics and balance should be adjusted specifically to the peculiar feature of the map without making any significant changes to its geometry. We're experimenting with the starting locations of teams and key areas to make the map as balanced as possible.

[h3][b]New Year Celebrations[/b][/h3]
Long and bright New Year celebrations await us this year. We'd prefer not to reveal all of the secrets now, but here is a sneak peek at the planned activities. You can expect Snowflakes (battle performance bonuses), gifts, and a range of special events, including the celebratory Dockyard.

The Dockyard will feature [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Admiral Schröder[/b][/b] as the main reward and Renown'44 as an interim reward. Renown is currently present in our game as part of the newest British battleship branch. However, many of you have pointed out that you'd like to see this ship as she was in 1944, with modernized AA defenses and secondary armament. We decided to add such a version to the game and make it a free reward available to all players.

[h3][b]Map Updates[/b][/h3]
Last year, we updated the game graphics and introduced HD versions of a number of maps. Next year, we'll keep adding new maps and update the already available ones. For now, we plan to update the following maps: Mountain Range, Strait, North, Northern Lights, Estuary, Shatter, Neighbors, New Dawn, Polar, Islands, and Land of Fire.

[h3][b]Lunar New Year[/b][/h3]
Traditionally, Lunar New Year is celebrated after New Year. You can expect themed content and activities. We'll prepare a new collection and a unique Pan-Asian Commander. The Commander will have personalizations and talents, just like Commanders from other nations.

[h3][b]Dirigible Derby: Round 2[/b][/h3]
At the beginning of this year, we presented a new temporary mode—Dirigible Derby—where each of the teams is tasked with escorting their allied dirigible to the destination point and trying to prevent the opposing team from accomplishing the same goal. In winter, the mode will be back with a number of improvements.

During its first appearance in the game, Dirigible Derby became one of the most popular temporary battle types and received great feedback from players.

It's no secret that we regularly test new mechanics in temporary modes with a view to adding them into the game on a permanent basis. Dirigible Derby is just such a case. You often ask us to add new modes to the main battle types. So, if the reworked version of the mode proves to be well received, Dirigible Derby can be the main candidate for introduction into Random Battles in the future.

[h3][b]Other Improvements[/b][/h3]
We plan a number of technical improvements for the end of this year.

The game Settings menu will be updated. We're going to change the interface design to make it more convenient. Settings will be stored on the server, and we'll be able to easily add new settings when necessary, thanks to "under-the-bonnet" improvements.

Notification for players in the Port will be updated. We plan a number of improvements to make them more structured and informative.
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=2023][/h1]2023[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/41182136-2ecd-11ed-a0f3-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

[h2]Bounty Hunting[/h2]
We frequently hold special in-game activities where players need to spot one of our volunteers and contributors in battle and sink them to earn a valuable prize. Such events will be officially supported in the game client in the future. The "hunt" targets will be specifically indicated in the game.

[h2]Collective Combat Missions[/h2]
Collective combat missions are missions with special conditions that require the joint effort of the entire server to be completed. They will be completed as usual combat missions but will be common for all players. Each participant will make a contribution to the overall completion progress. If players manage to complete a collective combat mission, each player who took an active part in the process will receive their reward.

[h2]Achievements[/h2]
We're working on new achievements to be added to the game, including achievements for different game modes (e.g., Clan and Co-op Battles). This will allow the gameplay to be additionally diversified and highlight players' progress in the game.

[h2]New Ships[/h2]
[h3][b]U.S. Hybrid Battleships[/b][/h3]
A branch of U.S. hybrid battleships awaits players in the winter. Three new ships—Nebraska, Delaware, and Louisiana—are in development. We can safely say that they will be armed with 406 mm guns. The hulls for these ships are designed based on the battleship branch headed by Montana, and the primary unique feature of the new ships will be the ability to launch squadrons similar to aircraft carriers and other hybrid ships.

[h3][b]European Destroyers[/b][/h3]
Another branch of European destroyers will be introduced next year. It will bring in representatives of several European countries, such as Poland, Norway, Turkey, and Greece. These will be Tier V–X destroyers with powerful artillery armament having a caliber of up to 140 mm.

[list]We'll keep releasing special videos of the Waterline series once per quarter! We'll share new information and our plans for the upcoming 6 months with you, as well as explain why we make any changes to the already announced plans. Stay tuned![/list]
[i]World of Warships Team[/i]

notes.title: Apply a Tag—Get 1 Day of Warships Premium Account
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8f8d3b9c0582cb7d06a3856dd53bc852767abfdd.jpg[/img]

Captains!

What part of World of Warships captivates you most? Is it the global multiplayer environment? The gritty naval setting? Or is it perhaps the realistic ship models? Tell us what draws you to the game by applying tags here on Steam, and we'll grant you [b]a full day of Warships Premium Account[/b]!

[h2]How to take part:[/h2]
[olist][*]Find the "Popular user-defined tags for this product" section on the right-hand side of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/552990/World_of_Warships/?tags]the main page[/url] of the game.
[*]Click the "+" symbol.
[*]Select a tag (or create your own) that’s applicable to World of Warships. To select an existing tag from the list, click the "+" symbol next to the tag of your choice.
[*]Share your list of tags in the comments of this news item.[/olist]
Voilà! Your Warships Premium Account will be activated precisely 7 days later.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/552990/World_of_Warships/?tags][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/552990/extras/Steam_tags.gif?t=1574441033[/img][/url]

[b]Attention![/b] The reward can only be granted once a month per player, regardless of the number of tags applied.

Good luck in battle, Captains!

notes.content:

[b]World of Warships celebrates its Seventh Anniversary! We've come a long way together, and now it's time to celebrate what we've achieved. You can expect festive rewards, a themed collection, and the Warship Strike minigame.[/b]
[list]We've prepared special gifts in the form of Oil supplies for Clans that were created over a year ago. Clans with up to 29 players will receive [b]777[/b] Oil in their treasuries. Clans with 30 or more players will receive [b]7,777[/b] Oil in their treasuries. We will take into account the number of players in the Clan as of September 7, 2022. Gifts will be credited on September 16, 2022.[/list]

[/tr][tr][th][h3]EU[/h3][/th][th][h3][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/sales-and-events/wows-anniversary-2022/#map-wrapper style=button][b]Collect Reward[/b][/url][/h3][/th]
[/tr][tr][th][h3]NA[/h3][/th][th][h3][url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/sales-and-events/wows-anniversary-2022/#map-wrapper style=button][b]Collect Reward[/b][/url][/h3][/th][/tr][/table]

Click on a map element and learn how to open it. Complete combat missions, collect gifts in articles on our website, and find bonus codes in YouTube videos.
[list][*]Some mosaic elements will open as soon as you click on them.
[*]To open other elements, you need to complete combat missions. Click on the related map elements to unlock the combat missions. You can find the conditions and description of the rewards under the Treasure Map tab which will appear in the Combat Missions section in your Port.
[*]Look for bonus codes in videos that will be published on our [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/worldofwarshipscom]YouTube channel[/url] during Update 0.11.8. Enter the codes here to obtain another piece of the mosaic.
[*]Look for our survey in articles on the website during Update 0.11.8. Share your opinion, claim your gift, and unlock a map element.
[*]A timer on a map element indicates the remaining time until the publication of the relevant article or video.[/list]
[list][i]Unlock all 16 elements of the map: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Warships Premium Account[/b] is hidden in the bonus code on the map, while [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]2 days of Warships Premium Account[/b] and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]3,000[/b] Coal can be obtained by clicking a button below the map, which is activated when the last map element is opened.[/i][/list]
[list]The Seventh Anniversary is a special event. Therefore, we will draw a special prize among the winners of the final reward: an all-inclusive seven-day cruise for two! Open the Treasure Map elements and participate in the draw. You can find detailed information about the conditions of this special via [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/document/bd26e23a-2db5-11ed-8afb-ac162d70f4e4.pdf]this link[/url].[/list][hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=battle-performance-bonuses][/h1]Battle Performance Bonuses[/b][/h2]
[list]Battle performance bonuses are available
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]from:[/b] [b]Fri. 16 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]until:[/b] [b]Fri. 14 Oct. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

To mark our Anniversary, we're bringing back bonuses for your performance in battles playing all ships of Tier V and above. Players will now be able to receive several gifts per battle! This change will make it much easier to receive rewards for those who have a large number of ships in their Port.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a3569938-2aa2-11ed-81a9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a3874024-2aa2-11ed-9624-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a2e521d6-2aa2-11ed-a2a9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a2d04784-2aa2-11ed-b640-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a2bf1c7a-2aa2-11ed-85b4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
If you have 100 or more ships, you will be able to receive a standard gift for a battle fought playing a ship, as well as additional gifts for ships in your Port. You cannot receive gifts on the same ship a second time. Additional gifts can be applied to any other ship of Tier V and above to which they have not yet been applied. This way, you will receive a gift for a ship without having to enter battle.

Win a battle or earn Base XP to receive Supercontainers and new containers with economic bonuses.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/40df2e88-2a15-11ed-952c-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
The number of gifts you receive after a battle depends on the number of ships you have in your Port and the amount of Base XP earned in that battle. For example, a player with a port fleet exceeding 300 ships will be able to earn [b]four gifts[/b] in one battle: one gift for entering battle with a ship and three gifts for effective action in battle.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/03b441d8-2e2a-11ed-995e-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=seven-seas-collection][/h1]Seven Seas Collection[/b][/h2]
To celebrate our Seventh Anniversary, we offer you a fresh look at the historical ports in the game. Collect the new festive Seven Seas collection to learn interesting facts about 16 famous ports featured in World of Warships.

Collection elements can only be found in the special Seven Seas containers. In total, you can obtain:
[list][*]Up to 16 containers for completing combat missions
[*]Up to 4 containers for completing a special combat mission for Anhalt
[*]Up to 3 containers in free daily bundles[/list]
The collection consists of four pages, each composed of four elements.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1c926080-2dd6-11ed-93e3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1c90fa6a-2dd6-11ed-b8c9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1c937bb4-2dd6-11ed-b44b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1c90f9d4-2dd6-11ed-92e7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][b]Reward for completing the collection page: [/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Warships Premium Account[/b].
[b]Reward for completing the entire collection: [/b]A bonus package for a Tier VII ship.[/list]
[list][i]The exchange rate for duplicates is 1:1.
After opening 16 containers, you are guaranteed to complete the entire collection.[/i][/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/40ebd4b2-2a15-11ed-95d8-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h3][i][h3][b]Contents of the Seven Seas container[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
The percentage indicates the drop chances of each group of items:
[list][*]Gregale expendable camouflage — 100%
[*]One item from the list below — 100%. Breakdown:
[list][*]3x economic bonuses — Credits +20% — 20%
[*]3x economic bonuses — Ship XP +100% — 20%
[*]3x economic bonuses — Commander XP +100% — 20%
[*]3x economic bonuses — Free XP +300% — 20%
[*][b]1,500[/b] Elite Commander XP — 20%[/list]
[*]One element of the same-name collection — 100%[/list]
[list][i]In a future update, the Seven Seas containers will be added to the Armory and be available in exchange for Coal.[/i][/list]
[h2][b][h1=warship-strike][/h1]Warship Strike[/b][/h2]
The Warship Strike minigame is a new activity that marks the Seventh Anniversary of World of Warships. The game will be available in a special section of the Armory. If you are familiar with the classic version of the game, you will be able to immerse yourself once again in the exciting atmosphere of enemy ships hidden from sight and early shots fired at random. The game is played against an AI opponent.
[list]The minigame will be available:
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]from:[/b] [b]Fri. 16 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]until:[/b] [b]Fri. 14 Oct. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

You can pause ongoing battles at any time and return to them later, and your progress will be saved. Automatic completion of the battle is allowed. In this case, the AI will complete the moves for the player. Battles can also be fought completely automatically.

In Warship Strike, players will be able to earn special rewards—Festive Tokens—awarded according to the following rules:
[list][*]Quick victory in 35 moves or less — 40 Tokens
[*]Winning a battle in 36 moves or more — 20 Tokens
[*]Sinking a ship — 10 Tokens[/list]
You can obtain up to 5,920 Festive Tokens in total:
[list][*]Up to 4,320 Tokens for participating in Warship Strike (maximum possible number of Tokens; each game must end in a quick victory)
[*]Up to 800 Tokens in exchange for Credits
[*]Up to 800 Tokens in exchange for Community Tokens[/list]

notes.title: Your Guide to Reworked Operations
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/76fa0095de2b8933d137868dec05630ee1cb1be8.jpg[/img]
[b]Update 0.11.8 brings in quite a lot of changes to Operations.
[/b]
[list][*]Operation of the Week is now replaced with a randomly offered Operation.
[*]You can enter battle playing Tier VI–VIII ships in any Operation.
[*]The 30-minute restriction for re-entry into battle playing the same ship has been removed.
[*]One-time rewards for earning stars have been replaced with special combat missions.
[*]The following Operations are back in the game: The Ultimate Frontier, Hermes, and Cherry Blossom.[/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#participation-in-operations]Participation in Operations[/url]
[url=#economy-and-rewards]Economy and Rewards in Operations[/url]
[url=#three-operations-are-back]Three Operations Are Back[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/579ac0a8-2aa4-11ed-978a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5818bb48-2aa4-11ed-b573-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/58196d0e-2aa4-11ed-9b24-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/98e49994-2aa4-11ed-b573-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/996b5fd8-2aa4-11ed-9624-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/996908b4-2aa4-11ed-978a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2f510eb4-29ef-11ed-949f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bf030ae8-2aa4-11ed-b573-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bf275010-2aa4-11ed-978a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][b]Please note that you can only play Operations after reaching Level 14 in your Service Record.[/b][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=participation-in-operations][/h1]Participation in Operations[/b][/h2]
Operations in our game has long been a battle type that was not very popular. One-time rewards and restrictions on the choice of ships didn't make them too popular among players. We've done our best to make Operations more diverse in Update 0.11.8.

Now, you can join an Operation playing Tier VI–VIII ships. The final team composition will affect the strength of bots, depending on the ship tiers. This way, you will be able to take part in Operations with even more ships while also advancing along the Tech Tree ship branches.

The 30-minute restriction for re-entry into battle playing the same ship has been removed. Now, you can take up a new Operation at the helm of your favorite ship immediately after the end of the previous one.

We decided to try out a new approach and replace Operation of the Week. An Operation will now drop randomly when playing within a team where allies are matched to battle automatically, making the mode more diverse for those who play it on a regular basis. You will still be able to select an Operation of your liking when part of a Division.

[list]Earnings in a randomly picked Operation will be, on average, 25% higher compared to a hand-picked scenario. It won't matter whether you play solo or in a Division. You will not know what awaits you in battle, so you will receive more resources for its successful completion.[/list]
[list][i]We will closely monitor your feedback and share the details with you.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=economy-and-rewards][/h1]Economy and Rewards in Operations[/b][/h2]
You will now be able to receive valuable rewards in Operations regularly. First of all, we have removed stars. Secondly, completing secondary tasks when successfully completing an Operation will keep bringing you extra Credits and XP. And one-time rewards for earning stars have been replaced with daily and weekly combat missions:
[list][*]Every day, your first victorious battle will bring you 30 Community Tokens
[*]Three combat missions will be available every week. Earn Base XP and get up to 1,300 Community Tokens per week (or up to 5,200 Community Tokens per month)
[*]Completing 8 out of 12 weekly combat missions will reward you with a Supercontainer[/list] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=three-operations-are-back][/h1]Three Operations Are Back[/b][/h2]
With Update 0.11.8, we are bringing back three long absent and highly awaited Operations, increasing the total number of available scenarios to eight. Welcome the return of Operations The Ultimate Frontier, Hermes, and the night-lit Cherry Blossom!

[h2]The Ultimate Frontier[/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/d020427c-2b7c-11ed-ad32-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

The tense situation at sea forced your squadron to disperse forces across two areas. The primary mission is divided into two submissions, during which you will join forces with the second group of ships.

An important project of Japanese scientists and engineers is at stake, requiring evacuation along with classified documents. You will need to escort transport aircraft to the aerodrome while saving at least 45 planes from the aircraft reinforcements.

An important point is the repair base in the center of the map, which can be used to restore the HP of allied ships. You cannot let the foes take that base! Suppose you successfully repel all attacks: At the end of the scenario, you will then be able to switch to attack and sink the enemy aircraft carrier [b]Raptor[/b], familiar to you from other Operations, as well as help allied aircraft destroy the remaining enemies.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e184edaa-2b73-11ed-a87e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e1909204-2b73-11ed-9c6c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e1974ffe-2b73-11ed-a467-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e192b7b4-2b73-11ed-af31-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h3][b]Primary task[/b][/h3]
Protect the group of transport aircraft arriving at the base. Defend the aerodrome until embarkation is finished and the aircraft leave the base.

[h3][b]Secondary tasks[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Save at least 3 forts
[*]Do not let the enemy occupy the repair base
[*]Destroy aircraft carrier [b]Raptor[/b]
[*]Destroy 2 ships attacked by aerodrome squadrons within the allotted time
[*]Save at least 45[b] planes from aircraft reinforcements[/b][/list]
[h2]Hermes[/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/04892998-2b7d-11ed-b09e-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

A squadron of battleships with holds filled with gold is on a raid through the Atlantic to the American shores. You are tasked with the mission to escort the ships to a safe sector while repelling enemy attacks of superior forces. A thunderstorm raging at the expected encounter point makes your mission even more challenging. Harsh weather conditions reduce spotting and detectability ranges, but this can be to your advantage—moving inside the cyclone makes it harder for your ship to be hit due to the increased dispersion of incoming shells.

Once you are halfway to your destination, you will be able to repair the received damage. For 100 seconds, the leading transport ship will be restoring the HP of ships moving in her vicinity.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/08f81ae0-2b76-11ed-8486-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0902dd2c-2b76-11ed-8456-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/08f785d0-2b76-11ed-a87e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/08fe41b8-2b76-11ed-bbd7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h3][b]Primary task[/b][/h3]
Escort the squadron led by flagship [b]Ruan[/b] to the designated sector. Make sure the gold is transported safely.

[h3][b]Secondary tasks[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Destroy 100 enemy aircraft (this task is split into two stages)
[*]Make sure battleship [b]Ruan[/b] retains more than 50% of her HP
[*]Save at least 3 allied battleships
[*]Destroy aircraft carrier [b]Adler[/b]
[*]Destroy 20 enemy ships or destroy 5 enemy battleships (specific task is selected randomly)[/list]
[h2]Cherry Blossom[/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/20fe5558-2b7d-11ed-a44f-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

The fighting unfolds under the veil of night in the Empress Augusta Bay. As part of the 12th Cruiser Division under the command of Rear Admiral Merrill, your task is to defend the position of the 3rd Marines Division and clear the region of enemy forces. The top priority, however, is for you to protect transport ships from a squadron of Japanese destroyers controlling these waters. Try not to get caught in the crossfire when entering illuminated areas, which appear as a result of enemy illumination shells being launched into the sky.

The second part of the Operation begins at dawn. Your only mission will be to put the squeeze on the remaining enemy forces. Accompanied by two allied destroyers, two aircraft carriers will come to the rescue, capable of repairing nearby ships. Your ultimate task will be to destroy aircraft, the flagship cruiser of the Japanese forces, as well as the enemy's Northern and Southern aerodromes.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e96df68e-2b77-11ed-8b46-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e98b0fee-2b77-11ed-b54c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e98fe118-2b77-11ed-8289-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e968257e-2b77-11ed-bbd7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h3][b]Primary task[/b][/h3]
Defend the marine regiments that have just disembarked. Locate and destroy enemy aerodromes.

[h3][b]Secondary tasks[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Save both [b]Liberty[/b] transport ships
[*]Maintain the positions of both regiments
[*]Destroy 50 enemy aircraft
[*]Destroy flagship cruiser [b]Atago[/b]
[*]Save at least 4 allied ships[/list]
[list]In celebration of the game's Anniversary, you can expect many other combat missions with valuable rewards. Details of the missions will be available in the game client.[/list]

notes.title: How to Play: Maps
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c4061c1fc2a7629565d3b632fcd6e35306e8a271.jpg[/img]
[b]Captains![/b]

Maps play an important role in our game. Depending on the type of map, players can adopt different combat strategies to get ahead. If you want to know how best to use open water, straits, and islands, this video will help you figure it out.
[previewyoutube=qomyOIWwZlk;full][/previewyoutube] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Theoretical Basis[/b][/h2]
[list][*]Open water is a strong suit of battleships and long-range cruisers. Adepts of close-range encounters prefer to stick to islands close to Key Areas in the vicinity of the enemy's main attack directions.
[*]Light and rapid-firing cruisers tend to prefer clusters of islands. The same can be said about destroyers. The latter also do well in open water. This is especially true for destroyers that rely on torpedoes.
[*]Aircraft carriers are most often located behind the main forces. However, this ship type benefits from getting as close as possible to the enemy in battle, as it allows them to reduce the time it takes aircraft to reach their target.[/list] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Practical Tips[/b][/h2]
There are over 30 maps in our game. Each is used at a certain battle tier. There are places on maps where certain ships can be most effective or where their presence can be extremely useful for allies. Today, we’ll be highlighting three low-mid Tier maps: Archipelago, Big Race, and Solomon Islands.

[h2]Archipelago[/h2]
There are four large islands in the center of the map that turn Key Area B in the Domination mode into a kind of arena.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9648e2e2-29c5-11ed-a7b7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
When playing a destroyer, you can slightly hold off capturing a Key Area or fighting same-type ships in this improvised arena.

Wait for your torpedoes to reload and try to launch them into the narrow strait between the islands. This way, the enemy who decides to duel will receive an unexpected and powerful blow.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/964ab194-29c5-11ed-9e6d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Helming a cruiser in battle, you can support allied destroyers that have nevertheless chosen to go to the center of the map. You can do this while being near one of the four islands.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/96553af6-29c5-11ed-b6ff-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Don't forget about the torpedo threat and battleships that can deal a lot of damage to your cruiser.

[h2]Big Race[/h2]
There are several interesting positions on this map. Cruisers can control the exit from the bay.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bd88d18c-29c5-11ed-b96b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The bay itself is another arena for fast destroyer battles. There are three small islands here that can serve as a cover or ambush spot.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bd8cabd6-29c5-11ed-a7b7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
A protruding piece of land on the map can serve as a secluded spot for aircraft carriers. However, you should move there only in certain circumstances. For example, in case of danger from lines 9–10, or in the presence of ships that regularly spot your aircraft carrier.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bd8fc474-29c5-11ed-bb0a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
When taking a position, be aware of opponents who can break through from the side of the bay and quickly detect you.

[h2]Solomon Islands[/h2]
The key point on the map is the strait between the three islands in the center of the game location. No one forbids you to advance there at the helm of a destroyer or cruiser from the first minutes, but keep in mind that you risk running into superior enemy forces.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/dba666e8-29c5-11ed-9e6d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
We recommend taking a position close to the strait. And then meet your opponent with torpedoes or artillery.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/dba2cbd2-29c5-11ed-838b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
There are also less obvious positions on the Solomon Islands map. A large island is cut by a small river, forming a gorge. Therefore, nearby battleships and cruisers can shoot across and thus reach their enemies on the other side of the island.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/dba0e344-29c5-11ed-b6ff-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Helming an aircraft carrier, you can come close to the large island. As mentioned previously, such a maneuver will reduce the time of aircraft approaching their target. This means that it will be possible to attack the enemy more often. When changing your position, make sure that you cannot be detected by opponents who have broken through from the flank or through the central strait.
[list]In the next episode, we'll take a look at useful positions on higher-tier maps: Strait, Ring, New Dawn, and Fault Line. Stay tuned![/list]

Commanders, thank you for participating in the first round of Public Test for Update 0.11.8! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Balance changes were applied to researchable Italian and German destroyers, as well as a number of other ships. Depth Charge Airstrike parameters have additionally been unified for all cruisers and battleships. Details are available on our [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/364/]Development Blog[/url].
[*]Updated bot Tiers and fixed a number of bugs in Operations.
[*]The interface of the window displaying bonus gifts has been updated.
[*]Fixed a number of bugs in several different Ports.
[*]Fixed a bug due to which ships could get stuck near the islands on some maps.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the client to crash when playing in a submarine.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the client to crash when in spectator mode.
[*]Fixed a bug due to which characters were duplicated in the game chat text entry box when opening the tactical map.[/list]
[h2]Combat Missions and Rewards[/h2]
You can earn Community Tokens by progressing through combat missions on the Public Test Server. These Tokens can be exchanged for various rewards in the Armory, including rare permanent camouflages, containers, and other in-game items.

[list][i]The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/i][/list]

Destroy three enemy ships.

[/td][/tr][/table]
[list][i]The combat mission chain can be completed in Random Battles or Operations and is available for completion three times per day at the following times: 11:00–15:00 UTC; 17:00–21:00 UTC; and 23:00–03:00 UTC. You can complete the mission all three times and obtain the rewards three times during the day.[/i][/list]

[h2]Starting Bonuses[/h2]
[list][*]The research prices for ships and ship modules will be substantially discounted.
[*]You will be able to reset Commander skills free of charge.[/list]
If you're joining the Public Test for the first time since Update 0.11.7, you'll be awarded the following additional bonuses:
[list][*]At the start of the Public Test, every participant will have all researchable Tier VI and VIII ships, helmed by Commanders with 19 skill points, credited to their PT accounts.
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]500,000,000[/b] Credits; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]30,000[/b] Doubloons; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]250,000[/b] Coal; and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]90 days of Warships Premium Account[/b].
[*]Sets with expendable economic bonuses and 50 combat signals.[/list]
[list]If you played at least one battle on the Public Test Server during the 0.11.7 Public Test, your account will be copied from the Live Server to the Public Test Server.[/list]

notes.title: Hampshire and Web Campaign
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/fffd643f39a7215a42c02efb3824550b0115445b.jpg[/img]
[b]Hampshire has arrived in the Armory and Premium Shop![/b]

You can celebrate the event with a new web campaign—choose a team and set off on a journey around the world to collect combat missions and themed rewards!

[table][tr][th][b][url=#hampshire]Hampshire[/url]
[url=#campaign]Around the World and a Little Bit Further[/url]
[url=#armory]Armory[/url]
[url=#premium-shop]Hampshire in the Premium Shop[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/cc5da0e8-23b7-11ed-b8fc-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/around-the-world/ style=button]To the Campaign Map[/url]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=hampshire][/h1]Hampshire[/b][/h2]
In 1932, three Surrey-class cruisers were meant to enter service in the Royal Navy. The design of the ships was based on Exeter, but with a 10,000-ton displacement and a fourth main battery turret added. However, the London Naval Treaty prevented that from happening. The introduced limitation on the total displacement of heavy cruisers forced Great Britain to cancel the Surrey order due to the total displacement limit being exhausted. Hampshire is our answer to the question: "What might the further development of the Surrey-class British cruisers have looked like?"
[previewyoutube=Hx2KBPdNZWU;full][/previewyoutube]
In honor of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Hampshire[/b][/b]'s release, we're launching a web campaign. Follow the instructions on the map to collect all the available rewards!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Fri. 26 Aug. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Fri. 09 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=campaign][/h1]Around the World and a Little Bit Further[/b][/h2]
This time, you're about to set off on a journey around the world and uncover the mystery of the Navigators—a powerful ancient guild of seafarers and explorers of the depths. The web campaign consists of seven stages which must be completed sequentially. The final reward will depend on the team you decide to join. Over the entire journey, you'll be able to earn:
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4f44cac8-23c1-11ed-80e2-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list]For completing the web campaign, you'll receive two Navigator Tokens—you can use these to get random [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Hampshire[/b][/b] bundles. Moreover, the web campaign is the only way you can obtain the Around the World themed patch and flag.[/list]
[h2]Rules[/h2]
[h3][i]Stages[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
The Around the World Campaign comprises seven mandatory stages that will bring your team closer step by step to the mysterious Navigator Tokens. Make your choices on the website, claim the combat missions, and complete them—you'll learn their requirements upon claiming them. Follow the instructions on the map to acquire Navigator Tokens and other rewards!
[/expand]
[h3][i]Cities[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
This time, you're about to set off on a journey around the globe, and the campaign map covers the entire world. You need to sequentially complete all combat missions in each port to get all the rewards.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Choosing a Team[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
The choice of team that you need to make at the beginning of your journey will define your final reward. Join either the brave explorers or reckless pirates, and set off in pursuit of Navigator Tokens flying the flag of one of the event characters.
[/expand]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9441ab3e-23ba-11ed-9df2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/94363dee-23ba-11ed-9570-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9437c1aa-23ba-11ed-ac0b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/94207a36-23ba-11ed-ace5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=armory][/h1]Armory[/b][/h2]
In the Armory, you'll find bundles with themed Commander [b]William Lymington[/b] and the Cloud Privateer permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Hampshire[/b][/b], plus you'll be able to obtain the ship from random bundles. To acquire the latter, you'll need Navigator Tokens.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]The bundles are available until:[/b] [b]Fri. 16 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/03758720-23b9-11ed-ac0b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/198060c0-23ba-11ed-9570-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/18a63e86-23ba-11ed-ace5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/18a560ba-23ba-11ed-ab7e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/18a90eae-23ba-11ed-9df2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]Navigator Tokens[/h2]
You can obtain Navigator Tokens in the Armory and Premium Shop. The Armory also has three Navigator Tokens available in exchange for Credits.
[list][i][b]Navigator Tokens[/b] are a temporary resource for the Around the World event. You can obtain Navigator Tokens by completing combat missions of the campaign, which will be available on the website for a limited period. With the release of Update 0.11.9, any unspent Navigator Tokens will be converted into Free XP at the rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]35,000[/b].[/i][/list]

[h3][i]Research Cruise[/i][/h3]
Random bundle
0/35    1 [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_2_efc8a47009f68ca2e3c2dfd183d9b81ba04e5d1d243c2cef15ded36595cb346c.png[/img] Navigator Tokens   [url=https://armory.worldofwarships.eu/category/event_6/5000002052/?utm_source=wows-portal&utm_medium=metashop-banner&utm_campaign=news&utm_term=pc-browser&utm_content=hampshire-and-web-campaign style=button]Purchase[/url][/td][/tr][/table]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Hampshire[/b][/b] is a British heavy cruiser that embodied the further development of the Surrey-class ships with the number of her main battery guns increased to ten.
[list][i]If deemed necessary, balance changes may be applied to [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Hampshire[/b][/b].[/i][/list]
[list]The ship comes with a permanent camouflage, and she has standard economic bonuses for her tier. She also earns more Credits per battle and has a reduced post-battle service cost. Commander retraining isn't required for this ship.[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4f74df24-23c1-11ed-a63e-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Transfer Opportunities for Players from CIS to the EU Realm
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/bee625891f031b9badab94a5b487827d4fc31764.jpg[/img]
[b]Dear players![/b]

On April 4, we announced that Wargaming projects including World of Warships, will be operated by Lesta Games in Russia and Belarus. This was the first step, followed by months of hard work. The result is the complete structural and financial division of the two companies. Today, World of Warships and other products are operated by two independent companies: by Lesta Games in Russia and Belarus, and by Wargaming in all other countries.

The next big step is [b]to launch a special transfer campaign for CIS players who wish to stay with Wargaming and continue playing on Steam.[/b]

Transfer is a crucial activity where every player from CIS realm will need to decide on how to continue playing the game. Below you can find the key points about this procedure:
[olist][*]In [b]September[/b], CIS servers will be turned off for Steam players.
[*]If you already have an account on CIS region, you will have an opportunity to transfer your CIS account to EU region and continue playing on Steam.
[*]If you don’t want to transfer your account to EU region, unfortunately, you will not be able to continue playing on Steam.[/olist]
Providing high quality service and ensuring the comfort of our players will always remain our priority. We will keep your account progress and all applicable terms and conditions, including pricing principles, as well as the core set of services you are used to, no matter where you continue playing.

We understand that this is a big and serious decision for our players, and we will do our best to make it a smooth and easy experience for everyone.

[h3]Additional Questions[/h3]
[expand][olist][*][b]Q: Do I need to perform any actions now?[/b]
A: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/4174225702959905780]If you wish to transfer your account, make sure that you have completed your registration by adding an email and a password.[/url] Other than that, you do not have to do anything now, this is just an announcement to make sure you stay up to date with our latest plans. We will make an additional publication when the transfer is ready with all details about the procedure.
[*][b]Q: How long will the transfer option be available?[/b]
A: The transfer campaign doesn’t have any planned end date. We want to make sure that all our players get a chance to move to EU region, including those who decided to take a break from the game at the moment. If this changes sometime in the future, we will let you know in advance.
[*][b]Q: Can I transfer my EU, NA, ASIA account to another server during this transfer campaign?[/b]
A: No, this transfer campaign will be aimed specifically at CIS-region players. Other regions remain without any changes.
[*][b]Q: Can players transfer their clan to the EU?[/b]
A: Yes, if requested by the Clan Commander.
[*][b]Q: Will my progress, stats, purchases and resources be transferred as well?[/b]
A: Yes, of course. Your progress, stats, purchases, resources etc. will be transferred to a new account on EU region with only a couple of exceptions. Game progress will not be saved, the ability to complete already started regional game events will be disabled.
[*][b]Q: I play from Belarus or Russia and I want to transfer my account to EU region. Will I be able to make purchases in the game after the transfer?[/b]
A: We will continue to accept all payment methods available in Steam. Therefore, you will be able to make purchases on EU region using payment methods that are available in Steam in your country.
[*][b]Q: What if I don’t want to transfer my account to EU region?[/b]
A: Unfortunately, in that case you will not be able to play World of Warships via Steam on your CIS-region account.[/olist][/expand]
We understand that you might have more questions about the transfer procedure. We will share the full transfer conditions and technical details for Steam players closer to the transfer launch which is currently planned for the middle of September. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Developer Bulletin for Update 0.11.8
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/65f0d999cae1abdb52333471d0f6123bf53c6219.jpg[/img]
[list][b][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.[/b][/list]

[list][i]Please note: The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/i][/list]

[table][tr][th][b][url=#wows-anniversary]World of Warships Anniversary[/url]
[url=#warship-strike]Warship Strike[/url]
[url=#reworked-operations]Reworked Operations[/url]
[url=#changes-to-the-reload-mechanics]Changes to the Reload Mechanics[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=wows-anniversary][/h1]World of Warships Anniversary[/b][/h2]
This year, World of Warships is celebrating its seventh birthday! We've prepared various activities for our players in honor of the occasion.

[h2]Seven Seas Collection[/h2]
An important new feature that's also part of our birthday celebrations is the Seven Seas collection dedicated to historic ports that have been recreated in our game. The Seven Seas collection will let you take a fresh look at familiar locations from a new perspective and get to know some curious facts from the history of as many as 16 famous ports.

The collection elements can only be obtained from dedicated same-name containers. You can earn these containers by progressing through special chains of combat missions and also find them in free daily bundles in the Armory. Rest assured that those containers will be quite enough to complete the entire collection. The collection consists of four pages, with four elements on each.

[list][b]Reward for completing a page:[/b] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Warships Premium Account[/b].
[b][b]Reward for completing the collection:[/b][/b] bonus package for a Tier VII ship.[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/d29aed54-1c90-11ed-8872-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]Note: The new collection will not be available on the Public Test Server.[/i][/list]

[h2]Festive Rewards[/h2]
To celebrate the Seventh Anniversary of World of Warships, we're bringing back gift bonuses for your performance in battles playing all ships of Tier V and above. This time, however, we've added an important enhancement—the ability to receive several gifts for a single battle!

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/34c44aba-1c92-11ed-8944-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/34cfef3c-1c92-11ed-a5d9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/35f26caa-1c92-11ed-b1b8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3640f672-1c92-11ed-ad59-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/35055c94-1c92-11ed-96b9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
If a player has 100 or more ships, they will be able to receive a standard gift for a battle played with a ship, as well as extra bonus gifts that depend on the amount of Base XP earned. The old rule that you can't get gifts a second time playing the same ship applies as well.

Extra bonus gifts can be applied toward any other ship they have not been applied to, so you can "score" a gift for that ship without the need to actually hit the seas for battle at her helm.

The bonus gift rewards depend on your ship tier:
[list][*]For Tier V–VII ships, it's 1x Special Bonuses container
[*]For Tier VIII–IX ships, it's 1x Rare Bonuses container and 1x Special Bonuses container
[*]For Tier X ships and superships, it's 1x Supercontainer[/list]
The number of bonus gifts you receive after a battle depends on the number of ships you have in your Port and the amount of Base XP earned in that battle. For example, a player with a Port fleet exceeding 300 ships will be able to earn four gifts in one battle: one gift for entering battle with a ship and three gifts for effective action in battle.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/02f79758-1c92-11ed-96b9-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
The new [b][b]Special Bonuses container[/b][/b] drops Level 2 economic bonuses. 5x bonuses of one of the following types: "Credits [b]+40%[/b]," "Ship XP [b]+200%[/b]," "Commander XP [b]+200%[/b]," "Free XP [b]+600%[/b]."

The new [b][b]Rare Bonuses container[/b][/b] drops Level 3 economic bonuses. 3x bonuses of one of the following types: "Credits [b]+160%[/b]," "Ship XP [b]+800%[/b]," "Commander XP [b]+800%[/b]," "Free XP [b]+2,400%[/b]."
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=warship-strike][/h1]Warship Strike[/b][/h2]
One of the fresh activities that's getting released with Update 0.11.8 involves challenging AI in a new game codenamed "Warship Strike," inspired by a classic naval combat game. You can access the game via the Armory. You'll need a special resource—[b]a Strike Pass[/b]—to unlock access to it and play. Strike Passes can be earned by completing special combat missions.

You can pause any ongoing battle at any time and return to it later, and your progress will be saved. Battles can also be completed automatically. In that case, the AI completes the battle for you. The battle results will simply appear on the screen, and you'll receive all due rewards in the form of Festive Tokens. These are issued for sinking enemy ships and winning battles.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/64b9c772-1c92-11ed-adf0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/649ba008-1c92-11ed-a5d9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
You can exchange these Tokens in the Armory for the option that suits your needs best:
[list][*]Permanent camouflages
[*]Bonus packages for ships
[*]Economic bonuses
[*]Containers with signals and resources
[*]Credits[/list] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=reworked-operations][/h1]Reworked Operations[/b][/h2]
In Update 0.11.8, we've reworked all Operations in the game. The purpose of these changes is to give you the opportunity to participate in Operations playing more of your favorite ships and earn valuable rewards along the way.

Now, Tier VI to VIII ships can be matched in battle at the same time, and the final team lineup will have an effect on the strength of the bots and post-battle earnings. The "fee" for re-entering battle with the same ship will be removed.

The economy in effect in Operations will change as well. Previously, players earned Stars for completing an Operation, and the rewards could only be obtained once. We've removed Stars altogether, and the rewards can now be earned by progressing through dedicated daily and weekly combat missions specifically designed for Operations. The rewards are Community Tokens.

The Operation of the Week won't be available in Update 0.11.8. When playing on a team where your allies are selected automatically, an Operation will be picked at random. You will still be able to select an Operation of your liking when you are part of a Division.

[list][i]Update 0.11.8 brings back the following three Operations for the revamped game mode: The Ultimate Frontier, Hermes, and Cherry Blossom.[/i][/list]

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/85ea4502-1c92-11ed-9180-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8680b76c-1c92-11ed-a853-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/867fda04-1c92-11ed-b1b8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a2490a30-1c92-11ed-8944-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a248fce8-1c92-11ed-96b9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a24937da-1c92-11ed-adf0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3fcba64-1c92-11ed-adf0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3fb9e72-1c92-11ed-b1b8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3719ef2-1c92-11ed-a5d9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=changes-to-the-reload-mechanics][/h1]Changes to the Reload Mechanics[/b][/h2]
We've changed the gun reload mechanics that are applied when switching shell type.

With the "Gun Feeder" Commander skill active, the shell type will now switch faster even if not all main battery guns are completely reloaded after a salvo (which was required prior to the change for the skill to take effect).

Shells now have a new parameter—"shell-type switching time."
[list][*]If the current gun reload time exceeds the shell-type switching time, shell switching will not affect the gun reload time.
[*]If the current gun reload time is shorter than the shell-type switching time, the gun reload time when switching shell types is equal to the shell-type switching time.[/list]
The Gun Feeder skill bonus applied to shell-type switching time has been changed from [b]–50%[/b] to [b]–40%[/b]. For example, if the standard gun reload time is 30 seconds, the shell-type switching time with the Gun Feeder skill activated will be 18 seconds, but the following should be kept in mind:
[list][*]If the remaining gun reload time is 20 seconds and you switch shell type, the reload time will still be 20 seconds.
[*]If only 5 seconds are left for the guns to reload, switching shell type will increase the gun reload time to 18 seconds.[/list]
[list][i]The new mechanics apply to each turret individually. Shell-type switching time will be shown in a ship's tech specs.[/i][/list]
Additionally, all researchable Italian battleships will have the "[b]–30%[/b] to shell-type switching time" bonus applied by default, which means that it will apply even when the Gun Feeder skill is inactive. Activating the skill will further increase this bonus.

Speaking of Italian battleships, switching between shell types frequently is an important gameplay component. The extra bonus will emphasize this feature and increase the effectiveness of using the Gun Feeder skill compared to battleships of other nations.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1b3cbd1dea298c0a33e29bdb727fd5cdef22fe11.jpg[/img]
[b]Commanders![/b]

Update 0.11.7. kicks off Season 18 of Clan Battles. It's named "Sirenidae." Sirenidae, or "sirens," are amphibious predators found in the Southeastern United States. They hunt for mollusks, prawns, and small fish. As opposed to other salamanders, which is the order they belong to, sirens can emit sounds. They're named after creatures from Greek mythology who lured sailors to a certain death.

Clan Battles offer an excellent opportunity to show off your skills in World of Warships. It's not only the results of individual battles that are important here but also general progress. Fight alongside your brothers-in-arms and rise to the top!

[list]Win Clan Battles to earn valuable rewards such as Steel, Oil, days of Warships Premium Account, combat signals, Level 4 expendable bonuses, and a Clan Token. The more victories you achieve, the more rewards you'll earn.[/list]

Just like in previous seasons, certain restrictions on the numbers of specific ships per team apply in Clan Battles.

The restrictions can be set for the entire duration of a season or for specific periods of time. For example, they might be set after the first 2 weeks of a season then replaced with different restrictions a few weeks later. This allows us to promptly react to the current state of the season.

Season 18 begins with the following restrictions:
[list][*]Aircraft carriers are not allowed in battles.
[*]No more than one battleship per team.
[*]No more than three mercenaries per Division.[/list]
These restrictions allow us to diversify the gameplay and increase the variety of setups in the season.

[list][i]During the season, based on statistics, new restrictions may be added and existing restrictions may be changed. We will announce the changes separately on our Development Blog. Information about any changes will also be available in the game client.[/i][/list]

notes.title: Dockyard: Building Puerto Rico
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/4914110d1decfd7046aa4fb43f05049f27887f41.jpg[/img]
[b]Throughout Updates 0.11.7 – 0.11.9, the buzz and frenzy at the Dockyard will be all about building Puerto Rico. This ship is based on an American design developed during World War II.
[/b]
The expiration of the Washington Naval Treaty in 1936 gave American designers free rein to come up with whatever they thought expedient to meet the needs of the Navy. By the end of the 1930s, a stringent situation had emerged in the Pacific, exposing the United States' need for heavy cruisers to effectively protect communication lines and aircraft carrier formations. Simply said, the country needed a strong ship with great firepower, high speed, and effective armor. By the year 1940, several projects had been created. The CA-2D design was the largest of them in terms of size and outnumbered all the other ones in main battery guns. This is the very project we used as a prototype for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Puerto Rico[/b][/b] in our game.

She’s armed with twelve 305 mm guns placed in four main battery turrets. The cruiser's AP shells have good damage-dealing capabilities and enhanced ricochet angles. The ship also has a large HP pool and solid armor protection. The cruiser is best suited for duels at medium to long ranges, but at the same time, she’s no less effective in supporting allies with her good AA defenses to repel enemy air attacks. Her Surveillance Radar is a must-have when capturing Key Areas.

[h2][b][h1=combat-missions][/h1]Combat Missions[/b][/h2]
The new game event tasks you with completing 90 combat missions spread across 10 groups. The first group will become available with the release of Update 0.11.7, while those that follow will be unlocked each week.

Completing the first six groups will progress you through three shipbuilding phases each—two phases for accomplishing certain missions and one for finishing the group. Completing each of the remaining four combat mission groups will progress you through four shipbuilding phases—three for accomplishing certain missions and one for finishing the group.

notes.title: Two vs. Two Playing Tier VII
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/0782c81589ab35b8138fcbf35f1e301287f43855.jpg[/img]
[b]Two Brawls, both utilizing a 2 vs. 2 format, await you in Update 0.11.6. The first stage sees Tier X ships go head-to-head, and the second one puts Tier VII ships in the heat of action.[/b]

Team up with your friends and achieve more victories—this is a great opportunity to earn Coal, economic bonuses, signals, and Elite Commander XP in a short time!

[list]Brawls are characterized by short seasons and small teams. The clashes are fast and dynamic, and players are matched by their skill level. You can participate in a Division, and you don't need to be a member of a Clan.[/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#rewards]Rewards[/url]
[url=#rules]Rules[/url]
[url=#maps]Game Maps and Modes[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=rewards][/h1]Rewards[/b][/h2]
Up to 10,000 Coal; 2,250,000 Credits; 80,000 Elite Commander XP; 56 combat signals; and 16 expendable economic bonuses.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/bd75ccfa-0417-11ed-90e7-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]

[b]Format:[/b] 2 vs. 2 playing Tier VII ships

[b]Restrictions:[/b] No more than one battleship per team
[hr][/hr]

Hotspot, Islands of Ice, Land of Fire, Sea of Fortune, and Crash Zone Alpha—all with reduced combat zones.
