[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Tue. 02 Aug. 07:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

Commanders, thank you for participating in the first round of Public Test for Update 0.11.7! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Removed settings "Fly around the ship before battle starts" and "Airstrike alternative controls".
[*]Updated a number of UI interaction sounds and added some new ones.
[*]Minor visual improvements to the Port of London.
[*]Changed the camera angle in Port and in battle.
[*]Changed camera pathing during the pre-battle countdown.
[*]Fixed the incorrect display of some ships' torpedo arming distance.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the aiming reticle to shift while on the move.
[*]Fixed bug that caused [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_66da2bf0a3d0736ade533118e5131aab9b4f7c9367cbb0392c621e6888c23fe1.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Halland[/b][/b]'s torpedo damage to be 11,467 instead of the intended 10,700.
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause shipbuilding sounds from the Dockyard interface to play in Port and in battle.
[*]Fixed a bug that would prevent the sounds of submarines submerging and surfacing from playing.
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause the game interface to freeze when switching quickly from the Clans tab to Port and back.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused ships to not be able to move in some situations when autopilot was active.
[*]Fixed the incorrect behavior of the overview camera for ship modules when changing Port.[/list]
[h2]Combat Missions and Rewards[/h2]
You can earn Community Tokens by progressing through combat missions on the Public Test Server. Community Tokens can be exchanged for various rewards in the Armory, including containers with Premium ships, rare permanent camouflages, and other in-game items.

[list][i]The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/i][/list]

notes.title: Ship's Log: A Great Journey
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2838738487][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/80194782418e4ff35efab8fe0a0396ba8017bf86.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]Captains![/b]

An exciting journey awaits you with Ship's Log today. Keep a sharp eye—the program is quite packed! We'll start in Belgium, then travel to the coasts of Colombia and Peru, and end up in Ecuador. Ship's Log will reward diligent captains with a lot of souvenirs for completing special combat missions. Welcome aboard, Captain! We're heading out!

Our journey starts in Belgium. Don't forget to unlock the special combat mission chain. Upon completing it, you'll receive the Naval Ensign of Belgium commemorative flag.

Before the outbreak of World War II, neutral Belgium didn't have a navy. In 1936, however, a special flag was introduced for all state-owned ships—a black-crowned lion in the center of the Belgian tricolor. A few mobilized ships of the hastily created Belgian Naval Corps served under that flag during the short military campaign of 1940.

notes.title: Developer Bulletin for Update 0.11.7
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/65f0d999cae1abdb52333471d0f6123bf53c6219.jpg[/img]
[list][b][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.[/b][/list]
[list][i]Please note: The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/i][/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#dockyard]Dockyard[/url]
[url=#camera-improvements]Camera Improvements[/url]
[url=#submarine-improvements]Submarine Improvements[/url]
[url=#british-battleships-part-2]British Battleships: Part 2[/url]
[url=#other-changes]Other Changes[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=dockyard][/h1]Dockyard[/b][/h2]
Update 0.11.7 kicks off the construction of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Puerto Rico[/b][/b] at the Dockyard. The ship is armed with twelve 305 mm guns placed in four main battery turrets. The cruiser's AP shells have good damage-dealing capabilities and enhanced ricochet angles. The ship also has a large HP pool and good armor protection.

[h2]Rules[/h2]
The construction process at the Dockyard comprises 40 phases. These shipbuilding phases can be completed by progressing through Dockyard combat missions or by spending [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,750[/b] Doubloons to pass through each phase. The combat missions span Update 0.11.7, 0.11.8, and the first three weeks of 0.11.9. The Dockyard itself will remain in your Ports until the start of Update 0.11.10.

[list]In total, you can progress through 34 out of 40 shipbuilding phases by completing Dockyard combat missions. Completing the 25th phase will reward you with [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Commonwealth_abdc3eb3f8c9b1c0421b3aed2f550ac45b78602942f9a4a2cdd438835720edc7.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Huron[/b][/b] with a 6-skill-point Commander and a Port slot. The final reward is [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Puerto Rico[/b][/b] with the Ceremonial permanent camouflage, a Port slot, a Commander with 10 skill points, and a commemorative flag.[/list]
If you already have [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Puerto Rico[/b][/b] and upon construction completion, you'll obtain a Puerto Rico Certificate, which can be exchanged in a special section of the Armory for one of the following rewards: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]35,000[/b] Doubloons, [b]33,000[/b] Steel, or [b]63,000[/b] Research Points. Thus, you'll be able to purchase any other available Tier X ship for completing shipbuilding phases at the Dockyard. If you do not exchange your Puerto Rico Certificate for one of the resources before the release of Update 0.11.10, you will automatically receive [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]35,000[/b] Doubloons when the update goes live.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4e0aee92-0767-11ed-9ad0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4e074c74-0767-11ed-88b1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4e0e3a52-0767-11ed-937a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=camera-improvements][/h1]Camera Improvements[/b][/h2]
The battle camera will be improved in Update 0.11.7 to make gameplay experience more comfortable.
[list][*]The base default view angle will be changed.
[*]The camera performance when using Spotting Aircraft will be improved: Now, a player has two camera positions to choose from to make aiming while using Spotting Aircraft more comfortable.

[list][*]Lower position, similar to the camera position without Spotting Aircraft.
[*]Upper position, similar to the current camera position when using Spotting Aircraft.[/list][/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6caa5666-0745-11ed-990b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6ca0df28-0745-11ed-96e8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][*]New settings will be added.

[list][*]Field of view: The setting allows players to set the angle of view themselves. The setting does not affect the Binocular mode.
[*]Camera height: This allows you to raise and zoom out the camera from a ship.
[*]Airstrike alternative controls: Enables dynamic camera zoom based on distance when using Airstrike.[/list]
[*]When switching to Airstrike mode, the position of the main battery and torpedo launchers will be fixed.
[*]The camera view angle in the torpedo launcher view is similar to that in the main battery view.
[*]Improved camera performance when tracking flying shells and in replays.[/list] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=submarine-improvements][/h1]Submarine Improvements[/b][/h2]
Submarines will receive a number of improvements in Update 0.11.7.

[h3][b]The Hydrophone consumable will be split into two—Echo-Ranging Set and Low-Frequency Hydrophone.[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Echo-Ranging Set shows the position of surface ships and highlights the bottom topography.
[*]Low-Frequency Hydrophone allows you to detect submerged submarines.[/list]
Hydrophone combines two different tasks and is often used to perform only one, while the second is performed in vain. Splitting the consumable will make playing submarines more comfortable by enabling you to activate exactly the equipment you need at a given time.

Both consumables will be available on all submarines. The settings of the new consumable types will change from the current version of Hydrophone.

[h3][b]Disabled guaranteed detection for submarines in submerged position.[/b][/h3]
Due to interaction specifics, it is common for submarines to accidentally detect each other. Because of this, they come under an airstrike and are forced into a duel with no possibility of safely disengaging. Disabling guaranteed detection will make playing submarines more comfortable, and in case players want to attack an enemy submarine, they will be able to use Low-Frequency Hydrophone.

[h3][b]The visual effect above a submarine when using sonar will also be displayed for the submarine herself.[/b][/h3]
The change will make playing submarines clearer and help players better understand enemy submarine interaction.
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=british-battleships-part-2][/h1]British Battleships: Part 2[/b][/h2]
The Port of London has been updated as part of the continuation of Early Access to British battleships.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b57bad4a-0745-11ed-8f93-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b57ef054-0745-11ed-9857-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b582065e-0745-11ed-b5c8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=other-changes][/h1]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
[h2]Visual Improvements[/h2]
Improved in-game shadow rendering for all presets. Added a new shadow quality preset—Very High. Increased detail level for High and Maximum presets.

Improved buoys. Increased model quality and added soft lamp flashing.

[list][b]The minimum system requirements have been increased to require full support for DX 11 SHADER MODEL 5_0. The minimum required graphics cards are now GeForce GTX 460/Radeon HD 5770/Intel HD Graphics 4000. It will not be possible to run the game client on older graphics cards.[/b][/list]

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
The Port of Rio de Janeiro has been added to the game to celebrate the 200th anniversary of Brazil's independence.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/82acc10a-0746-11ed-be95-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/82a8e6ca-0746-11ed-9857-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/82ac13a4-0746-11ed-8f93-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/82acd6d6-0746-11ed-bf91-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
Updated the drop rates of items from the "Two Titans—One King" Premium container. The containers that players have on their accounts will be changed accordingly with the release of the Update:
[list][*]Chances of dropping expendable camouflages reduced from 29% to 21%.
[*]Chances of dropping permanent camouflages increased from 7% to 12%.
[*]Chances of dropping Commanders increased from 14% to 15%.
[*]Chances of dropping expendable economic bonuses increased from 40% to 42%.
[*]Number of containers that must be opened to guarantee the acquisition of one of the permanent camouflages—unless dropped from one of the open containers—reduced from 35 to 20.[/list]
[list][i]For the current scope and drop rates, follow this [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/contents-and-drop-rates-of-containers/]link[/url].[/i][/list]

We're continuing our mission to keep you posted about the main news of the week via our "In a Nutshell" series. In the new episode, Natali will tell you about the Industry Titans event, separation of exterior customizations from economic bonuses, British battleships in Early Access, and much more!
[previewyoutube=Xym7R2V6p84;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]The Ship's Log gets updated in any weather.[/b][/h3]
Today, we're bringing you a chain of hot combat missions dedicated to the summer season, telling you about a combat mission for superships, and showing you how to get submarines for rent.

[table][tr][th][b][url=#the-hottest-time]The Hottest Time[/url]
[url=#superships-and-submarines]Superships and Submarines[/url]

[h2][b][h1=the-hottest-time][/h1]The Hottest Time[/b][/h2]
The ancient civilizations of Europe dubbed the unbearably hot summer days “dog days.” This was attributed to the Greek belief about the brightest star in the sky—Sirius—which is part of the Canis Major constellation. Nowadays, however, this name is much more often associated with pets spreadeagled on the ground, weary of the heat. To help you cope with the high temperatures, we've prepared some special rewards and a special combat mission chain.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Thu. 14 Jul. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Thu. 11 Aug. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

To successfully complete the combat mission chain, you’ll have to earn ribbons and Free XP, as well as deal damage playing Tier V-X ships and superships. As a reward, you’ll receive the "Winston, a Salty Sea Dog!" and Bulldog patches, as well as expendable economic bonuses.
[list][i]You can complete the combat mission chain in Random, Ranked, and Co-op Battles, as well as in Operations and Brawls.[/i][/list]

notes.title: Two vs. Two Playing Tier X
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/36b02837780f771ace158bd4d97584d1d47046a7.jpg[/img]
[b]Two Brawls, both utilizing a 2 vs. 2 format, await you in Update 0.11.6. The first stage sees Tier X ships go head-to-head, and the second one puts Tier VII ships in the heat of action.[/b]

Team up with your friends and achieve more victories—this is a great opportunity to earn Coal, economic bonuses, signals, and Elite Commander XP in a short time!
[list]Brawls are characterized by short seasons and small teams. The clashes are fast and dynamic, and players are matched by their skill level. You can participate in a Division, and you don't need to be a member of a Clan.[/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#rewards]Rewards[/url]
[url=#rules]Rules[/url]
[url=#maps]Game Maps and Modes[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=rewards][/h1]Rewards[/b][/h2]
Up to 10,000 Coal; 2,250,000 Credits; 80,000 Elite Commander XP; 56 combat signals; and 16 expendable economic bonuses.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/bd75ccfa-0417-11ed-90e7-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]

Hotspot, Islands of Ice, Land of Fire, Sea of Fortune, and Crash Zone Alpha—all with reduced combat zones.

notes.title: Division Star: Play Together With Your Clanmates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8ff1b080743fa46a55705c5bc791c9f6bf58084d.jpg[/img]
[b]The Division Star event allows you to receive Stars and rewards by fighting in a Division with your Clanmates. The event is returning in Update 0.11.6.[/b]

[table][tr][th][b][url=#learn-the-rules]Learn the Rules[/url]
[url=#assemble-a-division]Assemble a Division[/url]
[url=#fight-for-stars]Fight for Stars[/url]
[url=#get-rewards]Get Rewards[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=learn-the-rules][/h1]Learn the Rules[/b][/h2]
Division Star was introduced to make it more interesting for you to play in Divisions with the Clanmates. The last time we held this event, it was very much enjoyed by our players! Head into battle and fight for Stars and rewards.
[list][*]The Stars can be earned in all battle types, except for Training Battles.
[*]All the rewards can be obtained before the end of Update 0.11.6.
[*]If you switch Clans, any Stars and rewards you previously received remain with you.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/dafa5b90-0676-11ed-8054-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=assemble-a-division][/h1]Assemble a Division[/b][/h2]
The names of players in your Clan can be viewed in the Division Star tab of the Clans section. Choose any member of the Clan and start chatting with them to invite them into a Division.

Earn Stars for completing missions while fighting in a Division with your Clanmates. If you want to view a list of available missions for completion with each member of your Clan, hover the mouse cursor over their name. You can complete several missions with several Clanmates in a single Division per battle.
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=fight-for-stars][/h1]Fight for Stars[/b][/h2]
By playing together with each of your Clanmates, you can get a total of up to 3 Stars—one for each fulfilled condition:
[list][*]Winning a battle.
[*]Earning the Shoulder to Shoulder Division achievement—to unlock the achievement, a Division must damage 10 and more enemy ships. The damage caused to an enemy must comprise no less than 20% of their normal HP pool.
[*]Earning the Coordinated Attack Division achievement—to unlock the achievement, your Division must sink at least seven enemy ships.[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/da57e7d4-0676-11ed-abb7-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=get-rewards][/h1]Get Rewards[/b][/h2]
By accumulating the specific number of Stars, you'll automatically receive various rewards.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/da4766d4-0676-11ed-9f61-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]
We come bearing gifts! Stay on the lookout for Community Tokens in this and other articles on our website! You can exchange them in the Armory for containers that hold Premium ships and other items. Stay tuned for more news, and be sure to share the articles with your friends so they can also enjoy claiming gifts!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]The reward can be claimed before:[/b] [b]Tue. 02 Aug. 15:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

notes.title: Industry Titans and British Battleships in Early Access
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d154b40b0368e79d008995a7a587264827ffa5b2.jpg[/img]
[b]Every update injects more variety into World of Warships.
[/b]
Update 0.11.6 sees a new branch of British battleships arriving in the Early Access and the introduction of the Industry Titans temporary event.

[table][tr][th][b][url=#british-battleships]British Battleships[/url]
[url=#industry-titans]Industry Titans[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=jHdPxfWJmL0;full][/previewyoutube] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=british-battleships][/h1]British Battleships[/b][/h2]
The new British battleships are medium- and close-range fighters. They're equipped with guns with a short firing range, and they are also armed with torpedoes. Their efficient Repair Party consumable can restore a significant amount of any damage dealt to them.

The battleships' HE shells have standard penetration characteristics and average accuracy. Their AP shells have a typically British short fuse time. These shells are more efficient against lightly armored targets as they suffer from fewer overpenetrating hits. The guns have a solid caliber—up to 457 mm at Tier X.

Starting from Tier V, the ships are equipped with Engine Boost; from Tier VI—with Defensive AA Fire; and from Tier IX, Repair Party is replaced with Specialized Repair Teams.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f01a730a-ffde-11ec-bf4f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f01eb5be-ffde-11ec-b645-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f01b37cc-ffde-11ec-95cd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f01de184-ffde-11ec-acb1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f028496c-ffde-11ec-baf5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f01e9bec-ffde-11ec-a474-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f014b3e8-ffde-11ec-9000-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f01c2a38-ffde-11ec-b205-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]Early Access[/h2]
[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]III[/b] Indefatigable[/b][/b] can be obtained via daily random bundles. You can obtain only one bundle (out of a total of 12) per day for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]150[/b] Doubloons.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Duncan[/b][/b] can be obtained via random bundles. We're offering 70 bundles at [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,000[/b] Doubloons each.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]IV[/b] Queen Mary[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Tiger[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Renown[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Rooke[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Hawke[/b][/b] are available via sequential bundles for British Tokens.
[*]With the release of Update 0.11.8, all British Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]18,000[/b].
[*]Upon obtaining all available sequential bundles, you'll be able to acquire [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] St. Vincent[/b][/b] in exchange for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]20,000[/b] Doubloons.[/list]
[list][i]When Update 0.11.8 goes live, the British battleships will become available for all players to research.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=industry-titans][/h1]Industry Titans[/b][/h2]
A new temporary event awaits players in Update 0.11.6. The Chatham, Elswick, and Clydebank shipyards will compete for the right to be called the best shipbuilder serving the needs of the Royal Navy. Make your choice, and lend your support to one of the shipyards! Don't forget—each of them will allow you to earn a unique reward.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8c2d9118-ffe0-11ec-b26d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8c96ff86-ffe0-11ec-acb1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8c94a4c0-ffe0-11ec-bf4f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8c96d9d4-ffe0-11ec-a33c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8c29c506-ffe0-11ec-9000-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
The Industry Titans event is similar to the New Year's Eve and Clash of Courage ones.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Thu. 14 Jul. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Thu. 11 Aug. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

The Port of London has been updated to celebrate the event.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a7a309d0-ffdd-11ec-a474-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a79e1c72-ffdd-11ec-bf4f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a7a2bce6-ffdd-11ec-acb1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]Event Rules[/h2]
The event will run until the release of Update 0.11.7 and is divided into four stages. Each stage lasts 1 week. Before starting each stage, you can choose one of three teams named after the British shipyards.
[list][*][b]Chatham team.[/b] The shipyard in Chatham built more than 500 ships for the British Navy throughout its history.
[*][b]Elswick team.[/b] The shipyard in Elswick built entire fleets for various countries and was especially famous for its cruisers.
[*][b]Clydebank team.[/b] The shipyard in Clydebank was famous for its warships of all types, ranging from destroyers to battleships.[/list]
During the day, event participants will receive special missions that can be completed in Random, Co-op, and Ranked Battles playing Tier V ships and higher.

[list][i]Completing the missions will advance you through the personal and team progress bars and unlock rewards. Your personal and team progress is reset to zero at the beginning of each new stage.[/i][/list]

[h2]Missions[/h2]
During the day, each player is issued combat missions once every 40 minutes; the time to complete each of them is limited to 120 minutes. Players can carry out only three missions simultaneously.

After a mission expires, the next mission becomes available. A total of 31 missions are available throughout each day. Battles that end after a mission expires are counted toward the next mission. The only exceptions are the last missions of the day. The time for counting the results of these missions is extended by 20 minutes.

[list][i]The missions are only available during a certain time period each day. This period is extended to 22 hours. More details are available in the game client.[/i][/list]

[h2]Personal and Team Progress[/h2]
Completing the missions will earn you Points for both personal and team progress. When you reach certain personal and team milestones, you'll receive rewards.
[list][*]The reward for reaching each stage of personal progress is credited immediately.
[*]The reward for team progress is credited if your personal progress is equal to or higher than the team progress.[/list]
[list]During each stage, you can obtain up to 10 rewards—five for personal progress and five for team progress. To obtain all 10 rewards, you need to earn 1,500 Personal Progress Points and 150,000 Team Progress Points during the week.[/list]
[h2]Earning Points[/h2]
[list][*]Each mission has four completion marks.
[*]Reaching each mark will earn you 20 Points.
[*]In total, you can earn 80 Points per mission.[/list]
If you complete missions more efficiently than other players, then after completing the mission, you’ll receive from 10 to 25 additional Points, as well as see your position in the overall player standings.

The results are summed up when each mission expires, and the teams take their places in the overall team standings. A team is awarded 700; 900; or 1,200 Points per mission, based on its position in the team standings. The position in the overall standings, in turn, depends on the activity of the members of each team.

[h2]Rewards[/h2]
Advancing through the personal and team progress bars can earn you themed British Commanders with 6 skill points; a researchable Tier V British ship ([b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Hawkins[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Emerald[/b][/b], or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Acasta[/b][/b]); a special reward; and a new temporary resource—[b]British Tokens[/b].
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/22e8b6a6-028d-11ed-9783-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
You can collect all the unique rewards by selecting a new team each week. The ships come with all of their modules researched. The first time you earn a unique reward from any team, you'll also receive the Industry Titans achievement.

The unique reward from each team can be obtained several times if you select this team again at the beginning of a new stage and reach a certain mark in terms of personal progress. You can have an unlimited number of the themed British Commanders simultaneously.

If you already have the mentioned ships in your Port, then upon reaching a certain mark on the personal progress bar, you'll receive compensation in Credits equal to the cost of the ship with all of her modules researched.

[h2]British Tokens[/h2]
You can obtain as many as 1,010 British Tokens for free. This will be enough to grab [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Rooke[/b][/b] and a special camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Hawke[/b][/b].
[list][*]760 Tokens for participating in the Industry Titans event
[*]50 Tokens in free daily bundles
[*]200 Tokens in exchange for Community Tokens[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/176b1592-0208-11ed-b189-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]Permanent camouflages only change the ship exterior and do not provide any economic or combat bonuses.[/i][/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d0590f9e-ffe9-11ec-a5d6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
You can also find British Tokens in random bundles available in exchange for Doubloons. Permanent economic bonuses for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Duncan[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] St. Vincent[/b][/b], as well as [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Collingwood[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Duncan[/b][/b], are available in the same bundles.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c4fb1d86-028c-11ed-8f47-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
If you already have permanent economic bonuses for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Duncan[/b][/b] or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] St. Vincent[/b][/b], you'll receive compensation in the form of Doubloons.

[list]In addition to bundles with warships in Early Access, you can exchange British Tokens for expendable economic bonuses and Credits in the Armory.[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/1758e606-0208-11ed-b18a-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]
We come bearing gifts! Stay on the lookout for Community Tokens in this and other articles on our website! You can exchange them in the Armory for containers that hold Premium ships and other items. Stay tuned for more news, and be sure to share the articles with your friends so they can also enjoy claiming gifts!

notes.title: Guide to Separation of Exterior Visuals and Economic Bonuses
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/df3c3d1386547eac1905774dae475af963f25bc8.jpg[/img]
[b]Our game was released almost 7 years ago. Since then, one of the crucial elements of World of Warships—its economy—hasn't changed much in its key aspects.[/b]

Over time, a lot of issues have emerged that are well worth tweaking or improving. Now, we're kicking off a major overhaul of the economic component of the game by separating visual customization from economic bonuses.

[table][tr][th][b][url=#goals]Goals of the New Changes[/url]
[url=#key-changes]Key Changes[/url]
[url=#in-game-economy]Changes to the In-Game Economy[/url]
[url=#interface-changes]Interface Changes[/url]
[url=#other-changes]Other Changes[/url]
[url=#armory]Armory[/url]
[url=#transition-to-the-new-system]Transition to the New System[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=goals][/h1]Goals of the New Changes[/b][/h2]
In the process of making changes to the in-game economy, we committed to an important principle: Our players won't lose their earnings overall, and in certain cases, they will earn even more. We pursued several goals:
[list][*]Offer an option to select economic bonuses and visual elements (camouflages) separately.
[*]Provide an easier way to manage economic bonuses.
[*]Enable a user-friendly transition from the old system to the new one.
[*]Maintain the current state of the in-game economy, i.e., prices and earnings.[/list]
We have improved the interface, bonus management, Inventory display, and much more.
[h2][b][h1=key-changes][/h1]Key Changes[/b][/h2]
Economic bonuses will now act as individual in-game entities that are separate from camouflages and signals. Camouflage patterns will change a ship's exterior only and will be used separately from these bonuses.

The new system will include the following expendable economic bonuses:
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/57d89d5e-01ed-11ed-b460-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Only one expendable economic bonus can be applied to each resource (Credits, Base XP, Free XP, and Commander XP) at the same time. This limitation serves to simplify the way the system works. The values of these bonuses are designed in such a way that they can cover even the most profitable combinations from the current system.

Permanent economic bonuses are purchased and used separately from permanent camouflages, and the effects of these bonuses are applied to a ship's economy on a permanent basis. Expendable bonuses can be used together with permanent bonuses.
[list][i]After the release of the new update, all current economic signals and camouflages will be converted into the new economic bonuses.[/i][/list]
We've made the following changes to the in-game economy:
[list][*]New profitability of Tier IX–X ships.
[*]New principles of earning Free XP and Commander XP.
[*]Increased earning of Credits in Co-op Battles.
[*]The bonus to the reduction in the cost of servicing ships will only be available from the Clan Naval Base.[/list]
The outcome is that camouflages are going to affect the aesthetics of ship exteriors only, so they are being stripped of all combat bonuses they previously offered. The bonus that provided a 3% reduction to detectability range by sea is now included in all ships' tech specs by default. We also removed the bonus that increased the dispersion of incoming enemy shells by 4%.
[h2][b][h1=in-game-economy][/h1]Changes to the In-Game Economy[/b][/h2]
[h2]XP[/h2]
We've significantly increased bonuses that influence gaining Free XP and Commander XP. However, these values are no longer influenced by the bonus applied to Ship XP. The calculations are now simpler, and it will now be easier to understand how to use the system itself.
[list][i]The base amount of earned Free XP has increased from 5% to 10%.[/i][/list]
[h2]Bonus to the Reduction in the Cost of Servicing Ships[/h2]
The expendable bonus to the reduction in the cost of servicing ships is a bonus to Credits by its nature. Its value greatly depends on the tier of a ship it is used with. Therefore, we decided to remove and substitute it. The system has become simpler, and the amount of earned Credits has increased.

Expendable bonuses to the reduction in the cost of servicing ships have been changed from signals or camouflages to a temporary resource that can be exchanged for other bonuses in the Armory.

Bonuses to the reduction in the cost of servicing ships provided by permanent camouflages have been replaced by an equivalent bonus to Credits. Note that it's significantly more beneficial for ships of Tier IX and below. The cost of servicing researchable Tier IX–X ships has been reduced, and the sum of Credits earned in Co-op Battles has been increased a little:
[list][*]The base cost of servicing researchable ships has been reduced from [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]120,000[/b] to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]115,000[/b] Credits for Tier IX ships; from [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]180,000[/b] to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]150,000[/b] Credits for Tier X ships.
[*]In Co-op Battles, the cost of ship servicing has been reduced by 13.3%, and the sum of earned Credits has been increased by 12.5%.[/list]
On average, the sum of earned Credits with a permanent bonus applied to Tier IX–X ships hasn't changed, and it has become even higher for ships of lower tiers. If you play with good combat performance, the sum of earned Credits will be much higher.

[h2]Changes to Basic Earnings[/h2]
Since the very beginning, the XP and Credit reward system used a declining method to reward players for this or that action in the game, i.e., the first actions brought more reward than the following. This made it easier to earn small amounts of XP or Credits and hampered the gain of larger amounts. Starting from this update, we're increasing the amount that will be easier to obtain and slightly decreasing the threshold from which it'll be more difficult to obtain large amounts. For example, it'll be easier to earn a basic amount of [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]200,000[/b] Credits (i.e., Credits before using any modifiers) on Tier X ships. As a comparison, for a Tier X ship with a permanent camouflage:
[list][*]Currently, in Version 0.11.5, the cost of the post-battle service is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]90,000[/b] Credits, the profit is increased by 20%.
[*]In the new system, after all the changes implemented in Update 0.11.6, the cost of the post-battle service will be [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]150,000[/b] Credits, the profit will be increased by 50%.[/list]
Given [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]200,000[/b] Credits, the profit will remain the same. However, if your earnings are higher than the amount above, the new system will be more effective. Given all the new changes, your average amount of earned Credits will remain the same or become even higher.
[h2][b][h1=interface-changes][/h1]Interface Changes[/b][/h2]
[h2]Economic Bonuses Section[/h2]
A new Economic Bonuses section has been added to the Ship Specifications section in the Port. It allows you to see all the economic bonuses applied to your ship.

Clicking the tab will open the Economic Bonuses section in the Port.

You can apply the best expendable bonuses all at once or remove them from the ship.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/068ad088-012b-11ed-863a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/069feeaa-012b-11ed-b5dc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/069f31fe-012b-11ed-a376-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/066fa0ba-012b-11ed-a8ea-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/067d7afa-012b-11ed-9596-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/065dd8d0-012b-11ed-ae2f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][*]Both permanent and expendable bonuses can be applied to your ship simultaneously. In such cases, all bonuses stack up.
[*]Level 1 and level 2 bonuses are available to purchase using Doubloons directly in the Economic Bonuses section.
[*]Level 1 bonuses are available for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]12[/b] Doubloons; level 2 bonuses are available for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]24[/b] Doubloons.[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/68b1357a-012d-11ed-beb4-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2]Auto-Resupply and Auto-Purchasing[/h2]
These are two different entities that have been divided to facilitate the use of large numbers of bonuses. The auto-resupply option will always be enabled, allowing you to have the same bonus automatically applied to the ship after being used if this bonus is available. The use of this option doesn't require you to spend Doubloons.

You can enable the auto-purchase option at your discretion, and it will allow you to automatically purchase bonuses of the first two levels (for example, +20% and +40% Credits) and any camouflages that you expend.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/067b804c-012b-11ed-8b49-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Large to Small Bonus Exchange[/h2]
During the conversion process, we aim to provide the player with more large bonuses, but it may decrease the total number on your account compared to the number of signals and camouflages. If you want to use smaller bonuses more often than larger ones, in a few game updates, you will be able to to exchange them in the Inventory.

The exchange process ensures that the aggregate value of the bonuses is maintained. For example, a +7,200% to Free XP bonus can be divided into three +2,400% bonuses. Each of them can be further divided into four +600% bonuses, and each of them can be divided into two +300% bonuses. Bonuses can only be exchanged for those available in the new system. For example, you can't divide a +100% to XP bonus into two +50% bonuses.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b21f3eea-0138-11ed-a9a3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]To mitigate potential inconveniences related to shifting to the new system, we'll grant you one bonus of every type and value, regardless of what you have at your disposal. Sixteen additional bonuses in total.[/i][/list]
[h2]Exterior Section[/h2]
Along with separating the economic bonuses, we've updated the Camouflages tab in the Exterior section.

Camouflages are divided by themed categories.

Players will always be able to obtain the majority of expendable camouflages, except special camos—co-branded; status; or especially rare, such as Recruiting Station, King of the Sea, or Gold. Available camouflages can be auto-purchased for Credits or obtained from the brand-new More Camouflages container. It will be available as a daily container, can be purchased for Community Tokens, or can be found in various bundles or combat missions.

Camouflages will cost from [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]22,500[/b] to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]90,000[/b] Credits, depending on their category:
[list][*]Standard, e.g., Type 1 or European—[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]22,500[/b] Credits.
[*]Single Color, e.g., Type 21 or Trophy—[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]45,000[/b] Credits.
[*]Abstract, e.g., Ocean Soul or French Riviera—[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]75,000[/b] Credits.
[*]Themed, e.g., Union Jack or Summer—[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]90,000[/b] Credits.[/list]
Some camouflages will become available under the tab as your account access level increases. To have the majority of them displayed, you'll have to obtain these camouflages from any source first. If an expendable camouflage was available on your account but its stock was completely spent before the release of Update 0.11.6, it will be available to obtain in the new system.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ccc1057e-0135-11ed-b17b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ccd18b74-0135-11ed-a64b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cdb30630-0135-11ed-9a4a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cccd9744-0135-11ed-9e1e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
You can sell any of your camouflages, except special ones, in the Inventory. The option to sell special camouflage is going to be added to the game in one of upcoming updates.

The auto-resupply and auto-purchase options will also be available for camouflages.
[h2]Permanent Bonuses and Camouflages[/h2]
Permanent camouflages and permanent economic bonuses can now be obtained separately. The cost of an economic bonus is a little lower than that of a permanent camouflage.
[list][*]The first permanent camouflage that you purchase for a researchable ship in the Exterior section will be available at a discount if you didn't have a permanent camouflage for this ship before the release of Update 0.11.6. This discount will remain in place if you obtain the camouflage for this ship from another source after the release of Update 0.11.6.
[*]The total combined cost of a bonus and the first camouflage is equal to the cost of a permanent camouflage prior to the update.
[*]All subsequently obtained permanent camouflages for the same ship will have the same cost as before.[/list]
Let's take an example. If you have [b] [b][b]X[/b] Yamato[/b][/b] without permanent camouflages and economic bonuses, then:
[list][*]Cost of a permanent economic bonus is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]4,800[/b] Doubloons.
[*]Cost of the first-purchased permanent camouflage is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]4,800[/b] Doubloons lower. For example, the Scorpioid camouflage costs [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]3,200[/b] Doubloons; Type 20—[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]200[/b] Doubloons.
[*]The cost of the second and subsequently purchased permanent camouflages is the same as before. For example, Scorpioid camouflage costs [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]8,000[/b] Doubloons; Type 20—[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]5,000[/b] Doubloons.[/list]
[list]Thus, the value of already available permanent camouflages and economic bonuses remains the same. The first permanent camouflage can now be purchased at a much lower price.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c6fc4cea-0138-11ed-a92a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Permanent camouflages that weren't attached to a ship and could be used with any ship of a specific tier will be converted into two different entities:
[list][*]Permanent economic bonus that corresponds to a standard bonus for the tier.
[*]Permanent camouflage that only effects the visual exterior of the ship.[/list]
These entities do not necessarily have to be bound to the same ship. The camouflage can be bound to one ship and the bonus to another.

[h2]Combat Signals[/h2]
Combat signal management is performed in the Equipment tab.

In addition to changes to the interface and in-game economy, we've also updated the icons for resources, signals, and camouflages.

The total number of combat signals, camouflages, and economic bonuses displayed in the game client includes those already attached to your ships. Now, you'll always be aware of the total sum of your stock—you'll see the total number of signals and camouflages on your account.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d5a7767a-0138-11ed-8300-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=other-changes][/h1]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
[h2]Updated Rewards[/h2]
The large-scale updates and addition of a new entity have resulted in changes to all rewards in the game. Economic and special signals will be replaced by bonuses in combat missions, campaigns, Operations, and collections. The variety of camouflages has been increased, and some camouflages have also been replaced by bonuses.

The contents of all containers with signals or camouflages have changed.
[list][i]After the release of the update, detailed information about the updated rewards will be available in the game client and on our [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/contents-and-drop-rates-of-containers/]website[/url].[/i][/list]
[h2]Clan Base Bonuses[/h2]
Bonuses to Free XP and Commander XP are no longer related to ships' XP. Hence, the Naval Academy provides an XP bonus that doesn't influence other XP types. This has resulted in changes to Clan Base structures.
[list][*]Bonuses to Free XP of all levels provided by the Design Bureau have been doubled. The completed structure will give you +50% Free XP for Tier I–X ships instead of 25%.
[*]The bonus to Commander XP for every level in the Academy has been increased by 1%. The completed structure will give you +15% Commander XP instead of 10%.[/list]
[h2]Premium Account[/h2]
Premium Account provides bonuses to all types of XP and Credits as it did prior to the changes to the system. However, note that XP bonuses no longer effect Free XP and Commander XP.

Just as it did prior to the update, Premium Account still increases the Base XP and Credits you earn. Premium Account will increase your Base XP and Credit earnings in a similar way to the old system.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/8f6d0170-0138-11ed-a9a3-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2]Bonus to XP for the First Victory[/h2]
The bonus for the first victory of the day will give you +50% XP, +50% Free XP, and +50% Commander XP.

[h2]Missouri[/h2]
All players who have a special combat mission for Missouri will obtain an improved permanent Credit bonus instead. Players will receive +40% Credits instead of +10%. This facilitates the bonus tracking process.

[h2]Daily Containers[/h2]
In Update 0.11.6, the following daily containers will be available for all players:
[list][*]More Economic Rewards, which replaces the More Credits container
[*]More Signals
[*]More Coal
[*]Try Your Luck
[*]Brand-new More Camouflages container[/list]
Expendable camouflages have been removed from all daily containers except the More Camouflages and Try Your Luck containers. Containers have been complemented with expendable economic bonuses.

[list][i]Detailed information about contents of containers, their mechanics, and drop rates can be found [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/contents-and-drop-rates-of-containers/]here[/url].[/i][/list]

[h2]Access Levels[/h2]
Apart from that, the following two account access levels are going to be added to support the upcoming changes:
[list][*]Level 5, unlocking signals
[*]Level 7, unlocking economic bonuses for ships[/list]
This means that we're increasing the total number of access levels to 17. At the same time, the total number of battles that need to be fought to unlock all access levels will remain the same. Players won't lose any progress in terms of unlocking access levels. They will receive all missed rewards.

[list][i]You can read about the rewards for unlocking access levels and the required number of battles to unlock them in the game client.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=armory][/h1]Armory[/b][/h2]
[h2]Customizations[/h2]
In the Customizations section, economic signals and expendable camouflages have been replaced by bundles with expendable economic bonuses available for Coal.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/21af1a4c-0138-11ed-9a4a-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2]Naval Community[/h2]
After the release of Update 0.11.6, all permanent camouflages for researchable ships, all expendable camouflages, and the Signal Spoils bundle will cease to be available in the Naval Community section. The tab now holds bundles with economic bonuses and the brand-new More Camouflages container.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/49f4db18-012e-11ed-9b0c-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2]Coupons[/h2]
In August, a new permanent coupon will be implemented in the game. It will provide a discount when purchasing economic bonuses for Coal. The coupon can be used four times until its next reset.

[h2]Economic Bonus Tokens[/h2]
Service cost reduction bonuses from expendable camouflages and signals have been replaced by Economic Bonus Tokens. They can be exchanged in a special section of the Armory for other bonuses until the release of Update 0.11.8. Level 1 bonuses (for example, +20% to Credits) will cost 3 Tokens; level 2 bonuses—6 Tokens; level 3 bonuses—24 Tokens.
[list][i]With the release of Update 0.11.8, these Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]6,000[/b].[/i][/list]
[h3][b]Exchange rate of bonuses for Tokens.[/b][/h3] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7f338964-012e-11ed-b899-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=transition-to-the-new-system][/h1]Transition to the New System[/b][/h2]
With the release of the update, economic bonuses will now act as individual in-game entities that are separate from camouflages and signals. The rules for permanent camouflages, expendable camouflages, and signals are slightly different.

[h2]Permanent Camouflages[/h2]
You will receive permanent bonuses with the best values available from those of your permanent camouflages for specific ships.
[list][*]If you had worse bonuses than the standard ones for a tier, they will be improved accordingly.
[*]The post-battle service cost reduction bonus is replaced by a Credit bonus: For every 2% of service cost reduction, you get +1% Credits.
[*]What if a camouflage didn't apply a bonus to Free XP or Commander XP but applied a bonus to XP per battle? Then, you get not only a bonus to XP per battle but also bonuses to other types of XP.
[*]The permanent camouflage for superships is an exception, and it will provide +200% XP, +200% Commander XP, and +100% Free XP.[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/74936832-01ea-11ed-bee9-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[b][i]1[/i][/b] For researchable ships, permanent bonuses are available for purchase from Tier V. For Premium ships, permanent bonuses are active by default.
[b][i]2[/i][/b] The base cost of servicing researchable Tier IX and X ships has been reduced with the release of Update 0.11.6.
[b][i]3[/i][/b] The value of the bonus is lower because the basic Free XP earnings have been doubled with the release of the update. This means that all bonuses that were previously applied by supership permanent camouflages are higher in the new system.

In addition, there are a number of permanent camouflages with non-standard bonuses:
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b55098e2-01f7-11ed-8fb8-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2]Expendable Camouflages[/h2]
Camouflages will remain on your account, but they will only affect the look of your ships' exteriors. Moreover:
[list][*]Combat bonuses have been removed.
[*]The standard detectability range of all ships has been reduced by 3%.
[*]Removed a bonus that increased shell dispersion by 4%.
[*]Economic bonuses now act as individual in-game entities.[/list]
The bonuses you get depend on the specific camouflage. The general rules are:
[list][*]A bonus to XP per battle is converted into either the same or the next larger one. For example, +100% will become a +100% bonus, and +125% will become +200%.
[*]Bonuses to Commander XP are calculated from bonuses to this type of XP and XP per battle. For example, if a camouflage provides +50% XP per battle and +100% Commander XP, it will increase Commander XP by 150% in the current system. The nearest bonus in the new system is 200%, so exactly this bonus will be given.
[*]Bonuses to Free XP are calculated from bonuses to this type of XP and XP per battle. Keep in mind that Free XP earnings are now twice as large.
[*]What if a camouflage didn't apply a bonus to Free XP or Commander XP but applied a bonus to XP per battle? Then, you get not only a bonus to XP per battle but also bonuses to other types of XP. This is because the bonuses to different types of XP are no longer related to each other.
[*]Bonuses to Credits will be converted into either the same or next larger one. For example, +30% to Credits will become a +40% bonus to Credits.[/list]
[h2]Signals[/h2]
The system before the update made it possible to use several expendable bonuses of the same type at the same time, but the new system allows you to use only one to simplify things. However, we wanted to preserve the ability to achieve high bonus values, so the conversion will work like this:

[h3][b]Step 1[/b][/h3]
First, we check if a player has the maximum possible bonuses of a particular type on their account. For example, a complete "set" of special signals for Credits would be the Scylla, Leviathan, Basilisk, and Wyvern signals.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/2221e11c-0138-11ed-842c-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Step 2[/b][/h3]
One signal can fall within in several such sets. For example, Hydra provides a bonus to all types of XP. In this case, we count how many of the different sets the signals fall within. The number of received bonuses of each type is equal to the minimum number of signals required for the bonus. For example, if you have 100 Scylla, Leviathan, and Basilisk signals, but only 80 Wyvern signals, you will receive 80 bonuses to Credits.

[h3][b]Step 3[/b][/h3]
Bonuses from signals in sets are counted individually.

[h3][i][h3][b]Example[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
Let's suppose an account has 250 Leviathan signals. Let's assume that, taking into account other signals, it participates in sets the following number of times:
[table][tr][th][b]XP[/b][/th][th][b]Commander XP[/b][/th][th][b]Free XP[/b][/th][th][b]Credits[/b][/th][/tr] [tr][td]100[/td] [td]80[/td] [td]50[/td] [td]150[/td][/tr][/table]
Subtract these values from the total number of Leviathan signals to get the number of bonuses of each type that will participate in further conversion:
[table][tr][th][b]XP[/b][/th][th][b]Commander XP[/b][/th][th][b]Free XP[/b][/th][th][b]Credits[/b][/th][/tr] [tr][td]250 — 100 = 150[/td] [td]250 — 80 = 170[/td] [td]250 — 50 = 200[/td] [td]250 — 150 = 100[/td][/tr][/table]
After calculating the number of bonuses for sets, the remaining signals are converted into bonuses according to the following table:
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/2259a71e-0138-11ed-adff-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[b]*[/b] The bonus to Free XP is provided taking into account the bonus to XP and the doubling of Free XP earnings with the release of the changes.

[h2]Merging Bonuses[/h2]
After the conversion, the bonuses received at the last step are merged according to the table below. This helps to take into account combinations of several signals from the old system that were not taken into account by full sets. Rounding up is applied if the bonuses are not sufficient in number. For example, if there are only two +200% XP bonuses, one +800% bonus will be given.

Bonuses for sets are not combined.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/6cfdab0c-012f-11ed-b899-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2]Service Cost Reduction[/h2] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/218f04dc-0138-11ed-a64b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2]Flags[/h2]
A small number of flags have economic bonuses. These are mainly flags for members of various volunteer programs, as well as for winners of the King of the Sea tournament. In the new system, these bonuses are not tied to the flags and are always active if they are available on an account.

There are three such "global" bonuses in total. The "For Personal Merits" bonus is always active.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/21ba04c0-0138-11ed-a2e3-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]The winners of the latest King of the Sea tournament receive a level 3 bonus.
[*]Those who have one flag with economic bonuses, except the King of the Sea flag, receive a level 1 bonus.
[*]Those who have more than one flag with economic bonuses, except the King of the Sea flag, receive a level 2 bonus.[/list]

notes.title: Ranked Battles: Season 8
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c63263adb85b9b91a6935fd62a4a1e0080de49f1.jpg[/img]
[b]Update 0.11.6 kicks off the new Ranked Battles season.[/b]
[list][*]Earn Doubloons, Steel, camouflages, and special containers.
[*]Ranked Tokens are awarded for achieving Rank 1 in the Gold League.
[*]Stock up on Tokens and purchase rare permanent camouflages![/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#rewards]Rewards[/url]
[url=#rules]Rules[/url]
[url=#bonus-combat-mission]Bonus Combat Mission[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=rewards][/h1]Rewards[/b][/h2]
The rewards for each league refresh and become available again at the start of each new Sprint.

Due to the separation of visual exterior elements and economic bonuses for ships, the rewards for each league have been changed.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/20412c66-feba-11ec-80b6-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list]Reaching Rank 1 will reward you with Bronze, Silver, and Gold League containers. Reaching Rank 1 in the Bronze League will reward you with 10x Bronze camouflages.[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/20255e1e-feba-11ec-a50d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=rules][/h1]Rules[/b][/h2] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/bb044c7c-fed0-11ec-8e5a-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]
[h2]Format[/h2]
This season, all leagues involve Tier X ships fighting in a 6 vs. 6 format.

Compared to the previous season, the number of Stars required to complete the Gold League has increased. To achieve Rank 1, players will now need to earn one additional Star.

[h2]Game Maps and Modes[/h2]
The Atlantic, Fault Line, Trap, Land of Fire, Northern Lights, Okinawa, Trident, Loop, Warrior's Path, and Haven.
[list][i]Battles on all maps are fought in Domination mode.[/i][/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9d9a5314-feb9-11ec-bdc9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9da0e026-feb9-11ec-86ad-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9e489992-feb9-11ec-ad40-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9e475582-feb9-11ec-a50d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9e42e042-feb9-11ec-b7f9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9e44f486-feb9-11ec-a831-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9daf9292-feb9-11ec-900f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9fe8c16e-feb9-11ec-900f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9daa733e-feb9-11ec-b84a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9da4e086-feb9-11ec-adc3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]Season Structure[/h2]
The season is divided into six Sprints, each lasting 2 weeks. Each new Sprint starts immediately after the end of the previous one.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/201a02d0-feba-11ec-86ad-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]After qualifying, you can continue to play in the next league without having to wait for the start of a new Sprint.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=bonus-combat-mission][/h1]Bonus Combat Mission[/b][/h2]
A special combat mission is available with the start of the season: Earn 1,500 Base XP in Ranked Battles to receive two Gift containers.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ac61df4a-feb7-11ec-b05d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: How It Works 2.0: In-Game Mechanics
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2831318129][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f1a50a09719bf17f287d49c66caa9f833aae7dc3.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]Our favorite game isn't resting on its laurels—each fresh update brings new ships or mechanics, as well as interface improvements or new game modes.[/b]

Given that the game is constantly changing, video tutorials can quickly become outdated, much like update release notes, for example. For this reason, we've revitalized the series of How It Works tutorial videos!
[list][i][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/how-it-works-20-game-basics/]The first episode[/url] will be useful for beginners who are learning the basics of the game.[/i][/list]
Today, we're going to tell you about some important in-game mechanics. You'll learn how to interpret the damage counter, get an understanding of what benefits different crosshairs provide, find out why you should switch between different shell types, and discover loads more useful details.
