[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/86644d357fdb289c0d71fcee5fee598808ec0377.png[/img]
[b][b]Captains[/b][/b][b]![/b]

Last May, we held a special Q&A session on the official World of Warships Discord server where members could ask their most their most desired questions on the topic of maps and game modes. We’ve compiled our dev team’s answers to your most popular queries right here in this article.

[list]Want to take part in future Q&A activities and more? Sign up to our Discord by following the instructions [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/community/discord-dev-q-n-a/#new]here[/url].[/list]  [hr][/hr]
[h3][b]Why are new maps so rare?[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b1cab7c2-d1e4-11ec-80f1-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

It's true that the rate of introduction of new maps used to be faster than it is now. The main reason for this change of pace is that shortly after release, World of Warships had relatively few maps, so we needed to expand the pool as soon as possible. Currently, since we now have a good number of varied maps (34, not counting those linked to temporary events), and since we are constantly updating existing maps according to newest graphics technologies (like updating maps to HD), the production of new ones is no longer as high on our list of priorities. Regardless, we will continue working on releasing new maps and are currently planning to release them at a rate of 1–2 new maps every year.

For example, Update 0.11.5 will bring Faroe Islands—a map with a visual theme that was chosen by players in autumn 2021. Also, in our recent roadmap publication showcasing our development plans for summer–autumn 2022, we announced another new map that will be developed this year.

[h3][b]Will Epicenter be reworked / reintroduced?[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/dd2abcf4-89b0-11ec-a65b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

From our point of view, the main issue with Epicenter is not the pace of the battles, but the fact that all 24 ships converge on one point. This, in turn, significantly lowers the variety of gameplay and increases the density of interaction between ships, making this game mode unsatisfactory for the majority of players.

The ending phase of a battle in the new Arms Race mode is, in a way, the successor of Epicenter—players have to conquer one Key Area in the center of the map. However, Arms Race doesn't carry over Epicenter's gameplay issues—the Key Area appears only in the final stage of the battle, when players are already spread across the map, and the number of the ships still afloat has decreased significantly.

To answer your question, we do not currently have any plans to rework and bring back Epicenter. We are now focused on developing new game modes.

[h3][b]Are there any statistically unbalanced maps? What about Ocean?[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/16939ce4-f168-11ec-9ac9-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]

The "Ideal" winrate for each spawn in Random battles is 50%, and on most of our maps, it's more or less what we have. For example, in the last month, the maps with the most significant winrate variation according to spawns are "Northern Lights" and "Ocean," where the northern spawn has a 51.8% winrate. However, such a difference in winrate is statistically insignificant because the winrate of a certain team is not carved in stone. Fluctuations according to certain spawns, even up to 2–3%, are within the norm in terms of game balance.

As for the competitive modes, the situation is not fundamentally different, and the fluctuation in the winrate of the different spawns is no more than 2% which is within the norm.

That's why we don't currently have any maps with one spawn in Random Battles having the upper hand. We will of course continue to monitor these stats and make changes to maps if it's deemed necessary.

[h3][b]Will the game’s engine ever be swapped for another?[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/d1683e82-b584-11ec-bfb5-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

We are constantly improving our engine. For example, the water system, the forest system, and the visibility system have been completely rewritten. An underwater world appeared. The game switched to DX11. Now, a new animation system is being implemented. In fact, there are no systems that have been left unchanged, and it's already basically a different engine than the one we started with.

There are still more technological changes in various stages of readiness that will further increase performance and take the game's visuals to the next level.

We recognize that incremental changes may not look as spectacular, but it's our position to bring improvements to players as soon as they are ready.

The development potential of our engine is still great. At the moment, we see limitations not on the engine's side, but in the need to support the full range of hardware available to our players. Many effective solutions are not available on GPUs or CPUs older than 6–7 years, which is a significant part of the World of Warships audience’s hardware.

When it comes to comparing the World of Warships and World of Tanks engines, there are significant differences, primarily due to the scale of the maps and the fact that significant resources are spent on rendering the ocean in World of Warships. These key features affect the rest of the solutions used in our engine and differentiate it from the World of Tanks engine.

[h3][b]What happened to the Breakthrough mode and the map Bering Sea?[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5affd64e-0bf5-11ec-81fc-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[url=https://medium.com/@devblogwows/st-new-map-92df993a4e97]This map[/url] was originally developed and tested with the express aim of having it host a non-standard battle type where both teams spawned in close proximity to each other, thereby promoting aggressive tactics in battle. However, testing results and player feedback showed that, at the time, this concept was not very suitable for our game. As a result, development of the map itself was halted. Perhaps in the future, we will return to work on this map and implement the ideas mentioned above.

[h3][b]Was Dirigible Derby successful? Will it ever appear in Random Battles?[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/af6af810-8a64-11ec-a67e-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

We used several indicators to assess the success of the mode, including the number of players who took part, the time spent in the mode, our own assessment, and the feedback we received. The results of Dirigible Derby were quite positive, and players have warmly embraced the mode. We are currently planning to bring it back to the main server as a temporary mode towards the end of year, and if its second appearance is as successful as the first, we will definitely consider adding it to Random Battles in the future.

[h3][b]Do you keep competitive play in mind when creating new maps?[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b3b029e6-d1e4-11ec-a003-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

It's worth realizing that not all modes are designed for competitive activities, and the feasibility of adding a mode to these battle types is not a requirement when creating them. However, if the format of the new mode is potentially suitable for competitive activities, we do consider adding it there in the future. When adapting a mode for competitive activities, we usually do not change the key rules and only change the settings, such as the number and location of Key Areas, the number of points for capturing and holding them, the spawn locations, etc., as is done in Clan or Ranked Battles with the Domination mode used in Random Battles as well.

[h3][b]Will we see night battles like on Operation Cherry Blossom again?[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/37abf5ac-f163-11ec-81d2-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]

As we pointed out in the last Q&A session, we have some ideas for implementing nighttime as a visual effect on the map.

However, at the moment we have no plans set in stone for nighttime specifically as a "gameplay mechanic." This is due to the fact that it limits visibility, which is currently handled quite well by the weather system in World of Warships.

However, in the future, we are going to explore ways to add/improve new effects similar to local weather, and perhaps night battles will become a part of those improvements.

[h3][b]Are there any new Operations planned? Anything for Tiers VIII, IX, and X?[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9fe05ddc-21db-11ec-bf48-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

This year, we will return the previously withdrawn Operations to the game. We plan not only to return them but also to make them—and the ones currently available—playable for different ship tiers (at first, it will be Tier VI–VIII ships). At the same time, bot ships will not change, but they will get specific bonuses to their characteristics depending on the setup of the player team. If it goes well, in the future, we will expand operations to higher ship tiers. For now, the feature is still in development, so unfortunately, we cannot reveal all the details, but we will definitely share new information with you as soon as everything is ready. Stay tuned!

As for new Operations, we don't have any final plans yet. We will wait for the old Operations to be released on the Live Server, and then we will collect statistics and player feedback on all of the upcoming changes to determine the fate of this battle type. If Operations are popular with players, there’s a good chance we’ll go back to creating new ones.

[h3][b]Can we expect to see old temporary modes such as Bathtub or Torpedo Beat return?[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9fe1906c-21db-11ec-ade5-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Speaking of bringing back old modes, it is worth realizing that bringing them back often requires significant development resources to update the mode to the current version of the game, fixing bugs, testing, and gameplay tweaks. This year, we have already brought back Savage Battle, and so far, we have no plans to bring back other old modes. Instead, we are concentrating our resources on updating Operations, as we outlined in our Summer and Fall 2022 plans. We plan to bring back the improved Cherry Blossom, Hermes, and The Ultimate Frontier, and we are also considering bringing back the themed Operation Terror of the Deep as part of the Halloween event. As for the game's temporary modes, right now, we're more focused on refining the newer ones like Dirigible Derby and Convoy rather than updating old ones. It's possible that some beloved old modes will return to the game, but not this year. Stay tuned!

Rather, the challenge for us is that in reality naval battles took place far away from islands, and in creating the look of the map we need to make sure that the islands and other objects on the maps—while fulfilling their gameplay functions—look organic and do not interfere with the atmosphere.

[h3][b]Would it be possible to have a feature allowing teams queued for Clan Battles to see the next map?[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/1447ba9a-f16a-11ec-a5af-ac162d70f4e4.png[/img]

We have no plans to add such a feature at the moment. This is because its introduction will cause serious problems for the matchmaker, as teams with different maps for the next battle will be placed in separate queues. For example, in the 17th Clan Battles season, there will be six maps available, and each map will have its own queue, which will increase the waiting time of battles and significantly worsen the gaming experience in Clan Battles. In the Hurricane League, for example, the waiting time for a battle can become significantly longer, as the number of Clans reaching it is relatively small.

[h3][b]Could we have pickable spawn points before battle?[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4b2b7be6-72c6-11ec-b598-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Adding the ability to choose a specific spawn would immediately lead to a number of problems, the most important of which would be:
[list][*]An imbalance in the number and classes of ships on either flank.
[*]Competition between players for grabbing certain spawn points will become a cause of conflict.[/list]
This would lead to discomfort for players and have a negative impact on the quality of battles. Therefore, we have no plans to add such mechanics, at least in Random Battles.

[h3][b]Is there a system in place that could prevent a player from getting the same map twice in a row?[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e83bb3fc-e88b-11ec-b383-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In fact, such a restriction is already present in Clan Battles and prevents your Clan from hitting the same map several times in a row. Unfortunately, introducing such a system for other types of combat is complicated by the fact that with it, each player would have a different set of recently played maps. Picking, for example, 24 players for a Random Battle with the same set of map restrictions would be a serious challenge for the matchmaker. As a result, players would have to wait in queue for a long time and ship setups in teams would be less balanced. Therefore, we do not yet plan to introduce such a system for the other main battle types besides Clan Battles

[h3][b]Could we have dynamic maps with erupting volcanos or moving / destructible icebergs? [/b][/h3]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3c5376ee-a059-11ec-8f19-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

Yes, we have planned and even tested a prototype of destructible icebergs and even announced it in the Development Blog. However, the development of such dynamically changing objects was complicated by a number of technical problems and limitations. Therefore, while we are working on the necessary fixes and improvements, the idea of dynamically changing maps has been temporarily shelved in favor of higher priority features such as improved Operations and new game modes. We'll be sure to let you know when we get back to working on such mechanics.

[h3][b]Would it be possible to have larger maps with larger / more teams in Random Battles?[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3762c33c-f163-11ec-bfe7-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]

The limit of maximum 12 players per team in our game is due to a number of factors, the main ones being balance and technical limitations:
[list][*]All ships in the game are initially balanced for exactly this maximum number of ships in battle.
[*]Changing the number of ships would lead to either an increase of firing density or to situations where the dynamics of battle would be significantly reduced due to the increased size of maps that would be necessary (because, for example, even more time would be required to change flanks).
[*]Every additional ship in a battle increases the load on the server. Therefore, we do not plan to increase the number of ships in battle, unless there is a clear gameplay need for this.[/list]
Even if we hypothetically changed our approach and decide to increase the number of ships in a battle, this would require a significant change to many of our existing maps, which does not seem to be feasible. Redesigning a map would require moving and reshaping all the objects on it and the map would not look like itself anymore. It would therefore be easier to create a new map for the larger teams' format.

Regarding creating new maps: We already have experience creating large maps, such as the Polygon for the Big Hunt event.

Therefore, in theory, creating a map specifically for large format battles is not a problem for our team and would require approximately the same resources and time as creating any other map: creating visual style, placing islands, planning key areas and spawns, testing, etc.

However, once again we do not have any plans to act on this front at the moment.

[h3][b]Could we see classic modes such as Capture the flag, King of the Hill, or Last Man Standing in WoWS?[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3826f1da-f163-11ec-b724-ac162d70f4e4.png[/img]

If we consider the modes you mentioned in the context of adding them as main modes, a number of obstacles to their implementation are immediately apparent:
[list][*]Capture the flag does not really fit into the mechanics of our game—ship speeds and distances are not well suited for it, and the detectability system in World of Warships may further unpleasantly complicate the gameplay in such a mode. Additionally, Capture the Flag would involve ships respawning, which is not present in the main modes of World of Warships.
[*]King of the hill—for the time being, we decided to remove Epicenter from the Live Servers, which is essentially a variation of this mode.
[*]Last Man Standing—this is essentially a free-for-all mode, which does not suit our game very much, as a lot in World of Warships is tied to teamwork.[/list]
However, despite the obstacles and limitations described above, these are quite interesting mode concepts. We could probably implement them in World of Warships, but only as temporary entertainment modes with special settings. We have no such plans at the moment, but they are great ideas for the future.

[h3][b]Any chance of implementing community-designed maps into the game?[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3c86e57e-a059-11ec-8888-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

Perhaps in the future we will conduct a contest for new map ideas among the players, but it should be understood that the complete creation of new maps is a complex process that requires balancing and thorough testing using various tools that only the developers have access to. Therefore, such activities require careful preparation and close cooperation between development and players, and we have already tried something like that. For example, players had the opportunity to influence the development of a map by choosing the visual theme for it, as we already did in the autumn of 2021. We were very happy to see the high level of activity and interest of players in participating in the map design process, so we have some ideas for similar activities in the future.

In addition, it is worth bearing in mind that gameplay features of new maps are developed largely on the basis of feedback from the participants in the various testing phases. Therefore, in a way, players are already involved in the creation process of new maps.

[h3][b]How long does it take to create a new map, from start to finish?[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b3234056-f6c7-11eb-b9f6-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Creating a new map is a long and complex process. There are two main stages:

The first is creating a gameplay prototype of the map and testing it. At this stage, the map has no visuals and testing is only for its gameplay, depending on the location of Key Areas and islands. At this point, it is important that the location and shape of the islands as well as the positions of the key areas do not give a significant advantage to either team. This stage usually takes 1–2 months. If initial testing is successful, the map moves on to the next stage of production, and if the concept of the map cannot be balanced or has significant flaws, the development and testing of another prototype begins.

The second stage is the creation of the appearance of the map—the biome, textures, and the underwater world. With our transition to HD maps, this part has become technically more complicated, so development takes about 4 months. The underwater world is created in parallel with the surface world, as this is more convenient, and we avoid the complicated process of combining them, and it is impossible to allocate a separate term for creating the underwater world.

Once these steps have been completed, the map goes through the standard testing procedure as part of the next update, after which it will be released. This means that, on average, it takes at least 6 months to create a new map.

[h3][b]Have maps inspired by historical battles ever been considered?[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/37804902-f163-11ec-9222-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]

Right now, we are working on a map idea with a design inspired by a famous historical battle. However, it is still in the early phases of design, and we are now at the stage of choosing a suitable historical event. This is complicated by the fact that we need to choose an event that is easy to identify based on the visual style of the map and at the same time fits well with the gameplay features of our game, such as the number of ships in battle, the size of the map itself, the location of the Key Areas, etc. As soon as we find the right event and decide on the concept of the map, we will share it with you.

[h3][b]Are there any map themes or biomes that have never been used due to technical limitations?[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/382acea4-f163-11ec-8684-ac162d70f4e4.png[/img]

We have no such technical limitations. World of Warships already has a wide variety of biomes representing different geographical zones. Battles take place in Arctic ice, tropical zones, and among desert islands. What's more, battles have been transported to fantastical and futuristic locations, as well as to a post-apocalyptic world and even into space during various temporary events!

Captains, thank you for participating in the first round of Public Test for Update 0.11.6! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!
[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Added the ability to browse, sell and convert economic bonuses in the Inventory.
[*]While converting signal sets into economic bonuses, now only special signals are taken into account. Economic signals are converted separately. Thus, owners of special signals on the Live server will be able to get more economic bonuses of the third and fourth level.
[list][*]The Economic Bonus [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/economic-bonus-calculator/]Calculator[/url] will be updated along with this change.[/list]

notes.content:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2825263433][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5ac71fa982af5a9dad9d2af2ca00d83478d25c92.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]Don't miss the current sale—it might be the last one for them! There are big discounts on bundles, as well as Commanders with unique voiceovers and new camouflages. You can also get collection containers and other rewards by completing combat missions.[/b]

[h2][b][h1=commanders-and-permanent-camouflages][/h1]Commanders and Permanent Camouflages[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Bundles are available until:[/b] [b]Thu. 14 Jul. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

The "Transformers: Large Bundle" is available in the Armory and Premium Shop. It provides themed permanent camouflages and all Transformers Commanders with unique voiceovers and 10 skill points.
[list]You can have an unlimited number of identical Transformers Commanders with unique voiceovers simultaneously.[/list]
[list][i]Commanders! There is a mistake in bonuses of “Messenger of Oblivion” for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Bismarck[/b][/b] and “Lord of the Seekers” for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_9f372d47b4fa5b5bbd79a3aaac816cb8d5343fa93949cce8934d94b84751b88e.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] August von Parseval[/b][/b] permanent camouflages: they have [b]+50% credits[/b] bonus but should have [b]+50% XP bonus[/b] instead.
We plan to fix this mistake this night, and these permanent camouflages will provide standard economic bonuses.
Players who’ve obtained these camos in any way before [i]23:59 UTC 25th of June[/i] are eligible for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]5000[/b] doubloon refunds irrespective of discounts until the release of 0.11.6. The refund only affects these two camouflages, so other items from the bundles are not touched.
We are sorry for the inconvenience.[/i][/list]
If you would like to entrust your ship to the [b]Autobots[/b], the Armory and Premium Shop are offering a bundle that holds Autobot Commanders with unique voiceovers and 10 skill points, as well as themed permanent camouflages, including the following new ones: King of Primitives for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Richelieu[/b][/b], Hot Racer for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Edinburgh[/b][/b], Gold Bug for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Fletcher[/b][/b], and Freedom Fighter for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Iowa[/b][/b].
The [b]Decepticons[/b] are ready to set your sails too—a bundle is available in the Armory and Premium Shop that provides Decepticon Commanders with unique voiceovers and 10 skill points, as well as themed permanent camouflages, including the following new ones: Messenger of Oblivion for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Bismarck[/b][/b]; Crush 'n' Destroy for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Tashkent[/b][/b]; Lord of the Seekers for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_9f372d47b4fa5b5bbd79a3aaac816cb8d5343fa93949cce8934d94b84751b88e.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] August von Parseval[/b][/b]; and Superior for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Amalfi[/b][/b].
[list]The new permanent camouflages can be obtained separately.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f4dae590-d825-11ec-90cd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f6085218-d825-11ec-8139-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f5d399a6-d825-11ec-9e8c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f60b8866-d825-11ec-87dd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f4dd1af4-d825-11ec-afe4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f4d6555c-d825-11ec-ae56-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f57fd1a4-d825-11ec-83a0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f60dba1e-d825-11ec-b18e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]When the Gold Bug permanent camouflage is mounted on [b] [b][b]IX[/b] Fletcher[/b][/b], the turret armor is disconnected from the hull armor. This bug does not affect the battle performance of the ship. Please accept our apologies. We will fix it in one of the closest updates.[/i][/list]
Besides this, the Autobot Ark and Decepticon Disguise camouflages are available in the Armory.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2060370/World_of_Warships__Transformers_Autobot_Camouflage_Stockpile/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2060371/World_of_Warships__Transformers_Decepticon_Camouflage_Stockpile/
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3d7fba08-f20e-11ec-89d4-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3d807510-f20e-11ec-9ac9-ac162d70f4e4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h3][i][h3][b]Bonuses provided by the camouflages[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
[h3][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/camouflage/PCEC098_DecepticonCamo_fdc1a3efc1a4378c7cb46b4a0173da7a9f324e37c92cc787e2e7ef51789c1487.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/camouflage/PCEC097_AutobotCamo_19ae44e5efc1c805e1f95542fb2685656003d731467cd3fb9d1b8e60a4d83b02.png[/img]Autobot Ark and Decepticon Disguise camouflages[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]−3%[/b] to the ship's detectability range by sea
[*][b]+4%[/b] to the dispersion of shells fired by enemies at your ship
[*][b]+100%[/b] Commander XP per battle
[*][b]+100%[/b] XP per battle[/list][hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=containers][/h1]Containers[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Bundles are available until:[/b] [b]Thu. 14 Jul. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

A bundle with Cybertronian and "The Transformers: The Movie 35th Anniversary" [b]Premium containers[/b] is available in the Armory and Premium Shop.

[h3][i][h3][b]Cybertronian Premium container contents[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b348bffa-f2d6-11ec-b11d-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]3x Autobot Ark camouflages — 100%
[*]One item from the list below — 100%. Breakdown:
[list][*]7x signals of the same type (Dragon, Wyvern, Red Dragon, Ouroboros, Hydra, Basilisk, Scylla, or Leviathan) — 56%

[h2][b][h1=british-battleships][/h1]British Battleships[/b][/h2]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3661b6cc-f0a1-11ec-b1e3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/36647722-f0a1-11ec-ac82-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/36626f68-f0a1-11ec-a487-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/365d63f6-f0a1-11ec-879e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/35c8a478-f0a1-11ec-ab99-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/35c499aa-f0a1-11ec-b742-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/35c46638-f0a1-11ec-a816-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/35c8d0b0-f0a1-11ec-8eb6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
Update 0.11.6 launches a whole new branch of Tier III to X British battleships into Early Access. Equipped with powerful torpedoes and main guns that don’t have a particularly long reach, the new sea giants will show their worth at medium- to knife-duel distances. The Repair Party consumable they have on board regenerates a decent chunk of any lost HP.

The battleships carry HE shells with standard penetration capabilities, their accuracy is fairly average, and the AP shells they fire have a typically British fuse time. Their main batteries are solid enough, with calibers reaching up to 457 mm at Tier X. Ships of Tiers V and above can take advantage of Engine Boost. Starting from Tier VI, these battleships will be a bitter bite for aircraft as they get Defensive AA Fire; starting from Tier IX, Repair Party is swapped for Specialized Repair Teams.

[list][i]The new British battleships won't be available on the Public Test server.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=industry-titans][/h1]Industry Titans[/b][/h2]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/12c88c86-f0a6-11ec-9c9f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1261a6e2-f0a6-11ec-a816-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/12c21176-f0a6-11ec-a1e7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/127c9786-f0a6-11ec-9be3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1243b466-f0a6-11ec-8c4d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
One of the key new features of the update is a temporary event called Industry Titans. The [b]Chatham[/b], [b]Elswick[/b], and [b]Clydebank[/b] shipyards will compete for the right to be called the best shipbuilder serving the needs of the Royal Navy.

Make your choice and lend your support to one of the shipyards! Keep in mind that each shipyard will be offering its own unique reward—a British Commander with 6 skill points and a researchable British Tier V ship ([b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Hawkins[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Emerald[/b][/b], or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Acasta[/b][/b]).
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b68920e-f0a7-11ec-a2ff-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The Titans of Industry event is similar to previous events that we’ve held, including the New Year's Eve, Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry, Battle of the Beasts, and Clash of Courage events.

[list]Dive into the event on the Live Server to earn [b]British Tokens[/b] that you can be exchange for Early Access ships, permanent camouflages, and other items.[/list]
The Port of London has been updated to celebrate the event.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7a02966a-f12f-11ec-a811-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7a21f884-f12f-11ec-b2ea-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7a261a5e-f12f-11ec-bbf4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=separation][/h1]Separation of Exterior Visuals and Economic Bonuses[/b][/h2]
Update 0.11.6 kicks off a major overhaul of the economic component of the game by separating the visual element from economic bonuses.



While working on the update, we aimed to achieve several goals:
[list][*]Offer an option to select economic bonuses and visual elements (camouflages) separately.
[*]Simplify management of economic bonuses.
[*]Make sure the transition from the old system to the new one is as comfortable as possible.
[*]Maintain the current state of the in-game economy in terms of costs and earnings.[/list]
[list]We’ve improved the interface, bonus management, Inventory display, and much more! The key principle behind this effort is that you as players [i]do not lose[/i] in your overall earnings. In certain scenarios, you actually [i]gain even more[/i] than before.[/list]
Below is a brief list of the key changes. For a deeper look into the separation process, please refer to our [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/327]Development Blog[/url].

[h3][i][h3][b]List of Changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
[list][*]Economic bonuses will now act as individual in-game entities that are separate from camouflages and signals. Camouflage patterns will change a ship's exterior only and will be applied separately from these bonuses.
[*]Bonuses to XP will have no effect on Free XP and Commander XP. To compensate for this, we have changed all permanent and expendable economic bonuses.
[*]Basic Free XP earnings are now twice as large.
[*]Economic bonuses from permanent camouflages are purchased separately, and their effect will be applied towards a ship's economy on a permanent basis. Expendable bonuses can also be added on top of permanent ones.
[*]Only one economic bonus can be applied towards each of the resources (Credits, combat XP, Free XP, and Commander XP) at the same time. This limitation serves to simplify the way the system works. The values of these bonuses are designed in a way that they can cover even the most profitable combinations from the current system.
[*]Instead of reducing the post-battle service cost, permanent camouflages will provide a bonus to Credits so that your average earnings either remain unchanged or grow.
[*]The service cost for Tier IX and X researchable ships has been reduced from [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]120,000[/b] to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]115,000[/b] and from [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]180,000[/b] to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]150,000[/b] Credits, respectively.
[*]To account for the changes to bonuses applied towards service costs, the current service cost in Co-op Battles will be additionally reduced by [b]13.3%[/b] while Credits earnings will grow by [b]12.5%[/b].
[*]We want camouflages to affect ship exteriors only, so we’re removing all the combat bonuses they used to offer. The bonus that provided a [b]3%[/b] reduction in the detectability range by sea is now included in all ships' tech specs by default. We also removed the bonus that increased the dispersion of incoming enemy shells by [b]4%[/b].
[*]At present, the number of signals and camouflages displayed in the Exterior tab does not include those currently mounted on your ships. When this change goes live, you will always know the exact number of reserves you have in stock—the total number of signals and camouflage patterns you have on your account will be displayed.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f6e613c8-f12f-11ec-ad63-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f6ec0152-f12f-11ec-bbf4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f6e5ce86-f12f-11ec-972c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f6ebb0da-f12f-11ec-b67d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
This change, along with the addition of the new in-game entity, entails a revision of all rewards in the game. In combat missions, campaigns, Operations, and collections—economic and special signals will be replaced with bonuses. Camouflages will also be supplemented with bonuses.
[list][i]The contents of all containers that drop signals or camouflages will also change.[/i][/list]
Apart from that, the following two account access levels are going to be added to support the upcoming changes:
[list][*]Level 5, unlocking combat bonuses for a ship
[*]Level 7, unlocking economic bonuses for a ship[/list]
It means that we’re increasing the total number of access levels to 17. At the same time, the total number of battles that need to be played to unlock the access levels will not change. All of your current progress toward unlocking access levels will be retained, meaning that you won't lose any progress and will still get any due rewards.
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=ai-updates][/h1]AI Updates[/b][/h2]
In Update 0.11.6, we've substantially upgraded the AI behind our bot ships in Training and Co-op Battles.
[list][*]We’ve enhanced the AI responsible for bots moving, firing, and using consumables in Training Battles.
[*]In Co-op Battles, AI-controlled aircraft carriers will now move to the nearest Key Area if only a few surviving allies are left in battle.
[*]Bots will now be less likely to ram one another or strike islands in Co-op Battles.[/list] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=updates-to-us-destroyer-models][/h1]Updates to U.S. Destroyer Models[/b][/h2]
In Update 0.11.6, we’re continuing to update the American destroyers. This time, new models are being added for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] notes.title: The Faroe Islands Are Already in the Game!
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2821691576][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/528de8d2d4719fccfaef247ed43567b16b1f106c.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]In autumn of 2021, you helped us choose the visual style for the new map.[/b]

This was followed by long months of preparation and meticulous work. Finally, the Faroe Islands map has been introduced into World of Warships and is ready for battle!

[table][tr][th][b][url=#tiers-and-modes]Tiers and Modes[/url]
[url=#map-appearance]Map Appearance[/url]
[url=#how-to-play]How to play[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=XcQKuVeKZMA;full][/previewyoutube] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=tiers-and-modes][/h1]Tiers and Modes[/b][/h2]
The Faroe Islands map has been designed for battles involving Tier VII–X ships, as well as superships.

It can be found in two game modes: Domination with three Key Areas and Domination with four Key Areas.
[table][tr][td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2f2d6b08-ec91-11ec-9e8d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2f2d6b08-ec91-11ec-9e8d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2f289d4e-ec91-11ec-941c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2f289d4e-ec91-11ec-941c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][/td] [td][/td][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=map-appearance][/h1]Map Appearance[/b][/h2]
Battles will take place among flowing mountains covered with a thin layer of snow and islands with steep shores. Visually, the map is divided into two parts—the eastern part, covered with snow and ice, and the less snowy center and western part. When creating the map, we were inspired not only by the climate but also by the sights of the Faroe archipelago.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/79a835ac-ec8f-11ec-b65d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/79a8404c-ec8f-11ec-926b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
There are many small crystal-clear icebergs in the snowy part. At the base of the mountain in the southeastern part, you can see waterfalls covered in ice and a small snow-covered settlement. Drangarnir is a large gate-shaped cliff located in the eastern part of the map. Nearby, you can see a small ship in the ice-covered waters.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/79a4b0ee-ec8f-11ec-9c57-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/79a460d0-ec8f-11ec-913c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
Close to that is an island with a high wedge-shaped cliff, which resembles another attraction of the Faroe Islands—Tindhólmur. Take a closer look—you will see a small weather station on top of the cliff.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7a43be50-ec8f-11ec-a085-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Move closer to the center and pay attention to the island with numerous geothermal sources from which steam is constantly emitted. In the northwestern part of the map, at the base of another peak, you can find a small settlement with well-groomed green fields. A football field for the town's residents to spend their leisure time is also nearby. In real life, about 20 football stadiums have been built on the territory of the Faroe Islands.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/79abe8be-ec8f-11ec-afed-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/79add0d4-ec8f-11ec-b204-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list]In total, the map can have three types of weather: early morning, bright sunny day, and thick fog.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/79a98e52-ec8f-11ec-a7fc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7bb87de8-ec8f-11ec-9c57-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=how-to-play][/h1]How to play[/b][/h2]
[h2]Three Key Areas[/h2]
We can distinguish three main directions on the Faroe Islands map. Let's consider them on the example of Domination with three Key Areas.

[h3][i]Key Area A[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4455d342-ec8e-11ec-b4ca-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The [b]first direction[/b] is an area of open water with a range of islands and protruding cape near Key Area A. This direction is a great place for duels and maneuvers for battleships and cruisers that play at long ranges because there is a fairly large area of open water nearby. However, stealthy torpedo destroyers can also successfully operate in this place. The cape serves as a shelter for destroyers and cruisers when capturing the Key Area, and the islands can cover ships from enemy fire from the opposite flank and center of the map.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Key Area B[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0f9901e8-ec8d-11ec-b65d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The [b]second direction[/b]—and the most notable feature of the map—is the center with Key Area B located between the four islands. This is a kind of arena with clean lines of fire for battles at close range, primarily for destroyers and cruisers that help in capturing. Gently sloping on one side and sheer on the other, the islands at the central Key Area offer an ideal cover and firing position for cruisers with high-arcing shell trajectories.

If you stay around one of the side islands, you'll have clean lines of fire at targets in the opposite part of the Key Area. In this case, the destroyers going to capture the Key Area will be safer on the enemy half of the map. The sheer edges of the side island will protect them from enemy fire. This tactic is still dangerous because the destroyer is not protected from attacks from the side of the islands, but with proper positioning, it's possible to capture a hard and critical Key Area while being practically on the enemy half of the map.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Key Area C[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4449f414-ec8e-11ec-8b97-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The [b]third direction[/b] is snow-covered islands with small icebergs and a high wedge-shaped cliff near Key Area C. This direction suits almost all ship types. There is an area of open water for long-range artillery firefights and stealth torpedo attacks. Destroyers will be comfortable among clusters of small icebergs. Battleships are not recommended to sail there. Close-quarters ships can prove themselves near the two largest islands.
[/expand]
[h2]Four Key Areas[/h2]
This variant of Domination has a couple of [i]differences[/i]. The first one is the smaller size of the Key Areas. In this mode, the cape in the northwestern part of the map plays a smaller role in the fight for Key Area A.

The second difference is the eastern part of the map, where C and D are home areas for the teams. As a result, the pace and distance of combat in this direction changes significantly. Instead of rapidly capturing one Key Area, teams should try to systematically push through the enemy formations and push them to the flank.

Icebergs and small islands between the Key Areas provide good cover when advancing toward the enemy's home area. Two small islands within the boundaries of both Key Areas are worth a special mention. Under the cover of one of them, ships can start to capture the Key Area or block the opposing team's attempt to capture it.

There are also several small islands in the area where teams spawn on each side. They will serve as excellent cover for aircraft carriers. In general, small islands on the map make it possible to safely move to the flanks without fear of being detected by the enemy. They also allow ships with high-arcing ballistics—primarily cruisers—to effectively rain down fire on large areas of the map and support their allies.

The arena in the center is the most dangerous place on the map. However, it will be very difficult to take Key Area B back if it's captured. Therefore, fighting for this Key Area will be a difficult but important task for destroyers and supporting cruisers. Long-range ships should stick to open water on the flanks, while stealthy and maneuverable destroyers will be comfortable among the iceberg clusters in the eastern part of the map.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7a46d4e6-ec8f-11ec-9f22-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Updated Convoy in Update 0.11.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/567c483954a7a6fbfcc1912ef3087154790fc6aa.jpg[/img]
[b]Update 0.11.5 brings back the Convoy temporary battle type, which tasks you with defending or attacking transport ships as they sail to their destination point.[/b]

We've updated the format and diversified the maps, as well as increased the number of transport ships that now move along different routes. We've also revamped the interface and tactical tips in battle, as well as changed the description of the Convoy rules in the battle-type selection window.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e51943fa-ebed-11ec-ae3b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[i]In real life, naval battles involved more than squadron duels and air raids. A significant aspect of confrontations between navies involved defending or attacking cargo lanes used to transport strategically important cargo.[/i]

[table][tr][th][b][url=#rules]Rules[/url]
[url=#achievements-and-combat-missions]Achievements and Combat Missions[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=rules][/h1]Rules[/b][/h2]
To ensure high-quality matchmaking and contribute to battles being assembled more quickly, Convoy is only available during a certain Prime Time period each day.

[h2]Format[/h2]
12 vs. 12 with Tier VIII–X ships.

[list][i]Convoy will be available throughout Update 0.11.5.[/i][/list]

We've changed some conditions of Convoy to bring more variety to the tactics of both teams and diversify the gameplay in this battle type.

Aircraft carriers, destroyers, cruisers, battleships, and submarines are allowed to participate.

Two teams participate in each battle—one is tasked with escorting cargo ships, and the other is tasked with attacking them. Players are randomly distributed among the two teams. You can enter each battle either alone or as part of a Division of 2—3 players.

The [i]defending team[/i] needs to escort convoys of cargo ships as they sail along a defined route. The [i]defending team[/i] wins if at least one of the convoy ships reaches the destination point or the entire enemy team is sent back to Port. The mission of the attacking team is to completely destroy either the convoys or its defenders.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/314653f2-ebe5-11ec-b84a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/314aa86c-ebe5-11ec-b8aa-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/314d67e6-ebe5-11ec-bfc8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3147d0ce-ebe5-11ec-90a1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1fd37b04-ebdb-11ec-9ff5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1f3eb7d0-ebdb-11ec-bd60-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/video/convoys_torp_evading_1200x600_wg_spb_wows.mp4]In total, there are six AI-controlled transport ships in each battle. Depending on the map, transport ships will be split into three convoys of two ships or two convoys of three ships.[/url]
[list][*]Each convoy moves along its own route.
[*]Each route has its own destination. The destination points may be the same or different.
[*]The convoy's route is visible to both teams on the Minimap.
[*]The numbering of routes is tied to their travel time—the higher the number, the longer the duration of the route.[/list]
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/video/convoy_shooting_1200x675_wg_spb_wows.mp4]All convoys are made up of Liberty-class transport ships. They have little HP and weak armor, but they can deploy smoke screens, as well as change speed and maneuver to dodge enemy torpedoes. In addition, the transport ships are armed with two main battery guns and twelve secondary battery guns capable of firing at approaching enemies.[/url]
[h2]Maps[/h2]
North, Hotspot, Trap, Two Brothers, Tears of the Desert, Crash Zone Alpha. A cyclone can appear on the Trap map.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/558addcc-ebe6-11ec-ae3b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/558b3362-ebe6-11ec-a4eb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5592ffca-ebe6-11ec-9ff5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/558ed2f6-ebe6-11ec-a3b0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/558cb700-ebe6-11ec-b8aa-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/55919a36-ebe6-11ec-bfc8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/558d7f82-ebe6-11ec-a2ee-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=achievements-and-combat-missions][/h1]Achievements and Combat Missions[/b][/h2]
As before, your successes in Convoy will be rewarded with special themed achievements. We've updated their visual appearance for the new iteration.
[table equalcells=1][tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9d86f7b8-ebd8-11ec-822f-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][b]Living Shield[/b][/td] [td]Receive two torpedo hits from the enemy while being within a 2-kilometer radius of an allied transport ship.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9d86c1c6-ebd8-11ec-8e96-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][b]Neat Job[/b][/td] [td]Win by destroying all the transports and without losing any allied ships. At the same time, the damage caused by you should be more than 50% of the standard HP of your ship.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9ddc5c12-ebd8-11ec-9882-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][b]Safe Route[/b][/td] [td]Win a battle and save all transports. At the same time, the damage caused by you should be more than 50% of the standard HP of your ship.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9d8a9972-ebd8-11ec-a75f-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][b]Nerves of Steel[/b][/td] [td]Win and survive in a battle when the enemy has twice the number of warships or more. At the same time, the damage caused by you should be more than 50% of the standard HP of your ship. Can be completed while playing for any team.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9d8f7dac-ebd8-11ec-ac73-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][b]Raider[/b][/td] [td]Destroy two transports in a single battle.[/td][/tr][/table]
Due to the specifics of the battle type, you can only earn these achievements in Convoy.
[list]You will have access to special combat missions that can be completed only in Convoy. Win and earn Base XP to obtain Community Tokens.[/list]
[list][i]Detailed information about the special mission completion criteria can be found in the game client.[/i][/list]

[h2]Round 2 Schedule[/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Thu. 02 Jun. 18:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Tue. 07 Jun. 07:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

Commanders, thank you for participating in the first round of Public Test for Update 0.11.5! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!
[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Made balance changes to the Kansas-Vermont branch of American battleships, Unites States, and submarines. See our [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/329]Development Blog[/url] for details.
[*]Fixed the external code execution technical vulnerability in World of Warships' replay tool. We thank those who brought the problem to our attention.
[*]Fixed an issue because of which the FPS limit in battle was not removed in Update 0.11.4. This limit has now been removed for all players. If you want to set it manually, edit the [code]<maxFrameRate>[/code] value in the [i]preferences.xml[/i] file in the game folder.
[*]Corrected the display of an outdated tech tree. The tech tree now matches Update 0.11.4.
[*]Thanks to your feedback, it was discovered that after completing the relevant combat missions on the 0.11.5 Public Test, players received Commander Dasha only for the Tier I ship of her respective version's nation. The rewards have been changed, and now battles on each nation's Tier X ship will bring several Dasha Commanders with a specialization for that nation's Tier X ships. [h2]What Is Warhammer 40,000?[/h2]
Warhammer 40,000 is the pinnacle of tabletop wargaming. Produced by Games Workshop, its distinct visual style blends elements of science fiction and fantasy to create a beautifully dark atmosphere that has amassed a massive following over the years. Today, the universe has expanded to video games, novels, comics, and more, garnering a huge following around the globe.

Together with Games Workshop, we’ve created something that stays true to the renowned fantasy IP and also resonates with our universe of naval battles.

[h2][b][h1=what-is-azur-lane][/h1]What is Azur Lane?[/b][/h2]
The Azur Lane mobile game has been developed as a shooting RPG based on "shoot 'em up" mechanics.
[list][*]Players progress through levels by taking command of a Division that includes several naval warships turned humanoid.
[*]Enemies deliver a squall of fire, and the player's main task is to avoid the shells, minimize damage, and blast away foes by returning fire.
[*]There are more than 400 ships, or rather "Ship-Girls," in Azur Lane. They are based on ships of different nations from the World War II era.[/list]
More information is available on the official [url=https://www.azurlane.jp/]website[/url] of the Azur Lane game (in Japanese).

[list][b][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.[/b][/list]
[list][i]Please note: The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/i][/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#the-return-of-convoy]The Return of Convoy[/url]
[url=#updated-us-destroyer-models]Updated U.S. Destroyer Models[/url]
[url=#faroe-islands]Faroe Islands[/url]
[url=#submarines]Submarines[/url]
[url=#other-changes]Other Changes[/url]
[url=#transformers]Transformers[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=the-return-of-convoy][/h1]The Return of Convoy[/b][/h2]
Military operations at sea didn't only involve duels between squadrons or air raids against enemy ships. In real life, a significant aspect of confrontations between navies involved defending or attacking cargo lanes used to transport strategically important cargo. During [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/convoy-defend-or-destroy/]Update 0.10.8[/url], you had an opportunity to participate in a separate battle type—Convoy—in which you had to either defend or destroy cargo ships. We've updated the rules and format, and Convoy is going to return in Update 0.11.5!

[h3][i]Format[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
The battles will be fought in teams of 12 with Tier VIII–X ships.

Players can participate in Convoy playing submarines as well. The limit on the number of submarines is identical to Random Battles.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Rules[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
Two teams participate in each battle—one is tasked with escorting cargo ships, and the other is tasked with attacking them. Players are randomly distributed among the two teams.

The defending team needs to escort a convoy of AI-controlled cargo ships as they sail along a defined route. The defending team wins if at least one of the convoy ships reaches the destination point or the entire enemy team is destroyed. The mission of the attacking team is to completely destroy either the convoy or its defenders.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Maps[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
North, Hotspot, Trap, Two Brothers, Tears of the Desert, Haven, Crash Zone Alpha, Northern Waters.

The defending team needs to escort a total of six transport ships. Depending on the map, they are divided into convoys of two or three ships, and each convoy follows its own route. This means that you can expect two or three convoy routes with either the same destination or different ones. This change allows for new tactics for both teams and makes the gameplay more diverse. At the same time, we've reduced the number of Convoy ships respectively for each route so as not to complicate the task for the attacking team and to avoid performance issues in battle.
[/expand]
[list][i]Apart from changing the rules and format, we've also updated the interface and tactical hints in battle, as well as the Convoy rules in the battle mode selection window.[/i][/list]

We're starting to update the models of U.S. destroyers. In Update 0.11.5, the models of [b] [b][b]VII[/b] Mahan[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] Benson[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]IX[/b] Fletcher[/b][/b], and [b] [b][b]X[/b] Gearing[/b][/b] are going to be revamped. In Update 0.11.6, we're going to revamp the models of [b] [b][b]III[/b] Wickes[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]IV[/b] Clemson[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]V[/b] Nicholas[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]VI[/b] Farragut[/b][/b], and [b] [b][b]VII[/b] Sims[/b][/b].

The changes will slightly affect the aiming angles of torpedo tubes and main battery guns, anti-aircraft and anti-submarine defense composition, and the distribution of HP in different parts of the ships. The gameplay features of these ships will not change.

[h2][b][h1=faroe-islands][/h1]Faroe Islands[/b][/h2]
In [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/community/choose-a-new-map/]autumn of 2021[/url], players helped us choose the visual style for the new map. It has now passed through the final stages of preparation, and we're ready to introduce the new Faroe Islands map in Update 0.11.5!

Battles will take place among flowing mountains covered with a thin layer of snow and islands with steep shores. The map has been designed for battles involving Tier VII–X ships, as well as superships. It can be found in the Domination mode with three or four Key Areas.

[h2][b][h1=submarines][/h1]Submarines[/b][/h2]

[list][*]0–39 seconds: Four ships total; no more than four destroyers and two submarines.
[*]40–89 seconds: Five ships total; no more than four destroyers and two submarines.
[*]In case of longer waiting times for the first player, these limits will be less strict.[/list] [hr][/hr]

[list][*]Rental Commanders can no longer be reassigned to different ships. Rental Commanders with specializations for different ships won't be shown in the Commander Replacement tab.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e2b3c752d095911dcb9048e48bfe174183dabaf1.jpg[/img]
[b]Captains![/b]

Clan Battles Season 17 kicks off during Update 0.11.4. It's named "Cayman." The cayman is a dangerous reptile that inhabits the swamps, rivers, and lakes of America. They are nocturnal predators that are often at the top of the food chain in their ecosystems. The trunk of the world tree was depicted as an upright cayman in Mesoamerican mythology.

Clan Battles offer an excellent opportunity to show off your skills in World of Warships. It's not only the results of individual battles that are important here but also general progress. Fight alongside your allies and rise to the top!
[list][i]Just like in previous seasons, any player who fights in a Clan, Co-op, Ranked, or Random Battle playing a Tier VIII–X ship or supership will be given a set of three special Tier X ships for temporary use: [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Gearing[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Yamato[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Zaō[/b][/b].[/i][/list]
[list]Win Clan Battles to earn valuable rewards such as Steel, Coal, camouflages, special signals, Clan Tokens, and much more. The more victories you achieve, the more rewards you'll earn.[/list]

The following rules apply for all maps:
[list][*]Number of Key Areas: 3
[*]Capture time: 30 seconds
[*]Scoring capture points: 3 points every 4 seconds[/list]
[list][b]On the days of any update releases, Clan Battles are held only during the Prime Time of your server.[/b][/list]
[h2]Restrictions on Ship Numbers[/h2]
Just like in previous seasons, certain restrictions on the numbers of specific ships per team apply in Clan Battles.

The restrictions can be set for the entire duration of a season or for specific periods of time. For example, they might be set after the first 2 weeks of a season then replaced with different restrictions a few weeks later. This allows us to promptly react to the current state of the season.

Season 17 begins with the following restrictions:
[list][*]Aircraft carriers are not allowed in battles.
[*]You cannot enter battle playing [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Petropavlovsk[/b][/b] or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Kléber[/b][/b].
[*]No more than one battleship per team.
[*]No more than two superships per team.
[*]No more than three mercenaries per Division.[/list]
These restrictions allow us to diversify the gameplay and increase the variability of setups in the season.

Aircraft carriers are not allowed in the current season. In future seasons, however, carriers will take their rightful place in Clan Battles again.

During the season, based on statistics, new restrictions may be added and existing restrictions may be changed. We will announce the changes separately on our Development Blog. Information about any changes will also be available in the game client.

notes.title: French Cruisers in Early Access
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2809610012][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c76837ddde328262442013677d25cad92572ce0e.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]Three new cruisers have arrived in Early Access in World of Warships: Cherbourg, Brest, and Marseille.[/b]

Read on to learn everything you need to know about the features of the new ships and Early Access.

[table][tr][th][b][url=#features-of-the-new-ships]Features of the new ships[/url]
[url=#early-access]Early Access[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=-991z-7uYJY;full][/previewyoutube] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=features-of-the-new-ships][/h1]Features of the new ships[/b][/h2]
These new ships have found their places alongside the first branch of French cruisers. The main feature of the new ships is their large-caliber guns (relative to the ship type) mounted on their bows. They reload slowly, but this is compensated for by the Main Battery Reload Booster consumable.

Cruisers are capable of achieving high speeds with the help of the improved "French-specific" Engine Boost consumable. The ships' armor does a great job in protecting their citadels against medium-caliber AP shells, but the new cruisers are quite vulnerable against HE and SAP shells. Medium and long ranges are optimal for engagements, but with the help of their 139 mm secondary battery guns with improved accuracy, the new ships can also show their worth in close-range encounters.

notes.title: Arms Race Hits Random and Co-op Battles in Update 0.11.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9f50dfc0d6e5d944eb11941981a9a1e0b1fce434.jpg[/img]
[b]Update 0.11.4 brings Arms Race—a mode that allows you to improve the characteristics of your ship right in battle—into Random and Co-op Battles.[/b]

With the addition of Arms Race to Random and Co-op Battles, we're disabling Epicenter.

[table][tr][th][b][url=#rules]Rules[/url]
[url=#features-of-arms-race]Features of Arms Race[/url]
[url=#how-buff-areas-work]How Buff Areas Work[/url]
[url=#buff-types]Buff Types[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=rules][/h1]Rules[/b][/h2]
Arms Race will be available only in battles where the highest ship tier is IX or X, as well as in battles with superships. You can enter a battle in a Division of no more than three players. The number of players and matchmaking restrictions are the same as those applied in Random and Co-op Battles.

It will also be available only on these eight maps: Northern Waters, Sleeping Giant, Loop, Warrior’s Path, Mountain Range, Land of Fire, Islands of Ice, and Hotspot.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1abcd6aa-d29b-11ec-91d2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1ac437c4-d29b-11ec-b168-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b66a0ae-d29b-11ec-a66e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1ac27984-d29b-11ec-abbb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1ac4112c-d29b-11ec-b4bc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b67d456-d29b-11ec-8a8c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1ac7ff30-d29b-11ec-890f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1ac67aa2-d29b-11ec-a14f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=features-of-arms-race][/h1]Features of Arms Race[/b][/h2]
Once a battle starts, areas with buffs spawn on the map. If you can make it to a special area and pick up the buffs before your opponents do, your entire team will get a bonus to their combat abilities till the end of that battle.

Eight minutes after a battle starts, a Key Area appears in the center of the map. The diameter of this area then shrinks over time. The team that captures it will be able to quickly gain an advantage in points and greatly increase their chances of winning. The capture time is 120 seconds. Holding an area brings 10 points every 2 seconds.

To win a battle, a team will need to meet one of the following conditions:
[list][*]Sink all enemy ships
[*]Be the first to score 1,000 superiority points
[*]Reduce the opposing team's points to zero
[*]Prevail over the opposing team by the number of points at the time the battle ends[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/34acb83e-d285-11ec-a866-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/354b3cac-d285-11ec-a119-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/35431036-d285-11ec-95b6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/34a520ba-d285-11ec-b748-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][i]Battles in the Arms Race mode will bring players the standard sums of XP and Credits they would get in Random or Co-op Battles (depending on which type of battle they are in). Activating buff areas will also be rewarded.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=how-buff-areas-work][/h1]How Buff Areas Work[/b][/h2]
Each buff area becomes available to capture 2 minutes after spawning. The player whose ship first enters the area after its activation gets a buff for their ship and all allies.

If both allied and enemy ships are in a buff area at the moment of its activation, the team with the most ships in the area gets the buff. If the ship numbers are equal, the balance of power inside the area must shift one way or another for a team to receive the buff.

In addition to the buffs, each captured area grants 20 points to your team and deducts 20 points from the enemy team. Players who capture a buff area receive an economic reward of XP and Credits. New buff areas appear on the map every 2 minutes until the 14th minute of each battle. Buff areas spawn randomly on maps, so every battle is unique!
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/88c7e8a8-d299-11ec-a14f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=buff-types][/h1]Buff Types[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Permanent HP recovery for ships and carrier aircraft:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Restores [b]+0.04%[/b] HP per second for destroyers and submarines
[*]Restores [b]+0.03%[/b] HP per second for cruisers
[*]Restores [b]+0.02%[/b] HP per second for battleships
[*]Restores[b] +0.125%[/b] HP per second for carrier aircraft[/list]
[h3][b]Faster reload time for all ship armaments; faster squadron preparation time for aircraft carriers:[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]−10%[/b] to the reload time of all armaments and sonar
[*][b]−10%[/b] to squadron restoration time[/list]
[h3][b]Boosted armament damage for ships and carrier squadrons:[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]+10%[/b] to maximum ship armament damage
[*][b]+10%[/b] to maximum armament damage of carrier and hybrid ship squadrons[/list]
[h3][b]Increased current and maximum HP values for ships and carrier squadrons:[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]+10%[/b] to current and maximum HP of destroyers and submarines
[*][b]+7.5%[/b] to current and maximum HP of cruisers
[*][b]+5%[/b] to current and maximum HP of battleships
[*][b]+17%[/b] to current and maximum HP of carrier squadrons[/list]
[list][i]Each buff has three levels. The bonuses stack up if you capture the same buffs multiple times. All four buff types can be applied to a ship simultaneously.[/i][/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0e948830-d4fa-11ec-8d47-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list]Picking up a buff that you have already maxed out will have no effect. Capturing a buff area will bring 20 superiority points to your team and deduct 20 points from the enemy team. Buff areas disappear after being captured.[/list]
