notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e856aef7de8d4a870ec24544116d2a9deedcc212.jpg[/img]
[b]Update 0.11.4 kicks off the new Ranked Battles season.[/b]
[list][*]Earn Doubloons, Steel, camouflages, and special containers.
[*]Earn Ranked Tokens for achieving Rank 1 in the Gold League.
[*]Stock up on Tokens and purchase rare permanent camouflages![/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#format]Format[/url]
[url=#rewards]Rewards[/url]
[url=#rules]Rules[/url]
[url=#bonus-combat-mission]Bonus Combat Mission[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=format][/h1]Format[/b][/h2]
This season, all the leagues see Tier VIII and IX ships fighting in a 6 vs. 6 format. The leagues differ in their rules for keeping a Star:
[list][*]In the Bronze League, players who take the first two places by XP earned keep their Stars in a lost battle.
[*]In the Silver League, only the top XP earner keeps their Star in a lost battle.
[*]In the Gold League, players do not keep their Stars in a lost battle.[/list]
These changes emphasize the different levels of competitiveness in each league.
[list][i]We have revised the number of Stars required to reach Rank 1. The purpose of this is to make sure that the average number of battles required to reach Rank 1 does not change.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=rewards][/h1]Rewards[/b][/h2]
The rewards for each league refresh and become available again at the start of each new Sprint.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9768c024-d11f-11ec-8b7a-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]Due to the change in the number of Stars required to reach Rank 1, the number of victories required to obtain rewards has been reduced in the Gold League.[/i][/list]
[list]Reaching Rank 1 will reward you with Bronze, Silver, and Gold League containers. Reaching Rank 1 in the Bronze League will reward you with a commemorative flag.[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/96f2c0cc-d11f-11ec-a3d2-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[list][*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]20,000[/b] Free XP

[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]7,500[/b] Coal

[list][*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]32,000[/b] Free XP

[h2][b][h1=rules][/h1]Rules[/b][/h2] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/26ccd280-d28a-11ec-b748-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Thu. 19 May 10:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Thu. 14 Jul. 01:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

Fault Line, Trap, Trident, Haven, Crash Zone Alpha, Northern Waters, and Riposte.

notes.title: Waterline: Roadmap Update – Spring 2022
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2803640665][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/4385e192275530917dbe689be694da3607501bbf.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]Captains![/b]

In early February, we announced our plans for 2022. Over the months since our [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/roadmap-for-2022/]previous publication[/url], many of our ideas have been implemented. More information about future changes to World of Warships is now available and some details have changed. It's high time we shared our development plans for the second half of 2022!
[list][i]Please note that all the information contained in this document is preliminary. Any changes and new features that we announce may be adjusted several times during tests. During each of those testing rounds, we'll carefully consider your feedback and opinions. Now, let's get down to the details! To reveal the information, click on the respective blocks.[/i][/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#whats-already-done]What's Already Done[/url]
[url=#spring-2022]Spring 2022[/url]
[url=#summer-2022]Summer 2022[/url]
[url=#fall-2022]Fall 2022[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=C-LcU9W2TGI;full][/previewyoutube] 
[h2][b][h1=whats-already-done][/h1]What's Already Done[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/797e48b6-c7cb-11ec-a918-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]
[h2]Ships[/h2]
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/pan-asian-cruisers-review/]Pan-Asian cruisers[/url] are now available to everyone, and Early Access to [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/italian-destroyers-review/]Italian destroyers[/url] will also end soon.

A new nation has been added to the game—Spain. The first representative is [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/history/armada-canarias/]Canarias[/url].

Also, the testing of superships [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img] [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img] [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]★[/b] Hannover[/b][/b] was finished, and they were added to the branches of their respective nations.
[h2]Game Events[/h2]
We celebrated [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/sales-and-events/lunar-new-year/]Lunar New Year[/url].

Players had a chance to try out [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/dirigible-derby/]Dirigible Derby[/url] and fight in the [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/savage-battle/]Savage Battle[/url] on the Flooded City map.

Construction of [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/history/armada-atlantico/]Atlântico[/url] has started on the already familiar Clydebank Dockyard.
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
Significant [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/graphics-improvements-in-0113/]visual improvements[/url] have been implemented. Snow, ice, and sand on maps have become more realistic and spectacular, the ice build-up effect has appeared on ships and is visible in battles on snow-covered maps, and shadows on maps and ships now look more realistic.

A number of visual effects have been updated, and we're continuing to rework maps and Ports to bring them up to HD quality. By the way, we've released a Hot Fix episode covering our work on the World of Warships graphics. You can watch it [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zdr_M3cXnn8]here[/url].

We've also disclosed the item drop chances for all containers. Check them out [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/contents-and-drop-rates-of-containers/]here[/url].
[h2][b][h1=spring-2022][/h1]Spring 2022[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/794085da-c7cb-11ec-92c5-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]
[h2]French Cruisers[/h2]
Update 0.11.4 kicks off Early Access to new French ships [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Cherbourg[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Brest[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Marseille[/b][/b]. The cruisers are armed with large-caliber guns mounted on their bows. Their long reload time is partly compensated for by the Main Battery Reload Booster consumable. The ships are capable of achieving high speeds with the help of the improved Engine Boost consumable that is typical for French ships. The armor of the new cruisers ensures good protection of their citadels against medium-caliber AP shells, but they are quite vulnerable against HE and SAP shells.
[list][i]Read the [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/311]Development Blog[/url] and [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/bulletin-0114/]Developer Bulletin for Update 0.11.4[/url] to learn more details about Early Access to the French cruisers.[/i][/list]
[h2]Arms Race in Random and Co-op Battles[/h2]
Arms Race was first introduced into the game quite a long time ago—as a separate test mode initially, and then as a format for several Ranked Battles seasons later. [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/arms-race-in-update-01010/]In Update 0.10.10[/url], it returned as a separate battle type featuring various changes and improvements. It received positive feedback from players and demonstrated good statistics. The next stage of the Arms Race development will be its introduction to Random and Co-op Battles.

Arms Race will be available only in battles where the highest ship tier is IX or X, as well as in battles with superships. It will also be available only on these eight maps: Northern Waters, Sleeping Giant, Loop, Warrior's Path, Mountain Range, Land of Fire, Islands of Ice, and Hotspot. With the addition of the new mode to Random and Co-op Battles, Epicenter will be disabled.
[h2][b][h1=summer-2022][/h1]Summer 2022[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/79671a7e-c7cb-11ec-a53d-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]
[h2]British Battleships[/h2]
Great Britain—one of the mightiest naval powers in the world—is expecting reinforcements. The branch of [b]British battleships[/b] will feature warships that are historically classified as battlecruisers.

The new Tier III–VI ships were actually built in real life. The new ships of higher tiers were created based on Royal Navy projects from the first half of the 20th century.
[list][i]More details about the concept and settings of the new British battleships are available in the [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/310]Development Blog[/url].[/i][/list]
[h2]Game Events[/h2]
[h3][b]Sea Battle[/b][/h3]
We strive to delight you with new and interesting activities. Sea Battle is one of them. It's inspired by a classic game that you're probably familiar with.

You'll need a special resource—[b]Passes[/b]—to participate. Passes can be earned by completing combat missions.

When playing Sea Battle, you'll be competing against AI. Destroying ships and winning battles will bring you rewards. These rewards can include special themed resources, e.g. Tokens for Early Access to ships, or other in-game items. Before starting or during playing, you can press the "Finish battle automatically" button for the AI to finish the battle instead of you. Battle results will be displayed on the screen, and you'll receive any due rewards. You can pause the battle at any time and return to it later without losing your progress.
[h3][b]New Iteration of Convoy[/b][/h3]
Convoy was first introduced to the Live Server as a [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/convoy-defend-or-destroy/]separate battle type[/url] in Update 0.10.8. It received positive feedback from players, and we're happy to announce that we'll soon launch the second iteration of this battle type.

Battles will utilize a 12 vs. 12 format with Tier VIII–X ships. The maps and routes have been updated—you can expect two or even three convoy routes on the map, with one or more destination points. This will increase gameplay variety for both the escorting and attacking teams, as well as offer new tactics. Along with this, we'll decrease the number of ships in Convoy respectively for each route so as not to complicate the task for the attacking team and to avoid performance issues in battle.

We've also prepared various interface improvements, updates to tips, and other changes to help players take their bearings in the new battle type.
[h3][b]Return of Puerto Rico[/b][/h3]
The Dockyard with [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_America_e1c73e4294d3f8addc39872e23f6457e6f540a68db120d8bc5dec7e2034f83af.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Atlântico[/b][/b] won't be the last one this year. The next opportunity to build a ship will come at the end of summer. This time, we'll return the pioneer of the Dockyard—[b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Puerto Rico[/b][/b].

The first Dockyard with [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Puerto Rico[/b][/b] was very complicated and not the most successful from the perspective of its design and mechanics. We've taken all of our mistakes into account and reworked the event design. As all subsequent iterations—starting with [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Odin[/b][/b]—demonstrated, the Dockyard in its current format has become a full-fledged part of our game and works well. On top of that, many players have been asking when we are going to bring Puerto Rico back to the game. That's why we've decided to put Puerto Rico back on the stocks—we see it as an excellent opportunity to rectify our early mistakes with this feature. It also means that you'll be building a Tier X ship, which hasn't happened since the very first Dockyard. Those who didn't manage to build the ship in the New Year Update 0.8.11 or started playing the game later will now have a chance to do so. Obtaining the ship will be much easier than the first time, but it won't be possible to finish the construction for free, same as with previous ships at the Dockyard.
[list]Players who already have [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Puerto Rico[/b][/b] in their Ports but still build her at this Dockyard will be provided with compensation. We plan to give such players the opportunity to select a bundle with one of the following resources: Doubloons, Steel, Coal, or Research Points. The amount of whichever resource is in the bundle will be enough to obtain any Tier X ship currently available for purchase.[/list]
[h3][b]Return of Operations[/b][/h3]
As a result of the changes to aircraft carriers in Update 0.8.0, many AI-related internal tools became outdated. Adjusting aircraft carriers controlled by AI became hard or even impossible. For this reason, some Operations were temporarily removed from the game. We are currently actively working on aircraft carriers' AI to bring some Operations (e.g. Cherry Blossom, Hermes, and The Ultimate Frontier) back to the game.
[h3][b]Personal Challenges[/b][/h3]
Personal Challenges are a rather easy but interesting activity that allow you to achieve results playing your favorite ships and get rewards for this. They also encourage you to research new ship branches.

Future updates will bring new iterations of Personal Challenges with a number of improvements. More "type–nation" categories will be added for completing challenges, including Early Access ships. New mission conditions will be introduced: earning ribbons or XP; dealing damage. It will be possible to style Personal Challenges for themed events like New Year's Night, Clash of Courage, and their analogs. We'll also improve the interface to make it more informative.
[h3][b]Return of USS Black and Website Minigames[/b][/h3]
A special event is planned for June during which you'll be able to obtain USS [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Black[/b][/b] and earn various themed rewards. The event is going to be accompanied by a web campaign that will allow you to choose your own path through the Pacific theater of World War II in 1944 on a special map and build a career for your own Commander. As a reward for completing the campaign, you'll receive a U.S. Commander with 12 skill points. You can distribute some of the skill points by making choices right on the campaign map.
[list]With the introduction of the Pan-Asian cruiser branch, we've added a [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/history/a-look-through-time-pan-asian-cruisers/#assemble-the-ten]special minigame[/url] to publications dedicated to ships coming to Early Access. Play, familiarize yourself with new ships, remember them, and get special achievements! We're going to add such minigames to articles about each new ship branch in our game.[/list]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[h3][b]New Map: The Faroe Islands[/b][/h3]
The visual style of The Faroe Islands map was selected by players back in [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/community/choose-a-new-map/]fall 2021[/url], and the map is currently in the final stages of its preparation. We plan to release it to the Live Server with Update 0.11.5.
[h3][b]Changes to the Containers Tab[/b][/h3]
The cargo ship feature is currently very limited—players can only see the total number of containers they possess. This is particularly inconvenient for those who store lots of containers. To address this issue, we're going to improve the system for storing containers on the cargo ship and make it more informative.

Players will be able to view the numbers of each container type they have and open containers only of a specific type. We're adding information about container names and their descriptions, as well as an option to get information about the drop chances of container items.

We initially planned to finish this feature in spring, but tweaking it and testing the reworked cargo ship requires more time. That's why the changes to the Containers tab will be implemented in one of the summer updates.
[h3][b]Training Missions for New Players[/b][/h3]
Helping new players master the key principles and mechanics is a very important part of the game development. For this purpose, we're adding a set of simple missions to World of Warships. These missions will gradually focus on different game mechanics. This will help inexperienced players get their bearings in World of Warships, acquire basic skills through playing, and receive small rewards for this. Each mission will have its own set of tips that will enable players to better navigate in the game.

This is another feature that we've postponed to summer because we needed more time to finalize the design of these missions.
[h3][b]Separation of Exterior Elements and Economic Bonuses[/b][/h3]
We're working on the separation of exterior elements and economic bonuses, as well as on updating the latter. These changes will enable you to select economic bonuses and camouflages separately, and they will simplify the process of managing economic bonuses. We'll do our best to make the transition from the old system to the new one as comfortable as possible, as well as to conserve the current state of the game economics (prices and earnings). Cumulatively, players won't lose in profitability and will earn even more in some situations.
[list][i]This large-scale change will be implemented in one of the summer updates or in the early fall. All essential information is published in the [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/318]Development Blog[/url].[/i][/list]
[h3][b]Changes to the Battle Camera[/b][/h3]
The quality of textures and effects is an essential part of the game, but the way players see World of Warships is no less important. Not long ago, we [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/287]announced[/url] a new stage of testing battle camera settings. Its results were positive. Some minor tweaks are still required, and after that, we'll implement these changes on the Live Server.
[h3][b]Independence Day: Update of U.S. Destroyer Models[/b][/h3]
In summer, we traditionally celebrate U.S. Independence Day. You can expect to see loads of themed content. Updating the models of U.S. destroyers will also be dedicated to this holiday. This work will span two updates. First, we'll update the models of researchable Tier VII–X destroyers. Second, we'll turn to the models of researchable Tier II–VI destroyers and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Sims[/b][/b], which we started working on concurrently with the researchable ships.
[h2][b][h1=fall-2022][/h1]Fall 2022[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/79395422-c7cb-11ec-a05e-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

New features and improvements that we plan for fall are at the preliminary design stage, so we don't have many details to share with you. We'll cover the most important things.
[h2]Japanese Light Cruisers[/h2]
By fall, we'll have added Japanese Tier V–X light cruisers for testing. Their concept is in development, but we can already safely say that all ships of the branch will have 610 mm torpedoes at their disposal, and their torpedo launchers will have wide aiming angles. As for their main batteries, the Tier V and VI ships will have 152 mm guns, the Tier VII ship will have 155 mm guns, and high-tier cruisers will carry 150 mm dual-purpose guns.
[h2]Anniversary and Improvements of Battle Performance Bonuses[/h2]
We're going to celebrate World of Warships' Anniversary—our beloved game is turning seven! Players can expect loads of themed rewards and interesting activities.

Naturally, festive bonuses for battle performance will also be available. Many players have very extensive Ports, and getting rewards for battle performance on each ship can be very difficult and time-consuming. To deal with this, we plan to rework the battle performance bonus system. Players with many ships in their Ports will be able to receive rewards from several ships per battle.
[h2]Halloween[/h2]
For Halloween 2021, we [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/halloween-nightmare-operations/]brought back[/url] themed Operations Saving Transylvania and Sunray in the Darkness. As the statistics showed, players were enthusiastic about their return—Nightmare Operations appeared to be much more popular than the standard ones. This year, we plan to add Saving Transylvania and Sunray in the Darkness as part of the Halloween activities again. Besides that, we are considering the possibility to additionally bring back another once very popular themed Operation—Terror of the Deep—featuring submarines!
[h2]New Map[/h2]
In addition to The Faroe Islands and continuation of reworking maps and Ports to bring them up to HD quality, we plan to start working on one more new map. It's currently at the preliminary design stage. We promise to disclose details later when we're ready.
[list]We'll keep releasing special videos of the Waterline series once per quarter! We'll share new information and our plans for the upcoming 6 months with you, as well as explain why we make any changes to the already announced plans. Stay tuned![/list]
[i]World of Warships Team[/i]

[h2]Round 2 Schedule[/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Thu. 28 Apr. 18:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Thu. 05 May 07:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

Commanders, thank you for participating in the first round of Public Test for Update 0.11.4! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Important: The second session will be live until:[/b] [b]Thu. 05 May 07:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
After analyzing their combat effectiveness, we’re reducing the survivability of submarines in Update 0.11.4 with the following changes:
[list][*]The damage radius of ship-dropped depth charges has been significantly increased: 450 to 800 m.
[*]Increased the damage dealt by airstrike depth charges in the outermost part of their damage radius.
[*]The minimum airstrike depth charge drop distance for battleships has been changed to 500 m, like cruisers.[/list]
[h3][b]New mechanics for displaying the source of enemy sonar pings[/b][/h3]
In the Public Test for Update 0.11.4, we tested a change to the sonar ping visual effect from enemy submarines: instead of displaying the ping itself in real time, an effect is played on the water surface near to where the ping was emitted.

The new effect was supposed to make it easier to find the source of the ping. If the submarine emitting the ping is undetected, the effect is displayed at a certain distance from the submarine in order to give the submarine a chance to avoid taking damage.

After the Public Test, we got a lot of feedback about this new effect. Mainly:
[list][*]The effect disappears too quickly and is difficult to notice.
[*]The effect is often displayed too far from the submarine to determine its actual location.[/list]
Therefore, we are introducing the following changes to this mechanic:
[list][*]Increased the time the effect remains visible to 5 seconds.
[*]The distance at which the ping from the emitting submarine is displayed has been halved.[/list]
[h3][b]Removal of the possibility to remain constantly between two depth states by quickly tapping the dive and surface buttons[/b][/h3]
In Update 0.11.4, we removed the possibility of walking the line between two different depths while enjoying the benefits of both. The characteristics of periscope depth are now maintained between the depths of 0 and 15 m. The 15 m depth mark will be the border between periscope and maximum depth states. We also changed the possible depth limits for maximum depth to 30 m and 60 m.

[h3][b]Other submarine changes[/b][/h3]
We made adjustments to the captain skills for submarines, you can find all information about this change in our [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/322]Development Blog[/url].

[h3][b]Other changes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The bonus for strengthening the current and maximum combat capability of aircraft carrier squadrons in the Arms Race has been increased from 10% to 17%.
[*]The setting "Transmit exact position in the square" is now enabled for all players by default.
[*]Fixed a bug due to which the selected prime time in Clan Battles was reset in some cases.
[*]Fixed incorrect descriptions of superships in the port.
[*]Fixed a bug due to which an empty field appeared in the team list when activating voice chat.
[*]Now, when the [b]Enter[/b] key is pressed quickly in the "Exit Battle" dialog box, the player exits the battle, and the client closes in the "Exit Game" dialog box.
[*]Fixed a bug due to which in some situations in battle it was impossible to use an airstrike.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the client to crash when opening dialog boxes.
[*]Fixed bugs in the armor of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Submarine/special_ac6b2659676bb2f9f46f099fd4ad26d30f2fa64d76f6487f382af721ac6bee4f.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] U-190[/b][/b].
[*]Fixed a bug due to which submarines displayed the wrong torpedo speed after picking up power-ups.
[*]Fixed a bug with the missing horn on the "Japanese Castle" camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Fusō[/b][/b].
[*]Fixed a bug due to which ship names on the minimap could overwrite ship icons when minimap rotation was enabled.
[*]Fixed a bug with the position of the fort icon after the destruction of the ship.
[*]Made balance changes to [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/premium_4516ee494bb0396e51796cebff5e45c3f448d9790e0a58082057b8949ed9a3f8.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Chkalov[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Petropavlovsk[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Yueyang[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Des Moines[/b][/b] and other ships. notes.title: Walk the Port: London
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/ab88b94dbd03d2de961f9612c645525ff8eefe26.png[/img]
[b]In this episode, we'll tell you about London in the mid-nineteenth century.[/b]

The city center, divided by the River Thames, is full of unique structures and objects. The Port has been in our game for many years, but it gets updated regularly and cheers us all with its new colors.

You'll see famous London bridges, magnificent palaces, and some not-so-obvious niceties of the British capital.

[list][i]We've already told you about the Port of Marseille. You can read [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/walk-the-port-marseille/]the article[/url] on our website and watch a video about the main seaport of France.[/i][/list]
[previewyoutube=xkoVqB5QjAA;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]Did you enjoy the video? Subscribe to our channel to stay tuned for new episodes![/list]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/user/worldofwarshipscom?sub_confirmation=1 style=button][i][/i] Subscribe to the channel[/url]
[hr][/hr]

In reality, the port on the bank of the River Thames has existed since the moment London was founded by Romans in the 1st century. In the present day, skyscrapers of the financial center have grown in the place where the old docks used to be, but the port still remains one of the largest in Great Britain.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/06680014-c236-11ec-9f23-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/06620dda-c236-11ec-bf08-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/07a53a8c-c236-11ec-b66a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/066e58d8-c236-11ec-934f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/066af21a-c236-11ec-a523-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
In World of Warships, the London Port first appeared in Update 0.5.16. Our developers and artists have reproduced its real terrain in the game with great accuracy, and the architectural landmarks have been recreated to match their real-world versions down to the tiniest detail. But we do sometimes also give full play to creativity and imagination so as to make the most out of the benefits a virtual world has to offer and create exceptional events and memorable celebrations. World of Warships celebrated [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N4CotngUVmM&t=80s]the New Year of 2022[/url] precisely in the London Port.

notes.title: Developer Bulletin for Update 0.11.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/65f0d999cae1abdb52333471d0f6123bf53c6219.jpg[/img]
[list][b][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.[/b][/list]
[list][i]Please note: The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/i][/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#arms-race-testing]Arms Race in Random and Co-op Battles during the Public Test[/url]
[url=#french-cruisers]French Cruisers[/url]
[url=#italian-destroyers-in-the-tech-tree]Italian Destroyers in the Tech Tree[/url]
[url=#submarine-improvements]Submarine Improvements[/url]
[url=#minimap-improvements]Minimap Improvements[/url]
[url=#azur-lane]Azur Lane[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=arms-race-testing][/h1]Arms Race in Random and Co-op Battles during the Public Test[/b][/h2]
Arms Race is a game mode that players are very familiar with. Previously, it appeared in the game as a standalone battle type or as a format in seasons of the old Ranked Battles. We've spent a lot of time improving and expanding this mode based on your feedback and various statistics that we've gathered. It last appeared on the Live Server in Update 0.10.10. During the Public Test of Update 0.11.4, Arms Race will be introduced into Random and Co-op Battles.

Arms Race will be available only in battles where the highest ship tier is IX or X, as well as in battles with superships. It will also be available only on these eight maps: Northern Waters, Sleeping Giant, Loop, Warrior’s Path, Mountain Range, Land of Fire, Islands of Ice, and Hotspot.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0190727e-bfd9-11ec-a774-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0193abba-bfd9-11ec-b739-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/018fe62e-bfd9-11ec-b724-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/018cbb2a-bfd9-11ec-b8da-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][i]With the addition of Arms Race to Random and Co-op Battles, we're disabling Epicenter.[/i][/list]

[list]Take part in testing Arms Race in Random and Co-op Battles during the Public Test of Update 0.11.4, and let us know what you think! This will help us decide the fate of this mode on the Live Server, based on your feedback and statistics.[/list] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=french-cruisers][/h1]French Cruisers[/b][/h2]
Update 0.11.4 kicks off an event that puts new French cruisers [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Cherbourg[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Brest[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Marseille[/b][/b] right in spotlight! These ships will become available in Early Access on the Live Server only when the update is released. Meanwhile, we invite you to take part in the testing of the event.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/706f82d6-bcb2-11ec-b00c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/70a16fee-bcb2-11ec-a626-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7171a826-bcb2-11ec-8f88-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
These new ships found their places next to the first branch of French cruisers. The main feature of the new ships is their large-caliber guns (in terms of their class) mounted on the bow. While they reload slowly, this is compensated for by the Main Battery Reload Booster consumable.

The new ships are capable of achieving high speeds with the help of the improved "French" Engine Boost consumable.

Their armor does a great job in protecting them against medium-caliber AP shells, but it's quite vulnerable against HE and SAP shells.

Medium and long ranges are optimal for engagements, but with the help of their 139 mm secondary battery guns with improved accuracy, the new ships can also show their worth in close-range encounters.

Port of Marseille has been updated.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c8875b1e-bf0b-11ec-ae71-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/dcb4c998-bcb1-11ec-b00c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/dc166e24-bcb1-11ec-a3d0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=italian-destroyers-in-the-tech-tree][/h1]Italian Destroyers in the Tech Tree[/b][/h2]
The entire branch of Italian destroyers will become available for players to research with the release of Update 0.11.4. You can learn the details about how to play the new Italian ships in a dedicated [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/italian-destroyers-review/]article[/url] on our website.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bc7b61d0-a692-11ec-8901-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bce6de42-a692-11ec-a9e6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bc785dc8-a692-11ec-9f4b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bc743df6-a692-11ec-b297-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=submarine-improvements][/h1]Submarine Improvements[/b][/h2]
Submarine testing continues. What changed in Updated 0.11.4?
[list][*][b]Disabled the possibility to launch conventional torpedoes at maximum depth.[/b] From Update 0.11.2, conventional torpedoes no longer home in on targets vertically. It became inefficient to launch them from the maximum depth, which is why we've disabled this possibility.
[*][b]Disabled the increased dive capacity depletion rate when a submarine was detected by the enemy.[/b] This led to a change in the corresponding Commander skill and upgrades—a modifier for the dive capacity restoration rate has been introduced instead of the modifier for additional dive capacity depletion. Additional dive capacity depletion was very low and also had no impact on the gameplay of submarines. We decided to get rid of it because it was overcomplicated.
[*][b]The effect of the ping moving has been replaced with the effect of its launch, which also shows its direction.[/b] If a submarine isn't detected when it's used, the effect is displayed in the direction the sonar ping was emitted within a range of several kilometers. The effect that was previously used was visible and drew attention, but it was hard to understand where it started. The new effect better shows where the sonar ping was emitted from. Players' attention will still be drawn by the hit indication and the sound of any pings that came close. The new effect will help players better understand the locations of undetected submarines so they can attack them with main battery guns and depth charges with improved efficiency.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/274ca282-bfd2-11ec-b739-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/27558fdc-bfd2-11ec-b6b2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2751a232-bfd2-11ec-801a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=minimap-improvements][/h1]Minimap Improvements[/b][/h2]
To make communication in battle more convenient, comprehensive, and simple, we've updated the Minimap. Added new settings.
[list][*][b]Show the exact location in the square. [/b]When double-clicking the Minimap, the exact spot is shown instead of the overall square.
[*][b]Show object location.[/b] When double-clicking an object (ships, bases, forts, armament), the signal on the Minimap is transmitted, similar to hotkeys ([b]F3[/b] or [b]F5[/b]).[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3822d99e-bfd9-11ec-a774-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ac41b324-bfd2-11ec-801a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ac4ad292-bfd2-11ec-885e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ac46ac94-bfd2-11ec-ad4c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
Minimap settings consist of two sections: [b]Circle Settings[/b] and [b]Other Settings[/b].

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/03a97494-bfd3-11ec-801a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/03a1ecb0-bfd3-11ec-885e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=azur-lane][/h1]Azur Lane[/b][/h2]
As part of the next stage of our collaboration with Azur Lane, World of Warships will see the addition of:

notes.title: Graphics Improvements in Update 0.11.3
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2794673336][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d454ddfe57f4f16b806857830cd2b3603aa04c8c.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]World of Warships is constantly evolving.[/b]

Our team works every day to make the game more interesting and attractive. This meticulous work has been transforming our favorite game for many years.
[previewyoutube=Jg3J4Bie8qY;full][/previewyoutube]
We've made major improvements to the following maps: Tears of the Desert, Trap, Warrior's Path, and Solomon Islands. We've added high-detailed textures and changed the weather, visual effects, and underwater world, as well as carefully worked on many other details.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d788aca8-b58d-11ec-9239-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d7725840-b58d-11ec-976f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d76d3d6a-b58d-11ec-9823-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d78c6b18-b58d-11ec-b074-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d77002e8-b58d-11ec-bfb5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d76baf54-b58d-11ec-95ba-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d8054af6-b58d-11ec-9445-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d801a77a-b58d-11ec-ad7c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
We've improved how snow and sand are displayed on islands, and we've also added the effect of snow covering ships, depending on the weather.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/af11276c-b58f-11ec-95ba-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ae55cc1a-b58f-11ec-9239-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The camouflages of aircraft now match the ships they take off from. This effect applies to all aircraft types in the game, including aircraft carrier squadrons and fighters, spotting aircraft, and Airstrike flights.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/af0d6384-b58f-11ec-a356-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ae5f2f4e-b58f-11ec-8b34-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
We've reworked the visual component of the underwater world. The ships and underwater landscape now look more natural and picturesque. We've also improved how distant underwater objects are drawn in the Binocular View.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5c19fad8-b590-11ec-9239-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5c0e76a4-b590-11ec-9823-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Twitch Drops in Update 0.11.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/03ba5e4199dbdf60453ba0be7afd029eb43c213c.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Captains![/b][/h3]
Find out how to make the most of our latest Twitch Drops!

[table][tr][th][b][url=#channel-drops]Official Channel Drops[/url] ● [url=#challenges]Twitch Challenges[/url] ● [url=#drops]Twitch Drops[/url] ● [url=#community-tokens]How to Spend Community Tokens[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/worldofwarships style=button][i][/i] WoWS | Twitch[/url]

[h3][i][h3][b]How to Receive Twitch Drops[/b][/h3][/i][/h3] [table][tr][td]
Get Twitch Drops by watching livestreams on the official World of Warships channel or those of any other Twitch streamer playing World of Warships [b]with Drops enabled[/b]. Take care to ensure that your Twitch account is linked to your Wargaming Account, else it won’t work!
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/twitch-connect/ style=button]Instructions[/url]
[list][i]On the first Thursday of the game update, Drops become available and remain claimable for a full week until they are refreshed the following Thursday.[/i][/list]
[/td][/tr][/table][hr][/hr]

notes.title: Game Settings Explained
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/34631f2af94da457e39b7a56c0d42ea42e8cbd57.jpg[/img]
[b]The graphics and audio in World of Warships are constantly being refined and polished.[/b]

Accordingly, the game’s customizable settings are also changing to reflect this. For example, we have recently updated the basic graphics setting options, so you can safely set a preset that suits your computer before you enter battle. Even though we recommend rolling with the settings automatically chosen by the client based on your system, we also encourage you to familiarize yourself with the relevant in-game menu that can help your tailor the sights and sounds of the game to your exact liking.

The settings menus are quite extensive, though, and it’s not always clear what every little option means. Read this article to find out! We're going to explain the meaning of some of the more enigmatic terms, as well as tell you about some useful settings for graphics and audio that you can use. You can find all the necessary information about control settings in the [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/education/]Training[/url] section on our website.

[table][tr][th][b][url=#graphics]Graphics[/url]
[url=#audio]Audio[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=graphics][/h1]Graphics[/b][/h2]
Much of what you see on your screen while playing World of Warships can be changed in the settings menu:
[list][*]While in Port, click on the gear in the upper-left corner of the screen and select [b]Settings[/b] in the game menu.
[*]During battle, you can press the [b]Esc[/b] key and select [b]Settings[/b] in the game menu.[/list]
[h2]General settings[/h2]
[b]Antialiasing[/b] is a technique used to eliminate the "jagged" effect that occurs at the edges of many separate objects that are displayed at the same time. Let's take a look at all three types:
[list][*][b]MSAA[/b]: More pixels are processed to get better quality. This is a rather "heavy" setting that can dramatically affect game performance, so it needs to be used wisely. The 8x option will provide the best image quality, but it is also the most resource-intensive.
[*][b]TXAA[/b] is a complex process that uses prior frames to produce a smoother image. This technique allows you to reduce crawling and flickering. The effect is especially visible for small details like forests on islands.
[*][b]FXAA[/b] is a mature technology that does not lose its effectiveness. It is similar to MSAA, but more pixels are calculated only at the edges of 3D objects. It can even be used on computers with modest characteristics.[/list]
The [b]AMD FSR 1.0[/b][b]*[/b] scaling technology upscales the image resolution from lower to higher resolution. In practice, it can be very useful when playing, for example, on a laptop. It helps you significantly reduce the load on your processor and video card, and there will be no noticeable visual difference on a small screen.

[list][i][b]*[/b]This technology is not supported by all models of video cards.[/i][/list]

[b]Game browser hardware acceleration[/b] is enabled by default for all users and provides acceleration on any configuration. The option should be disabled only if the Armory or News is not displayed due to errors in the implementation of the video card driver.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7ef200d2-b1b7-11ec-a7ba-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[b]Vertical synchronization[/b] is a classic setting used in the vast majority of PC games. It allows the video card to operate with less power and reduces its temperature and noise, as well as reduces power consumption.

[b]Triple buffering[/b] increases the consumption of video memory, but allows you to smooth out small bumps due to different rendering times for successive frames.

[b]Increase GUI contrast[/b]: Translucent backgrounds of UI elements are replaced with solid fills.

There are also several settings in the menu that can be useful for computers with modest characteristics:
[list][*][b]Reduce GUI refresh rate[/b]: Enabling this feature makes icons react to movements in-game every two frames instead of every frame. This reduces the load on the processor when updating interface elements.
[*][b]Animate small objects[/b]: Disabling this option simplifies the way non-essential details such as individual airplanes or secondary battery guns are represented.
[*][b]Reduced fire and flooding effects[/b]: Enabling this option makes the visual effects associated with these statuses less spectacular.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7efb7ea0-b1b7-11ec-81aa-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Graphics settings[/h2]
The World of Warships development team recommends using auto-configured settings. If you have not changed the settings for a long time, you should click on the [b]Autoconfig[/b] button, which looks like a circular arrow.

The game has changed a lot over the past year, and this feature will help you choose the optimal image quality for the current state of World of Warships. In addition, you can select one of six options in the drop-down list of the [b]Graphics Quality[/b] setting.

[list][i]We believe that the available preset options are well-optimized and capable of satisfying even the most demanding users. If you decide to adjust the image yourself, remember—an incorrect assessment of your PC's resources can make the game uncomfortable to play and can even negatively affect your results in battle.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=audio][/h1]Audio[/b][/h2]
The audio in World of Warships is constantly being improved. Each Port has its own unique music theme written specifically for our game. The sound effects of the surrounding world, for their part, are becoming more detailed and realistic.

As in the case of graphics, you can also change the audio to suit your preferences. To do that, select the [b]Audio[/b] tab in the game menu.

[h2]General settings[/h2]
In battle, you can choose your preferred [b]Music mode[/b] from four options:
[list][*][b]Original[/b]: Classic tracks familiar to experienced players from the early days of the game.
[*][b]Dynamic[/b]: The tracks adapt to the events taking place in battle.
[*][b]Mixed[/b]: Before the start of the battle, the game randomly selects either the Dynamic or Original option.
[*][b]War Drums[/b]: The adrenaline-pumping sound of percussion instruments.[/list]
Audio accounts for only a small fraction of the load on your PC's processor and RAM. Although it makes sense to limit the sound quality only with weak hardware, you still need to be careful using the [b]Ultra[/b] quality setting.

Sound quality is tied to graphics quality, but not vice versa. If you select high graphics quality, the sound quality changes to the corresponding level automatically. If you select a different sound quality, the graphics quality remains unchanged.

[list][i]If the audio is played through a laptop's built-in speakers, you will hardly notice the difference between [b]High[/b] and [b]Ultra[/b] sound quality.[/i][/list]

[b]Voiceover language[/b] allows you to select the language of all voiceovers that will work in the standard voiceover modification mode.

[b]Voiceover modification[/b] allows you to select various options:
[list][*][b]Standard[/b]: A Commander speaks the game language selected by the user in the Voiceover language section. You hear allied Commanders in your chosen language during the battle.
[*][b]National[/b]: Voice messages in battle are played in the language corresponding to the ship's nation. If an allied ship pronounces a quick message, this message is heard by the player in the language corresponding to the nation of the allied ship.
[*][b]National+[/b]: Works the same as National, with the exception that if a ship has a special Commander with a unique voiceover, that voice will take precedence over the ship's nation. You will hear both the unique voice of Commanders on your ships as well as those on allied ships.
[*]The rest of the voiceover modifications correspond to any special Commanders with unique voiceovers that you have on your account. Choosing one of these Commanders will give their unique voiceover to all ships in the game, be they your own or allied. For example, if you have unique Commander Dasha Perova with her own unique voiceover, then you can select her here.[/list]
[h2]Sound preset[/h2]
With this feature, you can adjust the sound balance, both with the help of the suggested modes and at your own discretion. You several presets at your disposal:
[list][*][b]Standard[/b]: Default sound settings.
[*][b]Cinematic[/b]: Sound effects are brought to the foreground; the sound is more vivid and saturated.
[*][b]Simple[/b]: The volume of sound effects is reduced; additional sounds are disabled. This setting will help focus your attention on in-game notifications.
[*][b]Night[/b]: The settings are optimized for playing at low and medium volumes, and at the same time, all effects and notifications are preserved.
[*][b]Custom[/b]: Provides access to audio fine-tuning sliders that give you the ability to fine-tune individual groups of sounds.[/list]
[list][i]Select the [b]Custom[/b] option to be able to "move" the sliders yourself.[/i][/list]

When enabled, [b]Wide dynamic range[/b] gives you the ability to hear more fine details at a high volume level.

When enabled, [b]Loudness compensation[/b] allows you to hear more individual effects at low volumes.

[b]Radio communication effect[/b] changes the voice of your and other Commanders so the messages sound like radio transmissions.

[h2]Voice Chat[/h2]
If you hear other players too loudly or, on the contrary, too quietly, change the position of the [b]Chat volume[/b] slider.

If other players hear you too loudly or too quietly, adjust the [b]Microphone sensitivity[/b] slider.

The [b]transmission mode[/b] gives you the ability to configure at what action your words will be recorded and transmitted to other players. There are two options: Either by toggling it on with a single press on the [b]V[/b] key or push-to-talk by holding the key for the duration of the recording.

[b]Voice chat processing[/b] allows you to change the nature of the radio communication effect for the voice chat and voiceover. The level of the radio communication effect is adjusted in the Custom preset.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7eeef4b4-b1b7-11ec-beb4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Clydebank Dockyard: Construction of Atlântico
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2793860193][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6706d90d4bb4c8cdefddc2d17f23eba38dcb520f.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]The building of Pan-American Tier VIII battleship Atlântico commences in Update 0.11.3.[/b]

The warship will slide down the ways of the British Clydebank Dockyard that saw [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Marlborough[/b][/b] sail out not so long ago. In the beginning of the 20th century, there were no dockyards in South America, which is why many design and construction orders for the region were handled by British shipbuilding companies and others.

[b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_America_e1c73e4294d3f8addc39872e23f6457e6f540a68db120d8bc5dec7e2034f83af.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Atlântico[/b][/b] is armed with ten 381 mm main battery guns that are placed in five twin-gun turrets and fire only AP shells. Atlântico's primary feature is her powerful secondary battery guns with a long firing range—ten 127 mm guns and sixteen 234 mm guns with a normal firing range of 7.5 km. The secondary battery guns are accurate, but they're not that easy to use—due to an arcing trajectory, the shells travel slowly. It's harder to attack maneuverable targets with such secondary battery guns, but at the same time, you can efficiently fire at slower ships and over islands. The 127 mm guns have the same accuracy as artillery mounts of German battleships, while the 234 mm guns have similar accuracy to [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Georgia[/b][/b] and German battlecruisers. While the ship is quite slow for a battleship of her tier, she has a sturdy deck, a citadel with solid armor, and decent overall armor protection against high-explosive shells.

[table][tr][th][b][url=#event-rules]Event Rules[/url]
[url=#combat-missions]Combat Missions[/url]
[url=#rewards]Rewards[/url]
[url=#completing-construction-of-the-ship]Completing Construction of the Ship[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=mNtb2Q3ymA0;full][/previewyoutube] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=event-rules][/h1]Event Rules[/b][/h2]
[list][*]The construction process at the Dockyard comprises 22 phases.
[*]These shipbuilding phases can be completed by progressing through Dockyard combat missions or by spending [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,750[/b] Doubloons to pass through each phase.
[*]If you want to complete shipbuilding phases at a discount, you can purchase Starter Packs—eight shipbuilding phases in exchange for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]8,000[/b] Doubloons and three shipbuilding phases in exchange for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]3,900[/b] Doubloons. However, these packs will only be available for purchase prior to the point in time when you complete three shipbuilding phases by finishing combat missions.
[*]You can complete combat mission groups throughout the entire duration of Update 0.11.3 and during the first 3 weeks of Update 0.11.4. The Dockyard will remain available until the start of Update 0.11.5.
[*]In total, you can progress through 19 out of 22 shipbuilding phases by completing Dockyard combat missions.[/list]
[list]If you complete the construction of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_America_e1c73e4294d3f8addc39872e23f6457e6f540a68db120d8bc5dec7e2034f83af.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Atlântico[/b][/b] by spending Doubloons, make sure to keep progressing through the Dockyard combat missions—completing each phase will earn you [b]250[/b] Steel.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8e556d20-b58b-11ec-ad7c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8e555a4c-b58b-11ec-bfb5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8e5993fa-b58b-11ec-95ba-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8e5fc7d4-b58b-11ec-82e8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=combat-missions][/h1]Combat Missions[/b][/h2]
The new game event tasks you with completing 63 combat missions spread across seven groups. The first group will become available with the release of Update 0.11.3, while those that follow will be unlocked on a weekly basis.

Completing each of the first two groups will progress you through two shipbuilding phases—one for accomplishing certain missions and one for finishing the group. Completing each of the remaining five combat mission groups will progress you through three shipbuilding phases—two for accomplishing certain missions and one for finishing the group.
[hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=rewards][/h1]Rewards[/b][/h2]
By progressing through the Dockyard combat missions, you can complete 19 out of 22 shipbuilding phases and obtain the corresponding rewards at the Dockyard.

By finishing the first two combat mission groups, you can complete up to four shipbuilding phases and obtain the following rewards:
[list][*]5x Brazilian camouflages
[*]2x Gift containers
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Warships Premium Account[/b][/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/1d7f2ac6-b713-11ec-ae87-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Superships in the Tech Tree
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/97a427a599d8e9d7b8d39921b374df545c9f709e.jpg[/img]
[b]Captains![/b]

Superships have gone through several different stages of testing. They participated in the Grand Battle in Update 0.10.5, Ranked Battles during the Fifth Season, Co-op Battles from Update 0.10.10, and Random Battles from Update 0.11.0. These tests allowed us to collect the necessary information and prepare for an important event. In Update 0.11.3, superships are being introduced into the Tech Tree on a permanent basis.

[table][tr][th][b][url=#access-to-superships]Access to superships[/url]
[url=#superships-economy]Superships economy[/url]
[url=#what-else-you-need-to-know]What else you need to know[/url]
[url=#superships]Superships[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=access-to-superships][/h1]Access to superships[/b][/h2]
Superships are placed in the Tech Tree just after Tier X ships. However, their arrival means much more than just the continuation of their respective branches. Superships have mechanics that are entirely new for our game and make a noticeable qualitative jump from Tier X ships. For this reason, we've opened access to them only for players who have researched or own at least three Tier X ships. This means that any players helming a supership will already have a certain level of experience in the game. To purchase a specific supership, you must also research the Tier X ship of the corresponding branch. It's not necessary to research superships.

The cost of purchasing superships depends on their type:
[list][*]Super battleships—57 million Credits.
[*]Super carriers—48 million Credits.
[*]Super cruisers—47.5 million Credits.
[*]Super destroyers—45 million Credits.[/list]
[list][i]We would like to avoid an excessive increase in the popularity of battleships compared to other types, so their cost is significantly higher.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=superships-economy][/h1]Superships economy[/b][/h2]
A very important aspect of adding superships to the Tech Tree is their battle economy—earnings per battle and service costs. Over the years of development, the in-game economy has accelerated significantly due to various bonuses and numerous economic signals. Earning Credits has become easier, even when playing the most expensive Tier X ships to service. This has significantly influenced their popularity.

In the case of superships, we decided to change our approach. This is done to curb their popularity in the matchmaker and give Tier X ships an economic advantage over superships.
[list][*]Superships yield Credits at the level of Tier X ships.
[*]The cost of servicing superships is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]360,000[/b] Credits.
[*]Permanent camouflages for superships are purchased separately from the ships, just like for other researchable ships from the Tech Tree.
[*]The permanent camouflage of superships does not reduce their service cost or increase their Credit earnings. However, it provides a larger XP bonus compared with permanent camouflages for Tier X ships.
[*]Any permanent camouflages provided with rental superships on player accounts will be removed.[/list] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=what-else-you-need-to-know][/h1]What else you need to know[/b][/h2]
[list][*]Superships do not interact with the Research Bureau and will not be sold after you reset a branch.
[*]Tier IX and X ships will enter battles with superships with restrictions similar to the limits on the number of ships of different tiers and on the number of bottom-tier battles in Tier VIII–X battles. Single-tier battles involving only superships are also possible.
[*]Superships are classified as “researchable” ships in the game. This means that Commanders must complete their retraining when they are assigned to superships.[/list]
[list][i]In future updates, we plan to add a special building to the Naval Base. More details will be available on our website later.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=superships][/h1]Superships[/b][/h2]
Along with superships, new mechanics have been added to World of Warships:
[list][*][b]Combat Instructions[/b] grant a temporary boost to the ships' characteristics in battle. You can activate the bonus by pressing the [b]F[/b] key in the standard keyboard layout, but only after carrying out successful adjustment fire.
[*][b]Alternative fire mode[/b]: A series of salvos where each turret automatically fires several shells with a short interval between salvos. After firing, the guns take a long time to reload. Depending on the ship, activating this mode can change the characteristics of guns or shells.
[*][b]Tactical squadrons[/b] have a high maximum speed and are the main feature of super carriers. These aircraft can quickly cover substantial distances and carry out lightning-fast attacks against enemy ships. At the same time, they cannot slow down below their cruising speed, and their engine boost does not restore when they are airborne. Tactical squadrons consist of one attacking flight only, because they are best used as auxiliary weapons. Just like the squadrons of hybrid ships, they come with a ready timer that's triggered with the start of each battle, and they also require considerable preparation time.[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5072b95c-b5ab-11ec-8241-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Combat Instructions increase the secondary battery firing range by 12% and reduce the secondary battery reload time by 20%.

Commanders, thank you for participating in the Public Test for Update 0.11.0! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Fixed bugs on the maps Solomon Islands, Tears of the Desert, and Trap.
[*]The snow cover effect on ships has been added for the maps Big Race, Ice Islands, Polar, Northern Waters, Shatter, and Northern Lights.
[*]Fixed a bug causing clan tags to not display in Contacts.
[*]Fixed the incorrect exchange rate for duplicate elements of the “Italian Destroyers” collection.
[*]Fixed incorrect bonuses provided by [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_America_e1c73e4294d3f8addc39872e23f6457e6f540a68db120d8bc5dec7e2034f83af.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Atlântico[/b][/b]’s permanent camouflage. The values were brought to standard for Tier VIII.[/list]
[h2]Combat Missions and Rewards[/h2]
By progressing through combat missions on the Public Test Server, you can earn Community Tokens. Community Tokens can be exchanged for various rewards in the Armory, including rare permanent camouflages, containers, and other in-game items. All details about Community Tokens are available in [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/community-tokens/]a dedicated article[/url]
[list][b]The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/b][/list]

[h2][b][h1=early-access-to-italian-destroyers][/h1]Continuation of Early Access to Italian destroyers[/b][/h2]
Early Access to Italian destroyers continues in Update 0.11.3. An additional component of the event dedicated to Early Access is a new collection that reveals details of the artillery armament of Regia Marina destroyers and awards of Italian sailors.

[b]The collection[/b] consists of three pages, with six elements on each. Elements of the collection can be obtained from the event containers.

[b]The reward for completing each of the sections is[/b] the ability to mount a second commemorative flag aboard Italian destroyers, cruisers, and battleships.

[b]The rewards for completing the entire collection are [/b][b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Leone[/b][/b] and a commemorative flag.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f86588c4-a6c4-11ec-86dd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]

[h2]Event Rules[/h2]
[list][*]The construction process at the Dockyard comprises 22 phases.
[*]These shipbuilding phases can be progressed through by completing Dockyard combat mission groups or by spending [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,750[/b] Doubloons to pass through each phase.
[*]The combat mission groups span two updates—0.11.3 and 0.11.4—and the Dockyard itself will remain in your Ports until the start of Update 0.11.5.
[*]In total, you can progress through 19 out of 22 shipbuilding phases by completing Dockyard combat missions.[/list]

[h2][b][h1=visual-improvements-and-changes][/h1]Visual Improvements and Changes[/b][/h2]
Our work on the visual component of the game is ongoing, and you can expect new graphical improvements and changes in Update 0.11.3.

[h2]New Effects[/h2]
We've improved how snow and sand are displayed on islands. We've also added the effect of snow covering ships, depending on the weather.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3999d2c2-a8f1-11ec-b64f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/39ecf664-a8f1-11ec-9e99-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/39911b14-a8f1-11ec-978e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]HD textures on maps[/h2]
We're continuing to update all the maps to accommodate enhanced HD textures. In Update 0.11.3, high-detail textures will be added on the Tears of the Desert, Trap, Warrior’s Path, and Solomon Islands maps.

In future updates, we'll keep working on texture details on other maps and Ports.

The camouflage mounted on the ship will also be displayed on aircraft that belong to that ship. This effect applies to all aircraft types in the game, including aircraft carrier squadrons and fighters, spotting aircraft, and airstrike flights.

The improved visuals have made the ships and underwater landscape look more natural and picturesque. We've also improved how distant underwater objects are drawn in the Binocular View.

notes.title: How to Get Free Premium Ships for Participating in Public Test!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8c6c3e851ab1f7b99a8cdbdd1c3ae11a6b7f0d29.jpg[/img]
[b]The World of Warships player community contributes significantly to our game.[/b]

Anyone can join the Public Test to help find bugs, review and evaluate game updates before others, and provide feedback to our developers.

[table][tr][th][b][url=#public-test]Why do we need the Public Test?[/url]
[url=#community-tokens]Earn Community Tokens[/url]
[url=#rewards]Choose Your Reward[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=public-test][/h1]Why do we need the Public Test?[/b][/h2]
World of Warships is constantly evolving. Every day, our specialists work on the implementation of new updates and improvements. They concern not only the emergence of new ships—every game entity is improved, from the visual effects to technical characteristics. But before showing our new features to the world, we carefully evaluate their quality through testing.

Before introducing new features, our developers need the help of the community. Some testing stages simply cannot be carried out without your participation. You have a special passion for World of Warships, and you love to dive into the details and study the minutiae of everything. Each person is unique and comes up with their own ways of interacting with the game. This can lead to unexpected consequences that developers need to look into. By doing so in the testing stage, they have the opportunity to correct any shortcomings in good time. Sometimes, the test results directly influence our decisions about whether to introduce changes to the Live Server or to hold and finalize them. Feedback from testers helps us fix bugs and improve every next update of the game.
[list][i]To participate in the Public Test, you need to log in using your main account details. To do that, select "Public Test" in the Game Instance menu of the Wargaming Game Center.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=community-tokens][/h1]Earn Community Tokens[/b][/h2]
The Public Test is not just a way you can touch the development process of World of Warships. You can earn Community Tokens.

[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_recruitment_points_e30ec137465b5e672aa3cd633442824abc4884652e65c8bc443767fafdd18fd6.png[/img] [b]Community Tokens[/b] are a special resource that can be accumulated and exchanged for valuable in-game items, including unique Recruiting Station containers, under a special tab in the Armory.
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=rewards][/h1]Choose Your Reward[/b][/h2]
During Round 1 of the 0.11.3 Public Test, you can earn up to 2,500 Community Tokens on the Live Server, and up to 5,000 Tokens for participating in both rounds. This will be enough, for example, to purchase a permanent camouflage for New York and a set of combat signals in the Armory. The details can be found in a separate [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/public-test/public-test-0113/]article[/url].

You have the ability to independently choose the in-game items that suit you best instead of receiving fixed rewards. You can purchase the following items for Community Tokens right now:
