notes.title: Submarines Are Again Lurking in the Depths of Our Seas for Testing Purposes
notes.content:
[url=https://youtu.be/SJIXOd1NqQs][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d1a093b2cc395e0b3aff092939ee8d3c3f7c088c.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]The World of Warships team is constantly working on improving the game and making it more diverse and interesting. As part of Update 0.11.2, we're going to present the updated submarines. Submarines are available for testing again.[/b]

In this new round of testing, we've gone above and beyond to address many of the issues raised by our player community. Everything from subs being hard to detect and interact with, to the unstable damage-dealing capabilities of submarines. We've made both playing and countering submarines more intuitive.
[list]We've prepared this text to make it easier for you to approach the new round of testing. We hope these changes will help us shape the final image of the new ship type.[/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#how-to-obtain]How do you get them?[/url]
[url=#playing-submarine]Submarines[/url]
[url=#counter-submarine]Playing Against Submarines[/url]
[url=#changes]What's Changed?[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=how-to-obtain][/h1]How do you get them?[/b][/h2]
To get the subs for rent, complete sequential combat missions.
[list][i]More details will be available in the game client.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=playing-submarine][/h1]Submarines[/b][/h2]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9f27a992-a924-11ec-b0dc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Consumables[/h2]
[list][*]Limited number of charges for the Damage Control Party consumable.
[*]Unlimited number of charges for the Hydrophone consumable. In the new round of testing, this equipment will provide updated data on the whereabouts of enemies more frequently.
[*]Submarines can have the Enhanced Rudder Gears consumable or Reserve Battery Unit.[/list]
[h2]Acoustic torpedoes and sonar pings[/h2]
[list][*]Acoustic torpedoes have decent homing capabilities, but they lack damage and have reduced chances of causing flooding.
[*]The first hit with a sonar ping makes the torpedo home in on the target, and the second one increases the homing effectiveness.
[*]Pings emitted by submarines are now visible to enemies at distances of around 8 km. They can help players determine the approximate location of the attacking submarine.
[*]Torpedoes home in on the last ping and remember their target. They don't lose the bonuses from the active ping hit sector, even when new pings hit another ship.
[*]Torpedoes will interact with the last emitted pulse that hit a target before the torpedo was launched. It will interact with the first pulse that hit a target after the torpedo was launched if there were no other active pings. The torpedo's homing parameters will improve if the first ping hit the target before the torpedo was launched and the second ping hits the target after the torpedo was launched.
[*]Ships can nullify ping hit sectors by using Damage Control Party. However, if the submarine hits the same ship once or twice in the same sector, torpedoes get their homing bonuses again. This can be used to switch to another target in battle while preserving the effectiveness of torpedoes that have already been launched.
[*]Sonar pings can be emitted at several ships and stay on several targets simultaneously. Thus, you can prepare various variants for your next attack.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b314613e-a924-11ec-856c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Alternative torpedoes[/h2]
[list][*]Do not interact with sonar pings and do not home in, even vertically. There's no point in launching these torpedoes at enemy ships while submerged. They inflict damage that can be compared to that of destroyer torpedoes.
[*]Their range and speed have been reduced, while their arming distance and detectability have been increased.
[*]With these torpedoes, there's no need to use sonar pings, so you can launch them without revealing your position to the enemy.[/list]
[h2]Fuel spills[/h2]
[list][*]If a submarine is hit at the periscope or maximum depths, a fuel spill will appear on the water's surface. These spills will help surface ships determine submarine locations and movements.
[*]Submarines can eliminate fuel spills by using Damage Control Party, surfacing, or staying in the surfaced position.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cebc018a-a924-11ec-84c7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Dive capacity[/h2]
[list][*]When a submarine is detected at the periscope or maximum depths, dive capacity depletes but at a lower rate than before.
[*]The restoration rate has been increased, but the battery capacity has been reduced by a quarter.[/list] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=counter-submarine][/h1]Playing Against Submarines[/b][/h2]
[h2]Sonar pings[/h2]
[list][*]Sonar ping emitted by submarines are now visible to ships within an 8 km radius (approximately).
[*]Ping detection doesn't work exactly like torpedo detection—each ship sees only pulses within her acquisition radius.
[*]When a sonar ping hits a ship, a special indicator will appear on the ship itself and the ship miniature in the corner of the screen.
[*]Any sonar ping sector can be discarded with the help of Damage Control Party.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e5be65b2-a924-11ec-8f6d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Dealing damage to submarines[/h2]
[list][*]Shells, aerial bombs, aerial torpedoes, ship torpedoes, and rockets can deal damage to submarines only at periscope depth or on the surface.
[*]Ships can have depth charges or the Airstrike armament as countermeasures against submarines.
[*]Depth charges are used at close range. The effective radius of the Airstrike armament depends on the ship type and tier.
[*]Airstrike has a rather short reload time, but each dropped bomb deals only a small amount of damage. However, the bombing area is also small, which increases their fall density. If used successfully, several bombs may hit the submarine at once.
[*]Airstrike depth charges now cause flooding with 100% probability. A submarine can only be affected by one flooding instance at a time.[/list]
[h2]Consumables that can be used against submarines[/h2]
[list][*]Hydroacoustic Search can detect submarines in any position, but the detection radius is only 2 km below periscope depth.
[*]Surveillance Radar detects submarines only at the surface level.[/list]
[h2]Fighting against submarines underwater[/h2]
[list][*]A submarine can spend only a limited amount of time underwater because of her limited dive capacity—she will have to surface sooner or later.
[*]When a submarine is hit, an oil spill will appear on the water's surface, provided that the submarine doesn't take any countermeasures to fix it. These spills will help players track down damaged submarines, even when they are submerged[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1025fe46-a925-11ec-84c7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=changes][/h1]What's Changed?[/b][/h2] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3085ae80-a14a-11ec-be6c-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/daa2f920-a926-11ec-a3f2-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/305c2218-a14a-11ec-8379-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2]For submarines[/h2]
[list][*]Subs can now glide between three (previously, four) key positions—the surface, periscope depth, and maximum depth. This will make it easier for players to helm submarines and better understand their operation specifics.
[*]The time that submarines can spend at periscope level or underwater is limited by their dive capacity. Capturing Key Areas is only possible while on the surface.
[*]Subs are armed with two types of torpedoes:

[list][*]Homing torpedoes that have higher chances of reaching their target but deal less damage.
[*]Conventional torpedoes that make it harder to hit a target but deal more damage.[/list]
[*]The number of Damage Control Party consumable charges is now limited, For this reason, the consumable should now be used wisely. If you run out of charges early in battle, you'll have nothing to stop flooding or oil leaks, and this will make your sub easier to detect and destroy.[/list]
[h2]Playing against submarines[/h2]
[list][*]Surface ships have a wider range of options to interact with submarines.

[list][*]Sonar pings emitted by submarines are now visible to surface ships and can be used to determine their approximate position.
[*]Oil spills will now appear on the water's surface when a submerged submarine is hit, giving you the ability to track its movements.[/list]
[*]The Airstrike armament with an accelerated cooldown will allow for more frequent attacks and complement the new mechanics.
[*]Airstrike depth charges now always cause flooding, making them the perfect weapon to take a major chunk of a sub's HP.
[*]A submarine, however, can only have one instance of flooding at a time. This means that putting her under a barrage of Airstrikes wouldn't be an overly efficient way of using this armament.[/list]
[list][i]These are the global changes that will be put to the test in Update 0.11.2. At this stage, the numbers and values aren't final. Where possible, we provided approximate values.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
We come bearing gifts! Stay on the lookout for Community Tokens in this and other articles on our website! You can exchange them in the Armory for containers that hold Premium ships and other items. Stay tuned for more news, and be sure to share this article with your friends so they can also enjoy the gifts!

[b]Thursday, March 17, 16:45 local time. We moored in Dublin. The captain allowed us to go out into the city for a little shore leave.[/b]

[b]Thursday, March 17, 21:15 local time. We have been at anchor in Incheon for a week now. An old sailor has joined up with us. Our entire crew has taken an immediate liking to him. In the evenings, he tells us stories of the legendary Yi Sun-sin. He says that this naval commander knew how to emerge victorious from any situation.[/b]

notes.title: Savage Battle
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/cbf203a06eb32cc2da047bb34e59e0cbfb99afde.jpg[/img]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#what-you-need-to-know]What You Need to Know[/url]
[url=#special-destroyers]Special Destroyers[/url]
[url=#achievements-and-rewards]Achievements and Rewards[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=what-you-need-to-know][/h1]What You Need to Know[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Thu. 17 Mar. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Thu. 14 Apr. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

[list][*]The event will unfold on the [b]Flooded City[/b] map.
[*]Battles will be fought between[b] four teams, each with three ships[/b]. You can fight either in a Division or solo.
[*]At the beginning of the battle, all ships [b]have no consumable charges[/b]. Collect consumable charges from special zones and remember—each time you destroy an enemy ship, you will also obtain a charge for a random consumable.
[*]The map is plagued by [b]Wild Fire[/b] that encompasses the battle area. The safe zone starts shrinking from the start of the battle. By the end of the match, only a small portion of the map will remain safe. Watch out! Ships gradually lose HP while they remain engulfed in Wild Fire.
[*]In the Savage Battle, all ships have [b]reinforced bows[/b]. When ramming enemy ships, you will take less damage while causing more.
[*]The event is open for all players who have reached [b]Access Level 12[/b]. Once the event is over and all ships have been removed from your accounts, any XP you earned will be transferred to [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]I[/b] Orlan[/b][/b].[/list]
[b]Battle results.[/b] The amount of XP and Credits that you obtain at the end of each battle now depends on your team’s overall score relative to that of the others—the higher your team’s placement, the more resources you'll obtain! Teams that lose all of their ships are out of the battle. The team with the last surviving ship (or ships) on the battlefield is the winner.

[list][i]To commemorate the launch of the event, we're also bringing back the special Port.[/i][/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3beab56a-a549-11ec-a8b7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=special-destroyers][/h1]Special Destroyers[/b][/h2]
Each faction consists of three destroyers modified specifically for the Savage Battle. The characteristics of each subsequent ship in each faction outmatch those of the preceding ship. But the better the ship, the more resources it will take to service her.

To access the second ship in a faction, you will need to earn 10,000 Base XP on the first one, and you'll need to earn another 10,000 Base XP on the second ship to get to the third one.

[list]Each ship is helmed by a unique Commander. Any XP they earn will be converted into Elite Commander XP. You can use it for re-training and re-specializing any of your other Commanders or resetting their skills.[/list]
[h2]Octopus[/h2]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_498b9b5f1d1272d1a056a3cee913ad9a3230eafab62e06c4b4ed9b791c0a8cba.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Messer[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_498b9b5f1d1272d1a056a3cee913ad9a3230eafab62e06c4b4ed9b791c0a8cba.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Sea Devil[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_498b9b5f1d1272d1a056a3cee913ad9a3230eafab62e06c4b4ed9b791c0a8cba.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Stealthedo[/b][/b] all boast good concealment and powerful torpedoes. [h2][b][h1=features][/h1]Features of the new ships[/b][/h2]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/16de2a30-a3b0-11ec-91c0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]II[/b] Curtatone[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]III[/b] Nazario Sauro[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]IV[/b] Turbine[/b][/b]. The primary armament of the new ships placed at Tiers II to IV is their torpedoes. In terms of gameplay, these ships are similar to "conventional" destroyers. All of them carry SAP and HE shells.

At Tiers II to IV, ship consumables don't last long and are mostly used for illustrative purposes to introduce players to their unusual characteristics. Exhaust Smoke Generator will hide a ship even if it’s running at full speed, and the Emergency Engine Power consumable provides a bigger boost to speed compared to the standard Engine Boost, but for a shorter period of time.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/16e3c4cc-a3b0-11ec-a73b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Maestrale[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Aviere[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Luca Tarigo[/b][/b]. At Tiers V to VII, main battery guns get better but the ships continue to rely on torpedo tubes as their primary armament. Unlike their counterparts of other nations, there is only a slight increase in the firing range of their main batteries.

The characteristics of their consumables, however, improve from tier to tier, helping shape a full-fledged style of combat. With Emergency Engine Power, SAP shells, and Exhaust Smoke Generator, Italian destroyers can close in on an enemy ship for an aggressive attack at short range.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/16d8c73e-a3b0-11ec-9a2b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Vittorio Cuniberti[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Adriatico[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Attilio Regolo[/b][/b]. At Tiers VIII to X, combat strategy may be based on an intermittent approach. Commanders will need to conduct a thorough analysis of the situation and choose between (or combine) the following two strategies:
[list][*]Firing long-range quick-reload torpedoes in a measured way.
[*]Relying on a combination of main guns, torpedoes, and consumables for a lightning-fast strike.[/list]
The most similar pre-existing ship suited for this type of aggressive combat strategy is [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Paolo Emilio[/b][/b]. At the same time, researchable Italian destroyers will also rely on their main guns in knife-distance duels, since torpedoes alone may not be enough to finish the job. Keep in mind that at Tiers VIII—X, the standard firing range does not exceed 10 km. Upgrades to extend the firing range are not accessible.

[b]Captains![/b]

It's now much simpler to participate in the Public Test—you can log in using your main account. To do so, select [b]Public Test[/b] in the [b]Game Instance[/b] section of the Wargaming Game Center. You'll receive Community Tokens as a reward for participating in the Public Test. These can be exchanged for Premium ships, permanent camouflages, Supercontainers, and other in-game items!

Captains, thank you for participating in the Public Test for Update 0.11.2! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]
[list][*]In the first round, many testers experienced game crashes. For the second round, we’ve done some bugfixing to stabilize the client. Thank you for your feedback.
[*]Changed the colors of the different teams' icons in Savage Battle — now they are more easily distinguishable from each other.
[*]Balance changes applied to the Savage Battle mode: the Moray Eel faction has been reinforced, the Octopus faction was weakened, and changes were made to the post-battle economy of ships based on testing results.
[*]Fixed incorrect detectability settings for submarines.
[*]Fixed and issue that caused ships to get stuck near islands on the map Neighbors.
[*]Fixed a bug that made the researching of ships in bulk work incorrectly.
[*]Fixed visual bugs in the Flooded City port.
[*]Fixed the incorrect working of the Top Grade Gunner skill.
[*]Balance changes were made to Superships, Hornet, submarines, and depth charges. Further details can be found in our [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/289]Development Blog[/url].
[*]Fixed several other minor bugs.[/list]
[h2]Combat Missions and Rewards[/h2]
[list][*]The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.
[*]Any due rewards will automatically be credited to your account within a few days of the release of the new update.
[*]Once the Public Test begins, the starting ships for the Savage Battle event will appear on your accounts.[/list]

notes.title: Compensation for technical issue in 0.11.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a5f906585e460f893e3ca3313f5b6d696273ef3f.jpg[/img]
[h3][b][b]Captains![/b][/b][/h3]
As you already know, we discovered some bugs after the release of Update 0.11.1, among which were an increase in crashes and a longer loading time on startup, as well as the impossibility to open the Armory for some players. 

Our team has already found solutions to these problems and most of them were fixed last week with the release of patch 0.11.1.1.

We’d like to thank you for your constructive feedback, which helped us to quickly identify these problems and begin working on fixes as swiftly as possible.

[list]Compensation will be credited to the accounts of all affected players within a week. [/list]

[h1][b]Developer Bulletin for Update 0.11.2[/b][/h1]
[list][b][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.[/b][/list]

[h2][b][h1=submarines][/h1]Submarines[/b][/h2]
After a short break, submarines are again lurking in the depths of our seas for testing purposes. Read on for a glimpse of how to play and counter the revamped subs.

In this new round of testing, we've gone above and beyond to address all the issues reported by you—from subs being hard to detect and interact with, to the unstable damage-dealing capabilities of submarines. We've made both playing and countering submarines more intuitive. We hope these changes will help us shape the final stages of the new ship type's evolution. To make it easier for you to go through the new round of testing, we've reworked the way information is displayed by placing a stronger focus on the key aspects of playing a sub and countering one.

[h3][b]Countering a Submarine[/b][/h3]
[list][*]In the new testing round, surface ships have a wider range of options to interact with submarines.
[list][*]Sonar pings emitted by a sub now hint at the sub's approximate location because surface ships now have the ability to spot those pings.
[*]We've added a new mechanic—oil spills. These will appear on the water's surface over the location of damaged submarines, giving you the ability to track their movements.[/list]
[*]The Airstrike armament with an accelerated cooldown will allow for more frequent attacks and complement the new mechanics.
[*]Airstrike depth charges now always cause flooding, making them the perfect weapon to take a major chunk of a sub's HP.
[*]A submarine, however, can only have one instance of flooding at a time. This means that putting her under a barrage of Airstrikes won't be an overly efficient way of using this armament.[/list]
[h3][b]Playing a Submarine[/b][/h3]
[list][*]A sub can glide between three key positions—the surface, periscope depth, and maximum depth. This will make it easier for players on both teams to operate submarines and determine their depth in battle.
[*]A submarine can inflict damage to her foes in two ways:
[list][*]The safer option is to use homing torpedoes.
[*]The harder and riskier but more rewarding option is to stick to conventional torpedoes.[/list]
[*]The number of Damage Control Party consumable charges is now limited, which means that it's more important now for submarines to be aware of the situation around them and stay alert at all times.
[list][*]Damage Control Party should be used wisely, and it will certainly help you escape some tricky situations. For example, a damaged sub risks being tracked down by the oil spill she leaves on the surface and then suffering more flooding damage from the inevitable depth charge attack that ensues.
[*]If you run out of charges early in a battle, you will reduce your chances of having an effect on the outcome of the battle during its closing stages.[/list]
[*]An unlimited number of charges for the Hydrophone consumable. In the new testing round, this equipment will provide updated data on the whereabouts of enemies more frequently.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/947a168c-90b1-11ec-bb3e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/95e923f0-90b1-11ec-aa54-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/95e7f7f0-90b1-11ec-976b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/94d75504-90b1-11ec-9296-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9497dcb2-90b1-11ec-b09e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/95e79dd2-90b1-11ec-a62b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][i]More details about these changes will be available on the Public Test Server and in the [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/279]Development Blog[/url].[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=italian-destroyers-part-1][/h1]Italian destroyers: Part 1[/b][/h2]
Update 0.11.2 ushers Italian destroyers into Early Access.

All ships of the new branch are notable for being able to deal high damage per minute, but their main battery guns spit SAP and HE shells only and have a very short range of fire. The Italian destroyers are also armed with long-range torpedoes. The ships have access to Exhaust Smoke Generator and Emergency Engine Power starting from Tier II.

The Taranto Port has been updated to celebrate the arrival of the Italian destroyers in Early Access.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a8b9e33c-90b3-11ec-8b85-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][b]The Italian destroyers will not be available on the Public Test Server.[/b][/list]
[hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=clash-of-courage][/h1]Clash of Courage[/b][/h2]
One of the key new features is a temporary event called Clash of Courage. The Italian Navy, known for its love of destroyers, is staging a competition between divisions composed of the same series of ships to determine the most successful team. Choose which team you want to join as an ally, and keep in mind that each team will provide you with a unique reward—an Italian Commander with 6 skill points and a team patch.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a8c9824c-90b3-11ec-8b65-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The Clash of Courage event works in a similar way to the New Year's Night, Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry, and Battle of the Beasts events.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a8d667b4-90b3-11ec-8af5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list]Participate in the event to earn Italian Tokens, which can be exchanged for Early Access ships, permanent camouflages, and other items.[/list] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=savage-battle][/h1]Savage Battle: Sink 'Em All![/b][/h2]
The Savage Battle is back! The power of a once-great civilization is now history, and their glorious city is destroyed and flooded. It's your territory now—fight and become one of the best!

Battles will be fought between four teams, each with three ships. The small line-ups will let players enjoy the battle playing either solo or in a Division.

The Savage Battle will start on the outskirts of a flooded city. At the beginning of the battle, your ship has no consumable charges. This is because the world is on the brink of collapse, and the only limited resources that remain out there will go to those who fight the hardest to get them. Collect consumable charges from special zones and remember—each time you destroy an enemy ship, you will also obtain a charge for a random consumable. Watch out—the other teams are on high alert and can get at you where you would least expect them! On top of your enemies, you also want to watch out for the Wild Fire that encircles the water. Ships that remain engulfed in the Wild Fire gradually lose HP.

[h3][b]Specifically for the Savage Battle, we have modified nine destroyers and divided them into the following three factions:[/b][/h3]
[h3][i]Octopus[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
Low-detectability ships armed with powerful torpedoes that are capable of pulverizing anyone who dares stand in their way. The ships are also equipped with secondary batteries, but these are not the specialty of the Octopuses. The prototypes of these ships are [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Z-52[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Shimakaze[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Daring[/b][/b].
[/expand]
[h3][i]Moray Eel[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
Maneuverable steel monsters! Ships of this faction will ideally suit fans of aggressive close-quarters brawls. Their major advantage is maneuverability combined with powerful propulsion. The devastating main guns are operated by artificial intelligence, but the ship’s torpedoes are rather weak and slow. [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Yueyang[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Gearing[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Kléber[/b][/b] served as prototypes for the ships of the Moray Eel faction.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Barracuda[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
Those that glide swiftly through the waves on the wings of scorched winds! Expect high speeds, the ability to directly control her main battery guns, and torpedoes that have mediocre characteristics. While designing these ships, the engineers kept an eye on [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Harugumo[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Grozovoi[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Khabarovsk[/b][/b].
[/expand]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fbdebf32-90af-11ec-976b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The resources that you obtain at the end of each battle now depend on the place your team takes—the higher the place, the more resources you'll obtain! The team that loses all of their ships is out of the battle. The team with the last surviving ship (or ships) on the battlefield is the winner.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b291c726-90ae-11ec-9296-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b2a10bfa-90ae-11ec-9c48-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b29a5e54-90ae-11ec-b736-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b29c16d6-90ae-11ec-aa54-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list]Join the Public Test and try out the fierce action in this unusual format![/list] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=hot-wheels][/h1]Hot Wheels™[/b][/h2]
We have added the following items inspired by the Hot Wheels™ universe: permanent camouflages Bone Shaker™ for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Gneisenau[/b][/b], Twin Mill™ for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Fubuki[/b][/b], and Muscle Bound™ for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Hill[/b][/b]; Commanders [b]Bad Advice Cap[/b] and [b]Racing Fishy[/b]; patches; and commemorative flags. Details of the collaboration will be announced later.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/03576614-90c5-11ec-b068-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9dc98c34-90c2-11ec-9303-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/010bf0d4-90c3-11ec-a6b7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9dc0b99c-90c2-11ec-8ac9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9e6275fc-90c2-11ec-8c32-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9daeccdc-90c2-11ec-89bc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=visual-effects-improvements][/h1]Visual Effects Improvements[/b][/h2]
World of Warships is getting even more pleasing to the eye! The new update brings reworked effects for shooting main and secondary battery guns; depth charges hitting the water and islands; local weather effects on the Hotspot, North, Greece, and Islands of Ice maps; aircraft explosions on the deck when aircraft carriers are destroyed; obtaining a Supercontainer; and rain.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/59b6dc66-90b0-11ec-9296-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/59ad1b36-90b0-11ec-b09e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/59e6afd6-90b0-11ec-aa54-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/59ec1df4-90b0-11ec-976b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=changes-to-the-game-mechanics][/h1]Changes to the Game Mechanics[/b][/h2]
We have updated the mechanics of determining a ship's maximum spotting range. All ships now have a minimum spotting range that depends on their tier and type, as well as a dynamic spotting range. The first range is a constant value that's set regardless of the ship's parameters. The dynamic spotting range depends on the current firing range of all the ship's weapons (main battery guns, torpedoes, secondary battery guns, and Airstrike) and always exceeds this value by 25% or 3 km. At the same time, it's the higher value of the minimum and dynamic spotting ranges that's always applied.

[i]Example:[/i] [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] North Carolina[/b][/b] has a standard firing range of 21.1 km. The minimum spotting range for a Tier VIII battleship is 30 km. The dynamic spotting range for North Carolina is 21.1 * 1.25 = 26.4 km. As the largest value is applied, the spotting range for North Carolina with a firing range of 21.1 km is set at 30 km.

If we equip the ship with Gun Fire Control System and Artillery Plotting Room Modification 1, our firing range will be 27 km and the dynamic spotting range value will reach 33.75 km, which will be the prevailing value for the ship's spotting range in this case. If we also launch Spotting Aircraft in battle and increase our firing range to 32.4 km, our spotting range in battle will increase to a value that exceeds 40 km.

This, of course, is but a simple example that's intended to show how the new mechanics work. It's by no means a recommendation for selecting upgrades and equipment for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] North Carolina[/b][/b].

As we standardize these values, the standard spotting range values of certain ships may either decrease or increase.
[hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=other-changes][/h1]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
[list][*]Minor changes have been made to the Port interface—we've updated the tooltips for currencies and resources, corrected descriptions of ships, and added other minor details.
[*]We've also made it possible to research several consecutive ships from any branch in the Tech Tree.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c0f0a4bc-90b4-11ec-b0cd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Ranked Battles: The Sixth Season
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a35dc726706dbed281a2bb3ddf34a9a8a1339199.jpg[/img]
[b]Update 0.11.1 kicks off the Sixth Season of Ranked Battles.[/b]

Test your skills and earn Doubloons, Steel, camouflages, and special containers! Reaching Rank 1 in the Gold League will reward you with Ranked Tokens. Win battles, stock up on Tokens, and purchase rare permanent camouflages!

[table][tr][th][b][url=#rewards]Rewards[/url]
[url=#rules]Rules[/url]
[url=#bonus-combat-mission]Bonus Combat Mission[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=rewards][/h1]Rewards[/b][/h2]
The rewards for each league refresh and become available again at the start of each new Sprint.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/d03ee1f4-8b00-11ec-b06f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Dirigible Derby
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2755364323][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2c293225e93eaa609d08d4a3c95d763880b14cbd.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]Update 0.11.1 sees the start flag drop on a new temporary battle type codenamed "Dirigible Derby."[/b]

Airships historically carried intelligence agents bearing important messages and diplomats traveling to conduct secret negotiations in neutral territories. The new battle type tasks you with a mission to delay the hostile airship while also making sure that your allied airship is the first to reach the destination point.

[table][tr][th][b][url=#rules]Rules[/url]
[url=#achievements-and-combat-missions]Achievements and Combat Missions[/url]
[url=#super-zeppelin-behind-the-scenes]Super Zeppelin: Behind the Scenes[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=0kJOioH12cU;full][/previewyoutube] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=rules][/h1]Rules[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Thu. 17 Feb. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Thu. 17 Mar. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

Maps: Islands of Ice, Hotspot, Warrior's Path, Shards, Estuary, Trident, and Sea of Fortune.

Battles will be held in a 12 vs. 12 format with Tier X ships.

You can enter each battle either alone or as part of a Division of up to three players.

Each team has an invulnerable airship that travels along a fixed route. Your team's mission is to either be the first to have their airship reach the end of its route or to destroy all enemy ships.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a900ff02-8d92-11ec-b129-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The routes and locations of the airships are visible to both teams on the Minimap. A special bar will also help you keep track of which airship is closer to reaching the destination point.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/82aec2a8-8a68-11ec-aad1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Each team can affect the speed of both the allied and hostile airships. Each airship has an interactive zone with a 3 km radius displayed around it. The airships will move faster if only allied ships are within their zone, and they will slow down if at least one enemy ship manages to sneak inside it.
[hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=achievements-and-combat-missions][/h1]Achievements and Combat Missions[/b][/h2]
Your successes in Dirigible Derby will be rewarded with special themed achievements:
[table][tr][th][b][/b][/th][th][b]Achievement Name[/b][/th][th][b]Condition[/b][/th][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/2AIRSHIPS_VICTORYCLAIMED_69f3f26161a92dd6a92c2b17a89f4855d27bcd27edbb186526e63f6731e1a70a.png[/img][/td] [td]Snatched Glory[/td] [td]Win by destroying all enemy ships when the enemy airship is near the very end of the route.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/2AIRSHIPS_STOPPER_3aeaa3429f32b9e28bffaeeccb5a935f63d4cd64a21243aae2b7822dbd7317f9.png[/img][/td] [td]Held at Bay[/td] [td]Continuously slow down the enemy airship for a minute.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/2AIRSHIPS_5MINUTESWINNER_35b0206a2d60ffa59bba9efe2147cb9e03aa509450db536e8e8e2dcefbe4e54c.png[/img][/td] [td]Relentless[/td] [td]Win after having continuously accelerated the allied airship for 5 minutes.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/2AIRSHIPS_INCENTER_1bc8a7b88d570ac4fd77ce3eb1a1f5ec5835bc49d912a978cbf3ae1562666793.png[/img][/td] [td]Push Ahead, Hold Them Back[/td] [td]Simultaneously speed up your allied airship and slow down the enemy airship.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/2AIRSHIPS_PHOTOFINISH_7615de9bed90f541457240ea4f3a170edf51d628a1efab890076fe931cb1b772.png[/img][/td] [td]Photo Finish[/td] [td]Win by bringing your allied airship to the destination point with a slight lead over the enemy airship while also speeding up the allied airship or slowing down the enemy airship at the end of the battle.[/td][/tr][/table]
[list][i]Due to the specifics of the battle type, you can only earn these achievements in Dirigible Derby.[/i][/list]

[list]You will also have access to special daily and weekly combat missions that can only be completed in Dirigible Derby. Win and earn Base XP to obtain Community Tokens. Detailed information about the mission completion criteria can be found in the game client.[/list] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=super-zeppelin-behind-the-scenes][/h1]Super Zeppelin: Behind the Scenes[/b][/h2]
When implementing our idea of an escort-based game mode, we decided that we would need a mobile marker that would be visible across the entire map. At this point, we realized that instead of an artificial UI element, we could turn the escorted vehicle itself into the marker by elevating it into the sky. Airplanes are both too fast and too small to serve this purpose — thus the airship idea was born. We already had several models in-game to work with, the largest and most recognizable being the German Zeppelin LZ-127. However, even a giant of almost 237 meters in length wasn't large enough for our needs.

Simply doubling the size of this airship would be an affront to historical authenticity and engineering. Therefore, we had to urgently design a plausible new airship. We dubbed her the "Super Zeppelin."

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/dd1f4f84-8d90-11ec-a118-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/dd1619dc-8d90-11ec-a1b1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/dd163f98-8d90-11ec-bf26-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/dd1c8e48-8d90-11ec-8e16-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
The new giant turned out to be 519 meters long and 67 meters in diameter. To build the airship, we used the same design principles that were used in the prototype Zeppelin. It's clear that such an airship would not fit into existing hangars, but it could be built out in the open on a flat area, similar to how ships are made.

The purpose of such a large airship could have been regular communications with South America, a continent which Germany had been actively building relations with from the beginning of the 20th century. Therefore, we've made a cargo-and-passenger airship with a two-tiered control cabin, an observation lounge at the top of the hull, and a large cargo compartment near the center of mass. The Super Zeppelin's load capacity would be 150 tons, and its dry weight would be about 450 tons. To be able to maintain a speed of approximately 120 km/h, the number of engines has been increased by a factor of four, which amounts to 20 Maybach VL IIs.

We had only a short amount of time to develop this model, but, as you can see, the project was very carefully thought out and no detail was spared. For example, we made folding ramps in the cargo compartment so that trucks could enter and unload using an internal overhead crane or special loaders. As a result of our work, we have the desired marker, which is a realistic object that feels cohesive with the overall scope of World of Warships.

[h2][b][h1=pan-asian-cruisers][/h1]Pan-Asian Cruisers[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/dce0835a-89b0-11ec-98fa-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In Update 0.11.1, Pan-Asian cruisers continue to be available in Early Access. Ships of the new branch are equipped with main guns that have a rather small caliber but high rate of fire. They carry powerful deepwater torpedoes that pose a deadly threat to all ship types except destroyers. This, however, comes at a price—the new ships cannot boast of having high survivability.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c5751746-8a44-11ec-9e8d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c5606634-8a44-11ec-93e3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c5d3d4ac-8a44-11ec-9527-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c56faff4-8a44-11ec-ba47-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]

[list][*]Smoke Generator with a reduced cooldown time for all ships of the branch.
[*]Defensive AA Fire for the new cruisers of Tier VI and above.
[*]Torpedo Reload Booster for the ships of Tier VII and above.
[*][b] [b][b]IX[/b] Sejong[/b][/b] and [b] [b][b]X[/b] Jinan[/b][/b] are equipped with Repair Party.[/list]
[h2]Early Access[/h2]
[list][*][b] [b][b]VI[/b] Rahmat[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] Harbin[/b][/b], and [b] [b][b]X[/b] Jinan[/b][/b]—all hitting the high seas in Early Access with the release of Update 0.11.0—continue to be available in sequential bundles in the Armory.
[*][b] [b][b]VI[/b] Rahmat[/b][/b] and [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] Harbin[/b][/b], along with other rewards, can be obtained in bundles available in exchange for Pan-Asian Tokens.
[*]Once you've obtained all the sequential bundles for Tokens, you'll be able to grab [b] [b][b]X[/b] Jinan[/b][/b] for Doubloons.
[*][b] [b][b]IX[/b] Sejong[/b][/b] is available in random bundles for Doubloons.[/list]
[list][i][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/83f4bea4-8a47-11ec-93e3-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]To celebrate the arrival of the Pan-Asian cruisers in Early Access, we've updated the Dragon Port. You will also have access to a dedicated combat mission to obtain the Pan-Asian Cruisers: Part 2 commemorative flag. Details of the mission will be available in the game client.[/i][/list]

[list]When Update 0.11.2 goes live, the Pan-Asian cruisers will become available for all players to research.[/list] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=dirigible-derby][/h1]Dirigible Derby[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/af6af810-8a64-11ec-a67e-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Update 0.11.1 kicks off a temporary battle type named "Dirigible Derby."

Historically, airships carried intelligence agents with important messages and diplomats traveling to conduct secret negotiations in neutral territories. The new battle type tasks you with a mission to delay the hostile airship while also making sure that your allied airship is the first to reach the destination point.

[h2]Rules[/h2]
Each team will have an invulnerable airship that moves along a fixed route. Your team's mission is to outrun the opposing team in escorting their airship to the end of the route or destroy all enemy ships.

The teams can affect the speed of both allied and hostile airships. Each airship has an interactive zone with a 3 km radius displayed around it. The airship will move faster if only allied ships are within that zone and will slow down if at least one enemy ship manages to sneak inside it.

[b]Format:[/b] 12 vs. 12 playing Tier X ships.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/82aec2a8-8a68-11ec-aad1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/73f67032-8a66-11ec-8e16-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/737067a8-8a66-11ec-a732-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/721eeed8-8a66-11ec-b311-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/736e0e36-8a66-11ec-9c3a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/72222652-8a66-11ec-a67e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][i]The full details of the Dirigible Derby will follow in a separate article.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=personal-challenges][/h1]Personal Challenges[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/dd2abcf4-89b0-11ec-a65b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Update 0.11.1 brings back Personal Challenges. Your goal during the event is to earn as much base XP as possible while showing off your skills in battle playing ships of different types and nations. More details will follow in a dedicated [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/personal-challenges-and-the-naval-battle/#personal-challenges]article[/url].

We've updated the rewards, and the table of records will be reset 2 weeks after the update goes live. This means that the rewards will again become available to any players who manage to reach the top level prior to the reset.

You can take up Personal Challenges in Random, Ranked, and Co-op Battles, as well as in Dirigible Derby.

[h2]Rewards[/h2]
Each completed Personal Challenge mission will bring you [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_4_cf148075fbd52573c744fbc889a1a765b55ca304693f6c2b5fecf36d3cc8ef76.png[/img] 1x Mediterranean Token and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]50[/b] Coal.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6c08d47a-8a6e-11ec-baae-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]The event is split into two rounds, each 2 weeks long.
[*]In the span of 2 weeks, you can get a maximum of [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_4_cf148075fbd52573c744fbc889a1a765b55ca304693f6c2b5fecf36d3cc8ef76.png[/img] 50 Tokens.
[*]After reaching the maximum weekly limit, each completed task will bring only [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]50[/b] Coal.
[*]Once the table is reset, you'll be able to earn Tokens again.
[*]The entire event can bring you as many as [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_4_cf148075fbd52573c744fbc889a1a765b55ca304693f6c2b5fecf36d3cc8ef76.png[/img] 100 Mediterranean Tokens.[/list]
Navigate to "Gibraltar Pillars"—a special tab in the Armory—to exchange Mediterranean Tokens for sequential bundles and other rewards. You will have access to two types of sequential bundles. They include one of two new ships—[b] [b][b]VI[/b] Dido[/b][/b] or [b] [b][b]VI[/b] Canarias[/b][/b]—clad in the Atlantic permanent camouflage, as well as Firepower Premium containers, which can drop Tier X ships. Mediterranean Tokens can be exchanged until the end of Update 0.11.2.

The number of Tokens you can grab for free by progressing through Personal Challenges will be enough to get [b] [b][b]VI[/b] Dido[/b][/b] or [b] [b][b]VI[/b] Canarias[/b][/b] and one Firepower container.

[b] [b][b]VI[/b] Dido[/b][/b], named in honor of Queen Dido—the legendary founder of Carthage—served extensively in the Mediterranean during World War II. The ship is armed with ten 133 mm main guns and torpedoes that have a decent reload time and speed. She can also choose between firing all of her torpedoes in a single salvo or one at a time. Despite somewhat mediocre survivability, the ship boasts good concealment and agility characteristics. She is propelled by an engine with enhanced parameters that allow her to gain or drop speed fast. However, the cruiser lacks the Propulsion Modification 1 upgrade in Slot 4. Dido is equipped with Defensive AA Fire and Short-Burst Smoke Generator, which has lots of charges and a short reset timer but also a short smoke setting time and individual smoke clouds that don't last very long.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/324efb46-8a51-11ec-abcb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[b] [b][b]VI[/b] Canarias[/b][/b] was built in Spain in the 1930s using a British design (Armstrong). During World War II, Spain remained neutral, and the means of identification the cruiser carried on both of her sides was the country's national flag. The ship is armed with eight 203 mm main guns that can fire only AP shells with enhanced ricochet angles. The guns have a long firing range and good reload time for their caliber. Canarias' survivability is quite solid, but this feature comes at the cost of rather mediocre maneuverability. The range of consumables the ship has access to includes Hydroacoustic Search and Engine Boost—a consumable that isn't typically found on cruisers and provides the ship a 15% boost to her maximum speed.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/324fe52e-8a51-11ec-bc2f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Firepower containers have chances of dropping a new ship named [b] [b][b]X[/b] Forrest Sherman[/b][/b]—the lead ship of a series of destroyers that were built after World War II and designed with the experience gained from the conflict in mind. The ship relies on three rapid-firing 127 mm main guns that spit HE and SAP shells, as well as four 533 mm single torpedo mounts—two on either side of the ship. They have a long reach and good reload time but a narrow aiming sector. The destroyer is equipped with Hydroacoustic Search, Defensive AA Fire, and Smoke Generator with a small number of charges, but she has no access to Engine Boost.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9a4489d2-8a51-11ec-8748-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The destroyer will also be available in the Armory in exchange for Coal later.

[h3][i][h3][b]What's inside a Firepower container?[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
The percentage indicates the drop chances of each group of items:
[list][*]One item from the list below — 100%. Breakdown:
[list][*]A Tier X ship with a Port slot and Commander with 10 skill points ([b] [b][b]X[/b] Forrest Sherman[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]X[/b] Moskva[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]X[/b] Max Immelmann[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]X[/b] Napoli[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]X[/b] Hayate[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]X[/b] Salem[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]X[/b] Marceau[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]X[/b] Yoshino[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]X[/b] Grosser Kurfürst[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]X[/b] Khabarovsk[/b][/b]) — 5%
[*]25x special signals of the same type (Dragon, Wyvern, Red Dragon, Ouroboros, Hydra, Basilisk, Scylla, or Leviathan) — 44%
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]15,000[/b] Coal — 10%
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]37,500[/b] Free XP or [b]120,000[/b] Elite Commander XP — 41%[/list]
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]12,500[/b] Free XP; or [b]37,500[/b] Elite Commander XP; or [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]900,000[/b] Credits — 100%
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]12,500[/b] Free XP; or [b]37,500[/b] Elite Commander XP; or [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]900,000[/b] Credits — 100%[/list]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f776a176-8a51-11ec-838e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[list][i]All other details about the container mechanics will be released later.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=changes-to-the-in-game-economy][/h1]Changes to the In-Game Economy[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/dcdb171c-89b0-11ec-a885-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Damage to Aircraft[/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/fe0f9fca-7ac4-11ec-b3e5-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]The economic reward for destroying aircraft will now be distributed in the same way as the reward for damaging and destroying ships. Some Credits and XP will be issued not only for shooting aircraft down but also for dealing damage to them.

On average, the amount of resources earned won't change, but the reward will be easier to obtain.

[h2]Ammunition Resupply[/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/fe1514a0-7ac4-11ec-bff8-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]The costs of resupplying aircraft carrier ammunition and the Airstrike armament will now be calculated by reference to the amount of ammunition used rather than the number of aircraft lost. Credits will also be spent on resupplying depth charges used by destroyers and cruisers.

These steps will bring the costs of resupplying aircraft carrier ammunition, the Airstrike armament, and depth charges in line with the other types of ammunition.

[h2]Aircraft Carrier XP[/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/fe15a744-7ac4-11ec-a704-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]We've reworked the way XP is earned by Tier VIII and X carriers. They will now earn more for sinking enemies and less for damaging them.

Previously, good battle performance playing Tier VIII and X carriers yielded a smaller reward compared to the other ship types. Even sinking numerous enemy ships hardly ever placed carriers among the top XP earners on the team. Now, effective performance in battle will result in a bigger reward.
[hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=content-additions-and-changes][/h1]Content Additions and Changes[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/dd2cc62a-89b0-11ec-9061-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Armory[/h2]
The following ships will become available in the Armory with the release of Update 0.11.1:

[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Khabarovsk[/b][/b], a never-built project of an armored destroyer flotilla leader for the Soviet Navy. The ship is armed with eight powerful 130 mm main battery guns, as well as two quintuple-tube torpedo launchers. Her torpedoes have low detectability and are capable of dealing decent damage, but they are also slow and have a short range. The ship enjoys good armor protection for her type, a decent HP pool, and high speed, but she has mediocre maneuverability and high detectability. The destroyer is equipped with the Engine Boost consumable, as well as Smoke Generator or Repair Party in a single slot. The ship will be available for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]240,000[/b] Coal.

[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Grosser Kurfürst[/b][/b] is one of the possible development variants of the H-class battleship project. The ship is armed with twelve 406 mm main battery guns. She also carries alternative 420 mm guns with a longer reload time but more powerful shells than those of the standard guns. The battleship has numerous long-range secondary battery guns, an extensive HP pool, and excellent armor with a well-protected citadel and high level of protection against HE shells. At the same time, the ship has mediocre torpedo protection and high detectability. She is equipped with Repair Party and Hydroacoustic Search with long ship spotting and torpedo acquisition ranges. She can also choose between the Fighter and Spotting Aircraft consumables. The ship will be available for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]256,000[/b] Coal.

The Weird City permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Austin[/b][/b] will be added and available for [b]10[/b] Ranked Tokens.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5951b8ea-8a52-11ec-be64-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
With the release of Update 0.11.1, the following changes will occur in the Naval Community tab:
[list][*]A bundle with a Symbols of Yukon patch and commemorative flag for [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_recruitment_points_e30ec137465b5e672aa3cd633442824abc4884652e65c8bc443767fafdd18fd6.png[/img] 4,000 Community Tokes will be added.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/59813584-8a52-11ec-8748-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]The Recruiting Station flag will be removed.[/list]
[list][i]With the release of Update 0.11.1, all Star Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_6_2949a8a229f2246eaf7a90ca8e43e15593606e41c27ca88657864966a6b07d19.png[/img] 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]9,000[/b].[/i][/list]

[h2]Tech Tree[/h2]
With the release of Update 0.11.1, [b] [b][b]X[/b] Grosser Kurfürst[/b][/b] and [b] [b][b]X[/b] Khabarovsk[/b][/b] will be replaced in their branches by [b] [b][b]X[/b] Preussen[/b][/b] and [b] [b][b]X[/b] Delny[/b][/b], respectively.

More details about the Tech Tree changes are available in a [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/upcoming-changes-to-the-tech-tree/]special article[/url]. With the release of the update, the following ships will be added to the Armory: [b] [b][b]X[/b] Grosser Kurfürst[/b][/b]—for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]256,000[/b] Coal; [b] [b][b]X[/b] Khabarovsk[/b][/b]—for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]240,000[/b] Coal.

If a player has [b] [b][b]X[/b] Grosser Kurfürst[/b][/b] and [b] [b][b]X[/b] Khabarovsk[/b][/b] in their Port when the replacement happens, they will receive compensation in the form of a sum of Credits equal to half of these ships' cost. If you already own these ships, you won't lose them—they will stay on your account.
[list][*]The compensation for [b] [b][b]X[/b] Grosser Kurfürst[/b][/b] is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]10,300,000[/b] Credits.
[list][*]If a player has researched the ship's 420 mm main battery guns, they will receive a compensation of an additional [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9d43348869eb4ac094288dad196925d8f6d9d89b.png[/img][b]35,000[/b] XP for this ship.
[*]If a player has purchased the ship's 420 mm main battery guns, they will also receive an additional [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]2,500,000[/b] Credits as compensation.[/list]
[*]The compensation for [b] [b][b]X[/b] Khabarovsk[/b][/b] is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]9,400,000[/b] Credits.[/list]
[list][i]All players who own any permanent camouflage for [b] [b][b]X[/b] Khabarovsk[/b][/b] or [b] [b][b]X[/b] Grosser Kurfürst[/b][/b] at the time when the ships are removed from the Tech Tree will receive the Type 20 permanent camouflage for [b] [b][b]X[/b] Delny[/b][/b] or [b] [b][b]X[/b] Preussen[/b][/b], respectively.[/i][/list]

[h2]Other[/h2]
The armor of [b] [b][b]X[/b] Audacious[/b][/b] and [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] Enterprise[/b][/b] has been updated due to the implementation of the new technology we discussed in the article about [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/game-updates/update-0109-halloween/#content-additions-and-changes]Update 0.10.9[/url]. We'll continue reworking ships in future updates to gradually accommodate the new armor protection system.

This update brings the following content to the game:
[list][*]Commander [b]Pedro Max Fernando Frontin[/b] for Pan-American ships.
[*]The Yatagarasu, Cat the Cap, and Dokkaebi patches.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7ce110b2-8a52-11ec-be64-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]Details on how to obtain this content will be announced later.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=other-improvements][/h1]Other Improvements[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/dccb6ff6-89b0-11ec-9f65-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2]Changes to Bots[/h2]
We've completely reworked the AI system behind the in-game bots. The new system makes setting up bots for various battle types and in-game scenarios simpler and faster.

We've simplified the behavior algorithm of bots for all difficulty levels in the Training Rooms. We don't expect any considerable changes to bot behavior in Operations, Co-op Battles, or the various temporary battle types. However, since the sheer scale of this update of the entire AI system is so massive, it's difficult to provide an assessment of the effects of these changes at this point. We'll be keeping a close eye on bot behavior and making further tweaks if necessary.

Currently, we're actively working on improving the AI within this new system. We already have some improvements planned for bots in Operations and the Training Room. In addition to that, changes are also expected in other battle types. We'll share the details a bit later.
[list]Thank you for being an attentive reader! Click "Collect Your Gift" to claim [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Warships Premium Account[/b]. The day of Warships Premium Account will start immediately after you click the button.[/list]
Other improvements and changes. For a complete list, please refer to [url=https://eu.wargaming.net/support/products/wows/article/33375/]Player Support[/url].

notes.title: Important Message for the World of Warships Community
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f9ccea38d51b44322353e07c557876bfc4fa625a.jpg[/img]
[b]Captains![/b]

Six months have passed since we first told you that the World of Warships team was changing course towards more open communication with the community. Today, we're going to tell you about the changes and improvements we have made.
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Random Mechanics[/b][/h2]
[list][*]One of the most important milestones of the previous year was the [b]disclosure of drop chances[/b] for Black Friday and Santa’s Gift containers, as well as for all the other containers that appeared during that time. Detailed information about drop chances is collected in one place and can be found [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/contents-and-drop-rates-of-containers/]on this page[/url].
[*]We have added [b]a warning about the nature of randomness[/b] and the need to approach purchases soberly. Players also now need to confirm that they are [b]at least 18 years old[/b] to purchase containers and random bundles.
[*]One of the upcoming game events is a new auction in which you will have an opportunity to obtain a rare ship—Gremyashchy. The distribution of this ship through an auction will give you the ability to replenish your collection. At the same time, the battle balance and situation in combat will remain almost the same, since the lots are not numerous.[/list][hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Feedback and Communication[/b][/h2]
[list][*]We have published [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/roadmap-for-2022/]our plans[/url] for the game for the next 6 months. We plan to update the roadmap quarterly and accompany it with [b]Waterline videos and streams[/b].
[*]The [b]camouflage design contest[/b] for Aviere has recently concluded. Everyone was able to suggest their own camouflage variant for the ship, and the winning one will be recreated in-game after the ship’s release. The details can be found [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/sales-and-events/camo-contest-aviere/]here[/url].
[*]The [b]Hot Fix[/b] series continues to provide insights about different people in the World of Warships team and their work on the game. For example, in December, the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PxIXiN8qkbA]Hot Fix: Testing and Bugs[/url] episode was released on our YouTube channel. New episodes will follow soon! We have also improved our approach to Q&A on the [url=https://discord.gg/wows]official Discord[/url] and shared some insights into graphics development by answering your most popular questions.
[*]Recently, we extensively covered our work on submarines in the [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/261]Development Blog[/url]. In that article, we shared a lot of information with you and outlined our further plans in this area. At the moment, [b]submarines[/b] need additional tweaking and will not be available in Updates 0.11.0 and 0.11.1.
[*][b]The distribution methods for new ships[/b] are one of the most interesting topics for our gaming community. We have returned to publishing news on the topic regularly and will do our best to keep you informed about all the upcoming ships. Fresh news can be found in [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/256]this publication[/url].[/list][hr][/hr]
[h2][b]What Lies Ahead for Us?[/b][/h2]
[list][*]We are constantly looking for new ways to make the game more diverse. In Update 0.11.1, you will have the ability to try out a new battle type—[b]Dirigible Derby[/b]. Your mission is to delay the hostile airship while also making sure that your allied airship is the first to reach the destination point.
[*]We are working on [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/250]aircraft carriers[/url]. We carry out regular tests to check different hypotheses and ideas, including those related to the mechanics of ship detection by planes. However, there is a big difference between testing something in a super test and implementing a full-fledged solution that can solve some of the current issues. We are working on various aspects of aircraft carriers and will keep you updated about possible changes.
[*]We are ready to share information about [b]Huron's status[/b]. The ship's 3D model is currently being checked for errors and fixed before it can serve as the basis for a game engine object—a ship with all of her settings implemented.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/dec74702-85a1-11ec-aeba-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/deb9749c-85a1-11ec-8389-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Very soon, we will share the latest results of the [b]balance changes[/b] for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Zaō[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Petropavlovsk[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Franklin D. Roosevelt[/b][/b].
[*]We have made some progress in creating a new map inspired by the Faroe Islands. The general layout is ready, and our artists are currently enriching it with details and improving its visuals. We are planning to release [b]The Faroe Islands[/b] on the Live Server by the summer.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5d0d6566-85a1-11ec-8389-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5d1f74a4-85a1-11ec-a57d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5da9997c-85a1-11ec-aeba-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5d1b8a4c-85a1-11ec-bde7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5cfc521c-85a1-11ec-8562-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5d037dee-85a1-11ec-90f9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]
We are constantly working on improving our communication with you. No considerable change is possible without mistakes. Not everything has been perfect during these past months, but we will continue to work on it, improve our processes, and strive to perfect our skills.

In conclusion, we would like to thank you for both your constructive criticism and your support. Criticism allows us to identify our shortcomings, and your kind words help us understand when we are on the right course.
[list]We will continue to keep you informed about our plans and important updates. See you soon![/list]

We would like to remind you that it's now easier than ever to participate in the Public Test—you can log in using your main account details.
