notes.title: Roadmap for 2022
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e775ca4a46339eafa535871afc56c00199078fc1.jpg[/img]
[b]Captains![/b]

Let's take a look ahead at what we're working on in the first half of 2022!

[list][i]Please note that all the information contained in this document is preliminary. Any of the changes and new features that we announce may change several times during tests. During each of those testing rounds, your feedback and opinions will be carefully considered. Now, let's get down to the details! To reveal the information, click on the respective blocks.[/i][/list]

[table][tr][th][b][url=#winter]Winter 2022[/url]
[url=#spring]Spring 2022[/url]
[url=#summer]Summer 2022[/url]
[url=#plans-going-forward]Plans Going Forward[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table][hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=winter][/h1]Winter 2022[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/17c39a8c-7f4a-11ec-9792-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

[h2]Ships[/h2]
Last year, the new ships we added to the Tech Tree were inspired by the history of European and Soviet shipbuilding. Now, we’ve started 2022 by taking a step beyond that horizon. With Update 0.11.0, Pan-Asian cruisers hit our seas in Early Access. We're convinced that the new ships will add a good deal of diversity to naval battles and be liked by our players around the globe.

The national representation in the game is set to grow bigger—[b]Spain[/b] is making its way into the roster. The first ship of the new nation is [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Spain_5e711825138501e1ece2e80248e5b5efd6e544b05d2887dd1bd8ec577e33d820.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Canarias[/b][/b].

German battleships and Soviet destroyers are getting fresh new additions as [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Preussen[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Delny[/b][/b] take the places of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Grosser Kurfürst[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Khabarovsk[/b][/b], respectively. The newcomers are a better match for the rest of their respective branches from the viewpoint of progression and gameplay. Read all the details [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/upcoming-changes-to-the-tech-tree/]here[/url].

[h2]Game Events[/h2]
Joining the [b]Lunar New Year[/b] celebrations is a winter tradition for World of Warships. And this year we’ve prepared something very special for the holiday!

A new temporary in-game event called [b]"Dirigible Derby."[/b] Each team must escort an airship of its own to a destination point. The airships can't be damaged and move at set speeds but the presence of allied or hostile ships in the interactive zone around the airship can either speed them up or slow them down.

For a limited period of time, [b]Asymmetric Battles[/b] will also be available—a non-standard game mode based on an uneven distribution of ships per team. The types and numbers of ships are matched in such a way that makes the forces of both sides in battle as equal as possible.
[hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=spring][/h1]Spring 2022[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/182b0276-7f4a-11ec-b9e7-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

[h2]Ships[/h2]
What's your ideal evening? We say it's a slice of delicious pizza straight from the oven, a cup of hot cappuccino, and Early Access to [b]Italian destroyers[/b]. They’re all packing Exhaust Smoke Generators, as well as distinctly Italian SAP shells coupled with HE rounds.

At the end of spring, we expect new forces to join the French fleet, too. The second branch of [b]French cruisers[/b] will offer you exciting new gameplay experiences. Can't wait for the details? Keep an eye on the Development Blog.

If the [b]supership testing[/b] turns out to be a success and returns good results, then this spring we'll extend the existing ship branches by adding their own respective superships.

[b]Submarine testing[/b] will resume. The fate of the new ship type will depend on the test results.

[h2]Game Events[/h2]
We're bringing back the [b]Rogue Wave[/b] event. Welcome back to the post-apocalyptic world! A land of scavengers who crawl the desolate ruins of a once-flourishing civilization which is now a war zone that’s home to the warships of those unfortunate enough to have survived the cataclysm. We're working on the ship visuals to make it easier for you to identify what faction the enemy in your sights belongs to.

A new mode called [b]"Sea Battle"[/b]—a mini-activity in World of Warships, inspired by a classic game—offers a new way to obtain various rewards. The rules are simple—you'll play on a 2D ruled grid that holds each player's fleet of ships. Your mission is to seek and destroy enemy ships, and you'll earn various bonuses and rewards along the way.

The [b]Arms Race[/b] mode, which is much liked by so many of you, will be reworked and enhanced in light of your feedback. It will emerge as another one of the possible Random Battle modes. You'll be able to boost your ship during the course of battle, and this will result in plenty of surprises and add greater gameplay diversity.

[b]Wondering about the Dockyard[/b]? The activity focused on the phased construction of a warship is taking its rightful place on the Roadmap. You'll have a chance to lay down [b]Pan-American battleship Atlântico[/b] and enjoy unique cinematic shots as it’s assembled before your eyes.

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[b]Training combat missions[/b] for new players. A chain of simple missions that will focus on different game mechanics consecutively. It will help new players get to grips with the basic knowledge of the game and take their first steps in it.

[b]Changes to the Containers tab[/b]. Our new convenient and informative system of displaying and sorting your containers will enable you to better manage them and open exactly the type of containers you need.

[b]New map[/b]. The visual appearance of the new map was [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/community/choose-a-new-map/]inspired by your votes[/url], and we're happy to finally add it to World of Warships!

[b]Visual enhancements[/b]. Snow, ice, and sand on maps will become more realistic and spectacular; the ice build-up effect will appear on ships and be visible in battles on snow-covered maps; shadows on maps and ships will look more realistic; and we'll continue reworking maps and Ports with an aim to bring them up to HD quality.
[hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=summer][/h1]Summer 2022[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/17b9b4d6-7f4a-11ec-99ac-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

[h2]Ships[/h2]
Great Britain—one of the mightiest naval powers in the world—is expecting reinforcements. The new branch of [b]British battleships[/b] will feature warships that are historically classified as battlecruisers.

[h2]Game Events[/h2]
[b]The return of Convoy[/b]. We're changing the format of this game mode. New routes and other details will be added to refresh the standard gameplay. It will be way more interesting to escort and attack transport ships.

[b]U.S. Independence Day[/b]. We'll keep with the good old tradition and join the 4[i]th[/i] of July celebrations. Plans are already on the table to update the models of the U.S. destroyers.

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[b]We plan to overhaul the in-game economic system and also separate it from ship exteriors[/b]. Economic bonuses will be separated from signals and camouflages and be made into a stand-alone entity. This means that you'll be able to choose your ship's appearance and select economic bonuses separately. Signals and camouflages will serve as elements of the exterior and yield combat bonuses only.
[hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=plans-going-forward][/h1]Plans Going Forward[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b460cd56-7de7-11ec-af5b-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

These are, of course, only some of the new features we've cooked up for 2022. We've planned loads of new additions and improvements in World of Warships for the second half of the year as well. Right now, they're at the preliminary design stage, so we're not ready to talk about them yet. We'll be sure to release another article when we're ready to share new information with you and explain any changes to the plans we've just announced.
[list]We strive for openness and mutual understanding with our players, and we would like to thank you for your attention to the game, constructive criticism, and positive feedback. And we hope you enjoy the fruits of our efforts! Stay with us.[i][/i][/list]
[i]World of Warships Team[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2716184589232191867
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9d2174ffca142e4a81f7050ab3781eaa21ff28f9.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]Developer Bulletin for Update 0.11.1[/b][/h1]
[list][b][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.[/b][/list]
[list][i]Please note: The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/i][/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#dirigible-derby]Dirigible Derby[/url]
[url=#super-aircraft-carriers]Super Aircraft Carriers[/url]
[url=#personal-challenges]Personal Challenges[/url]
[url=#changes-to-the-in-game-economy]Changes to the In-Game Economy[/url]
[url=#other-improvements]Other Improvements[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=dirigible-derby][/h1]Dirigible Derby[/b][/h2]
Update 0.11.1 kicks off a new temporary battle type codenamed "Dirigible Derby."

Historically, these airships carried intelligence agents with important messages and diplomats traveling to conduct secret negotiations in neutral territories. The new battle type tasks you with a mission to delay the hostile airship while also making sure that your allied airship is the first to reach the destination point.

[h2]Rules[/h2]
[list][i]Battles will be held in a 12 vs. 12 format playing Tier X ships.[/i][/list]

Each team will have an invulnerable airship that moves along a fixed route. Your team's mission is to outrun the opposing team in escorting their airship to the end of the route or destroy all enemy ships.

The teams can affect the speed of both allied and hostile airships. Each airship has an interactive zone with a 3 km radius displayed around it. The airship will move faster if only allied ships are within that zone and will slow down if at least one enemy ship sneaks inside it.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5df8a930-7ac6-11ec-8769-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5e11b1a0-7ac6-11ec-b66c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5eb81018-7ac6-11ec-a2c2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c333c48c-7ce8-11ec-8197-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c32029b8-7ce8-11ec-a8ce-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=super-aircraft-carriers][/h1]Super Aircraft Carriers[/b][/h2]
Update 0.11.1 sees the launch of two new superships in the game:
[list][*]British aircraft carrier [b]Eagle[/b] was initially laid down as one of the Audacious-class warships. The carrier was completed to a substantially altered project, and she was later given an extensive modernization that allowed her to carry and operate the most advanced deck-based aircraft of the 1950s, including jet aircraft.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/504bfa74-7ac3-11ec-a4d4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]American aircraft carrier [b]United States[/b] was intended to be the lead ship of a new design of super carriers that was laid down in 1949 but was never completed. Our developers have recreated her in the game as a fleet strike carrier with necessary alterations to the ship's layout design and equipment.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/50ba3854-7ac3-11ec-8d97-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The ships carry two types of squadrons: standard and tactical. While standard squadrons are a carrier's striking power that players are already familiar with, tactical squadrons constitute a new weapon.

Tactical squadrons on board the new carriers are composed of very fast jet-propelled aircraft. This feature allows them to quickly cover substantial distances and carry out lightning-fast attacks against enemy ships. The jet aircraft of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.png[/img][b] Eagle[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.png[/img][b] United States[/b][/b] cannot slow down below their cruising speed, and their engine boost won't cool down when the aircraft are airborne.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/76d9466e-7ac4-11ec-8769-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/29e5c24c-7ac4-11ec-8284-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
We would like to note that the tactical squadrons carried by [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.png[/img][b] Eagle[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.png[/img][b] United States[/b][/b] are best used as auxiliary weapons, which is why they consist of one attacking flight only. This means their efficiency will be substantially impaired with each aircraft they lose, and for this reason, they can't expose themselves to enemy AA fire for long.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/76ccce20-7ac4-11ec-b3e5-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/29ec27e0-7ac4-11ec-a6e6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=personal-challenges][/h1]Personal Challenges[/b][/h2]
Update 0.11.1 brings back Personal Challenges. Your goal during the event is to earn as much Base XP as possible while demonstrating your skills in battle playing ships of different types and nations. More details will follow in a dedicated [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/personal-challenges-and-the-naval-battle/#personal-challenges]article[/url].

We have updated rewards, and the table of records will be reset 2 weeks after the update goes live. This way, rewards will again be available to players who have already reached the limit.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a6346f90-7dbe-11ec-8e2d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][b][b]Rewards:[/b][/b] A new temporary resource called [b]Mediterranean Tokens[/b], plus Coal. Navigate to a special tab in the Armory to exchange your Mediterranean Tokens for bundles with [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Dido[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Spain_5e711825138501e1ece2e80248e5b5efd6e544b05d2887dd1bd8ec577e33d820.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Canarias[/b][/b] in their Atlantic camouflage, as well as other rewards.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/20eeadaa-7ac6-11ec-bff8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/20e4d564-7ac6-11ec-a2c2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=changes-to-the-in-game-economy][/h1]Changes to the In-Game Economy[/b][/h2]
[h2]Damage to Aircraft[/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/fe0f9fca-7ac4-11ec-b3e5-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]The economic reward for destroying aircraft will now be distributed in the same way as the reward for damaging and destroying ships. Part of Credits and XP will be issued not only for shooting aircraft down but also for dealing damage to them.

On average, the amount of resources earned won't change, but the reward will be easier to obtain.

[h2]Ammunition Resupply[/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/fe1514a0-7ac4-11ec-bff8-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]The costs of resupplying carrier ammunition and the Airstrike armament will now be calculated by reference to the amount of ammunition used rather than the number of aircraft lost.

Credits will also be spent on resupplying depth charges used by destroyers and cruisers.

With these steps, we're bringing the costs of resupplying aircraft carriers' ammunition, the Airstrike armament, and depth charges in line with the other types of ammunition.

[h2]Aircraft Carrier XP[/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/fe15a744-7ac4-11ec-a704-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]We've reworked the way XP is earned by Tier VIII and X carriers. They will now earn more for sinking enemies and less for damaging them.

Previously, good battle performance playing Tier VIII and X carriers yielded a smaller reward compared with the other ship types. Even sinking numerous enemy ships hardly ever placed carriers among the top XP earners on the team. Now, effective performance in battle will result in a bigger reward.
[hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=other-improvements][/h1]Other Improvements[/b][/h2]
[h2]Changes to Bots[/h2]
We've entirely reworked the AI system behind in-game bots. The new system makes setting up bots for various battle types and in-game scenarios simpler and faster.

We've simplified the behavior algorithm of bots for all difficulty levels in the Training Rooms. We don't expect any considerable changes to bot behavior in Operations, Co-op Battles, and various temporary battle types. However, since the sheer scale of this update of the entire AI system is so massive, it's difficult to provide an assessment of the effect of these changes at this point. We'll be keeping a close eye on bot behavior and make further tweaks if necessary.

[h2]Tech Tree Changes[/h2]
With the release of Update 0.11.1, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Grosser Kurfürst[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Khabarovsk[/b][/b] will be replaced in their Tech Tree branches by [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Preussen[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Delny[/b][/b], respectively.

More details about the Tech Tree changes are available in a [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/upcoming-changes-to-the-tech-tree/]special article[/url].

[h2]Technical Updates[/h2]
[list][*]We've updated the way in which the conditions of missions and rewards, as well as other UI elements, are displayed in the Combat Missions tab.
[*]The behavior of the ships carousel has been fixed and updated for cases where various actions are made in the Port.[/list]

notes.title: Pan-Asian Cruisers: Early Access
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d465f2d3683053d6994c5d8a386c8b6804769583.jpg[/img]
[b]Pan-Asian Tier V–X cruisers are now available in Early Access! Read on to learn everything you need to know about the new game event in Update 0.11.0.[/b]

[table][tr][th][b][url=#the-ships]The Ships[/url]
[url=#things-to-know-about-early-access]Things to Know About Early Access[/url]
[url=#pan-asian-tokens]Pan-Asian Tokens[/url]
[url=#armory]Armory[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=the-ships][/h1]The Ships[/b][/h2]
The ships of the new branch have small-caliber guns with high rates of fire and powerful deepwater torpedoes, but they cannot boast of having high survivability. The consumables available to these cruisers are also of note:
[list][*]All ships of the branch are equipped with a variant of the Smoke Generator consumable with a reduced cooldown time.
[*]The new Tier VI and higher ships have Defensive AA Fire.
[*]The Tier VII and higher cruisers have the Torpedo Reload Booster consumable.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Sejong[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Jinan[/b][/b] are equipped with Repair Party.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e20526c6-72de-11ec-a6d4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e214abaa-72de-11ec-ae1c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e211d7ea-72de-11ec-93fa-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e22c06e2-72de-11ec-b1e2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e234615c-72de-11ec-bf2a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e235e928-72de-11ec-8022-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=things-to-know-about-early-access][/h1]Things to Know About Early Access[/b][/h2]
[b]Combat missions:[/b] The game event comprises 28 combat missions spread across four groups. The first group will become available with the release of Update 0.11.0, while those that follow will be unlocked on a weekly basis.

[b]Rewards:[/b] Completing combat missions will earn you a new temporary resource—[b]Pan-Asian Tokens[/b]—as well as ships [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Chungking[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Chumphon[/b][/b] for completing the second and fourth combat mission groups, respectively. The ships come with a Port slot and Commander with 6 skill points. Other nice bonuses include the Friendship Knot patch and the "Pan-Asian Cruisers: Part 1" flag.

The Dragon Port has been updated to celebrate the arrival of the Pan-Asian cruisers in Early Access.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8ee46f0c-721f-11ec-a157-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8df4e09a-721f-11ec-88c9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8dfeca88-721f-11ec-bb9d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][i]When Update 0.11.2 goes live, the Pan-Asian cruisers will become available for all players to research.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=pan-asian-tokens][/h1]Pan-Asian Tokens[/b][/h2]
[img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_3_7c644d2bd3e7a71a90f1aed7ac9713ee597a33cd89aadb235cdd9e9e0647e798.png[/img] [b]Pan-Asian Tokens[/b] are a new temporary resource that can be exchanged for various rewards in the Armory. You can obtain these Tokens in several ways:
[list][*]By completing combat missions—up to [b]14,000[/b] Tokens.
[*]From free daily random bundles in the Armory—up to [b]1,000[/b] Tokens.
[*]In exchange for Community Tokens in the Armory—up to [b]3,000[/b] Tokens.
[*]From random bundles available for Doubloons in the Armory.[/list]
[b]Rewards for the Tokens:[/b] Sequential bundles with [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Rahmat[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Harbin[/b][/b], Silk Sunrise permanent camouflages for researchable Pan-Asian Tier VII–X cruisers, and much more.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/caa34958-7221-11ec-9ee1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Jinan[/b][/b] will become available for purchase in exchange for Doubloons after you obtain all the sequential bundles available for the Tokens.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Sejong[/b][/b] is available in random bundles for Doubloons.
[*]The number of Tokens you can earn by completing combat missions is enough to obtain [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Rahmat[/b][/b] and the permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Chumphon[/b][/b].[/list]
[list][i]With the release of Update 0.11.2, Pan-Asian Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]750[/b].[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=armory][/h1]Armory[/b][/h2]
[h2]Sequential Bundles[/h2] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5762e25c-72e2-11ec-a6d4-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list]The ships come with all of their modules researched.[/list]
[h2]Free Bundles[/h2]
The Armory will offer free random bundles—Treasures of Siam. Within them, you'll find Pan-Asian Tokens, Doubloons, [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Warships Premium Account[/b], and other rewards.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5706c828-72e2-11ec-a955-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]You can obtain only one bundle per day. A total of 12 bundles will be available, so you can skip more than 2 weeks and still be able to collect all the rewards.[/i][/list]

[h2]Bundles for Doubloons[/h2]
[h3][b]Pan-Asian Cruisers: Random Bundles[/b][/h3]
Random bundles that can each be obtained for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,000[/b] Doubloons will be available to you until the end of Update 0.11.1. They contain [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Sejong[/b][/b] with all of her modules researched, a Port slot, and a Commander with 10 skill points; Pan-Asian Tokens; special signals; Lunar Warrior themed camouflages; and Mosaic, Spring Sky, and Asian Lantern camouflages, which provide increased economic bonuses.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/57635e30-72e2-11ec-980a-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Moreover, the Armory will offer you "Fair Wind From the East" daily random bundles at the cost of [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]150[/b] Doubloons each. Within them, you can find [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]3 days of Warships Premium Account[/b], expendable camouflages, Coal, combat signals, and Elite Commander XP.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/57068d86-72e2-11ec-870d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]You can purchase only one bundle per day.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=rental-superships][/h1]Rental Superships[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4a96eef4-72c6-11ec-b5ac-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Superships and their mechanics have been of great interest to players so far, and these ships may one day become a full-fledged part of World of Warships. In the future, we want to continue the existing branches by adding superships. We consider this to be a logical step, and we are confident that superships do not fit into Tier X because of their superiority over their "predecessors" in terms of their performance characteristics.

This is a big and important decision for World of Warships. For this reason, we've planned thorough testing of the superships based on our previous experience.

We're carefully monitoring both the data we receive and your feedback. The current Ranked season has shown that superships fit into the current game concept and have been warmly received by players.

Therefore, starting from Update 0.11.0, the testing of superships will continue not only in Ranked and Co-op Battles but also in Random Battles.

Random Battles have a different format compared to Ranked Battles—12 vs. 12. It's important to test superships in these conditions because they significantly change the battle tempo and density, which means that the effectiveness of superships may change. The high popularity of Random Battles will allow us to collect the necessary statistics and get feedback for the further development of superships.

Only Tier IX and X ships will be able to participate in battles with superships, and the standard restrictions on the number of ships of certain types and tiers apply in battle.

[list][*]A ship (battleship [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]III[/b] König Albert[/b][/b] or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Agincourt[/b][/b]) with a Port slot and Commander with 10 skill points, or a permanent camouflage ("To Honor Skagerrak" for König Albert or Jutland Veteran for Agincourt) — 1%
[*]1x Battle of Jutland camouflage — 39%
[*]4x signals of the same type ([b]Zulu[/b], [b]Equal Speed Charlie London[/b], [b]Papa Papa[/b], or [b]Zulu Hotel[/b]) — 40%
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]1,500[/b] Free XP — 10%
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]100,000[/b] Credits — 10%[/list][/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ee1ab892-7223-11ec-84df-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Agincourt[/b][/b] will also be available in the Armory in exchange for Doubloons.
[h3][i][h3][b]Battle of Jutland Container Mechanics[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
The chances of obtaining a particular reward from a group are the same for all items in the group. If a container drops an item from the Ships and Permanent Camouflages group, you will receive an item that you do not already have. The drop chances of a specific group don't change, regardless of how many items you already have from that group.

If you already have all the ships or permanent camouflages from the list and a Battle of Jutland container drops an item from the Ships and Permanent Camouflages group, you will receive the Battle of Jutland camouflage.

Battle of Jutland containers have the guaranteed drop mechanic applied: If an item from the Ships and Permanent Camouflages group does not drop after you open 249 Battle of Jutland containers, you are guaranteed to find an item from this group in the 250th container of this type.

[list][i]Detailed information about the container mechanics and how to obtain them will be published later.[/i][/list]

[list]Starting with Update 0.11.0, for all standard Premium Ship containers, players will receive compensation in Credits if they already have all the ships that this container type can drop. The special version of the Premium Ship container will still compensate players in Doubloons.[/list]
[h2]Changes to Camouflages[/h2]
An alternative color scheme was added for special permanent camouflages for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Tirpitz[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Scharnhorst[/b][/b].
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/eeb9fe8e-7223-11ec-a363-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Tech Tree Changes in Update 0.11.1[/h2]
Several months ago, we announced changes to the German and Soviet Tech Trees. With the release of Update 0.11.1, [b] [b][b]X[/b] Grosser Kurfürst[/b][/b] and [b] [b][b]X[/b] Khabarovsk[/b][/b] will be replaced with [b] [b][b]X[/b] Preussen[/b][/b] and [b] [b][b]X[/b] Delny[/b][/b], respectively.

After this, [b] [b][b]X[/b] Grosser Kurfürst[/b][/b] and [b] [b][b]X[/b] Khabarovsk[/b][/b] will be added to the Armory and become available for Coal. Detailed information about the replacement of these ships is available in a [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/upcoming-changes-to-the-tech-tree/]dedicated article[/url] on our website.

[h3][i][h3][b]Replacement Mechanics[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
[list][*]If a player has [b] [b][b]X[/b] Grosser Kurfürst[/b][/b] and [b] [b][b]X[/b] Khabarovsk[/b][/b] in their Port when the replacement happens, they will receive compensation in the form of a sum of Credits equal to half of these ships' cost. At the same time, Grosser Kurfürst and Khabarovsk will remain on the accounts of their owners.
[*]Compensation for [b] [b][b]X[/b] Grosser Kurfürst[/b][/b] is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]10,300,000[/b] Credits.
[*]If the 420 mm main battery guns were researched, the player will also receive compensation of 35,000 XP for this ship.
[*]If the 420 mm main battery guns were purchased, the player will also receive compensation of [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]2,500,000[/b] Credits.
[*]Compensation for [b] [b][b]X[/b] Khabarovsk[/b][/b] is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]9,400,000[/b] Credits.[/list]
[list]Thank you for being an attentive reader! Click "Collect Your Gift" to claim [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Warships Premium Account[/b]. [h2][b][h1=other-changes][/h1]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4aaa5714-72c6-11ec-a7ad-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]The torpedo reticle brightness now increases automatically when sun reflections are visible in the background.

[*]Fixed an error that caused shells fired over long distances to travel with an incorrect velocity in some cases.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the HP of aircraft to be displayed incorrectly if some aircraft within the attacking flight were damaged.
[*]Fixed an error that caused an incorrect viewing range to be displayed in the ship characteristics and the Minimap when a ship entered a cyclone.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the acceleration time on [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b] Satsuma[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Yamato[/b][/b] to not change if their engines were damaged.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the notification about new Dockyard rewards to be displayed even after they had been received.
[*]Fixed an error that caused a performance decrease in the game client when switching to the torpedo reticle.
[*]Fixed an error that sometimes made it impossible to destroy secondary armament / anti-aircraft armament, torpedo launchers, guns, and other ship modules.  [*]Other improvements and changes. It's now much simpler to participate in the Public Test—you can log in using your main account. To do so, select [b]Public Test[/b] in the [b]Game Instance[/b] section of Wargaming Game Center. You'll receive Community Tokens as a reward for participating in the Public Test. These can be exchanged for Premium ships, permanent camouflages, Supercontainers, and other desirable items!

notes.title: New Year's Night and Our Festive Collection
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2688130742][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/03e696143eeb99c0af7b460075b261d60d9aa6ed.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]Read on to learn about a new temporary event and the "Christmas and New Year in the Navy" collection.[/b]

[table][tr][th][b][url=#new-years-night]New Year's Night[/url]
[url=#rules]Rules[/url]
[url=#missions]Missions[/url]
[url=#personal-and-team-progress]Personal and team progress[/url]
[url=#earning-points]Earning Points[/url]
[url=#rewards]Rewards[/url]
[url=#star-tokens]Star Tokens[/url]
[url=#the-christmas-and-ny-in-the-navy-collection]The "Christmas and New Year in the Navy" Collection[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=N4CotngUVmM;full][/previewyoutube] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=new-years-night][/h1]New Year's Night[/b][/h2]
The New Year's Night temporary event awaits you in festive Update 0.10.11. Magic stars brought three snow giants to life, and those snow giants now have the responsibility to prepare the festive celebrations. Each star entrusted its snow giant with an errand in preparation for the celebrations. Help them contribute to the celebration!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Thu. 23 Dec. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Thu. 20 Jan. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

New Year's Night is similar to the Battle of the Beasts and Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry events that took place in Updates 0.10.4 and 0.10.8, respectively. We have made minor changes to the interface only: The tooltips on the team selection screen and above the mission cards have been updated.
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a733de0e-5e73-11ec-83e2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a9ac47e8-5e73-11ec-947c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ac90be6c-5e73-11ec-834f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/af41c728-5e73-11ec-ac52-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b2ca8cc2-5e73-11ec-bf01-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=rules][/h1]Rules[/b][/h2]
The event will run until the release of Update 0.11.0 and is divided into four stages. Each stage lasts 1 week. Before starting each stage, you can choose one of three teams named after the magic stars:
[list][*]Team [b][b]Modus[/b][/b]: The snow giant brought to life by the Modus star has been entrusted with creating a festive mood.
[*]Team [b][b]Sertum[/b][/b]: The snow giant brought to life by the Sertum star has been entrusted with decorating the Holiday Tree with fairy lights and toys.
[*]Team [b][b]Munera[/b][/b]: The snow giant brought to life by the Munera star has been entrusted with giving New Year gifts.[/list]
During the day, event participants will receive special missions that can be completed in Random, Co-op, and Ranked Battles. Completing the missions will advance you through the personal and team progress bars and unlock rewards. Your personal and team progress is reset to zero at the beginning of each new stage.

[list][i]All players who have reached Access Level 8 can participate in the event.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=missions][/h1]Missions[/b][/h2]
Three mission types, with a limited allotted time for each mission, will be available to you each day.

Missions are assigned sequentially once every 40 minutes. You will receive a total of 25 missions during the day. Each mission should be completed within 120 minutes.

After a mission expires, the next mission of the same type becomes available. Battles that end after a mission expires are counted toward the next mission. The only exceptions are the last missions of the day. The time for counting the results of these missions is extended by 20 minutes.
[list][i]The missions are only available during a certain time period each day. More details are available in the game client.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=personal-and-team-progress][/h1]Personal and team progress[/b][/h2]
Completing the missions will earn you Points for both personal and team progress. When you reach specific personal and team milestones, you will receive rewards:
[list][*]The reward for reaching each stage of personal progress is credited immediately.
[*]The reward for team progress is credited if your personal progress is equal to or higher than the team progress.[/list]
During each stage, you can obtain up to 10 rewards—five for personal progress and five for team progress. To obtain all 10 rewards during the week, you need to earn 1,500 Personal Progress Points and 150,000 Team Progress Points.
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=earning-points][/h1]Earning Points[/b][/h2]
Each mission has four completion marks. Reaching each mark will earn you 20 Points. In total, you can earn 80 Points in one mission. If you complete missions more efficiently than other players, then after completing the mission, you’ll receive from 10 to 25 additional Points, as well as see your position in the overall player standings.

The results are summed up when each mission expires, and the teams take their places in the overall team standings. A team is awarded 700; 900; or 1,200 Points per mission, based on its position in the team standings. The position in the overall standings, in turn, depends on the activity of the members of each team.
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=rewards][/h1]Rewards[/b][/h2]
Advancing through the personal and team progress bars can earn you themed Commanders; [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Omaha[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Conte di Cavour[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Jaguar[/b][/b], each with the Snow and Stars permanent camouflage; a new temporary resource—[img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_6_2949a8a229f2246eaf7a90ca8e43e15593606e41c27ca88657864966a6b07d19.png[/img] [b]Star Tokens[/b], containers with elements of the Christmas and New Year in the Navy collection, as well as the New Year Sky expendable camouflages.

You can have more than one identical snow giant Commander in your roster simultaneously. As for ships—if you already have [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Omaha[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Jaguar[/b][/b], or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Conte di Cavour[/b][/b] in your Port, then upon reaching a certain mark on the personal progress bar, you will receive compensation in Credits equal to the cost of the ship with all of her modules researched. Compensation for the Snow and Stars camouflage is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]3,000,000[/b] Credits.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/27a4ecd0-5290-11ec-9206-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=star-tokens][/h1]Star Tokens[/b][/h2]
During the event, you can earn a total of up to [b]600[/b] Tokens: 200 Tokens for team progress and 400 Tokens for personal progress.

You will also be able to purchase special bundles in the Armory. Each of them includes [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/camouflage/PCEC123_NY2022_camo_20a72800472191aa1f2206a763c354c4534c4aefa928b10803ac678cf0a68f15.png[/img] 1x New Year Sky expendable camouflage and [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_6_2949a8a229f2246eaf7a90ca8e43e15593606e41c27ca88657864966a6b07d19.png[/img] 15 Star Tokens. The bundles will be available in exchange for Credits and Doubloons. You can purchase no more than 20 bundles for Credits.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e9c1a232-5e38-11ec-9baf-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Star Tokens can be exchanged in the Armory for a variety of festive rewards, including New Year Commanders, Credits, and containers of the "Christmas and New Year in the Navy" collection.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ebdb8e56-5e5c-11ec-92a1-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]The New Year Commanders come with specializations for Tier I ships of their nations.[/i][/list]
[list]The bundles with Star Tokens and New Year Sky camouflages, as well as the available rewards for Star Tokens, will be available in the Armory until the end of Update 0.11.0.[/list] [hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=the-christmas-and-ny-in-the-navy-collection][/h1]The "Christmas and New Year in the Navy" Collection[/b][/h2]
This festive collection is dedicated to New Year and Christmas traditions in the navies of various countries. It consists of four pages, with six elements on each.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/90ae67e2-5290-11ec-b8a1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[b]The reward for completing each page[/b] is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Warships Premium Account[/b]. [b]The reward for completing the entire collection[/b] is a [b]Santa’s Big Gift[/b] container.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/bfcf3c86-5290-11ec-88c5-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list]Collection elements drop only from "Christmas and New Year in the Navy" containers. The exchange rate for duplicates is 4:1.[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ea649cc6-5e38-11ec-abeb-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
These containers can be obtained by participating in the New Year's Night event and in exchange for Star Tokens in the Armory. You can receive a total of:
[list][*]Up to 28 containers in the New Year's Night event for reaching team progress marks
[*]Up to 40 containers for Star Tokens received in the New Year's Night event
[*]Up to 20 containers for Star Tokens obtained from bundles available for Credits in the Armory[/list]
In a future update, the "Christmas and New Year in the Navy" containers will be added to the Armory and be available in exchange for Coal. This way, you will be able to complete the entire collection if you do not have enough time to do so during the New Year's Night event and during Update 0.11.0.

[h1][b]Developer Bulletin for Update 0.11.0[/b][/h1]
[list][b][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.[/b][/list]
[list][i]Please note: The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/i][/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#pan-asian-cruisers-part-1]Pan-Asian Cruisers: Part 1[/url]
[url=#rental-superships-0110]Rental Superships in Random Battles in 0.11.0[/url]
[url=#asymmetric-battles]Asymmetric Battles[/url]
[url=#submarine-tweaks]Submarine Tweaks[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=pan-asian-cruisers-part-1][/h1]Pan-Asian Cruisers: Part 1[/b][/h2]
Update 0.11.0 brings Pan-Asian Tier V–X cruisers to Early Access. The ships of the new branch are notable for their small-caliber guns, high rates of fire, and powerful deepwater torpedoes, but they also have rather low survivability.

All researchable Pan-Asian cruisers are equipped with a variant of the Smoke Generator consumable with a reduced cooldown time, and starting from Tier VI, they have Defensive AA Fire. The new Tier VII–X ships are equipped with the Torpedo Reload Booster consumable; and starting from Tier IX—with the Repair Party consumable.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a8c09448-5be8-11ec-ac78-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a8c39350-5be8-11ec-8f59-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a8c7fc24-5be8-11ec-a976-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a9d3fcda-5be8-11ec-917d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a97beaae-5be8-11ec-bc9c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a8ca8192-5be8-11ec-8a54-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]Early Access[/h2]
Complete the event's combat missions to gain Early Access to [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Chungking[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Chumphon[/b][/b], as well as a new temporary resource—[b]Pan-Asian Tokens[/b].

You can exchange Pan-Asian Tokens for various items in the Armory, including sequentially available bundles with [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Rahmat[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Harbin[/b][/b], as well as the Silk Dawn permanent camouflages for researchable Pan-Asian Tier VII–X cruisers, plus other rewards.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ec08c08a-5be9-11ec-9272-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The number of Tokens you can earn by completing combat missions is enough to obtain [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Rahmat[/b][/b] and the permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Chumphon[/b][/b]. You can purchase [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Jinan[/b][/b] in exchange for Doubloons after obtaining all the sequential bundles. [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_44b68c918edc534e1367cb6512e9e8cc4d28aa54d237db820f1bbba867266742.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Sejong[/b][/b] will be available in random bundles for Doubloons.

The Dragon Port has been updated to celebrate the arrival of the Pan-Asian cruisers in Early Access.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cd242b62-5beb-11ec-ac78-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ce1146ae-5beb-11ec-b0b0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cd314bbc-5beb-11ec-998e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][b]The Pan-Asian cruisers can't be obtained on the Public Test Server.[/b][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=rental-superships-0110][/h1]Rental Superships in Random Battles in 0.11.0[/b][/h2]
As we've already mentioned, superships with special mechanics have the potential to become a full-fledged part of World of Warships, given the interest shown in them. In the future, we want to continue the existing branches with superships. In addition to the logic of this continuation of the branches, we also believe that due to the superiority of superships in terms of their performance characteristics over their "predecessors," they do not fit into Tier X.

This is a big and important step for our game. Based on our previous experience, we planned to test them thoroughly. We're carefully monitoring both the data we receive and your feedback. The current Ranked Season has shown that superships fit into the current game concept and have been warmly received by players.

Therefore, starting from Update 0.11.0, the testing of superships will continue not only in Ranked and Co-op Battles but also in Random Battles—the most popular battle type in the game. This will allow us to better assess the current state of superships and continue to refine the content that is important for the game development.

In addition, Random Battles have a different format from that of Ranked Battles—12 vs. 12. It's important to test superships in this battle type because this significantly changes the battle tempo and density, which means that the effectiveness of superships may change.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf4459e4-5cb8-11ec-87cd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf575576-5cb8-11ec-b48b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf5d1826-5cb8-11ec-a574-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf54c6f8-5cb8-11ec-8d2c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf5f57e4-5cb8-11ec-b663-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf31ee12-5cb8-11ec-91b7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][i]In Update 0.11.0, rental superships will be available from random bundles in the Armory. Only Tier IX and X ships will be able to participate in battles with superships, and the standard restrictions on the number of ships of certain types and tiers apply in battle.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=asymmetric-battles][/h1]Asymmetric Battles[/b][/h2]
The update sees the return of Asymmetric Battles—a temporary battle type with a different distribution of ships and tiers between teams.

We've changed the tiers of ships you can helm into battle.

[h3][b]First team[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Tiers: IX and X
[*]Number of ships: 6–8[/list]
[h3][b]Second team[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Tiers: VII and VIII
[*]Number of ships: 9–12[/list]
If there aren't enough players in the matchmaking queue, bots may be added to teams.

[list][i]To participate playing a Tier IX–X ship, a new temporary resource—[b]Battle Tokens[/b]—is required. You can earn these Tokens for completing combat missions by participating in Asymmetric Battles playing Tier VII–VIII ships.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=submarine-tweaks][/h1]Submarine Tweaks[/b][/h2]
We've updated the sonar ping and torpedo mechanics. A submarine can now simultaneously maintain sonar pings on several enemy ships.
[list][*]Sonar pings that hit a ship are now either active or inactive.
[*]After you launch torpedoes, they home in on an active ping hit sector and continue to home in on the sector if it becomes inactive. At the same time, torpedoes you release cannot be redirected to another target.
[*]Only the last sonar ping that hits an enemy ship is considered to be active.
[*]If a ship has an active ping hit sector and torpedoes are homing in on the sector, it will become inactive when the ping hits another ship.
[*]If a ship has an active ping hit sector and torpedoes are not homing in on the sector, it will disappear when the ping hits another ship.[/list]
These changes will prevent submarines from changing the target their torpedoes are homing in on, but they will also give them the ability to efficiently counter multiple opponents at once.

[h3][b]Detectability Changes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Submarines at the operating depth can now detect ships in smoke from the assured acquisition range.
[*]Ships in smoke can now detect submarines at the operating depth from the assured acquisition range.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused submarines to be affected by a 20-second detectability penalty after using a sonar ping.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused ships' detectability to increase for submarines after firing main battery guns while in smoke.[/list]We have also made a number of balance changes to submarines and anti-submarine weapons. The full details are available on our Development Blog.

[b]Captains![/b]

Recently, two bugs have been found on the main server:
[list][*]some ship modules have become indestructible;
[*]HP is incorrectly distributed to different parts of the ship when the Survivability Expert skill is active.[/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]The fix for the issue will be deployed[/b] [b]Fri. 17 Dec. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

[list][b]Expected downtime: ~1 hour.
Please be aware that because of this, cross-server Clan Battles will not be available on the days the patch is being applied.[/b][/list]

Instead of reverting the mechanics, the fix will adjust how getting additional HP works in general (this covers such cases as Survivability Expert or, for example, HP buffs in Arms Race). Additional HP will be distributed among different parts of the ship proportionally instead of being put into the hull. As an example of what effect it might have, a destroyer with about 2,000–2,500 HP in the bow section and roughly 20,000 total HP, the increase of HP in the bow would be about 400 HP, which will not lead to a significant gameplay change. We understand that it won't be a full revert to how it was before, but we were planning to change this mechanic as it will help to improve the technical state of the game and keep the mechanics consistent.

As for the bug with indestructible modules — regrettably, the fix will only be deployed with the release of 0.11.0 due to the noticeable technical risk caused by applying it without sufficient testing, since it concerns the game's crucial damage dealing logic. We will also adjust the combat missions in the Dockyard which require destroying modules.

We apologize for this situation and would like to offer you a token of gratitude in the form of 3 WG containers — each dropping a day of Premium account — in each one which you will be able to claim by pressing the button below until the end of the year.
