The following new features await you in Update 0.10.10:
[list][*]Superships piercing waves in Ranked and Co-op Battles
[*]Arms Race as a standalone battle type
[*]Massive graphics update
[*]Combat mission groups with the ultimate completion reward being [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Novorossiysk[/b][/b]
[*]New season of Clan Battles
[*]Tweaks to submarines[/list]
Let's dive into the details of these and other changes!

[table][tr][th][b][url=#superships-in-ranked-battles]Superships in Ranked Battles[/url] ● [url=#arms-race]Arms Race[/url] ● [url=#novorossiysk]Novorossiysk Service[/url] ● [url=#soviet-aircraft-carriers]Soviet Aircraft Carriers[/url] ● [url=#german-battleships]German Battleships[/url] ● [url=#visual-improvements]Visual Improvements[/url] ● [url=#сlan-battles]Clan Battles[/url] ● [url=#submarine-tweaks]Submarine Tweaks[/url] ● [url=#achievements]Division Achievements and Division Stars[/url] ● [url=#armory]Armory[/url] ● [url=#balance-changes]Game Balance Changes[/url] ● [url=#other-changes]Other New Features and Changes[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[list]Read through this article carefully and keep an eye out for a gift! Share the article with your friends and Clanmates so they can stay on top of all the essential info for this update![/list] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=superships-in-ranked-battles][/h1]Superships in Ranked Battles[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ce75a536-37f6-11ec-922f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Update 0.10.10 kicks off the Fifth Season of Ranked Battles, which you can join at the helms of superships.

Apart from super battleships [b] [b] Satsuma[/b][/b] and [b] [b] Hannover[/b][/b], which you already had a chance to helm during the Grand Battle event in Update 0.10.5, four more superships await you in the game: [b] [b] Condé[/b][/b], [b] [b] Annapolis[/b][/b], [b] [b] Yamagiri[/b][/b], and [b] [b] Zorkiy[/b][/b]. Like their forerunners, the new superships boast unique features that will allow players to pursue alternative gameplay tactics and employ different decision-making strategies in battle.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/460f0854-38af-11ec-8ea0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/44ce1656-38af-11ec-8114-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/460d77f0-38af-11ec-b0e4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/44b8daf2-38af-11ec-8c3d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/45251ad2-38af-11ec-97a3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/44a73220-38af-11ec-8793-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[b] [b] Condé[/b][/b], [b] [b] Annapolis[/b][/b], and [b] [b] Zorkiy[/b][/b] have one additional firing mode that can be activated by pressing the [b]F[/b] key. After switching to this mode, each separate turret can automatically deliver several consecutive salvos in rapid succession before being subjected to a long reload. Depending on the ship, activating this mode changes the characteristics of shells or guns.

[b] [b] Yamagiri[/b][/b] is armed with two types of torpedoes that can be switched between in battle. The torpedoes differ by various parameters such as range, speed, and damage. Switching to the alternative torpedoes takes an additional fixed amount of time that is separate from the reloading mechanic. Torpedo-tube reloading is suspended while switching to the alternative torpedo type and then resumes immediately after.

We have changed Combat Instructions—the unique feature of [b] [b] Satsuma[/b][/b] and [b] [b] Hannover[/b][/b]. Now, the adjustment fire bonus will not trigger automatically. Instead, it is now activated by pressing the [b]F[/b] key. This change will allow these super battleships to apply the power-up bonus at the most optimal moment.

All six superships will be available for rent from random bundles that can be obtained in exchange for a new resource— [b]Supership Tokens[/b]—in the Armory. You can earn Tokens by completing special combat missions playing Tier X ships. This will help us prevent the battle queue from filling up with superships only.

[list][i]In addition to Ranked Battles, you can also helm superships into Co-op Battles—a great place to tame the new ships and get to know their mechanics in a more relaxed environment.[/i][/list]

[h2]Ranked Season Format[/h2]
[list][*]7 vs. 7
[*]Tier X ships and superships in all three leagues[/list]
The season is divided into six Sprints. The first Sprint lasts 1 week. All the other Sprints each run for 2 weeks. Each new Sprint starts immediately after the end of the previous one.

This season will not feature submarines. The matchmaker will apply the standard ship type restrictions. In terms of superships, team lineups will be mirrored. Details of the new Ranked Battles season and superships will be released in a dedicated article on our website.
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=novorossiysk][/h1]Novorossiysk Service[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/10077ad2-37f8-11ec-922f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

A week after Update 0.10.10 goes live, players will be able to access five themed combat mission groups named "Novorossiysk Service." Completing those combat mission groups, as well as individual missions, will reward you with expendable camouflages and signals. Once you have completed the fifth group, you will get [b] [b][b]VI[/b] Novorossiysk[/b][/b], a Commander with 6 skill points, and a Port slot.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/df7756bc-3d60-11ec-8544-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Check the game client for details about how to complete the missions.
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=german-battleships][/h1]German Battleships[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0e26970c-37f8-11ec-bf43-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In Update 0.10.10, Early Access continues for German Tier III–IX battleships.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/98053c0e-38ba-11ec-a69f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9947ff20-38ba-11ec-856c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/980a68c8-38ba-11ec-9fa9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9942b524-38ba-11ec-b7b4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/98012cea-38ba-11ec-b100-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/994330a8-38ba-11ec-8c3d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/980b5044-38ba-11ec-836d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
You can spend German Tokens on sequentially available bundles with these ships and the following permanent camouflages: German Eagle for [b] [b][b]IX[/b] Prinz Rupprecht[/b][/b] and [b] [b][b]X[/b] Schlieffen[/b][/b]; German Navy for [b] [b][b]VII[/b] Prinz Heinrich[/b][/b] and [b] [b][b]VIII[/b] Zieten[/b][/b].

A special combat mission will become available with the release of the update. Completing it will reward you with a flag and a "German Battleships: Part 2" patch.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8b00718a-38bb-11ec-a69f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8b262722-38bb-11ec-b100-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/60717614-38b9-11ec-9fa9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
We have decorated the Port of Hamburg.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cb7ada0c-3d6b-11ec-b110-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cbebac82-3d6b-11ec-9094-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cc0b38a4-3d6b-11ec-ba79-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [hr][/hr]

[h2][b][h1=visual-improvements][/h1]Visual Improvements[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0e324598-37f8-11ec-bf71-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Update 0.10.10 brings quite a few large-scale improvements and changes to the graphics as we continue working on the game's visuals.

[h2]New water[/h2]
Water simulation and visuals have been completely reworked for all maps. The new simulation system can create waves of any shape and height while also adding realism to wave dynamics. This means that waves will now gently rock a ship, and the ship will produce a response that varies according to the wave height. This change will not affect gameplay.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/73c205c6-3279-11ec-9613-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

We have improved the display of the sun glitter path over water and other optical effects on the water's surface. Added dynamic seafoam and updated the ship wake effect.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/de9e3d02-3345-11ec-aee1-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/73bd6d2c-3279-11ec-b9b9-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

With low graphics settings, water simulation will remain unchanged.

[h2]HD textures on maps[/h2]
We are launching a massive update for all maps and Ports to accommodate enhanced HD textures. In Update 0.10.10, high-detail textures will be added to the Two Brothers and Hotspot maps, as well as the Philippines, Saint-Petersburg, and Twitch Prime Ports.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0c2e5de2-38be-11ec-bd50-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0c2b1f38-38be-11ec-adeb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0abb50f0-38be-11ec-9fa9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0ab26c9c-38be-11ec-81f1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0ab1e92a-38be-11ec-86d0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0c2e1710-38be-11ec-8d24-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Future updates will bring high-detail textures for the other maps and Ports. However, like with HDR lighting, such an update requires a huge amount of content to be reworked and an individual approach to each map and Port. For that reason, adopting the new technology for all maps and Ports in the game will take time and be implemented incrementally with the release of future updates.

[h2]Underwater world, vegetation, and animations[/h2]
We are continuing to improve the underwater world in our game. In Update 0.10.10, we have added underwater vegetation on the Two Brothers and Hotspot maps. The underwater world will also appear on the Haven, Sleeping Giant, and Crash Zone Alpha maps. In the nearest updates, we will focus on adding improvements to the underwater world on other maps as well.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9f4d69c4-327e-11ec-a73e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Vegetation has been enhanced on all maps and in all Ports. Trees look more realistic with enhanced shading and rays of sunlight shining through the green foliage. We have also reworked the wind-tree interactions. We have added more trees and other green foliage on maps.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/87dd20ea-38be-11ec-8d24-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/87bfa786-38be-11ec-86d0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/87c7234e-38be-11ec-acb6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Ports and maps with HD textures now feature birds, fish, flying flags, and other moving objects. We will continue adding more animated objects to maps and Ports over time.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/73c07102-3279-11ec-8545-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/73b85eb8-3279-11ec-9217-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]
More details on how we have been enhancing graphics can be found in a dedicated [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/graphics-update-review/]article[/url].
[hr][/hr]
[h2][b][h1=submarine-tweaks][/h1]Submarine Tweaks[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0e9f6362-37f8-11ec-9a70-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The periscopes of submarines have been piercing through waves in Live Server Random Battles for an entire update now. We are extremely grateful to our players for the battles played helming or countering submarines, and for all the feedback that is helping us shape the new ship type and make the experience of helming or countering them more interesting and engaging.

In Update 0.10.10, we have introduced a number of important changes for this ship type based on collected data and your feedback.

[h2]Changes to torpedoes[/h2]
The only "meaningful" weapon that submarines carry is their torpedo tubes. Mechanics like sonar pings and homing are essential for submarines as a ship type to offer distinctive and interesting gameplay that is relevant for an action-packed battle. This, however, comes at the cost of subs being fragile and firing only a tiny number of torpedoes per salvo.

But even though the data suggests that submarine torpedoes are not over-powered, we have heard our players say that submarine torpedoes are currently both effective and easy to master at the same time, while countering them poses quite a challenge. When used wisely, sonar pings could give sub Captains everything at once, i.e. both torpedo homing and increased damage. For the other ship types, interacting with such torpedoes in battle could hardly be called a pleasant experience.

To solve this problem while preserving the unique gameplay of submarines, we split their torpedoes into two types. They receive deferent bonuses from sonar pings.
[list][*]The first type is homing torpedoes. These have reduced maneuvering capabilities, and the distance at which they cease to home in on cruisers and destroyers is increased by a factor of two. The other characteristics correspond to those currently in effect for submarine torpedoes. As long as the effect of one sonar ping hit remains active, these torpedoes will home in on a target. The effect of a second sonar ping hit improves homing but does not make it any better than it currently is on the Live Server, nor does it have any effect on how much damage the torpedo can deal.
[*]The other type comes in the form of torpedoes that can deal increased damage. Their standard damage is slightly higher than that of homing torpedoes. The effect of the first sonar ping hit reduces the detectability range of these torpedoes by 25%. A second ping hit increases the damage dealt to the target by a factor of two if the torpedoes hit the ship's anti-torpedo protection. With the ping hit effect still active, this type of torpedo can home in on a target vertically (i.e. it can ascend or dive, depending on positions of the target and sub) but not horizontally.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7a16dcb4-3d62-11ec-9b9b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Tier VI subs will receive homing torpedoes only when submarines of Tier VIII and X are equipped with torpedoes of both types. The torpedo switching mechanics are the same as those used for destroyer [b] [b] Yamagiri[/b][/b]. Switching between torpedo types takes a certain amount of time, and the reload status of the torpedo tubes remains the same as it was before torpedo switching was activated.

The different torpedo types will offer sub Captains a choice between accuracy and damage while also substantially improving the gameplay experience for players helming the other ship types.
[h2]Submarine spotting range at depth[/h2]
Apart from their damage-dealing capabilities, subs are pretty good at detecting hostile ships while underwater. We decided that these capabilities were excessive and did not fit well into the basic concept of this ship type. For this reason, the standard range of surface ship detectability by submarines at their operating depth has been reduced to 2 kilometers, and in a future update, it will be replaced by the assured acquisition range. That said, subs will no longer be able to spot hostile ships while lurking in the relative safety of the depths.

[h2]Changing depth and sub detectability tweaks[/h2]
By constantly switching between the surface and periscope depth levels, players were able to reduce their submarine's detectability without depleting dive capacity. This was because their detectability range would start to change almost immediately as they shifted between depths. This does not fit with the intended gameplay, and from now on, detectability will change at the periscope and maximum depths.

[h2]Testing will continue[/h2]
While these changes will have a substantial effect on gameplay, there are still many submarine mechanics that we have not even approached yet. We need more data to be able to test subs in the best way we can. This will allow us to effectively decide what other changes are needed. With that being said, we will continue testing subs, despite the fixes planned for release with Update 0.10.10. For this reason, all battles played before Update 0.10.10 hits the servers are still extremely valuable in this respect.

The damage caused to each ship must amount to at least 20% of her normal HP.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/FRAG_SQUAD_4492b13adf552c7874b3e37313cf6caf8575896e2e6865daa3ee84b75e5e22ea.png[/img][/td] [td][b]Brothers in Arms[/b][/td] [td]Each Division mate must destroy at least two enemy ships in a single battle.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/MAIN_CALIBER_SQUAD_dbc27fce51731d7b451668bc2c7dcb8b26955edcaf5392a4c5176bd43106adcb.png[/img][/td] [td][b]Strike Team[/b][/td] [td]Damage caused by a Division must be equal to 50% or more of the consolidated total normal HP of all enemy ships.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/594292a0-37fc-11ec-a993-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][b]General Offensive[/b][/td] [td]Your Division must destroy hostile ships of three different types.[/td][/tr][/table]

[list][*]One for a victorious battle.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0e2ae37a-37f8-11ec-8e7c-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The following ships will become available in the Armory with the release of the Update:

[b] [b][b]X[/b] Gibraltar[/b][/b] is a heavy cruiser that carries twelve 234 mm guns housed in three turrets. She fires shells along a flat ballistic trajectory. The ship is armed only with AP shells that have enhanced ricochet angles and short fuse delay, which significantly increases their efficiency. Gibraltar is equipped with Hydroacoustic Search, Repair Party, and a variant of Smoke Generator with a short smoke screen setting time and long smoke screen dispersion time. All consumables are available in separate slots.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/dd0d04de-38c0-11ec-b491-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[b] [b][b]IX[/b] Tulsa[/b][/b] is a ship based on the Oregon City-class heavy cruisers. She is armed with six 203 mm guns that have a short reload time for the caliber and AP shells with enhanced ricochet angles. Tulsa has a good AA defense system and decent set of consumables: Repair Party, Surveillance Radar, and a choice between Hydroacoustic Search and Defensive AA Fire.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/dd6ee0aa-38c0-11ec-8250-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/dd0de84a-38c0-11ec-af29-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]With the release of Update 0.10.10, all Festive Tokens and Soviet Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]90,000[/b] and 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]6,000[/b], respectively.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=other-changes][/h1]Other New Features and Changes[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0fe6b338-37f8-11ec-96bb-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Changes to Economics[/h2]
We have changed the availability, cost, and characteristics of certain signals and camouflages:
[list][*]Expendable camouflages "For Meritorious Service," Rising, and Blue Lagoon, as well as economic signal India Bravo Terrathree, can no longer be obtained.
[*]We changed the bonuses and cost of the Type 1 and Type 2 camouflages. They will differ from the Type 5 camouflage only visually:
[list][*]The camouflages will provide [b]–3%[/b] to the detectability range by sea and [b]+4%[/b] to the dispersion of shells fired by the enemy at your ship.
[*]The cost of the camouflages has been increased from [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]7,500[/b] to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]22,500[/b] Credits.[/list][/list]
We are working to differentiate elements of the exterior (camouflages and signals) from economic bonuses. The above changes to the accessibility and characteristics of the camouflages and signals are a part of that large-scale change. We will share more information at a later date.

[h2]Battle Performance Bonuses[/h2]
We are starting to the get things up and ready for the New Year frenzy! As early as in Update 0.10.10, you can earn festive battle performance bonuses on all of your Tier V and higher ships. Depending on the ship's tier, you can grab Coal, Steel, or a special temporary resource called [b]New Year Certificates[/b] that you can exchange for Santa's Gift containers in Update 0.10.11.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b02222a4-37ff-11ec-8e1f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
You can get 1x Santa's Gift container in exchange for 1 New Year Certificate. A Santa's Big Gift container will be available in exchange for 3 Certificates, and a Santa's Mega Gift container will require as many as 5 Certificates.

[list][i]Access to the festive battle performance bonuses will open 1 week after Update 0.10.10 goes live and will continue until the end of Update 0.10.11. This way, players will have more time to get New Year Certificates and other festive bonuses.[/i][/list]

[h2]Changes to the Naval Battle[/h2]
Throughout the entire duration of Update 0.10.10, the Engagement stage of the Naval Battle will be held in a group format. Clans will be randomly divided between several groups of 25 or 50 Clans each. The amount of Oil earned depends on the number of Stars obtained and the Clan's place in its own group.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2778ff44-3d64-11ec-999e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/279be9fa-3d64-11ec-999e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

But not with this sleek little [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Ship Smasha[/b][/b]. It was built in the shipyards orbiting a world of proud and fearsome warriors. Though the citizens adhered to the Imperial creed and paid their tithes, secret cabals on the planet’s surface worshipped Khorne, the Lord of Rage. Their cults were strong. They were hated. They were outnumbered. At the appointed hour, they rose up and tried to overthrow their loyalist masters. They failed. They were defeated in a long, bloody war and all, to a man, perished in flames. Their names were erased from history. [h2][b][h1=what-is-warhammer-40k][/h1]What Is Warhammer 40,000?[/b][/h2]
Warhammer 40,000 is the pinnacle of tabletop wargaming. Produced by Games Workshop, its distinct visual style blends elements of science fiction and fantasy to create a beautifully dark atmosphere that has amassed a massive following over the years. Today, the universe has expanded to video games, novels, comics, and more, garnering a huge following around the globe.

Together with Games Workshop, we’ve created something that stays true to the renowned fantasy IP and also resonates with our universe of naval battles.

notes.title: Graphics Update Review
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/22ca335b1a5c2a594597e662054aadf2083d83a4.jpg[/img]
[b]World of Warships was released back in 2015. As the available technology has continued to evolve since the game's launch, the game itself has also evolved with numerous updates and improvements. One of the most important elements of a game is its visuals, and World of Warships is by no means an exception.[/b]

With Update 0.10.10, we're launching a large-scale overhaul of the in-game graphics. That's what we're going to talk about today, while also looking back at some of the most significant changes that we've made over the past few years.

[table][tr][th][b][url=#boosting-graphics-the-first-steps]Boosting Graphics: The First Steps[/url] ● [url=#visual-effects]Visual Effects[/url] ● [url=#water-and-other-new-features]A Future Look at Water and Other New Features[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=zdr_M3cXnn8;full][/previewyoutube] 
[h2][b][h1=boosting-graphics-the-first-steps][/h1]Boosting Graphics: The First Steps[/b][/h2]
Rendering, DirectX, and HDR—complicated stuff, in plain words.

[h2]Latest technology[/h2]
The updated lighting system is one example of how we've made use of the latest technology at our disposal over the past years. It all started with the tweaks we made to the image creation stages.

[b]Rendering[/b] is the process of creating an image with the help of a computer program.

The rendering system we relied on when the game went live, as well as its underlying DirectX 9 technology, were bottlenecks that limited any attempts to enhance the in-game graphics.

[b]DirectX[/b] is a special set of "instructions" created for managing graphic card operations. It's widely used in the development of video games for Microsoft Windows.

To remove this bottleneck, we adopted the more sophisticated DirectX 11, which gave us the green light to use more modern technology to create the game graphics, enhance the lighting, and add new effects.

[h2]Updated lighting model and HDR[/h2]
The technical refit allowed us to move ahead with making the game visuals more beautiful. First, we changed the lighting model because the "old" one came with numerous technical limitations and was a little uncomfortable to work with.

At the same time, since all content in the game had been created to "fit" the old lighting system, we had to make endless manual adjustments to reproduce colors correctly. After a number of experiments, we developed an algorithm that allowed us to convert game objects made in the outdated lighting system to fit the new one.

In the case of warships, it didn't take a huge effort since they all have similar properties in terms of game graphics and were reworked along with the lighting system in Update 0.8.6. The majority of maps and Ports, however, had to be approached by artists individually and were updated for the HDR technology gradually as we rolled out updates.

[b]HDR[/b] (high dynamic range) [b]rendering[/b] is a method of calculating and rendering an image using a wide color and brightness range. This technology brings the ratio of light brightness in line with reality, so even separate shades can be easily differentiated from one another. It allows for the simulation of bright day or dark night and everything in between, as well as looking from a low-light perspective towards a bright light or vice versa in an accurate and realistic way.

The new lighting system widened our choices of how to handle lighting, color rendering, and the reproduction of various surface effects. It allowed us to make all of the imagery in the game brighter, more realistic, and more diverse.
[table][tr][td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d39d8576-3344-11ec-b228-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d39d8576-3344-11ec-b228-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d402e25e-3344-11ec-a8ab-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d402e25e-3344-11ec-a8ab-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][/td] [td][/td][/tr][/table]
Once we finished working on the lighting system, we were able to move on to directly updating the HDR technology. For quite some time, we experimented with various parameters of the formula used to convert the physical parameters of an image into the brightness values of monitor pixels, and we compared our imagery to images of real-life sea locations before we arrived at a result that satisfied us.
[table][tr][td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f1acc9a0-3344-11ec-b228-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f1acc9a0-3344-11ec-b228-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f20e739e-3344-11ec-80e4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f20e739e-3344-11ec-80e4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][/td] [td][/td][/tr][/table]
Next, we moved on to work with the in-game sky and [b]indirect lighting[/b], i.e. lighting that does not shine directly onto an object. Lighting in our game previously only simulated the amount and direction of light on maps. Because of that, we updated the textures of our [b]skydomes[/b], i.e. the panoramic photographs of the real sky that were shot using special technology. The new HDR textures make it possible to create "real-life" physically correct lighting.

The creation of the new lighting for each map and Port in the game required an individual approach and considerable investment of time, so we added changes to the lighting effects step by step, covering all maps, Ports, and operations in the game between Updates 0.8.8 and 0.9.9.
[table][tr][td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/21fd13bc-3345-11ec-80e4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/21fd13bc-3345-11ec-80e4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/21fa51b8-3345-11ec-aee1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/21fa51b8-3345-11ec-aee1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][/td] [td][/td][/tr][/table]
[h2][b][h1=visual-effects][/h1]Visual Effects[/b][/h2]
Visual effects add beauty to the game and have an effect on gameplay. They help you make the right decisions and take your bearings in battle.
[previewyoutube=WsxaDra-niM;full][/previewyoutube] 
With this in mind, another big step was a large-scale reworking of the visual effects in Update 0.10.2:
[list][*]The new lighting system improved interactions between all visual effects and lighting in the game while also making the effects themselves more three-dimensional.
[*]We added new visual effects that allow for easier orientation and decision-making in battle. These changes made the game brighter overall and rich in vibrant colors.[/list]
At the same time, we improved the technical side by significantly optimizing the visual effects. This increased the frames per second (FPS) value at peak loads, which was particularly noticeable on weaker PC configurations. Such a considerable "performance reserve" opened up new opportunities to make further improvements to the visual component of the game.

Stay tuned for more news, and be sure to share the articles with your friends so they can also enjoy claiming gifts!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]The reward can be claimed before:[/b] [b]Tue. 02 Nov. 15:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[table][tr][th][h3=button]Asia[/h3][/th][th][h3][url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/general-news/graphics-update-review/#button style=button][b]Claim Tokens[/b][/url][/h3][/th]
[/tr][tr][th][h3]CIS(Ru)[/h3][/th][th][h3][url=https://worldofwarships.ru/news/general-news/graphics-update-review/#button style=button][b]Claim Tokens[/b][/url][/h3][/th]
[/tr][tr][th][h3]EU[/h3][/th][th][h3][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/graphics-update-review/#button style=button][b]Claim Tokens[/b][/url][/h3][/th]
[/tr][tr][th][h3]NA[/h3][/th][th][h3][url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/general-news/graphics-update-review/#button style=button][b]Claim Tokens[/b][/url][/h3][/th][/tr][/table]

[list]Watch our official streams and participate in the Public Test and other activities to earn Community Tokens. In total, you will be able to find up to [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_recruitment_points_e30ec137465b5e672aa3cd633442824abc4884652e65c8bc443767fafdd18fd6.png[/img] 1,510 Community Tokens on our website before the end of Update 0.10.9.[/list]
We ended up enhancing nearly all the effects in the game.
[list][*]Fire effects are now more detailed and three-dimensional. Their display now takes a ship's speed into account, and it will be easier to aim at an enemy if your ship is on fire.
[*]Shots fired by primary and secondary guns are now clearly distinct—the smoke and fire effects have different shapes and dynamics. Moreover, the size of the effects depends on the number of guns in a turret and their caliber—the more guns and the larger their caliber, the more impressive the visual effects are.
[*]We've also reworked splash and shell hit effects. Hitting the water now results in different splash effects that depend on the shell type. At the same time, we've reduced the sizes of splashes, which will make aiming amidst an intense fire exchange more convenient.
[*]Disabling or destroying primary and secondary guns, AA defense systems, and torpedo tubes is now accompanied by a smoldering smoke effect.
[*]Hit effects now depend on their type. For example, a citadel hit will cause a large explosion, while a ricochet will produce bright sparks. The visual display of a shell explosion now depends on the shell type and angle at which it strikes a ship or the ground.
[*]AA gunfire is now accompanied by muzzle flashes and smoke, while the explosions of AA shells have received various visual effects. The tracer color and density of AA gunfire depend on the activation of a priority sector and the Defensive AA Fire consumable, which will improve immersion and help aircraft carrier Captains better orient themselves in battle. Destroyed planes have received additional falling animations.
[*]Now, when the Damage Control Party, Repair Party, Main Battery Reload Booster, Defensive AA Fire, and Hydroacoustic Search consumables are activated, you'll see additional effects that will help you stay aware in the heat of battle.
[*]The effects of torpedo hits on ships and islands have been updated—a hit can now be accompanied by large volumes of fire, water, and rising sand.
[*]The destruction of a ship will now be marked by a powerful explosion.
[*]The effect for exhaust smoke coming out of smokestacks now takes the actual movement speed of a ship into account—the higher the speed, the longer the smoke trail. Moreover, smoke no longer interferes with firing without the binoculars enabled.[/list]
The reworked visual effects give the graphics of World of Warships a fresh look, and they also allow you to get more important gameplay information by simply observing the battleground.

[h2]Other Improvements[/h2]
We've made numerous improvements over the last years, so we're bringing up only the most substantial ones.

Minor tweaks are added to graphics with nearly every update:

[h3][b]Fog[/b][/h3]
With Update 0.9.8, we added the following changes to fog in the game:
[list][*]While studying images of real coastal areas, we found out that fog on different surfaces and at differing heights spreads differently, so we added a spatial distribution effect for fog to the game.
[*]We also added a scattered sunlight effect inside the fog, which made it possible to add warmer bright tones to illuminated areas while leaving unlit areas shaded and cold. This made fog in the game more realistic and beautiful.
[*]Apart from improving the visual component, this change also resulted in a slight improvement to the game client's performance.[/list] [table][tr][td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/43168560-3345-11ec-b228-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/43168560-3345-11ec-b228-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/431b6f6c-3345-11ec-aa9b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/431b6f6c-3345-11ec-aa9b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][/td] [td][/td][/tr][/table]
[h3][b]Trees[/b][/h3]
We updated the tree rendering system to make trees more realistic with the following:
[list][*]An improved self-shadowing effect—required to create a 3D effect.
[*]Updated effects that create realistic sun glittering of leaves.
[*]New effect for sunrays shining through green foliage.[/list] [table][tr][td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/61f82b0a-3345-11ec-aee1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/61f82b0a-3345-11ec-aee1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/61f5748c-3345-11ec-80e4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/61f5748c-3345-11ec-80e4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][/td] [td][/td][/tr][/table]
[h3][b]Water[/b][/h3]
With Update 0.9.9, we improved the sea rendering quality for all graphics settings. Sun glare on the water's surface now looks more realistic; the horizon is now rendered at a higher quality; and water now appears in a range of different shades, depending on the map. This change has also improved the game client's performance. The changes are most visible at low and medium graphics quality settings. In Update 0.10.1, we reworked the way in which sun glitters on the water's surface with a sun path on the water. We improved the quality of reflections, waves, and areas with calm winds. Increased the amplitude and speed of waves on several maps.
[list][*]Added support for [b]temporal anti-aliasing[/b]—a method of image smoothing that analyzes an image based on preceding frames, eliminates noises, significantly reduces eye strain, and improves perception.[/list] [table][tr][td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/872ea4d0-3345-11ec-aa9b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/872ea4d0-3345-11ec-aa9b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/871ef56c-3345-11ec-aee1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/871ef56c-3345-11ec-aee1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][/td] [td][/td][/tr][/table]
[h3][b]Underwater world[/b][/h3]
Creating the underwater world turned out to be one of the biggest challenges for our team over the last year.
[list][*]For most maps, we had to create the seabed landscape from scratch.
[*]Numerous visual effects have been added that give you much-needed gameplay information in battle, as there aren't many orientation cues at your disposal while underwater.
[*]We reworked the lighting for sun rays penetrating through water thickness so they scatter in a realistic and eye-catching manner.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9f4d69c4-327e-11ec-a73e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9f77b620-327e-11ec-a332-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9f4bbd90-327e-11ec-b339-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9f474fee-327e-11ec-a0e9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9f4b2f74-327e-11ec-918e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9f424db4-327e-11ec-8854-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
All of these new features significantly improved the in-game graphics, but our options to improve the sea, for example, were still limited by the simulation and rendering system. For this very reason, we were unable to take the next step to boost the realism of water and other game components.

We decided to spark a graphics "revolution" and completely rework it like we had done with the lighting.

[h2][b][h1=water-and-other-new-features][/h1]A Future Look at Water and Other New Features[/b][/h2]
Let's take a look at the upcoming changes!

[h2]The fascinating seas[/h2]
New reflections, glare, and changes to water shading in response to different lighting conditions—everything we implemented in the game over the last years added to the game's beauty. But no matter how beautiful the picture looked, it still lacked realism.

This was because of the water simulation system used in World of Warships. We decided to completely remove the old system from the game code and replace it with a new one that utilizes modern technology.

[b]FFT[/b] (Fast Fourier Transform) is an algorithm that computes the discrete Fourier transform—an operation used to perform various calculations and analyses in computer technology and other fields.

The new system utilizes a number of special algorithms and formulas, such as the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) technology that calculates the water's surface in real time and smoothly changes its shape. This allows for realistic water simulation, creates waves of various heights and shapes, and adds dynamic sea foam. Everything we had been unable to achieve earlier.
[table][tr][td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9dd73e22-3345-11ec-80e4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9dd73e22-3345-11ec-80e4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9de17edc-3345-11ec-aa9b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9de17edc-3345-11ec-aa9b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][/td] [td][/td][/tr][/table]
At the same time, all the algorithms are configured to run on data obtained by oceanographers observing real seas and oceans, which also contributes to the realism of the wave shapes and dynamics.

The new simulation model affects both the shape and "structure" of waves, and it also makes it much easier to achieve visual and optical effects like the glittering of a sun path on waves.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/de9e3d02-3345-11ec-aee1-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

It will make it easier for you to determine whether a ship is moving in battle or if she has come to a stop. Previously, over long distances, waves resembled a homogeneous moving surface, and this sometimes misled players into believing that an observed ship was moving. Owing to the variety of waveforms, the new water simulation model makes it possible to determine the movement direction of a ship at a glance.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/73c205c6-3279-11ec-9613-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

The updated water means that any associated visual effects applied to ships will be updated, too. We take special pride in the new wake trails produced by ships. You can look forward to admiring the new water on all maps and in all Ports as early as this fall. But even though we're pleased with the improvement, we're not going to rest on our laurels and will continue to improve the sea in our game.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/73bd6d2c-3279-11ec-b9b9-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

[h2]Tiles and HD maps[/h2]
Beginning from Update 0.10.10, we started to update maps using tiles and HD textures.

[b]Tiling[/b] is a method of creating an image using tiny repeating textures. With this technology, we can achieve excellent image quality while optimizing the process of creating maps.

For World of Warships' maps, we also blend several detailed layers, such as grass, sand, rocks, etc.

Due to the use of a height map for each type of terrain, the mixing is physically correct. Blades of grass penetrate the sand, and stones are higher than grass. The new technology makes island models look a lot more realistic and detailed, and the use of HD textures will significantly increase the image quality. We have increased the details of islands by a factor of 12, while the size of the textures is now three times smaller.

We also changed the shaders for islands. By doing so, we achieved a "wet beach" effect on shore sands. Stones will also get wet in rainy weather. The islands themselves will no longer produce an unnatural glare.
[table][tr][td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/05daccb0-334a-11ec-bb82-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/05daccb0-334a-11ec-bb82-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/05c025a4-334a-11ec-964d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/05c025a4-334a-11ec-964d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][/td] [td][/td][/tr][/table]
A [b]shader[/b] is a program that works with graphics and determines the image parameters and ways in which they change. They are used to apply textures to geometric objects, and they also allow us to create shadow, reflection, and refraction effects based on specified settings.

The materials we use to create maps are obtained using photogrammetry of real islands, many of which are shot directly by our colleagues as they travel around the globe to film various locations.

[b]Photogrammetry[/b] is a method of determining the shape, size, location, and other characteristics of objects by their photographic images.

And the underwater world! We reworked all underwater objects to improve their aesthetics. This process also solved a number of gameplay issues, such as ships getting stuck near islands.

Fun fact: You've already had a chance to try out this new technology right in the game. We often use temporary game modes to test potential new features for the game. The Key Battle, the Big Hunt, and the Twilight Hunt were no exceptions. The sci-fi map called Polygon was created for these events specifically using tiles.

During this "test drive," we aimed to collect your feedback and check the game performance. The results were positive, so we continued to work with this technology.

As in the case of HDR lighting, such an update requires a huge amount of content to be reworked and an individual approach to each map. It's not just about a comprehensive graphics update, we're also trying to work on landmark features for each map. For example, a real active volcano has finally made it to the Hotspot map.
[table][tr][td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e6f9b9be-3349-11ec-998e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e6f9b9be-3349-11ec-998e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e7006e80-3349-11ec-964d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e7006e80-3349-11ec-964d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][/td] [td][/td][/tr][/table]
This is why reworking all the game maps to fit the new technology will take time. In Update 0.10.10, however, you can already check out the newly reworked maps Two Brothers and Hotspot, as well as the updated Philippines and Saint-Petersburg Ports.
[table][tr][td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9be9ddc8-3349-11ec-998e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9be9ddc8-3349-11ec-998e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9be4e8fe-3349-11ec-964d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9be4e8fe-3349-11ec-964d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][/td] [td][/td][/tr][/table]
[h2]New foliage[/h2]
It seems only natural that updating the islands should be followed by updating more of their aesthetics. That's why our next step will be to focus on reworking various species of greenery. When reworking trees, we focused on two main things: improving and diversifying the models of trees and their number on each map.

None of the existing solutions we had to hand worked for these tasks for several reasons. For example, particular difficulties were created by specific camera angles and a large number of plants on a map.

For that reason, updating trees required creating a custom solution based on the programs we already use. This way, we managed to configure a huge number of different parameters for trees like foliage shades, various lighting parameters (such as foliage transparency), and even adjust the wind physics for interactions with tree crowns. In the future, we'll be able to add many new features.
[table][tr][td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6ba282be-3349-11ec-a569-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6ba282be-3349-11ec-a569-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6b8f6c24-3349-11ec-a8ab-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6b8f6c24-3349-11ec-a8ab-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][/td] [td][/td][/tr][/table]
We managed to achieve a new level of detail for greenery on maps. But even the most beautiful trees will not make the visual component of the game shine if we're only talking about scarce plants scattered across huge islands. To tackle that problem, we needed to create entire beautiful forests. As a result, the total number of plants on maps now exceeds one million.
[table][tr][td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4ee8f784-3349-11ec-a8ab-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4ee8f784-3349-11ec-a8ab-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4f516fa8-3349-11ec-998e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4f516fa8-3349-11ec-998e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][/td] [td][/td][/tr][/table]
[h2]Texture-based animations[/h2]
As the final step in the current round of graphics updates, we added a huge number of new texture-based animations.

[b]Texture-based animation[/b] is an animation method that implies baking animation into an object's texture for subsequent rendering and playback in the game directly using the GPU.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/73c07102-3279-11ec-8545-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/73b85eb8-3279-11ec-9217-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]
With this technology, we added new animations for birds and fish, waving flags, and other moving objects on islands. All of this brings more detail to the game world and adds life to it without having a major impact on the game client's performance. In the future, we plan to continue adding new animals to the maps to make the game world as diverse and interesting as possible.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/a1c7ce8a-327c-11ec-8717-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

We could call this graphics update the most ambitious endeavor in the entire history of World of Warships, but it's not the end—we'll continue to improve the game visuals by updating the underwater world, deploying new technology for maps, and considering other new graphics features that can be implemented in the game.

In the meantime, join us in World of Warships and enjoy the real seascape from the deck of your favorite steel giant!

[h3][b]Until next time, Captains![/b][/h3]

notes.title: Public Test of Update 0.10.10: Round 3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38188069/1e16ea670055ebff5ca8b6f3860499f92bdd6664.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Sixth Brawl
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9d44f7f3259dbb67d34505ab63b5e915b2f2be55.jpg[/img]
[b]The sixth Brawl utilizes a 3 vs. 3 format and Tier X ships. Don't miss this opportunity to fight for Credits, Coal, and Elite Commander XP![/b]

Brawls are a separate battle type with short seasons and a smaller team format—expect the battles to be more dynamic and fast-paced compared to other battle types! Players are matched based on their skill level. You can participate in a Division, and you don't need to be a member of a Clan. Team up with friends to win more battles!

[h2][b]Rewards[/b][/h2]
Up to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]10,000[/b] Coal; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]2,250,000[/b] Credits; [b]80,000[/b] Elite Commander XP; and 76 combat and economic signals.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ac1baad0-2694-11ec-8689-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Rules[/b][/h2] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0d65332e-301d-11ec-9a3e-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Mon. 25 Oct. 10:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends: [/b] [b]Mon. 01 Nov. 03:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[b]Format:[/b] 3 vs. 3; Tier X ships

[b]Restrictions:[/b] Not more than one ship of each type per team, and the teams may differ in terms of their ship-type compositions

[list][i]You can take part in the Brawl only during the time period specified for your server.[/i][/list]

[h2][b]Game Maps and Modes[/b][/h2]
Big Race, Hotspot, Shatter, and Greece, all with reduced combat areas in Domination mode; Two Brothers in the Epicenter mode.

[*]Fixed an issue which caused torpedo tubes to be displayed incorrectly on the submarine's silhouette
[*]Fixed an issue because of which dive capacity did not deplete when a submarine would constantly change depth.
[*]Fixed an issue because of which torpedoes of submarines were homing incorrectly towards targets located at the border of the map.
[*]Fixed an issue because of which the Engineer of the Future and Breaking the Eighth Wall achievements were not displayed in the Achievements tab.
[*]Fixed an issue because of which some of the animations were not played on Transformers-themed camouflages.
[*]Fixed several visual issues in the Saint Petersburg port.
[*]Fixed several other issues.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c59403932ead1b00e1084da1ffce1a59cc1db060.jpg[/img]
[b]As many as nine special ships await you in our new temporary battle type which pits sixteen players against each other! Welcome to the Twilight Hunt—a revamped version of the Big Hunt event from Update 0.10.2.[/b]

Ships will sail out for the "Hunt" in the third week of Update 0.10.9, and you can expect to continue hunting until Update 0.10.10 goes live.

Be cautious, though, as the Portal opens up only some time after the start of each battle.

The Twilight Hunt ends when all surviving players exit through the Portal or when the battle time expires. For this reason, it is better not to stay in the Polygon for too long—the Portal will not stay open forever and, as the battle nears its end, AI-controlled ships of the Twilight Fleet will start hunting down any remaining players, headed by the formidable boss ship [b]Rasputin[/b]. For destroying ships of the Twilight Fleet and other players, you will get a temporary resource—Battle Points—that you can use to reinforce your ship directly in battle.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1ed59dae-2d86-11ec-85d4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
You can team up with other players during the battle. The Twilight Hunt's difficulty intensifies each week—the time it takes for the Portal to open, as well as the HP pools and damage dealt by the Twilight Fleet ships (as well as the amount of Battle Points earned by destroying them!), increase. The maximum team size also increases—from three players in the first week to six players in the third week.

[h2][b][h1=a-few-tips-from-us][/h1]A Few Tips From Us...[/b][/h2]
[list][*]Destroy the first Twilight Fleet ships you encounter, then upgrade your ship. This will give you an advantage in the following engagements.
[*]Try to assemble a team of your own or join one with other players. Fighting side by side with your allies will increase your chances of escaping via the Portal. You will always start out alone, even if you enter battle as part of a Division. You will need to locate your Division mates on the map before you can team up with them.
[*]You can place markers on the Minimap when playing as part of a team. These markers will be visible to all team members and will help you coordinate your actions. To place a marker, press [b]Сtrl[/b] [b]+[/b] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/095e93cc-8589-11eb-8f09-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img] on the Minimap.
[*]As you get closer to the center of the map, the ships of the Twilight Fleet will become increasingly stronger, but you will also earn more Battle Points for destroying them.
[*]Keep an eye on Rasputin's arrival timer. This will help you ensure that you are in the right place and combat-ready when she finally arrives. Defeating the boss ship will bring you and your team the most Battle Points.
[*]Do not be afraid to experiment—you need to act unpredictably in the Polygon.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9c093ca4-2dc2-11ec-9098-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9c3c8ab4-2dc2-11ec-961e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9c18ae50-2dc2-11ec-b2aa-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9c0b6470-2dc2-11ec-92fd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2][b][h1=combat-missions-and-rewards][/h1]Combat Missions and Rewards[/b][/h2]
You can access special weekly combat missions during the event. Completing the missions requires you to earn Battle Points in the Twilight Hunt or Base XP in Random, Ranked, and Co-op Battles, as well as in Operations.

[list][b]Rewards for weekly combat missions:[/b] Up to [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_3_09977141afe61c0ca2d00715ea4037b8306d808b4973171281587c5286c558a8.png[/img] 130 Twilight Tokens and up to 2x Jack-o’-Lantern containers.[/list]
To stock up on Community Tokens, you can progress through daily and weekly missions that can only be completed in the Twilight Hunt.

[list][b]Rewards for daily combat missions:[/b] Up to [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_recruitment_points_e30ec137465b5e672aa3cd633442824abc4884652e65c8bc443767fafdd18fd6.png[/img] 30 Community Tokens, Free XP and Elite Commander XP, Credits, and XP that counts toward your daily container progress.[/list]
Details about the mission completion criteria and rewards are available in the game client. Once the event is over, any XP earned playing the special ships will be transferred to Tier I cruiser Orlan. More details are available in the game client.

[list][b]Rewards for completing daily missions for Community Tokens: [/b]up to [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_recruitment_points_e30ec137465b5e672aa3cd633442824abc4884652e65c8bc443767fafdd18fd6.png[/img] 1,300 Community Tokens.[/list]
You can find more Community Tokens in our articles. Stay tuned for more news, and be sure to share the articles with your friends so they can also enjoy claiming gifts!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]You can claim your reward before:[/b] [b]Sun. 07 Nov. 15:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

be exchanged in the Armory for themed Commanders with 10 skill points; Intanian Fleet permanent camouflages for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [h2][b][h1=battle-points][/h1]Battle Points[/b][/h2]
You can earn [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_2_65bc5d6f2e5b745981b237addbe95a8b0eab5f1e4be650cbe25135f0b2246955.png[/img][b]Battle Points[/b] by destroying Twilight Fleet ships and the ships of other players. [b]Rasputin[/b], the boss ship, will bring you the most Battle Points. Be careful though—vanquishing Rasputin and her escorts will not be easy, even with a team.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9c3cd672-2dc2-11ec-9b2f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

To select one of the two improvements, use [b]Ctrl+1[/b], [b]Ctrl+2[/b], or [b]Ctrl[/b] [b]+[/b] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/095e93cc-8589-11eb-8f09-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img] on the preferred improvement. You do not spend any Battle Points in the process of improving your ship, so make sure to reinforce your ship as soon as you are able!
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9c14dc8a-2dc2-11ec-9edc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Successfully exiting via the Portal will double your earned Battle Points. If you fail to escape the Polygon, you will still get any Battle Points you accrued in battle. In total, you can earn up to 10,000 Battle Points in a single battle. These will be counted toward your combat mission progress.

[h2][b][h1=ships-and-armaments][/h1]Ships and Armaments[/b][/h2]

The three dreadful new ships—[b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_7f464599e130cf92f9271625063d02d744733b691d8446659f12384e698aaf0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Fangblade[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_7f464599e130cf92f9271625063d02d744733b691d8446659f12384e698aaf0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Thornridge[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_7f464599e130cf92f9271625063d02d744733b691d8446659f12384e698aaf0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Lobster-Eyed[/b][/b]—will unlock once you complete the corresponding combat missions.

It's now much simpler to take part in the Public Test—you can log in using your main account. To do so, select [b]Public Test[/b] in the [b]Game Instance[/b] section of Wargaming Game Center. As a reward, you'll receive Community Tokens! These can be exchanged for Premium ships, permanent camouflages, Supercontainers, and other items.

Take a look at the [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/bulletin-01010/]Developer Bulletin[/url], and welcome to the Test! See you on the Public Test Server!

[h3][b]Alternative Firing Mode: Burst Fire (Condé, Zorkiy, and Annapolis)[/b][/h3]
Each turret has one additional firing mode. It can be activated by pressing the [b]F[/b] key. After switching to this mode, each separate turret can deliver several consecutive salvos in rapid succession before being subjected to a long reload. Activating this mode changes gun characteristics such as shell dispersion and penetration capabilities.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6837e8ec-2b62-11ec-a107-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Alternative Torpedoes (Yamagiri)[/b][/h3]
The Japanese superdestroyer is armed with two types of torpedoes that can be switched between in battle. The torpedoes differ by parameters such as range, speed, and damage. Switching to the alternative torpedoes takes an additional fixed amount of time that's separate from the reloading mechanic. Torpedo launcher reloading is suspended while switching to the alternative torpedo type and then resumes immediately after.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6c905c74-2b5f-11ec-8b9e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

It is now activated by pressing the [b]F[/b] key. This change will allow players to apply the power-up bonus at the most optimal moment.

[h2]Fifth Ranked Battles Season[/h2]
The Fifth Season of Ranked Battles is going to be held in a 7 vs. 7 format playing Tier X ships. Superships will also feature in all three leagues! [h2][b][h1=arms-race][/h1]Arms Race[/b][/h2]
Arms Race is back as a temporary battle type in Update 0.10.10. This represents an important testing round before we add Arms Race to Random Battles at some point in the future.

Arms Race brings various buffs scattered around the map that spice up the usual flow of battle. Once picked up, they benefit your entire team by improving their combat characteristics right until the end of each battle.

The new iteration features new buffs that boost armament damage and increase the current and maximum HP values. You can also expect the following changes:
[list][*]The HP-regenerating buff turned out to be overly effective compared with others and reduced the appeal of the Repair Party consumable for players. We've reduced the efficiency of the buff while also refocusing it to first restore the parts of ships that cannot be repaired by the Repair Party consumable.
[*]The following buffs have been removed: consumable reload acceleration for ships and squadrons; ship speed increase and rudder-shift time reduction, and aircraft Engine Boost consumable reload time reduction.
[list][*]Reducing the reload time was not as effective as we had intended. It provided a significant bonus only after several levels of this buff had been picked up. Players were only able to achieve this in the middle or closer to the end of a battle when most ships are typically left with just a few consumable charges or none at all.
[*]Boosting ship speed and maneuverability was excessively effective for a limited number of ships. For most ships, this boost was of little benefit.[/list]
[*]We have added an economic reward of XP and Credits for players who pick up buffs, but we have also brought the number of buff levels down from six to three. This will enhance the overall effect provided by each particular level.
[*]More buffs will now spawn in "neutral waters," and ships will start each battle in wide formations like they do in Random Battles.[/list]

[h2][b][h1=visual-improvements-and-changes][/h1]Visual Improvements and Changes[/b][/h2]
Update 0.10.10 brings quite a few large-scale improvements and changes to the graphics as we continue working on the game's visuals.

[h2]New water[/h2]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a536a5ba-2b5f-11ec-b51f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Water simulation and visuals have been completely reworked for all maps. The new simulation system can create waves of any shape and height while also adding realism to wave dynamics. This means that waves will now gently rock a ship, and the ship will produce a response that varies according to the wave height. This change will not affect gameplay.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/49b32876-2a97-11ec-87a4-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4a7a771e-2a97-11ec-8165-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

We have improved the display of the sun glitter path over water and other optical effects on the water's surface. Added dynamic seafoam and updated the ship wake effect.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3e244472-2a83-11ec-bbf4-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

[list][i]With low graphics settings, water simulation will remain unchanged.[/i][/list]

[h2]HD textures on maps[/h2]
We are launching a massive update for all maps and Ports to accommodate enhanced HD textures. In Update 0.10.10, high-detail textures will be added to the Two Brothers and Hotspot maps, as well as the Philippines, Saint-Petersburg, and Twitch Prime Ports.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4f4850d4-2a71-11ec-8cf1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4f601174-2a71-11ec-8e38-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/50090dce-2a71-11ec-9bc2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/500be918-2a71-11ec-885f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
Future updates will bring high-detail textures for other maps and Ports. However, like with HDR lighting, such an update requires a huge amount of content to be reworked and an individual approach to each map and Port. For that reason, adopting the new technology for all maps and Ports in the game will take time and be implemented incrementally with the release of future updates.

[h2]Underwater world, vegetation, and animations[/h2]
We are continuing to improve the underwater world in our game. In Update 0.10.10, we have added underwater vegetation on the Two Brothers and Hotspot maps. The underwater world will also appear on the Haven, Sleeping Giant, and Crash Zone Alpha maps. In the next updates, we will focus on adding improvements to the underwater world on other maps as well.

Vegetation has been enhanced on all maps and in all Ports. Trees look more realistic with enhanced shading and rays of sunlight shining through the green foliage. We have also reworked the wind–tree interactions. We have added more trees and other green foliage on maps.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a529f806-2b5f-11ec-8b9e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a5359af8-2b5f-11ec-8afb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Ports and maps with HD textures now feature birds, fish, flying flags, and other moving objects. We'll continue adding more animations to maps and Ports over time.

[h2][b][h1=other-changes][/h1]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
We have added the following five achievements that can only be earned by playing as part of a Division in Random Battles:
[list][*]Coordinated Attack: Your Division must destroy at least seven enemy ships.
[*]Hand to Hand: Your Division must damage at least 10 enemy ships. The damage caused to each ship must amount to at least 20% of her normal HP.
[*]Brothers-in-Arms: Each Division mate must destroy at least two enemy ships in a single battle.
[*]Strike Team: Damage caused by a Division must be equal to 50% or more of the consolidated total normal HP of all enemy ships.
[*]General Offensive: A Division must destroy ships of three different types.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/43076c64-2a9a-11ec-b0fc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The conditions for earning Division Stars (victory bonuses issued to Clanmates) have changed. You can now get a Division Star playing with each of your Clanmates as many as three times by:
[list][*]Winning a battle
[*]Earning the Coordinated Attack achievement
[*]Earning the Strike Team achievement[/list]
Throughout the entire duration of Update 0.10.10, the Engagement stage of the Naval Battle will be held in a group format. Clans will be randomly divided between several groups of 25 or 50 Clans each. The amount of Oil earned depends on the number of Stars obtained and the Clan's place in its own group. Once Update 0.10.11 goes live, the standard format of the Engagement will be replaced with the group format every four weeks.

We have reworked the portraits of all Commanders in the game and brought them to a uniform size. Added new Commander portraits for the U.S.; Great Britain; the U.S.S.R.; Italy; Pan-Asia; and France.

notes.title: Submarines in Random Battles
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/59ed355b98c015a4fb05afeccbcf6f8966618340.jpg[/img]
[b]Captains![/b]

In this article, we are going to tell you about the arrival of rental submarines in Random Battles; anti-submarine weapons of cruisers and battleships; and balance changes to submarines.

[table][tr][th][b][url=#submarines]Submarines[/url] ● [url=#anti-submarine-weapons]Anti-Submarine Weapons[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b][h1=submarines][/h1]Submarines[/b][/h2]
Submarines have been present in Ranked and Co-op Battles for almost 2 months now, and we are extremely grateful for the battles you have played, as well as your feedback. By participating and telling us your opinions, you helped us determine what the next steps in submarine development should be.

We have planned a number of further changes based on the data and feedback we collected. The first of these is the addition of anti-submarine weapons to all Tier V–X cruisers and battleships in Update 0.10.9, except for hybrids and Dutch cruisers.

We are aware that adding anti-submarine weapons on a large number of ships can have a significant impact on the effectiveness of submarines, so we have made a number of balance changes to the new ship type:
[list][*]We have changed the characteristics of torpedoes, and submarines now have tube-by-tube torpedo-launching capabilities. Tube-by-tube torpedo launching will allow for more dynamic gameplay and better control over the number of torpedoes launched during an attack. To encourage submarine Captains to use sonar pings for better accuracy, the width of the torpedo launch sector has been increased.
[*]German submarines were weaker compared to American submarines in terms of damage they were able to deal. To make them even in terms of this parameter, we've increased the maximum damage and the chances of causing flooding of torpedoes launched by German submarines.
[*]The torpedo tubes of German submarines are mostly located in their fore ends, which is great for attacking from longer distances. To shift German submarine gameplay toward long-range combat, we increased the range of their torpedoes.
[*]American submarines, in their turn, can be quite effective in short- and medium-range battles, because their torpedo tubes are located in both their bows and sterns. To encourage American submarine Captains to embrace this style of combat, the range of American submarines' torpedoes has been reduced.[/list]
Reduced dive capacity depletion if the submarine is detected. The increase of dive capacity depletion in Update 0.10.8 significantly affected how comfortable it was to play submarines, and it also impacted their effectiveness. To make the detection of submarines impact their gameplay less, we've reduced the dive capacity depletion rates when submarines are detected.

[h3][i][h3][b]Summary of Changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
[list][*]Dive capacity depletion of a detected submarine reduced from 4 to 3 units/second.
[*]Torpedoes are now launched tube-by-tube. If a submarine had several torpedo launchers in her bow or stern, they are now displayed as a single torpedo launcher in her bow or stern, respectively. The torpedo launcher reloading concept remains unchanged.
[*]Width of the torpedo launch sector increased by a factor of 2.5.
[*]Changed the parameters of torpedoes and sonar pings.[/list]
[h3][b]U-69[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Maximum damage of torpedoes increased from 7,067 to 7,533.
[*]Chances of causing flooding with torpedoes increased from 37 to 41%.
[*]Range of torpedoes and sonar pings increased from 9 to 11.5 km.[/list]
[h3][b]U-190[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Maximum damage of torpedoes increased from 7,467 to 8,633.
[*]Chances of causing flooding with torpedoes increased from 40 to 47%.
[*]Range of torpedoes and sonar pings increased from 10 to 12.5 km.[/list]
[h3][b]U-2501[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Reload time of torpedo tubes reduced from 85 to 77 seconds.
[*]Maximum damage of torpedoes increased from 7,700 to 8,633.
[*]Chances of causing flooding with torpedoes increased from 41 to 47%.
[*]Range of torpedoes and sonar pings increased from 11 to 14 km.[/list]
[h3][b]Cachalot[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Range of torpedoes and sonar pings reduced from 11.5 to 10 km.[/list]
[h3][b]Salmon[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Range of torpedoes and sonar pings reduced from 12.5 to 11 km.[/list]
[h3][b]Balao[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Range of torpedoes and sonar pings reduced from 14 to 12 km.[/list]
We have also changed the settings for AI-controlled submarines in Co-op and Training Battles. AI-controlled submarines will now be more active in battle. This will help prevent situations where the battle takes too long because players have to find and destroy the last enemy submarine.

The next step in testing submarines is to add them to Random Battles. This will allow us to accurately evaluate their state and gather feedback from a larger number of players. Another important element of testing is to check submarine gameplay in the 12 vs. 12 format, because it has a considerably different battle tempo and density compared to Ranked Battles.

Moreover, adding rental submarines to Random Battles will allow a larger audience to try out the new ship type, get used to playing them, or come up with some tactics to oppose them. When submarines are added to the game on a permanent basis, this will help prevent battle queues being filled with submarines, since they will be mostly selected by players who are interested in the new ship type.

[list][i]You can get submarines to rent for 7 days by completing sequential combat missions that are updated every 2 weeks.[/i][/list]

Offering submarines in this way will help us keep an eye on how many of them are out on our seas and prevent extended queue times. Apart from this, we are going to closely follow submarines in Random Battles, and we will be able to quickly take measures if their presence in Random Battles has an adverse impact on gameplay.

[h2][b][h1=anti-submarine-weapons][/h1]Anti-Submarine Weapons[/b][/h2]
The Depth Charge Airstrike consumable has been added to all Tier V–X cruisers and battleships that don't have anti-submarine weapons, except for hybrids and Dutch cruisers. At the same time, the range of Depth Charge Airstrike has been changed for all battleships that already had this consumable.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c8b8ef7a-251f-11ec-8a91-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
The Depth Charge Airstrike Modification 1 upgrade has been added to the 4th slot of all Tier VI–X cruisers and battleships that already had the Depth Charge Airstrike consumable.

[b]Prepare to dive, and good luck![/b]
