notes.content:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2621105127][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/edf618e13f28b7344ee8f4a39e61e1ce33dc900b.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]Captains![/b]

On the night of October 31 to November 1, the shadows get thicker, and the monsters awaken again. To drive out the darkness, you must become a monster yourself.

[table][tr][th][b][url=#halloween]Halloween[/url] ● [url=#saving-transylvania]Saving Transylvania[/url] ● [url=#sunray-in-the-darkness]Sunray in the Darkness[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=r7ASMW-o8wY;full][/previewyoutube] [img]https://img.youtube.com/vi/r7ASMW-o8wY/maxresdefault.jpg[/img]
Some familiar Operations return. Are you ready to take helms of incredible steel monsters to dispel the darkness?

[h2][b][h1=halloween][/h1]Halloween[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]This year, we are celebrating Halloween in two stages[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The first stage takes place throughout Update 0.10.9. During this period, Operations Saving Transylvania and Sunray in the Darkness will be available.
[*]The second stage starts on the third week of the update and lasts until the release of Update 0.10.10. You will be able to participate in the Twilight Hunt temporary battle type—a reworked version of the Big Hunt that was available during Update 0.10.2.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/61938f86-2514-11ec-addd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
In this article, we are going to remind you about the festive Operations and tell you about the updated rewards. As for the Twilight Hunt, we will talk about it later in a separate article. Stay tuned for more news on our website!

Both Operations will be available as Operations of the Week. Players will also have an opportunity to team up with their friends in a Division and fight the evil at any of the three difficulty levels throughout the entirety of Update 0.10.9!

[list][i]Attention! The first completion of the Operation at the Super Hard difficulty level with three Stars or more will reward brave Captains with a new Jack-o’-Lantern Premium container.[/i][/list]

By completing Operations at every difficulty level, you can earn expendable camouflages, signals, and days of Warships Premium time. The more successfully you fight, the better your reward will be!
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9dc471ea-2510-11ec-9c2c-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][h1=saving-transylvania][/h1]Saving Transylvania[/b][/h2]
Operation Saving Transylvania will be available at Normal difficulty during the first and last weeks of Update 0.10.9 and at Hard difficulty during the second week. You can also complete the Operation as part of a Division throughout Update 0.10.9 at all three difficulty levels, including the Super Hard one.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/56a52922-2523-11ec-a4a2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The main task in this Operation is to escort a ship called [b]Transylvania[/b] on her winding route to a safe place. On the way, you must protect her from the attacks of catapults and [b]Zikasa[/b] ships possessed by the darkness. At the end of this journey, players will face the final boss—the evil and dangerous battleship [b]Rasputin[/b].
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/57154dec-2523-11ec-b62f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
For Operation Saving Transylvania, we will provide players with the following ships manned by Commanders with 21 skill points:
[list][*]Destroyer [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_7f464599e130cf92f9271625063d02d744733b691d8446659f12384e698aaf0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b][b]III[/b] Blade[/b][/b] with Commander Abraham V. Hellsinger
[*]Battleship [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_7f464599e130cf92f9271625063d02d744733b691d8446659f12384e698aaf0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b][b]III[/b] Jackal[/b][/b] with Commander Henry J. Hide
[*]Cruiser [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_7f464599e130cf92f9271625063d02d744733b691d8446659f12384e698aaf0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b][b]III[/b] Igor[/b][/b] with Commander Victor F. Einstein[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b334b402-250d-11ec-bdd1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b3557868-250d-11ec-9ee0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b34931c0-250d-11ec-83a2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0ca9b78e-2514-11ec-9c2c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]

[h3][b]Primary task[/b][/h3]
Escort and protect Transylvania during her escape through the Portal.

[h3][b]Secondary tasks[/b][/h3]
Apart from the primary task, the team can complete five secondary tasks to increase the reward they earn:
[list][*]Transylvania must not lose 50% or more of her HP during the voyage.
[*]Destroy at least 16 Zikasa ships.
[*]Neutralize all catapults on the map.
[*]Transylvania must not stop until reaching the end of the route. To ensure that this condition is completed, at least one player should always remain near the ship.
[*]Sink battleship Rasputin.[/list]

[h2][b][h1=sunray-in-the-darkness][/h1]Sunray in the Darkness[/b][/h2]
When Transylvania and her defenders return to their home realm, they face an even bigger evil. The entire kingdom is at risk! The most advanced ships of the royal fleet are awaiting your orders. Put a stop to the invasion and save the civilians!
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/56b6a486-2523-11ec-99c1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Operation Sunray in the Darkness, which has already become a traditional continuation of Saving Transylvania, will be available to players as the Operation of the Week at Normal and Hard difficulty levels. Take on Operation Sunray in the Darkness to get generous prizes!
[list][*]At Normal difficulty, the Operation will be available during the third week of Update 0.10.9.
[*]Hard difficulty level of the Operation will become available on the fourth week.[/list]
[list][i]Throughout Update 0.10.9, the Operation can also be completed as part of a Division at Normal and Hard difficulty, as well as at Super Hard one.[/i][/list]

The Forces of Darkness are breaking through the Portal. Your mission is to fend off their attacks, but you won't be alone. The security towers will try to seal the Portal, but you will have to protect the towers from enemy ships. Along with monsters, the Filth—a dense fog—is leaking through the Portal and endangering life itself.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/56a6069e-2523-11ec-a1bc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Be careful: While in the Filth, your ship takes damage each second. The amount of damage you receive depends on your ship type. Besides this, visibility and ship detectability decrease significantly in the Filth. At the same time, the Filth benefits your enemies by restoring their hit points and reducing the amount of damage they take. Note that your main task is to protect the towers until they seal the Portal.

Ulibin
[*]Battleship [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_7f464599e130cf92f9271625063d02d744733b691d8446659f12384e698aaf0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Magnu-S[/b][/b] with Commander Klaus V. notes.title: German Battleships: Early Access
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8d2a7c9136075f243aa468c38e37c0f8f33c80ce.jpg[/img]
[b]German Tier III–X battleships have arrived in the Early Access. We're going to tell you everything you need to know to get started with these ships, and most importantly—we're going to reveal how you can get your hands on them.[/b]

[table][tr][th][b][url=#german-battleships-part-1]German Battleships: Part 1[/url] ● [url=german-tokens]German Tokens[/url] ● [url=#free-bundles]Free Bundles[/url] ● [url=#bundles-for-doubloons]Bundles for Doubloons[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b][h1=german-battleships-part-1][/h1]German Battleships: Part 1[/b][/h2]
What are the features of the new branch?
[list][*]While they don't have so many main battery guns, and those guns have a rather short range for this ship type, these battleships come out on top against their peers when it comes to accuracy. The shots you do fire will fly true and hit hard.
[*]Tier VII ships and higher are armed with long-range torpedoes.
[*]Numerous accurate secondary battery guns.
[*]Low detectability.
[*]Starting from Tier VI—a variant of the Hydroacoustic Search consumable that's similar to the type that German cruisers are equipped with.
[*]A variant of the Fast Damage Control Team consumable that differs from the standard Damage Control Party by having a reduced cooldown time and limited number of charges.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ae8e58c8-21d8-11ec-a2d7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/adac764c-21d8-11ec-9ab9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ad168b96-21d8-11ec-ade5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ad2b76fa-21d8-11ec-9322-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ad151aae-21d8-11ec-9ab7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/adaf2a36-21d8-11ec-bf48-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ae8d4294-21d8-11ec-a00d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ae907ea0-21d8-11ec-a5e7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Things to Know About Early Access[/h2]
[b]German Tokens[/b] are a new temporary resource that you can obtain by participating in our new Personal Challenges temporary event, from free daily bundles, and from bundles available in exchange for Doubloons and Community Tokens in the Armory.

[b]Rewards for German Tokens[/b]: sequentially available bundles with new German Tier III–IX battleships; the German Eagle permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Prinz Rupprecht[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Schlieffen[/b][/b]; the German Navy permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Prinz Heinrich[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Zieten[/b][/b]; the "German Battleships: Part 1" commemorative flag; and other items.

Early Access to [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Schlieffen[/b][/b], together with a Port slot and 10-skill point Commander, will be one of the lots at the upcoming Lighthouse auction. The starting bid is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,000[/b] Doubloons; in total, 1,000 lots will be auctioned.

The Lighthouse auction will be held from October 7 through 11. You'll find details about the auction's rules, the lots, their quantity, and the starting bids in a dedicated article that's scheduled to be published on our website later this week.

The Hamburg Port has been updated to celebrate the arrival of the German battleships in Early Access.

[list]When Update 0.10.11 goes live, the German battleships will become available for all players to research[/list]
We come bearing gifts! Stay on the lookout for Community Tokens in this and other articles on our website! You can use these to obtain various items from the Armory. Make sure to keep up to date with the news, and be sure to share the articles with your friends so they can also enjoy claiming gifts!

[/tr][tr][th][h3]EU[/h3][/th][th][h3][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/german-battleships-early-access/#button style=button][b]Claim Tokens[/b][/url][/h3][/th]
[/tr][tr][th][h3]NA[/h3][/th][th][h3][url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/general-news/german-battleships-early-access/#button style=button][b]Claim Tokens[/b][/url][/h3][/th][/tr][/table]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]You can claim your gift before:[/b] [b]Tue. 26 Oct. 15:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[list][i]Watch our official streams and participate in the Public Test and other activities to earn Community Tokens. In total, you'll be able to find up to 1,510 Community Tokens on our website before the end of Update 0.10.9.[/i][/list]

[h2=german-tokens][b]German Tokens[/b][/h2]
German Tokens can be obtained:
[list][*]By participating in Personal Challenges—up to [b]2,550[/b] Tokens.
[*]From free random bundles in the Armory—up to [b]100[/b] Tokens.
[*]In exchange for Community Tokens in the Armory—up to [b]600[/b] Tokens.
[*]From random bundles available in exchange for Doubloons in the Armory—up to [b]6,000[/b] Tokens.[/list]
Tokens that you can earn by participating in Personal Challenges will be enough to obtain German Tier III–VII battleships and the German Navy permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Prinz Heinrich[/b][/b].

[list][i]With the release of Update 0.10.11, German Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]4,500[/b].[/i][/list]

[h2]Rewards for Tokens[/h2]
You can exchange German Tokens for sequentially available bundles and other rewards in the Armory.

[h2]Sequentially Available Bundles[/h2]
[list][i]The ships come with all of their modules researched.[/i][/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9eb2fd22-252b-11ec-93fb-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]If you already have [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b][b]IV[/b] Moltke[/b][/b] in your Port, you will receive [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]1,300,000[/b] Credits as compensation, as well as a Port slot and Commander with 3 skill points.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=free-bundles][/h1]Free Bundles[/b][/h2]
The Armory will offer free random bundles—Ocean Raiders Trophies. Within them, you'll find German Tokens, Doubloons, 1 day of Premium Account, and other rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]The bundles will be available until:[/b] [b]Thu. 11 Nov. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[list][i]You can obtain only one bundle per day. A total of 15 bundles will be available, so you can skip more than 2 weeks and still be able to collect all the rewards.[/i][/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9e3ee360-252b-11ec-963b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][h1=bundles-for-doubloons][/h1]Bundles for Doubloons[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]The bundles will be available until:[/b] [b]Thu. 09 Dec. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

The German Battleships section of the Armory will feature special bundles, such as "In the Shipyards of Lower Saxony," "From the Docks of Schleswig-Holstein," "In the Ports of East Prussia," and "On the Stocks of Pomerania." Each bundle costs [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]500[/b] Doubloons. Within them, you can find German Tokens, "Black-White-Red" expendable camouflages, and special signals.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9e64f140-252b-11ec-8413-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Moreover, the Armory will offer you Support for Battle Fleet daily random bundles at the cost of [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]150[/b] Doubloons each. They can drop days of Warships Premium Account, expendable camouflages, Coal, Free XP, and combat signals.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]The bundles will be available until:[/b] [b]Thu. 11 Nov. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9e45cc3e-252b-11ec-929f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]You can purchase only one bundle per day.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=submarines-in-random-battles][/h1]Submarines in Random Battles[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9f09bdea-21db-11ec-9546-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Submarines have been present in Ranked and Co-op battles for almost 2 months now, and we're extremely grateful for the battles you've played, as well as your feedback. By participating and telling us your opinions, you helped us determine what the next steps in submarine development are going to be.

We've planned a number of future changes for the new ship type, based on the data we collected and player feedback. First, we're going to add anti-submarine weapons on all Tier V–X cruisers and battleships in Update 0.10.9, except for Dutch cruisers and hybrids.

We're aware that adding anti-submarine weapons on a large number of ships can have a significant impact on the effectiveness of submarines, so we've made a number of balance changes to the new ship type:
[list][*]We've changed the characteristics of torpedoes—submarines now have tube-by-tube torpedo-launching capabilities. Tube-by-tube torpedo launching will allow for more dynamic gameplay and also allow better control over the number of torpedoes launched during an attack. To encourage submarine Captains to use sonar pings for better accuracy, the width of the torpedo launch sector has been increased
[*]German submarines were weaker compared to American submarines in terms of damage they were able to deal. To make them even in terms of this parameter, we've increased the maximum damage and the chances of causing flooding of torpedoes launched by German submarines.
[*]The torpedo tubes of German submarines are mostly located in their fore ends, which is great for attacking from longer distances. To shift German submarine gameplay toward long-range combat, we increased the range of their torpedoes.
[*]American submarines, in their turn, can be quite effective in short- and medium-range battles, because their torpedo tubes are located in both their bows and sterns. To encourage American submarine Captains to embrace this style of combat, the range of American submarines' torpedoes has been reduced.
[*]Reduced dive capacity depletion if the submarine is detected. The increase of dive capacity depletion in Update 0.10.8 significantly affected how comfortable it was to play submarines, and it also impacted their effectiveness. To make the detection of submarines impact their gameplay less, we've reduced the dive capacity depletion rates when submarines are detected.[/list]
Check out a detailed list of changes in a dedicated article on our website.

We’ve also changed the submarine settings in Co-op and Training battles. Now, submarines controlled by AI will take part in battles more actively. This change will prevent situations where the battle went on for far too long due to the process of searching for and destroying the last enemy submarine.

The next step in testing submarines is to add them to Random Battles. This will allow us to properly evaluate their state and gather feedback from a larger number of players.

[list][i]For this reason, rental submarines will become temporarily available in Random Battles during Update 0.10.9.[/i][/list]

Offering submarines in this way will help us keep an eye on how many of them are out on our seas and prevent extended queue times. We are going to keep a close eye on submarines in Random Battles, and we are able to take measures if their presence in Random Battles has an adverse impact on gameplay.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7abd4d54-1d0c-11ec-91f6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7b176c8a-1d0c-11ec-aa74-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1908f09c-21f1-11ec-b000-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/18cc1c58-21f1-11ec-a5d0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]Tech Tree Changes[/h2]
In early 2022, [b] [b][b]X[/b] Khabarovsk[/b][/b] and [b] [b][b]X[/b] Grosser Kurfürst[/b][/b] are going to receive the status of "special" ships and leave the branch. They'll be replaced with [b]Delny [/b]and [b]Preussen[/b], which better match other ships from the branch in terms of progression and gameplay.

Any players who own a permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Khabarovsk[/b][/b] or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Grosser Kurfürst[/b][/b] at the time when the ships are removed from the Tech Tree will receive the Type 20 permanent camouflage for Delny or Preussen, respectively.

Any players who had a permanent camouflage for [b] [b][b]X[/b] Moskva[/b][/b] on their accounts at the time when Update 0.9.5 was released will receive the Type 20 permanent camouflage for [b] [b][b]X[/b] Alexander Nevsky[/b][/b] within a week of Update 0.10.9 going live. Those who already have the Type 20 permanent camouflage will receive [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]5,000[/b] Doubloons as compensation.
[list][i]Details about the new ships, as well as details about the upcoming changes, can be found in a dedicated article on our website.[/i][/list]

[h2]Armory[/h2]
The "Naval Community" section will have several changes. Premium Ship V and Premium Ship VII containers, as well as the Restless Fire commemorative flag, will no longer be available for purchase.

The following ships will be available to purchase with Community Tokens:
[list][*][b] [b][b]IV[/b] Ishizuchi[/b][/b] for  10,000 Community Tokens.
[*][b] [b][b]V[/b] Exeter[/b][/b] for  15,000 Community Tokens.
[*][b] [b][b]VII[/b] Leningrad[/b][/b] for  20,000 Community Tokens.[/list]
[list]The ships are credited with a Port slot and Commander with 3 skill points.[/list]
Apart from that, a bundle with a Supercontainer will become permanently available for [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_recruitment_points_e30ec137465b5e672aa3cd633442824abc4884652e65c8bc443767fafdd18fd6.png[/img] 6,000 Community Tokens and without any purchase restrictions in the "Naval Community" section.

[h2][b][h1=other-changes-and-improvements][/h1]Other Changes and Improvements[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/a0b735f0-21db-11ec-a00d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Upgrade Changes[/h2]
[h3][b]Anti-Submarine Aircraft Modification 1 upgrade (4th slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Renamed Airstrike Modification 1.
[*]Added for all Tier V–X battleships, researchable Tier V–X Dutch cruisers, and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_dd3112a12284f158a1e9d283ac7fa46d3beaa3d8698e70d99f28f6ade0286941.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] De Zeven Provinciën[/b][/b].[/list]
[h2]Technical changes of ship armor[/h2]
Changed the code that processed ship armor.

The update will allow for better interactions between shells and armor due to a more accurate calculation of the position of the shell in the ship's hull. For example, these changes allow us to avoid situations where a ship receives damage from penetration and overpenetration of the same shell at the same time. They also make it impossible to penetrate a ship's armor through various decorative elements on the deck.

The way in which the parts of a ship's armor are displayed will also change—it will be more detailed and uniform.
[list][i]The transfer of ships to the new armor system will take effect gradually, starting from Update 0.10.10.[/i][/list]
[h2]Other Changes and Improvements[/h2]
[list][*]Added the option to rent a Commander, similar to ship rental.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the shell ballistics of [b] [b][b]IX[/b] Missouri[/b][/b] to be calculated incorrectly in some cases.
[*]Fixed an error that caused torpedo range not to be shown in the characteristics of torpedo bombers in the Port.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the Airstrike bomb penetration value to be incorrectly displayed for [b] [b][b]X[/b] Gouden Leeuw[/b][/b].
Fixed an error that caused the Survivability Expert skill to increase aircraft HP by an incorrect value.
[*]Other Improvements and Changes. For a complete list, please refer to [url=https://eu.wargaming.net/support/products/wows/article/33375/]Player Support[/url].[/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/8d5ac391d5e1a896bce3e468f29333669cf106cb.jpg[/img]
[b]Commanders! We've been thinking about what birthday gifts to give you, our players, for quite some time, and our bright idea is finally being brought to life![/b]

Every year, you'll receive a gift in the game on the occasion of your birthday. What gift? Just have a look:

[table][tr][th][b][url=#how-to-start-receiving-gifts]How to Start Receiving Gifts?[/url] ● [url=#receiving-gifts]Receiving Gifts[/url] ● [url=#more-about-the-coupon]More About the Coupon[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b][h1=how-to-start-receiving-gifts][/h1]How to Start Receiving Gifts?[/b][/h2]
To start receiving birthday gifts in the game, you need to:
[list][*]Specify your date of birth on the Account Management page (otherwise, how can we know, right?).
[*]Link your account to your email address and confirm it (important for Steam users).
[*]Give us permission to send you letters with presents to your specified email address.
[*]Have at least one battle played in the last 365 days.[/list]
[list][i]Please note: You can change the date of your birthday on the Account Management page once every 365 days.[/i][/list]
[h2][b][h1=receiving-gifts][/h1]Receiving Gifts[/b][/h2]
If all the requirements are met, you'll receive a congratulation letter on your birthday every year! To claim your gift, simply enter the game within a period of 7 days after your specified date of birth.
[list][i]Congratulatory letters can be sent only once a day. It can happen on the next day from the date you've set before in case you've changed it recently.[/i][/list]
[h2][b][h1=more-about-the-coupon][/h1]More About the Coupon[/b][/h2]
[list][*]Your birthday coupon will give you [b]100%[/b] cashback in Doubloons when purchasing an item in the Premium Shop. In other words, when you use this coupon to make a purchase, you'll receive both the purchased item and an amount of Doubloons that's equal to the cost of this item.
[*]The maximum cashback amount provided by the coupon is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]50,000[/b] Doubloons. There are almost no items that cost more than this in the Premium Shop.
[*]You can use this coupon only once, and you must use it within 7 days of receiving it.
[*]You can't transfer the coupon to another player or use it to purchase a gift for someone else.
[*]The coupons have expiry dates. Each birthday coupon must be used within 7 days of receiving it.[/list]
[list][i]Please note: Each coupon can be applied to a single item, not to the entire cart.[/i][/list]

notes.title: Three Days of Premium Account as a Gift!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3b0ecd1ad60168951ec16ffd2578dff17a48c74d.jpg[/img]

Captains!

As you already know, Update 0.10.8 went live with several bugs, and the most annoying of them was the torpedo bug that appeared as a result of fixing an error that caused torpedoes to change trajectory if a ship was moving in a circle while launching torpedoes. You can read more about the situation [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/213]here[/url]. 

We apologize for these issues. Fortunately, our team has already found solutions to these problems. The full details are available on our Development Blog. Thank you for your constructive feedback—it allowed us to quickly identify the existing problems and start to solve them.

We are giving all players 3 days of Warships Premium Account, and we hope you have a good time in the game!

Please claim your gift on your region’s World of Warships portal before October 5th 13:00 (UTC). If you are not sure what region you are playing on, press ESC in your Port and check the upper left corner.
[list][*][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/3-days-of-premium-account]EU[/url]
[*] [url=https://worldofwarships.ru/news/general-news/3-days-of-premium-account]CIS [/url]
[*] [url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/general-news/3-days-of-premium-account]NA [/url]
[*] [url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/general-news/3-days-of-premium-account]SEA [/url] [/list]
Wargaming authentication is required.

If you do not have a WG account yet, please complete your registration in-game. More on this:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/4174225702959905780
For the registration you will receive:
[list]
[*]3x Steam containers
[*]250 doubloons
[*]1 day of Warships Premium Account
[/list]
With a registered account you can also use all of the website features (bonus codes, gifts, coupons, etc.), and also link your account to Twitch to receive Twitch drops.

Action stations!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2b34a49959b124f9874d3cf227d556ac1e3ae0e1.jpg[/img]

[b]Commanders![/b]

You'll be happy to hear that we've made it much simpler to participate in the Public Test—you can now log in using your main account. To do so, select [b]Public Test[/b] in the [b]Game Instance[/b] section of Wargaming Game Center.

The epic "German Battleships: Part 1" event, challenging Asymmetric Battles, spooky Twilight Hunt, and other new features await you! Take a look at the [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/bulletin-0109/]Developer Bulletin[/url], and welcome to the Test! See you on the Public Test Server!

[url=https://forum.worldofwarships.eu/forum/485-public-test/ style=button]Leave Feedback[/url]


[h2]Round 2 Schedule[/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts: [/b] [b]Thu. 23 Sep. 18:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends: [/b] [b]Tue. 28 Sep. 07:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

Сommanders, thank you for participating in the Public Test for Update 0.10.9! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and to fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Added the Depth Charge Airstrike armament for most Tier V-X cruisers and battleships that had no ASW armament. Balance changes were also made to submarines. More details are available in our [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/214]Development Blog[/url].
[*]Balance changes to german battleships, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/premium_4516ee494bb0396e51796cebff5e45c3f448d9790e0a58082057b8949ed9a3f8.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Béarn[/b][/b], and other test ships were made. More details you can find [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/215]here[/url].

notes.title: Naval History in Photos: Crossing the Line
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5e6fc6bbcda64900a35a7486ab0834cc6e2ad087.jpg[/img]

[b]The sailors of different navies have different line-crossing ceremonies. Together with the U.S. Naval Institute, we've prepared a selection of photos depicting crew rituals that have taken place when crossing the zero-degree latitude.[/b]


[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3c199fdc-19ea-11ec-bf20-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
The line-crossing ceremony is an initiation rite in various navies that commemorates a sailor's first crossing of the Equator. The tradition may have originated with ceremonies when passing headlands and become a "folly" sanctioned as a boost to morale. Sailors who have already crossed the Equator are nicknamed Shellbacks, Trusty Shellbacks, Honorable Shellbacks, or Sons of Neptune. Those who have not crossed are nicknamed Pollywogs, or Slimy Pollywogs.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3c2e0e5e-19ea-11ec-8e24-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
World cruise of the US Navy, 1907–09. Crossing the Equator. Sailors wading in water aboard a ship.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3c19f00e-19ea-11ec-9e77-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
The "Royal Court" passes judgement during Shellback initiation as USS Rochester (CA-124) crossed the Equator.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3ca63050-19ea-11ec-a4e1-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Neptune party aboard destroyer tender USS Black Hawk (AD-9) when crossing the Equator en route to the Dutch East Indies.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3ca620a6-19ea-11ec-8750-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
A Marine Corps officer undergoes the electric treatment during "Shellback" initiation ceremonies for "Pollywogs" as a transport bearing Marines to the South Pacific crosses the Equator.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3c0996b4-19ea-11ec-8714-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Murray Wiener, Asst. Physician, crosses the Equator, but not before submitting to having the "Southern Cross" clipped across his chest, a ducking and other "tortures"; Ship's baker, Jack Gambole, washes the victim's mouth under Dr. Alfred B. Geyer's guidance.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3c7b2a90-19ea-11ec-b504-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Crew members of USS Libra (AKA-12) perform a line-crossing ceremony.

[list]All photos are courtesy of the [b]U.S. Naval Institute Photo Archive[/b]. Looking for more thrilling shots related to naval history? Check the photo archive online [url=https://photos.usni.org/]here[/url].[/list]

notes.title: Convoy: Defend or Destroy!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7d4686a11a570f5bc01fcfb92ff1a767c276994b.jpg[/img]

[b]Captains![/b]

Defending or destroying maritime shipping routes has always been one of the most important tasks of any navy, because large quantities of military equipment, fuel, and other strategically important cargo are often transported across the seas. Intercepting merchant and cargo ships was the primary objective of numerous raiders, and warring parties had to maintain considerable naval forces to protect their trade routes.

Update 0.10.8 invites you to participate in a new temporary battle type inspired by this historical practice—Convoy—in which you'll need to either defend or destroy cargo ships.

[table][tr][th][b][url=#rules]Rules[/url] ● [url=#achievements]Achievements[/url] ● [url=#combat-missions]Combat Missions[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=CB6ZiX1RfjI;full][/previewyoutube] 
[h2][b][h1=rules][/h1]Rules[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Thu. 23 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Thu. 07 Oct. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[h3][b]Format[/b][/h3]
7 vs. 7, playing Tier VIII ships.

[h3][b]Restrictions[/b][/h3]
No more than one aircraft carrier and three battleships per team.

[h3][b]Maps[/b][/h3]
The Atlantic, Islands of Ice, Warrior's Path, Loop, and Labyrinth.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0d555c9c-16c8-11ec-b12f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0cecb4ee-16c8-11ec-aab3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0da29778-16c8-11ec-b302-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0da4d63c-16c8-11ec-8c71-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0ce863d0-16c8-11ec-b890-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
Two teams participate in each battle—one is tasked with escorting cargo ships, and the other is tasked with attacking them. Players are randomly distributed among the two teams. You can enter each battle either alone or as part of a Division.

The defending team needs to escort a convoy of four AI-controlled cargo ships as they sail along a defined route. The defending team wins if at least one of the convoy ships reaches the destination point or the entire enemy team is destroyed. The mission of the attacking team is to completely destroy either the convoy or its defenders.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d104acc4-1600-11ec-b1f3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d1a83664-1600-11ec-8834-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d1026d4c-1600-11ec-814f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d0ff5ddc-1600-11ec-8e5f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d1a5dda6-1600-11ec-825d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d0e7ef94-1600-11ec-9603-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d0f395d8-1600-11ec-9201-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
On average, it takes the convoy between 10 and 12 minutes to complete the route. The convoy's route is visible to both teams on the Minimap. Moreover, at the beginning of each battle, the escorting team will see the position of the attacking ships on the Minimap, while the attacking team will only see the position of the transport ships themselves.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/870fa65a-1600-11ec-9201-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/87221d80-1600-11ec-b1f3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/870c0e8c-1600-11ec-8834-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
The convoy consists of four Liberty-class transport ships. They have little HP and weak armor, but they can deploy smoke screens, as well as change speed and maneuver to dodge enemy torpedoes.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/cd07445e-16f2-11ec-89c4-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

[h2][b][h1=achievements][/h1]Achievements[/b][/h2]
Your successes in Convoy will be rewarded with special themed achievements:
[table][tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/08b64626-1603-11ec-8bd7-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][b]Living Shield[/b][/td] [td]Receive two torpedo hits from the enemy while being within a 2-kilometer radius of an allied transport.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/08b88620-1603-11ec-a7ff-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][b]Neat Job[/b][/td] [td]Win by destroying all the transports and without losing any allied ships. At the same time, the damage caused by you should be more than 50% of the standard HP of your ship.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/08b59d5c-1603-11ec-ba28-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][b]Safe Route[/b][/td] [td]Win a battle and save all transports. At the same time, the damage caused by you should be more than 50% of the standard HP of your ship.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/08b53380-1603-11ec-888f-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][b]Nerves of Steel[/b][/td] [td]Win and survive in a battle when the enemy has twice the number of warships. At the same time, the damage caused by you should be more than 50% of the standard HP of your ship. Can be completed while playing for any team.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/08b60d64-1603-11ec-814f-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img][/td] [td][b]Raider[/b][/td] [td]Destroy two transports in a single battle.[/td][/tr][/table]
[list][i]Due to the specifics of the battle type, you can only earn these achievements in Convoy.[/i][/list]
[h2][b][h1=combat-missions][/h1]Combat Missions[/b][/h2]
You will also have access to combat missions that can be completed only in Convoy. Win and earn Base XP to obtain Community Tokens. During the first week, you'll also have access to a special mission chain that can be completed in Convoy playing cruisers; in the second week, you'll get another mission chain that can be completed playing destroyers. These chains will earn you Credits and More Resources containers.

[list][i]Detailed information about the mission completion criteria can be found in the game client.[/i][/list]

To celebrate the Sixth Anniversary of World of Warships, we offer you a chance to experience the most memorable moments of the past year once again. The "6 Years of World of Warships" collection looks like a big jigsaw puzzle and comprises 60 elements. The collection elements only drop from "6 years of World of Warships" special containers. You can obtain these:
[list][*]By completing a special combat mission chain.
[*]By participating in the new Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry temporary event.
[*]In exchange for Festive Tokens.[/list]

notes.title: Announcing Community Tokens: A Unified Currency for Community Activity
notes.content:
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6879d15c-c93e-11eb-8429-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Captains![/b][/h3]
A new permanent tab will find its home in the Armory with the release of Update 0.10.5. Under it, you’ll be able to obtain exclusive rewards in exchange for a new currency—[b]Community Tokens[/b]. These Tokens will not only functionally replace Recruitment Points, they will also become a major reward for participants of World of Warships activities outside of the game itself.

[h2][b][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/community-tokens/][/url]Concept[/b][/h2]
With the introduction of Community Tokens, we aim to both streamline the system of collecting rewards and diversify the content that can be earned by participating in community activities, including—but not limited to—the [url=https://wo.ws/2EUYquO]Recruiting Station[/url], [url=https://wo.ws/3pC00rg]Public Test[/url], [url=https://wo.ws/3pIYTq4]Twitch Drops[/url], sponsored tournaments, and live meetups.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ac5c4b06-c93f-11eb-8d99-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]
Earned Community Tokens will accumulate on your account like any other in-game currency. You’ll be able to spend them at any time in the new “[b]Naval Community[/b]” permanent tab, which is going to appear in the Armory with the release of Update 0.10.5.

[list][i]The main advantage of this reward system over the previous ones is that it enables you to choose the loot that suits you personally instead of receiving fixed rewards.[/i][/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ac1f1466-c93f-11eb-b619-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][h1=rewards][/h1]Community Rewards[/b][/h2]
The “[b]Naval Community[/b]” Armory tab will be stocked with a sizeable amount of in-game content that can be obtained in exchange for Community Tokens. At launch, you’ll be able to purchase a number of rare ship customizations, containers, and even a Premium ship! The pool of available rewards may be partially refreshed from time to time, but some items, such as Recruiting Station containers, will be a constant fixture.

With the release of Update 0.10.5, the following rewards will be available for Community Tokens:

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/fde7804f2a1111900d11ac112ad2a0337b3b821d.jpg[/img]
[b]Early Access to the new ship branch, plus a new temporary event![/b]

[table][tr][th][b][url=#soviet-aircraft-carriers]Soviet Aircraft Carriers[/url] ● [url=#about-early-access]Things to Know About Early Access[/url] ● [url=#aircraft-bureaus-rivalry]Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b][h1=soviet-aircraft-carriers][/h1]Soviet Aircraft Carriers[/b][/h2]
Soviet aircraft carriers [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b][b]IV[/b] Komsomolets[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Serov[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Pobeda[/b][/b] arrive in Early Access.

[h3][b]What are the features of the new branch?[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Small number of aircraft in squadrons. Squadrons consist of a single flight that carries out one powerful attack with all aircraft at once.
[*]Starting from Tier VIII, aircraft are equipped with jet boosters. As with [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Ise[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Tone[/b][/b], the boosters kick in automatically during takeoff and provide a short-term increase in speed. You can jettison the boosters by pressing the [b]S[/b] key.
[*]Small HP pools and low cruising speeds.
[*]Soviet aircraft carriers carry skip bombers instead of standard bombers. The skip bombers are armed with HE bombs.
[*]The torpedo bombers are armed with torpedoes that have a long range and take longer to arm.
[*]Starting from Tier VI, attack aircraft squadrons are armed with powerful HE rockets that are similar to the American "Tiny Tims."[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ac4587ac-0c99-11ec-a571-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ac3d7a30-0c99-11ec-9041-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ac371a64-0c99-11ec-b46c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][i]When Update 0.10.10 goes live, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b][b]IV[/b] Komsomolets[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Serov[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Pobeda[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Admiral Nakhimov[/b][/b] will be available for all players to research.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=about-early-access][/h1]Things to Know About Early Access[/b][/h2]
[h2]Soviet Tokens[/h2]
[img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_7_33722423c774d6b0ffcc70c576e7538971637aefc907ec76bc1fabfef7d674bf.png[/img] [b]Soviet Tokens[/b] are a new temporary resource that can be obtained:
[list][*]By participating in the Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry event—up to [b]1,500[/b] Tokens.
[*]From free random bundles—up to [b]100[/b] Tokens.
[*]From random bundles that are available in exchange for Doubloons—up to [b]2,600[/b] Tokens.
[*]In exchange for Community Tokens in the Armory—up to [b]200[/b] Tokens.[/list]
[h2]Rewards for Soviet Tokens[/h2]
You can exchange Soviet Tokens for sequentially available bundles that include Soviet aircraft carriers [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b][b]IV[/b] Komsomolets[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Serov[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Pobeda[/b][/b] along with the Forward Bound permanent camouflages for these ships, as well as for other rewards in the Armory.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/888f8286-0c9e-11ec-acfb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b][b]IV[/b] Komsomolets[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Serov[/b][/b], and permanent camouflages for Tier IV, VI, and VIII carriers can be obtained for free. The sum of Tokens that can be earned in the Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry event and received from free daily bundles will be sufficient to achieve that.

[list][i]With the release of Update 0.10.10, Soviet Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]6,000[/b].[/i][/list]

[h3][b]Sequentially Available Bundles[/b][/h3] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7d7d4ae8-0efd-11ec-ac3f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Other Rewards[/b][/h3] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7d74ed30-0efd-11ec-9a83-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Random Bundles[/b][/h3]
The Armory is offering free random bundles—Regular Supplies. Within them, you'll find Soviet Tokens, [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Warships Premium Account[/b], Doubloons, and other rewards.

[list]The bundles will remain available until the end of Update 0.10.8.[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7d75726e-0efd-11ec-ac5e-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]You can obtain only one bundle per day. A total of 12 bundles will be available, so you can skip more than 2 weeks and still be able to collect all the rewards.[/i][/list]

[h3][b]Random bundles for Doubloons[/b][/h3] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7dff5056-0efd-11ec-a92b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Random bundles that can each be obtained for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,000[/b] Doubloons have been added to the Soviet Aircraft Carriers section of the Armory. They can drop the Forward Bound permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Admiral Nakhimov[/b][/b]; Soviet Tokens; special signals; and expendable camouflages such as Victory, Spring Sky, Mosaic, and Asian Lantern.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7e0767e6-0efd-11ec-b3c4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][h1=aircraft-bureaus-rivalry][/h1]Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry[/b][/h2]
A new temporary event awaits you in Update 0.10.8—Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry. It's based on the history of Soviet naval aviation development and various research and development bureaus that worked on machines for the Soviet Navy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Thu. 09 Sep. 09:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Thu. 07 Oct. 03:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry is similar to the Battle of the Beasts event that took place in Update 0.10.4 but with small changes. The event has three teams instead of four, and a special pop-up window will remind you about the start of each new stage. The Port now displays your personal progress to the next reward instead of team progress. We've also updated the interface of the team selection screen and the window that displays personal and team progress.

A window displaying the event description and unique rewards for each team has been added to the team selection screen. It also shows which team you have selected for the previous stages and if you have unique team rewards. Unique rewards—team patches—are awarded for your personal progress, not for team progress. You can earn unique rewards even if your team hasn't reached the necessary progress milestone. If you haven't made any progress on specific missions, they will not be displayed on the mission screen.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9951d5f8-0efe-11ec-a344-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/994cf9b6-0efe-11ec-a663-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9975e0a6-0efe-11ec-ac5e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/99bbfe6a-0efe-11ec-ac3f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3e585ff0-0c92-11ec-8dc7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Rules of the Event[/h2]
The event runs until the release of Update 0.10.9 and is divided into four stages. Each stage lasts 1 week. Before starting each stage, you can choose one of three teams:

[h3][i]The Polikarpov Bureau Team[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ab475124-0eff-11ec-9cb7-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]
Nikolai Polikarpov was known as the "King of Fighters" because Soviet aces flew only his machines until the beginning of the 1940s. Moreover, the Polikarpov Experimental Design Bureau created the first attack aircraft for the Red Army Air Force.
[/expand]
[h3][i]The Chetverikov Bureau Team[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/aae444bc-0eff-11ec-ac3f-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]
Igor Chetverikov developed a successful series of long-range naval scouts. It was his Experimental Design Bureau that was tasked with creating a carrier-based torpedo bomber for the Soviet Navy Air Force, and the task was successfully completed.
[/expand]
[h3][i]The Kocherigin Bureau Team[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/aae6c192-0eff-11ec-9107-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]
Sergey Kocherigin worked on a number of original fighters and scouts, but he achieved his greatest successes designing bombers.
[/expand]
During the day, event participants will receive special missions that can be completed in Random, Co-op, and Ranked Battles, as well as in the new temporary battle type—Convoy. Convoy will become available 2 weeks after the release of the update.

[list][i]Completing missions will advance you through personal and team progress bars and unlock rewards. Your personal and team progress is reset to zero at the beginning of each new stage. All players who have reached Access Level 8 can participate in the event.[/i][/list]

[h2]Missions[/h2]
Three mission types, with a limited allotted time for each mission, will be available to you each day. Missions are assigned sequentially at specific times throughout the day—once every 40 minutes. There are 25 missions in total. Each mission should be completed within 120 minutes. The only exceptions are the last missions of the day—the time for counting the results of these missions is extended by 20 minutes.

After a mission expires, the next mission of the same type becomes available. Battles that end after a mission expires are counted towards the next mission. More details are available in the game client.

[h2]Personal and Team Progress[/h2]
Completing the missions will earn you Points for both personal and team progress. When you reach certain personal and team milestones, you'll receive rewards:
[list][*]The reward for reaching each stage of personal progress is credited immediately.
[*]The reward for team progress is credited if your personal progress is equal to or higher than the team progress.[/list]
During the week, you can obtain up to 10 rewards: five for personal progress and five for team progress. To obtain all 10 rewards during the week, you need to earn 1,500 Personal Progress Points and 150,000 Team Progress Points.

[h2]Earning Points[/h2]
Each mission has four completion marks. Reaching each mark will earn you 20 Points. A total of 80 Points can be earned per mission. If you complete a mission with high efficiency, you’ll receive from 10 to 25 additional Points, as well as see your position in the overall player standings.

The results are summed up when each mission expires, and the teams take their places in the overall team standings. A team is awarded 700; 900; or 1,200 Points per mission, based on its position in the team standings. The position in the overall standings, in turn, depends on the activity of the members of each team.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b7e1a82-0eff-11ec-b3c4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b7ba5d6-0eff-11ec-ac3f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b69d2b6-0eff-11ec-ac5e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b6721ba-0eff-11ec-a344-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]Rewards[/h2]
Containers of the "6 Years of World of Warships" collection, Victory camouflages, Coal, Soviet Tokens, and themed patches with the team insignias.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7dc2fb60-0efd-11ec-a663-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
You can collect all the patches by selecting a new team each week.
[list][i]If you already have a team patch, then when you select the same team again and reach the necessary personal progress milestone, you'll receive compensation of [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]15,000[/b] Credits instead of the patch.[/i][/list]

World of Warships: 6th Anniversary! We've prepared lots of new things for you in Update 0.10.8 to celebrate the event:
[list][*]The World of Warships Anniversary celebration, special battle performance bonuses, a themed collection, and much more!
[*]Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry event
[*]Dutch cruisers leaving Early Access
[*]Early Access to Soviet aircraft carriers
[*]Convoy—a new temporary battle type![/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#wows-anniversary]World of Warships Anniversary[/url] ● [url=#dutch-cruisers]Dutch Cruisers[/url] ● [url=#soviet-aircraft-carriers]Soviet Aircraft Carriers[/url] ● [url=#aircraft-bureaus-rivalry]Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry[/url] ● [url=#convoy]Convoy[/url] ● [url=#armory]Armory[/url] ● [url=#conten-additions-and-changes]Content Additions and Changes[/url] ● [url=#other-changes-and-improvements]Other Changes and Improvements[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[list]Read through this article carefully and keep your eyes peeled for a gift! Share the article with your friends and Clanmates so they can arm themselves with all the essential info for this update![/list]
[h2][b][h1=wows-anniversary][/h1]World of Warships Anniversary[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/1962da5e-0c7e-11ec-809a-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Festive Rewards[/h2]
In Update 0.10.8, you can earn festive battle performance bonuses on all of your Tier V and higher ships. Win a battle or earn 300 Base XP to receive Supercontainers, a new temporary resource called [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_6_16266bfe10c9894a55b2a77a7945ff1688ccdd935f462d4788f4ae693c233078.png[/img] [b]Festive Tokens[/b], and Gift containers:
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5acab0a4-0bf5-11ec-8001-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list]Battle Performance Bonuses will be available
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]from:[/b] [b]Fri. 17 Sep. 14:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]to:[/b] [b]Thu. 04 Nov. 14:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d867076c-0c98-11ec-b46c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d8720e96-0c98-11ec-9c86-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d8651088-0c98-11ec-ad3b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]The bonus for each ship can be earned only once in battles of any type, except for Training Battles.[/i][/list]

In a special section of the Armory, Festive Tokens can be exchanged for containers of the "6 Years of World of Warships" collection; "6 Years of World of Warships" permanent camouflages for [b] [b][b]VII[/b] Lyon[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]VII[/b] Yorck[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]VII[/b] Shchors[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]VII[/b] Gadjah Mada[/b][/b], [b] [b][b]VII[/b] Akatsuki[/b][/b], and [b] [b][b]VII[/b] Zara[/b][/b]; Gift and Distant Voyages containers; and World of Warships Anniversary expendable camouflages. The rewards section will be available from September 17, before Update 0.10.10 is released.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6d8fb63c-0c89-11ec-b59e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Each Gift container holds 5x special signals of the same type (Dragon, Red Dragon, Wyvern, Ouroboros, Hydra, Basilisk, Scylla, or Leviathan).

[list][i]You can only earn Festive Tokens from battle performance bonuses. With the release of Update 0.10.10, Festive Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]90,000[/b].[/i][/list]

[h2]The "6 Years of World of Warships" Collection[/h2]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/04e3d61c-0c99-11ec-ad3b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/04eacee0-0c99-11ec-b46c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/04f2e684-0c99-11ec-9c86-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
We're also celebrating our Anniversary with the "6 Years of World of Warships" collection, which is dedicated to the most notable events that happened in the game over the past year. The collection looks like a big jigsaw puzzle with 60 elements in it. The collection elements only drop from "6 years of World of Warships" special containers. You can obtain these:
[list][*]By completing a special combat mission chain that will become available on September 17.
[*]By participating in the new temporary Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry event.
[*]In exchange for Festive Tokens.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/978ae61a-0c88-11ec-9041-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b][h1=convoy][/h1]Convoy[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5affd64e-0bf5-11ec-81fc-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Update 0.10.8 brings players an opportunity to participate in a new temporary battle type—Convoy—which focuses on escorting (or sinking) transport ships. Historically, defending or disrupting cargo routes has been one of the key tasks of fleets: a timely supply of military equipment, ammunition, and provisions has always played a tremendous role in the success of combat actions.

[h2]Rules[/h2]
[list][*]The defending team is tasked with escorting a convoy of four bot ships as they sail along a defined route. The defending team wins if at least one of the convoy ships reaches the destination point or the entire attacking team is destroyed.
[*]The mission of the attacking team is to completely destroy either the convoy or its defenders.
[*]Players are randomly distributed among the two teams. You can either play solo or as a member of the Division. 
[*]On average, it takes the convoy between 10 and 12 minutes to complete the route.
[*]Format: 7 vs. 7, playing Tier VIII ships Restrictions: No more than one aircraft carrier and three battleships per team
[*]Battles will take place on the following maps: The Atlantic, Islands of Ice, Warrior's Path, Loop, and Labyrinth.[/list]
