notes.title: World of Warships' Team Shout-Out to Game Community
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9197197b860e7801c03b7e1ff64fddd7d75320b3.jpg[/img]
[b]Dear players,[/b]
 
Lately a lot of you have been upset with various incidents, our decisions, as well as a general state of things in the game and community. Before we continue, we want to apologize to all of you, players, content creators, moderators, testers, and other volunteers, to those who support us and those disappointed with us. Everything that happens within the game and the community is our responsibility, and we are sorry that we let the situation come to its current state.
 
We want to take this opportunity to be more transparent about how we will take actions to improve our internal processes and our relationship with you. It will be a long read, you will see items of different scales and with different times required to see results. No doubt more news and announcements will follow, so please don't treat this as a final plan and the ultimate solution to everything. Instead, please treat it as a list of things we're currently working on and a way to show our intentions to make the game and community a better place. Also, please note that it is not comprehensive, as many other measures are revolving around internal processes.
 
[h2][b]Monetization[/b][/h2] 
World of Warships is a free-to-play title following the game-as-a-service concept with substantial monthly updates and a constant evolutionary cycle. To support this model we rely on a multitude of monetization tactics considered to be standard practice in the industry. While we believe it's unreasonable to expect to discuss our monetization strategies in all but the most general terms — this is business-critical information — we do understand that there are specific details that are a cause of concern for some of you. We will address them as best we can below. 
[list][*][b]Random mechanics. [/b]As a business, we always follow laws and comply with new regulations as they appear. Therefore, our position on containers and random bundles is always consistent with governments' decisions on this matter and will keep being so. In some cases, we will even try to work ahead of industry practices. We are aware that there are slowly progressing trends to regulate the digital space more and more, to catch up with technical solutions and business models built on them. With that in mind, we appreciate your feedback and commit to the following: from now on for all new ships, if they are distributed via Containers or Random Bundles, there will be an alternative way to obtain them. Methods may vary and may include timegating (i.e. early access or time delayed offers), direct purchases, completing in-game activities, etc. 
[*][b]Drop rates.[/b] We plan to publish all drop rates for all Containers and Random Bundles, and are already working on it. It will take some time, but our hard commitment is that it will happen over the course of next year. 
[*][b]Return of Missouri. [/b]The initial concept of the event was perceived negatively, and we should have known better. The case was a learned lesson for us and we added an alternative way to purchase the ship. We're also addressing the situation with the ship's earnings to make sure that those who owned Missouri before 0.10.7 will on average receive not less credits than before the changes to the ship's economics. We're grateful for the battles you played, these helped us to collect sufficient data. This amount of data allows us to add a +10% bonus to the special Missouri combat mission (from 20% to 30%). Additionally, we will issue appropriate amount of credits to all the affected players as a sign of appreciation; details will be published in Devblog separately. 
[*][b]Summer Sale. [/b]Unfortunately, we made a translation mistake in a sensitive description. We fixed it ASAP and to protect you from such mistakes in the future, we will add additional checks and approvals to our internal processes. If anything like that happens again, we will offer refunds to all of the affected players. We did it before and we will do it again to make sure that you are compensated. We will also pay more attention to the positioning of such events: for example, many of you stated the term "Sale" suggests direct discounts on in-game items. 
[*][b]Age ratings.[/b] We've already added disclaimers about in-game purchases with random items to our PEGI ratings. We're also in touch with other rating organizations to adjust our ratings everywhere in a consistent way. While our game was never popular among minors and we adhere to legislation in all countries where we publish World of Warships, we plan to go beyond what is required of us by laws and we are working on our own in-game measures to additionally protect children who interact with our game. We will share more details on this point once we're ready to announce them.[/list] 
[h2][b]Feedback[/b][/h2] 
One of the main topics we want to address is how your feedback influences the game. Regrettably, it was not always clear how we use certain types of feedback and where it fits into our decision-making process. We've always taken it into account, but looking back, we see that in some cases it was not balanced well enough against other equally important sources of information: large volumes of data and the team's creative vision of the game. We want to change this situation and make sure we pay more direct attention to your suggestions and opinions while also giving you more insight into how the decisions are made. Things we are considering and evaluating right now: 
[list][*][b]More reaction to feedback on ships balance.[/b] We know there are several ships you want to be addressed, and we'd like to confirm: balance changes are planned for Zao, Petropavlovsk, and FDR in 0.10.10. Moving forward we will try to increase the promptness of addressing released ships in a similar way and when it is not possible (for example, changing a ship will move it out of the interval of normal performance), we will put more effort into giving you insights and explaining our reasoning. 
[*][b]Aircraft Carriers.[/b] Despite many other things happening in the game, we haven't forgotten that there are still questions to be answered regarding CVs. We've implemented a lot of changes to this class since the rework, but we acknowledge more changes may be needed. CV spotting is a good example — we conducted several tests before and did not find a good, adequate way to address it. That does not mean we will not continue to improve it. It's not something that can be done quickly, please keep that in mind. Another common question is regarding odd-tier carriers, which were previously mentioned as "support CVs". Right now they are in an early prototyping stage (developing document concepts), and we want to honestly tell you that they are not to be expected in 2022. 
[*][b]New gameplay experiences.[/b] We will keep evolving the game by introducing new game modes and mechanics, both fiction- and history-based. For example, in 0.10.8 we will have a new mode — Convoys — inspired by historical events. We will keep exploring new game modes in the future, — it's one of our priorities. Expanding permanent types of battles (primarily Random battles) with new modes is also one of the long-term goals to keep the game fresh and entertaining. However creating a mode suitable not just for a short gaming period, but for a permanent presence with high replayability is a much bigger challenge, so it takes many more tries and effort. 
[*][b]Maps.[/b] We've slowed down with adding new maps to the game recently because the team focused more on the game's visuals in general (updated visual effects, new water, and other improvements) as well as introducing a whole new level of underwater world. That said, in 2022 at least one new map will be released, and another one has some chances to make it in time. Spoiler: we're also going to try a new mechanic with the first of these new maps not previously used in the game. 
[*][b]Operations.[/b] CV rework rendered a lot of AI-related internal tools obsolete and made working with AI-aircraft-related stuff very difficult or impossible. Right now we're in the process of removing this obstacle. It's being worked on for many reasons, not just for the sake of Operations, but one of the benefits we will have when this project is done is that we will be able to return some of the old Operations in 2022. 
[*][b]Other. [/b]There are plenty of other things we know you're interested in, and quite a lot of them are being worked on in different stages of development. We haven't forgotten about things such as secondary builds for cruisers, the update of some old ship models, Tier IV CV tuning, Huron (coming 2022), West Virginia'44 (coming 2023), addressing the chat system, improvements for Ranked Battles, and many other small and not so small changes to the game that will make your experience with it better.[/list] 
[h2][b]Communications[/b][/h2] 
We are a large, distributed team of over 500 people working across more than 4 countries. Coming from all walks of life, culturally varied and hindered severely by the pandemic from travelling to see each other in person to be able to align on certain matters, we are bound to have organizational challenges in the realm of communication. However, these internal challenges should not be visible, much less influence the player experience. Improving communications is a never-ending process which needs to be evolutionary and not revolutionary, so you will see those improvements incrementally over time in many areas, rather than as a one-time institutional overnight change. But we want to address a few specific points you pointed out in this area. 
[list][*][b]Community Contributor Program. [/b]When we created our CCTP, our goal was to help talented folks interested in our game create content and grow their channels. Right now it's clear that a lot of things in the Program do not work as they should, which leads to frustration and failed expectations even though some other parts are running well. We will update the Program, both in terms of rules and the way we work with it internally. We expect to have some sort of internal plan and first action points ready in the second half of September, and then proceed with the changes during this Autumn. 
[*][b]Future of the game. [/b]We'd like to offer you a deeper look into the future of the game. Right now we have Devblogs (where we basically announce everything that comes to Supertest) and the Waterline series (quarterly updates). To complement these and expand the horizon of events, we want to share a general roadmap with you, of what you can expect to see in World of Warships in the far future. It will give you an idea of what we want to focus on — but please keep in mind that things can and will change. At the same time, we want to show the progress World of Warships achieves. The game evolves a lot each year and it will make it easier for you to follow what we are doing. 
[*][b]Communications quality.[/b] There have been a lot of communication mistakes and incidents on our side recently. While mistakes always happen and we're all human, we acknowledge that we need to improve in this area. We've already launched a full internal review of all related processes. We want fewer mistakes and translation errors, more answers, and productive conversations. We want to improve the way you interact with us in any place, be it Forums, Customer support, Discord servers or official streams. 
[*][b]General transparency. [/b]We need to work hard on it: on the one hand, we need to pay more attention to the community sentiment, on the other hand, we have to be more transparent and explain our positions. We will create a series of publications to make our development process more transparent and to show the logic behind what we do. For example, players did not understand why the latest torpedo bug took 2 updates to fix, while a CV bug (plane losses in 0.9.9) was fixed almost instantly. They are in fact very different: the CV bug was fixed by quickly adjusting some parameters, while the torpedo bug involved game logic, and even though it was technically fixed within a week, it had to go through all regular quality assurance processes. Deploying such change through a hotfix is extremely risky for the game. This should have been communicated transparently and we will do our best to do so in the future. 
[*][b]In-depth communications and insights. [/b]When it's necessary we will use more specifics and will provide deeper explanations of our decisions. For example, we implemented the system for CvC ship bans, which helps us to keep the meta fresh, and we want to tell you more about how and why we use it, as it's something that our hardcore players are interested in.[/list] 
All of it is just our current, first plan. We will keep looking for other points of interest and challenges. We want to show you our responsibility, care and desire for the game by the way we communicate and through our actions — to make the game better for everyone.
 
A final word on passion and communication. While we are working hard to improve the way we communicate and interact with you, we want to take a moment to address your passion and the way that we communicate with each other. We know that you care about the game a great deal and ask you to remember that there are people — community managers, support staff, developers and volunteers — that read your communications and posts, wherever they may be made. While we as a company certainly need to work on the way we communicate with you, we ask that you treat the people you interact with fairly and with respect. Your voice will carry as much — or more — weight with them if you present your feedback and opinions in a reasoned and constructive way.
  
[i]Yours sincerely,[/i]
 
[i]Victor Bardovsky, Publishing Director[/i]
 
[i]Andrey Lisak, Development Director[/i]
 
[i]World of Warships Team[/i]

notes.title: Web Campaign: The Pacific War
notes.content:
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/campaign-map/ style=button][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/760dfda382e7ed6814599d2c4be6084c67cdbd53.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]Captains![/b]

The first stage of the Pacific War web campaign opens today. You'll have a chance to immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the greatest naval battles and choose your own path through the Pacific theater of World War II on a special map.
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e3f60bc8-05b3-11ec-8275-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/campaign-map/ style=button]To the Campaign Map[/url]

[table][tr][th][b][url=#rewards]Rewards[/url] ● [url=#how-it-works]How it works[/url] ● [url=#return-of-missouri]Return of Missouri[/url] ● [url=#pacific-tokens]Pacific Tokens[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b][h1=rewards][/h1]Rewards[/b][/h2]
Completing the combat mission chains of the web campaign will reward you with Pacific Tokens, commemorative flags of the key naval battles of World War II, the "Strength for Freedom" unique patch, special signals, themed camouflage patterns, and other rewards.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ddc1755a-05b1-11ec-ac8b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list]After you have completed all seven stages of the campaign, a bundle containing [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Missouri[/b][/b] with a Port slot will be available to you in the Premium Shop. In addition, after completing the campaign you can also purchase Missouri for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]19,500[/b] doubloons by contacting our [url=https://eu.wargaming.net/support/products/wows/]Support[/url] team.[/list]
[list][i]You can only obtain the "Strength for Freedom" unique patch as the final reward for completing the last stage of the Pacific War campaign.[/i][/list]
Completing all the campaign stages will reward you with 1,750 Pacific Tokens. You can exchange these Tokens in a special section of the Armory for either a 12-skill-point Commander of any of eight nations or a Premium Ship II–IV container from sequentially available bundles that also hold other rewards. You can read more about how Pacific Tokens can be spent [url=#pacific-tokens]here[/url].
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/dd809c88-05b1-11ec-ab52-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]You can obtain Pacific Tokens only by completing the stages of the Pacific War campaign or from random bundles in the Armory.[/i][/list]
[h2][b][h1=how-it-works][/h1]How it works[/b][/h2]
[list][b]At different stages of the campaign, you will have to make choices that determine the conditions of the combat mission chains that you receive—sometimes their difficulty, the location of the battles, and even the side you will fight for. Make your choices consciously, but also keep in mind that luck and circumstances also play significant roles in war.[/b][/list]
The campaign consists of seven stages—real-life battles that changed the course of the Pacific War. By selecting a corresponding marker on the map, you can view the assignment instructions—a brief description of the event, its circumstances, and the outcome, as well as find out who your character will be in this battle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]The campaign stages can be completed until:[/b] [b]Wed. 15 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e5832268-0681-11ec-8b83-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Once you start progressing through a stage, you can read the main character's memoirs and get a preset combat mission chain to complete, or you can assemble a chain on your own by making decisions step by step based on a specific situation that your character tells you about. Your actions will define the map of the campaign, the combat mission conditions to fulfill, and the reward for their completion.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f890212e-05b1-11ec-83e3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]You can only complete the missions in Ranked, Random, and Co-op Battles. All other conditions will be revealed when you receive the combat mission chain and make key decisions in combat environments. You can also read them under a special tab in the game client.[/i][/list]
You'll progress through the first three stages as Japanese deck aviation and naval officers. For the fourth stage, you'll be able to choose between the U.S. and Japanese Navies, the fifth stage will give you a chance to show your worth on both sides of the conflict, and the heroes of the sixth and seventh stages are the U.S. ship Commanders.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f81de1a4-05b1-11ec-94d4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list]Some stages of the Pacific War campaign are accompanied by historical photographs of the described events. All battle photos are courtesy of the [b]U.S. Naval Institute[/b] Photo Archive. Looking for more thrilling shots related to naval history? Check the photo archive online [url=https://photos.usni.org/]here[/url].[/list]
Every 2 days, a new campaign stage will be unlocked. The first one is available now—set sail to the shores of Malaysia or prowl the waters of the Pacific Ocean. Make your choice, but keep in mind that your decision is permanent. Complete the unlocked combat mission chains and earn rewards!

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/campaign-map/ style=button]To the Campaign Map[/url]

[h2][b][h1=return-of-missouri][/h1]Return of Missouri[/b][/h2]
The Japanese Instrument of Surrender was signed aboard U.S. battleship Missouri on September 2, 1945. This was the event that officially put an end to World War II. The legendary ship is now back!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]The bundles will be available for purchase until:[/b] [b]Fri. 17 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[h2]Random Bundles[/h2]
Random bundles are now available in the Armory. They hold [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Missouri[/b][/b] with a Port slot, Pacific Tokens, special signals of different types, and Stars 'n' Stripes camouflages.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b86e1f38-05b1-11ec-ac8b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Missouri[/b][/b] is an American Iowa-class battleship and one of the fastest ships of this type in her time. Missouri carries nine powerful 406 mm main battery guns, boasts great AA defenses, and has access to the Surveillance Radar consumable, which is rare for battleships.
[list][i]The number of credits [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Missouri[/b][/b] earns is standard for Tier IX Premium ships.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=pacific-tokens][/h1]Pacific Tokens[/b][/h2]
By completing the stages of the Pacific War web campaign and obtaining random bundles of the Return of Missouri event, you'll obtain [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_5_bed91acc3961e87dacadd6c5519deadf0432c73fb8a43ac97136ddeed284a579.png[/img] [b]Pacific Tokens[/b]—a new temporary resource that can be exchanged for rewards in the Armory.
[list][i]With the release of Update 0.10.9, Pacific Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]3,000[/b].[/i][/list]

notes.title: Public Test of Update 0.10.8: Round 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38188069/1e16ea670055ebff5ca8b6f3860499f92bdd6664.jpg[/img]
[b]Captains, we invite you to take part in the Public Test of Update 0.10.8—you can earn Community Tokens for your participation![/b]

Earn Community Tokens and exchange them for Tier V and Tier VII Premium Ship containers, rare permanent camouflages, and other items. All details about Community Tokens are available [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/community-tokens/]in a dedicated article[/url].

The Soviet Aircraft Carriers event, the sixth anniversary of World of Warships, and other new features await you. Make sure to read the [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/bulletin-0108/]Developer Bulletin[/url], and see you on the Public Test server!

[b]End: [/b] [b]Tue. 31 Aug. 07:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

Сommanders, thank you for participating in the Public Test for Update 0.10.8! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and to fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Balance changes made to German and Soviet aircraft carriers, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Franklin D. Roosevelt[/b][/b] and several other ships. Further details can be found in our Development Blog of [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/194]24 August[/url] and [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/197]26 August[/url];
[*]Fixed several issues and changed the background on the queue screen in the Convoys battle type;
[*]Fixed an issue which caused the Grand battle icon to be displayed instead of the Convoys icon in combat mission descriptions;
[*]Fixed an issue which caused the "impossible to hit the target" icon to be displayed above ships which can be hit by deepwater torpedoes;
[*]Fixed an issue which caused the sound of ASW armament reloading to be played in Random battles on ships with ASW armament;
[*]Fixed an issue which caused ships on the "Neighbors" map to be stuck near one of the islands;
[*]Fixed an issue which caused bonuses to ship detectability to be displayed incorrectly on some of the upgrades;
[*]Fixed several other issues.[/list]
[h2]Combat Missions and Rewards[/h2]
[list][*]The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.
[*]The rewards are automatically credited to your account within a few days after the release of a new version.[/list]
[list][i]You can earn Community Tokens for completing combat missions on the Public Test Server.[/i][/list]

[h2]Starting Bonuses[/h2]
[list][*]The research prices for ships and ship modules will be substantially discounted.
[*]Players will be able to reset Commander skills free of charge.[/list]
If you joined the Public Test Server for the first time, then, starting with Update 0.10.7, the following bonuses will be additionally credited to your account:
[list][*]At the start of the Public Test, every participant will have all researchable Tier VI and VIII ships, helmed by Commanders with 19 skill points, credited to their PT accounts.
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]500,000,000[/b] Credits; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]30,000[/b] Doubloons; and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]90 days of Warships Premium Account[/b].

[b]Captains, we invite you to take part in the Public Test of Update 0.10.8—you can earn Community Tokens for your participation![/b]

It's now much simpler to take part in the Public Test—now you can log in using your main account. To do so, select [b]Public Test[/b] in the [b]Game Instance[/b] section of Wargaming Game Center.

Earn Community Tokens and exchange them for Tier V and Tier VII Premium Ship containers, rare permanent camouflages, and other items. All details about Community Tokens are available [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/community-tokens/]in a dedicated article[/url].

The Soviet Aircraft Carriers event, the sixth anniversary of World of Warships, and other new features await you. Make sure to read the [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/bulletin-0108/]Developer Bulletin[/url], and see you on the Public Test server!

If you joined the Public Test Server for the first time, then, starting with Update 0.10.7, the following bonuses will be additionally credited to your account:
[list][*]At the start of the Public Test, every participant will have all researchable Tier VI and VIII ships, helmed by Commanders with 19 skill points, credited to their PT accounts.
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]500,000,000[/b] Credits; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]30,000[/b] Doubloons; and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]90 days of Warships Premium Account[/b].
[*]50 signals of all types (except for special signals) will also be added to your PT account.[/list]
[list]If you fought at least one battle on the Public Test Server during the 0.10.7 Public Test, your account will be copied from the Live Server to the Public Test Server.[/list]
[h2]How to Participate[/h2]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2716184589232191867

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9d2174ffca142e4a81f7050ab3781eaa21ff28f9.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]Developer Bulletin for Update 0.10.8[/b][/h1]
[list][b][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.[/b][/list]

[list][i]Please note: The rewards for activities on the Public Test server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/i][/list]

[table][tr][th][b][url=#wows-anniversary]World of Warships Anniversary[/url] ● [url=#dutch-cruisers]Dutch Cruisers[/url] ● [url=#aircraft-bureaus-rivalry]Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry[/url] ● [url=#soviet-aircraft-carriers]Soviet Aircraft Carriers[/url] ● [url=#convoy]Convoy[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b][h1=wows-anniversary][/h1]World of Warships Anniversary[/b][/h2]
In Update 0.10.8, World of Warships is celebrating its sixth anniversary! In honor of this event, we've prepared various activities for our players.

[h2]The "6 Years of World of Warships" Collection[/h2]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/53ad0d7a-fe90-11eb-97ba-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/53bd6120-fe90-11eb-b3c4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/53be8032-fe90-11eb-b353-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
The main treat for the anniversary is the "6 Years of World of Warships" collection dedicated to the most notable events that happened in the game over the past year. The collection looks like a big puzzle with 60 elements in it. You can obtain them only from "6 years of World of Warships" special containers. The containers are available:
[list][*]In the Armory, in exchange for a new temporary resource—Festive Tokens.
[*]For completing a special combat mission chain.
[*]In the new temporary Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry event.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fe688d9e-fe76-11eb-9d6f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The reward for completing the collection will be a Supercontainer, 6x Gift containers, and the "6 Years of World of Warships" festive flag. The exchange rate for duplicates is 1:1.

Apart from the "6 Years of World of Warships" containers, Festive Tokens can be exchanged in the Armory for themed "6 Years of World of Warships" permanent camouflages for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Lyon[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Yorck[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Shchors[/b][/b], [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Gadjah Mada[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Akatsuki[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img] Voyages containers; and World of Warships Anniversary expendable camouflages.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fe872844-fe76-11eb-864d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
In one of the future updates, the "6 Years of World of Warships" containers will be added to the Armory and be available in exchange for Coal.

[h2]Festive Rewards[/h2]
In Update 0.10.8, you can earn the familiar Snowflakes—festive bonuses for combat results of all your Tier V ships and higher. Depending on ship tier and type, you can obtain Supercontainers, Gift containers, and Festive Tokens.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9592808a-fe90-11eb-97ba-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/958a9992-fe90-11eb-a364-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/953a2c28-fe90-11eb-ba49-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
The bonus for combat results is the only way to earn Festive Tokens.

[list][i]With the release of Update 0.10.10, Festive Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]90,000[/b].[/i][/list]

The Designer's Table Port was considerably updated in honor of the celebration.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c4415c76-fe90-11eb-97ba-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c4444d8c-fe90-11eb-b353-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3bc0300-fe90-11eb-a364-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3c92aee-fe90-11eb-9e0f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2][b][h1=dutch-cruisers][/h1]Dutch Cruisers[/b][/h2]
When Update 0.10.8 goes live, Dutch Tier I–X cruisers will become available for all players to research.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/491f414c-fe78-11eb-83a3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4b4ea2f0-fe78-11eb-8ffd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/497e847c-fe78-11eb-8ffd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/498b6c00-fe78-11eb-bc89-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/48fe578e-fe78-11eb-bbb6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4b288e62-fe78-11eb-bbb6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/499b0f52-fe78-11eb-ba14-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/498afcfc-fe78-11eb-bdca-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4998b3a6-fe78-11eb-ab5a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4911cd0a-fe78-11eb-972c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2][b][h1=aircraft-bureaus-rivalry][/h1]Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry[/b][/h2]
The update brings a new temporary event called Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry. It is based on the history of the naval aviation development and various experimental design bureaus that worked on new machines for the Navy.

Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry is similar to the Battle of the Beasts event that took place in Update 0.10.4 with the following changes:

[h3][b]The main changes compared to the Battle of the Beasts[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Three teams instead of four.
[*]Unique rewards—team patches—will be awarded for personal progress and not for team progress. This way, players will be able to obtain unique rewards even if their team doesn't reach the necessary progress point.
[*]Updated interface of team selection window, as well as the personal and team progress window.
[*]Your personal progress until the next reward is now displayed in the Port instead of your team's progress.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/03c194aa-fe7e-11eb-91d5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Rules of the Event[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The event will run until the release of Update 0.10.9 and is divided into four stages. Each stage lasts one week.
[*]Once per week, you can select one of the three teams: Polikarpov Bureau, Chetverikov Bureau, or Kocherigin Bureau.
[*]During the event, you need to complete your personal missions issued daily to all participants. They can be completed during the day in Random, Co-op, and Ranked Battles, as well as in the new temporary battle type—Convoy.
[*]Completing missions will advance you through personal and team progress bars and unlock rewards.
[*]Rewards: 6 Years of World of Warships containers, themed patches, Victory camouflages, Coal, and Soviet Tokens.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fefa9b0c-fe90-11eb-97ba-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/feeeaa86-fe90-11eb-b3c4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/feda2584-fe90-11eb-9e0f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2][b][h1=soviet-aircraft-carriers][/h1]Soviet Aircraft Carriers[/b][/h2]
Update 0.10.8 brings Early Access to Soviet aircraft carriers [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b][b]IV[/b] Komsomolets[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Serov[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Pobeda[/b][/b].

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/25c31782-fe91-11eb-ba49-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/264bca5a-fe91-11eb-9e0f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/25bb709a-fe91-11eb-97ba-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]Features of the Branch[/h2]
[list][*]Squadrons consist of one flight, which carries out one powerful attack with all aircraft at once.
[*]Small number of aircraft in squadrons.
[*]Starting from Tier VIII, aircraft are equipped rocket boosters. As with [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Ise[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Tone[/b][/b], the boosters kick in automatically during take-off and provide a short-time increase in speed.
[*]Small HP pool and low cruising speed of all aircraft.
[*]All aircraft carriers are equipped with skip bombers armed with HE bombs instead of standard bombers.
[*]Torpedo bombers' torpedoes have long range and arming distance.
[*]Starting with Tier VI, attack aircraft squadrons are armed with HE rockets similar to the American Tiny Tim.[/list]
[h2]Soviet Tokens[/h2]
A new temporary resource which can be obtained:
[list][*]By participating in the Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry event
[*]From free daily bundles
[*]From random bundles available for Doubloons
[*]For Community Tokens in the Armory[/list]
[h3][b]Rewards for Soviet Tokens[/b][/h3]
Sequentially available bundles with [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b][b]IV[/b] Komsomolets[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Serov[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Pobeda[/b][/b], as well as the Forward Bound permanent camouflage for Tier IV, VI, and VIII Soviet aircraft carriers, and other rewards.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/26474af2-fe91-11eb-a364-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The Tokens that you earn by participating in the Aircraft Bureaus Rivalry and opening free daily bundles will be enough to obtain [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b][b]IV[/b] Komsomolets[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Serov[/b][/b], and permanent camouflages for Tier IV, VI, and VIII aircraft carriers.

The random bundles available for Doubloons can drop the Forward Bound permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Admiral Nakhimov[/b][/b], Soviet Tokens, Victory expendable camouflages, and other rewards.

[list][i]With the release of Update 0.10.10, Soviet Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]6,000[/b].[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=convoy][/h1]Convoy[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Start:[/b] [b]Thu. 23 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]End:[/b] [b]Thu. 07 Oct. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

In Update 0.10.8, players will have an opportunity to play in a new temporary battle type—Convoy—based on escorting transport ships. In real life, a large part of confrontation between navies consisted of defending or destroying cargo lanes because they played a crucial role during wars.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5027ef2a-fe91-11eb-a364-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Rules[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The defending team needs to escort a convoy of four bot ships that sail along a defined route. The team wins if at least one of the convoy ships reaches the destination point or the entire enemy team is destroyed.
[*]The mission of the attacking team is to completely destroy either the convoy or its defenders.
[*]Players are distributed among teams randomly.
[*]On average, the Convoy needs between 10 and 12 minutes to complete their route.
[*]Format: 7 vs. 7 playing Tier VIII ships. Restrictions: No more than one aircraft carrier and three battleships per team.
[*]Battles will be held on maps such as The Atlantic, Islands of Ice, Land of Fire, Warrior's Path, Loop, Haven, Northern Waters, and Labyrinth.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/507c8d96-fe91-11eb-9e0f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/503775ee-fe91-11eb-97ba-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/50803126-fe91-11eb-a193-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/50a00028-fe91-11eb-8bbd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][i]While the Convoy is available, you can complete special combat missions only for this battle type, which will bring you Community Tokens. Detailed requirements of these combat missions can be found in the game client.[/i][/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1e8f8323909fba883cd4a0bf24eeed1130c56b56.jpg[/img]
[b]Captains![/b]

Clan Battles Season 14—"Piranha"—kicks off during Update 0.10.7. Clan Battles offer an excellent opportunity to show off your skills in World of Warships. It's not only the results of individual battles that are important here, but also general progress. Fight alongside your Clanmates and rise to the top!

Win Clan Battles to earn valuable rewards such as Steel, Coal, camouflages, special signals, Clan Tokens, and much more. The more victories you achieve, the more rewards you'll earn.

[table][tr][th][b][url=#rules]Rules[/url] ● [url=#rewards]Rewards[/url] ● [url=#treasury]Clan Treasury[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b][h1=rules][/h1]Rules[/b][/h2] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/d46ef088-faba-11eb-85eb-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Format[/b][/h3]
Tier VI ships, 7 vs. 7.

[h3][b]Maps[/b][/h3]
Hotspot, Sleeping Giant, Neighbors, Trident, Northern Waters, Crash Zone Alpha, and Big Race, in the Domination mode.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/47efd37a-fab0-11eb-9263-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/47391568-fab0-11eb-85c3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/473ed3ea-fab0-11eb-b6da-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/47e8cbc0-fab0-11eb-b856-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/473f938e-fab0-11eb-97cc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/47e183ce-fab0-11eb-abf9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/47e6a12e-fab0-11eb-9389-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
The following rules apply for all maps:
[list][*]Number of Key Areas: 3
[*]Capture time: 30 seconds
[*]Scoring of capture points: 3 points every 4 seconds[/list]
[list][i]On the days of any update releases, Clan Battles are held only during the Prime Time of your server.[/i][/list]

[h2]Restrictions on Ship Numbers[/h2]
Just like in Season 13, certain restrictions on the numbers of specific ships per team apply in Clan Battles.

The restrictions can be set for the entire duration of a season or for specific periods of time. For example, they could be set after the first 2 weeks of a season, then replaced with different restrictions a few weeks later. This allows us to promptly react to the current state of the season.

[h3][b]Season 14 begins with the following restrictions:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]No more than two aircraft carriers or battleships (or a combination of both) per team in total.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Admiral Graf Spee[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] HSF Admiral Graf Spee[/b][/b] will not be accessible in Clan Battles.
[*]No more than three mercenaries per Division.[/list]
[list][i]During the season, based on statistics, new restrictions may be added, and existing restrictions may be changed.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=rewards][/h1]Rewards[/b][/h2] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/a67c620c-faae-11eb-a304-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]Detailed information on the completion criteria and rewards can be found in the game client.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=treasury][/h1]Clan Treasury[/b][/h2]
Clans with Ranks 1–50 in the Global Rating will receive from [b]5,000[/b] to [b]25,000[/b] Steel.

notes.title: The Rotterdam Dockyard: Construction of De Zeven Provinciёn
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2573069640][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3b638e3820749071120c6e633a5687dd9ff4220f.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]In Update 0.10.7, you will be able to start building a new Dutch cruiser—De Zeven Provinciën.[/b]

[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] De Zeven Provinciën[/b][/b] is the lead ship of her series. She was laid down before the outbreak of World War II and completed in the 1950s under a revised project. De Zeven Provinciën was acquired by Peru in the second half of the 20th century, and it was only in September 2017 that the last ship of this series was decommissioned. The ships of this class were the last artillery cruisers in service.

[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] De Zeven Provinciën[/b][/b] is armed with eight dual-purpose 152 mm guns housed in four turrets. The ship is equipped with the Repair Party and Engine Boost consumables, as well as the Airstrike armament. The ship's guns have a medium firing range and high rate of fire. She is able to quickly change flanks and take up advantageous positions thanks to her Engine Boost consumable.

[table][tr][th][b][url=#rules]Rules of the Event[/url] ● [url=#rewards]Rewards[/url] ● [url=#missions]Combat Missions[/url] ● [url=#completing-construction]Completing Construction of the Ship[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=M04PWG831aI;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b][h1=rules][/h1]Rules of the Event[/b][/h2]
[list][*]The construction process at the Dockyard comprises 24 phases.
[*]These shipbuilding phases can be progressed through by completing Dockyard combat missions, or by spending [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,500[/b] Doubloons to pass through each phase.
[*]If you want to complete shipbuilding phases at a discount, you can purchase Starter Packs: nine shipbuilding phases in exchange for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]8,950[/b] Doubloons and three shipbuilding phases in exchange for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]3,950[/b] Doubloons.
[*]The Dockyard combat missions span two updates—0.10.7 and 0.10.8. You will be able to complete shipbuilding phases in exchange for Doubloons until the end of Update 0.10.9.
[*]In total, you can progress through 21 out of 24 shipbuilding phases by completing Dockyard combat missions.
[*]Completing shipbuilding phases will reward you with a container with a Tier V Premium ship, Steel, Coal, Free XP, Elite Commander XP, days of Premium Account, Distant Voyages containers, and other rewards.
[*]Upon completing the 24th shipbuilding phase, you'll receive [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] De Zeven Provinciën[/b][/b] in the War Paint camouflage, a Commander with 10 skill points, a Port slot, and a commemorative flag.[/list]
[list][i]If you complete the construction of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] De Zeven Provinciën[/b][/b] by spending Doubloons, make sure to keep progressing through the Dockyard combat missions—completing each phase will bring you [b]250[/b] Steel.[/i][/list]

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/79518aec-f9b3-11eb-98e4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7955da20-f9b3-11eb-a054-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/79677afa-f9b3-11eb-8df5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2][b][h1=rewards][/h1]Rewards[/b][/h2]
By progressing through the combat mission groups, you can complete 21 out of 24 shipbuilding phases and obtain the corresponding rewards at the Dockyard.

By finishing the first two combat mission groups, you can complete up to six shipbuilding phases and obtain the following rewards:
[list][*]10x Flying Dutchman camouflages
[*]2x Gift containers
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Premium Account[/b]
[*]1x Distant Voyages container that can drop one of 236 permanent camouflages; Summer, World of Warships Anniversary, or Cartographic expendable camouflages; or special signals.[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/f7d5ad44-f9b3-11eb-a054-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Finishing five out of seven combat mission groups will progress you through up to 15 shipbuilding phases and reward you with:
[list][*]15x Flying Dutchman camouflages
[*]2x Gift containers
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]4 days of Premium Account[/b]
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]10,000[/b] Free XP
[*]10x each of the following special signals: Wyvern, Dragon, Scylla, Leviathan, and Hydra
[*]1x Distant Voyages container
[*]1x Premium Ship V container[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/f8085a96-f9b3-11eb-a123-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Completing all the combat mission groups will progress you through 21 shipbuilding phases and reward you with:
[list][*]15x Flying Dutchman camouflages
[*]2x Gift containers
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]4 days of Premium Account[/b]
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]10,000[/b] Free XP
[*]10x each of the following special signals: Ouroboros, Wyvern, Dragon, Scylla, Leviathan, Hydra, Basilisk, and Red Dragon
[*][b]50,000[/b] Elite Commander XP
[*]4x Distant Voyages containers
[*]1x Premium Ship V container[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/f8000e2c-f9b3-11eb-aa44-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][h1=missions][/h1]Combat Missions[/b][/h2]
The new game event tasks you with completing 63 combat missions spread across seven groups. The first group will become available with the release of Update 0.10.7, while those that follow will be unlocked on a weekly basis.

Completing each of the groups will progress you through three shipbuilding phases—two for accomplishing missions and one for finishing the group.

[list][i]The Dockyard combat missions will remain available until the release of Update 0.10.9. Detailed information about the mission completion criteria can be found in the game client.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=completing-construction][/h1]Completing Construction of the Ship[/b][/h2]
In order to complete phases 22–24, in addition to progressing through all the combat mission groups, you'll need to spend Doubloons to finish any three shipbuilding phases.
[list][*]The reward for completing the 22nd shipbuilding phase is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]10,000[/b] Coal.
[*]The 23rd phase—[b]1,000[/b] Steel.
[*]Upon completing the 24th shipbuilding phase, you'll receive [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] De Zeven Provinciën[/b][/b] in the War Paint camouflage, a Port slot, a Commander with 10 skill points, and a commemorative flag.[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/f7e848c8-f9b3-11eb-846d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
If you want to complete shipbuilding phases at a discount, two Starter Packs are available to purchase:
[list][*]Nine shipbuilding phases for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]8,950[/b] Doubloons
[*]Three shipbuilding phases for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]3,950[/b] Doubloons[/list]
However, these packs will only be available to purchase prior to the point in time when you complete three shipbuilding phases by finishing combat missions. Once you've purchased both Starter Packs or completed three shipbuilding phases by finishing combat missions, you'll be able to purchase further phases individually for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,500[/b] Doubloons each.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7b533670-f9b2-11eb-aae8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1bfc407c-f9b2-11eb-a556-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1c37fba8-f9b2-11eb-8df5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1c41d13c-f9b2-11eb-a80b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1bfc8190-f9b2-11eb-aae8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]

[h2][b][h1=submarines-in-ranked-battles][/h1]Submarines in Ranked Battles[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b3597798-f6c7-11eb-ba29-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Ranked Battles Season 4 kicks off 1 week after the update hits the Live Servers.

In addition to the traditional four ship types, a new type—submarines—is joining the fight for Ranked glory in the new season.

Submarines have made quite a journey, having gone through six open and a gazillion closed tests since they were first announced back in 2019. Adding a totally new type of ship to World of Warships requires extended testing by a wide and stable audience in Random Battles. Testing them on a standalone server or in a special game mode would simply not give us a broad enough picture.

However, we don't want to allow submarines to "surface" in the main type of battle directly—it's essential that we ensure they are properly tested first. To perform the test, we've settled on Ranked Battles as the most suitable and closest equivalent of Random Battles. The new Ranked season starts a week after the update goes live, but submarines will be accessible immediately after the release of Update 0.10.7. Co-op Battles will give you an opportunity to try the subs out in a more relaxed environment and get prepared for the new Ranked season.

[h2]Season features[/h2]
[list][*]A maximum of two submarines is allowed per team.
[*]To prevent long queues from forming in the matchmaker, submarines will be rented out free of charge through random bundles from the Armory.
[*]Commanders will receive a fifth skill tree for submarines, and some of the skills of other ship types will receive additional effects that are designed to counter submarines.[/list]
You'll also find a revamped interface in the Port, and there are updated rules for the season:
[list][*]Ranked Battles statistics will be displayed in the profile summary. Distribution by league starts from Season 4. Statistics for previous seasons, broken down by leagues, will not be available.
[*]After qualifying, you can continue playing in the next league without having to wait for the start of a new Sprint. If you make it to Rank 1 in the Bronze League and successfully qualify, you can continue playing in the Silver League within the same Sprint.[/list]
[h2]Format[/h2]
[list][*]7 vs. 7
[*]Tier VI in the Bronze League
[*]Tier VIII in the Silver League
[*]Tier X in the Gold League[/list]

Since the latest Commander skills update, we've taken a close look at the extensive feedback we received from you and compiled statistics related to those changes. We've made some balance tweaks, as well as improved or replaced unpopular skills. Some skills have received additional effects that are intended to counter submarines.

[h2]Battleship skills[/h2]
[h3][i][h3][b]One skill point[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
[h3][b]Pyrotechnician[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The skill has been renamed "Demolition Expert."
[*]Bonus added: +15% to the fragmentation damage area of the main battery and secondary battery shells, as well as HE rockets and bombs, when firing at submarines.[/list]
[h3][i][h3][b]Two skill points[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
[h3][b]Consumables Enhancements[/b][/h3]
[list][*]This skill has been replaced with the "Brisk" skill, which provides the ship a 10% speed increase while she remains undetected.[/list]
[h3][b]Vigilance[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Bonus added: +7% to the ship's torpedo protection.[/list]
[h3][b]AA Gunner[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The skill has been renamed "AA Defense and ASW Expert."
[*]Bonus added: +10% to damage inflicted by depth charges.[/list]
[h3][i][h3][b]Three skill points[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
Added a new skill called "Improved Repair Party Readiness" that replaces the "Enhanced Anti-Torpedo Protection" skill:
[list][*]Activated effect: –0.8% to the reload time of the Repair Party consumable each time your ship receives potential damage equal to 100% of the ship's base HP.[/list]
[h3][b]AA Gun Aiming Expert[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The skill has been renamed "Focus Fire Training."
[*]Bonus added: –10% to the reload time of the Airstrike armament (including the Airstrike with anti-submarine defense aircraft).[/list]
[h3][i][h3][b]Four skill points[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
Added a new skill called "Furious" that replaces the "Brisk" skill:
[list][*]Activated effect: –5% to the reload time of main battery guns and +5% to the dispersion of shells fired by enemies attacking your ship for each active fire on board.[/list]
[h3][b]Improved Secondary Battery Aiming[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The skill has been renamed "Manual Secondary Battery Aiming."
[*]Added the following permanent bonuses:
[list][*]−10% to the reload time of the secondary battery.
[*]−10% to the dispersion of secondary battery shells.[/list]
[*]We've reworked the mechanics for the bonus that gets applied to the maximum dispersion of secondary battery shells fired at a priority target:
[list][*]Activated effect: a gradual increase in secondary gun accuracy at a priority target when secondary battery guns are firing continuously. The maximum bonus to fire accuracy provided by the activated effect equals +50%. This can be achieved if the secondary battery has been continuously firing for 45 seconds.[/list]
[*]The accuracy bonus gradually decreases if the secondary guns haven't fired for 15 seconds.
[*]When the priority target is changed, the accuracy bonus provided by the activated effect instantly drops down to 75% of the accumulated accuracy.[/list]
[h3][b]Close Quarters Expert[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Bonus removed: –10% to the secondary battery reload time.[/list]
[h2]Cruiser skills[/h2]
[h3][i][h3][b]Two skill points[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
[h3][b]Pyrotechnician[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The skill has been renamed "Demolition Expert."
[*]Bonus added: +15% to the fragmentation damage area of the main battery and secondary battery shells, as well as HE rockets and bombs, when firing at submarines.[/list]
[h3][b]AA Gun Aiming Expert[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The skill has been renamed "Focus Fire Training."
[*]Bonus added: –10% to the reload time of the Airstrike armament (including an airstrike using anti-submarine defense aircraft).[/list]
[h3][i][h3][b]Four skill points[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
[h3][b]Outnumbered[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The bonus to the main battery accuracy and ship speed is now activated if the number of visible enemy ships is equal or greater than the number of allies within the firing range of your ship's main guns. The bonus will also apply when there are no enemies or allies within your ship's main battery firing range.[/list]
[h3][b]AA Gunner[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The skill has been renamed "AA Defense and ASW Expert."
[*]Bonus added: +15% to damage inflicted by depth charges.[/list]
[h2]Destroyer skills[/h2]
[h3][i][h3][b]Two skill points[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
[h3][b]Pyrotechnician[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Bonus added: +15% to the damage-inflicting area of main and secondary battery shells when firing at submarines.[/list]
[h3][b]Extra-Heavy AP Shells[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The skill has been renamed "Extra-Heavy Ammunition."
[*]Bonus added: +10% to damage inflicted by depth charges.[/list]
[h2]Aircraft carrier skills[/h2]
[h3][i][h3][b]Four skill points[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
[h3][b]Hidden Menace[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Bonus added: –50% to the height at which aircraft return to a carrier after an attack or upon pressing the [b]F[/b] key. Squadrons will now soar up to a height where they are invulnerable to AA fire faster.[/list]
[h3][b]Demolition Expert[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The skill has been renamed "Pyrotechnician."[/list]

Our special event that commemorates the end of World War II launches on August 27. During the event, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Missouri[/b][/b] will appear in random bundles that can be obtained in exchange for Doubloons.

[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Missouri[/b][/b] was our first experience of creating a Tier IX Premium ship, and during her adjustment, the ship received excessively high Credit profitability compared to other Premium Tier IX ships. The existence of a large number of ships with such high profitability negatively affects the game economy. Furthermore, it was often excessive profitability rather than the ship’s specifications and gameplay that became the determining factor for players deciding to helm Missouri into battle more often than they would perhaps otherwise prefer.

At the same time, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Missouri[/b][/b] is a renowned historical ship, and we would like more players to have the opportunity to add the ship to their collections. In the forthcoming update, Missouri's base economic capabilities will be brought into line with other Tier IX Premium ships.

Players who already own the ship at the moment Update 0.10.7 goes live will, on average, earn the same number of Credits as before—a permanent combat mission will apply an economic bonus to all battles played at the helm of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Missouri[/b][/b].

To mark the event, we're launching the Pacific War campaign on our website. You'll advance through it from the perspectives of those who sailed through flooding and flame in the grandest naval encounters of World War II. More details will follow in a dedicated article.

Premium Ship II-IV containers have been added.
