notes.title: Submarines in Ranked and Co-op Battles
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/a09c90a20ef04b1f71593951651d2d601f4bbd8c.jpg[/img]
[b]Submarines have made quite a journey, going through six open and a gazillion closed tests since they were first announced back in 2019. Adding a totally new type of ship to World of Warships requires extended testing by a wide and stable audience in Random Battles. Testing them on a standalone server or in a special game mode would simply not give us a broad enough picture.[/b]

However, we don’t want submarines to "surface" in the most populated type of battle just yet. It's essential that we ensure they are properly tested first. To perform the test, we've settled on Ranked Battles as the most suitable and closest equivalent of Random Battles. The new Ranked season kicks off a week after the update goes live, but submarines will be accessible immediately after the release of Update 0.10.7. Co-op Battles will give you an opportunity to try the subs out in a more relaxed environment and get prepared for the new Ranked season.

[table][tr][th][b][url=#starting-out-in-a-sub]Starting Out in a Sub[/url] ● [url=#ranked-battles-season]Ranked Battles Season[/url] ● [url=#submarines-strike-in-swift-silence]Submarines: Strike in Swift Silence[/url] ● [url=#surfaced-and-submerged]Surfaced and submerged[/url] ● [url=#acoustic-homing-torpedoes]Acoustic homing torpedoes[/url] ● [url=#nation-specific-features]Nation-specific features[/url] ● [url=#playing-against-submarines]Playing against submarines[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=KrIvIiNqmVc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b][h1=starting-out-in-a-sub][/h1]Starting Out in a Sub[/b][/h2]
When Update 0.10.7 goes live and until the end of Ranked Battles Season 4, the Armory will feature three types of random bundles available free of charge. Each of them will drop four sets with 100 Coal and one set with two submarines that will be rented out to you for three days. Offering submarines in this way will help us keep an eye on how many of them are out on our seas and prevent extended queue times.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/13070468-f4f1-11eb-a89d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]The bundles will be updated each week. This means that you can open them again each week to get Coal and the rental submarines.[/i][/list]

Helm submarines in Co-op Battles and mow down bots—these battles offer a great opportunity to try out the mechanics that make the new ship type stand out. When the waters start raging with the heat of Ranked Battles, you'll already be familiar enough with submarines to test your strategies against real players. The season commences 1 week after Update 0.10.7 hits the live servers.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/202b78e8-f480-11eb-99a3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/202be77e-f480-11eb-9322-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1f8d9a2e-f480-11eb-a89d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1f97e330-f480-11eb-a1fe-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1f7e0898-f480-11eb-a9a6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1f7e80a2-f480-11eb-a62e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2][b][h1=ranked-battles-season][/h1]Ranked Battles Season[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Forthcoming changes:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Ranked Battles statistics will be displayed in the profile summary. Distribution by league starts from the Fourth Season. Statistics for previous seasons, broken down by leagues, will not be available.
[*]After qualifying, you can continue to play in the next league without having to wait for the start of a new Sprint. If you make it to Rank 1 in the Bronze League and successfully qualify, you can continue playing in the Silver League within the same Sprint.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/90f8ec5e-f4f3-11eb-a517-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Rewards[/h2]
The rewards for each league will be refreshed and available again at the start of each new Sprint.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c9d99fa8-f52c-11eb-a1cb-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Reaching Rank 1 will reward you with Bronze, Silver, and Gold League containers.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ba078878-f45b-11eb-bd1f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
A commemorative flag is awarded for achieving Rank 1 in the Bronze League.

[h2]Rules[/h2] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/32216f20-f51c-11eb-883b-ac162d70f4e4.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Format[/b][/h3]
7 vs. 7 (with a maximum of two submarines per team)
[list][*]Tier VI in the Bronze League
[*]Tier VIII in the Silver League
[*]Tier X in the Gold League[/list]
[h3][b]Game maps and modes[/b][/h3] [table][tr][th][b]Map[/b][/th][th][b]League[/b][/th][th][b]Battle Tiers[/b][/th][/tr] [tr][td]Strait[/td] [td]Bronze[/td] [td]VI[/td][/tr] [tr][td]New Dawn[/td] [td]Bronze[/td] [td]VI[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Fault Line[/td] [td]Bronze[/td] [td]VI[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Neighbors[/td] [td]Bronze[/td] [td]VI[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Tears of the Desert[/td] [td]Silver[/td] [td]VIII[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Mountain Range[/td] [td]Silver[/td] [td]VIII[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Islands of Ice[/td] [td]Silver[/td] [td]VIII[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Shards[/td] [td]Silver[/td] [td]VIII[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Northern Lights[/td] [td]Gold[/td] [td]X[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Sea of Fortune[/td] [td]Gold[/td] [td]X[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Trap[/td] [td]Gold[/td] [td]X[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Loop[/td] [td]Gold[/td] [td]X[/td][/tr][/table]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bbbac57a-f4f3-11eb-92cf-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bbd29aec-f4f3-11eb-a5fc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5c00c7cc-f50e-11eb-b0b3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bbd79e8e-f4f3-11eb-a517-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bcf06576-f4f3-11eb-9cde-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bd7f39fe-f4f3-11eb-92de-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ba99c43e-f4f3-11eb-92de-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bbdd70e8-f4f3-11eb-b756-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/baa2f266-f4f3-11eb-b392-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bbba9e2e-f4f3-11eb-a89d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bbd4db72-f4f3-11eb-99a3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bdc089b8-f4f3-11eb-b392-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][i]Battles on the Neighbors map will utilize Epicenter mode. Battles on other maps will utilize Domination mode.[/i][/list]

[h2]Season structure[/h2]
The season is divided into six Sprints. The first Sprint runs for 1 week, and each subsequent one runs for 2 weeks. Each new Sprint starts immediately after the end of the previous one.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/13961bbc-f4f1-11eb-80c2-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][h1=submarines-strike-in-swift-silence][/h1]Submarines: Strike in Swift Silence[/b][/h2]
Submarines are fragile and sneaky hunters. The diving depth of a submarine affects her detectability, viewing range, and interactions with other ship types and submarines. Maneuver, change your submergence depth, hide from your enemies, and surprise them with stealth attacks. Keep the enemy guessing and on their toes!

Submarines have small HP pools, so stick to the flanks and attack your opponents while you are submerged. Change position often, try to enlist the support of your teammates, and dive deeper when you find yourself in immediate danger.

Cruisers and destroyers are the primary targets for submarines during the beginning and middle stages of a battle. These ship types keep submarines in check and prevent them from breaking through to the sluggish battleships.

[h2]Controls[/h2]
[list][*]The [b]W[/b], [b]A[/b], [b]S[/b], and [b]D[/b] keys control horizontal movement.
[*]Press [b]F[/b] to ascend.
[*]Press [b]C[/b] to dive.
[*][b]1[/b]—sonar pings.
[*][b]2[/b]—torpedoes.[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/12dc8472-f4f1-11eb-a517-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][h1=surfaced-and-submerged][/h1]Surfaced and submerged[/b][/h2]
Submarines have four submergence levels: surface, periscope depth, operating depth, and maximum depth.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2c8e8344-f4f5-11eb-9a9b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2ca3288a-f4f5-11eb-a517-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2c92bec8-f4f5-11eb-92cf-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2c740a46-f4f5-11eb-b392-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
The amount of time that a submarine can operate at levels other than the surface level is limited by her dive capacity, varies by submarine, and does not exceed 10 minutes. If a submarine is detected while at the periscope depth or underwater, her dive capacity depletes faster.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e31f815c-f479-11eb-95b4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
When her dive capacity runs out, a submarine will automatically surface. On the surface, her dive capacity can be gradually restored.

Shells, ship and aerial torpedoes, bombs, and rockets pose a threat to submarines that are on the surface or at the periscope depth.

The deeper a submarines dives, the harder she is to detect—her detectability for enemy ships decreases as she descends into the depths.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3cc1146c-f481-11eb-a89d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Each submergence level needs to be used in a specific situation, and it's important to take the penalties and bonuses of each level into account.
[list][*]The surface level is the riskiest, but you don't spend any dive capacity while on the surface. Capturing Key Areas is only possible while on the surface.
[*]At the periscope depth, submarines can move at full speed and become less visible. Descend to this level to assume an attack position quickly without being noticed.
[*]At the operating depth, submarines have much lower visibility, but enemy ships are also harder to detect. This position is the best to attack a target you’ve already detected.
[*]In case of immediate danger, dive to the maximum depth. Once there, your submarine can't be detected by other ships. This comes at a price—at this level, your sub can detect only other submarines sailing at operating and maximum depths within your guaranteed acquisition radius.[/list]
The higher the tier of a submarine, the faster she can sail while submerged. Like a shark, the sub gradually takes to hunting at her operating depth as effectively as on the surface.

[h2][b][h1=acoustic-homing-torpedoes][/h1]Acoustic homing torpedoes[/b][/h2]
Submarines' primary armament is [b]acoustic homing torpedoes.[/b] The sonar pings mechanic will help you increase the potential effectiveness of your torpedo salvos. By hitting an enemy ship with a sonar ping, you activate horizontal and vertical acoustic homing on that ship. Torpedoes can ascend from the depths and home in on an enemy only with the help of an active sonar ping effect.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/12ea5ca0-f4f1-11eb-8f64-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]You can launch torpedoes and sonar pings from any depth. When underwater, you can emit sonar pings in any direction—even at targets above or below your submarine.
[*]Aim at an enemy ship, take a lead on the target, and click the left mouse button.
[*]Hitting a target with a sonar ping highlights a section on its hull that torpedoes will home in on. The pinged part of the target ship will also be highlighted for the player controlling that ship. Moreover, the targeted ship will see an indicator showing the approximate direction the ping came from.
[*]Hitting the highlighted part of the ship with another sonar ping extends the duration of the sonar ping's effect and increases damage inflicted by torpedoes.[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/2134e4b4-f47f-11eb-a9a6-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]
[list][*]The effect of a successful ping hit remains active for up to 30 seconds, depending on the specific submarine. Hitting the highlighted part of a ship with another sonar ping will reset its action time.
[*]If a sonar ping hits part of a ship that isn't highlighted, the spot from the previous sonar ping hit will relocate to the new area and the active effect will continue working.[/list] [table][tr][td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/56c6c388-f4f5-11eb-b392-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/56c6c388-f4f5-11eb-b392-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/56d3edd8-f4f5-11eb-8c73-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/56d3edd8-f4f5-11eb-8c73-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][b]1[/b][/td] [td][b]2[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
If you attack a ship from afar, keep emitting sonar pings to maintain their effect while your torpedoes are traveling to their target. Bear in mind, though, that guiding your torpedo to its target with the help of sonar pings doesn't guarantee a hit.
[list][*]The target will know the approximate direction from which torpedoes will approach it.[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e608d6de-c86e-11eb-b447-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]
[list][*]The target ship can remove the highlighting effect from its hull by using the Damage Control Party consumable. You won't be able to highlight it again while Damage Control Party is in operation.
[*]Upon approaching to a certain distance of the target, torpedo homing gets disabled, and it will travel straight ahead. If the enemy changes speed or course at the right time, your torpedo might miss it.[/list]
Emitting a sonar ping makes your submarine more visible, so be sure to consider this factor if the enemy is nearby.

Torpedo tubes mounted on submarines do not necessarily reload simultaneously like they do on surface ships. The number of torpedoes that can be reloaded simultaneously depends on how many loaders are available. Torpedo tubes located at the bow and stern can have different numbers of loaders assigned to them.

To counter hostile subs, make use of the Hydrophone—a consumable designed to detect submerged submarines over long ranges.

[h2][b][h1=nation-specific-features][/h1]Nation-specific features[/b][/h2]
[h3][i]U.S.A.[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
U.S. submarines have the following key features:
[list][*]Long-range torpedoes.
[*]Small number of loaders.
[*]High sonar ping velocity.
[*]Good maneuverability.
[*]Access to the Enhanced Rudder Gears consumable, which accelerates the diving plane shift time and makes it possible to change diving depth faster.[/list]
Submarines of this nation can attack targets from a long distance using multiple-torpedo salvos. However, if you fire all your torpedoes at once, the total reload time will be rather long due to the small number of available loaders.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Germany[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
Key features of German submarines:
[list][*]Short-range torpedoes.
[*]Large number of loaders, which provides for high damage per minute.
[*]Access to the Hydrophone consumable with a longer action range and time.
[*]Access to the Reserve Battery Unit consumable, which temporarily stops dive capacity depletion.[/list]
German submarines are a good choice for a risky style of combat at close to medium ranges. You can deal high damage by unleashing a full torpedo salvo, then deliver another painful punch after a relatively short time. After an attack, these submarines can sneak away from enemy radar and lurk around at their maximum depth for a long time.
[/expand]
[h2][b][h1=playing-against-submarines][/h1]Playing against submarines[/b][/h2]
Many destroyers and some light cruisers carry depth charges that can hit submarines prowling about in the depths. Approach the approximate location of the submarine and release your depth charges using the [b]G[/b] key.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4e1a082e-f47f-11eb-99a3-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

Some battleships can call in anti-submarine defense aircraft.  You can choose this armament type by pressing [b]4[/b]. The camera rises and the reticle allows you to select an area within a 10 to 12 km radius from the ship. A group of aircraft will arrive and drop depth charges in this area shortly after being called.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4e0fe808-f47f-11eb-a62e-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

In addition to depth charges and anti-submarine defense aircraft, high-explosive shells, Surveillance Radar, and Hydroacoustic Search will come in handy when fighting against submarines.
[list][*]A submarine on the surface and at periscope depth can be hit with shells, ship- and airborne torpedoes, bombs, and rockets, as well as by ramming.
[*]All shells can inflict damage to a submarine even when they don't directly strike the sub but fall within her vicinity. High-explosive shells, however, are the most effective shell type to deploy against submarines thanks to the shell's large fragmentation damage area.
[*]Depth charges and anti-submarine defense aircraft have several charges that are reloaded in sequence.  This armament can be activated several times in a row.
[*]If your ship is hit by a sonar ping, the hit sector will be highlighted, and an indicator will show the direction from which the ping was launched. This will help you identify the location of the attacking submarine. Change course constantly to make it all the more difficult for the enemy to hit you.
[*]If you're hit by a sonar ping, you can remove its effect by using the Damage Control Party consumable. Incoming torpedoes will cease to home in on your ship but will continue to run straight, so don’t stop maneuvering!
[*]Surveillance Radar detects submarines on the surface and at the periscope depth; Hydroacoustic Search detects them at all depth levels except maximum depth. Detection increases the rate at which a submarine’s dive capacity depletes.
[*]A submarine can spend only a limited amount of time underwater—it will have to surface sooner or later. If you can detect a submerged submarine, it will consume its dive capacity faster.[/list]
[list]This is almost everything you need to know about the key principles of operating and countering submarines in the game. Good luck in your Ranked Battles, Commanders![/list]

Сommanders, thank you for participating in the Public Test for Update 0.10.7, and — in particular — for testing submarines in Ranked Battles! Your sincere and detailed feedback has helped us to tune the new class, as well as its mechanics and interactions with other ships, before the addition of submarines to Ranked and Co-Op battles on the main server in Update 0.10.7! Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!
[list][i]Please Note: The “Inventory” tab will be unavailable on the Public Test server for technical reasons.[/i][/list]
[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Balance changes to submarines, anti-submarine upgrades, and the Depth Charge Airstrike were made, as well as some other adjustments. Further details can be found in our [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/181]Development Blog[/url].
[*]Fixed several issues with the interface of submarines in battle, as well as the display of their parameters in Port;
[*]Updated the tactical hints for submarines and surface ships that play against them;
[*]Updated the videos and fixed several issues in the Dockyard;
[*]Fixed an issue which caused some buildings to disappear in the Rotterdam port when playing with a lower graphics setting;
[*]Fixed an issue which caused the limit on the number of submarines to be displayed in the division window when Random Battles were picked;
[*]Fixed an issue which caused the indicator of a ship's detectability range to be not displayed when the Airstrike armament is active;
[*]Fixed several other issues.[/list]
[h2]Special Features of the Test[/h2]
[list][i]The rewards for activities on the Public Test Server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/i][/list]

During Public Test 0.10.7, all players will have access to Tier VI submarines, which they can play in Co-op and Ranked Battles in a 7 vs. 7 format. Tier VIII and X submarines can be obtained by completing combat missions.

The reward for completing the 24th shipbuilding phase on the Public Test server is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]100,000[/b] Coal instead of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] De Zeven Provinciën[/b][/b].

[h2]Combat Missions and Rewards[/h2]
Starting with the Public Test of Update 0.10.7, you'll be able to earn Community Tokens by completing tasks. Community Tokens can be exchanged for various rewards in the Armory, including rare permanent camouflages, containers, Premium ships, containers with Premium ships, and other in-game items. All details about Community Tokens are available in a [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/community-tokens/]dedicated article[/url].

[h1][b]Developer Bulletin for Update 0.10.7[/b][/h1]
[list][b][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.[/b][/list]
[list][i]Please note: the rewards for activities on the Public Test server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/i][/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#submarines]Submarines[/url] ● [url=#ranked-battles]Ranked Battles[/url] ● [url=#changes-to-commander-skills]Changes to Commander Skills[/url] ● [url=#dockyard]Dockyard[/url] ● [url=#the-dutch-cruisers-part 2]The "Dutch Cruisers: Part 2" event[/url] ● [url=#return-of-missouri]Return of Missouri[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b][h1=submarines][/h1]Submarines[/b][/h2]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bc93788c-e87f-11eb-977c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bc90cd44-e87f-11eb-bd9f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bd3ba520-e87f-11eb-87eb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bc9f4aae-e87f-11eb-954f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bc8ee1e6-e87f-11eb-9004-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bd3e6058-e87f-11eb-915c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
Update 0.10.7 is going to introduce a special season of Ranked Battles that you'll be able to participate in playing submarines! To prevent long waiting times in battle queues caused by many people trying to play submarines at the same time, submarines will only be available for limited rental periods in free random daily bundles.

The new ship type will also be available in Co-op Battles. This will allow you to check out the new mechanics in a more relaxed environment.

Commanders will receive a fifth skill tree specifically for submarines, and some of the skills of other ship types will receive additional effects that are designed to counter submarines.

[h2]Playing Submarines[/h2] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/d3b10066-e870-11eb-8410-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
They are fragile and stealthy hunters that are capable of traveling not only horizontally, but also into the depths. The diving depth of a submarine affects her detectability, viewing range, and interactions with other ship types and submarines. Submarines have four submergence levels: surface, periscope depth, operating depth, and maximum depth. Each submergence level needs to be used in a specific situation, and the penalties and bonuses of each level must be taken into consideration. The time that submarines can spend underwater is limited by their dive capacity. However, dive capacity can be gradually restored when a submarine is on the surface.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b0e5ef22-e86d-11eb-8f49-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

The main armament carried by submarines is acoustic homing torpedoes. The sonar ping mechanic will help you increase the potential effectiveness of your torpedo salvos. Hitting an enemy ship with a sonar ping temporarily activates acoustic homing on that ship. Torpedoes can ascend from the depths and home in on an enemy only with the help of an active sonar ping effect.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/d3db9380-e870-11eb-99b5-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Emitting a sonar ping makes your submarine more visible, so be sure to consider this factor if the enemy is nearby.

[h2]Playing Against Submarines[/h2]
Many destroyers and some light cruisers carry depth charges that can hit submarines that are lurking in the depth. Approach the approximate location of the submarine and release your depth charges using the [b]G[/b] key.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b121bdf4-e86d-11eb-b3b0-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

Some battleships can call anti-submarine defense aircraft. You can choose that armament type by pressing [b]4[/b]. The camera rises and the reticle allows you to select an area within a 10 km radius from the ship. Aircraft will arrive and drop depth charges in this area shortly after selecting it.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b106e808-e86d-11eb-b573-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

A submarine on the surface or at the periscope depth can be hit with shells, ship-launched and airborne torpedoes, bombs, and rockets, as well as by ramming. If you detect a submerged submarine, its dive capacity will be depleted more rapidly.

[h2][b][h1=ranked-battles][/h1]Ranked Battles[/b][/h2]
Update 0.10.7 kicks off the Fourth Season of Ranked Battles.

[h3][b]Format[/b][/h3]
[list][*]7 vs. 7
[*]Tier VI in the Bronze League
[*]Tier VIII in the Silver League
[*]Tier X in the Gold League[/list]
[h3][b]Changes to Ranked Battles[/b][/h3]
[list][*]You can participate playing rental submarines, which are available from free random daily bundles.
[*]Ranked Battles statistics are now available in the profile summary. Distribution by league starts from the Fourth Season. Statistics for previous seasons are not available.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d3efe132-e870-11eb-a72f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]After qualifying, you can continue to play in the next league without waiting for the start of the next Sprint. If you reach Rank 1 in the Bronze League and successfully qualify, you can continue playing in the Silver League within the same Sprint.[/list]
[list][i]Details of the Fourth Season of Ranked Battles will be announced later.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=changes-to-commander-skills][/h1]Changes to Commander Skills[/b][/h2]
Since the latest Commander skills update, we've taken a close look at your feedback and compiled a huge amount of data that relates to the changes. We've made some balance tweaks and improved or replaced unpopular skills.

For example, for battleship Commanders, we've updated the mechanics of the Improved Secondary Battery Aiming skill and replaced Consumables Enhancements with Brisk, which now costs 2 skill points. Some skills have received additional effects that are intended to counter submarines.
[list][i]When Update 0.10.7 goes live, all players will have a 100% discount on resetting Commander skills.[/i][/list]
You can learn more details about the updated skills during the Public Test and on our [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/175]development blog[/url].

[h2][b][h1=dockyard][/h1]Dockyard[/b][/h2]
With the release of Update 0.10.7,  [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] De Zeven Provinciën[/b][/b] will become available for construction at the Dockyard.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6ec0e8de-e883-11eb-accc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Key features of the new Dockyard[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Ship construction at the Dockyard comprises 24 shipbuilding phases. You can advance through these by completing Dockyard combat missions or spending [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,500[/b] Doubloons on each phase.
[*]In total, you can progress through 21 out of 24 shipbuilding phases by completing Dockyard combat missions. To finish building the ship, you'll need to purchase three shipbuilding phases.
[*]If you complete the construction of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] De Zeven Provinciën[/b][/b] by spending Doubloons, make sure to keep progressing through the Dockyard combat missions—completing each phase will bring you [b]250[/b] Steel.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4aef49a2-e881-11eb-8d78-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4ad3cd4e-e881-11eb-8410-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4ad1dac0-e881-11eb-a5ac-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4ae55d20-e881-11eb-872a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
The rest of the rules remain the same as those for the previous Dockyard.

[list]The reward for completing 24 shipbuilding phases on the Public Test server is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]100,000[/b] Coal instead of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] De Zeven Provinciën[/b][/b].[/list]
[h2][b][h1=the-dutch-cruisers-part 2][/h1]The "Dutch Cruisers: Part 2" event[/b][/h2]
Update 0.10.7 continues to offer Early Access to Dutch cruisers. We've added a chain of combat missions that will bring you the following rewards when completed:
[list][*]Unique Dutch Commander [b]Klaas Janssen[/b] with the following enhanced skills:
[list][*]For destroyers, cruisers, and battleships—Pyrotechnician: [b]+1.5%[/b] to the chances of setting a target on fire when hitting it with HE shells (by default: +1%).
[*]For cruisers and battleships—Expert AA Marksman: [b]+35%[/b] to AA damage in the priority sector (by default: +25%).[/list][/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bc442fc0-e87f-11eb-b83b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]The "Dutch Cruisers: Part 2" commemorative flag.[/list]
[b]Early Access:[/b] Dutch Tier IV, VI, VIII, and IX cruisers that hit the seas in Early Access with the release of Update 0.10.6 continue to be available in random and sequentially available bundles in the Armory.

When Update 0.10.8 goes live, Dutch Tier I–X cruisers will become available for all players to research.
[list][i]Please note: the new Dutch cruisers and Commander [b]Klaas Janssen[/b] cannot be obtained on the Public Test server.[/i][/list]
[h2][b][h1=return-of-missouri][/h1]Return of Missouri[/b][/h2]
Update 0.10.7 features an event that's dedicated to the end of World War II. During the event, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Missouri[/b][/b] will become available for purchase in exchange for Doubloons.

[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Missouri[/b][/b] was our first experience in creating a Tier IX Premium ship, and during her adjustment, the ship received excessively high Credit profitability compared to other Premium Tier IX ships. The existence of a large number of ships with such high profitability negatively affects the game economy.

Furthermore, it was often not the ship’s specifications and gameplay, but her excessive profitability that became the determining factor for players deciding which ship to take into battle. This resulted in some Captains playing [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Missouri[/b][/b] more often than they planned.

At the same time, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Missouri[/b][/b] is one of the most famous historical ships, and we would like more players to have the opportunity to add the ship to their collections.

In the forthcoming update, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Missouri[/b][/b]'s base economic capabilities will be brought into line with other Tier IX Premium ships. Players who already own the ship at the moment Update 0.10.7 goes live will, on average, earn the same number of Credits as before—a permanent combat mission that applies an economic bonus to all battles will maintain the ship’s economic value for everyone who owned Missouri prior to this change.

notes.title: Dutch Cruisers: Early Access
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2be4454a886dceb90f7d1baa76a7aae06287b60.jpg[/img]
[b]Dutch Tier IV–IX cruisers have arrived in Early Access.[/b]

[table][tr][th][b][url=#the-dutch-cruisers-part-1]The "Dutch Cruisers: Part 1" Event[/url] ● [url=#combat-missions]Combat Missions of the "Dutch Cruisers: Part 1" Event[/url] ● [url=#dutch-tokens]Dutch Tokens[/url] ● [url=#rewards-for-tokens]Rewards for Tokens[/url] ● [url=#free-bundles]Free Bundles[/url] ● [url=#random-bundles]Random Bundles[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b][h1=the-dutch-cruisers-part-1][/h1]The "Dutch Cruisers: Part 1" Event[/b][/h2]
What are the features of the new branch?
[list][*]Good concealment and maneuverability, but a short firing range.
[*]Tier VIII–X cruisers are armed with main battery guns that have large calibers for cruisers:
[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Haarlem[/b][/b]—203 mm
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Johan de Witt[/b][/b]—240 mm
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Gouden Leeuw[/b][/b]—283 mm[/list]
[*]At higher tiers, the new cruisers have solid armor that provides decent protection against HE shells.
[*]The Hydroacoustic Search, Fighter, and Spotting Aircraft consumables are available from Tier IV.
[list][*]Fighter and Spotting Aircraft are not available for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Haarlem[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Johan de Witt[/b][/b] or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Gouden Leeuw[/b][/b].[/list]
[*]An enhanced version of the Repair Party consumable and Defensive AA Fire are available from Tier VIII.
[*]The new Airstrike armament is available from Tier VI.[/list]
[h2]Airstrike[/h2]
Airstrike is a new type of armament that's set to make its first appearance on Dutch cruisers. It allows you to call in aircraft that bombard a specified area with HE bombs. Airstrike was created based on the low altitude bombing principle that was actually used in battle. Bombs dropped from aircraft in this manner had drogue parachutes which slowed their descent.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1e2f8e14-dfe3-11eb-9809-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1e4675c0-dfe3-11eb-b65a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1e402b70-dfe3-11eb-ae00-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1e4e4f2a-dfe3-11eb-9390-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h3][b]Operating principle:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]When you activate Airstrike by pressing [b]4[/b], an aiming reticle appears. This represents the location the bombers will strike. The strike area is comparable in size to two battleships.
[*]Clicking the left mouse button calls in a squadron that bombards the specified area after a certain period of time. The aircraft cannot spot enemies and cannot be directly controlled.[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/728f8720-dfe3-11eb-9809-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/72974974-dfe3-11eb-8258-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]
[list][*]The bombs have drogue parachutes which slow their descent.
[*]The indicator near the drop area shows how long it will take for the bombs to reach the target after the aircraft are called in.[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/729b1270-dfe3-11eb-b6df-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

Preparation of Airstrike begins at the start of each battle, similar to the loading of main battery guns and torpedo launchers. Tier VI–VII cruisers can call in only one attacking squadron, while Tier VIII–X cruisers can call in two squadrons. The armament is reloaded in successive order. Airstrike has a maximum operating distance of 10–13 km, depending on the ship tier.

When using Airstrike, you should take the long time it takes for the bombs to fall into account. It's best to deploy this armament against low-mobility targets such as battleships and large cruisers. You can also use it to strike any enemy ships that might think they are safely hiding behind the cover of islands.

We've prepared a gift for you. Stay on the lookout for Community Tokens in this and other articles on our website! You can exchange them for containers that hold Premium ships and other items in the Armory. Make sure to keep up to date with the news, and be sure to share the articles with your friends so they can also claim gifts!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]The reward can be claimed before: [/b] [b]Tue. 27 Jul. 15:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[table][tr][th][h3=button]Asia[/h3][/th][th][h3][url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/general-news/dutch-cruisers-early-access/#button style=button][b]Claim Tokens[/b][/url][/h3][/th]
[/tr][tr][th][h3]CIS(Ru)[/h3][/th][th][h3][url=https://worldofwarships.ru/news/general-news/dutch-cruisers-early-access/#button style=button][b]Claim Tokens[/b][/url][/h3][/th]
[/tr][tr][th][h3]EU[/h3][/th][th][h3][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/dutch-cruisers-early-access/#button style=button][b]Claim Tokens[/b][/url][/h3][/th]
[/tr][tr][th][h3]NA[/h3][/th][th][h3][url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/general-news/dutch-cruisers-early-access/#button style=button][b]Claim Tokens[/b][/url][/h3][/th][/tr][/table]
[list]Watch our official streams and participate in the Public Test and other activities to earn Community Tokens. In total, you'll be able to find up to 1,630 Community Tokens on our website until the end of Update 0.10.6.[/list]
[h2]Things to Know About Early Access[/h2]
[b]Dutch Tokens [/b][b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_3_37ce14667ea42a7b7f1b4cd237d365d9399c509e9fabcf042960389568752e3b.png[/img]:[/b] a temporary resource for the Dutch Cruisers event. They can be obtained by completing combat mission groups; from random bundles, free daily bundles, and bundles that are available in exchange for Community Tokens.

[b]Combat mission group rewards:[/b] Dutch Tokens; the "Dutch Cruisers: Part 1" commemorative flag; and the Kinderdijk Windmill patch; as well as [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Celebes[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Eendracht[/b][/b] with Port slots and Commanders with 3 and 6 skill points, respectively.

[b]Rewards for Dutch Tokens:[/b] sequentially available bundles with [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]IV[/b] De Ruyter[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Kijkduin[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Haarlem[/b][/b] with Commanders and Port slots[b];[/b] permanent camouflages for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Eendracht[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Haarlem[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Johan de Witt[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Gouden Leeuw[/b][/b]; and other rewards in the Armory.

You can get the following rewards free of charge:
[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Celebes[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Eendracht[/b][/b]—by completing all combat mission groups.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]IV[/b] De Ruyter[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]VI[/b] Kijkduin[/b][/b], and the Royal Netherlands Navy permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Eendracht[/b][/b]—by collecting all Tokens that can be earned by completing combat mission groups.
[*]The Royal Netherlands Navy permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]VIII[/b] Haarlem[/b][/b]—by additionally collecting Tokens from free bundles and bundles that are available in exchange for Community Tokens.[/list]
[b]Rewards from random bundles available for Doublo[/b][b]ons:[/b] [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Johan de Witt[/b][/b] with a 10-skill-point Commander and Port slot; Dutch Tokens; Flying Dutchman, Asian Lantern, Mosaic, and Spring Sky expendable camouflages; and special signals.

Added a new Port—Rotterdam.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/21edad32-e08e-11eb-ac6f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/21e9a0b6-e08e-11eb-aa34-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/21f20580-e08e-11eb-ba30-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/21e85724-e08e-11eb-bcd3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][i]When Update 0.10.8 goes live, the Dutch cruisers will become available for all players to research.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=combat-missions][/h1]Combat Missions of the "Dutch Cruisers: Part 1" Event[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Start:[/b] [b]Thu. 15 Jul. 07:15 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]End:[/b] [b]Thu. 12 Aug. 06:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

You can look forward to accomplishing twenty-four missions spread across four groups. The first group will become available with the release of Update 0.10.6, while those that follow will be unlocked on a weekly basis. Rewards for completing missions and groups: Dutch Tokens; special signals; the "Dutch Cruisers: Part 1" commemorative flag; and the Kinderdijk Windmill patch. In terms of ships, completing the second group will reward you with [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Celebes[/b][/b], a 3-skill-point Commander, and a Port slot; completing the fourth group will bring you [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Eendracht[/b][/b] with a 6-skill-point Commander and Port slot.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7cf95842-dff9-11eb-a8d8-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]Detailed information about the mission completion criteria can be found in the game client.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=dutch-tokens][/h1]Dutch Tokens[/b][/h2]
Dutch Tokens can be obtained:
[list][*]By completing the "Dutch Cruisers: Part 1" combat missions—up to [b]280 Tokens[/b].
[*]From free random bundles in the Armory—up to [b]20 Tokens[/b].
[*]In exchange for Community Tokens in the Armory—up to [b]25 Tokens[/b].
[*]From random bundles that are available in exchange for Doubloons in the Armory—up to [b]780 Tokens[/b].[/list]
For more details about Community Tokens, follow this [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/community-tokens/]link[/url].

[list][i]With the release of Update 0.10.8, Dutch Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]60,000[/b].[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=rewards-for-tokens][/h1]Rewards for Tokens[/b][/h2]
You can exchange Dutch Tokens for sequentially available bundles and other rewards in the Armory.

[h2]Sequentially Available Bundles[/h2] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/63469c06-e301-11eb-bff9-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]If you already have [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]IV[/b] De Ruyter[/b][/b] in your Port, you will receive [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]1,100,000[/b] Credits as compensation, as well as a Commander with 3 skill points and a Port slot.[/i][/list]

[h2]Other Rewards[/h2] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5a311d6a-e2e5-11eb-a659-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][h1=free-bundles][/h1]Free Bundles[/b][/h2]
The Armory is offering free random bundles—Batavian Supplies. Within them, you'll find Dutch Tokens, [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Premium Account[/b], Doubloons, and other desirable rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]The bundles are available until: [/b] [b]Mon. 02 Aug. 08:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/6ca156f4-e2e5-11eb-becf-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]You can obtain only one bundle per day. A total of 12 bundles will be available, so you can skip 6 days and still be able to collect all the rewards.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=random-bundles][/h1]Random Bundles[/b][/h2]
The "Dutch Cruisers: Part 1" section of the Armory is now offering random bundles that can each be obtained for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,000[/b] Doubloons. Within them, you can find [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]IX[/b] Johan de Witt[/b][/b] with a 10-skill-point Commander and Port slot; Dutch Tokens; Flying Dutchman, Asian Lantern, Mosaic, and Spring Sky expendable camouflages; and special signals.

[list][*]Dutch Tier IV–IX cruisers have arrived in Early Access. The new ships are effective at short and medium ranges. They also have a new armament type—Airstrike.
[*]Two seasons of Brawls await you.
[*]Various visual and technical improvements have been implemented, including the updated combat mission interface and AI improvements for bots.[/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#the-dutch-cruisers-part-1]The "Dutch Cruisers: Part 1"[/url] ● [url=#brawls]Brawls[/url] ● [url=#clans]Clans[/url] ● [url=#armory]Armory[/url] ● [url=#content-additions-and-changes]Content Additions and Changes[/url] ● [url=#other-changes-and-improvements]Other Changes and Improvements[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[list]Read through the article carefully to claim two gifts from us at once! Share the article with your friends and Clanmates so they can also claim gifts, and make sure to dive in and arm yourself with all the essential info for this update![/list]
[h2][b][h1=the-dutch-cruisers-part-1][/h1]The "Dutch Cruisers: Part 1"[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ff41fa58-dfcb-11eb-9706-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Dutch Tier IV–IX cruisers have arrived in Early Access.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6343afc2-dfe2-11eb-abd4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/640e2c34-dfe2-11eb-9809-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/640fcecc-dfe2-11eb-a739-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/640fc800-dfe2-11eb-ae00-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/63b6e712-dfe2-11eb-ac45-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6353bc78-dfe2-11eb-9390-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Features of the branch[/h2]
[list][*]These ships have good maneuverability and concealment, but don’t have great firing range.
[*]The Tier VIII–X cruisers are armed with main battery guns that have impressive calibers for cruisers:
[list][*][b] [b]VIII[/b] Haarlem[/b]—203 mm
[*][b] [b]IX[/b] Johan de Witt[/b]—240 mm
[*][b] [b]X[/b] Gouden Leeuw[/b]—283 mm[/list]
[*]At higher tiers, the new cruisers have solid armor that provides decent protection against HE shells.
[*]The Hydroacoustic Search, Fighter, and Spotting Aircraft consumables are available from Tier IV.
[list][*]Fighter and Spotting Aircraft are not available for [b] [b]VIII[/b] Haarlem[/b], [b] [b]IX[/b] Johan de Witt[/b] or [b] [b]X[/b] Gouden Leeuw[/b].[/list]
[*]Defensive AA Fire and the Repair Party consumable with improved reload time are available from Tier VIII.
[*]The new Airstrike armament is available from Tier VI.[/list]
[h2]Airstrike[/h2]
Airstrike is a new type of armament that's set to make its first appearance on Dutch cruisers. It allows you to call in aircraft that bombard the specified area with HE bombs. Airstrike was created based on the low altitude bombing principle that was actually used in battle. Bombs dropped from aircraft in this manner had drogue parachutes which slowed their descent.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1e2f8e14-dfe3-11eb-9809-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1e4675c0-dfe3-11eb-b65a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1e402b70-dfe3-11eb-ae00-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1e4e4f2a-dfe3-11eb-9390-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Operating principle:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]When you activate Airstrike by pressing 4, an aiming reticle appears. This represents the location the bombers will strike. The strike area is comparablepa in size to two battleships.
[*]Clicking the left mouse button calls in a squadron that bombards the specified area after a certain period of time. The aircraft cannot spot enemies and cannot be directly controlled.[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/728f8720-dfe3-11eb-9809-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/72974974-dfe3-11eb-8258-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

[list][*]The bombs have drogue parachutes which slow their descent.
[*]The indicator near the drop area shows how long it will take for the bombs to reach the target after the aircraft are called in. Airstrike is most efficient against targets with low maneuverability and ships sheltering behind islands.[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/729b1270-dfe3-11eb-b6df-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

Preparation of Airstrike begins at the start of each battle, similar to the loading of main battery guns and torpedo launchers. Tier VI–VII cruisers can call in only one attacking squadron, while Tier VIII–X cruisers can call in two squadrons. The armament is reloaded in successive order. Airstrike has a maximum operating distance of 10–13 km, depending on the ship tier.

When using Airstrike, you should take the long descent time of the bombs into account. It's best to deploy this armament against low-mobility targets such as battleships and large cruisers. You can also use it to strike any enemy ships that might think they are safely hiding behind the cover of islands.

We've prepared a gift for you. Stay on the lookout for Community Tokens in this and other articles on our website! You can exchange them for containers that hold Premium ships and other items in the Armory. Make sure to keep up to date with the news, and be sure to share the articles with your friends so they can also claim gifts!

[list]Watch our official streams and participate in the Public Test and other activities to earn Community Tokens. In total, you'll be able to find up to 1,630 Community Tokens on our website until the end of Update 0.10.6.[/list]
[h2]How to get the Dutch cruisers[/h2]
Complete combat mission groups and earn a new temporary resource—[b]Dutch Tokens [/b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_3_37ce14667ea42a7b7f1b4cd237d365d9399c509e9fabcf042960389568752e3b.png[/img]. The reward for completing the second combat mission group is [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]V[/b] Celebes[/b][/b], and the final reward for the last combat mission group is [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]VII[/b] Eendracht[/b][/b]. For the first and third groups, you'll receive the Kinderdijk Windmill  patch and the "Dutch Cruisers: Part 1" commemorative flag, respectively.

Even more Dutch Tokens can be obtained from random bundles available for Doubloons, free daily bundles, and bundles that are available in exchange for Community Tokens in the Armory.

You can purchase sequentially available bundles using Dutch Tokens in the Armory. These bundles include: [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b][b]IV[/b] De Ruyter[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Netherlands_fedce9c191a9d9346b44eb45eea4068834ac175c9992d8a5caa4fe0a76c3f6a3.png[/img] [h2][b][h1=brawls][/h1]Brawls[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ff588200-dfcb-11eb-96e6-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Two seasons of Brawls await you in Update 0.10.6. Brawls are open to all players, even if a player isn't currently in a Clan.

[h2]Third Brawl[/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts: [/b] [b]Mon. 19 Jul. 10:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Mon. 26 Jul. 03:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[b]Format:[/b] 3 vs. 3, playing Tier VII ships.

[b]Restrictions:[/b] no more than one ship of each type per team.

[h2]Fourth Brawl[/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts: [/b] [b]Mon. 02 Aug. 10:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends: [/b] [b]Mon. 09 Aug. 03:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[b]Format:[/b] 3 vs. 3, playing Tier VI ships.

[b]Restrictions:[/b] no more than one ship of each type per team. The ship-type compositions of each team won't necessarily mirror each other.

The following conditions apply to both Brawls:

[b]Prime Times:[/b]
[list][*]ASIA 01:00 — 18:00 UTC
[*]CIS 06:00 — 23:00 UTC
[*]EU 08:00 — 01:00 UTC
[*]NA 16:00 — 09:00 UTC[/list]
[list][i]You can take part in the Brawl only during the time period specified for your server.[/i][/list]

[b]Maps and modes:[/b] Big Race, Shatter, Northern Waters, Loop, and Crash Zone Alpha in Domination mode; Two Brothers in the Epicenter mode.

[b]Rewards for each Brawl:[/b] up to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]10,000[/b] Coal; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]2,250,000[/b] Credits; [b]80,000[/b] Elite Commander XP; and 76 combat and economic signals.

[list][i]You'll find a detailed description of the new Brawls in a dedicated article. Stay tuned for more news on our website![/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=clans][/h1]Clans[/b][/h2]

[h2]Hall of Fame[/h2]
A "Hall of Fame" tab has been added to the "Clan Battles" section. Winners of the previous seasons of Clan Battles in each region will be shown there.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/31f91ca8-e08d-11eb-ad1b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Division Star[/h2]
Throughout Update 0.10.6, players will have access to special victory bonuses in the form of Division Stars. These are available for members of Clans.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/328aeebc-e08d-11eb-ae3c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]You can get a Division Star by playing in a Division with your Clanmates.
[*]A Star is issued to each member of a Division for the first victory gained by that Division during Update 0.10.6.
[*]The Stars can be earned in all battle types, except for Training Battles.
[*]A certain number of earned Stars unlocks access to various rewards.
[*]If you switch Clans, any Stars and rewards you previously received remain with you.
[*]To see the roster of Clanmates who you can team up with in a Division, as well as the list of rewards you can get, navigate to the Division Star tab in the Clans section.[/list]
[h3][b]List of rewards[/b][/h3] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/327ec5e2-e08d-11eb-aa25-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][h1=armory][/h1]Armory[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ff290084-dfcb-11eb-8e83-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The new Floating permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Somers[/b][/b] has been added and made available in exchange for [b]3[/b] Clan Tokens.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ecc19aba-e0a6-11eb-b03a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Added Dutch Commander [b]Dasha Perova[/b] with 10 skill points. The Commander is available for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,500[/b] Doubloons.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b33d405c-dfe1-11eb-b6df-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][h1=content-additions-and-changes][/h1]Content Additions and Changes[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/fee367f4-dfcb-11eb-a0e6-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Added the Grigio-azzurro chiaro permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img] [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b][b]X[/b] Napoli[/b][/b].
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d0c3fce0-dfe8-11eb-a9b1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Added new Dutch Commander [b]Michiel de Ruyter[/b] with the following enhanced skills:
[list][*]For destroyers, cruisers, and battleships—Pyrotechnician: [b]+1.5%[/b] to the chances of setting a target on fire when hitting it with HE shells (by default: +1%).
[*]For cruisers and battleships—Expert AA Marksman: [b]+35%[/b] to AA damage in the priority sector (by default: +25%).[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d0ee9c0c-dfe8-11eb-b252-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d07d755e-dfe8-11eb-8e62-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d08eaa04-dfe8-11eb-b55a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]Details on how to get these items will be announced later.[/i][/list]

The Saint Petersburg Port has been decorated to celebrate Navy Day.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ecc987a2-e08d-11eb-aa34-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ed1a416a-e08d-11eb-bcd3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ece81ae6-e08d-11eb-aa25-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ed1b67e8-e08d-11eb-b083-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]With the release of Update 0.10.6, [b] [b]IX[/b] Friesland[/b] will cease to be available. In Update 0.10.7 she'll be replaced with [b] [b]IX[/b] Groningen[/b], which is identical to Friesland. She'll be available for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]1,000,000[/b] Free XP and for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]19,300[/b] Doubloons. With the release of Update 0.10.7, owners of Friesland will be able to replace the ship with Groningen in the "Inventory" section. This can be done until the release of Update 0.10.8.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=other-changes-and-improvements][/h1]Other Changes and Improvements[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/fee2d672-dfcb-11eb-9eba-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Visual and other enhancements[/h2]
[h3][b]The combat mission interface has been updated[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Added a new type of combat mission that allows players to choose one of two rewards after completing it. This means that you can choose a reward that you like or need rather than obtain a predetermined reward. If no reward is chosen, the first reward will be credited after the mission expires.
[*]Priority missions are now highlighted. This will help you notice important missions or mission chains, such as those dedicated to certain activities, that offer valuable rewards, or that have a short duration.
[*]The tooltip now shows the exact expiration time of the mission.
[*]Fixed a number of errors that caused problems with how combat missions were displayed in the corresponding Port tab and on the post-battle statistics screen.[/list]
Missions that allow players to choose the reward, as well as highlighted priority tasks, will appear in the activities of future updates.

[h3][b]Updated the AI of bots[/b][/h3]
[list][*]They can now adjust their speed to avoid torpedoes.
[*]Reduced the likelihood of bots colliding with islands in Training and Co-op battles, as well as in Operations.
[*]In Co-op battles, bots will try to change their course if there's a risk of colliding with other ships, rather than lower their speed or move astern.[/list]
This change will result in more realistic behavior for bots.
[h2]Game balance changes[/h2]
We've made some changes to the parameters of certain ships based on our analysis of their battle efficiency and player feedback. These changes were required in order to carefully adjust the balance of selected warships. Further changes may follow in future updates, should they be required.
[h3][i][h3][b]Summary of Changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
[b] [b]VIII[/b] Gustav-Julius Maerker[/b]
[list][*]Detectability range by sea reduced from 8.1 to 8 km. Other detectability values were reduced accordingly.[/list]
[b] [b]IX[/b] Felix Schultz[/b]
[list][*]Detectability range by sea reduced from 8.2 to 8.1 km. Other detectability values were reduced accordingly.[/list]
[b] [b]VII[/b] Leberecht Maass[/b]
[list][*]Main battery reload time increased from 4 to 4.2 seconds.[/list]
[b] [b]VIII[/b] Fenyang[/b]
[list][*]Main battery reload time reduced from 4.9 to 4.7 seconds.[/list]
[b] [b]VI[/b] Queen Elizabeth[/b]
[list][*]Main battery gun 180-degree traverse time reduced from 72 to 54.5 s.[/list]
[b] [b]VIII[/b] Monarch[/b]
[list][*]Standard main battery firing range increased from 16.5 to 17 km.[/list]
[b] [b]VI[/b] Leander[/b], [b] [b]VII[/b] Fiji[/b]
[list][*]Main battery reload time increased from 7.7 to 8 seconds.[/list]
[b] [b]VIII[/b] Edinburgh[/b]
[list][*]Main battery reload time increased from 7.5 to 7.7s.[/list]
[b] [b]VII[/b] Jervis[/b]
[list][*]Detectability range by sea increased from 7.2 to 7.3 km Other detectability values were increased accordingly.[/list]
[b] [b]VIII[/b] Baltimore[/b]
[list][*]Surveillance Radar consumable action time reduced from 30 to 27 s.[/list]
[b] [b]VII[/b] Shchors[/b]
[list][*]Standard main battery firing range increased from 15.2 to 15.7 km.[/list]
[b] [b]VI[/b] Andrea Doria[/b]
[list][*]Maximum SAP shell damage increased from 9,900 to 10,250.[/list]
[h2]Other changes[/h2]
[list][*]In Update 0.10.5, the mechanic that determines the contents of containers was changed—this is now determined at the point in time when the container is opened. This will prevent situations where players could receive a unique item for the second time if the container hadn’t been opened immediately after it was received and the player had already obtained the item from the container.
[*]In Clan Battles, when a cyclone appears, various weather effects will be displayed on maps.
[*]Updated the button and animation for receiving rewards in the "Daily Rewards" section.
[*]Optimized the performance of the game client with a large list of contacts or large blacklist.
[*]For displays with a resolution of 1920х1080 or higher, the size of the mouse cursor now becomes larger proportional to the screen resolution.
[*]Fixed an error that caused Co-op battles to take place with no more than two players on each team.
[*]Fixed an error that prevented the priority target for secondary guns from being selected by clicking on the ship icon when the alternative battle interface mode was enabled.
[*]The fighters of [b] [b]X[/b] Yamato[/b], [b] [b]X[/b] ARP Yamato[/b], [b] [b]X[/b] Shikishima[/b], [b] [b]IX[/b] Ibuki[/b] and [b] [b]X[/b] Zaō[/b], as well as the Spotting Aircraft of most ships, now launch from catapults a bit faster.
[*]Updated the icons of certain expendable and permanent camouflages. They now better match the look of camouflages.
[*]Added a confirmation tooltip when converting XP from ships into Free XP or exchanging Doubloons for Credits.
[*]Other improvements and changes. For a complete list, please refer to [url=https://eu.wargaming.net/support/products/wows/article/33375/]Player Support[/url].[/list]

notes.title: LIVE Reveal — New German Battleship Branch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/fb2ffe5757892c587027aab9491aa0a17ca0c2c0.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Stream starting in…[/b]
[b]02 : 30[/b] hours[/h2]
