notes.title: Submarine Testing
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/840c2089cee7c81a65c7cb192834afccc41aa55e.jpg[/img]
[b]Submarines have come a long way: they were announced in the summer of 2019; went through three testing phases; lived as the Submarine Battles temporary mode on the main server; and then tested again on a separate server in October 2020.[/b]

During this time, we've gathered a lot of feedback and statistics. We used it to make some changes for a new beta test:
[list][*]Updated diving controls, torpedo settings, and sonar ping mechanics
[*]Added skills and upgrades
[*]Replaced the battery charge with dive capacity
[*]Made many other improvements[/list]
[list]We invite you to participate in a new test stage and try not only Tier VI submarines but Tier X as well.[/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#how-to-participate]How to Participate[/url] ● [url=#schedule]Testing Period and Conditions[/url] ● [url=#changes]Changes Since Autumn of 2020[/url] ● [url=#playing-submarine]Playing Submarines[/url] ● [url=#counter-submarine]Playing Against Submarines[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b][h1=how-to-participate][/h1]How to Participate[/b][/h2]
You can install the client right now. Your live server account details will be used to enter the test. All players are welcome to join the test.

[h3][b]Test client installation[/b][/h3]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/4174225702959905780
[olist][*][url=https://wargaming.net/personal style=button]Complete your Steam WoWS account[/url] — meaning you need to have a linked email-address and password. You can do it from inside the game or logging into https://wargaming.net/personal using Steam account.
[*][url=https://wargaming.net/wgc style=button]Install Wargaming Game Center[/url]
[*]Log into WGC using that email and password, also make sure to select correct server/region (EU/Asia/NA/CIS) from the dropdown menu.
[*]In Wargaming Game Center, navigate to the World of Warships tab.
[*]Open the "Game Settings" menu and select [b]"Install additional game instance."[/b]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bd5da2ca-c871-11eb-a24a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[*]Select [b]World of Warships TST[/b] in the upper-left corner of the screen that appears and start the installation process by selecting the installation folder.
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bda50f16-c871-11eb-8f09-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/olist]
[h2][b][h1=schedule][/h1]Testing Period and Conditions[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Testing starts:[/b] [b]Thu. 10 Jun. 15:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Testing ends:[/b] [b]Tue. 15 Jun. 22:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[list][i]Prime Times: 13:00 to 20:00 UTC and 01:00 to 04:00 UTC[/i][/list]

The server will be available during the Prime Time only. This way, we can get the maximum number of real players together at one time to reduce the number of bots in battles.

Only Random Battles will be available, playing Tier VI and X ships. If necessary, team lineups can be completed with bots. This will reduce the time spent in queues for battles if there aren't enough players on the server to match a real-players-only battle.

When testing starts, all [b]Tier VI[/b] researchable ships and a container will be credited to your account that has a certain chance of dropping one random Tier VI submarine. If you don't receive a submarine, earn [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9d43348869eb4ac094288dad196925d8f6d9d89b.png[/img][b]4,000[/b] Base XP to obtain two Tier VI submarines.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]The Tier VI ships will be removed:[/b] [b]Sat. 12 Jun. 15:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

When the Tier VI ships are removed, all [b]Tier X[/b] researchable ships and a container will be credited to your account that has a certain chance of dropping one random Tier X submarine. You're guaranteed to obtain Tier X submarines by completing a combat mission chain:
[list][*]Earn [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9d43348869eb4ac094288dad196925d8f6d9d89b.png[/img][b]4,000[/b] Base XP.
[b]Reward:[/b] a container that has a certain chance of dropping one random Tier X submarine.
[*]Earn [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9d43348869eb4ac094288dad196925d8f6d9d89b.png[/img][b]4,000[/b] Base XP.
[b]Reward:[/b] two Tier X submarines.[/list]
A combat mission is available for each ship type, except submarines: earn [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9d43348869eb4ac094288dad196925d8f6d9d89b.png[/img][b]8,000[/b] base XP.
[b]Reward:[/b] three special signals of each type on the live server. In total, you can receive up to 96 signals.
[list][i]Only Russian and English languages are available on the test server.[/i][/list]
[h2][b][h1=changes][/h1]Changes Since Autumn of 2020[/b][/h2]
In the previous test stages, submarines had a gameplay similar to that of torpedo destroyers. To create a unique gameplay for a new unit type, we've changed the main objective of submarines. Now, the underwater hunters will spend a significant portion of battle fighting against ship types that are equipped to oppose them—destroyers and cruisers.
[list][i]Below, you can find a list of changes that might interest you if you followed the submarine development or participated in previous tests. Read on to learn how to play submarines and how to oppose them![/i][/list]
[h3][i][h3][b]Major Changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h3]
[h3][b]Dive Capacity[/b][/h3]
Submarines are very complex machines in real life. When adding them to World of Warships, we consider the fact that they are limited in their actions under water. To better reflect this in the game, we’ve introduced a parameter that takes different systems and resources of a submarine into account—dive capacity. It will replace the battery charge.

The dive capacity has a limited action time—approximately 10 minutes per battle depending on the nation and tier of submarine. This parameter doesn't get restored in battle. An average battle lasts around 15 minutes. If a submarine is active under water, it will have to surface by the end of a battle. If a submarine is discovered under water or at the periscope level, its dive capacity runs out more quickly. This way, ships equipped with Hydroacoustic Search or Surveillance Radar can impact submarine operations without even damaging them.

This change will give other ships the ability to counter submarines even without anti-submarine weapons.

[h3][b]Depth, concealment, and viewing controls[/b][/h3]
We've combined several mechanics that we had tested before. Now, the submergence depth is not specified in meters, but can be selected from several levels using [b]C[/b] and [b]F[/b] keys. Apart from that, we've brought back the periscope depth. It allows you to move stealthily at the standard speed but depletes the dive capacity. Moreover, you no longer need consumables to dive to the maximum depth.

A submarine's Detectability Range decreases as she dives deeper in a linear fashion. This will help us avoid situations when a sub dives and instantly disappears from the enemy's viewing range.

It became easier and more convenient to control diving and surfacing, while different submergence levels will have different effects on gameplay.

[h3][b]Torpedoes and sonar pings[/b][/h3]
Submarines' weapons will become more effective against maneuverable targets and less effective against ships with powerful anti-torpedo defenses:
[list][*]Torpedoes now deal less damage but have an increased chance of critically damaging modules.
[*]Torpedoes don't ignore anti-torpedo defenses when the effect of two sonar pings is active.
[*]Launching a sonar ping became more convenient and obvious. When aiming a sonar ping, the camera follows the target automatically, just like in the firing mode.
[*]Emitting sonar pings increases a submarine's visibility.
[*]Torpedo aiming at the targets highlighted by sonar pings has been improved.
[*]Now, sonar pings highlight both sides of the ship they hit, and torpedoes continue to follow the target even if it turns the side on which the pings landed away.
[*]The captain of the ship highlighted by a sonar ping sees the direction from which a submarine attacks them, similar to the Radio Location skill.
[*]Damage Control Party removes the sonar ping effect.[/list]
[h3][b]Hydrophone[/b][/h3]
Surface ships now have new ways of affecting submarine operations due to their limited dive capacity that starts to deplete more quickly once they are discovered under water. For this reason, we have removed the Hydrophone from the game.

[h3][b]Other Changes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]We've added upgrades, Commander skills, and new consumables for submarines. You can view them in the game client. When submarines are added to the main server, you'll be able to reset Commander skills for free.
[*]A part of existing skills for destroyers, cruisers, and battleships will receive additional effects to counter submarines.
[*]Submarines' secondary batteries fire semi-armor-piercing shells.
[*]We've updated ribbons, achievements, mission requirements, upgrades and consumables functioning, and settings for maps and modes.
[*]We've updated the underwater world for most maps—the seabed relief and underwater parts of islands. This will help you to take your bearings in battle better.
[*]We've also fixed many errors, enhanced the game client stability, updated effects, and made a multitude of other technical improvements.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1e7f4bea-c871-11eb-8c09-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1eb9ca0e-c871-11eb-b150-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1ea34bd0-c871-11eb-8ef3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][h1=playing-submarine][/h1]Playing Submarines[/b][/h2]
Submarines are fragile and cautious hunters. Their diving depth affects their detectability, viewing range, and interaction possibilities with other submarines and ships. Maneuver, change your diving depth, hide from your enemies, and surprise them with stealth attacks.

Submarines have a small HP pool, so stick to the flanks and attack your opponents while submerged. Change position often, try to enlist the support of your teammates, and dive deeper in of immediate danger.

The main targets for submarines at the beginning and middle of a battle are cruisers and destroyers. These ship types keep submarines in check and keep them from breaking through to sluggish battleships.

[h3][b]Submarine Controls[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The [b]W[/b], [b]A[/b], [b]S[/b], and [b]D[/b] keys control horizontal movement.
[*]Press [b]F[/b] to ascend.
[*]Press [b]C[/b] to dive.
[*][b]1[/b]—sonar pings.
[*][b]2[/b]—torpedoes.
[*][b]T[/b]—a consumable that emits a wave from the underwater hydrophone. It highlights the underwater topography and displays ships, including those that are located beyond the underwater visibility distance.[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0bd43ed6-c873-11eb-9308-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Surfaced and Submerged Submarines[/b][/h3]
Submarines have four submergence levels: surface, periscope depth, operating depth, and maximum depth.

The time that submarines can spend under water per battle is limited by their dive capacity. It can last up to 10 minutes depending on the submarine. If a submarine is discovered at the periscope depth or under water, the dive capacity is consumed more quickly.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3b2c4d4a-c873-11eb-9308-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
When you run out of dive capacity, a submarine will have to surface and won't be able to dive until the end of this battle.

Shells, ship and aerial torpedoes, bombs, and rockets are dangerous for submarines that are on the surface or at the periscope depth.

The deeper submarines dive, the lower their detectability is. Moreover, submerged submarines have lower speed and enemy ships are less visible to them.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3b347204-c873-11eb-a9f8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Each submergence level needs to be used in a specific situation, considering its penalties and bonuses.
[list][*]The surface level is the riskiest, but you don't spend any dive capacity at it. Capturing Key Areas is only possible in this position.
[*]At the periscope depth, submarines can move at the full speed and become less visible. Descend to this level to assume an attack position quickly and without being noticed.
[*]At the operating depth, submarines have much lower visibility, but the enemy ships are also harder to detect. This position is the best to attack a target that you have already discovered.
[*]In case of immediate danger, dive to the maximum depth—your submarine can't be detected by other ships. This comes at a price—at this level your sub can detect only other submarines at operating and maximum depth that are within your guaranteed acquisition radius.[/list]
[h3][b]Acoustic Homing Torpedoes[/b][/h3]
The main armament carried by submarines is [b]acoustic homing torpedoes.[/b] The sonar pings mechanic will help you increase the potential effectiveness of your torpedo salvos. By hitting an enemy ship with a sonar ping you activate acoustic homing on this ship. Torpedoes can ascend from the depths and hit an enemy only with the help of an active effect from a sonar ping.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e6004802-c86e-11eb-a9cc-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]
[list][*]You can launch torpedoes and sonar pings from any depth. When under water, you can launch sonar pings in any direction—even at targets above or below your submarines.
[*]Aim for an enemy ship, take a lead on the target, and click the left mouse button.
[*]Sonar pings travel much faster at the operating depth. This helps you hit maneuverable targets.
[*]Upon hitting a target, part of the hull will be highlighted. The size of the highlighted part depends on the ping's width. Torpedoes will home in on it. The pinged part of the target ship will also be highlighted for the player controlling that ship. Moreover, they will see an indicator showing the approximate direction, from which the ping was launched.
[*]A repeat hit to the highlighted part of the hull will make your torpedoes ascend to the optimum depth and deal more damage.
[*]The effect of a successful ping hit remains active for up to 35 seconds, depending on the exact submarine. Hitting the highlighted part of a ship with another sonar ping will reset its action time.
[*]If a sonar ping hits part of a ship that isn't highlighted, the spot from the previous sonar ping will relocate to the new area and the active effect will continue working. The effect timer won't be updated if the target was under the effect of two sonar ping hits at the same area.[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0bdce1e4-c873-11eb-bcd5-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
If you attack a ship from afar, keep emitting sonar pings to maintain their effect while your torpedoes are traveling to their target. Remember that guiding your torpedo to its target with the help of sonar pings doesn't guarantee a hit.
[list][*]They lose speed when turning and can’t catch up to a ship that's actively maneuvering.
[*]The target knows the approximate direction from which torpedoes approach it.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e608d6de-c86e-11eb-b447-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]
[*]Upon approaching the target to a certain distance, torpedo homing gets disabled, and it will travel straight ahead. If the enemy changes speed or course during this time, your torpedo might miss it.[/list]
Launching a sonar ping makes your submarine more visible, consider it if the enemy is nearby.

[h2][b][h1=counter-submarine][/h1]Playing Against Submarines[/b][/h2]
Many destroyers and some light cruisers carry depth charges that are capable to hit submarines lurking in the depth. Approach the approximate location of the submarine and release your depth charges using the [b]G[/b] key.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e5fd99f4-c86e-11eb-b00b-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

Some battleships and heavy cruisers can call anti-submarine defense aircraft. You can choose that armament type by pressing [b]4[/b]. The camera rises and the reticle allows you to select an area within a 10 km radius from the ship. Aircraft will arrive and drop depth charges in this area shortly after selecting it.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/e60b92a2-c86e-11eb-8252-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

In addition to depth charges and anti-submarine defense aircraft, high-explosive shells, Surveillance Radar and Hydroacoustic Search will come in handy when fighting against submarines.
[list][*]A submarine on the surface can be hit with shells, ship- and airborne torpedoes, bombs, and rockets, as well as by ramming.
[*]High-explosive shells are the most effective shell type to deploy against submarines. They can inflict damage to a submarine even when they don't directly strike one. Falling in a sub's vicinity is enough, thanks to the shell's fragmentation damage area.
[*]Depth charges and anti-submarine defense aircraft have several charges that are restored in sequence. This armament can be activated several times in a row.
[*]If your ship is hit by sonar ping, the hit part will be highlighted and an indicator will show the direction from which it was launched. This will help you define the location of the submarine that attacks you. Change course constantly to make it more difficult for the enemy to hit you.[/list] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3cbb40d0-c873-11eb-85fa-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]If you're hit by a sonar ping, you can remove its effect by using the Damage Control Party consumable.
[*]Submarine torpedoes have a high probability of damaging ship modules—keep your Damage Control Party at hand.
[*]Surveillance Radar detects submarines at the periscope depth; Hydroacoustic Search detects them at the maximum depth. Detection will increase the rate at which the submarine depletes its dive capacity.
[*]A submarine can spend only a limited time under water in a battle—it will have to surface sooner or later. If you can detect a submerged submarine, it will consume its dive capacity faster.[/list]
[b]Take part in the test and evaluate the submarine improvements for yourself![/b]

notes.title: Armada: Ise
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/12e7f1a90a626f23cd10e1227874c2eae0964bb9.jpg[/img]
[b]The first hybrid ship—Ise—has dropped anchor in World of Warships. Prepare for a unique hybrid naval warfare experience![/b]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2507093708
[h2][b]History[/b][/h2]
Ise, the lead ship of her series, was ordered as part of a planned replenishment program for the Japanese Navy under the 1914–1915 budget. It was originally planned for Ise and Hyūga—the latter being the second battleship of this class—to become the third and the fourth Fusō-class battleships. However, their project was reworked and they formed their own separate class. The placement of their central turrets was changed, secondary battery guns with a higher rate of fire were mounted, and their armor protection was also improved.

In November 1916, Ise was launched, and on December 15, 1917 she was equipped. After Ise was put into operation, she became the flagship of the 1st Battleship Division. She received various improvements during her service, and between 1934 and 1937, both ships were modernized. This significantly increased their speed.

In June 1942, Ise, together with other Japanese battleships, took part in the Battle of Midway. After losing four aircraft carriers in that battle, the Imperial Japanese Navy General Staff planned to convert both Ise-class battleships into aircraft carriers. However, full refurbishment would have taken a great deal of time and money. For this reason, the battleship was only partially rebuilt—her aft superstructures were removed and replaced by flight decks. Ise underwent reconstruction from February 23 to October 8, 1943.

In late October 1944, Ise participated in the Battle of Leyte Gulf. Later, Ise and Hyūga were tasked with transporting fuel, rubber, tin, and other materials to Japan. During an American air raid on Kure in 1945, Ise was sunk. A year later, she was raised from the bottom and scrapped.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6282d566-c2d9-11eb-beb2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Modeling the Ship[/b][/h2]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VI Ise[/b][/b] is the first hybrid ship that combines the traits of both the battleship and aircraft carrier ship types. She can attack her enemies both with artillery fire and from the air with the aid of her torpedo bombers.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/725aad02-c2dd-11eb-ac8a-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

[b]Main battery:[/b] eight 356 mm/45 41st Year Type guns in twin turrets

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/71bfc5ee-c2dd-11eb-ac39-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

[b]Dual-purpose battery:[/b] sixteen 127 mm/40 Type 89 guns in Model A1 mounts

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/244fb660-c2de-11eb-ac8a-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

[b]AA defenses:[/b] 93 25 mm/60 Type 96 anti-aircraft guns in triple mounts, 11 similar guns in single mounts, 180 120 mm AA Rocket anti-aircraft guns
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6147065e-c2d9-11eb-a3e9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Upgrades[/b][/h2]
[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/modernization/icon_modernization_PCM030_MainWeapon_Mod_I_bb1e79efbcc73dfa03a6dd5ae173566ee691b77e3a6587389d6f7ea07eb03588.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/modernization/icon_modernization_PCM020_DamageControl_Mod_I_bbc708467bc8f1e6264ac88fb8999ea40660e4b0b94b59ab7b3f1a8b60539ed8.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/modernization/icon_modernization_PCM033_Guidance_Mod_I_10c7521afe2d577c42618dd04cf6834f2be78cf6b64503844cf87793a5816484.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/modernization/icon_modernization_PCM023_DamageControl_Mod_II_3c6aea0c5bccc94f1d8f1fa52662232afa007d784638ce6e981c8ad3457c63fa.png[/img]
[list][*]Main Armaments Modification 1
[*]Damage Control System Modification 1

[h2][b][h1=key-features][/h1]Main Features[/b][/h2]
Update 0.10.1 brings updated Brawls! They are now a separate battle type with short seasons and a smaller team format—expect the battles to be more dynamic and fast-paced compared to other battle types! You can participate either in a Division or solo, and you don't need to be a member of a Clan. Team up with friends to win more battles!
[list][*]Each Brawl runs for only a few days. This battle type isn't available during low-activity periods.
[*]You'll be able to complete a special combat mission chain—win battles to earn Credits, Coal, and other rewards!
[*]Your allies are picked at random if you don't enter the queue in a Division. Matchmaking takes your ship type into account.
[*]The ship-type compositions of each team won't necessarily mirror each other.
[*]For each new battle, you won't be matched with any opponents who you fought against in your last several battles.
[*]Bonuses for the first win of the day are not available in Brawls.[/list]
[h2][b][h1=rules][/h1]Rules[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Start:[/b] [b]Mon. 07 Jun. 10:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[list][i]You can take part in the Brawl only during the time period specified for your server.[/i][/list]

[h3][b]Format[/b][/h3]
5 vs. 5, playing Tier X ships of any type.

[list][*]A maximum of one aircraft carrier.
[*]Up to two battleships. If the team has one aircraft carrier, there can be no more than one battleship in the same team.
[*]Up to two cruisers.
[*]Up to two destroyers.[/list]
[h3][b]Game maps and modes[/b][/h3]
New Dawn, Trident, Warrior’s Path, Shards, and Crash Zone Alpha; Domination mode.

notes.title: Warhammer SKULLS - Show Your Loyalty to the Imperium or Chaos
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e767db92d64906140c0ed603f147910960ae9dab.jpg[/img]

[h2][b][h1=special-content][/h1]Special Content for World of Warships[/b][/h2]
The 41st Millennium is back in World of Warships. 
[b]The DLCs will be available for purchase until:[/b] [b]10 June. 18:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

[h2]Ships[/h2]
Two special battleships with distinctive themed camouflage patterns—Chaos [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VIII Ragnarok[/b][/b] and Imperial Navy [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VIII Ignis Purgatio[/b][/b]—are already in the game!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1650241/World_of_Warships__Ragnarok
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1650240/World_of_Warships__Ignis_Purgatio
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/710d57e3870a7aa2a972c255ff491e96c93857f1.jpg[/img]

[h2]Details[/h2]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VIII Ragnarok[/b][/b] is an immeasurably ancient vessel, a relic of days long forgotten. It was built in the shipyards orbiting a world of proud and fearsome warriors. Though the citizens adhered to the Imperial creed and paid their tithes, secret cabals on the planet’s surface worshipped Khorne, the Lord of Rage. Their cults were strong. They were hated. They were in a minority. At the appointed hour, they rose up and tried to overthrow their loyalist masters. They failed. They were defeated in a long, bloody war and all, to a man, perished in flames. Their names were wiped from history. But the fickle whims of the Warp decreed that their vengeful spirits would forever haunt the vessel Ragnarok, whose hull was being constructed in the docks above the planet's surface. To this day, Ragnarok and all aboard it cry, "Vengeance! Death! Blood for the Blood God!"

For a detailed look at the ship's technical specifications, follow this [url=https://wiki.wargaming.net/en/Ship:Ragnarok]link[/url].

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e6785e4e-affd-11ea-bd74-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e6c86114-affd-11ea-b661-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e701712a-affd-11ea-a1fc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e6bdc524-affd-11ea-897f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

Originally designed for a Naval mission of the purpose now long forgotten, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VIII Ignis Purgatio[/b][/b] was lost during the Horus Heresy. After missing for several millennia, the ship was rediscovered on one of the Frontier worlds in the Jericho Reach. Though clearly a warship, it was put to use as a transport by its new, uncouth masters who failed to recognize its true potential. After undergoing intensive repairs and cleansing its quarters of its previous inhabitants, Ignis Purgatio was eventually returned to Imperial Navy service and, since then, it has become an essential component of Battlefleet Solar. Once again, it acts as a fearsome guard dog for humanity and, by proxy, the Emperor Himself.

For a detailed look at the ship's technical specifications, follow this [url=https://wiki.wargaming.net/en/Ship:Ignis_Purgatio]link[/url].

[h2]Commanders[/h2]
The World of Warships Commander roster will be see the addition of two new characters: a valiant naval officer of pious military lineage—Justinian Lyons XIII, and an Aspiring Champion of Khorne—Arthas Roqthar the Cold. Each Commander has their own unique voiceover!
[list]The new Commanders are available only in bundles together with the Warhammer 40,000-themed battleships.[/list]
[list][i]Here are some voice samples—take a listen![/i][/list]
[previewyoutube=I2qqrj7qUAQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]What is Warhammer 40,000?[/b][/h2]
Warhammer 40,000 is the pinnacle of tabletop wargaming, produced by Games Workshop. Its distinct visual style blends elements of science fiction and fantasy to create a beautifully dark atmosphere that has amassed a massive following over the years. Today, the universe has expanded to video games, novels, comics, and more, garnering a huge following around the globe.

Together with Games Workshop, we’ve created something that would stay true to the renowned fantasy IP, while also resonating with our universe of naval battles.

notes.title: Developer Bulletin for Update 0.10.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/4445b9b9355f6287012de83c66cf1e36d2aa5ade.png[/img]
[list][b][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.[/b][/list]
[list][i]Please note: the rewards for activities on the Public Test server may differ from those on the Live Server.[/i][/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#grand-battle]Grand Battle[/url] ● [url=#damage-caused-to-allies]Damage Caused to Allies[/url] ● [url=#changes-to-attack-aircraft]Changes to Attack Aircraft[/url] ● [url=#other-changes]Other Changes[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b][h1=grand-battle][/h1]Grand Battle[/b][/h2]
A new temporary battle type—Grand Battle—awaits you, and its main feature comes in the form of super battleships. When legendary battleship Yamato was destroyed by aircraft carriers, it presaged the domination of deck aviation in naval warfare. Super battleships are the ships that might have existed if shipbuilding had moved toward the development of main batteries as the primary decisive factor of battle.

Two super battleships will be available to you in the Grand Battle:
[list][*][b]Satsuma[/b] is a project based on Yamato with reinforced primary armament—510 mm guns in four twin-gun turrets.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/731c17ea-bd3c-11eb-98ad-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7327c838-bd3c-11eb-8e4e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7419fffe-bd3c-11eb-ab2a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][*][b]Hannover[/b] is a version of the H-42 project with 483 mm guns in four twin-gun turrets and her secondary battery replaced with dual-purpose artillery with a caliber of 128 mm.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/73c72acc-bd3c-11eb-bd99-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/733435b4-bd3c-11eb-8b0a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/73148660-bd3c-11eb-be29-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]Things You Should Know[/h2]
[list][*]Battle format is 9 vs 9, playing Tier IX–X ships, including super battleships. Restrictions: no more than three super battleships per team.
[*]Once Update 0.10.5 is released, you will receive Satsuma and Hannover for rent.
[*]To enter battle at the helm of a super battleship, you will need a new temporary resource—[b]Intelligence Reports[/b]. Participate in the Grand Battle playing Tier IX–X ships to earn the new resource.
[*]The rewards include Dazzling expendable camouflages, a commemorative flag, and the Grand Battle patch.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c315f932-bd69-11eb-a8a1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/feb19032-bd41-11eb-8e4e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Adjustment Fire[/b][/h3]
New mechanics have been added for the super battleships—adjustment fire. Each gun salvo that hits a locked target, or lands near it, fills the adjustment fire meter. As soon as it is filled, some ship characteristics get a temporary boost. Satsuma receives a bonus to the accuracy of her main battery; Hannover receives a bonus to the range and accuracy of her secondary battery.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/44a53cd8-bd6a-11eb-a5cf-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/44a42794-bd6a-11eb-9d4c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]The bonuses can be applied an unlimited number of times in a single battle. If the ship ceases firing for a certain amount of time, the progress of the adjustment fire meter resets.[/i][/list]
Thanks to the new mechanics, you can reinforce your ship directly in battle, but to use this feature to maximum effect, you will need to plan your actions and positioning in advance. This will make the gameplay more interesting and diverse.

[h2][b][h1=damage-caused-to-allies][/h1]Damage Caused to Allies[/b][/h2]
In Update 0.10.5, we are disabling the ability to cause damage to allies. This change will have a positive impact on gameplay—your teammates won't be able to damage or destroy your ship now.

[h2]Main changes[/h2]
[list][*]You can no longer damage allied ships, disable their modules, cause detonation, or destroy them. You can't damage allies by ramming them either.
[*]At the same time, all armament types will still hit allied ships. For example, you won't be able to launch torpedoes at an enemy through an allied ship.
[*]A warning for unsportsmanlike behavior will now be issued for a certain number of hits on allied ships with any armament type, except for secondary battery hits. You can now be issued a warning for unsportsmanlike behavior only if you hit allied ships with torpedoes and main battery shells 15 times or more.
[*]If you continue to break the rules, you will be banned from all battle types, except for Co-op, Clan, and Training Battles.
[*]Additionally, you won't earn any Credits or XP for any battle in which you receive the warning for attacking your teammates. If you don't break the rules in your next battles, any resources you earn will be credited to you as usual.
[*]The return damage that a ship receives as a penalty for hitting teammates will grow with each subsequent hit on an allied ship.
[*]Camera effects that indicate incoming damage won't be active for a ship that is hit by an ally.
[*]The warning about allied torpedoes has also been removed, since they can no longer inflict damage.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/44a64aec-bd6a-11eb-af78-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4470b0a8-bd6a-11eb-a8a1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/44a8dd84-bd6a-11eb-8813-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][i]Damage to allies has been disabled for all battle types.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=changes-to-attack-aircraft][/h1]Changes to Attack Aircraft[/b][/h2]
In Update 0.10.5, the rocket-launching mechanics are being updated. Attack aircraft will now fire small-caliber machine guns prior to an attack. They don't inflict damage to ships, but show the exact spot where the rockets are going to hit. This information, together with a prolonged attack time, will allow the Captains of agile ships—destroyers, primarily—to maneuver, and thus reduce possible rocket damage.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c7488e5a-bd43-11eb-bebf-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c749388c-bd43-11eb-a507-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]This change will be applied to the attack aircraft of all carriers.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=other-changes][/h1]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
A new nation—the Netherlands—has been added. The Netherlands cruiser branch, which is currently being tested, will be transferred to it; once Update 0.10.6 releases, [b]Friesland[/b] will also be transferred to it.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4520bc32-bd6a-11eb-8371-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/87670440-bd40-11eb-8492-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]Recruitment Points have been updated. They will become a more versatile resource that can be earned by participating in various activities and exchanged for valuable and rare rewards.
[list][*]Recruitment Points have been renamed [i]Community Tokens[/i].
[*]You will be able to earn the Tokens by participating in the Recruiting Station referral program, by participating in activities on the Public Test server, for watching World of Warships official streams, and during various regional and global activities.
[*]You can spend Community Tokens on different items in the Armory: ships, containers, permanent and expendable camouflages, commemorative flags, and other rewards.[/list]
We have updated the sorting and filters in the "Ships" section of the Armory. This change will make navigation easier and allow you to find any ships you are looking for faster.
[list][*]The ships have been arranged in themed sets.
[*]They can now be sorted by various criteria, for example—cost and name.
[*]A price range can now be specified when selecting a resource in the filters.
[*]A filter for ships that can be purchased at a discount has also been added.[/list]

The display of upgrades in the Equipment tab has been updated.
[list][*]Now, a full list of upgrades available for purchase is shown in each slot.
[*]While in the Equipment tab of the Port, you can now click through to purchase special or unique upgrades from the Armory.
[*]Upgrade sorting has been updated.
[*]A button allowing you to return to the Equipment tab has been added to the purchase status pop-up window.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/452369aa-bd6a-11eb-b899-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Battle of the Beasts
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/b14f359497144aa18f005ffb8ecb0fb973113d64.jpg[/img]
[b]Update 0.10.4 brings a new temporary event—the Battle of the Beasts—which is inspired by Germanic mythology. Join one of four teams to complete missions and earn rewards!
[/b]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#things-you-should-know]Things You Should Know[/url] ● [url=#rules-of-the-battle-of-the-beasts]Rules of the Battle of the Beasts[/url] ● [url=#rewards]Rewards[/url] ● [url=#german-destroyers-collection]German Destroyers Collection[/url] ● [url=#german-destroyers-collection]Free Daily Bundles[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b][h1=things-you-should-know][/h1]Things You Should Know[/b][/h2]
[list][*]The event lasts a month and is spread over four stages. Each stage lasts 1 week.
[*]Each week, you can fight for one of four teams.
[*]During the event, you can complete personal missions that are issued daily to all event participants.
[*]Completing missions will advance you through personal and team progress bars, as well as unlock rewards.[/list]
[h2][b][h1=rules-of-the-battle-of-the-beasts][/h1]Rules of the Battle of the Beasts[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts: [/b] [b]Thu. 20 May 09:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends: [/b] [b]Wed. 16 Jun. 03:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[h2]Key Rules[/h2]
[list][*]The event is divided into four stages, each lasting 1 week.
[*]Before starting each stage, you can choose one of four teams:
[list][*][b]Welthund[/b]: a huge black dog with a sole big eye on its forehead. It gets bigger and angrier during epidemics and wars.
[*][b]Feuerputz[/b]: a demon that can take on different forms. Most often, it appears as a flaming skeleton or horseman.
[*][b]Glühschwanz[/b]: a night ghost in the guise of a dragon. It flies to the homes of witches and miscreants in search of treats at night. If it doesn't receive treats, it burns their houses.
[*][b]Lindwurm[/b]: a wingless creature with a dragon's head and a serpentine body that lies in wait for its victims by the water.[/list][/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1cbc7f3a-b7b9-11eb-94a7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Participants receive special missions throughout each day. Completing the missions will progress you through personal and team milestones.
[*]The missions can be completed playing Tier V–X ships in Random, Co-op, and Ranked Battles.
[*]Progress is reset to zero at the beginning of each next stage.
[*]All players who have reached Access Level 8 can participate in the event.[/list]
[h2]Missions[/h2]
[list][*]Three mission types, with a limited allotted time for each mission, are available to you each day.
[list][*]Missions are issued in a sequential order every 40 minutes.
[*]The allotted time for each mission is 120 minutes.[/list][/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/58ac42fa-b7b9-11eb-a575-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]After a mission expires, the next mission of the same type becomes available.
[*]Battles that end after a mission expires are counted towards the next mission. The only exception is the last missions of each day — the time for counting its results is extended by 20 minutes.
[*]A total of 25 missions are available throughout each day.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1c6de12c-b7b9-11eb-a575-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The missions are only available during a certain time period each day.

[list][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/d7c15ed8-b4ba-11eb-b410-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]Starts: [b]09:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
Ends: [b]03:30 CEST (UTC+2)
[/b][/list]
[h2]Personal and Team Progress[/h2]
[list][*]Completing the missions will earn you Points that increase your personal and your team progress.
[*]When you reach certain personal and team milestones, you'll receive rewards. For each personal milestone achieved, you'll immediately receive the corresponding reward. To receive a reward for team progress, your personal progress must be equal to or surpass your team's progress.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/69f8d3c8-b6df-11eb-9cbb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]During the week, you can obtain up to 10 rewards: five for personal progress and five for team progress.
[*]To obtain all 10 rewards during the week, you should earn 1500 Personal Progress Points and 1500 Team Progress Points.[/list]
[h2]Earning Points[/h2]
[list][*]Each mission has four completion marks. Reaching each mark will earn you 20 Points. In total, you can earn 80 Points in one mission.[/list]
[i]For example, a mission to earn Base XP may have the following marks: 800 Base XP; 2,000 Base XP; 4,000 Base XP; and 8,000 Base XP. After earning 800 Base XP, you get 20 Points. However, to get the maximum number of Points for this mission and reach the fourth completion mark, you should earn 8,000 Base XP.[/i]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1c9ed750-b7b9-11eb-b574-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]If you complete the missions more efficiently than other players, then after completing a mission, you’ll receive between 10–25 additional Personal Progress Points, as well as be able to see your position in the overall player standings.[/list]
[i]For example, if you complete a mission to earn Base XP and earn more XP than 50% of the other players, you'll be awarded additional Points when the mission ends.[/i]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1d90a242-b7b9-11eb-a353-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]The results are summed up when each mission expires, and the teams take their places in the overall team standings.
[*]A team receives 5, 7, 9, or 12 Points per mission, based on its position in the team standings. The position in the overall standings, in its turn, depends on the activity of the members of each team.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1d43c1d4-b7b9-11eb-aa88-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][h1=rewards][/h1]Rewards[/b][/h2]
Advancing through your personal and team progress bars will earn you flags and patches with your team's symbols, as well as themed Commanders and a new temporary resource—[b]Beast Tokens[/b] [img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_2_26adc7d6ff2af59aff267a55c819b680d5c441ad85431968558da6f9359aa07a.png[/img].
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b5ac0058-b7b9-11eb-a575-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
If you select a new team each week, you can collect all the Commanders, flags, and patches. All Commanders of the Battle of the Beasts event have 10 skill points and are specialized for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]I Hermelin[/b][/b].

You can have an unlimited number of identical Battle of the Beasts Commanders simultaneously. If you don't change your team, then upon reaching a certain mark on the team's progress bar, you'll receive another themed Commander, as well as compensation for a patch in the amount of [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]15,000[/b] Credits.

[list][i]You will also be able to earn one of each new Commander by completing missions obtainable through special Twitch Drops. Stay tuned for a dedicated article with more details.[/i][/list]

[h2]Beast Tokens[/h2]
In total, you can obtain up to 440 Tokens: 400 for completing the event missions and 40 from free daily bundles in the Armory.

The Tokens can be exchanged in the Armory for various in-game items, including German Destroyers containers that drop elements for the collection of the same name, as well as Battle of Jutland containers.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4edb0b4c-b7ed-11eb-846e-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
You can obtain up to two Battle of Jutland containers in exchange for Beast Tokens.

A Battle of Jutland container can drop [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]III König Albert[/b][/b] or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]V Agincourt[/b][/b], as well as the "To Honor Skagerrak" and Jutland Veteran permanent camouflages for these ships, or other rewards.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b0ae1208-b7e6-11eb-9a57-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Five German Destroyers containers can be purchased in exchange for 200 Recruitment Points each.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/93d74810-b3f0-11eb-9b88-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]With the release of Update 0.10.6, Beast Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]9,000[/b].[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=german-destroyers-collection][/h1]German Destroyers Collection[/b][/h2]
The German Destroyers collection is dedicated to German destroyers and will inform you about the history of ships of this type, as well as the people who served on them.

The collection consists of four sections, with four elements in each.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/07d097f2-b6e5-11eb-833e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/07c2ce4c-b6e5-11eb-8009-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/079048a0-b6e5-11eb-a7fe-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0781c898-b6e5-11eb-bcaa-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[b]Rewards for completing the sections:[/b] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Warships Premium Account[/b] for each section.

[b]Rewards for completing the entire collection:[/b] an Iron Cross permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]VIII Gustav Julius Maerker[/b][/b] and a flag of the "German Destroyers: Part 2" event.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/90fd7d54-b4c1-11eb-be6b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The exchange rate for duplicate elements is 4:1. After you complete the collection, all duplicates will automatically be exchanged for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]15,000[/b] Credits each.

[list][i]Elements of the collection can only be obtained from German Destroyers containers.[/i][/list]
[list]You can claim a free German Destroyers container in a special article dedicated to the collection. Stay tuned for updates on our website![/list]
[h2][b][h1=german-destroyers-collection][/h1]Free Daily Bundles[/b][/h2]
The Armory is offering free random bundles. Within them, you'll find Beast Tokens, [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Warships Premium Account[/b], Doubloons, and other rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]The bundles are available until: [/b] [b]Mon. 07 Jun. 08:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3286c054-b7ba-11eb-a353-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]You can obtain only one bundle per day. A total of 12 bundles will be available, so you can skip 6 days and still be able to collect all the rewards.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=german-destroyers-part-2][/h1]German Destroyers: Part 2[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/68a2c2fa-b490-11eb-b756-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Features of the Ship Branch[/h2]
[list][*]Accurate main battery guns with a large caliber for this ship type—150 mm.
[*]Powerful AP shells with decent penetration, damage, and enhanced shell ricochet angles. They are capable of dealing significant damage to cruisers.
[*]Good armor for their type, which effectively protects them against the HE shells of most destroyers (unless they have mastered the Inertia Fuse for HE Shells skill), as well as large HP pools. Combined with their effective artillery, this results in special gameplay for the new German destroyers. They are essentially agile ships that primarily focus on lone targets—light cruisers in particular.
[*]The low damage per minute of their HE shells and their high detectability means that these new ships are quite ineffective when fighting for control of Key Areas.
[*]The Smoke Generator consumable improves the already good survivability of the new ships even further. Starting from Tier IX, German destroyers have the Defensive AA Fire consumable, which allows them to counter enemy aircraft with greater confidence.
[*]Despite their torpedoes' slow speed and pretty standard reload time for most destroyers, they can deal heavy damage and have good range.[/list]
[h2]Early Access[/h2]
German destroyers [b][b]VII Z-31[/b][/b] and [b][b]VIII Gustav Julius Maerker[/b][/b], which hit the seas in Early Access with the release of Update 0.10.3, continue to be available in consecutive bundles at the Armory. [b][b]IX Felix Schultz[/b][/b] can be found in random bundles that are available in exchange for Doubloons in the Armory.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/f0401106-9922-11eb-a25b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0edb3d36-9ba1-11eb-8396-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0e67aeb6-9ba1-11eb-b464-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0ed83f3c-9ba1-11eb-9170-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
During Update 0.10.4, German Tokens can be found in bundles that are available in the Armory. These Tokens can be spent until the end of Update 0.10.4. At the end of the update, they will be exchanged for Credits at the rate of 1:[b]2,100[/b].
[list][i]When Update 0.10.5 goes live, German Tier VII–X destroyers will be available for all players to research.[/i][/list]
[h2][b][h1=battle-of-the-beasts][/h1]Battle of the Beasts[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/6a95aa6e-b490-11eb-b3ed-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts: [/b] [b]Thu. 20 May 09:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends: [/b] [b]Wed. 16 Jun. 03:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

During Update 0.10.4, you can take part in the new "Battle of Beasts" temporary event, which is inspired by German folklore. Join one of four teams to complete missions and earn rewards!

[h3][b]Key Rules[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The event is divided into four stages, with each stage running for 1 week.
[*]Before starting each stage, you can choose one of four teams:
[list][*][b]Welthund[/b]: a huge black dog with a sole big eye on its forehead.
[*][b]Feuerputz[/b]: a demon that can take various guises. Most often, it appears as a flaming skeleton or horseman.
[*][b]Glühschwanz[/b]: a night ghost in the guise of a dragon.
[*][b]Lindwurm[/b]: a wingless creature with a dragon's head and a serpentine body.[/list]
[*]Event participants are issued special missions throughout each day. Completing the missions will progress you through personal and team milestones.
[*]The missions can be completed playing Tier V–X ships in Random, Co-op, and Ranked Battles.
[*]Progress is reset to zero at the beginning of each next stage.
[*]All players who have reached Access Level 8 can participate in the event.
[*]You'll earn rewards by reaching specific personal and team progress milestones.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6a0798d6-b6df-11eb-af16-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/69f8d3c8-b6df-11eb-9cbb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/69f91bb2-b6df-11eb-91c5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
The missions are only available during a certain time period each day.

[list][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/d7c15ed8-b4ba-11eb-b410-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]Starts: [b]09:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
Ends: [b]03:30 CEST (UTC+2)
[/b][/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/6082e160-b4b6-11eb-8ab2-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
The rewards include themed patches, flags, and 10-skill-point Commanders, as well a new temporary resource—[b]Beast Tokens [/b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_2_26adc7d6ff2af59aff267a55c819b680d5c441ad85431968558da6f9359aa07a.png[/img]. You can exchange these Tokens for various in-game items in the Armory, including Battle of Jutland and German Destroyers containers.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c124cf44-b6df-11eb-bcaa-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
A Battle of Jutland container can drop [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]III König Albert[/b][/b] or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]V Agincourt[/b][/b], the "To Honor Skagerrak" and Jutland Veteran permanent camouflages for these ships, or other rewards. German Destroyers containers can drop signals, expendable camouflages, and elements of the eponymous collection.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c72f29e6-b4c0-11eb-bbc8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c72d0f08-b4c0-11eb-a409-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list]You'll find a detailed description of the new event in a dedicated article. Stay tuned for more news on our website![/list]
[list][i]You will also be able to earn one of each new commander by completing missions obtainable through special Twitch Drops. Stay tuned for a dedicated article with more details.[/i][/list]

[h2][b][h1=german-destroyers-collection][/h1]German Destroyers Collection[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/68a47bc2-b490-11eb-bbed-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

This collection is dedicated to German destroyers and will inform you about the history of ships of this type, as well as the people who served on them. The collection consists of four sections, with four elements in each.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/07d097f2-b6e5-11eb-833e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/07c2ce4c-b6e5-11eb-8009-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/079048a0-b6e5-11eb-a7fe-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0781c898-b6e5-11eb-bcaa-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[b]Rewards for completing the sections:[/b] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Warships Premium Account[/b] for each section.
[img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/ensign/PCEE420_German_DD2_42bb2bba77b5932e36f35c27d306ed13c88ddf00d7f56b8ae648ea2976b432f2.png[/img][b]Rewards for completing the entire collection:[/b] include an Iron Cross permanent camouflage for [b][b]VIII Gustav Julius Maerker[/b][/b] and a flag of the "German Destroyers: Part 2" event.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/90fd7d54-b4c1-11eb-be6b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]Elements of the collection can only be obtained from German Destroyers containers.[/i][/list]
[list]You can get a free German Destroyers container in a special article that's dedicated to the collection. Stay tuned for more news on our website![/list]
[h2][b][h1=auction][/h1]Auction[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/68363a0e-b490-11eb-b429-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

With the launch of Update 0.10.4, we're adding a new way to obtain in-game items. We call it the "auction"—you can participate in it and compete with other players to obtain rare goodies. It represents a great additional way to stock up on desirable items and resources.

[h2]Key Rules[/h2]
[list][*]Each auction has a limited duration.
[*]It comprises the following stages:
[olist][*]The available lot for the auction is announced. Its starting price and number of possible bid winners are announced at the same time.
[*]The auction begins and bids are placed.
[*]Bidding ends. The results of the auction are summed up.
[*]The auction winners receive their rewards, while the unsuccessful auction participants receive their bids back.[/olist]
[*]You can change your bid amount at any time, provided that bidding for that lot is still active.
[*]The number of lots is limited. The highest bids win.
[*]Information will be provided about the starting bid for each lot and the number of possible winners.
[*]Depending on the lot, you can place various in-game resources as your bid.
[*]After the results are calculated, the highest bids win. If the bids are tied, the bids that were made earliest win. The time when the last bid change was made is also taken into account.
[*]It's a no-risk adventure! Any bid that doesn't win will be returned to the bidder when the auction closes.[/list]
[i]For example, if there is a lot for 500 commemorative flags, the 500 players with the highest and earliest bids will each receive one flag. All other bids will be returned to the participating players' accounts.[/i]

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0a83e580-b6e5-11eb-8815-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/07bc30b4-b6e5-11eb-860e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/06ed52e4-b6e5-11eb-86c7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/07c3ac72-b6e5-11eb-9522-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]Auction in Update 0.10.4[/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Fri. 28 May 14:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends: [/b] [b]Mon. 31 May 14:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[h3][b]Lots[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]100,000[/b] Coal: [i]starting bid[/i]—[b]25,000,000[/b] Credits; [b]5,000[/b] winners.
[*]British Commander [b]Adrian Griffiths[/b] with 14 skill points and 20 Rising expendable camouflages: [i]starting bid[/i]—9,000 Doubloons; [b]1,000[/b] winners.
[*]Thunderer commemorative flag: [i]starting bid[/i]—1,500 Doubloons; [b]2,500[/b] winners.[/list]
[list][i]The number of winners and starting bid amounts are the same for the CIS, EU, NA and ASIA World of Warships servers.[/i][/list]

[h2]Changes to Commander skills[/h2]
In Update 0.10.4, we've changed the following skills:

[h3][b]Cruiser skills[/b][/h3]
Survivability Expert:
[list][*]HP bonus for each ship tier increased from 350 to 450.
[*]HP bonus of the enhanced skill increased from 400 to 500.[/list]
[h3][b]Destroyer skills[/b][/h3]
Extra-Heavy AP Shells:
[list][*]Bonus applied to main battery AP shells increased from 5% to 7.5%.[/list]
Fearless Brawler:
[list][*]Ship detectability penalty removed.[/list]
[h3][b]Aircraft carrier skills[/b][/h3]
Enhanced Reactions:
[list][*]25% penalty to the action time of the Patrol Fighters and Interceptor consumables replaced with a 25% bonus.[/list]
[h3][b]Battleship skills[/b][/h3]
Super-Heavy AP Shells:
[list][*]Bonus applied to main battery AP shells increased from 5% to 7.5%.
[*]Penalty applied to fire-extinguishing time and flooding recovery time reduced from 30 to 25%.[/list]
Dead Eye
[list][*]The Dead Eye skill is replaced with the Swift in Silence skill, giving battleships a 10% speed increase while the ship remains undetected.[/list]
The parameters of these skills were inferior to other same-price skills in terms of combat efficiency, which affected their popularity.

The replacement of these skills adds more options for battleships in terms of positioning, and allows them to engage in combat or change position more rapidly during a skirmish. When Update 0.10.4 goes live, all Commanders with the Dead Eye skill already mastered will have their battleship skills reset free of charge. Skills associated with other ship types will not be reset.

[h2]Ship changes[/h2]
We've made changes to the parameters of certain ships based on our analysis of their battle efficiency and feedback from players. These changes were required in order to carefully adjust the balance of selected warships. Further changes may follow in future updates, should they be required.

[h3][b]Soviet Tier X destroyer Grozovoi[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Maximum damage of researchable torpedoes increased from 15,100 to 16,200.
[*]Chances of causing flooding with torpedoes increased from 250% to 271%.[/list]
[h3][b]German Tier X destroyer Z-52[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time reduced from 4 to 3.8 s[/list]
[h3][b]British Tier IX destroyer Jutland[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Torpedo tube reload time increased from 125 to 133 s.[/list]
[h3][b]Pan-Asian Tier VIII destroyer Hsienyang[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Range of researchable torpedoes increased from 9.2 to 9.5 km.
[*]Torpedo speed increased from 56 to 59 kts.[/list]
[h3][b]Pan-Asian Tier IX destroyer Chung Mu[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Range of stock torpedoes increased from 9.2 to 9.5 km.
[*]Torpedo speed increased from 56 to 59 kts.[/list]
[h3][b]Pan-Asian Tier VIII destroyer Fenyang[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time reduced from 5.2 to 4.9 s.[/list]
[h3][b]German Tier VIII destroyer Gustav-Julius Maerker[/b][/h3]

We've updated the interface to make navigating through the Achievements section, as well as tracking progress in the game, more comfortable:
[list][*]Updated the appearance of the Achievements screen.
[*]Added categories and updated the sorting of achievements.
[*]Updated pop-up tooltips in the Port and for post-battle statistics.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/08021b92-b6e5-11eb-a404-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Having updated the section, we'll be able to add more achievements to the game in future.

Changed the conditions for obtaining rewards for achievements. They will be replaced by weekly chains of combat missions for Base XP in victorious battles. The missions can be completed in Ranked, Random, and Co-op Battles, as well as in Operations and Brawls. This will allow you to replenish your signals in most battles. At the same time, the mission conditions have different difficulties. For instance, you could win often in Co-op battles for less XP per battle, or achieve the same result by winning fewer Random or Ranked battles for more XP per battle.

Two combat mission chains are available to you:
[list][*]The first comprises three missions with the same condition. You must earn 2,500 Base XP in victorious battles. Reward: up to three More Signals containers and one Gift container.
[*]The second includes five missions with the same condition. You must earn 5,000 Base XP in victorious battles. Reward: up to five More Signals containers and two Gift containers.[/list]

Tiger '59 has low detectability, decent maneuverability, and a large set of consumables—Specialized Repair Teams, Surveillance Radar, Smoke Generator, and Defensive AA Fire. All aircraft called in with Airstrike are currently armed with HE bombs. Such aircraft will be effective at medium ranges and drop bombs over an area that's similar in size to two battleships. At the same time, the aircraft do not require direct control, unlike those launched from aircraft carriers.

Greetings, Captains!

In celebration of our new partnership with the "Godzilla vs. Kong" movie, we're holding a special giveaway with guaranteed prizes! You stand a chance to win our new themed Kong or Godzilla camouflages, worth 5,000 Doubloons! 

[h1]How to Enter:[/h1]

[*]The avatar and background must stay on your profile for at least a week. 
[*]Any comments that miss the correct information or break the discussion rules may be deleted or excluded.
[*]The comment thread will be locked on May 21. The results will be announced in this thread on May 28. Prizes will be awarded within a week.

notes.title: High School Fleet Returns to World of Warships!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/dacfd6966ffaf1b8ec6a37b0849c6f37e6af0066.jpg[/img]
[b]Captains![/b]

We're happy to announce a new stage of collaboration between World of Warships and the popular High School Fleet anime series. It brings back a themed collection, ship Commanders, and a selection of original camouflages styled after the series.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2465569702

[list]Interested? Click the Participate button to gain access to some special combat mission chains. Complete them to obtain containers that will allow you to start gathering elements of the collection. As a reward for finishing it, you can obtain the K117 camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]X Yamato[/b][/b] and other items. [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/60fc998e-a36c-11eb-9bf2-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Powerful, long-range torpedoes in combination with good concealment allow the ship to carry out devastating surprise attacks, while the availability of several artillery armament variants allows the destroyer to determine her own fighting style.

[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VI HSF Admiral Graf Spee[/b][/b] is a German cruiser from the High School Fleet anime series. This German Navy heavy cruiser was known as a "pocket battleship". She bristles with battleship-sized main guns and has a strong HP pool, effective secondary battery, and the Repair Party consumable. Like conventional cruisers, she has torpedoes and a choice between the Hydroacoustic Search or Defensive AA Fire consumables at her disposal. Thus, a wide variety of gameplay options are open to HSF Admiral Graf Spee.

[h3][i]Chain 1[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
To complete the first chain, you'll need to earn XP plus "Destroyed" and "Target hits" ribbons. As a reward, you can receive up to five High School Fleet containers.

[list][i]You can complete this chain of combat missions in Random, Ranked, and Co-op Battles, as well as in Operations, playing Tier V–X ships.[/i][/list]
[/expand]
[h3][i]Chain 2[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
To complete the second combat mission chain you'll need to earn Credits, ribbons, and XP, as well as inflict damage and destroy enemy ships. As a reward, you can receive up to 10 High School Fleet containers.

[list][i]You can complete this chain of combat missions in Random, Ranked, and Co-op Battles, as well as in Operations, playing [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]V HSF Hiei[/b][/b].[/i][/list]
[/expand]
[h3][i]Chain 3[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
To complete the third combat mission chain, you'll need to earn ribbons, Credits, and XP, as well as inflict damage and win battles. As a reward, you can receive up to 10 High School Fleet containers.

[list][i]You can complete this chain of combat missions in Random, Ranked, and Co-op Battles, as well as in Operations, playing [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]VIII HSF Harekaze II[/b][/b].[/i][/list]
[/expand]
The special High School Fleet containers each drop two random elements of the collection of the same name and 10 [b]Zulu Hotel[/b] signals. Once you obtain the first collection elements, you can activate the subscription on the collection screen and obtain its elements from daily containers. In total, the collection consists of 34 female characters and the cat, Isoroku. As a reward for completing the collection, you'll receive the K117 permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]X Yamato[/b][/b] and some commemorative flags, including the Kure Maritime High School flag.

[h2][b][h1=hsf][/h1]The High School Fleet Anime Series[/b][/h2]
A century ago, most of Japan’s territory was submerged as a result of plate subduction. One after another, Coastal Cities began to emerge in order to preserve the remaining landmass—thus, seaborne routes became more important and their protection became a crucial issue.

Meanwhile, service in the Navy became highly popular among women and a special division for keeping the sea safe, the Blue Mermaids, was created.

The main protagonists of the anime series, childhood friends Akeno Misaki and Moeka China, enrolled in Yokosuka Girls’ Marine High School together with various other girls to become a part of the famous elite unit.

Akeno Misaki was assigned as captain of training destroyer Harekaze, and Moeka took up the captain’s post on battleship Musashi. The series starts when both warships set off for their first maritime exercises. However, what should have been standard training soon turns out to be a real battle.
