notes.title: Big Hunt: the Raid Begins
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/0667f8e147aed9e6f5645a5b3cfa7f20fa4248f1.jpg[/img]
[b]Update 0.10.2 brings a new temporary battle type—Big Hunt. Demonstrate your skills in a futuristic exhibition competition by assuming command over ships representing three different corporations![/b]

[table][tr][th][b][url=#things-you-should-know]Things You Should Know[/url] ● [url=#tips]Tips[/url] ● [url=#rewards]Rewards[/url] ● [url=#big-hunt-rules]Big Hunt Rules[/url] ● [url=#battle-points]Battle Points[/url] ● [url=#combat-missions]Combat Missions[/url] ● [url=#ships-and-armaments]Ships and Armaments[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table][previewyoutube=tGyOTaqFNGI;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b][h1=things-you-should-know][/h1]Things You Should Know[/b][/h2]
A new temporary battle type—Big Hunt—will be available to players in Update 0.10.2. It's a revamped version of the Key Battle mode from Update 0.9.10. Team up, fight, earn Battle Points, and exchange them for rewards in the Armory.

The new battle type pits 16 players against each other and AI-controlled monsters on a gigantic Polygon map.
[list][*]Your main objective is to exit the Polygon via the Portal located at the center of the map. Be cautious—the Portal only opens up after a certain amount of time.
[*]You start out alone, but you can form teams directly in battle.
[*]It's now possible to enter battle as part of a Division, but each player in the Division still starts the battle alone. In order to coordinate their efforts, Division mates will first need to locate each other on the map and create a team.
[*]The Big Hunt ends when all surviving players exit through the Portal, or when the battle time expires.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2457e88a-830f-11eb-8e36-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/24523e58-830f-11eb-b1a5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/245fd8d8-830f-11eb-9b0c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
A temporary resource—[img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_saltpeter_65bc5d6f2e5b745981b237addbe95a8b0eab5f1e4be650cbe25135f0b2246955.png[/img]Battle Points—will be issued to players for destroying monsters and other players.
[list][*]Having accrued a certain number of Battle Points, you can upgrade your ship directly in battle.
[*]Specifically for the Big Hunt, we've added a new AI boss ship called [b]Aurora[/b]. Defeating her will not be an easy task, but doing so will bring a huge amount of Battle Points to the team that sinks her.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2445a206-830f-11eb-9d35-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]The Battle Points you receive aren't lost or spent in battle when you apply upgrades. You’ll keep the points you earned regardless of what happens, and you can exchange them for rewards in the Armory.
[*]Successfully exiting the Polygon will double the amount of Battle Points you earn.[/list]
Each of the six available ships offers a wide variety of modules that can have a significant impact on gameplay.
[list]The Big Hunt's difficulty will intensify each week—the time it takes for the Portal to open and the monsters' HP and damage (as well as the amount of Battle Points earned by destroying them!) will increase. The maximum size of teams will also increase—from three players in the first week, to six players in the fourth week.[/list]
[h2][b][h1=tips][/h1]Tips[/b][/h2]
[list][*]Try different combinations of modules and armaments—assemble a ship that's to your liking! Don't be afraid to experiment—you need to act unpredictably in the Polygon.
[*]Try to assemble a team of your own or join one with other players. By fighting together with your allies, you'll increase your chances of escaping via the Portal.
[*]Destroy the first monsters you encounter and upgrade your ship as quickly as possible. This will give you an advantage in the following engagements.
[*]As you get closer to the center of the map, the monsters will become increasingly dangerous, but you'll also earn more Battle Points for destroying them.
[*]Keep an eye on [b]Aurora[/b]'s arrival timer so that you can be in the right place and combat ready when she finally arrives. Defeating the boss ship will bring you and your team the most Battle Points.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0142a26c-857c-11eb-9302-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][h1=rewards][/h1]Rewards[/b][/h2]
Earned Battle Points can be spent in the Armory to purchase three types of random bundles that include, among other things, a special temporary resource—[img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/currencies/icon_eventum_2_5e12273711a6fe3f2341957a1d21dcab0d260f39bfa09496ab09bb45bc76e934.png[/img] Corporation Tokens.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/8f4ddea8-8597-11eb-8267-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Corporation Tokens can be exchanged for themed permanent camouflages for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]VIII Akizuki[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Amagi[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_6c2bac10ec2bec5799e117af8aa6298d1647a6b0d3ae7ea9b78983e78d13e14e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]VIII Öland[/b][/b] (5 Tokens each), or for Credits.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/304251de-858b-11eb-98ed-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/305a0f54-858b-11eb-a0e2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3047aac6-858b-11eb-9ccd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
Apart from that, you can exchange Doubloons, Credits, and Free XP for bundles with Corporation Tokens and Coal in the Armory.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/8ebd2dcc-8597-11eb-a84e-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]Corporation Tokens can be exchanged for rewards in the Armory until the end of Update 0.10.3. After that, they will be exchanged for Credits at the rate of 1 Corporation Token : [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]1,500,000[/b] Credits. Battle Points can be exchanged for rewards in the Armory until the end of Update 0.10.2. After the end of the event, they will be exchanged for Credits at the rate of 1 Battle Point : [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]75[/b] Credits.[/i][/list]
Outstanding successes in the Big Hunt will be rewarded with special themed achievements.
[table][tr][td][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/EV2021_MONSTER_59c64f12223f36b71c30ac17db70fc6033657a4c26105ad6a2e5cf10990f6a8c.png[/img][/td] [td][b]Berserk[/b] — destroy 10 ships or monsters.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/EV2020_PORTAL_866ff7f1ead8ded9dd2c0e882e0bddd2f307e1c3c1abba8ada1c5c84c5bc50fe.png[/img][/td] [td][b]There's Always a Way Out![/b] — exit through the Portal in the Raid game mode.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/EV2021_MODULE_6f9adc7c22ede8112871c215770ec440424f51ad314f17e36dd5e92a2ecfb8bc.png[/img][/td] [td][b]Engineer of the Future[/b] — research all ships and modules in the Big Hunt event.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/EV2021_TOOLATE_4c8d24f2ee1582c0712542ac769d351e0f648978e3700fd3a2f82839d1a3097b.png[/img][/td] [td][b]Breaking the Eighth Wall[/b] — visit the place of your past battles.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/achievements/normal/EV2021_GIANTSLAYER_db970c043818981e35da92a28e7674a8f40f2f9abebf7a38fb7cae1f52e0c550.png[/img][/td] [td][b]Giant Slayer[/b] — destroy [b]Aurora[/b] in the Raid game mode.[/td][/tr][/table]
[h2][b][h1=big-hunt-rules][/h1]Big Hunt Rules[/b][/h2]
[list][i]To access the Big Hunt, you must have fought at least 21 battles in the available battle types.[/i][/list]
All 16 players begin each battle on the Polygon map alone, facing other players and AI-controlled monsters.

But you don't have to fight alone—you can assemble a team directly in battle. To invite a player to your team, aim at them and press [b]F[/b]. When you receive an invitation, the top of the screen displays who sent the invitation and how to accept or decline it.
[list]You can also enter the Big Hunt in a Division. However, you still start the battle alone and need to locate each other on the map in order to team up. The possibility to place markers on the Minimap has been added. These markers will be visible to all team members and will help you coordinate your actions.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ff9821e2-8596-11eb-8484-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ff857ae2-8596-11eb-a0e2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/39a857b2-858d-11eb-af5c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
The main objective of the Big Hunt is to gather as many Battle Points as possible and exit the Polygon via the Portal. It's closed at the beginning of a battle and you'll only be able to enter it some time after the battle starts.

The Big Hunt ends when all surviving players exit via the Portal, or when the battle time expires. For this reason, it's better not to stay too long in the Polygon—the Portal won't stay open forever and, as the battle nears its end, AI-controlled ships of the Terra Corporation will start hunting down any remaining players.

[h2][b][h1=battle-points][/h1]Battle Points[/b][/h2]
You can earn Battle Points by destroying monsters and other players' ships. [b]Aurora[/b], the new boss ship created by the Terra Corporation, will bring you the most points. Be careful though, vanquishing Aurora and her escorts will not be easy, even with a team.

Having accrued enough Battle Points, you can reinforce your ship directly in battle. To select one of the two improvements, use [b]Ctrl+1[/b] and [b]Ctrl+2[/b], or [b]Ctrl[/b][b] + [/b][b][/b][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/095e93cc-8589-11eb-8f09-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img] on the preferred improvement. You don't spend any Battle Points in the process of improving your ship, so make sure to reinforce your ship as soon as you're able! Any Points you earn can be exchanged for rewards in the Armory after the battle.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/001ab1c0-8597-11eb-9383-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
While you're part of the same team, you can't deal damage to your allies, and all earned Points are divided equally.

By exiting via the Portal, you'll double your earned Battle Points. If you don't escape the Polygon, you'll still get any Battle Points you've accrued in battle. In total, you can earn up to 10,000 Battle Points in a single battle.

[h2][b][h1=combat-missions][/h1]Combat Missions[/b][/h2]
Battle Points can also be earned by completing special combat missions that are updated weekly. Moreover, players will have access to a daily combat mission that also brings Battle Points.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/8eb14e08-8597-11eb-805d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Apart from that, another special combat mission will require you to deal damage to enemies in the Big Hunt. The reward for completing it comes in the form of XP that will be counted towards the daily container progress. This mission can be completed an unlimited number of times. Once the event is over, any XP earned while playing the special ships will be transferred to Tier I cruiser Orlan.

More details about the combat missions will be available in the game client when the Update has gone live.

[h2][b][h1=ships-and-armaments][/h1]Ships and Armaments[/b][/h2]
In total, six special ships for the Big Hunt will be available in Update 0.10.2. Each ship has access to a wide variety of modules that can have a significant impact on gameplay and your ship’s appearance.

Ships [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b]IX Valkyrie[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b]IX Gale[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b]IX Heracles[/b][/b], which are probably familiar to you from the Key Battle, will be available in your Port immediately with all of their modules researched. Three powerful new ships—[b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Hector[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b]X Avenger[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Whirlwind[/b][/b]—will be unlocked once you complete corresponding combat mission chains.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/65ca2890-8595-11eb-8267-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/660127fa-8595-11eb-a7f3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/65bda9d0-8595-11eb-b615-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
In addition to the new ships, completing combat missions will also unlock new hull modules, primary and auxiliary armaments, and a special module that changes the ship's consumables.

More details about ships and armaments will be available in the game client when the Update has gone live.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ffba2eb8-8596-11eb-a7f3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]Commander skills, camouflages, and signals are disabled in the Big Hunt.[/i][/list]
[h3][b]Avenger[/b][/h3]
Her well-armored hull reliably protects her against enemy torpedoes, while she can be additionally equipped with large-caliber mortars that have a colossal damage radius.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/aba7dba0-8595-11eb-8267-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ab7a824a-8595-11eb-b615-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ab8be79c-8595-11eb-9f21-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ab6e7b4e-8595-11eb-896f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][i]To obtain [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b]X Avenger[/b][/b], you need to complete a special combat mission playing [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b]IX Valkyrie[/b][/b].[/i][/list]
[h3][b]Hector[/b][/h3]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Hector[/b][/b] is the first ship to be capable of diving underwater temporarily. Thanks to this feature, she can quickly escape enemy fire by submerging, then suddenly resurface directly behind the enemy with her deadly laser weapon charged and ready to fire.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/255f0252-8596-11eb-896f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/25372b1a-8596-11eb-a0e2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/25831318-8596-11eb-b615-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/25264f70-8596-11eb-805d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][i]To obtain [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Hector[/b][/b], you need to complete a special combat mission playing [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b]IX Heracles[/b][/b].[/i][/list]

[h3][b]Whirlwind[/b][/h3]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Whirlwind[/b][/b] is fast and has access to a wide selection of torpedo armament. Moreover, once you install a special module, she'll be able to restore her own HP by inflicting damage to enemies.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9b950d72-8596-11eb-a7f3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9b954990-8596-11eb-8267-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9b48cf3e-8596-11eb-a0e2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9af6f43e-8596-11eb-9f21-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[list][i]To obtain [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Whirlwind[/b][/b], you need to complete a special combat mission playing [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b]IX Gale[/b][/b].[/i][/list]

[table][tr][th][b][url=#italian-battleships-part-2]Italian Battleships: Part 2[/url] ● [url=#big-hunt]Big Hunt[/url] ● [url=#visual-improvements]Visual Improvements[/url] ● [url=#division-star]Division Star[/url] ● [url=#armory]Armory[/url] ● [url=#other-changes]Other Changes[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
Read this article until the end to claim a gift! Share the article with friends and Clanmates to help them stay tuned about the details of this update.

[h2][b][h1=italian-battleships-part-2][/h1]Italian Battleships: Part 2[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/499dbccc-823e-11eb-ab6f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

With Update 0.10.2, Italian battleships continue to shine bright in the dedicated event that takes center stage!

[h2]Features of the Ship Branch[/h2]
[list][*]Semi-armor-piercing shells instead of HE shells. These shells can deal significant damage to weakly and moderately protected targets and vulnerable ship parts, but do not cause fires.
[*]A large number of guns with relatively short firing ranges and not the greatest accuracy.
[*]Decent maneuverability and armor protection.
[*]Tier VIII–X ships have access to the Exhaust Smoke Generator consumable, which allows them to sneak away from enemies without having to reduce speed. However, shooting from within a smoke screen while retreating isn't recommended—battleships have high detectability when firing their main battery guns from within smoke.[/list]
[h2]Early Access[/h2]
Italian battleships of Tiers IV–VI, as well as the Tier VIII and IX Italian battleships that hit the seas in Early Access with the release of Update 0.10.1, continue to be available in sequential and random bundles in the Armory.

In Update 0.10.2, Italian Tokens will only be obtainable from random bundles available for Doubloons in the Armory. Players can spend Italian Tokens until the end of Update 0.10.2. After Update 0.10.3 goes live, all Italian Tokens will be converted into Credits at the rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]2,250[/b].
[list][i]When Update 0.10.3 goes live, Italian Tier IV–X battleships will be available for all players to research.[/i][/list]
[h2]Combat Mission Group Rewards[/h2]
Italian Battleships containers, signals, Credits, and the Legion permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Marco Polo[/b][/b].
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0aa8ec46-830e-11eb-8e36-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
If you already own the Legion permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Marco Polo[/b][/b], you will receive compensation in the form of [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]6,000[/b] Doubloons.

An Italian Battleships container may drop one of the following Premium ships: [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]VI Leone[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VII Duca degli Abruzzi[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VIII Roma[/b][/b], or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Marco Polo[/b][/b], as well as special signals, Free XP, Regia Marina expendable camouflages, days of Warships Premium Account, and Doubloons.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ed9acfbe-8314-11eb-a953-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2]Free Bundles[/h2]
The Armory is offering free random bundles. Inside, you can find Italian Battleships containers, [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Premium Account[/b], Doubloons, and other rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]The bundles are available until: [/b] [b]Mon. 05 Apr. 07:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ed999806-8314-11eb-a69b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]The bundles will be available for 18 days. You can obtain only one bundle per day. A total of 12 bundles will be available, so you can skip 6 days and still be able to collect all the rewards.[/i][/list]
[h2][b][h1=big-hunt][/h1]Big Hunt[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/81d2e1bc-830b-11eb-85bd-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Update 0.10.2 brings a new temporary battle type called "Big Hunt"—a revamped version of the Key Battle that went live in Update 0.9.10. Demonstrate your skills as you stand against foes in an engaging competition of the future by assuming command over a ship that represents one of three corporations!

The new battle type pits 16 players against each other and AI-controlled monsters on the gigantic Polygon map.
[list][*]Your main objective is to exit the Polygon via the Portal located at the center of the map. Be cautious—the Portal opens up only some time after the battle starts.
[*]You start out alone, but you can gather a team directly in battle.
[*]It’s now possible to enter battle as part of a Division, but each player still starts the battle on their own. To coordinate their efforts, Division mates will need to locate each other on the map and build up their team.
[*]The Big Hunt ends when all surviving players exit through the Portal, or when the battle time expires.[/list]
[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2457e88a-830f-11eb-8e36-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/24523e58-830f-11eb-b1a5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/245fd8d8-830f-11eb-9b0c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
A temporary resource—Battle Points—will be issued to players for destroying monsters and other players.
[list][*]Specifically for the Big Hunt, we've added a new boss ship called Aurora. Defeating her won't be smooth sailing, but doing so will bring a huge amount of Battle Points to the team that sinks her.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2445a206-830f-11eb-9d35-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Having accrued a certain number of Battle Points, you can reinforce your ship directly in battle.
[*]Any Battle Points you earn won’t be lost or spent in battle. You can exchange them for rewards in the Armory.
[*]Successfully exiting the Polygon will double the amount of Battle Points you get.[/list]
Grab the helm of one of a total of six ships, and try your luck in the Big Hunt! Each ship has a wide variety of modules that can have a significant impact on gameplay.

The first three ships, which you are likely to already be familiar with from the Key Battle, are available immediately with all of their modules. The three new ships—[b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Hector[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b]X Avenger[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Whirlwind[/b][/b]—and all of their modules will become available after completing chains of combat missions.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/634348a8-8316-11eb-89ea-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/63467abe-8316-11eb-b2ab-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/63521298-8316-11eb-94b9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
Each ship is equipped with distinct types of weapons and consumables that can have a drastic impact on gameplay. [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Hector[/b][/b], for example, can dive underwater, where she has greater speed and maneuverability, and can also ignore enemy shells and torpedoes for a short period of time. [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b]X Avenger[/b][/b] can be equipped with large-caliber mortars that have a big impact zone. [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Events_f23a0323a8c3a2d26e34c71d4a7f290ee7b50bd974206ee3c9b87047876c450d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Whirlwind[/b][/b] offers a wide selection of torpedo armament and is capable of regenerating HP by damaging her enemies.
[list][i]More details on the Big Hunt rules, as well as the available rewards in the Armory, will come in a dedicated article on our website.[/i][/list]
[h2][b][h1=visual-improvements][/h1]Visual Improvements[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/81d69820-830b-11eb-ba61-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Update 0.10.2 ushers in a large-scale makeover of the in-game visual effects. All effects in the game—from shell tracers and fires on board ships, to gunfire, water splashes, and AA fire explosions—have been enhanced. New visual effects have been added for ricochets; fires on ships; citadel hits; incapacitated weapons; and active operation effects for the Damage Control Party, Repair Party, Main Battery Reload Booster, Defensive AA Fire, and Hydroacoustic Search consumables.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ca6cfbec-8310-11eb-a243-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ca3ddb46-8310-11eb-9f40-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ca186636-8310-11eb-b1a5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
More details about the visual effects enhancements are available in a [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/updated-visual-effects-review/]separate article[/url].

[h2][b][h1=division-star][/h1]Division Star[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/82398886-830b-11eb-93f1-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Throughout Update 0.10.2, Clan members will have access to special victory bonuses in the form of a Division Star.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ed3599f0-8314-11eb-94b9-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]You can get a Division Star by playing as part of a Division with your Clanmates.
[*]A Star is issued to each member of a Division for the first victory gained by that Division during Update 0.10.2.
[*]A Star can be obtained in Random, Co-op, and Clan Battles, as well as in Operations.
[*]Earning a certain number of Stars unlocks access to various rewards.
[*]If you switch Clans, any Stars and rewards you previously earned remain with you.
[*]To see the roster of Clanmates who you can combine your efforts with in a Division, as well as the list of rewards you can get, navigate to the Division Star tab in the Clans section.[/list]    [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ed41b500-8314-11eb-a4bc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][h1=armory][/h1]Armory[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/820276b6-830b-11eb-968e-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]New ships[/b][/h3]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b]X Austin[/b][/b], available for [b]29,000[/b] Steel, is a U.S. cruiser that was designed at the end of World War II. The ship is armed with twelve dual-purpose 127 mm guns in six turrets, and carries two quintuple-tube torpedo launcher mounts. The cruiser has an unlimited number of charges for the Main Battery Reload Booster consumable, which reduces the reload time of her guns by 75% instead of the standard 50%. She also has the Hydroacoustic Search and Defensive AA Fire consumables in separate slots. Her AA defenses are efficient, and she’s armed with SAP shells instead of AP shells.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/27dba80e-8312-11eb-9b58-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Brawls in 0.10.1: The Next Step
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1018da4d32f18456e8fb5c78334819e833569bff.jpg[/img]
[b]Brawl 1 will be held under an updated set of rules, utilizing a 1 vs. 1 format with Tier VIII ships. Face off against rivals for Credits, Coal, Free XP, and other rewards![/b]

[table][tr][th][b][url=#updated-brawls]Updated Brawls[/url] ● [url=#brawl-1]Brawl 1[/url] ● [url=#rewards]Rewards[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b][h1=updated-brawls][/h1]Updated Brawls[/b][/h2]
In Update 0.10.1, we've revamped Brawls to make them a separate battle type, with seasons spanning short periods of time and utilizing a smaller team format. You can participate either in a Division or solo, and you no longer need to be a member of a Clan in order to join in.

[h3][b]Other features[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Each Brawl runs for only a few days. Brawls are available throughout each day, except for low activity periods.
[*]If you're not playing in a Division, your allies are picked at random. Matchmaking takes the type and tier of your ship into account.
[*]The ship-type compositions of each team won't necessarily mirror each other.
[*]All ships will be of the same tier.
[*]Battles take place on maps with reduced combat areas.
[*]You can't take part in a battle with opponents who you previously fought against in your last several battles.
[*]Bonuses to XP for the first win of the day will not be available in Brawls.[/list]
[h2][b][h1=brawl-1][/h1]Brawl 1[/b][/h2] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/652e9ecc-7daf-11eb-9bbf-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Brawl 1, with the reworked rules applied, kicks off on March 8.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts: [/b] [b]Mon. 08 Mar. 09:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]Ends: [/b] [b]Mon. 15 Mar. 02:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

[h3][b]Format[/b][/h3]
Tier VIII ships of all types in a 1 vs. 1 format.

[h3][b]Timing[/b][/h3]
[list][*]ASIA: 01:00 — 18:00 UTC
[*]CIS: 06:00 — 23:00 UTC
[*]EU: 08:00 — 01:00 UTC
[*]NA: 16:00 — 09:00 UTC[/list]
[list][i]You can take part in the Brawl only during the time period specified for your server.[/i][/list]
[h3][b]Game maps and modes[/b][/h3]
Big Race, Shatter, Crash Zone Alpha, and Sleeping Giant in Domination mode; Two Brothers in the Epicenter mode.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5db33596-7a6b-11eb-8075-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5d43c8fa-7a6b-11eb-9c0c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5d0ecb5a-7a6b-11eb-bd52-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5db32a38-7a6b-11eb-a3f2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5d07f2d0-7a6b-11eb-9d73-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2][b][h1=rewards][/h1]Rewards[/b][/h2] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5c7bcc56-7a6b-11eb-9f94-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Up to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]2,250,000[/b] Credits; [b]80,000[/b] Elite Commander XP; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]10,000[/b] Coal; and 4x signals of each type, except for special ones.

For this Brawl, you can expect to receive the following fixed amounts of XP and Credits per battle:

It was built in the shipyards orbiting a world of proud and fearsome warriors. Though the citizens adhered to the Imperial creed and paid their tithes, secret cabals on the planet’s surface worshipped Khorne, the Lord of Rage. Their cults were strong. They were hated. They were in a minority. At the appointed hour, they rose up and tried to overthrow their loyalist masters. They failed. They were defeated in a long, bloody war and all, to a man, perished in flames. Their names were wiped from history. But the fickle whims of the Warp decreed that their vengeful spirits would forever haunt the vessel Ragnarok, whose hull was being constructed in the docks above the planet's surface. To this day, Ragnarok and all aboard it cry, "Vengeance! Death! Blood for the Blood God!"

Originally designed for a Naval mission with a purpose now long forgotten, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VIII Ignis Purgatio[/b][/b] was lost during the Horus Heresy. After going missing for several millennia, the ship was rediscovered on one of the Frontier worlds in the Jericho Reach. Though clearly a warship, it was put to use as a transport by its new, uncouth masters who failed to recognize its true potential. After undergoing intensive repairs and cleansing its quarters of its previous inhabitants, Ignis Purgatio was eventually returned to Imperial Navy service and, since then, has become an essential component of Battlefleet Solar. [h2][b][h1=warhammer-40000][/h1]What Is Warhammer 40,000?[/b][/h2]
Warhammer 40,000 is the pinnacle of tabletop wargaming. Produced by Games Workshop, its distinct visual style blends elements of science fiction and fantasy to create a beautifully dark atmosphere that has amassed a massive following over the years. Today, the universe has expanded to video games, novels, comics, and more, garnering a huge following around the globe.

Together with Games Workshop, we’ve created something that stays true to the renowned fantasy IP and also resonates with our universe of naval battles.

[h2]Starting Bonuses[/h2]
[list][*]Every participant of the Public Test will have all researchable Tier VIII ships, helmed by Commanders with 19 skill points, credited to their PT accounts.
[*]Research prices for ships and ship modules will be substantially discounted.

If you're joining the Public Test for the first time since Update 0.10.2, you'll be awarded the following additional bonuses:
[list][*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]500,000,000[/b] credits; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]30,000[/b] doubloons; and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]90 days of Premium Account[/b].
[*]50 signal flags of all types (except special signals) will also be added to your PT account.[/list]
If you fought at least one battle on the Public Test Server during the 0.10.0–0.10.1 Public Tests, your account will be copied from the Live Server to the Public Test Server.

[h2]How to Enter[/h2]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2716184589232191867

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b91b8bba-7e6b-11ea-85b6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]Developer Bulletin for Update 0.10.2[/b][/h1]
[list][b][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the update is still being tested, the information in this Bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the update is released.[/b][/list]
[list][i]Please note: the rewards for activities on the Public Test server may differ from those on the Live Server. The new Italian battleships will not be available on the Public Test server.[/i][/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#big-hunt]Big Hunt[/url] ● [url=#italian-battleships-part-2]Italian Battleships: Part 2[/url] ● [url=#visual-and-other-enhancements]Visual and Other Enhancements[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b][h1=big-hunt][/h1]Big Hunt[/b][/h2]
Update 0.10.2 brings a new temporary battle type called "Big Hunt"—a revamped version of the Key Battle presented in Update 0.9.10. Demonstrate your skills as you stand against foes in an engaging competition of the future by assuming command over a ship that represents one of three corporations!

[h2]Key Rules[/h2]
The new battle type pits 16 players against each other and AI-controlled monsters on a huge map codenamed Polygon. Your main objective is to exit the Polygon via the Portal located at the center of the map.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/840e7ef8-72be-11eb-807b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/840b7000-72be-11eb-975e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/841e88e8-72be-11eb-992c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
You no longer need a key to achieve that, but be cautious, as the Portal opens up only some time after a battle starts, and access to it is heavily defended.

All players enter each battle solo, but can build up a team of their own or join other players to form teams as the battle unfolds.

It is now possible to enter battle as part of a Division, but each player still starts the battle on their own. To play together, the Division mates will, therefore, need to locate each other on the map once they are spawned, and build up a team to coordinate their efforts. We've also added an option to place markers on the Minimap that are visible to all teammates to enable better cooperation in battle.

The Big Hunt ends when all surviving players exit through the Portal, or when the battle time expires. The new mode will not feature a final battle in the Octagon.

[h2]Battle Points[/h2]
By destroying monsters and other players, you can earn a temporary resource—Battle Points. Having accumulated a certain number of Battle Points, you can reinforce your ship directly in battle. You don't spend any Battle Points in the process of doing that, and because improving your ship won't cost any Battle Points, reinforce your ship as soon as you are able!

Specifically for the Big Hunt, we've added a new boss ship called Aurora. Defeating her will not be an easy ride, but doing so will bring a huge amount of Battle Points to the team that sinks her.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8b50b626-72bf-11eb-992c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Successfully exiting the Polygon will bring you additional Battle Points.

Any Battle Points earned are transferred to the Port so that you can exchange them in the Armory on the Live Server for any of the three types of random bundles that offer different rewards. Among other items, players will be able to get a new temporary resource from those bundles—a Corporation Token—which can be exchanged for themed permanent camouflages for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Amagi[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]VIII Akizuki[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_6c2bac10ec2bec5799e117af8aa6298d1647a6b0d3ae7ea9b78983e78d13e14e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]VIII Öland[/b][/b].

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8bb650e4-72bf-11eb-975e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8b71f782-72bf-11eb-a820-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8b5cc308-72bf-11eb-8560-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2]Ships[/h2]
A total of six ships will be available to players.

The first three ships, which you are likely to already be familiar with from the Key Battle, are available immediately with all modules. The three new ships—Hector, Avenger, and Whirlwind—and all of their modules will become available after completing a chain of combat missions.

Each of the ships carries new types of weapons and consumables that can have a drastic impact on gameplay. Hector, for example, can go underwater and hence ignore enemy shells and torpedoes for a short spell of time. Avenger can be equipped with large-caliber mortars that have a big impact zone. Whirlwind offers a wide selection of torpedo armament, and is capable of regenerating HP by damaging her enemies.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/912aa174-72bf-11eb-a820-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8b7126b8-72bf-11eb-a12a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8bbbeac2-72bf-11eb-a571-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
[h2][b][h1=italian-battleships-part-2][/h1]Italian Battleships: Part 2[/b][/h2]
With Update 0.10.2, we're continuing the event that revolves around Italian battleships.

[h2]Early Access[/h2]
Italian battleships of Tiers IV to VI, as well as Tier VIII and IX Italian battleships which hit the seas in Early Access with the release of Update 0.10.1, continue to be available in consecutive and random bundles at the Armory.
[list][i]When Update 0.10.3 goes live, Italian Tier IV–X battleships will be available for all players to research.[/i][/list]
[h2]Combat Mission Group Rewards[/h2]
Italian Battleships containers, signals, Credits, and the Legion permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Marco Polo[/b][/b].
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8b3601be-72bf-11eb-8f39-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
On the Live Server, an Italian Battleships container may drop one of the following Premium ships: [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]VI Leone[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VII Duca degli Abruzzi[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VIII Roma[/b][/b], or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Marco Polo[/b][/b], as well as special signals, Free XP, Regia Marina expendable camouflages, days of Warships Premium Account, and Doubloons.

[h2][b][h1=visual-and-other-enhancements][/h1]Visual and Other Enhancements[/b][/h2]
Update 0.10.2 ushers in a large-scale makeover of the in-game visual effects. All effects in the game—from shell tracers and fires on board ships, to gunfire, water splashes, and AA fire explosions—have been enhanced and reworked to accommodate the new lighting system. New visual effects have been added for ricochets; fires on ships with the Fire Prevention Expert skill active; citadel hits; incapacitated weapons; and active operation effects for the Damage Control Party, Repair Party, Main Battery Reload Booster, Defensive AA Fire, and Hydroacoustic Search consumables. These changes, depending on individual computer configurations and game settings, will not affect performance, but at peak loads will improve it significantly.

[expand style=more][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9195b086-72bf-11eb-a12a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/921dbe18-72bf-11eb-ba2b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9245383a-72bf-11eb-a2ab-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/91348040-72bf-11eb-8560-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/902e0216-72bf-11eb-992c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
The aiming sights of aircraft carrier squadrons will now display a land-hit indicator similar to that displayed for the main battery guns of ships.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e8a4b658ab54efdd123c94882f87ecbe718e3ca4.jpg[/img]
[b]Captains![/b]

Clan Battles Season 12—Greece—kicks off during Update 0.10.1.

[table][tr][th][b][url=#season-features]Season Features[/url] ● [url=#rewards]Rewards[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/d4e106f6-7297-11eb-80e2-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts: [/b] [b]Wed. 24 Feb. 12:30 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]Ends:  [/b] [b]Mon. 12 Apr. 04:30 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

[h3][b]Gaming sessions available on[/b][/h3]
Wednesday, Thursday, Saturday, and Sunday.
[list][i]Please note: upon reverting to summer time, the Prime Times for the EU and NA servers will change.[/i][/list]
[list][b]On the days of any update releases, Clan Battles are held only during the Prime Time of your server.[/b][/list]
[h3][b]Format[/b][/h3]
Tier IX ships, 7 vs. 7.

[h3][b]Restrictions[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Up to two battleships per team.
[*]Up to two mercenaries per Division.[/list]
[h3][b]Rewards[/b][/h3]
Up to [b]11,000[/b] Steel and other rewards.

[h3][b]Maps[/b][/h3]
Sleeping Giant, North, Greece, Northern Waters, Hotspot, and Sea of Fortune, in Domination mode.

[expand type=more]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d55cc5ac-7297-11eb-8665-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d5d945a0-7297-11eb-93bd-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d5370fc4-7297-11eb-8828-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d526fcb0-7297-11eb-9c33-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d52d1672-7297-11eb-8c06-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d52d306c-7297-11eb-84f0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/expand]
The following rules apply for all maps:
[list][*]Number of Key Areas: 3
[*]Capture time: 40 seconds
[*]Scoring of capture points: 3 points every 4 seconds[/list]
[h2][b][h1=season-features][/h1]Season Features[/b][/h2]
The new season has a small, but very important change—we've added a system that allows ship limits to be set. We're working on making sure that each battle and game mode offers diverse and interesting gameplay. This change allows us to make the team compositions more varied and the battles more diverse.

The restrictions can be set for the entire duration of the season or for specific periods of time. For example, they can be set after the first 2 weeks of a season, then replaced with different restrictions a few weeks later. This allows us to promptly react to the current state of the season.

[h2]Possible Restrictions[/h2]
[list][*]Limit on number of the same ships. For instance, the Division will not be able to join a battle if two or more of the same ships are selected.
[*]Limit on number of specific ships. For example, the Division can have only one [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]IX Ibuki[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]IX Yūgumo[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]IX Black[/b][/b].
[*]Restriction that makes certain ships ineligible for battle. For example, one cannot join the battle playing [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]IX Kronshtadt[/b][/b] or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]IX Kitakaze[/b][/b].[/list]
[list][i]Restrictions on the number of certain ships and banned ships are displayed in the Division window and in the tooltip in the window above the ship carousel when the "Clan Battle" battle type is selected.[/i][/list]
[h2][b][h1=rewards][/h1]Rewards[/b][/h2]
Detailed information about the task completion criteria and rewards can be found in the game client.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/d5587970-7297-11eb-8e71-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Clan Treasury[/b][/h3]
Clans with Ranks 1–50 in the Global Rating will receive from [b]5,000[/b] to [b]25,000[/b] Steel.

notes.title: Twitch Drops Changes in 0.10.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/29bf3ad7c8781ea2ed1f6abb094345f8d70c04ed.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Commanders![/b][/h3]
The way in which Twitch Drops work has changed, so in Update 0.10.1 you can expect things to look a little bit different than what you've been used to. The most important thing is that you'll still be able to collect free loot—including the valuable [b]Italian Tokens[/b] that are used to unlock Early Access Regia Marina battleships—just for watching World of Warships on livestreams!
[list][b]Don't forget[/b]: you need to link your Twitch account to World of Warships in order to receive Twitch Drops. It's easy! Just follow the instructions [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/twitch-connect/]here[/url].[/list]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#what-changed]What changed?[/url] ● [url=#twitch-rewards]Twitch rewards[/url] ● [url=#where-and-how]Where and How[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/worldofwarships style=button]
Twitch | Follow
[/url]
[h2][b][h1=what-changed][/h1]What changed?[/b][/h2]
Three new features will affect you as a viewer on [b]Twitch[/b]:
[list][*][b][b]User Interface update[/b][/b] — the main feature of the changes implemented by Twitch to the Drops system is the implementation of a new sleek, comfortable, and informative UI. Now, you'll be able to track just how long you need to watch a stream for in order to get the next drop, thanks to a handy progress bar that will dynamically fill up as time passes. Once the bar is filled, you will get a notification right in your browser with a button to claim the reward[b]*[/b].[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/59e50f54-7078-11eb-95d9-38eaa735f4cc.png[/img]
[list][*][b][b]Sequential Drops[/b][/b] — it will now be possible to have rewards drop in a specific order, e.g. in order to start progressing towards receiving reward Y, you must first have watched for long enough to receive reward X.
[*][b][b]Removal of random-chance drops[/b][/b] — with the new update, it is no longer possible to facilitate rewards that have random chances of dropping for viewers. Since this mechanic was the basis for our Twitch Epic Drops, these types of rewards will no longer be available in their past form for the time being.[/list]
As far as [b]in-game[/b] changes go, there are another two points to keep in mind:
[list][*][b][b]Log in to claim rewards[/b][/b] — unlike in the previous system, where your Drops were credited instantly to your account if you had the game running in the background, it will now be necessary to log in to the game for the loot to hit your Port. If you receive a drop while you're logged in to World of Warships, you'll need to log out and log back in, or to restart the game.
[*][b][b]In-game confirmation of rewards[/b][/b] — if you want to make sure that you've received your Twitch Drop after logging in to World of Warships, you can click the “Info” button on the bottom-right of your Port screen, where the goodies will be displayed.[/list]
As this is only the first update with the new system, you can look forward to further changes and improvements in the months to come. Join us on-stream and let us know what you think!
[list][b]* Due to the Twitch overhaul, all Drops—not just for World of Warships—must now actively be claimed on your Twitch account either by clicking the button on the pop-up notification in the stream interface or in your personal Twitch inventory. If you take no action, the reward will disappear 24 hours after the end of each campaign. Each Update will have 2 campaigns, each lasting 2 weeks. For more information, consult the All Campaigns tab in the Twitch interface.[/b][/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/59fb5d68-7078-11eb-ade7-38eaa735f4cc.png[/img]

[h2][b][h1=twitch-rewards][/h1]Twitch rewards[/b][/h2]
There are three types of Twitch Drops for World of Warships. All, except for the Official Channel Drops, can be obtained by watching any streamer on Twitch who is playing World of Warships and has [b][b]Drops Enabled[/b][/b].

On the [b]first Thursday of the update[/b], all three types of rewards become available and remain claimable for a full week, until they are refreshed the following Thursday.
[list][i]Be sure to join our official weekly English stream on Thursdays at 17:00 UTC so as not to miss out on any rewards![/i][/list]
[h3][b][b]Official Channel Drops[/b][/b][/h3]
A total of four simple missions—one for each week of the update—that will only drop when watching streams on the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/worldofwarships]official World of Warships channel[/url]. Completing the missions will reward you with some extra [b]Early Access Italian Tokens[/b] to help you progress towards unlocking the new Italian battleships!

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/twitch/official-stream-schedule/ style=button]Official Stream Schedule[/url]

[h3][b][b]Twitch Drops[/b][/b][/h3]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2b5f8144-34ac-11eb-a15b-38eaa735f4cc_330x.png[/img]A special Twitch container delivered straight to your Port when watching streams⁠—no strings attached! You can receive up to five of these during Update 0.10.1, with a new container becoming available each Thursday.

Exceptionally, [b]two containers will be claimable during the fourth week[/b] of the update!

When opened, a Twitch Container drops:
[list][*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]100,000 credits[/b]
[*][b]Assorted signal flags[/b][/list]
[h3][b][b]Twitch Challenges[/b][/b][/h3]
When watching streams during Update 0.10.1, a combat mission will be unlocked directly in your Port every week.
