[b]Restrictions:[/b] Up to two battleships per team, up to five cruisers per team, up to four destroyers per team and no aircraft carriers

[b]Times[/b]
[list][*]Asia 10:00 — 16:00 UTC
[*]CIS 14:00 — 20:00 UTC
[*]EU 16:00 — 22:00 UTC
[*]NA 22:30 — 4:30 UTC[/list]

[b]Rewards[/b]
[list][*]10,000 doubloons per clan for Top 25 clans [b](globally)[/b]
[*]5,000 doubloons per clan for clans ranked 26th -100th [b](globally)[/b]
[*]An invitation to the Verizon Warrior’s Championship for the [b]top 4 clans of each region[/b][/list]

[b]Maps:[/b] North, Islands of Ice, Mountain Range, Warrior’s Path, Sleeping Giant, Greece, Northern Waters
[list][i]The qualification season will be held in the standard clan battles setup with alpha and bravo ratings, there will however be only one league. Any amount of divisions from the same clan can play together.[/i][/list]
[list][b]The Mercenaries feature will be disabled during the qualification season.[/b][/list]
[h2][b]How to Participate[/b][/h2]
[list][*]Participate in our special qualification clan battles season and place among the top four clans in your region.
[*]Clan commanders of the top four teams in each region will be contacted via the e-mail address linked to their account and invited to participate in the tournament.[/list]
[list][i][b]Note:[/b] Due to the short time frame between qualifications and the tournament, you will have only 24 hours to respond and provide us with a full roster of participating players from your clan.[/i][/list]
[h2][b]Tournament Rules and Information[/b][/h2]
[h2]Dates[/h2]
[b]Regional Playoffs:[/b] 05/12/2020

[b]Times[/b]
[list][*]ASIA 13:00 — 17:00 UTC
[*]CIS 13:00 — 17:00 UTC
[*]EU 16:00 — 20:00 UTC
[*]NA 16:00 — 20:00 UTC[/list]

[b]International Playoffs:[/b] 06/12/2020

[b]Times[/b]
[list][*][b]All regions[/b] 14:00 — 19:00 UTC[/list]

[list][i][b]Note:[/b] All teams must be available to play during the specified time frames. Detailed match times will be communicated to Clan Commanders following a successful qualification. If a team fails to show up, it will be disqualified.[/i][/list]

[h2]Logistics[/h2]
[h3][b]Invitations[/b][/h3]
Clan Commanders of the top-4 clans from each region will be contacted via the E-mail linked to their accounts by December 1st and are required to respond to this invitation within 24 hours. This response needs to include:
[list][*]Username, In-Game Player ID and Real Name of each participating player.
[b]Note:[/b] A player may only be a member of one team, regardless of region.
[*]Commanders may nominate between 9 and 12 players to participate.
[b]Note:[/b] Nominated players must be part of the qualifying clan when this information is sent.
[*]A team logo[/list]

[list][i][b]Note:[/b]  In case this response is not sent in the allotted 24-hour time frame, the tournament organizer will contact the next-placed team and the qualifying clan will forfeit their qualification for the tournament. The same rules apply for the next-placed team when contacted.[/i][/list]

[h3][b]Restrictions[/b][/h3]
Players or Clans are ineligible to participate in the tournament if:
[list][*]They are suspended in-game due to a violation of the game rules at the time of the nomination.
[*]They have been previously warned for the use of forbidden modifications according to paragraph 8 of the [url=https://legal.eu.wargaming.net/en/game-rules-wows/]Game Rules[/url].
[*]They have an inappropriate nickname / clan name that violates paragraph 4 of the [url=https://legal.eu.wargaming.net/en/game-rules-wows/]Game Rules[/url] or in any way disparages the developers, tournament organizers, tournament sponsors or participating teams.
[*]They have an ineligible clan logo that violates the [url=https://legal.eu.wargaming.net/en/game-rules-wows/]Game Rules[/url] or the restrictions set out in the [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/content/verizon-championship-rules/]Contest Rules document[/url].
[*]There is any indication that they were violating the [url=https://legal.eu.wargaming.net/en/game-rules-wows/]Game Rules[/url] or [url=https://legal.eu.wargaming.net/en/EULA]EULA[/url] during the qualification stage, including sharing accounts with other players or allowing other players access to their accounts.
[*]Should an ineligible player be submitted as part of the roster, the clan commander will be required to nominate a replacement that is eligible within 24 hours.[/list]

[h3][b]Server[/b][/h3]
[list][*]All tournament games are to be played on the EU server.
[list][*]Regional qualifiers are played on regional servers.[/list]

[*]Appropriately fitted out tournament accounts will be sent to teams to ensure all teams can compete on an equal footing. Players can decide whether they want to use the designated tournament account or their private account.[/list]

[list][i][b]Note:[/b] Tournament accounts may only be used in training rooms and any violation of the [url=https://legal.eu.wargaming.net/en/game-rules-wows/]Game Rules[/url] with these may lead to an exclusion from the tournament and sanctions may be applied to a player’s main account. Tournament accounts may only be used by their assigned player, as communicated by the Clan Commander. Violations of this rule may lead to an exclusion from the tournament and sanctions may be applied to a player’s main account.[/i][/list]

[h3][b]Communication[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The language of the tournament is English. As such, the clan commander needs to be able to communicate in English, or nominate a team spokesperson who is able to handle communications for the team.
[*]Clan commanders and team spokespeople (where applicable) are required to join a dedicated discord server which will be used for all communication related to the running of the tournament, picks/bans, disputes and questions.[/list]

[h2]Format[/h2]
[h3][b]Structure[/b][/h3]
The top 4 teams from each region will play a single elimination tournament during regional playoffs.
[list][*]Round 1 — Best of 3:
[list][*]Game 1: 1[i]st[/i] placed team vs. 3[i]rd[/i] placed team
[*]Game 2: 2[i]nd[/i] placed team vs. 4[i]th[/i] placed team[/list]

[*]Round 2 — Best of 3:
[list][*]Winner Game 1 vs. Winner Game 2[/list]
[/list]

The winners of each regional qualifier will play a double-elimination tournament during International playoffs.
[list][*]Round 1 — Best of 3:
[list][*]Game 1: Winner ASIA vs. Winner CIS
[*]Game 2: Winner EU vs. Winner NA[/list]

[*]Round 2 — Mixed:
[list][*]Winner Game 1 vs. Winner Game 2 — Best of 5
[*]Loser Game 1 vs. Loser Game 2 — Best of 3[/list]
[/list]

[h3][b]Ships[/b][/h3]
All games will be played with 9 players and Tier 8 ships in the following configuration:
[list][*]0-2 Battleships
[*]3-5 Cruisers
[*]2-4 Destroyers
[*]0 Aircraft Carriers[/list]

Clan Commanders will be able to undergo a pick/ban process for ship selection prior to each series.
[list][*]For the purposes of the pick/ban process, the tournament organizer will select a random team to go first.[/list]

Each team will ban one ship (this can be the same ship)
[list][*]In case a ship with an alternate version is banned, the alternate version is also considered as banned. (i.e. [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VIII Massachusetts[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VIII Massachusetts B[/b][/b] or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Atago[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII ARP Takao[/b][/b])[/list]

[h2]Map Pool[/h2]
[list][*]North
[*]Islands of Ice
[*]Mountain Range
[*]Warrior’s Path
[*]Sleeping Giant
[*]Greece
[*]Northern Waters[/list]

[list][i]All maps will be played in the Clans Domination game mode.[/i][/list]

[h3][b]Picks/Bans[/b][/h3]
Clan Commanders will be able to undergo a pick/ban process for the map pick prior to each series. If a team is not ready to start the pick/ban process at least 10 minutes before the round’s scheduled start time, random picks and bans will be chosen for that team.
[list][*]For the purposes of the pick/ban process, the tournament organizer will select a random team to go first.
[*]Each team will ban one map (this can be the same map)
[*]Each team will choose one map and spawn
[*]For the Best of 5, teams will alternate picking two maps each.
[*]The tournament organizer will select a random map as the final map, with a random spawn allocated to each team.[/list]

[h2]Prizes[/h2]
[list][*][b]1st place[/b] — $15,000 (fifteen thousand US dollars)
[*][b]2nd place[/b] — $10,000 (ten thousand US dollars)
[*][b]3rd place[/b] — $5,000 (five thousand US dollars)[/list]

[list][i][b]Note:[/b] The amounts of the Prizes are specified per winning team and will be divided in equal parts among all the team members. Please make sure to check the detailed information on the payouts in the [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/content/verizon-championship-rules/]Contest Rules[/url].[/i][/list]

[h2]Disputes[/h2]
The tournament organizers have final say in regards to any and all disputes and complaints.
[list][*]In case a team wants to submit a complaint, they must do so on the dedicated discord server, immediately after the action in question has taken place.[/list]

[h3][b]Restarts[/b][/h3]
[list][*]During each game series, each clan commander has the right to ask for one game to be restarted, if no more than 2 minutes of game time have elapsed, for the following reasons:
[list][*]A player was disconnected
[*]A player experienced a client crash
[*]The training room’s settings were configured incorrectly[/list]

[*]In case a game has restarted, players have to ready up as soon as possible with the same ships, loadout and captain skills as they started the game with initially.[/list]

[list][i][b]Note:[/b] When asking for the restart, the reason has to be provided and approval has to be given by the tournament organizer or his designated representative on discord.[/i][/list]

[h3][b]Modifications[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Players may only use modifications from the official [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/modstation/]World of Warships ModStation[/url].[/list]

[h3][b]Tiebreaking[/b][/h3]
[list][*]In the unlikely event of a tie during the tournament, the teams will be required to play an additional deciding match on a random map with random spawns.[/list]

[h2][b]Check out the Verizon Branches Challenge![/b][/h2]
On December 5[i]th[/i] and 6[i]th[/i], veterans from the United States military will face off on the high seas to raise money for charity. Tune in to our coverage of this Verizon Branches challenge and find out which branch of the US military has what it takes to stand victorious.

notes.title: Review of U.S. Battleship Branch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/067037fa7d3de90b518b9ff8c5fd50cb32ddff0d.jpg[/img]
[b]U.S. battleships Kansas, Minnesota, and Vermont have become available for all players to research.[/b]

Read our article below to learn how to effectively play these new steel giants.
[previewyoutube=6XuH_8HG03A;full][/previewyoutube]
[table][tr][th][b]Key Features of the Branch ● Tactics ● Commander Skills and Upgrades[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]Key Features of the Branch[/b][/h2]
[list][*]Numerous main battery guns with a solid salvo weight and firing range, which come at the expense of longer gun reloading times.
[*]Great maneuverability for battleships, but they are rather slow.
[*]Good anti-torpedo protection, but [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Kansas[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IX Minnesota[/b][/b] have rather mediocre armor.
[*]Powerful AA defenses and the availability of the Defensive AA Fire consumable.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/56a0d252-3305-11eb-8dc1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/55485740-3305-11eb-911c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/569f2146-3305-11eb-a370-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Tactics[/b][/h2]
Due to their great firing range, the new U.S. battleships feel most comfortable at combat distances over 15 km.

At the beginning of a battle, the most important thing to do is take up a suitable position. Despite these battleships having relatively good maneuverability, it will still be difficult to quickly change the direction of your attack or escape from focused enemy fire due to their low speeds.

Their great firing ranges (more than 30 km for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]X Vermont[/b][/b]!), in combination with their weighty salvos, will enable you to keep the enemy at a distance. However, each salvo must be carefully prepared, as the ships of the new sub-branch have rather long reloading times.

Effective air defenses, additionally reinforced with the Defensive AA Fire consumable, will help you fend off enemy aircraft.

If possible, you should avoid approaching the enemy. [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Kansas[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IX Minnesota[/b][/b] lack good armor, and furthermore, all the new ships have long main battery reloading times. However, if you can't avoid a close quarters engagement, your advantage will be the weighty salvo of your numerous guns. The ships' decent anti-torpedo protection will reduce the damage they take from torpedoes.

[h2][b]Commander Skills and Upgrades[/b][/h2]
For a Commander with 10 skill points we recommend:

[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/icon_perk_PriorityTargetModifier_ffcc52036d210f6f22c4ea7ad44db3baf8ec256b54f5a471c3b342e852599a59.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/icon_perk_LastChanceModifier_08c69996db12c0caa1dacc5aa9c2c9dc1139371a3248c9d0c98a79822ec3b103.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/icon_perk_SuperintendentModifier_377444942b28914f815944fd2a86e21a23387d4b743827a79ac2813d8011282a.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/icon_perk_FireResistanceModifier_86b3ffe44c6181777d392cb8c57fc9729873b56cd8d13cd1c77d2688c85de18f.png[/img]
[list][*]Priority Target
[*]Adrenaline Rush
[*]Superintendent
[*]Fire Prevention[/list]
For a Commander with 19 skill points, we recommend choosing the most appropriate skills for your playstyle. Consider applying the following variants:

[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/icon_perk_AutoRepairModifier_c4564b2e8d0944294af4a54b0f1b11c55b80adb7831ab8e14685f32c2218423c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/icon_perk_VisibilityModifier_59d3bb84996e8f66039e6103dd58dccad99fa0c607b3e3375afcfc35fbb9fe71.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/icon_perk_MainGunsRotationModifier_125e4abed09610d4bcc97a38186af839794303af8eda2488acac96f129790809.png[/img]
[list][*]Basics of Survivability
[*]Concealment Expert
[*]Expert Marksman[/list]
The following upgrades will be useful:

[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/modernization/icon_modernization_PCM030_MainWeapon_Mod_I_bb1e79efbcc73dfa03a6dd5ae173566ee691b77e3a6587389d6f7ea07eb03588.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/modernization/icon_modernization_PCM020_DamageControl_Mod_I_bbc708467bc8f1e6264ac88fb8999ea40660e4b0b94b59ab7b3f1a8b60539ed8.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/modernization/icon_modernization_PCM028_FireControl_Mod_I_US_c5594545cedeb1f273aecbd98d18c8dbbcc7b0edc9b5e1b8184eacb443991cb5.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/modernization/icon_modernization_PCM023_DamageControl_Mod_II_3c6aea0c5bccc94f1d8f1fa52662232afa007d784638ce6e981c8ad3457c63fa.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/modernization/icon_modernization_PCM027_ConcealmentMeasures_Mod_I_bda1386ab237032301b6273e655a1998de5bfb50e2c8e59124c8a93d73093f0a.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/modernization/icon_modernization_PCM029_FireControl_Mod_II_US_35db21691559a7acc1af802e9a0fdcaf9bd6f56a5a0ddff720997643eec8b75d.png[/img]
[list][*]Main Armaments Modification 1
[*]Damage Control System Modification 1
[*]Artillery Plotting Room Modification 1
[*]Damage Control System Modification 2
[*]Concealment System Modification 1
[*]Artillery Plotting Room Modification 2[/list]

notes.title: World of Warships Advent Calendar
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/afdf11007a6fe75a968aafc256d8d3f47846cbac.jpg[/img]
[b]Captains![/b]

Starting December 1, you'll receive some nice New Year and Christmas presents—the World of Warships Advents Calendar is here! Recall your battle merits, collect gifts, and get additional rewards—including Santa's Gift and Santa's Big Gift containers—for completing quests! Make sure to share the Calendar with your friends—let no one remain without a present.

[table][tr][th][h2]Asia[/h2][/th][th][h3][url=https://calendar.worldofwarships.asia/]Open the Calendar[/url][/h3][/th]
[/tr][tr][th][h2]CIS(Ru)[/h2][/th][th][h3][url=https://calendar.worldofwarships.ru/]Open the Calendar[/url][/h3][/th]
[/tr][tr][th][h2]EU[/h2][/th][th][h3][url=https://calendar.worldofwarships.eu/]Open the Calendar[/url][/h3][/th]
[/tr][tr][th][h2]NA[/h2][/th][th][h3][url=https://calendar.worldofwarships.com/]Open the Calendar[/url][/h3][/th][/tr][/table]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5f01cfca-3317-11eb-b3a5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Daily Presents[/b][/h2]
Each day, you'll have an opportunity to open a card that offers some interesting info about your own game statistics and receive a present—various types of flags or camouflages.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b80d67d6-33ae-11eb-be7b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]The Advent Calendar will be active between December 1 and 31. You'll have 1 week to collect each present. If you miss more than 7 days, you'll lose an opportunity to open a card.[/i][/list]
[h2][b]Additional Rewards[/b][/h2]
By visiting the Advent Calendar and opening its cards every day, you'll get guaranteed gifts and be given opportunities to complete special quests that offer additional rewards. Having finished each simple task, don't forget to press the "Complete the Quest" button.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b7ff9804-33ae-11eb-a25a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b834c24a-33ae-11eb-bed2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b829c7a0-33ae-11eb-ba5a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[list][b]Each special quest will not be considered complete until you press the button![/b][/list]
For completing 6, 12, 18, and 24 of such quests, you'll receive doubloons and 1 day of Premium Account, as well as Santa's Gift and Santa's Big Gift containers.

[table][tr][td][url=https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/46458056-33af-11eb-be7b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/46458056-33af-11eb-be7b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/46030014-33af-11eb-a25a-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg][img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/46030014-33af-11eb-a25a-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr][/table]
[list][i]To complete some of the tasks, you'll be required to log into your personal account, launch the game, or perform another similar action. The detailed requirements will be described on the cards.[/i][/list]
[b]Happy holidays, Captains![/b]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2305228564
[table][tr][th][b]American Battleships ● Winter Trophies ● Brawls ● Armory ● Single Game Client ● Other Changes[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]American Battleships[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b1a565b0-32d7-11eb-ac8e-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

American battleships [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Kansas[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IX Minnesota[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]X Vermont[/b][/b] will become available for all players to research.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/59963166-fe56-11ea-a399-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/58b76ac6-fe56-11ea-b102-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bd348f8e-32e4-11eb-842f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Features of the Branch[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Numerous main battery guns with a solid salvo weight and firing range, which come at the expense of longer gun reloading times.
[*]Great maneuverability for battleships and effective anti-torpedo protection, but rather a low speed.
[*]Decent AA defenses that can be reinforced with the Defensive AA Fire consumable.[/list]
[h2][b]Winter Trophies[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b12b4744-32d7-11eb-8b11-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Update 0.9.11 brings you the first batch of gifts and festive New Year activities.

[h3][b]Free random bundles in the Armory[/b][/h3]
[list]The bundles are available between December 4–22, 05:00 UTC[/list]
You can obtain only one bundle per day. A total of 12 bundles will be available, so you can skip up to 6 days and still be able to collect all the rewards.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b23de712-32d8-11eb-98b7-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]We'll give you some indicators to jog your memory about claiming your rewards by highlighting the Armory banner with a color, as well as attaching a special icon and text notification to it.[/i][/list]
[h2]New Year Gifts[/h2]
Gear up for the time of gifts in World of Warships! From December 4, bundles that include three types of Santa's containers are scheduled to become available. Exchanging doubloons for them in the Armory is one of several ways in which they can be obtained.

Each festive container holds a reward: doubloons, days of Premium Account, Coal, Free XP, expendable camouflages, signals—or one of the 107 Premium ships!

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8c82cbac-32e5-11eb-ad6e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8c7fe810-32e5-11eb-842f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8c24dc5e-32e5-11eb-821f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2]Combat Mission Groups: Winter Trophies[/h2]
The new game event tasks you with completing 21 missions spread across three combat mission groups. The first group will become available with the release of Update 0.9.11, while those that follow will be unlocked on a weekly basis. The final reward for completing the last group is the New Year permanent camouflage for Tier VIII ships.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/347d257c-32e7-11eb-842f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]The combat mission groups will be available until the release of Update 0.9.12. More details about the completion criteria for the missions are available in the game client.[/i][/list]
[h2]Advent Calendar[/h2]
The Advent Calendar festivities kick off on December 1 and run until December 31. Open cards, get rewards, and complete missions to get even more rewards! More details about the Advent Calendar will follow in a [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/sales-and-events/advent-calendar/]dedicated article[/url].
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2885081624995503857
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5f01cfca-3317-11eb-b3a5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2]Battle Performance Bonuses[/h2]
An alternative option is opening up for you to get Research Points for resetting ship branches, as well as temporary victory bonuses. All you need to do now is earn 300 base XP. Claim bonuses by playing your favorite battle type!

Victory Bonuses have been replaced with "Battle Performance Bonuses" across all descriptions in the game client.

[h2][b]Brawls[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b0e9d0fc-32d7-11eb-8039-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][b]Due to technical issues the Ranked Battles system update has been delayed to a later update.[/b][/list]
Update 0.9.11 ushers in Clan Brawls 12 and 13. Brawls are now open to all players, even if a player isn't currently in a Clan. To participate, apply via the Create Division menu near the "Battle!" button, then wait for an invitation to join a Division. Only the Commander who creates a Division for a Brawl is required to be part of a Clan; the other two invitees do not have to belong to any Clan at all.

[h1][i]Clan Brawl 12[/i][/h1] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts: [/b] [b]Wed. 09 Dec. 12:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]Ends: [/b] [b]Mon. 14 Dec. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

[b]Prime Times:[/b]
[list][*]ASIA 11:00 — 16:00 UTC
[*]CIS 15:00 — 20:00 UTC
[*]EU 17:00 — 22:00 UTC
[*]NA 00:00 — 05:00 UTC[/list]
[b]Format[/b]: 3 vs. 3, playing Tier IX ships

[b]Restrictions:[/b]
[list][*]A maximum of one ship of each type per team
[*]No more than two mercenaries per Division[/list]
[b]Maps and modes[/b]: Crash Zone Alpha; Shatter, in Domination mode; Two Brothers, in Epicenter mode

[b]Rewards[/b]: up to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]2,500[/b] Coal; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]1,500,000[/b] credits; and [b]60,000[/b] Elite Commander XP

[h1][i]Clan Brawl 13[/i][/h1] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts: [/b] [b]Wed. 16 Dec. 12:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]Ends: [/b] [b]Mon. 21 Dec. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

[b]Prime Times:[/b]
[list][*]ASIA 11:00 — 16:00 UTC
[*]CIS 15:00 — 20:00 UTC
[*]EU 17:00 — 22:00 UTC
[*]NA 00:00 — 05:00 UTC[/list]
[b]Format[/b]: 5 vs. 5, playing Tier X ships

[b]Restrictions:[/b]
[list][*]A maximum of one aircraft carrier, battleship, and destroyer per team
[*]A maximum of two cruisers per team
[*]Up to four mercenaries per Division[/list]
[b]Maps and modes[/b]: Big Race; New Dawn; Sleeping Giant, in Domination mode

[b]Rewards[/b]: up to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]2,500[/b] Coal; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]1,500,000[/b] credits; and [b]60,000[/b] Elite Commander XP

[h2][b]Armory[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b0f79afc-32d7-11eb-98b7-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

American Tokens and Battle Points can be exchanged for rewards in the Armory until the end of Update 0.9.10. After that, American Tokens and Battle Points will be converted into credits at the rates of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]1,000[/b] and 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]75[/b], respectively.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]The possibility to make these exchanges will be available until: [/b] [b]Thu. 03 Dec. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

The following ships will become available with the release of the Update:
[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]IX Z-44[/b][/b], a Type 1936B destroyer, armed with two quintuple-tube torpedo launchers that reload their long-range torpedoes quickly. The ship excels at conducting torpedo attacks from a distance. Unlike the researchable German destroyers, Z-44 doesn't have access to the Hydroacoustic Search consumable. The ship is available for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]228,000[/b] Coal, as well as in bundles that are available in exchange for doubloons.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b]X Plymouth[/b][/b], based on one of the draft designs that preceded the creation of the Edinburgh-class cruisers. The ship's distinctive features include sixteen 152 mm guns placed in four turrets. Like the researchable British light cruisers, she carries AP shells only. The ship is equipped with the Surveillance Radar, Smoke Generator, and Hydroacoustic Search consumables, but has a short firing range and weak armor. You can get her in exchange for [b]27,000[/b] Steel.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]IX Neustrashimy[/b][/b], the first Soviet destroyer that was designed and built after World War II. She boasts one of the best concealment values at her tier, coupled with effective torpedo armament and a large HP pool. The destroyer has access to a wide range of consumables, including Specialized Repair Teams and Defensive AA Fire. You can get her in exchange for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]296,000[/b] Coal.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VII Flint[/b][/b], an American cruiser with powerful artillery, good AA defenses, and high maneuverability. Twelve dual-purpose 127 mm guns with a high rate of fire that fire shells along arcing trajectories. Take shelter behind an island, then rain a barrage of shells down upon your enemies. Flint boasts decent torpedo armament and a favorable set of consumables: Smoke Generator with a long smoke dispersion time, Hydroacoustic Search, or Defensive AA Fire in one slot. You can get the ship for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]168,000[/b] Coal.[/list]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VII Flint[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]IX Neustrashimy[/b][/b] were previously available for Steel—a valuable resource that's primarily earned in competitive game modes. We wouldn't like to diminish the value of those ships for their owners, which is why their prices are higher than the prices of other same-tier ships in Coal.
[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VII Duke of York[/b][/b] is a renowned British battleship that played a crucial role in the sinking of the no-less-famous German warship, Scharnhorst. Duke of York carries HE shells that are notable for delivering increased damage and having higher armor-penetration capabilities. They can deal consistent damage to enemy battleships and cruisers, even at long ranges where AP rounds are less efficient. To successfully counter destroyers, Duke of York has access to Hydroacoustic Search—a rare consumable for this ship type. You can get the ship in exchange for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]101,000[/b] Coal.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VII Lazo[/b][/b], a Soviet Project 68 light cruiser, has large dimensions and carries a formidable main battery of twelve 152 mm guns. She's well suited to long-range engagements. She excels at exchanging fire over a distance of 20 km due to the trademark features of the Soviet artillery and the specific parameters of her Spotting Aircraft consumable. You can get her in exchange for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]83,000[/b] Coal.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]V Hill[/b][/b] is an American destroyer flotilla leader that was designed at the end of World War I. Her guns can be aimed quickly and she has comfortable torpedo launching angles, as well as decent AA defenses for her ship type and tier. You can get her for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]38,000[/b] Coal.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/13c698c6-32ed-11eb-af6c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1458f2e8-32ed-11eb-901e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9d406238-32f9-11eb-a3b8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/14574c22-32ed-11eb-adde-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/13c01078-32ed-11eb-9d7e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9d4065e4-32f9-11eb-bc94-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/13c3fb2a-32ed-11eb-9dd2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

We've added containers from the "German Navy" and "Shipbuilding" collections, with each container available for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]1,000[/b] Coal. This presents a good opportunity to complete the two collections if you haven't done so already.

The reward for completing the sections and the entire "German Navy" collection is the ability to mount two flags and alternative camouflage patterns on German ships. The reward for completing the "Shipbuilding" collection is a Santa’s Big Gift container.

In connection with the forthcoming update to Ranked Battles, we've made the following changes:
[list][*]The cost of permanent camouflage patterns for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VII Flint[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]IX Black[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b]X Stalingrad[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b]X Bourgogne[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b]X Shikishima[/b][/b] has been increased from three to [b]10[/b] Ranked Tokens.
[*]The number of Ranked Tokens that each player has accrued has been increased fourfold.[/list]
We've added the Predator permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Somers[/b][/b], available for [b]10[/b] Ranked Tokens.
[list][b]Starting from Update 0.10.1, the following ships will no longer be available: [b][b]IX Georgia[/b][/b], [b][b]IX Alaska[/b][/b], [b][b]VIII Massachusetts[/b][/b], [b][b]X Thunderer[/b][/b], and [b][b]X Småland[/b][/b]. Georgia, Alaska, and Massachusetts will no longer be available to purchase in the Premium Shop.[/b][/list]

The ships have been taken out of the game due to a combination of their popularity and combat efficiency. In order to maintain the proper level of diversity in teams in terms of the ships they are made up of, these ships will no longer be available to obtain for an indefinite period of time, but may return in future.

We understand that accumulating resources for ships is a long process, which is why we wanted to warn you in advance, so that any interested players can still steer these ships into their Ports before Update 0.10.1 goes live in about 3 months' time.

[h2][b]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
[h1][i][h3][b]Changes to banners in the Port[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/857e5130-32ec-11eb-9dd2-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The banners of the Armory and Premium Shop will now announce the arrival of new items, coupons, and temporary specials.

We've added pop-up windows to the Dockyard banner to give players status reports on the current shipbuilding phase.

[h1][i][h3][b]Game Balance Changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b0de6ed8-32d7-11eb-81b9-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In Update 0.9.11, we've made changes to the parameters of several ships based on our analysis of their combat efficiency and feedback from players. Such changes were required in order to carefully adjust the balance of selected warships. Further changes may follow in future updates, should they be required.

[h3][b]Soviet Tier X destroyer Khabarovsk, and Japanese Tier X destroyer Harugumo[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Loss of HP after being hit by an AP or SAP shell with a caliber of 280 mm and above will now not exceed 10% of the maximum damage that such a shell can cause.[/list]
[h3][b]British Tier VIII aircraft carrier Implacable[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Maximum bomb damage increased from 5,100 to 5,300
[*]Chances of a bomb causing fire on target increased from 29% to 30%[/list]
[h3][b]American Tier VIII battleship Kansas[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Sigma parameter increased from 1.5 to 1.6[/list]
[h3][b]Japanese Tier IX destroyer Kitakaze[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Detectability range by sea increased from 7.56 to 7.76 km. Other detectability values have been increased accordingly.[/list]
[h1][i][h3][b]Content Additions and Changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b0f8c90e-32d7-11eb-992d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The following ships have been added for testing by developers, supertesters, and community contributors: [b][b]IV Dante Alighieri[/b][/b], [b][b]V Conte di Cavour[/b][/b], [b][b]IX Lepanto[/b][/b], [b][b]IX Marco Polo[/b][/b], [b][b]X Vampire II[/b][/b], and [b][b]VIII Fen Yang[/b][/b].

The Gothic permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Bismarck[/b][/b] is now available in exchange for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]5,000[/b] doubloons via the Exterior tab.

The exterior setting of the Naval Base Port has been reverted back to its initial design.

[h1][i][h3][b]Other Changes and Improvements[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b0e520ac-32d7-11eb-85e9-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In January 2021, we're going to cease support for macOS. We've made this decision due to the low popularity of the operating system among our audience. Supporting macOS restrains our ability to improve the visuals of the game and its overall performance. More details are available from [url=https://eu.wargaming.net/support/products/wows/article/15628/]Player Support[/url].
[list][*]We've added sound effects for some animations in the Port for the following themed permanent camouflages from the Transformers universe: Freedom Fighter for [b][b]X Montana[/b][/b], Gold Bug for [b][b]X Gearing[/b][/b], Messenger of Oblivion for [b][b]X Großer Kurfürst[/b][/b], and Crush ’n’ Destroy for [b][b]X Khabarovsk[/b][/b].
[*]Added an option to disable screen shaking from incoming damage and when using Engine Boost for squadrons with a new "Camera feedback when damage is taken" setting in the Controls tab.
[*]The Key Battle ships have been removed from player accounts. Any XP earned playing those ships has been transferred to [b][b]I Erie[/b][/b].
[*]We've removed the option to set an Autopilot course by clicking a square on the Minimap.
[*]Removed Naval Legends audio files from the [b]res/userMusiс[/b] folder. You can listen to all of our podcasts [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/general-news/wows-podcast/]here[/url].
[*]When previewing camouflage patterns in the Armory, a block will be displayed with the ship's tech specs adjusted for the effects and bonuses of the camouflage being previewed.
[*]Added an option to launch replays without pop-up notifications about opening files of such a format in Windows.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the Main Battery Reload Booster consumable to work incorrectly.
[*]Fixed an issue that, when locking onto a target with main battery guns, set an incorrect angle for the torpedo launchers. As a result, torpedoes could be sent in the wrong direction or the launchers could malfunction entirely.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the game client to crash after navigating to the Dockyard but before the ship being built had appeared in it.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused aerial torpedoes to arm at incorrect distances from the target.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the game client to freeze on the login screen.
[*]Fixed an issue that disabled the display of certain indicators (distance to aiming point, detectability, and shell flight time) for aircraft in battle with the alternative battle interface mode enabled.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused [b]Andrew Cunningham's[/b] "Lightning Fast" talent to provide an incorrect bonus to the speed of aircraft.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused a screenshot from the previous battle to pop up before displaying the battle results.
[*]Other improvements and changes. The full list is available from [url=https://eu.wargaming.net/support/products/wows/article/33375/]Player Support[/url].[/list]
[list]Attentive readers can expect a reward! All you need to do is click the "Get Reward" button, and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Premium Account[/b] will be yours! Please note: your day of Premium Account starts immediately after clicking the button, so make sure to dive straight into the game and make best use of it.[/list]
[table][tr][th][h2]Asia[/h2][/th][th][h3][url=https://worldofwarships.asia/en/news/game-updates/update-0911-winter-trophies/#other-changes][b]Get Reward[/b][/url][/h3][/th]
[/tr][tr][th][h2]CIS(Ru)[/h2][/th][th][h3][url=https://worldofwarships.ru/en/news/game-updates/update-0911-winter-trophies/#other-changes][b]Get Reward[/b][/url][/h3][/th]
[/tr][tr][th][h2]EU[/h2][/th][th][h3][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/update-0911-winter-trophies/#other-changes][b]Get Reward[/b][/url][/h3][/th]
[/tr][tr][th][h2]NA[/h2][/th][th][h3][url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/news/game-updates/update-0911-winter-trophies/#other-changes][b]Get Reward[/b][/url][/h3][/th][/tr][/table]
[list][i]You can claim the reward until December 15 (13:00 UTC).[/i][/list]

notes.title: Autumn sale and Steam Nominations!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/steamawards/category/52][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/31033d360cd1831b667fbcb3a53205ce6895560f.jpg[/img][/url]
Steam store is buzzing because there are two things going on:
[list][*]Autumn sales: World of Warships is participating too, so take a look at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/dlc/552990/World_of_Warships/]our DLCs[/url] to expand your collection.
[/list]https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/9276/World_of_Warships__3_Ships_Pack/[list]
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/steamawards/category/52]Steam Awards Nominations[/url] — choose the games you love and complete tasks to improve your Steam profile level.[/list]
World of Warships has changed significantly since the launch on Steam at 15th of November 2017 which had opened it for new audiences hungry for a unique blend of naval action that is easy to get into but hard to master, allowing to command the biggest war machines in the history of mankind, both built and planned ones.

We love our wonderfully dedicated and passionate community, and the game is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/steamawards/nominations]the Labor of Love[/url] for us. We'll keep on giving no matter what — the plans for the next year are large as a battleship— but we'll be very grateful for your vote! If we win — let's celebrate together with something special!

Good luck on conquering the seas and stay tuned for more news very soon.

Each month our subscribers will get some goodies, and they might be different each time! We’re going to send out a Steam container today(for those already subcribed) and at the end of the month too, which contains:
[olist][*]In the first slot:
[list][*]5x Steam camouflage patterns:
[list][*]+75% ship XP per battle
[*]+75% Commander XP per battle
[*]+75% Free XP per battle
[*]–3% to the ship's detectability range by sea
[*]+4% to the dispersion of shells fired by the enemy at your ship[/list]
[*]or 10,000 Free XP
[*]or 1 day of Warships Premium Account
[*]or 250 doubloons[/list]

Commanders!

ARP ships are Premium ships. This means that they earn more credits per battle and their permanent camouflages provide bonuses to XP, as well as reduce the cost of their post-battle service. You can reassign Commanders from any Japanese ships to ARP ships without having to retrain them. XP earned on ARP ships can be converted into Free XP. ARP ships have a special set of unique visual effects for shell and torpedo hits, fire, and flooding.

[list][i]You can disable the display of additional content any time. All bonuses provided by camouflages are active even when their display is disabled. In this case, the standard permanent camouflage, or in case a ship lacks one, the Type 5 camouflage, will be displayed.[/i][/list]

[h2][b]Combat Mission [/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Fri. 13 Nov. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Fri. 27 Nov. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

To complete the chain of combat missions, you need to earn "Hits to citadel" ribbons, deal damage to enemy ships, and earn XP. For completing stages of the chain, you'll earn X-Ray Papa Unaone and Sierra Bravo signals. The final reward comes in the form of Commander Kirishima with a unique voiceover and 6 skill points.

[h2][b]ARPEGGIO OF BLUE STEEL -ARS NOVA-[/b][/h2]
The anime and manga are set in the near future, at a time when the mysterious Fleet of Fog has seized control over the World Ocean. An enigmatic and invincible squadron is made up of the reincarnations of legendary ships from the first half of the 20th century, with Kongō, Kirishima, and Takao being among them.

Equipped with a mysterious superweapon, and led by battleship Yamato, the new masters of the oceans block the humans from accessing the seas—destroying anything that dares to move offshore. Many corners of the earth, including Japan, find themselves isolated and cut off from the rest of the world.

Ships of the Fleet of Fog are commanded by their human-like Mental Models. Iona, the Mental Model of Japanese submarine I-401, chooses to defect across to the humans in a bid to turn the tide of the war against the Fleet of Fog.

notes.title: We're Celebrating Our Third Anniversary on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5d712d42af895e20ca6896670686c7212dc14881.jpg[/img]
Captains!

Three years have passed since World of Warships first appeared on Steam! We're happy that so many players have revealed their talents for conquering in our epic naval battles during this time. Keep up that spirit!

For the anniversary, you'll receive some special combat missions. Completing them will grant you access to unique branded items such as a container, camouflages, and a Steam flag. For that to happen, simply enter battles playing Tier V ships and higher, and earn 10,000 total XP and 20,000 Commander XP.
[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/ensign/PCEE167_Steam_Flag_177ea27ee1c7aa65f1ad073104aaeb95949bb4fffc3f117a735e25d57fd22a13.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/camouflage/PCEC044_Steam_Camo_a5629d1decbee0c66e8be5e0bc2dabf048535cd3ce993bdbcb1b8e85066343d0.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/13766787543624b65d07d1c3de1a00e2d962d752.png[/img]
The Steam container includes economic signals and one of the following items: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]10,000[/b] Free XP; 5x Steam camouflages; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Premium Account[/b]; or [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]250[/b] doubloons.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Fri. 13 Nov. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Mon. 30 Nov. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[list][i]You can complete the chain of combat missions playing Tier V–X ships in Random and Co-op Battles, as well as in Operations.[/i][/list]
Still haven't upgraded to a Tier V ship? Then the special DLC that includes Texas will help you complete the combat missions—you will be able to stand at her helm for 3 days after downloading the expansion from the link.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/934640/World_of_Warships__Rental_Texas_3_Days/
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/dlc/552990/World_of_Warships/]The countdown starts once you've added the DLC to your library and entered the game.[/url]

[b]Are you new to World of Warships or do you have fewer than eight battles under your belt? Then simply finish two battles playing a Tier III ship or higher and you will receive Tier V battleship Oktyabrskaya Revolutsiya in a rare Victory Day permanent camouflage, a Commander with 6 skill points, and some unique branded items—Steam boxes, Steam camouflages and a Steam flag![/b]

notes.title: Verizon Warrior's Championship – Get Ready for Battle!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/fd1788087ca80781165b4d9fad40fb6a30511b15.jpg[/img]

[b]We’ve joined forces with Verizon to invite players from all realms to participate in a special tournament with a grand prize pool of $30,000 and the Verizon Branches Challenge — an exhibition tournament featuring four teams of U.S. Army, Navy, Marines and Airforce veterans competing to support their charity of choice.[/b]
[list][b]Dates:[/b] 27/11/2020 — 06/12/2020[/list]
[h2][b]Qualifications — Key Rules[/b][/h2]
Participate in our special Clan battles season, place among the top four teams on your server and we will invite you to participate in the tournament and have a shot at the grand prize pool of [b]$30,000[/b]!
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/6f9dbf7a-22a4-11eb-9d4a-d89d6715223c.jpg[/img]
[b]Qualifications run from:[/b] 27/11/2020 — 29/11/2020 — Friday, Saturday and Sunday
[b]Format:[/b] 9 vs. 9 playing Tier VIII ships
[b]Restrictions:[/b] Up to two battleships per team, up to five cruisers per team, up to four destroyers per team and no aircraft carriers
[b]Rewards[/b]
[list][*]10,000 doubloons per clan for Top 25 clans [b](globally)[/b]
[*]5,000 doubloons per clan for clans ranked 25th -100th [b](globally)[/b]
[*]An invitation to the Verizon Warrior’s Championship for the [b]top 4 clans of each region[/b][/list]
[b]Maps:[/b] North, Islands of Ice, Mountain Range, Warrior’s Path, Sleeping Giant, Greece, Northern Waters

[h2][b]How to Participate[/b][/h2]
[list][*]Participate in our special qualification clan battles season and place among the top four clans in your region.
[*]Clan commanders of the top four teams in each region will be contacted via the e-mail address linked to their account and invited to participate in the tournament.[/list]
[list][i][b]Note:[/b] Due to the short time frame between qualifications and the tournament, you will have only 24 hours to respond and provide us with a full roster of participating players from your clan.[/i][/list]

[h2][b]Tournament Rules and Information[/b][/h2]
[h2]Dates[/h2]
[b]Regional Qualifiers:[/b] 05/12/2020

[b]Times[/b]
[list][*]ASIA 13:00 — 17:00 UTC
[*]CIS 13:00 — 17:00 UTC
[*]EU 16:00 — 20:00 UTC
[*]NA 16:00 — 20:00 UTC[/list]
[b]International Playoffs:[/b] 06/12/2020

[b]Times[/b]
[list][*][b]All regions[/b] 14:00 — 19:00 UTC[/list]
[list][i][b]Note:[/b] All teams must be available to play during the specified time frames. Detailed match times will be communicated to Clan Commanders following a successful qualification. If a team fails to show up, it will be disqualified.[/i][/list]
[h2]Logistics[/h2]
[h3][b]Invitations[/b][/h3]
Clan Commanders of the top-4 clans from each region will be contacted via the E-mail linked to their accounts by December 1st and are required to respond to this invitation within 24 hours. This response needs to include:
[list][*]Username, In-Game Player ID and Real Name of each participating player.
[b]Note:[/b] A player may only be a member of one team, regardless of region.
[*]Commanders may nominate between 9 and 12 players to participate.
[b]Note:[/b] Nominated players must be part of the qualifying clan when this information is sent.
[*]A team logo[/list]
[list][i][b]Note:[/b]  In case this response is not sent in the allotted 24-hour time frame, the tournament organizer will contact the next-placed team and the qualifying clan will forfeit their qualification for the tournament. The same rules apply for the next-placed team when contacted.[/i][/list]
[h3][b]Restrictions[/b][/h3]
Players or Clans are ineligible to participate in the tournament if:
[list][*]They are suspended in-game due to a violation of the game rules at the time of the nomination.
[*]They have been previously warned for the use of forbidden modifications according to paragraph 8 of the [url=https://legal.eu.wargaming.net/en/game-rules-wows/]Game Rules[/url].
[*]They have an inappropriate nickname / clan name that violates paragraph 4 of the [url=https://legal.eu.wargaming.net/en/game-rules-wows/]Game Rules[/url] or in any way disparages the developers, tournament organizers, tournament sponsors or participating teams.
[*]They have an ineligible clan logo that violates the [url=https://legal.eu.wargaming.net/en/game-rules-wows/]Game Rules[/url] or the restrictions set out in the [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/content/verizon-championship-rules/]Contest Rules document[/url].
[*]There is any indication that they were violating the [url=https://legal.eu.wargaming.net/en/game-rules-wows/]Game Rules[/url] or [url=https://legal.eu.wargaming.net/en/EULA]EULA[/url] during the qualification stage, including sharing accounts with other players or allowing other players access to their accounts.
[*]Should an ineligible player be submitted as part of the roster, the clan commander will be required to nominate a replacement that is eligible within 24 hours.[/list]
[h3][b]Server[/b][/h3]
[list][*]All tournament games are to be played on the EU server.
[list][*]Regional qualifiers are played on regional servers.[/list]
[*]Appropriately fitted out tournament accounts will be sent to teams to ensure all teams can compete on an equal footing. Players can decide whether they want to use the designated tournament account or their private account.[/list]
[list][i][b]Note:[/b] Tournament accounts may only be used in training rooms and any violation of the [url=https://legal.eu.wargaming.net/en/game-rules-wows/]Game Rules[/url] with these may lead to an exclusion from the tournament and sanctions may be applied to a player’s main account. Tournament accounts may only be used by their assigned player, as communicated by the Clan Commander. Violations of this rule may lead to an exclusion from the tournament and sanctions may be applied to a player’s main account.[/i][/list]
[h3][b]Communication[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The language of the tournament is English. As such, the clan commander needs to be able to communicate in English, or nominate a team spokesperson who is able to handle communications for the team.
[*]Clan commanders and team spokespeople (where applicable) are required to join a dedicated discord server which will be used for all communication related to the running of the tournament, picks/bans, disputes and questions.[/list]

[h2]Format[/h2]
[h3][b]Structure[/b][/h3]
The top 4 teams from each region will play a single elimination tournament during regional playoffs.
[list][*]Round 1 — Best of 3:
[list][*]Game 1: 1[i]st[/i] placed team vs. 3[i]rd[/i] placed team
[*]Game 2: 2[i]nd[/i] placed team vs. 4[i]th[/i] placed team[/list]
[*]Round 2 — Best of 3:
[list][*]Winner Game 1 vs. Winner Game 2[/list]
[/list]
The winners of each regional qualifier will play a double-elimination tournament during International playoffs.
[list][*]Round 1 — Best of 3:
[list][*]Game 1: Winner ASIA vs. Winner CIS
[*]Game 2: Winner EU vs. Winner NA[/list]
[*]Round 2 — Mixed:
[list][*]Winner Game 1 vs. Winner Game 2 — Best of 5
[*]Loser Game 1 vs. Loser Game 2 — Best of 3[/list]
[/list]
[h3][b]Ships[/b][/h3]
All games will be played with 9 players and Tier 8 ships in the following configuration:
[list][*]0-2 Battleships
[*]3-5 Cruisers
[*]2-4 Destroyers
[*]0 Aircraft Carriers[/list]
Clan Commanders will be able to undergo a pick/ban process for ship selection prior to each series.
[list][*]For the purposes of the pick/ban process, the tournament organizer will select a random team to go first.[/list]
Each team will ban one ship (this can be the same ship)
[list][*]In case a ship with an alternate version is banned, the alternate version is also considered as banned. (i.e. [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VIII Massachusetts[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VIII Massachusetts B[/b][/b] or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Atago[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII ARP Takao[/b][/b])[/list]

[h2]Map Pool[/h2]
[list][*]North
[*]Islands of Ice
[*]Mountain Range
[*]Warrior’s Path
[*]Sleeping Giant
[*]Greece
[*]Northern Waters[/list]
[h3][b]Picks/Bans[/b][/h3]
Clan Commanders will be able to undergo a pick/ban process for the map pick prior to each series. If a team is not ready to start the pick/ban process at least 10 minutes before the round’s scheduled start time, random picks and bans will be chosen for that team.
[*]Each team will ban one map (this can be the same map)
[*]Each team will choose one map and spawn
[*]For the Best of 5, teams will alternate picking two maps each.
[*]The tournament organizer will select a random map as the final map, with a random spawn allocated to each team.[/list]
[h2]Prizes[/h2]
[list][*][b]1st place[/b] — $15,000 (fifteen thousand US dollars)
[*][b]2nd place[/b] — $10,000 (ten thousand US dollars)
[*][b]3rd place[/b] — $5,000 (five thousand US dollars)[/list]

[list][i][b]Note:[/b] The amounts of the Prizes are specified per winning team and will be divided in equal parts among all the team members. Please make sure to check the detailed information on the payouts in the [url=https://worldofwarships.com/en/content/verizon-championship-rules/]Contest Rules[/url].[/i][/list]
[h2]Disputes[/h2]
The tournament organizers have final say in regards to any and all disputes and complaints.
[list][*]In case a team wants to submit a complaint, they must do so on the dedicated discord server, immediately after the action in question has taken place.[/list]
[h3][b]Restarts[/b][/h3]
[list][*]During each game series, each clan commander has the right to ask for one game to be restarted, if no more than 2 minutes of game time have elapsed, for the following reasons:
[list][*]A player was disconnected
[*]A player experienced a client crash
[*]The training room’s settings were configured incorrectly[/list]
[*]In case a game has restarted, players have to ready up as soon as possible with the same ships, loadout and captain skills as they started the game with initially.[/list]
[list][i][b]Note:[/b] When asking for the restart, the reason has to be provided and approval has to be given by the tournament organizer or his designated representative on discord.[/i][/list]
[h3][b]Modifications[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Players may only use modifications from the official [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/modstation/]World of Warships ModStation[/url].[/list]
[h3][b]Tiebreaking[/b][/h3]
[list][*]In the unlikely event of a tie during the tournament, the teams will be required to play an additional deciding match on a random map with random spawns.[/list]
[h2][b]Check out the Verizon Branches Challenge![/b][/h2]
On December 5[i]th[/i] and 6[i]th[/i], veterans from the United States military will face off on the high seas to raise money for charity. Tune in to our coverage of this Verizon Branches challenge and find out which branch of the US military has what it takes to stand victorious.

notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/552990/World_of_Warships/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7a778c7fae482152c8bbb02bedad0c08490fd492.gif[/img][/url]
If you like reading our news on Steam, it’s likely that you’ve already subscribed. But if you haven’t yet — there’s an even more pleasant reason to do so now!

Each month our subscribers will get some goodies, and they might be different each time! We’re going to send out a Steam container today(for those already subcribed) and at the end of the month too, which contains:
[olist][*]In the first slot:
[list][*]5x Steam camouflage patterns:
[list][*]+75% ship XP per battle
[*]+75% Commander XP per battle
[*]+75% Free XP per battle
[*]–3% to the ship's detectability range by sea
[*]+4% to the dispersion of shells fired by the enemy at your ship[/list]
[*]or 10,000 Free XP

[*]or 250 doubloons[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/13766787543624b65d07d1c3de1a00e2d962d752.png[/img]
We’re going to use Steam inventory items for distribution, so you won't miss it when the item arrives—a notification will appear to let you know! After receiving a notification, log in via the Steam client to receive the goodies on your account.
