[h2][b]U.S. Battleships: Part 1[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4cf83b64-0182-11eb-86ab-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[list]American battleships [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Kansas[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IX Minnesota[/b][/b] have arrived in Early Access![/list]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Kansas[/b][/b] can be obtained by completing all the Directives, while [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IX Minnesota[/b][/b] can be obtained from random bundles that are available in the Armory in exchange for doubloons.

[b]American Tokens[/b]: a new temporary resource that can be earned by progressing through Directives of the event and by completing special chains of combat missions. They will also be available for Recruitment Points in the Armory, and via random bundles that will be available in exchange for doubloons.

[b]Rewards available in exchange for American Tokens[/b]: sequentially available bundles and other rewards that can be found in the Armory.

[b]Rewards from the sequentially available bundles[/b]: signals; expendable camouflages; Gold Eagle permanent camouflages for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Kansas[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IX Minnesota[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]X Vermont[/b][/b]; [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VII Florida[/b][/b] with a Gold Eagle permanent camouflage and commemorative flag; days of Premium Account; and Coal.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/63b82b84-022c-11eb-884b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Features of the New Branch[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Numerous main battery guns with a solid salvo weight and firing range, which come at the expense of longer gun reloading times.
[*]Great maneuverability for the ship type and good anti-torpedo protection, but they are rather slow.
[*]Decent AA defenses, additionally reinforced by access to the Defensive AA Fire consumable.[/list]

When Update 0.9.11 goes live, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Kansas[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IX Minnesota[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]X Vermont[/b][/b] will be available for all players to research.

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/us-battleships-early-access/]Read more>>>[/url]

[h2][b]The Dockyard and "Strong-Willed" Campaign[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3b83efc0-018e-11eb-b791-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Any remaining Dockyard Directives will be available for completion until October 26. Complete all the shipbuilding phases in time to get a brand-new U.S. cruiser—[b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Anchorage[/b][/b]!

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/dockyard-build-anchorage/]Read more>>>[/url]

Update 0.9.9 brings an end to the "Strong-Willed" temporary Campaign, which kicked off with the release of Update 0.9.3. Hurry to obtain the unique historical Commander, [b]Jerzy Świrski[/b], and other rewards!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]End date and time: [/b] [b]Sat. 10 Oct. 08:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/game-guides/campaigns-strong-willed/]Read more>>>[/url]

[h2][b]Clan Battles: "Northern Waters" Season[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3b61cd1e-018e-11eb-8c61-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts: [/b] [b]Wed. 07 Oct. 13:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends: [/b] [b]Mon. 23 Nov. 06:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[b]Format:[/b] 7 vs. 7 playing Tier X ships
[b]Restrictions:[/b] up to two battleships, or one battleship and one aircraft carrier per team
[b]Rewards[/b]: up to [b]11,000[/b] Steel and many other rewards
[b]Maps[/b]: Islands of Ice, Sleeping Giant, Warrior's Path, North, Greece, and Northern Waters, in Domination mode
[b]Season features[/b]: in the new Season, all maps may feature a cyclone
[list][*]The cyclone settles over the sea at the very start of a battle. Players should choose the most appropriate tactics in response to the conditions.
[*]Cyclones reduce the viewing radius of aircraft to 8 km.
[*]At the fourth minute of a battle, the viewing radius of ships starts to shrink, too. After 30 seconds, it gets reduced to 14 km.
[*]After 15 and a half minutes of battle, the cyclone will start to fade away. Its effects will vanish completely after a further 30 seconds.[/list]

Essentially, the cyclone is designed to reduce the reconnaissance potential of aircraft carriers in Clan Battles. The option to add a maximum of two battleships or replace one of them with one carrier will make team lineups and battle tactics in the upcoming Season more diverse. For example, it's possible that destroyers might prove to be a popular choice.

[list][i]Full details of the Season will be released in a dedicated article.[/i][/list]

[h2][b]Mercenaries[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3b7b1e86-018e-11eb-ac2b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Division Commanders now have the option to invite "mercenaries," i.e. players from outside their Clan or from other Clans, to join their Divisions for Clan Battles.

The new feature will allow Clan leaders to test candidates who want to join their Clans in real combat scenarios, or fill roster gaps without having to actually accept new players into the Clan.

[h3][b]Rules[/b][/h3]
[list][*]To add a mercenary to the team, simply invite them to join your Division. You can search for players via the "Divisions" tab in the game client.
[*]After a battle, the mercenary receives rewards based on the current league of the Clan they went into battle with.
[*]The mercenary may also receive achievements and emblems for Clan Battles, based on the current league of the Clan they went into battle with.
[*]However, the mercenary will not receive the associated economic bonuses of the Clan they fought for.
[*]A mercenary from a different Clan will be able to enter battle during the Prime Time of the inviting Clan. The selected Prime Time of the Clan that the mercenary belongs to will not change.[/list]

[list][i]During the "Northern Waters" Season of Clan Battles, only one mercenary can be invited to a Division.[/i][/list]

[h2][b]Research Bureau[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ba7676f4-018e-11eb-9fe4-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]We've added a victory bonus of [b]200[/b] Research Points for Tier V ships.
[*]The following achievements have been added: Junior Shipbuilder, Senior Shipbuilder, Shipbuilding Inspector, and Chief Shipbuilding Inspector. The achievements will be issued for 10/50/100/150 ship branches that you have reset.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0a83b098-0226-11eb-8394-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Only ship branches that you reset after Update 0.9.9 goes live will count towards your progress for the new achievements and the bonus for Tier V ships.[/list]

[list][i]More details about the Research Bureau will appear in a dedicated article.[/i][/list]

[h2][b]Changes to Game Mechanics[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/babd2144-018e-11eb-b66a-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

We've updated the mechanics behind the interactions between shells and main battery barbettes / turrets.

Previously, when a shell hit the main battery turret, damage was dealt only to the module itself, and the player received a "Penetration" ribbon without any actual damage having been dealt to the enemy ship. Now, hitting the main battery turret also entails a reduction in the ship's hit points.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/750165da-022d-11eb-b625-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The change will significantly reduce the number of no-damage penetrations.
[list][*]Any damage dealt to a main battery turret also entails damage to the ship in the amount of 1/10 of the maximum damage of the shell.
[*]The amount of damage dealt to the main battery turret modules in case of a penetration has been reduced 3.3 times.
[*]The number of hit points for main battery turret modules has been reduced by half.
[*]Damage affecting a ship's HP from a shell hitting any of the ship's main battery turrets can be restored completely using the Repair Party and Specialized Repair Teams consumables.
[*]The barbette models have been updated.[/list]

[h2][b]Visual Improvements[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ba9b062c-018e-11eb-b0e3-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]We've improved the sea rendering quality for all graphics settings. Sun glare on the water's surface now looks more realistic; the horizon is now rendered at a higher quality; and water will now appear in a range of different shades, depending on the map. This change will improve game client performance. The changes will be most visible at low and medium graphics quality settings.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/a0ee9f8c-022d-11eb-a627-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]
[*]The Spaceport has been updated to accommodate the new lighting model and enhanced HDR technology.
[*]We've changed the visual appearance of the aiming reticles for carrier squadrons, and also reworked the aircraft camera performance. This change will affect only the visual component of a squadron's interface, making it easier to aim with all types of armament without affecting gameplay.
[*]Aircraft aiming reticles will no longer adjust to changes in the terrain of islands. A special indicator will notify you that your armament is about to hit terrain, and the reticle will become slightly more transparent. The new feature will also help prevent scenarios when a player is fully aimed at a target ship, but there are still terrain obstacles in the path of the payload release trajectory.
[*]Aircraft operating as part of a squadron will now change positions in a smoother way; the trajectory of bombers moving in on a target will change slightly, and any damage taken by the aircraft in the process will cause it to shake.
[*]The visibility of aircraft aiming reticles on sunlight-reflecting water has been improved.[/list]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/aabb953c-0224-11eb-bc28-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8b51b82a-0224-11eb-bebc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/aabeff7e-0224-11eb-8394-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Technical Changes and Improvements[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ba704cfc-018e-11eb-981a-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

With the release of Update 0.9.9, players will be able to play on all World of Warships servers within a single game client, without the need to install separate game instances for each region. The game server will be determined by the currently selected account in the Wargaming Game Center.

We recommend that you delete all additional game instances installed on your computer before the release of Update 0.9.9. Please note: you will still need a separate game client for Public Tests.

We've seen drops in game client performance and aiming reticle distortions on devices with graphics cards that don't support DirectX 11 features. For this reason, we are discontinuing support for graphics cards that don't meet the minimum system requirements.

[h1][i][h3][b]List of unsupported graphics cards[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[list][*][b]NVIDIA:[/b] all graphics cards older than the GeForce 400 series.
[*][b]AMD:[/b] all graphics cards older than the Radeon HD 5000 Series.
[*][b]Intel:[/b] all graphics cards older than Intel HD 3000.[/list]

[list][b]Support for the macOS operating system will cease with the release of Update 0.10.0. We made this decision due to the low popularity of this OS among our players. Supporting macOS restrains our ability to improve the visuals of the game and its overall performance.[/b][/list]

More details are available [url=https://eu.wargaming.net/support/products/wows/article/15628/]in this article[/url].

[h2][b]Content additions and changes[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/109724a2-018f-11eb-b791-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Armory[/b][/h3]
The following ships will become available in the Armory with the release of the Update:
[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/special_f75e4cad6399ce68536c0ed26af761c905be8fa208d664915d20fde55b1b6db5.png[/img][b]X Franklin D. Roosevelt[/b][/b]—available in exchange for [b]33,000[/b] Steel. A Midway-class aircraft carrier that can boast of having solid armor protection. The extensive HP pools of her aircraft and large squadron size allow her to carry out continuous powerful attacks, even when her aircraft, which lack the Repair consumable, fall under heavy AA enemy fire.[/list]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fe882794-0228-11eb-b23f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Italy_206c77d5bf356559100ac3e95fdb7200b4fecf3e3ebb54d3ac18d332bd9cbdb7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]IX Paolo Emilio[/b][/b]—available in exchange for [b]43,000[/b] Research Points. This destroyer was initially designed as light cruiser intended for use in reconnaissance operations of the Italian Navy. She's fast, and equipped with good artillery that's capable of firing SAP and HE shells, all at the cost of a long reload time. The ship's powerful torpedo armament, coupled with access to the Emergency Engine Power and Exhaust Smoke Generator consumables, make her ideal for lightning-fast attacks at short ranges.[/list]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fe186968-0228-11eb-868d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Other changes[/b][/h3]
We're continuing our work on enhancing the Daily Shipments: two new options will be added in Update 0.9.9. We'll test the new mechanics as the Update goes live. To ensure that we get credible test results, some players will collect their rewards via the "old" version of Daily Shipments, while others will receive the new ones. This research will also require a random reference group, which is why certain players will unfortunately not have access to Daily Shipments during this Update.

A "Gothic" permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Bismarck[/b][/b] has been added to the game. Details on how to get it will follow a bit later.

[b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Mainz[/b][/b] has been added to the Tech Tree, and will be available for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]11,000[/b] doubloons.

[b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VIII Tirpitz[/b][/b] has temporarily been removed from the Tech Tree. However, she will still be available via the Armory.

The following ships have been added for testing by developers, supertesters, and community contributors: [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Hizen[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]IX Z-44[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VII Strasbourg[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b]X Plymouth[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Commonwealth_abdc3eb3f8c9b1c0421b3aed2f550ac45b78602942f9a4a2cdd438835720edc7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VI Mysore[/b][/b].

[h2][b]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
Check under the spoiler for more information regarding balance-related changes, content changes and additions, and other improvements.

[h1][i][h3][b]Improvements to the combat mission interface[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/104a8db8-018f-11eb-b0e3-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]We've re-enabled the option to jump to the Combat Missions section by clicking on the icon of a combat mission that drops from a container.
[*]A list of combat missions that you've scrolled down will now automatically scroll back up when switching between tabs.
[*]A combat mission hint that pops up on the post-battle results screen will now show the progress you've made towards the conditions of that mission in a battle.
[*]When navigating to the Directives tab, the currently active Directive will be selected by default.[/list]

[h1][i][h3][b]Game balance changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/1095c9ea-018f-11eb-8c61-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In Update 0.9.9, we've made changes to the parameters of several ships based on our analysis of their combat efficiency and feedback from players. These changes were required in order to carefully adjust the balance of selected warships. Further changes may follow in future updates, should they be required.

[h3][b]Tier V British cruiser Hawkins[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time reduced from 12.6 to 12.1 s[/list]

[h3][b]Tier VIII U.K. aircraft carrier Implacable[/b][/h3]
Changes to HE bomb characteristics:
[list][*]Maximum damage increased from 4,700 to 4,900
[*]Chance to cause fire on a target increased from 27% to 28%[/list]

[h3][b]Tier X Soviet cruiser Petropavlovsk[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Detectability range by sea increased from 14.9 to 15.4 km. Other detectability values have been increased accordingly[/list]

[h3][b]Tier IX Soviet cruiser Riga[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time reduced from 15.0 to 14.5 s
[*]Detectability range by sea increased from 14.74 to 15.04 km. Other detectability values were increased accordingly[/list]

[h3][b]Engine Boost Modification 1 upgrade[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Bonus to the action time of the Engine Boost and Emergency Engine Power consumables reduced from +40% to +30%[/list]

[h1][i][h3][b]Other changes and improvements[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/104f8f02-018f-11eb-ac2b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[list][b]Please note: running Overwolf application may cause World of Warships client collapse. To fix the issue, update Overwolf to the latest version. If the issue still persists, please contact the Customer Service Center.[/b][/list]

[list][*]Fixed a mistake in the description of Task 6 of Mission 4 in the "Five Epochs of the Navy" Campaign.
[*]Fixed a bug in the autopilot voiceovers for the following Commanders: Kaguya, Chang'e, and Hou Yi.
[*]The names of modules of attack aircraft now contain an HE or AP designation for their rockets.
[*]Reduced the frequency of a situation that caused the game client to crash during authorization.
[*]Reduced the frequency of a situation that caused a ship with autopilot enabled to leave her charted course.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the Expert Marksman skill to provide incorrect bonuses to the traverse speed of main battery guns.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the game client to crash after navigating to the Dockyard before the ship being built appeared.
[*]Fixed an issue that, in certain cases, made it impossible to authorize in the game after minimizing the client window and then maximizing it again.
[*]Other improvements and changes. For a complete list, please refer to [url=https://eu.wargaming.net/support/products/wows/article/33375/]Player Support[/url].[/list]

notes.title: U.S. Battleships: Early Access
notes.content:
[url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/baa25c7c-fe52-11ea-8ab8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/baa25c7c-fe52-11ea-8ab8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url]
[table][tr][th][b]U.S. Battleships: Part 1 ● Directives ● Random Bundles ● American Tokens[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]U.S. Battleships: Part 1[/b][/h2]
U.S. battleships [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Kansas[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IX Minnesota[/b][/b] in Early Access!

[b]Early Access[/b]: [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Kansas[/b][/b] can be obtained by completing all the Directives. [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IX Minnesota[/b][/b] can be dropped in random bundles that are available in exchange for doubloons in the Armory.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/59963166-fe56-11ea-a399-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/58b76ac6-fe56-11ea-b102-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[b]American Tokens[/b]: a new temporary resource that can be earned by progressing through Directives of the event and by completing special chains of combat missions. They will also be available for Recruitment Points in the Armory, and via random bundles that will be available in exchange for doubloons. When Update 0.9.11 goes live, American Tokens will be converted into credits at a rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]1,000[/b].

[b]Rewards in exchange for American Tokens[/b]: consecutive bundles and other rewards can be found in the Armory. Consecutive bundles will feature [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VII Florida[/b][/b] with a Gold Eagle permanent camouflage and commemorative flag; Gold Eagle permanent camouflages for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Kansas[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IX Minnesota[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]X Vermont[/b][/b]; days of Premium Account; Coal; expendable camouflages; and signals.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9ec65186-fe55-11ea-ad36-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]What distinctive features can the new U.S. battleships boast of having?[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Numerous main battery guns with a solid salvo weight and firing range, which come at the expense of longer gun reload times.
[*]The ships enjoy great maneuverability for their type, as well as good anti-torpedo protection, but are rather slow.
[*]Their decent AA defenses are reinforced by access to the Defensive AA Fire consumable.[/list]
[list][i]When Update 0.9.11 goes live, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Kansas[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IX Minnesota[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]X Vermont[/b][/b] will be available for all players to research.[/i][/list]
We've also updated the Naval Base Port.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/20fc9366-fe58-11ea-9071-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Directives[/b][/h2]
The new game event tasks you with completing 32 missions spread across four Directives. The first Directive will become available with the release of Update 0.9.9, while those that follow will be unlocked on a weekly basis. Completing the missions and Directives will reward you with American Tokens.
[list][b]The final reward for completing the last Directive[/b]: [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Kansas[/b][/b] with all her modules fully researched, a Commander with three skill points, and a Port slot.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fdf76a6e-fe55-11ea-b236-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fdff427a-fe55-11ea-bda0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fe00c60e-fe55-11ea-ad36-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fdfcc4aa-fe55-11ea-b859-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]


[h2][b]Random Bundles[/b][/h2]
The "U.S. Battleships: Part 1" section of the Armory has been stocked with five variants of random bundles. Each can be obtained in exchange for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,000[/b] doubloons. They have a chance of dropping [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IX Minnesota[/b][/b] plus a Commander with three skill points and a Port slot, American Tokens, and other rewards.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/20b65c34-fe58-11ea-b22c-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]American Tokens[/b][/h2]
American Tokens can be obtained in the following ways:
[list][*]By completing Directives and missions of the event—up to 12,900 Tokens.
[*]From random bundles that are available in exchange for doubloons in the Armory—up to 96,000 Tokens.
[*]In exchange for Recruitment Points in the Armory—up to 2,000 Tokens.[/list]
For more details about the Recruiting Station, follow this [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/content/recruiting_station/]link[/url].

You can get even more American Tokens for completing chains of combat missions that are available on the weekends of the second and third weeks after the release of the Update. The difficulty of the chains, as well as the number of Tokens that you can receive, depends on your activity during the previous updates.

[h2]Rewards[/h2]
You can exchange American Tokens for consecutive bundles and other rewards in the Armory.

[h3][b]Consecutive Bundles[/b][/h3] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/20d63130-fe58-11ea-afbf-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Other Rewards[/b][/h3] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/20bc6d7c-fe58-11ea-8f77-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]


[/url]

notes.title: Mid-Autumn Festival
notes.content:
[url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/52c5fe80-fc9d-11ea-be8b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/52c5fe80-fc9d-11ea-be8b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]Captains![/b]

Don't miss your chance to obtain unique Commanders [b]Chang’e[/b], [b]Hou Yi[/b], and [b]Kaguya[/b]; themed permanent camouflages for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VI Warspite[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VI Dunkerque[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/premium_4516ee494bb0396e51796cebff5e45c3f448d9790e0a58082057b8949ed9a3f8.png[/img][b]VIII Kaga[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Prinz Eugen[/b][/b]; and many other valuable rewards in celebration of the Mid-Autumn Festival!

[table][tr][th][b]Festive Bundles in the Armory ● Combat Missions[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[previewyoutube=KqA2pdKptr4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/sales-and-events/mid-autumn-festival/][/url]Festive Bundles in the Armory[/b][/h2]
You can purchase random themed bundles in the Armory that hold unique Commanders, rare themed camouflages, and other desirable rewards. In total, you can purchase up to 50 random bundles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Bundles will be available for purchase until:[/b] [b]Mon. 12 Oct. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[url=https://armory.worldofwarships.eu/]Show offers[/url]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/520f63a0-fc9d-11ea-96ad-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2]Commanders[/h2]
The event will provide you the opportunity to obtain new unique Commanders—a variety of heroes from Asian myths and legends.
[list][*][b]Chang'e[/b] is the Chinese goddess of the Moon—the popular Mid-Autumn Festival is dedicated to her.
[*][b]Hou Yi [/b]is a great bowman and Chang'e's husband, who was able to shoot nine suns down from the sky when they threatened to destroy all life on Earth.
[*][b]Kaguya[/b] is the legendary Japanese Moon princess with miraculous shining hair.[/list]
[list][i]Commander Hou Yi has a specialization for Pan-Asian ships, while Kaguya is specialized for Japanese ships. Commander Chang'e can be assigned to both Pan-Asian and Japanese ships.[/i][/list]

notes.title: Dry Dock. Graf Zeppelin
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6bd4eac915c47d01c4f5d3beee994b25cedba2a8.jpg[/img]
[b]World of Warships is the largest virtual shipyard in the world.[/b]

The quality of the work done by our artists improves each year, and the requirements for the accuracy of the models they create grow respectively. Unfortunately, the in-game camera doesn't allow you to see all of their details and beauty. In the Dry Dock show, you'll be able to see the refined beauty of our in-game models and duly appreciate the immaculate details of the various objects on their decks.

Today, we're focusing on a special German Tier VIII Premium aircraft carrier. Graf Zeppelin is a fast aircraft carrier with extensive secondary and dual-purpose artillery. If the project had been carried out as historically planned, the ship would have been equipped with the most powerful propulsion among all ships of the German Navy. However, changes in the priorities of the country's shipbuilding program prevented the carrier from being finished before the end of World War II.

notes.title: World of Warships Anniversary — Five Years of Victories!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/fcb17496851709145687c122dc7e59c1cc919cab.jpg[/img]
[b]World of Warships is turning five![/b]

The festive Update is inspired by the history of shipbuilding and has brought many new features to the game: the revamped Designer's Table Port, "Five Epochs of the Navy" permanent Campaign and collection of the same name, and some fresh first-victory bonuses.

[table][tr][th][b]Summary ● Anniversary ● Marathon with Gifts and a Festive Stream ● First-Victory Bonuses ● The "Five Epochs of the Navy" Campaign ● The "Five Epochs of the Navy" Collection[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[previewyoutube=3eqwuTvTMOA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]Five Years of Victories![/b][/h3]
It's been five years since the release of World of Warships. To celebrate, we've prepared a little something for you to reminisce on your past combat achievements and triumphant victories! When did you play your first battle in World of Warships? How many kilometers have you covered? How many enemy ships have you spotted? You can discover the answers to these and other questions via the button below!
[table][tr][th][h2]Asia[/h2][/th][th][h2][url=https://5.wows.asia/]My Records[/url][/h2][/th]
[/tr][tr][th][h2]CIS(Ru)[/h2][/th][th][h2][url=https://5.flot.ru/]My Records[/url][/h2][/th]
[/tr][tr][th][h2]EU[/h2][/th][th][h2][url=https://5.warships.net/]My Records[/url][/h2][/th]
[/tr][tr][th][h2]NA[/h2][/th][th][h2][url=https://5.warships.us/]My Records[/url][/h2][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]Summary[/b][/h2] [table][tr][th][b][b]First-Victory Bonuses[/b][/b][/th] [td]Win battles playing Tier V or higher ships to get rewards: World of Warships Anniversary camouflages, Gift containers, and supercontainers![/td][/tr] [tr][th][b][b]The Epoch Camouflage[/b][/b][/th] [td]Complete all missions of the new Campaign, complete the collection, and get new permanent camouflages that can be mounted on almost all Tier IX ships![/td][/tr] [tr][th][b][b]Historical Marathon Missions[/b][/b][/th] [td]Be on the lookout for bonus codes shown in each episode of the historical marathon. Each bonus code unlocks a chain of combat missions. Complete all of them to get [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]10,000[/b] Coal![/td][/tr] [tr][th][b][b]Festive Stream[/b][/b][/th] [td]A festive stream dedicated to the Fifth Anniversary of our game starts today. Plenty of gifts, interesting guests, and an ocean of positivity await you! We look forward to seeing you out on our virtual seas![/td][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]Anniversary[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts: [/b] [b]Wed. 02 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends: [/b] [b]Wed. 30 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

As we cross the threshold of our fifth year, we're marking the occasion by offering you an array of gifts and fresh in-game activities.

Join the celebrations by entering the updated Designer's Table Port, which has changed a lot over the past year and become even more festive—we've added a cake, postcards, confetti, and ribbons creatively scattered on the table. The collection of ship models has also been replenished with new representatives!

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1aec9b5c-e93f-11ea-b9bb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1aed4e3a-e93f-11ea-adbc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1a984d72-e93f-11ea-8952-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Marathon with Gifts and a Festive Stream[/b][/h2]
We invite you to watch the best episodes of the Naval Legends series and enjoy some gifts in the process!

Be on the lookout for bonus codes shown in each episode of the historical marathon. Each bonus code unlocks a chain of combat missions. Complete all of them to get four containers of the new "Five Epochs of the Navy" collection and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]10,000[/b] Coal!
[list]Join our festive stream in honor of the game's Fifth Anniversary today! Let's celebrate this special event together! Plenty of gifts, interesting guests, and an ocean of positivity await you! We look forward to seeing you out on our virtual seas![/list]
[h2][b]First-Victory Bonuses[/b][/h2]
Be sure to take a careful look at the ship carousel. Ships with a first-victory bonus applied will be marked with a special symbol. During Update 0.9.8, players will be able to receive a festive bonus for their first victories playing specific ships in Random, Co-op, Ranked, and Asymmetric Battles, as well as in Operations.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5e61a4e6-ec27-11ea-ae9d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[*]Tier VIII: 1x Gift container
[*]Tier IX: 2x Gift containers
[*]Tier X: 1x supercontainer[/list]

[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]50,000[/b] Free XP

[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]15,000[/b] Coal
[*]100x economic or combat signals of the same type
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]7/14/30/90 days of Warships Premium Account[/b]
[*]50x random camouflages of the same type
[*]25/50/100x special signals of the same type[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5ed4cdb2-f7ef-11ea-92bf-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[b]VI Admiral Graf Spee[/b], [b]VI Admiral Makarov[/b], [b]VI Aigle[/b], [b]VIII Alabama[/b], [b]IX Alaska[/b], [b]VI Anshan[/b], [b]VI Arizona[/b], [b]VI Ark Royal[/b], [b]VIII Asashio[/b], [b]VII Ashitaka[/b], [b]VIII Atago[/b], [b]VII Atlanta[/b], [b]IX Azuma[/b], [b]VIII Bayard[/b], [b]VII Belfast[/b], [b]IX Benham[/b], [b]VII Błyskawica[/b], [b]VII Boise[/b], [b]VII California[/b], [b]VIII Friedrich[/b], [b]VIII Prinz Eugen[/b], [b]VIII Roma[/b], [b]VIII Saipan[/b], [b]VII Scharnhorst[/b], [b]VII Sims[/b], [b]V Siroco[/b], [b]VI T-61[/b], [b]V Texas[/b], [b]VIII Tirpitz[/b], [b]VIII [h2][b]The "Five Epochs of the Navy" Campaign[/b][/h2]
The new permanent Campaign comprises 50 tasks grouped into five missions, each of which is dedicated to a specific shipbuilding epoch. To finish the Campaign, you need to complete tasks playing ships of various tiers: starting from Tier II–IV ships for the first mission, and progressing to Tiers VIII–X for the final mission. Most of the tasks must be completed playing certain ships related to the history of the navy. For example, some of the tasks of the first mission are inspired by the development of battleship building technologies and should be completed playing battleships of this era, such as [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]III South Carolina[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]III Kawachi[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IV Gangut[/b][/b], or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]III Dreadnought[/b][/b]—which contributed to the adoption of the name given to this period of naval history.

However, you can complete the Campaign, collect all the containers of the new collection, and obtain the final reward by completing the first three tasks of each mission playing any ships of the relevant tiers.

[b]The reward for completing the Campaign[/b] is the Epoch permanent camouflage, which can be mounted on all Tier IX ships, except for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX AL Sov. Rossiya[/b][/b].
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b26a26ba-e93b-11ea-85f1-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
The first Directive has become available with the release of Update 0.9.8, while those that follow will be unlocked each week.
[list][i]Please note: you can complete the tasks of each mission multiple times. This will allow you to continue earning Stars upon each completion, but you'll receive the reward for completing the task for the first time only.[/i][/list]
[h2][b]The "Five Epochs of the Navy" Collection[/b][/h2]
The "Five Epochs of the Navy" collection is made up of five sections, with six elements in each. Each section is dedicated to a specific period in the history of the navy in the first half of the 20th century—from ships of the dreadnought era to those of World War II and the post-war years. Having completed the entire collection, you'll have learned about the construction history, design features, and fates of prominent representatives of the shipbuilding epochs.
[list]The reward for completing each section is 1 day of Warships Premium Account. The reward for completing the entire collection is the Epoch permanent camouflage.[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/50407412-e940-11ea-a5d3-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Elements of the collection can only be obtained from the same-name containers. The exchange rate for duplicate elements is 1:1. To exchange duplicates, you need to select a vacant slot in a collection section and confirm that you want to exchange your duplicates for the missing item in the window that appears.

You can obtain 30 "Five Epochs of the Navy" containers by completing tasks of the same-name Campaign.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/f8919f7e-e93b-11ea-b355-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]A "Five Epochs of the Navy" container includes:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]One element of the "Five Epochs of the Navy" collection.
[*]1x World of Warships Anniversary camouflage.
[*]One of the following items: 2x signals of the same type (Zulu, Papa Papa, Equal Speed Charlie London, or India Bravo Terrathree); or [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]500[/b] Free XP; or [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]50,000[/b] credits.[/list]

notes.title: Dry Dock: Anchorage
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/6749c2b5c11926fff2c56ea5ea5acb956061e1b2.jpg[/img]
[b]One of the new features of Update 0.9.8 is the Dockyard, where you'll be able to construct Anchorage.[/b]

By progressing through missions of the Directives, you can complete 18 out of 20 shipbuilding phases and obtain the corresponding rewards at the Dockyard. In order to complete the 19th and 20th phases, in addition to finishing all the event's Directives, you'll need to purchase any two shipbuilding phases by spending doubloons.

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/dockyard-build-anchorage/#directives]Read more>>>[/url]
[previewyoutube=vzl6GehDyQw;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]History[/b][/h2]
In mid-1940, the U.S. Navy issued an order for the construction of a series of Baltimore-class heavy cruisers, which became the standard ships of this type in the U.S. Navy during World War II. At the same time, the General Board of the U.S. Navy assigned the Bureau of Ships the task of developing a design for a completely new heavy cruiser with improved armor, a greater number of main battery guns, and enhanced speed.

Prepared in September 1940, the design, codenamed CA-A—which featured reinforced armor and could theoretically achieve speeds of up to 34 knots—was not much bigger than Baltimore in terms of displacement. Both ships carried nine main battery guns. The CA-C design, presented in March 1941, which fulfilled all the requirements of the General Board, was close in dimensions to the already ordered Alaska-class large cruisers. A balance was found in the preliminary design, codenamed CA-B—with a displacement of 17,000 tons and speed of 33 knots, she had twelve 203 mm guns placed in four turrets.

The CA-B project has been resurrected in the form of World of Warships cruiser Anchorage.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/99d6117c-f42b-11ea-bc33-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/2f15fc48-f431-11ea-8d34-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

[b]Anti-aircraft armament:[/b] fifty-six 28 mm/75 Mark 1 anti-aircraft guns in quadruple mounts; sixteen 20 mm Oerlikon automatic cannons in single mounts

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/2f44728a-f431-11ea-899c-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

[b]Torpedoes:[/b] two 533 mm quadruple-tube torpedo launchers

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/41d59a1e-f42c-11ea-872d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Key Features[/b][/h2]
[list][*]Anchorage is armed with twelve 203 mm guns mounted in four triple turrets, making her capable of unleashing a weighty salvo.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/739f211fd0af5f56c1b25727686af7e162d32143.jpg[/img]
[b]Ahoy, Commanders![/b]

We’re thrilled to announce the launch of the World of Warships podcast. Join us each week as we discuss all things naval history.

[url=https://wowspodcast.podbean.com/]Join now[/url]
[list]The podcast is available in English and Russian.[/list]
[list][*]Why is Yamato considered to be the most powerful battleship ever built?
[*]What nation has the fastest and most powerful torpedoes?
[*]How did the Regia Marina try to regain naval dominance with the aid of human torpedoes?
[*]How did American destroyers break the backs of the Kriegsmarine submarine wolfpacks during World War II?[/list]
[h3][b]Listen via:[/b][/h3]
[list][*][url=https://podcasts.apple.com/podcast/world-of-warships-podcast/id1530013873]Apple Podcasts[/url]
[*][url=https://open.spotify.com/show/17NlsKrLRe1h4Xeyr0MLSm]Spotify[/url]
[*][url=https://tunein.com/podcasts/History-Podcasts/World-of-Warships-Podcast-p1362843/]TuneIn[/url]
[*][url=https://www.stitcher.com/s?fid=569571&refid=stpr]Stitcher[/url]
[*][url=https://www.listennotes.com/podcasts/world-of-warships-podcast-wowspodcast-QiH3dGYcqae/]Listen Notes[/url]
[*][url=https://deezer.com/show/1703762]Deezer[/url]
[*][url=https://overcast.fm/p2236847-Wjpcrm]Overcast[/url][/list]
[h3][b]This month on the World of Warships podcast:[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Bofors[/b]: we discuss a truly global weapon. The Swedish Bofors L60 has served as the anti-aircraft gun of choice for countless nations.
[*][b]Maiale[/b]: the first Human Torpedo! But how did the Regia Marina plan to utilize this technology to dominate the seas?
[*][b]Oerlikon[/b]: we chat about how World War II gun crews used the fearsome anti-aircraft mount to fill the skies with a storm of metal.
[*][b]Błyskawica: [/b]step aboard the oldest preserved destroyer in the world. She served in the Polish Navy during World War II and is the only ship of the nation’s navy to have been awarded the Virtuti Militari medal.[/list]
[list]Hop on board to discover and immerse yourself in the unique atmosphere of World of Warships anywhere you go![/list]

To make the switch, simply navigate to Settings — Audio — then click “Listen to your own music.” The podcasts will be enabled automatically.[/i][/list]

[h2]Round 1 Schedule[/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts: [/b] [b]Thu. 10 Sep. 18:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends: [/b] [b]Tue. 15 Sep. 07:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[h2]Special Features of the Test[/h2]
The Public Test server will host Clan Battles, with Tier X ships facing each other in a 3 vs. 3 format.

[h3][b]Procedure[/b][/h3]
[list][*]A maximum of two mercenaries per Division.
[*]Ship restrictions per team:
[list][*]A maximum of one destroyer, cruiser, and aircraft carrier.
[*]A maximum two battleships. If the team has one aircraft carrier, there can be no more than one battleship in the same team.[/list]
[*]You can start a Clan Battle on the Public Test server at any time.[/list]
For testing purposes, all players will have access to one of three Daily Shipment options. These will be allocated at random and differ in their designs, as well as the rewards they can drop.

[h2]Starting Bonuses[/h2]
[list][*]Every participant of the Public Test will have all researchable Tier VIII ships, helmed by Commanders with 15 skill points, credited to their PT accounts.
[*]The research prices for ships and ship modules will be substantially discounted.

If you're joining the Public Test for the first time since Update 0.9.9, you'll be awarded the following additional bonuses:
[list][*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]500,000,000[/b] credits; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]30,000[/b] doubloons; and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]90 days of Premium Account[/b].
[*]50 signal flags of all types (except special signals) will also be added to your PT account.[/list]
If you played at least one battle on the Public Test server during the 0.9.6–0.9.8 Public Tests, your account will be copied from the live server to the Public Test server.

[h2]How to Enter[/h2]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2716184589232191867

[h1][b]Developer Bulletin 0.9.9[/b][/h1]
[list][b][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the Update is still being tested, the information in this Bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the Update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the Update is released.[/b][/list]
[table][tr][th][b]U.S. Battleships: Part 1 ● Mercenaries ● Other Changes[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]U.S. Battleships: Part 1[/b][/h2]
Update 0.9.9 kicks off an event with the new U.S. battleships [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Kansas[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IX Minnesota[/b][/b] right in spotlight! These ships will become available in Early Access on the Live Server only when the Update is released. Meanwhile, we invite you to take part in the testing of the event.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f7a80758-f19f-11ea-98b3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][b]Please note: the rewards for activities on the Public Test server may differ from those on the live server. The new U.S. battleships will not be available on the Public Test server.[/b][/list]
[h3][b]Features of the Ship Branch[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Numerous main battery guns with a solid salvo weight and decent firing range, which comes at the expense of longer gun reload times.
[*]The ships enjoy great maneuverability for their type, as well as good anti-torpedo protection, but are rather slow.
[*]Their decent AA defenses are reinforced by the availability of the Defensive AA Fire consumable.[/list]
[b]Early Access[/b]: [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Kansas[/b][/b] can be obtained by completing Directives. [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IX Minnesota[/b][/b] can be obtained from random bundles that are available in the Armory in exchange for doubloons.

[b]Rewards for completing Directives[/b]: a new temporary resource called American Tokens.

[b]Rewards in exchange for American Tokens[/b]: sequentially available bundles with Gold Eagle permanent camouflage patterns for the new U.S. battleships, as well as other rewards.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f7ac1190-f19f-11ea-ab04-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The Naval Base Port has been updated.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7512124c-f1a0-11ea-9d49-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Mercenaries[/b][/h2]
Division Commanders will now have the option to invite "mercenaries," i.e. players from outside their Clan, to join their Divisions for Clan Battles.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c937e80a-f1a1-11ea-a814-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The new feature will allow Clan leaders to test candidates who want to join their Clan in a real combat scenario, or fill any roster gaps without having to actually accept new players into the Clan.

The following rules apply to mercenaries:
[list][*]To add a mercenary to the team, simply invite them to join your Division. You can search for players via the "Divisions" tab in the game client.
[*]After a battle, the mercenary receives rewards based on the league of the Clan they went into battle with.
[*]However, the mercenary will not receive the associated economic bonuses of the Clan they fought for.[/list]
[h2][b]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
The barbettes and main battery guns have been updated for all ships. Previously, when a shell hit the main battery turret, damage was dealt only to the module itself, and the player received a "Penetration" ribbon without any actual damage having been dealt to the enemy ship. Now, any damage dealt to the main battery turret also entails a reduction in the ship's hit points in the amount of 1/10 of the maximum damage of the shell. This way, hitting a turret will no longer result in a penetration without inflicting actual damage.

We've changed the visual appearance of aiming reticles for carrier squadrons and reworked the aircraft camera performance. This change will affect only the visual component of a squadron's interface, making it easier to aim with all types of armament without affecting gameplay.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7733cca8-f1a2-11ea-a814-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7733e9c2-f1a2-11ea-8800-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/76e46c26-f1a2-11ea-bf3f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

Any aircraft operating within a squadron will now change position in a smoother way; the trajectory of bombers moving in on a target will change slightly, and any damage taken by the aircraft in the process will cause it to shake.

We've improved the visual display of water for all graphic settings. In particular, the visual noise applied to the sea has been removed entirely on the horizon. This change will improve game client performance.

The Spaceport has been updated to accommodate the new lighting model and enhanced HDR technology.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4fb8715a-f1a3-11ea-af28-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

notes.title: WoWS x Transformers. More than meets the eye!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9b435e805f85947495b6e87ae08e312176dd9529.jpg[/img]
[b]We are happy to share more assets from the upcoming collaboration with Transformers![/b]

Autobots and Decepticons will be introduced for a limited time as themed ship skins and commanders later this September. For now, take a look at another comic page and assets below.

[table][tr][th][b]Permanent Camouflages and Commanders ● Expendable Camouflages ● Flags and Patches ● Containers ● About Hasbro[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/85b567f4-eded-11ea-bcfa-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Permanent Camouflages and Commanders[/b][/h2]
Four iconic Transformers characters will be released as unique ship skins and commanders with recognizable phrases and voiceovers. Optimus Prime and Bumblebee will set the stage for the heroic Autobots, with Megatron and Rumble to be available as their eternal foes — the Decepticons.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2d99b758-eddb-11ea-a385-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2d97b566-eddb-11ea-97d5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2d24b886-eddb-11ea-a1e6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2d1508e6-eddb-11ea-aa15-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Freedom Fighter[/b][/h3]
The design of this camouflage is based on Optimus Prime — the courageous and powerful leader of the Autobots. He is a skilled warrior in battle, and a tireless defender of the weak. Born of humble beginnings, he became a hero by raising his voice in support of freedom; he became a legend by picking up a blaster and putting his spark on the line to fight for it.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3c4a2336-eddc-11ea-98c0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3cbca8a2-eddc-11ea-aa15-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3c55cc72-eddc-11ea-8f90-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3cbbc3ba-eddc-11ea-b814-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Gold Bug[/b][/h3]
The design of this camouflage is based on Bumblebee — one of the youngest members of the Autobot team. An exuberant and energetic adventurer, he looks up to Optimus Prime as a mentor and is completely devoted to his leader’s mission to secure freedom for all sentient beings.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fadaf380-eddb-11ea-99b9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fb5fa6d4-eddb-11ea-b814-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpeg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fb86f52c-eddb-11ea-98c0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpeg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fad8c74a-eddb-11ea-8f90-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Messenger of Oblivion[/b][/h3]
The design of this camouflage is based on Megatron — the leader of the Decepticons and one of the most feared warriors in the universe. He believes in bringing order and peace to Cybertron and the universe through dictatorship — his dictatorship.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/301129e2-eddd-11ea-9223-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2faaab86-eddd-11ea-98c0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/30110318-eddd-11ea-aa15-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2fa0d296-eddd-11ea-9fd8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Crush ’n’ Destroy[/b][/h3]
The design of this camouflage is based on Rumble from Transformers — one of Soundwave’s spies. What he lacks in discretion, he makes up for in raw power. As the Decepticon demolitions expert, Rumble loves nothing more than breaking things apart and causing chaos and destruction.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d974198c-eddc-11ea-aa15-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d9f59700-eddc-11ea-8069-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d9d2a696-eddc-11ea-adfe-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpeg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d9717b14-eddc-11ea-a6f3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Expendable Camouflages[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Autobot Ark[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/855fa40e-eded-11ea-9c1d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Decepticon Disguise[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8562c01c-eded-11ea-8003-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Flags and Patches[/b][/h2]
Will you mount the Autobots flag or the Decepticons flag? Will you fight for Megatron’s dictatorship, or will you join the mission to secure freedom for all sentient beings?

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f89be29e-ede7-11ea-b99b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f83ecc80-ede7-11ea-8003-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f8602d4e-ede7-11ea-96ef-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f861fbec-ede7-11ea-a153-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f8811928-ede7-11ea-96a2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f91f3194-ede7-11ea-8852-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f847bcdc-ede7-11ea-933d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f8693fc4-ede7-11ea-9d51-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f883a90e-ede7-11ea-af43-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Containers[/b][/h2]
From Cybertronian containers, players will have a chance to get distinctive themed permanent and expendable camouflages, unique Transformers Commanders with unique voice-overs, and special signals.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/2f894746-ede4-11ea-8f07-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]About Hasbro[/b][/h2]
Hasbro (NASDAQ: HAS) is a global play and entertainment company committed to Creating the World's Best Play and Entertainment Experiences. From toys, games and consumer products to television, movies, digital gaming, live action, music, and virtual reality experiences, Hasbro connects to global audiences by bringing to life great innovations, stories, and brands across established and inventive platforms. Hasbro’s iconic brands include NERF, MAGIC THE GATHERING, MY LITTLE PONY, TRANSFORMERS, PLAY-DOH, MONOPOLY, BABY ALIVE, POWER RANGERS, PEPPA PIG and PJ MASKS as well as premier partner brands. Through its global entertainment studio eOne, as well as its entertainment labels, Allspark Pictures and Allspark Animation, Hasbro is building its brands globally through great storytelling and content on all screens. Hasbro is committed to making the world a better place for children and their families through corporate social responsibility and philanthropy. Hasbro ranked No. 13 on the 2019 100 Best Corporate Citizens list by CR Magazine, and has been named one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies® by Ethisphere Institute for the past eight years. Learn more at [url=http://www.hasbro.com/]www.hasbro.com[/url], and follow them on Twitter (@Hasbro) and Instagram (@Hasbro).

notes.content:

[b]Hurry to obtain these unique permanent camouflages on the occasion of the World of Warships Anniversary![/b]

[table][tr][th][b]World of Warships Anniversary ● Anchorage in the Dockyard ● Free rewards in the Armory![/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/sales-and-events/premium-shop-098-anniversary/][/url]World of Warships Anniversary[/b][/h2]
Celebrate the Fifth Anniversary of World of Warships by decorating your Tier IX ships with the unique Epoch permanent camouflage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Bundles will be available for purchase until:[/b] [b]Thu. 24 Sep. 08:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9f9187f8-ede2-11ea-953b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]World of Warships: 5th Anniversary![/b] –15%[/h2]
[list][*]Epoch permanent camouflage
[*][b]Bonus[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]555[/b]
[*][b]Bonus[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]555,555[/b][/list]
[h2]Details[/h2]
Celebrate the Anniversary of World of Warships by mounting a unique permanent camouflage for any Tier IX ship (except AL Sovetskaya Rossiya). Once the camouflage is mounted on a ship, it gets assigned to that ship and acquires the properties of a typical permanent camouflage. Onwards to new victories, Captains!

[h1][i][h3][b]Bonuses provided by the Epoch permanent camouflage[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
