notes.title: The Dockyard: Build Anchorage
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/02d13ee6219fcbf6f3e39c91d575189317827ece.jpg[/img]
[b]One of the new features of Update 0.9.8 is the Dockyard, where you'll be able to construct [i]Anchorage[/i].[/b]

[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Anchorage[/b][/b] is a multipurpose heavy cruiser that performs best when fighting at short and medium ranges. The ship is armed with twelve 203 mm guns mounted in four triple turrets, making her capable of unleashing a weighty salvo. Anchorage's AP shells have enhanced ricochet angles like those of the researchable American heavy cruisers. The Hydroacoustic Search consumable and torpedo armament she carries enable Anchorage to perform effectively in close quarters combat, while her Smoke Generator—a feature not typically found on American heavy cruisers—will help her escape situations where she finds herself under concentrated enemy fire.

[table][tr][th][b]Rules of the Event ● Directives ● Rewards[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[previewyoutube=RW_xZq31_TU;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4e70ffac-ec61-11ea-b1d9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4e6fc4d4-ec61-11ea-99db-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4e714ad4-ec61-11ea-a9b1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4db8a2d6-ec61-11ea-afb6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]


[h2][b]Rules of the Event[/b][/h2]
The rules of the new Dockyard are similar to those of the Hamburg Dockyard:
[list][*]The shipbuilding process is divided into 20 phases.
[*]These phases can be completed by progressing through Directives of the event, purchasing discounted Starter Packs, or exchanging [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,750[/b] doubloons for each phase.
[*]The Directives will span two updates—0.9.8 and 0.9.9, and the Dockyard itself will remain in your Ports until the end of Update 0.9.10.
[*]In total, you can complete 18 out of 20 shipbuilding phases by progressing through Directives. Two of the 20 phases must be completed by spending doubloons.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Anchorage[/b][/b] and her National camouflage, along with a 10-skill Commander, Port slot, and commemorative flag, await you upon completion of the 20th phase.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/97950540-ec50-11ea-a4b5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/979989bc-ec50-11ea-b7af-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/97930088-ec50-11ea-8a44-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/97986f50-ec50-11ea-8f8b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Directives[/b][/h2] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/407480fc-ecfe-11ea-ab62-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]
The new game event has 48 missions spread across six Directives. The first Directive will become available with the release of Update 0.9.8, while those that follow will be unlocked each week.

Completing each Directive will progress you through three shipbuilding phases:
[list][*]Two shipbuilding phases are completed by accomplishing specific missions that form part of the Directive.
[*]One shipbuilding phase is completed by finishing the entire Directive.[/list]
[list][i]Detailed information about the Directives is available in the game client.[/i][/list]
[h2][b]Rewards[/b][/h2]
By progressing through missions of the Directives, you can complete 18 out of 20 shipbuilding phases and obtain the corresponding rewards at the Dockyard.

By accomplishing the first two Directives, you can complete up to six shipbuilding phases and obtain the following rewards:
[list][*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]7,500[/b] Coal
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Warships Premium Account[/b]
[*]2x Gift containers, holding five special signals each
[*]10x Stars'n'Stripes camouflages[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/a696a3b2-ec61-11ea-9db6-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Completing four out of the six Directives will progress you through up to twelve shipbuilding phases and grant you even more valuable rewards:
[list][*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]100,000[/b] Free XP
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]7,500[/b] Coal
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]4 days of Warships Premium Account[/b]
[*]10x signals of each of the following types: Wyvern, Dragon, and Scylla
[*]2x Gift containers
[*]15x Stars'n'Stripes camouflages[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/a64f4e5e-ec61-11ea-9715-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Accomplishing all Directives of the event will progress you through 18 shipbuilding phases and grant you all the available rewards:
[list][*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]100,000[/b] Free XP
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]7,500[/b] Coal
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]4 days of Warships Premium Account[/b]
[*]10x signals of each of the following types: Hydra, Basilisk, Scylla, Leviathan, Dragon, Red Dragon, Ouroboros, and Wyvern
[*]7x Gift containers
[*]15x Stars'n'Stripes camouflages[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/a649aea4-ec61-11ea-99db-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
In order to complete the 19th and 20th phases, in addition to progressing through all the Directives, you'll need to spend doubloons to pass through any two shipbuilding phases.
[list][*]Reward for completing phase 19: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]10,000[/b] Coal
[*]Final reward: [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Anchorage[/b][/b] in the National camouflage, a Commander with 10 skill points, Port slot, and a commemorative flag[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/a65fdae4-ec61-11ea-afb6-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
If you would rather not wait, you can complete all the shipbuilding phases in exchange for doubloons and thus obtain all the available rewards immediately. If you decide to complete construction of the ship at the Dockyard by using doubloons, you can still progress through the Directives. In that case, you'll get [b]600[/b] Research Points for each completed phase instead of the standard rewards. Thus, you can earn up to [b]10,800[/b] Research Points in total. If you haven't yet accessed the Research Bureau, you'll gain access to it immediately with the first Research Points you earn. At the same time, you'll receive [b]10,000[/b] Research Points as a one-time reward and unlock the possibility to earn Research Points by completing Daily Missions.

If you want to complete shipbuilding phases at a discount, you can purchase two Starter Packs:
[list][*]Two shipbuilding phases for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]3,000[/b] doubloons
[*]Eight shipbuilding phases for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]8,000[/b] doubloons[/list]
[list][i]Please note: you can purchase the Starter Packs only before you complete the first four shipbuilding phases by progressing through Directives of the event.[/i][/list]

If there are problems with downloading or launching the update—please [url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=2037-QEUH-3335]perform files integrity check[/url].

Subtitles can be enabled in the video player separately.
[previewyoutube=rc4AXC4PRAo;full][/previewyoutube]

[table][tr][th][b]World of Warships Anniversary ● Asymmetric Battles ● Dockyard ● Armory ● Ranked Battles ● Visual Improvements ● Content Additions and Changes ● Other Changes and Improvements[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]World of Warships Anniversary[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7514a99a-eb82-11ea-831e-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

With Update 0.9.8, World of Warships is celebrating its Fifth Anniversary! The festive Update offers a bunch of gifts and in-game activities: a permanent Campaign titled "Five Epochs of the Navy," plus a collection of the same name; fresh first-win bonuses, a revamped Designer's Table Port, and a new battle type—Asymmetric Battles.

[h3][b]Permanent "Five Epochs of the Navy" Campaign[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b2e1ac68-e93f-11ea-99bf-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The "Five Epochs of the Navy" Campaign comprises 50 tasks grouped into five missions, each of which is dedicated to a specific shipbuilding epoch. To finish the Campaign, you'll need to complete tasks playing ships of various tiers: starting from Tier II–IV ships for the first mission, and progressing to Tiers VIII–X for the final mission.
[list][b]Reward for finishing the Campaign:[/b] Epoch permanent camouflage for Tier IX ships.[/list]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2846792783415563078

[h3][b]"Five Epochs of the Navy" Collection[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/55568bba-e93d-11ea-a5d3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The "Five Epochs of the Navy" collection is made up of five sections, with six elements in each. Each section is dedicated to a specific period in the history of shipbuilding.

Only [b]"Five Epochs of the Navy" containers[/b] drop collectibles.
[list][b]The reward for completing the entire collection:[/b] Epoch permanent camouflage for Tier IX ships.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b2cd7342-e93f-11ea-adbc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]The Epoch permanent camouflage can be mounted on any Tier IX ship, except for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX AL Sov. Rossiya[/b][/b]. Once mounted on a ship, the camouflage remains assigned to that ship. Another copy of the camouflage can be assigned to a different ship.[/i][/list]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2846792783415563078

[h3][b]Victory Bonuses[/b][/h3]
During Update 0.9.8, you can expect a festive bonus for your first victories of the Update with certain ships. It can be secured on ships starting from Tier V:
[list][*]Tiers V–VII: 2x World of Warships Anniversary camouflage patterns
[*]Tier VIII: 1x Gift container
[*]Tier IX: 2x Gift containers
[*]Tier X: 1x supercontainer[/list]
[h2][b]Asymmetric Battles[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/754588f8-eb82-11ea-8e7d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:  [/b] [b]Thu. 03 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Thu. 17 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[list][*]In an Asymmetric Battle, a team of five to seven Tier VII–VIII ships will confront a team of nine to twelve ships of Tiers V–VI.
[*]To enter battle with Tier VII–VIII ships, you'll need to spend a new temporary resource—Battle Tokens. The cost of entering a battle playing Tier VII–VIII ships is 500 Battle Tokens.
[*]Battle Tokens can be earned in Asymmetric Battles:
[list][*]Tier V: 250 Tokens per battle
[*]Tier VI: 150 Tokens per battle
[*]Tier VII: 200 Tokens per battle
[*]Tier VIII: 25 Tokens per battle
[*]You'll receive 1,000 Tokens each day upon logging in to the game.
[*]Tokens are earned irrespective of the battle results, but players will not be awarded them if they are inactive.[/list]
[/list]
[list][i]Please note: Battle Tokens are only used to participate in Asymmetric Battles. With the release of Update 0.9.9 all Battle Tokens will be converted into credits at a rate of 1:50. Asymmetric Battles become available after reaching Access Level 12.[/i][/list]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2846792783415563078

[h2][b]Dockyard[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7571f4d8-eb82-11ea-9630-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Another new feature of Update 0.9.8 is the Dockyard, where you'll be able to construct [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Anchorage[/b][/b]. The rules of the new Dockyard are in many ways similar to those applied to the Hamburg Dockyard, but the list of rewards for completing the shipbuilding phases has changed. For example, completing phase 12 will bring you [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]100,000[/b] Free XP.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/94edaef8-eb8f-11ea-a8f7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]The construction process of the Dockyard comprises 20 phases.
[*]Each shipbuilding phase can be completed by finishing the Directives of the event, or by spending [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,750[/b] doubloons per phase.
[*]The Directives will span two updates—0.9.8 and 0.9.9, and the Dockyard itself will remain in your Ports until the end of Update 0.9.10.
[*]You can complete 18 out of 20 shipbuilding phases by accomplishing Directives. In order to complete the 19th and 20th phases, in addition to completing all the Directives, you'll need to purchase any two shipbuilding phases by spending doubloons.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Anchorage[/b][/b] and her National camouflage, along with a 10-skill Commander, Port slot, and commemorative flag, await you upon completing the 20th phase.[/list]
[list][i]The full details will be published in a dedicated article.[/i][/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/96fdae8a-eb87-11ea-9342-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Armory[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/74dc091e-eb82-11ea-9a23-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In Update 0.9.8, the customary Daily Shipments will be replaced with free daily random bundles in the Armory:
[list][*]You can only obtain one bundle per day.
[*]A total of 15 bundles will be available during the period of three weeks, so you can skip up to 6 days and still be able to collect all the rewards.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f8045936-eb8c-11ea-973b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h1][i][h3][b]Bundle contents[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[list][*]1 day of Warships Premium Account—1x bundle
[*]50,000 credits—5x bundles
[*]50 doubloons—1x bundle
[*]3x World of Warships Anniversary camouflage patterns—4x bundles
[*]1x Gift container—3x bundles
[*]1x King of the Sea container—1x bundle[/list]
[h2][b]Ranked Battles[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/754bd94c-eb82-11ea-96a6-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts: [/b] [b]Wed. 16 Sep. 11:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends: [/b] [b]Tue. 13 Oct. 10:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[b]Format:[/b] 8 vs. 8 playing Tier X ships.
[b]Rewards:[/b] up to [b]5,500[/b] Steel and many additional rewards.
[b]Maps and modes:[/b] North, Sea of Fortune, and Greece in Domination mode; Sleeping Giant and Warrior's Path in Arms Race mode; and Tears of the Desert in Epicenter mode.
[list][i]The Season's details will be published in a dedicated article.[/i][/list]

[h2][b]Visual Improvements[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/756285de-eb82-11ea-a1c3-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The visual display of fog in the game has been enhanced by adopting an updated spacial distribution system and adding a scattered sunlight effect. Apart from improving the visual component, this change will also provide a slight improvement in the game client's performance.

[table][tr][td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f103a0c0-eb86-11ea-9342-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f103a0c0-eb86-11ea-9342-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f0faf240-eb86-11ea-bcb7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg][img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f0faf240-eb86-11ea-bcb7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr][/table]

[h2][b]Content Additions and Changes[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/74e81bd2-eb82-11ea-a21d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In collaboration with Hasbro and Takara Tomy, the following items have been added:
[list][*]Freedom Fighter permanent camo for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]X Montana[/b][/b], Gold Bug permanent camo for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]X Gearing[/b][/b], Messenger of Oblivion permanent camo for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]X Großer Kurfürst[/b][/b], and the Crush’n’Destroy permanent camo for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]X Khabarovsk[/b][/b].
[*]Decepticon Disguise and Autobot Ark expendable camouflage patterns.
[*]Commanders with special voiceovers: [b]Optimus Prime[/b], [b]Bumblebee[/b], [b]Megatron[/b], and [b]Rumble[/b].
[*]Cybertronian containers.
[*]Themed patches and flags.[/list]
[list][i]Details about the ways in which you can obtain content dedicated to [b]"Transformers: Generation 1"[/b] will be announced later.[/i][/list]
In honor of the holiday, the Mid-Autumn Festival permanent camouflage pattern for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VI Warspite[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VI Dunkerque[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/premium_4516ee494bb0396e51796cebff5e45c3f448d9790e0a58082057b8949ed9a3f8.png[/img][b]VIII Kaga[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Prinz Eugen[/b][/b] has been added, as well as the following unique Commanders:
[list][*][b]Chang’e[/b] with a specialization for Pan-Asian and Japanese ships
[*][b]Hou Yi[/b] with a specialization for Pan-Asian ships
[*][b]Kaguya[/b] with a specialization for Japanese ships[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/256745be-eb88-11ea-a1c3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f8714ad2-eb8c-11ea-9342-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The Anniversary commemorative flag and the For Meritorious Service patch have been added into the game.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/25576ac2-eb88-11ea-9342-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]Details on how to get these items will be published later.[/i][/list]
To make the process of researching ships simpler, the following changes have been made to [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]VIII Admiral Hipper[/b][/b]'s modules:
[list][*]Hull A has been removed from the game.
[*]Hulls B and C have been renamed "A" and "B," respectively.
[*]If you have already researched Hull B, you'll receive compensation in the amount of [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9d43348869eb4ac094288dad196925d8f6d9d89b.png[/img][b]22,000[/b] ship XP.
[*]If you have already researched Hull C, the new Hull B will be mounted on your ship instead. In other cases Hull A will be mounted on the ship.
[*]If you've already purchased one of the replacement hulls, you'll receive compensation in the amount of credits you paid for it.[/list]
The stock hull of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]V Königsberg[/b][/b] has been replaced with a new one, created on the basis of the researchable hull with a changed composition for the AA and secondary guns.

English-language audio for Naval Legends has been added into the game client:
[list][*]To listen to Naval Legends directly in battle, you need to enable the "Listen to your own music" option in the sound settings.
[*]If you already use your own music as background sound, then Naval Legends will be added to your playlist.
[*]In case you opt to remove Naval Legends from your playlist, you need to remove the respective audio files from the [b]bin/<VERSION_ID>/res/userMusiс[/b] folder in the game client.[/list]

notes.title: World of Warships Anniversary!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/bbfe0431e8147b2066f88d6e761ae1422cac5892.jpg[/img]
[b]With the release of Update 0.9.8, World of Warships begins its Fifth Anniversary celebration![/b]

The festive Update is inspired by the history of shipbuilding and will bring many new features to the game: the revamped Designer's Table Port, the “Five Epochs of the Navy” permanent Campaign and collection of the same name, a new battle type, and fresh first-victory bonuses.

[table][tr][th][b]Anniversary ● First-Victory Bonuses ● “Five Epochs of the Navy” Campaign ● "Five Epochs of the Navy" Collection ● Asymmetric Battles ● Marathon with Gifts and a Festive Stream[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]Anniversary[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Thu. 03 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Wed. 30 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

As we cross the threshold of our fifth year, we're marking the occasion by offering you an array of gifts and fresh in-game activities.

Join the celebrations by entering the updated Designer’s Table Port, which has changed a lot over the past year and become even more festive—we've added a cake, postcards, confetti, and ribbons creatively scattered on the table. The collection of ship models has also been updated with new representatives!

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1aec9b5c-e93f-11ea-b9bb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1aed4e3a-e93f-11ea-adbc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1a984d72-e93f-11ea-8952-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]First-Victory Bonuses[/b][/h2]
Be sure to take a careful look at your ship carousel. Ships with a first-victory bonus applied will be marked with a special symbol. During Update 0.9.8, players will be able to receive a festive bonus for their first victories playing specific ships in Random, Co-op, Ranked, and Asymmetric Battles, as well as in Operations.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/12d9c834-e941-11ea-b467-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]List of Rewards[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Tiers V–VII: 2x World of Warships Anniversary camouflages
[*]Tier VIII: 1x Gift container
[*]Tier IX: 2x Gift containers
[*]Tier X: 1x supercontainer[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/2367fa60-e93a-11ea-a195-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
A Gift container holds five special signals of the same type (Dragon, Red Dragon, Wyvern, Ouroboros, Hydra, Basilisk, Scylla, or Leviathan).
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a1e60c4e-e93d-11ea-9d07-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]You can receive the first-victory bonus for each ship only once during Update 0.9.8. The bonuses will also be applied to ships purchased, bought back, or dropped from containers during Update 0.9.8.[/i][/list]
[h2][b]“Five Epochs of the Navy” Campaign[/b][/h2]
The new permanent Campaign comprises 50 tasks grouped into five missions, each of which is dedicated to a specific shipbuilding epoch. To finish the Campaign, you'll need to complete tasks playing ships of various tiers: starting from Tier II–IV ships for the first mission, and progressing to Tiers VIII–X for the final mission. Most of the tasks must be completed playing certain ships related to the history of the navy. For example, some of the tasks of the first mission are inspired by the development of battleship building technologies and should be completed playing battleships of this era, such as [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]III South Carolina[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]III Kawachi[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]IV Gangut[/b][/b], or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]III Dreadnought[/b][/b]—all of which contributed to the adoption of the name given to this period of naval history.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b2e1ac68-e93f-11ea-99bf-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

However, you can complete the Campaign, collect all the containers of the new collection, and obtain the final reward by completing the first three tasks of each mission playing any ships of the relevant tiers.

[b]The reward for completing the Campaign[/b] is an Epoch permanent camouflage, which can be mounted on any one Tier IX ship, except for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX AL Sov. Rossiya[/b][/b].
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b26a26ba-e93b-11ea-85f1-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b2cd7342-e93f-11ea-adbc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The first mission will become available with the release of Update 0.9.8, while those that follow will be unlocked each week.
[list][i]Please note: you can complete tasks of each mission multiple times. This will allow you to continue earning Stars with each completion, but you'll receive the reward for completing the task for the first time only.[/i][/list]
[h2][b]"Five Epochs of the Navy" Collection[/b][/h2]
Update 0.9.8 ushers in the "Five Epochs of the Navy" collection, which comprises five sections with six elements in each. Each section is dedicated to a specific period in the naval history of the first half of the 20th century—from ships of the dreadnought era to those of World War II and the post-war years. Having completed the entire collection, you'll have learned about the construction history, design features, and fates of prominent representatives of each shipbuilding epoch.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/55568bba-e93d-11ea-a5d3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list]The reward for completing each section is 1 day of Warships Premium Account. The reward for completing the entire collection is an Epoch permanent camouflage.[/list] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/50407412-e940-11ea-a5d3-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Elements of the collection can only be obtained from the containers of the same name. The exchange rate for duplicate elements is 1:1. To exchange duplicates, you need to select a vacant slot in a collection section and confirm that you want to exchange your duplicates for the missing item in the window that appears.

You can obtain 30 "Five Epochs of the Navy" containers by completing tasks of the same-name Campaign. You can also obtain containers for participating in the official World of Warships streams! To do so, activate bonus codes given during the streams and then complete special combat missions.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/f8919f7e-e93b-11ea-b355-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]A "Five Epochs of the Navy" container includes:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]One element of the "Five Epochs of the Navy" collection.
[*]1x World of Warships Anniversary camouflage.
[*]One of the following items: 2x signals of the same type (Zulu, Papa Papa, Equal Speed Charlie London or India Bravo Terrathree); or 500 Free XP; or 50,000 credits.[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/fd8d0f36-e940-11ea-adbc-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Asymmetric Battles[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Start:[/b] [b]Wed. 02 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]End:[/b] [b]Wed. 16 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

We invite you to take part in Asymmetric Battles—a new temporary battle type with teams of different sizes and tiers.

The new battle type is inspired by actual historical battles, which usually took place with an unequal number of ships on each side.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/138d4f0e-e940-11ea-99bf-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Asymmetric Battles Rules[/b][/h3]
[list][*]A team of 5–7 Tier VII–VIII ships will fight against a team of 9–12 Tier V–VI ships in Domination mode. The types and numbers of ships are matched in such a way that the forces of both teams in battle are as equal as possible.
[*]Battles will be fought on the following maps: Ultimate Frontier, Naval Station Newport, and Killer Whale.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ca2bcba0-e940-11ea-a5d3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ca313edc-e940-11ea-b9bb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ca2797f6-e940-11ea-9f0e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[list][*]To enter battle playing Tier VII–VIII ships, you'll need 500 Battle Tokens—a new temporary resource.
[*]The Tokens are earned in Asymmetric Battles, regardless of the battle results. However, you won't receive the Tokens if you are inactive in battle.
[list][*]Tier V: 250 Tokens per battle
[*]Tier VI: 150 Tokens per battle
[*]Tier VII: 200 Tokens per battle
[*]Tier VIII: 25 Tokens per battle
[*]You'll receive 1,000 Tokens each day upon logging in to the game.[/list]
[*]If the waiting time spent by the first player in the queue exceeds 3 minutes, the teams in Asymmetric Battle can be complemented with bots.
[*]You cannot form Divisions in Asymmetric Battles.
[*]There will be no battle achievements in Asymmetric Battles.[/list]
[list][i]Please note: Battle Tokens are only used to participate in Asymmetric Battles.[/i][/list]
A special combat mission is available for Tier V–VI ships. Completing the mission will reward you with four Gift containers. You'll find the details in the game client.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/13902fda-e940-11ea-9f0e-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Marathon with Gifts and a Festive Stream[/b][/h2]
We invite you to watch the best episodes of the Naval Legends series and enjoy some gifts in the process!

Be on the lookout for bonus codes shown in each episode of the historical marathon. As with the in-game Daily Shipments, all gifts are revealed in advance! Each bonus code will unlock a chain of combat missions. Complete all of them to get four containers of the new "Five Epochs of the Navy" collection and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]1,000,000[/b] credits!

Want even more gifts? If we manage to get the indicated number of new subscribers by the time each video is published, the reward of credits will be replaced with Сoal. If we get the specified number of subscribers on all episodes, completing the combat missions will bring you [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]10,000[/b] Coal in total!

The first episode goes live on September 7—be sure to watch it! We'll publish all the conditions of the cinemarathon and gifts in a dedicated article on September 5!
[list]Join our festive stream in honor of the project’s Fifth Anniversary on September 17! Let’s celebrate this special event together! Many gifts, interesting guests, and an ocean of positivity await you! We look forward to seeing you out on our virtual seas![/list]

[h2][b]Tropical Atlanta[/b][/h2]
On the occasion of the Summer Sale, we've prepared a special bundle with [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VII Atlanta[/b][/b] in the Premium Shop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Bundles will be available for purchase until:[/b] [b]Fri. 28 Aug. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

In the [url=https://armory.worldofwarships.eu/category/event_3?force_login=true]Armory[/url], you'll be able to purchase the Blazing Tropics unique permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VII Atlanta[/b][/b] in exchange for Summer Tokens.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/85465be4-e153-11ea-9df5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h1][i][h3][b]Features of the Blazing Tropics permanent camouflage[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[list][*][b]−3%[/b] to the ship's detectability range by sea
[*][b]+4%[/b] to the dispersion of shells fired by enemies at your ship
[*][b]−10%[/b] to the cost of the ship's post-battle service
[*][b]+50%[/b] to XP per battle[/list]
[h2][b]Daily Bundles[/b][/h2]
For the entire week, you'll be able to purchase two containers daily, one with 10 Summer Tokens and the other with 50. Thus, you'll be able to grab up to 420 Summer Tokens in just 7 days! You can exchange the Tokens in the Armory for the Blazing Tropics unique permanent camouflage for cruiser [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VII Atlanta[/b][/b], rare ships [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]III König Albert[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Commonwealth_abdc3eb3f8c9b1c0421b3aed2f550ac45b78602942f9a4a2cdd438835720edc7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]III Vampire[/b][/b], Summer expendable camouflages, special containers dedicated to various events, and containers that drop Tier V–VIII Premium ships.

[h2][b]Chain of Combat Missions[/b][/h2]
Another way to get some Summer Tokens is to complete a special chain of combat missions.

To beat it, you'll have to earn "Set on fire," "Torpedo hits," and "Target hits" ribbons; unlock achievements; and accumulate damage upon your spotting. You'll get two Summer Tokens for each of the five Stages of the chain, and five more Tokens as the final reward. You can find more details in the Combat Missions section in the game.
[list][i]You can complete the chain of combat missions playing Tier V–X ships in Operations, Random, Ranked, and Co-op Battles.[/i][/list]

notes.title: More Rewards for Prime Gaming Members & Massachusetts for Rent
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/331ece26410a88db740918e63411ca664ae13837.jpg[/img]
[b]Ahoy, Captains! This month kicks off the third month of Prime Gaming in World of Warships. Prime members are set to get a shipton of great stuff![/b]
[list]This month, from August 20 through September 17, Prime Gaming members will get a special combat mission to earn American cruisers containers, a 3-day rental of Premium battleship [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VIII Massachusetts[/b][/b], and Summer camouflages.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/485e523a-e1f9-11ea-b7be-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/481137e8-e1f9-11ea-aa48-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/485db23a-e1f9-11ea-bd24-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/48259eea-e1f9-11ea-8458-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/48135ff0-e1f9-11ea-b96b-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]

Players can find the following rewards in American Cruisers containers:
[list][*]Two elements of the “American Cruisers” collection
[*]Seven economic signals; or one expendable Stars 'n Stripes camouflage; or 1,250 Free XP[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/224e175a-e2e0-11ea-8851-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]
If you missed the first month, jump in now to get the following set of rewards:
[list][*]Commander [b]Ashley Violet[/b], available only to Prime users
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]500[/b] doubloons
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]3 days of Premium Account[/b]
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]1,000,000[/b] credits[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/6038c9be-bab0-11ea-be6d-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]
[list][i]Commander Ashley Violet can helm only U.S. ships.[/i][/list]
[h2]Redemption Instructions[/h2]
[olist][*][b]Create a Prime Gaming Account.[/b]
If you do not have an [b][b]Amazon account[/b][/b] yet, [url=https://twitch.amazon.com/prime?ref_=WOWS_LP]sign up[/url] and then upgrade to a Prime Gaming Account.
[*][b]Create and link your World of Warships Account to your [b]Amazon Account[/b].[/b]
You can [url=https://wargaming.net/registration/?game=wows]create[/url] a World of Warships Account and [url=https://wargaming.net/personal/]link[/url] it after.
[*][b]Click the crown icon on Twitch.tv, then click “Claim Now” on the World of Warships loot.[/b]
You can Try Prime Gaming [url=https://twitch.amazon.com/tp]here[/url].
[*][b]Log in to the game and redeem your items![/b][/olist]
[list][i]Attention! Even if you’ve already linked your Twitch account to World of Warships in the past, you still need to link your Amazon account to your World of Warships Account.[/i][/list]
If you play World of Warships via the Steam or Microsoft Store platforms, you’ll first need to link your account to a [url=http://wargaming.net/r/wows_game/]Wargaming.net[/url] Account, then create a Prime Gaming account (if you don’t already have one) and then link it to your Wargaming.net one as well. Your next actions are the same—claim the World of Warships offer from the Twitch homepage, log in to the game, and redeem your loot.
[list][b]Please be aware: after you claim the offer and connect your accounts, you need to log in to the game, redeem the items, and complete the mission before the offer expires.[/b][/list]
[list]There are more rewards to come! Starting from September 17, Prime Gaming Members will get even more loot! Stay tuned![/list]

notes.title: How It Works: Consumables
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/41e7ceff13545cbc479d494a011a5e84be939d0a.png[/img]
[b]Consumables can be activated during battle to improve your ship's characteristics or provide additional abilities for limited periods of time. However, after each use of a consumable, it's necessary to wait for some time before you can use it again while it "cools down."[/b]

What are the various consumables used for? What are the most effective ways of using them? Can their "cooldown" period be reduced? To learn the answers to these and other questions, watch the new episode of "How It Works!"
[previewyoutube=4XF44GsF2v4;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]Are you enjoying the show? Subscribe to our channel to stay informed about the next instalments![/list]

[h2]Summer Season[/h2]
Public Test 0.9.6 opens the Summer Season, which is scheduled to run across three updates.

[h3][b]Rewards[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Completing two Directives will reward you with the season emblem.
[*]Completing three Directives will reward you with a unique flag, patch, and Premium Ship VI container.

Completing the above mission unlocks access to the Summer Season #2 mission from the previous Public Test. Once you are through with the Summer Season #2 mission, the Summer Season #1 mission from the Public Test of Update 0.9.6 will be unlocked for you. If you already started working your way through the Summer Season mission during the Public Tests of Update 0.9.6 and 0.9.7, your progress will have been saved.

[h2]Starting Bonuses[/h2]
[list][*]Every participant of the Public Test will have all researchable Tier V and Tier VII ships, helmed by Commanders with 15 skill points, credited to their PT accounts.
[*]The research prices for ships and ship modules will be substantially discounted.
[*]Players will be able to reset Commander skills free of charge.[/list]

If you're joining the Public Test for the first time since Update 0.9.6, you'll be awarded the following additional bonuses:
[list][*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]500,000,000[/b] credits; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]30,000[/b] doubloons; and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]90 days of Premium Account[/b].
[*]50 signal flags of all types (except special signals) will also be added to your PT account.[/list]

[h2]How to Enter[/h2]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/2716184589232191867

[h1][b]Developer Bulletin 0.9.8[/b][/h1]
[i]The World of Warships Anniversary, new Dockyard, Season 18 of Ranked Battles, and other features![/i]
[list][b][b]IMPORTANT![/b] Because the Update is still being tested, the information in this Bulletin is tentative and reflects the state of game development at the time of its publication. Some changes and new features may be removed entirely or implemented differently by the time the Update goes live. Screenshots, specific values of certain characteristics, and details of in-game mechanics will not necessarily be relevant after the Update is released.[/b][/list]
[table][tr][th][b]World of Warships Anniversary ● Ranked Battles ● Other Changes[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]World of Warships Anniversary[/b][/h2]
With the release of Update 0.9.8, World of Warships passes the threshold of its fifth year!

This time, the festive frenzy is inspired by naval history. The game will feature plenty of new and engaging content to mark the occasion, including a revamped Designer's Table Port, a permanent campaign titled "Five Epochs of the Navy" plus a collection of the same name, a new Dockyard, and fresh first-win bonuses. You can also try out a new battle type—Asymmetric Battle!

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/46204f10-dbdb-11ea-9ae3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The collection and new permanent campaign are both dedicated to the history of shipbuilding.

[b]The Five Epochs of the Navy permanent campaign[/b] features 50 tasks spread across 5 missions.

[list][b]Reward for completing the campaign:[/b] an Epoch permanent camouflage, which can be applied to the majority of Tier IX ships.[/list]
[b]The Five Epochs of the Navy collection[/b] is made up of five sections, with six elements in each. Each section is dedicated to a specific era in the history of shipbuilding. Elements of the collection can only be obtained from the same-name containers. The exchange rate of duplicates for missing elements is 1:1.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/09d523c8-dbd6-11ea-bf4b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[b]Five Epochs of the Navy containers[/b] will be available during the campaign of the same name. Each container will drop an element from the Five Epochs of the Navy collection, as well as other rewards.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a6118892-dbd8-11ea-a905-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[list][b]Reward for completing the collection:[/b] an Epoch permanent camouflage, which can be applied to the majority of Tier IX ships.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d4138024-dbd8-11ea-a905-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2]Asymmetric Battle[/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/1e357130-dbd9-11ea-a5ba-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]During the first two festive weeks of the World of Warships Fifth Anniversary, you can try out a new temporary battle type—Asymmetric Battle—with a differing distribution of ships and tiers between teams.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/41dc5988-dbd8-11ea-b2c5-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

Historically, encounters at sea have typically involved opposing sides with an unequal number of ships on each side. The new battle type offers a new gameplay experience in near-real naval combat conditions.

In an Asymmetric Battle, a team of four to six Tier VII–VIII ships will confront a team of eight to twelve ships of Tiers V–VI. Helming Tier VII–VIII ships in an Asymmetric Battle will require a new temporary resource called [b]Battle Tokens[/b].

Battle Tokens can be obtained by participating in Asymmetric Battles. The number of Tokens you get from each battle depends on the tier of ship you helm—the lower the tier, the more Tokens you can get.

This way, you'll be able to participate in an Asymmetric Battle with lower and higher-tier ships for a more immersive experience in the new battle type.

[h2]Dockyard[/h2]
In Update 0.9.8, players will be able to build a new U.S. Tier VIII cruiser—[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Anchorage[/b][/b]. The rules of the new Dockyard are in many ways similar to those applied to the Hamburg Dockyard, but the list of rewards for completing the shipbuilding phases has changed. For example, completing phase 12 will bring you [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]100,000[/b] Free XP.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4172ed90-dbd8-11ea-bf4b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[list][*]The construction process of the Dockyard comprises 20 phases.
[*]Each shipbuilding phase can be completed by finishing the Directives of the event, or by spending [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,750[/b] doubloons per phase.
[*]Event Directives will span two updates—0.9.8 and 0.9.9, and the Dockyard itself will remain in your Ports until the end of Update 0.9.10.
[*]In total, you can complete 18 out of 20 shipbuilding phases by finishing Directives.
[*]Anchorage and her National camouflage, along with a 10-skill Commander, Port slot, and commemorative flag, await you upon completing the 20th phase.[/list]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/46384e12-dbdb-11ea-9d9a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

If you decide to complete shipbuilding at the Dockyard by using doubloons, you can still progress through the Directives. However, in that case, instead of the usual rewards for completing the shipbuilding phases, you'll get [b]600[/b] Research Points for each completed phase. If you have not yet opened the Research Bureau, you'll get access to it immediately with the first Research Points you earn.

[h2]Victory Bonuses[/h2]
In Update 0.9.8, players will be able to receive a festive bonus for their first victory in the Update, secured on every ship starting from Tier V.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/461007d6-dbdb-11ea-8ee6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]List of Rewards[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Tiers V–VII: 2x World of Warships Anniversary camouflages
[*]Tier VIII: 1x Gift container
[*]Tier IX: 2x Gift containers
[*]Tier X: 1x supercontainer[/list]
[h1][i][h3][b]Gift Container[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
A Gift container holds five special signals of one type (Dragon, Red Dragon, Wyvern, Ouroboros, Hydra, Basilisk, Scylla, or Leviathan).

[h2][b]Ranked Battles[/b][/h2]
Update 0.9.8 kicks off a new Season of Ranked Battles. You can expect to play Tier X ships in an 8 vs. 8 format.

[h2][b]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
The visual display of fog in the game has been enhanced by adopting an updated spacial distribution system and adding a scattered sunlight effect. Apart from improving the visual component, this change will also provide a slight improvement in the game client's performance.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a8690630-dbd6-11ea-bb82-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

Naval Legends audio recordings have been added to the pool of in-battle soundtrack options.

notes.title: Collections: Completion and Rewards
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/dfdec718a346cae3115c477c924c51dbe9abbbc6.jpg[/img]
[table][tr][th][b][url=#why-should-I-complete-collections]Why Should I Complete Collections?[/url] ● [url=#how-can-i-complete-collections]How Can I Complete Collections?[/url] ● [url=#what-collections-and-rewards-are-available]What Collections and Rewards are Available?[/url][/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b][h1=why-should-I-complete-collections][/h1]Why Should I Complete Collections?[/b][/h2]
Collections are an excellent way to discover some interesting historical facts and obtain some desirable rewards along the way in the form of permanent camos, Commanders, and other desirable in-game items and abilities.

Our collections are designed to educate about the history of naval forces, significant operations, and famous historical figures. Sometimes “unhistorical” collections appear in the game as well. They are sometimes dedicated to collaborations with other brands (for example, the collection inspired by the popular High School Fleet anime series), or focus on the World of Warships game itself.

Collections are made up of various elements: coats of arms of warships and combat units; items dedicated to renowned personalities; weapons, ships and aircraft; insignias; and much more. Each image is accompanied by a detailed description. For players’ convenience, elements are divided into thematic sections. When each collection section is completed, an additional reward is unlocked. When all the elements of a collection or section are in place, a window informing the player about the associated reward will be displayed. The collection will then be marked with an icon stating that it’s "Complete," which means that you can return to it anytime to read the information about its elements.

[h2][b][h1=how-can-i-complete-collections][/h1]How Can I Complete Collections?[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Where can I find my collections?[/b][/h3]
In the Profile section of the Port. You gain access to each collection after obtaining its first element.

[list][i]Please note: the Collections tab won't be visible if you have no collection items.[/i][/list]

[h3][b]Where can I get collection items?[/b][/h3]
In most cases, you'll find collection items in containers that share the same name as the collection. Clicking on a collection item that was dropped from a container will transfer you to the screen of the corresponding collection. But there are exceptions—for example, items from a collection dedicated to the Anniversary of World of Warships in 2017 were issued for special achievements earned in battle.

[h3][b]What is a subscription?[/b][/h3]
You can subscribe to some of the collections. This way, you can choose which large collections you want to actively collect. You can obtain the first elements of these collections in special containers. By activating a subscription, you’ll be able to find the rest of the collectibles in the following containers: More Credits, More Signals and Camouflages, More Resources, and Try Your Luck. You can only subscribe to one collection at a time under the Profile tab.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/f24f4dda-d4d9-11ea-a93e-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

[h3][b]What is a duplicate?[/b][/h3]
When completing a collection, it’s possible to obtain an item you already have—this is called a “duplicate.” When you have a certain number of duplicates from the same collection, you can exchange them for any item you might still be missing. To do that, you need to select a vacant slot in an album and confirm that you want to exchange your duplicates for this missing item in the window that appears. The cost of such an exchange depends on the collection, but it’s usually 2–5 duplicates per item. Once a collection is complete, any remaining duplicates of that collection are automatically exchanged for credits. The exact exchange rate depends on the specific collection. Thus, you can decide whether you want to obtain the main reward for collecting all the elements as soon as possible, or prefer to get more duplicates to earn more credits.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/575cd020-d2b0-11ea-b165-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

[h2][b][h1=what-collections-and-rewards-are-available][/h1]What Collections and Rewards are Available?[/b][/h2]
There are currently 16 collections available in the game. The items of these can be obtained from containers that share the same name as the collections in the Armory in exchange for Coal. Exceptions: Yamamoto Isoroku, "Bad Advice: Behind the Scenes,” “King of the Sea,” and "Five Epochs of the Navy."

[h3][i]Yamamoto Isoroku[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/488fc3d6-db1b-11ea-a4eb-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

This collection is dedicated to the biography of Yamamoto Isoroku, Commander-in-Chief of the Imperial Japanese Navy. It consists of 40 elements, such as the personal belongings of the Marshal Admiral; the uniforms of naval senior officers and sailors of the Japanese Navy; battle merit decorations; and a variety of military equipment related to Yamamoto Isoroku. You can obtain the first collectible in a container that is issued for accomplishing the final mission of the Yamamoto Isoroku Campaign, or from a specific container in the Premium Shop.

[b]The reward for completing the sections[/b] is the ability to mount two flags and alternative camouflage patterns on Japanese ships.

[b]The reward for completing the entire collection [/b]is a commemorative flag.

[list][i]A subscription is available.[/i][/list]
[/expand]
[h3][i]The Hunt for Bismarck[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/44231b2c-db1b-11ea-a10f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Dedicated to the famous naval operation of the same name, this collection includes the badges of warships and aviation units that participated in it.

[b]The rewards for completing the entire collection[/b] are permanent camos for battleship [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Bismarck[/b][/b]: From the Bottom of the Ocean and The Last Conquest.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Dunkirk[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4490d05e-db1b-11ea-a6ef-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

This collection is dedicated to Operation Dynamo—the mission that took place in 1940 to rescue British and French soldiers from the city of Dunkirk, where they were surrounded by German troops. The collection tells the story of the ships that participated in the evacuation.

[b]The rewards for completing the entire collection[/b] are the unique British Commander, Jack Dunkirk, with 10 skill points, and the Dunkirk Evacuation commemorative flag.
[/expand]
[h3][i]2 Years of World of Warships[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/45211aba-db1b-11ea-b8a6-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

A collection dedicated to the game's second anniversary, the collection consists of various items related to different phases of the project’s development in 2016 and 2017.

[b]The rewards for completing the sections[/b] are various permanent camos for researchable Tier VIII ships.

[b]The rewards for completing the entire collection[/b] are the camouflage for British Tier VIII battleship [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Monarch[/b][/b] and a commemorative flag.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Vive la France[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/48757bde-db1b-11ea-9d55-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

This collection is dedicated to the introduction of French battleships into the game. It consists of various items related to the French Navy.

[b]The rewards for completing the entire collection[/b] are the unique French Commander, Jean-Jacques Honoré, with 10 skill points, and a commemorative flag.
[/expand]
[h3][i]American Cruisers[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/444c535c-db1b-11ea-9d55-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

This collection is dedicated to the introduction of American light cruisers into the game. It consists of various items related to the U.S. Navy—and cruisers in particular.

[b]The reward for completing the sections[/b] is the ability to mount two flags and alternative camouflage patterns on American ships.

[b]The rewards for completing the entire collection[/b] are the Freedom permanent camouflage for Cleveland and a commemorative flag.

[list][i]A subscription is available.[/i][/list]
[/expand]
[h3][i]Battle of the North Cape[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/448f9ebe-db1b-11ea-a4eb-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

This collection’s items are dedicated to the same-name battle of World War II, during which German battleship Scharnhorst clashed with numerous British ships.

[b]The rewards for completing the entire collection[/b] are the Arctic permanent camouflage for British battleship [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VII Duke of York[/b][/b] and North Cape commemorative flag.
[/expand]
[h3][i]3 Years of World of Warships[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/44c2dd7e-db1b-11ea-a84f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Dedicated to the game's third anniversary, this collection is presented in the form of Dasha Perova’s diary. It consists of various elements related to the development of the game in 2017 and 2018: the introduction of the Naval Base; Halloween and the New Year; Insignias; the American cycle; the Armory (called the Arsenal back then); and other game events.

[b]The rewards for completing the sections[/b] are expendable camos and special signals.

[b]The rewards for completing the entire collection[/b] are a supercontainer and commemorative flag.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Royal Navy Destroyers[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/44aafce0-db1b-11ea-a509-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

This collection is dedicated to the introduction of British destroyers into the game. It presents the history of the British Navy in the 20th century.

[b]The reward for completing the sections[/b] is the ability to mount two flags and alternative camouflage patterns on British and Commonwealth ships.

[b]The rewards for completing the entire collection[/b] are the permanent camos for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]VIII Lightning[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Commonwealth_abdc3eb3f8c9b1c0421b3aed2f550ac45b78602942f9a4a2cdd438835720edc7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]VII Haida[/b][/b] and a commemorative flag.

[list][i]A subscription is available.[/i][/list]
[/expand]
[h3][i]Naval Aviation[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/443529de-db1b-11ea-a7a6-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[b]This collection comprises elements[/b] that include aircraft models, signals of landing signal officers, and the badges of U.K. carriers.

[b]The rewards for completing the entire collection[/b] are the permanent camouflage for British aircraft carrier [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/standard_84f55678325d4b492215390a7f0b43008f3947ab201502cd979dcf4c37633cf3.png[/img][b]VIII Implacable[/b][/b] and the ability to choose alternative camouflage color patterns for Commonwealth ships and mount two flags on British aircraft carriers.

[list][i]A subscription is available.[/i][/list]
[/expand]
[h3][i]In the Service of the Motherland[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4538824a-db1b-11ea-b5cb-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

This collection is dedicated to the introduction of Soviet battleships into the game. Renowned admirals, outstanding engineers, glorious naval victories, innovative projects, and battleships wielding powerful armament—the collection delves into the history of the Russian and Soviet Navies.

[b]The rewards for completing the sections[/b] are Oktyabrskaya Revolutsiya containers and the ability to mount two flags and alternative camouflage patterns on Soviet destroyers and cruisers.

[b]The reward for completing the entire collection[/b] is the ability to mount two flags and alternative camouflage patterns on Soviet battleships.

[list][i]A subscription is available.[/i][/list]
[/expand]
[h3][i]Resolute and Rapid[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/9336995a-db9d-11ea-a509-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

This collection is dedicated to the introduction of Italian cruisers into the game. The name “Resolute and Rapid” refers to the motto of light cruiser Raimondo Montecuccoli—“Con risolutezza, con rapidità.” High speed was the hallmark of ships of the Regia Marina, while the Italian sailors' determination and devotion to duty was recognized even by their enemies.

[b]The reward for completing the sections[/b] is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Warships Premium Account[/b].

The rewards for completing the entire collection are a patch and the unique Italian Commander, Luigi Sansonetti, with 10 skill points. Commander Luigi Sansonetti possesses talents that extend the firing range of the main battery, increase the reload speed of main battery guns, and prolong the action time for all consumables.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Belle Époque[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/48abffb0-db1b-11ea-a7a6-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The collection is dedicated to the early 20th century ships—the era when ironclads flourished.

[b]The reward for completing the sections[/b] is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Warships Premium Account[/b].

[b]The rewards for completing the entire collection[/b] are a Santa's Gift container, Pickelhelm patch, and Prussia commemorative flag.
[/expand]
[h3][i]"Bad Advice: Behind the Scenes"[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/94f5e024-dba3-11ea-80f1-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

This collection is dedicated to the Bad Advice series and its primary protagonist, Cap. You can start building the collection by entering a promo code that can be found in the series of videos on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pMcv9YCI2QY&list=PLVmXzlhZvJVRtnGGbzh5DbvssHizkGqEY]YouTube[/url].

[b]The rewards for completing the sections[/b] are days of Premium Account, expendable camouflages, and special signals.

[b]The rewards for completing the entire collection[/b] are a patch, a commemorative flag, and unique Commander Cap with 10 skill points.

[list][i]A subscription is available.[/i][/list]
[/expand]
[h3][i]King of the Sea[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/93192622-db9d-11ea-a10f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

This collection is dedicated to the community-run tournaments of the same name. The strategies and gameplay features, players and tournament organizers—discover more facts about the largest World of Warships tournament. You can build the collection by completing combat missions during the tournament. During a single tournament, you can collect up to half of the elements.

[b]The reward for completing the sections[/b] is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Premium Account[/b].

[b]The reward for completing the entire collection[/b] is 1x Premium Ship VII container.
[/expand]
[h3][i]Five Epochs of the Navy[/i][/h3]
[expand type=details]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/f095760c-19f0-11eb-9f87-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

Each section is dedicated to a specific period in the history of the navy in the first half of the 20th century—from ships of the dreadnought era to those of World War II and the post-war years. Having completed the entire collection, you'll have learned about the construction history, design features, and fates of prominent representatives of the shipbuilding epochs. The collection elements can only be obtained from eponymous containers that are earned by completing missions of the "Five Epochs of the Navy" Campaign.

[b]The reward for completing the sections[/b] is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Premium Account[/b].

[b]The reward for completing the entire collection[/b] is the Epoch permanent camouflage.
[/expand]

notes.title: More Rewards for Twitch Prime Members!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7026be82d5db1c93ef12cc7b9672dabc9ddcb29b.jpg[/img]
[b]Ahoy, Captains! This month kicks off the second month of Twitch Prime loot in World of Warships. Prime members are set to get a shipton of great stuff![/b]

This month, from July 24 through August 20, Twitch Prime members will get a special combat mission that will reward them with an in-game container themed around the popular Azur Lane game! 
[list]Complete this mission to get 1x Azur Lane container![/list]
Inside an Azur Lane container, you’ll find the following rewards to aid you in naval battles:
[list][*]One of eight new Azur Lane Commanders with special voiceovers: Azuma, Baltimore, Roon, Jean Bart, Littorio, Shokaku, Yat Sen, or Sovestskaya Rossiya.
[*]10x special signals of one of the following types: Basilisk, Wyvern, Hydra, Dragon, Red Dragon, Leviathan, Scylla, or Ouroboros.
[*]5x Azur Lane – Siren camouflage patterns[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3cb0778e-cd08-11ea-8b0f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
If you missed the first month, jump in now to get the following set of rewards:
[list][*]Commander [b]Ashley Violet[/b], available only to Prime users
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]500[/b] doubloons
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]3 days of Premium Account[/b]
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]1,000,000[/b] credits[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/6038c9be-bab0-11ea-be6d-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]
[list][i]Commander Ashley Violet can helm only U.S. ships.[/i][/list]

[h3][b]Redemption instructions[/b][/h3]
[olist][*][b]Create a Twitch Prime account.[/b]
If you do not have an [b][b]Amazon account[/b][/b] yet, [url=https://twitch.amazon.com/prime?ref_=WOWS_LP]sign up[/url] and then upgrade to a Twitch Prime account.
[*][b]Create and link your World of Warships account to your [b]Amazon account[/b].[/b]
You can [url=https://wargaming.net/registration/?game=wows]create[/url] a World of Warships account and [url=https://wargaming.net/personal/]link[/url] it after.
[*][b]Click on the Crown Icon on Twitch.tv and then click “Claim Now” on the World of Warships loot.[/b]
You can Try Twitch Prime [url=https://twitch.amazon.com/tp]here[/url].
[*][b]Log in to the game and redeem your items![/b][/olist]

If you play World of Warships on the Steam or Microsoft Store platforms, first you’ll need to link your account to a [url=http://wargaming.net/r/wows_game/]Wargaming.net[/url] Account, then create a Twitch Prime account (If you don’t already have one) and link it to your Wargaming.net one as well. Your next actions are the same—claim the World of Warships offer from the Twitch homepage, log in to the game and redeem your loot.

[list][b]Please be aware: after you claim the offer and connect your accounts, you need to log in to the game, redeem the items, and complete the mission before the offer expires.[/b][/list]

[list]There are more rewards to come! Starting from August 20, Twitch Prime members will get even more loot! Stay tuned![/list]
