[table][tr][th][b]German Carriers: Part 2 ● Ranked Sprint ● Setting the Order of Consumables ● Unique Upgrades ● Naval Base ● Armory ● Other Changes[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]German Carriers: Part 2[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c13641e2-d59f-11ea-b8d8-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

German carriers are now available for all players to research! The new ships carry high-speed aircraft that have small HP pools. Their armament includes armor-piercing rockets and AP bombs, as well as fast torpedoes.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1ad30996-d2ae-11ea-82e1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b671ab4-d2ae-11ea-b559-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1aeb236e-d2ae-11ea-9a69-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b4065ea-d2ae-11ea-bdfa-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The [b]new “German Navy” collection[/b] comprises six sections, with six elements in each. Learn about the history of the German Navy during the first half of the 20th century—the ships and aircraft; personalities and emblems; awards and uniforms. The reward for completing the collection is the ability to mount two flags and alternative camouflage patterns on German ships.

You can find the first element of the collection in [b]German Navy containers,[/b] which in turn can be obtained by progressing through Directives or picked up from Daily Shipments.  You can continue collecting elements from daily containers by activating a subscription on the collection page. Another container can be obtained by clicking the button in an article about the collection that will be published next week.

[b]Rewards for completing the Directives:[/b] up to five Kriegsmarine containers, which have specific chances of dropping [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Pommern[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Mainz[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]VII Z-39[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]VIII Admiral Hipper[/b][/b], or other desirable rewards. Final reward: Iron Cross permanent camouflage for Pommern.

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/german-carriers-part-2/]Read more>>>[/url]

The Port of Hamburg has been updated.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cd422c70-d636-11ea-98d9-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cdd780fe-d636-11ea-adf3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cdb63822-d636-11ea-8245-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cd57820a-d636-11ea-ac1e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]


[list][i]Please note: German Tokens can be exchanged in the Armory before: [/i][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img]  [b]Thu. 03 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
After that, they will be converted into credits at the rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]9,000[/b].
[h2][b]Ranked Sprint[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c078d1ac-d59f-11ea-bc7c-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Fri. 21 Aug. 11:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Mon. 31 Aug. 10:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[b]Format:[/b] 3 vs. 3, playing Tier IX ships
[b]Rewards:[/b] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]10,000[/b] Coal; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]500,000[/b] credits; and a lot of signals.
[b]Maps:[/b] Hotspot, Mountain Range, Shatter, Warrior's Path, and Northern Waters with reduced combat areas.

[list][i]Details of the Ranked Sprint will be published in a dedicated article.[/i][/list]

[h2][b]Setting the Order of Consumables[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c1683ee0-d59f-11ea-963f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

An option to set a custom order of the consumables for each ship has been added. Any customizations are saved on the server, so you won't need to set them again if you play on different computers.

[h2][b]Unique Upgrades[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c0bec608-d59f-11ea-b1ad-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

New unique upgrades for [b][b]X Daring[/b][/b], [b][b]X Kléber[/b][/b], [b][b]X Harugumo[/b][/b], [b][b]X Kremlin[/b][/b], [b][b]X Audacious[/b][/b], [b][b]X Midway[/b][/b], and [b][b]X Hakuryū[/b][/b] have been added to the "Research Bureau" tab of the Armory. They are each exchangeable for [b]19,200[/b] Research Points. The current concept provides an additional opportunity to mount upgrades with special-but-balanced bonuses in comparison with the regular upgrades.

[h1][i][h3][b]New upgrades[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[h3][b]Daring (fifth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]−10%[/b] to the torpedo tube reload time
[*][b]+15%[/b] maximum torpedo damage[/list]

[b][b]X Daring[/b][/b] is currently a versatile ship with a slight focus on artillery. With the upgrade, the destroyer can stay some distance away from a Key Area and focus on torpedoes and attacks from within a smoke screen.

[h3][b]Kléber (sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]−20%[/b] to the ship's detectability range by sea
[*][b]+80%[/b] to the main battery reloading time[/list]

The unique upgrade provides an alternative to artillery focused gameplay. When mounted, [b][b]X Kléber[/b][/b] becomes a torpedo-carrying destroyer for close quarters combat with her high speed, fast reload time, and detectability that's equal to that of other same-tier destroyers. The upgrade allows for more effective torpedo attacks at the cost of losing a significant amount of potential artillery damage per minute.

[h3][b]Harugumo (fifth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]+30%[/b] smoke screen dispersion time
[*][b]+100%[/b] Smoke Generator action time
[*][b]+1 [/b]charge for consumables[/list]

This unique upgrade offers some improvements for gameplay that involves the use of smoke screens, at the cost of detectability and reduced effectiveness in battles for Key Areas. Thus, the ship can escape at ¼ speed while setting a smoke screen and reach the optimal distance for firing.

[h3][b]Kremlin (sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]−18%[/b] to the main battery reloading time
[*][b]−12%[/b] maximum main battery firing range
[*][b]−1[/b] charge for consumables[/list]

The upgrade allows for a more aggressive gameplay style, with the ship sacrificing her survivability in return for a bonus applied to her main battery firing rate.

[h3][b]Audacious (sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]−15%[/b] to the ship's detectability range by sea
[*][b]+20%[/b] Engine Boost action time
[*][b]−50%[/b] to the time it takes to reach full power when accelerating
[*][b]−30%[/b] rudder-shift time[/list]

The upgrade allows the ship to get close to an opponent and thus increase the frequency of her aircraft attacks. At the same time, the risk of being detected by the opponent, as well as the risk falling under heavy fire, increases.

[h3][b]Midway (sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]+10%[/b] bomber cruising speed
[*][b]+5.5%[/b] bomber minimum speed
[*][b]−4.5%[/b] bomber maximum speed
[*][b]+10%[/b] HE bomb damage[/list]

Instead of generally increasing the power of squadrons of all types, this upgrade offers gameplay with a focus on bombers with increased damage and speed.

[h3][b]Hakuryū (sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]+15%[/b] aircraft maximum speed
[*][b]−20%[/b] engine boost action time[/list]

The upgrade provides the biggest effect when you're starting an attack approach. It significantly increases the speed of the aircraft and reduces the time they spend within the enemy's AA defense range. At the same time, the overall distance travelled with engine boost remains the same.

We are continuing to update the existing unique upgrades. These changes will balance their effectiveness, and at the same time, preserve the unique gameplay of each ship. Their names and icons have also been updated.

[h1][i][h3][b]Updates to the existing upgrades[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[h3][b]Z-52 (fifth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Added a bonus that reduces the detectability range of torpedoes by 10%.[/list]

The upgrade will make [b][b]X Z-52[/b][/b] a more capable torpedo destroyer, but at the same time make her less effective in Key Areas due to the reduced bonus to concealment compared with the concealment upgrade.

[h3][b]Grozovoi (sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The penalty applied to her torpedo tube reload time increased from +10% to +20%.[/list]

The upgrade offers improvements for main battery gun-focused gameplay. It was too effective, and reducing the traverse speed of her main battery guns didn't affect it significantly because of the already high base value. For this reason, the penalty applied to her torpedo tube reload time was increased instead.

[h3][b]Moskva (sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The bonus that reduces the maximum dispersion of her main battery shells was reduced from –11% to –7%.
[*]The penalty applied to her main turret traverse speed increased from –13% to –20%.[/list]

The changes offer a choice between the unique upgrade with its bonus to accuracy, and the standard bonuses to the guns' reloading time or firing range.

[h3][b]Minotaur (fifth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Removed a bonus that increased the dispersion of incoming enemy shells by 10%.
[*]Added a bonus that reduces the reload time of ship consumables by 10%.[/list]

The upgrade allows the ship to stay in a smoke screen for an extended period of time when moving at ¼ speed. The bonus to the reload time of consumables will increase the overall survivability and effectiveness of the ship, and will be useful with any equipment.

[h3][b]Zaō (sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Removed a bonus that reduced her rudder-shift time by 20%.[/list]

The upgrade was too versatile and improved the ship in many ways. In the current state, it's effective when playing in open waters and engaging from long distances.

[h3][b]Yamato (sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Removed a bonus that reduced the main battery reload time by 6%.
[*]The penalty to the main turret traverse speed was reduced from –19% to –13%.[/list]

The upgrade was too effective because it provided two bonuses at once—greater damage per minute and accuracy. After the changes, the upgrade offers a choice between these two parameters.

[h2][b]Naval Base[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c0ee0aa8-d59f-11ea-aaa8-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Added improvements for the Treasury that will allow Clan leaders to regularly exchange Oil for Clan rewards.
[*]The Research Center, which provides a bonus to the amount of received XP, has been renamed "War College." A new building named "Research Institute" has been added. It increases the amount of Research Points a Clan receives.
[*]To show the result of the Clan's activity, the water area of the base will fill up with warships and auxiliary vessels, with their number depending on the number of battles played. The more Random, Ranked, and Co-op Battles that have been fought by Clan members over the last month, the more vessels that will appear in the waters of their Naval Base. The number of warships depends on the number of Clan Battles played over the last 3 months.[/list]

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/clans/naval-base-update/]Read more>>>[/url]

[h2][b]Armory[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/42f5474a-d5a1-11ea-84be-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Added two new battle signals, which can be obtained in exchange for credits, Coal, and Research Points.
[list][*][b]X-Ray Papa Unaone[/b]: increases the action time of Smoke Generator by 15%.
[*][b]Sierra Bravo[/b]: increases the action time of Hydroacoustic Search by 10% and reduces the cooldown period of Defensive AA Fire by 10%.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9efd6252-d5a6-11ea-9578-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]They will be added to the "More Signals and Camouflages" daily container at a later point in time.[/i][/list]

The following bundles will become available with the release of the Update:
[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Pommern[/b][/b] for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]228, 000[/b] Coal, and from bundles that are available in exchange for doubloons. Pommern is a variant of the H-class battleship project that's armed with twelve 380 mm guns. Decent armor, powerful secondary armament, the Hydroacoustic Search consumable, and torpedoes allow the ship a high degree of confidence in close quarters engagements.[/list]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9f0bfe52-d5a6-11ea-a8bb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/premium_4516ee494bb0396e51796cebff5e45c3f448d9790e0a58082057b8949ed9a3f8.png[/img][b]VI Erich Loewenhardt[/b][/b] in bundles that are available in exchange for doubloons. Her bombers, unlike the aircraft of researchable German aircraft carriers, are armed with HE bombs, and her torpedoes have a longer range but lower speed.[/list]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9ed14064-d5a6-11ea-945f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b]X Slava[/b][/b] for [b]63,000[/b] Research Points. She was an implementation of a battleship project that was developed after the end of World War II to counter the American Iowa- and Montana-class ships. Due to the high accuracy and excellent armor-penetrating capabilities of her AP shells, Slava is most efficient in artillery duels over greater distances. Her armor is not strong enough to be effective in close quarters combat.[/list]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9ec9b394-d5a6-11ea-8c73-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[list][*]Unique British historical Commander [b]Andrew Cunningham[/b] with 10 skill points for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]175,000[/b] Coal. The Commander possesses unique talents that increase the speed of his ship and aircraft, provide an additional charge for the ship's consumables, or increase the reload speed of the armament.[/list]

[list][i]Ships [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Pommern[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/premium_4516ee494bb0396e51796cebff5e45c3f448d9790e0a58082057b8949ed9a3f8.png[/img][b]VI Erich Loewenhardt[/b][/b] will also be available in the Premium Shop.[/i][/list]

[h2][b]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
Check under the spoiler for more information regarding balance-related changes, content changes and additions, and other improvements.

[h1][i][h3][b]Game Balance Changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c0e843e8-d59f-11ea-b8cf-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In Update 0.9.7, we've made changes to the parameters of several ships based on our analysis of their battle efficiency and feedback from players. Such changes were required in order to carefully adjust the balance of selected warships. Further changes may follow, should they be required, in future updates.

[h3][b]Attack aircraft on Hermes, Furious, Ark Royal, Implacable, Indomitable, Audacious, Graf Zeppelin, Graf Zeppelin B, Hōshō, Ryūjō, Shōkaku, Kaga, Hakuryū, Lexington (with Tiny Tim missiles), Saipan, Midway (with Tiny Tim missiles)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The missile crosshair was rotated 90 degrees, and is now stretched horizontally.[/list]

This change will unify all missile crosshairs and will allow the destroyers to stick to a set of common tactics to avoid the attacks of attack aircraft.

[h3][b]Tier V–X U.S. destroyers Nicholas, Farragut, Mahan, Benson, Fletcher, and Gearing[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The bonus to continuous AA damage provided by the Defensive AA Fire consumable increased from +75% to +100%.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier X Italian cruiser Venezia[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time increased from 20.5 to 21s.
[*]Rudder-shift time increased from 12.6 to 13.6s.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier IX British destroyer Jutland[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time increased from 4.3 to 4.5s.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier VII battleships Colorado and Nagato[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The Fighter consumable can now be mounted on their standard hulls.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier IX cruisers Buffalo, Saint-Louis, and Ibuki[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The Spotting Aircraft consumable can now be mounted on their standard hulls.[/list]

[h3][b]Cruisers Danae, Duguay-Trouin, Karlsruhe, Kuma, Svietlana[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The Hydroacoustic Search consumable can now be mounted on their standard hulls.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier IV U.S. cruiser Phoenix[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The Hydroacoustic Search consumable can now be mounted on both hull A and B.[/list]

This change allows for a more consistent transition from her standard hull to the researchable variety.

[h3][b]Tier VIII French battleship Richelieu[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The Engine Boost and Spotting Aircraft/Fighter consumables were swapped for her standard hull.[/list]

[h1][i][h3][b]Content Additions and Changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c07cc082-d59f-11ea-adcd-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Added the Blazing Tropics permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VII Atlanta[/b][/b].
[*]Added the Summer expendable camouflage.
[*]Added nine patches with symbols of countries.[/list]

[list][i]The details on how to obtain these items will be published a bit later.[/i][/list]

Ships [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b]VIII Kansas[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b]IX Minnesota[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/special_fdb3e9eabba1009b1c4adb7b370a68a29483aa7a0fe11935b2405792c4968d71.png[/img][b]X Vermont[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VII Florida[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b]X Kitakami[/b][/b] were added for testing by developers, volunteers, and community contributors.

[h1][i][h3][b]Other Changes and Improvements[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c0d03db6-d59f-11ea-8fcc-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[list][b]Thunderstorm front temporarily disabled due to the technical reasons.[/b][/list]

Changed the research cost of aircraft carriers of all nations:
[list][*]Decreased from 68,000 to 40,000 XP at Tier VI.
[*]Increased from 158,000 to 161,000 XP at Tier VIII.
[*]Increased from 330,000 to 355,000 XP at Tier X.[/list]

Progressing through the aircraft carrier branches will now happen in a similar way to other ship types. The time it takes to research Tier VI aircraft carriers will be reduced. At the same time, the research cost of all ships of the branch remains the same.

[list][i]If you've already researched a Tier VI aircraft carrier, but haven't researched a Tier VIII carrier of the same branch, the Tier VI carrier will receive [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9d43348869eb4ac094288dad196925d8f6d9d89b.png[/img][b]28,000[/b] XP. If you've already researched a Tier VIII aircraft carrier, but haven't researched a Tier X carrier of the same branch, the Tier VIII carrier will receive [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9d43348869eb4ac094288dad196925d8f6d9d89b.png[/img][b]25,000[/b] XP.[/i][/list]

[h3][b]Other Changes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]When entering the game for the first time after the Update, a short video will play back. It can be skipped by double-pressing any keyboard button. Another video will play back on the login screen. This video can be paused.
[*]To make the process of familiarizing players with the game easier, the possibility for new accounts to start the tutorial battle without the need to first enter the Port was added.
[*]Minor improvements to the geometry and textures of the following ships: [b][b]VIII Lenin[/b][/b], [b][b]VI Weser[/b][/b], [b][b]VIII Kii[/b][/b], [b][b]IX Izumo[/b][/b], [b][b]VIII Amagi[/b][/b], [b][b]X Yamato[/b][/b], [b][b]VI Ryūjō[/b][/b], [b][b]X Shimakaze[/b][/b], [b][b]V Raimondo Montecuccoli[/b][/b], [b][b]X Kléber[/b][/b], [b][b]X Goliath[/b][/b], [b][b]VIII Albemarle[/b][/b], [b][b]V Mutsuki[/b][/b], [b][b]X Großer Kurfürst[/b][/b], [b][b]VII California[/b][/b], [b][b]VIII Amalfi[/b][/b], [b][b]VIII Roma[/b][/b], [b][b]VIII Massachusetts[/b][/b], [b][b]VIII August von Parseval[/b][/b], [b][b]VIII Odin[/b][/b], [b][b]IV Langley[/b][/b], and [b][b]X Hindenburg[/b][/b].
[*]Updated the name of the airborne torpedoes of [b][b]IV Rhein[/b][/b], as well as the bombs of [b][b]VI Weser[/b][/b] and [b][b]VIII August von Parseval[/b][/b].
[*]Bombers of [b][b]IV Rhein[/b][/b], [b][b]VI Weser[/b][/b], [b][b]VIII August von Parseval[/b][/b] now gain altitude more smoothly during takeoff.
[*]Updated the upgrade icons.
[*]XP earned on a ship is now again displayed in the ship parameters in the Port.
[*]Updated the names of the Soviet, American, and German ships' armaments.
[*]Updated the description of [b][b]VIII Pyotr Bagration[/b][/b].
[*]Updated the "Over-penetration" ribbon for armor-piercing bombs.
[*]Improved the loading time for previewing camouflages in the Armory.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the "Equipment" screen to be shown as "Modules" when achieving Access Level 9.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the French Navy permanent camouflage for [b][b]X Kléber[/b][/b] to not be shown in the list of camouflages.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the date when the victory bonus for Research Points expired to be displayed in a pop-up tip.
[*]Updated the equipment icons in tactical hints on the battle loading and "Help" screens.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused tooltips to disappear when switching to the Tech Tree tab.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the sound not to play back when clicking the marker with information about the branches in the Tech Tree.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the "Battle!" button to still be active when there was a ship in the Division that didn't match the requirements of the selected battle type.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the "Assign Commander" text to blink when hovering over the "Commander unavailable" text.
[*]Fixed an error that caused text to overlap the borders of the drop-down list when purchasing a slot.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the game client to crash when switching to another window from the battle results screen.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the rank icons to be displayed for bots on the battle results screen.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the timer in Operation Aegis to be shown above the final point.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the camera to freeze when observing an aircraft carrier in Spectator Mode and switching to the allied squadron.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the frames from the center of the map to be shown before the loading screen when loading the replay or reconnecting to the battle.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the shadows to disappear in the New York Port with medium graphics settings applied.
[*]Fixed an error that caused weather effects not to be shown.
[*]Fixed an error that caused incorrect text to be displayed in the quick commands menu in battles with weather effects.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the turrets of [b][b]VIII Albemarle[/b][/b] to receive critical damage from HE shells without taking armor into account.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the "Commander Retraining" window to instantly close when they were assigned to another ship.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the message about the lack of places in Reserve to overlap the text field borders.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the price of a permanent camouflage to be displayed when the camouflage was already on the account.
[*]Fixed an error that cause islands to be poorly shown on the Tactical Map during blizzards.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the "In battle" player status not to be shown in the chat header.
[*]Fixed an error that caused patches of sunlight to disappear in certain camera positions.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the text of pop-up descriptions of various elements of the collection to have different indentations.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the game client to crash when changing the resolution with the "Clans" tab open.
[*]Fixed an error that caused incorrect armament to be shown in the "Equipment" tab on the ship selected in the Port when clicking the ship in the Tech Tree.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the cost of the post-battle service of [b][b]VIII Graf Zeppelin[/b][/b] and [b][b]VIII Graf Zeppelin B[/b][/b] to be 60,000 credits instead of 52,500.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the gun elevation angle of allied and enemy ships not to change.
[*]Fixed an error that allowed [b][b]IX Siegfried[/b][/b] to be sold.
[*]Fixed an error that prevented a Division comprised of different ship tiers with a Division Commander on a ship of a lower tier from entering a Tier I–V Random Battle.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the “New” marker not to disappear after opening the combat missions category for the first time.
[*]Operation Narai has returned to the rotation, with a technical error having been fixed.[/list]

notes.title: German Carriers: Part 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f25137b0ed51265ee05cc63daeb123bb47a978b8.jpg[/img]
[b]The branch of German carriers is scheduled to exit Early Access with the launch of Update 0.9.7![/b]

The new ships are equipped with fast-but-fragile aircraft that carry armor-piercing bombs and rockets, and fast torpedoes. We're here to tell you all about the rules of the new game event of Update 0.9.7!

[table][tr][th][b]The “German Navy” Collection ● Directives ● German Navy Containers ● Kriegsmarine Containers ● Daily Shipments[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1ad30996-d2ae-11ea-82e1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b671ab4-d2ae-11ea-b559-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1aeb236e-d2ae-11ea-9a69-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b4065ea-d2ae-11ea-bdfa-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]The “German Navy” Collection[/b][/h2]
Update 0.9.7 welcomes the “German Navy” collection, comprising six sections with six elements in each. Build the collection to learn about the history of the German Navy during the first half of the 20th century—ships and aircraft; personalities and emblems; awards and uniforms. Having completed the entire collection, you'll learn about the German carrier-based aircraft projects; the story of Karl von Müller, the commanding officer of cruiser Emden; the specifics of the House Order of Hohenzollern; and much more!

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0654b93a-d2ac-11ea-b165-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The reward for completing the sections and entire collection is the ability to mount two flags and alternative camouflage patterns on German ships, with completed sections unlocking these possibilities for different ship types.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/32f160d0-d4da-11ea-a93e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The exchange rate for duplicate elements is 4:1. To exchange duplicates, you need to select a vacant slot in a collection section and confirm that you want to exchange your duplicates for the missing item in the window that appears.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/575cd020-d2b0-11ea-b165-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

You can find the first element of the collection in [b]German Navy containers[/b], which in turn can be obtained by progressing through Directives or picked up from Daily Shipments. You can continue collecting elements from daily containers by activating a subscription on the collection page. Another container can be obtained by clicking the button in an article about the collection that will be published next week.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/f24f4dda-d4d9-11ea-a93e-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Directives[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Start:[/b] [b]Thu. 06 Aug. 07:15 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]End:[/b] [b]Tue. 01 Sep. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

The new game event tasks you with completing 32 missions spread across four Directives. The first Directive will become available with the release of Update 0.9.7, while those that follow will be unlocked each week.

Rewards for completing the missions: up to 10 German Navy containers, as well as credits and signals.

Rewards for completing the Directives: up to five Kriegsmarine containers, which have specific chances of dropping [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Pommern[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Mainz[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]VII Z-39[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]VIII Admiral Hipper[/b][/b], or other desirable rewards.

[list][b]Final reward:[/b] Iron Cross permanent camouflage for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Pommern[/b][/b].[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8e038524-d2b0-11ea-97f2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Pommern[/b][/b] is a variant of the H-class battleship project that's armed with twelve 380 mm guns. Decent armor, powerful secondary armament, the Hydroacoustic Search consumable, and torpedoes allow the ship a high degree of confidence in close quarters engagements. With the release of Update 0.9.7, Pommern will be available in the Armory for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]228,000[/b] Coal and from bundles that are available in exchange for doubloons, as well as in the Premium Shop.

[h2][b]German Navy Containers[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]How to get the containers[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Up to 10 containers—by completing Directives.
[*]Up to two containers—from Daily Shipments.
[*]Up to five containers—by completing special combat missions from the official World of Warships streams.
[*]One additional container—by clicking the button in an article about the “German Navy” collection.
[*]Up to six containers—by completing a chain of special combat missions playing [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Pommern[/b][/b]. Two of these missions can also be completed playing [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/premium_4516ee494bb0396e51796cebff5e45c3f448d9790e0a58082057b8949ed9a3f8.png[/img][b]VI Erich Loewenhardt[/b][/b], a German aircraft carrier unique for her bombers that carry HE bombs. With the release of Update 0.9.7, the aircraft carrier will be available in the Armory in exchange for doubloons, as well as in the Premium Shop.[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/577691d6-d2b0-11ea-a53d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]You can obtain even more containers by completing additional chains of combat missions during Update 0.9.7. You'll find all the details in the "German Carriers 2" section of the Combat Missions tab.[/i][/list]

[h3][b]A German Navy container includes:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Two elements of the “German Navy” collection.
[*]One of the following items: 1,250 Free XP; or 7x flags of the same type (Zulu, Papa Papa, Equal Speed Charlie London, India Bravo Terrathree); or 1x "Black, White, Red" expendable camouflage.[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/570a65ba-d2b0-11ea-b0ab-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]In Update 0.9.11, we're planning to make German Navy containers available in exchange for Coal in the Armory. Thus, you'll be able to start building the collection if you didn't manage to do so in Update 0.9.7. The exact cost of the containers will be announced later.[/i][/list]

[h2][b]Kriegsmarine Containers[/b][/h2]
Completing the Directives will reward you with up to five Kriegsmarine containers. You can find one of the following items in a Kriegsmarine container:
[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Pommern[/b][/b], a Commander with 10 skill points, and a Port slot
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Mainz[/b][/b], a Commander with 10 skill points, and a Port slot
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]VII Z-39[/b][/b], a Commander with 10 skill points, and a Port slot
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]VIII Admiral Hipper[/b][/b], a Commander with 10 skill points, and a Port slot
[*]3x "Black, White, Red" expendable camouflages
[*]3x special signal flags of the same type (Dragon, Wyvern, Red Dragon, Ouroboros, Hydra, Basilisk, Scylla, Leviathan)
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Warships Premium Account[/b]
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]5,000[/b] Free XP[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/5770b7fc-d2b0-11ea-9545-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Kriegsmarine Premium containers, which have higher chances of dropping Pommern, Mainz, Z-39, or Admiral Hipper, can be obtained in the Premium Shop and in exchange for doubloons in the Armory. You can find one of the following items in a Kriegsmarine Premium container:
[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Pommern[/b][/b], a Commander with 10 skill points, and a Port slot
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Mainz[/b][/b], a Commander with 10 skill points, and a Port slot

[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]VIII Admiral Hipper[/b][/b], a Commander with 10 skill points, and a Port slot

[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]32,000[/b] Free XP[/list]

[h2][b]Daily Shipments[/b][/h2] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/575e614c-d2b0-11ea-a972-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
During Update 0.9.7, enter the game in the period between August 6 and 20, inclusive, and start getting valuable rewards via the Daily Shipments section.

You can get a total of 10 rewards, while the shipments are available for 14 days. Thus, you can skip 4 days out of 2 weeks and still claim all the valuable rewards.

notes.title: Transformers join the battle in World of Warships
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/121890563ca58b2a6dd78db8123f8c1693c97e00.jpg[/img]
[b]Commanders![/b]

We are happy to announce that World of Warships is partnering up with Transformers in a brand-new collaboration! Autobots and Decepticons will be introduced for a limited time as themed ship skins and commanders in a much-anticipated update planned for this September.

[list]As for now, take a look at trailer for collaboration, comic page and beautiful renders below.[/list]
[previewyoutube=UnGP42M6Dig;full][/previewyoutube]
Four iconic Transformers characters will be released initially as unique ship skins and commanders with recognizable phrases and voiceovers. Optimus Prime and Bumblebee will set the stage for the heroic Autobots, with Megatron and Rumble to be available as their eternal foes — the Decepticons.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b6b5403c-d573-11ea-9751-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b6d005d4-d573-11ea-ba7e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b73cb8e6-d573-11ea-baac-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b73ab532-d573-11ea-bbb8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The coming Transformers collaboration will also bring a host of other new content, including special Transformers containers, dedicated in-game Combat Missions, consumable camouflages, commemorative flags and patches, and more.
[list][i]More details about the collaboration will be announced later.[/i][/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6917e3b6-d573-11ea-867a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Stream[/b][/h2]
One shall stand, one shall fall! Tune into our special stream today!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Stream starts:[/b] [b]Mon. 03 Aug. 23:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/worldofwarships]
Twitch
[/url]
[h2][b]About Hasbro[/b][/h2]
Hasbro (NASDAQ: HAS) is a global play and entertainment company committed to Creating the World's Best Play and Entertainment Experiences. From toys, games and consumer products to television, movies, digital gaming, live action, music, and virtual reality experiences, Hasbro connects to global audiences by bringing to life great innovations, stories and brands across established and inventive platforms. Hasbro’s iconic brands include NERF, MAGIC THE GATHERING, MY LITTLE PONY, TRANSFORMERS, PLAY-DOH, MONOPOLY, BABY ALIVE, POWER RANGERS, PEPPA PIG and PJ MASKS as well as premier partner brands. Through its global entertainment studio eOne, as well as its entertainment labels, Allspark Pictures and Allspark Animation, Hasbro is building its brands globally through great storytelling and content on all screens. Hasbro is committed to making the world a better place for children and their families through corporate social responsibility and philanthropy. Hasbro ranked No. 13 on the 2019 100 Best Corporate Citizens list by CR Magazine, and has been named one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies® by Ethisphere Institute for the past eight years. notes.title: Recruiting Station
notes.content:
[url=https://youtu.be/mwEV9cWwVEk][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/33d1ad404d862ff9768cc58341ad19fb485ac980.png[/img][/url]
[b]Greetings, veteran Captains and new players, renowned and yet-to-be-famed warriors, Clan leaders and die-hard solo sea wolves! Every single one of you has a place at the Recruiting Station, so let's make it stronger than ever before![/b]

[b]The Recruiting Station[/b] is a new special in-game system of rewards, where Recruiters invite their friends to the game and receive unique containers in return, as well as cashback in doubloons from purchases made by those they recruit.

[b]Note:[/b] for the Steam version you shouldn't create an account through an invitation link. Follow these steps instead:
[olist][*]Log in to World of Warships on Steam at least once.
[*]Click an invitation link. It should be from a player of the same region you've selected.
[*]Select "Log in".
[*]On the right-hand side select "Log in with your social profile: Steam."
[*]Sign in to the Steam website.

Cruiser Diana Lima should appear in your Port after playing one battle. If she doesn't, please restart the game and repeat the aforementioned steps, being sure to check that you haven't mixed up your accounts. Be wary that after playing 15 battles you can no longer use an invitation link.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/4e15f4c7f6a7c084e23a24961bd8b811bc77c4ec.jpg[/img]
[b]It's common knowledge that "ship" is a feminine word in many languages. But don't be intimidated by the transformation of these steel machines into fair ladies—even the most menacing battleships have hearts![/b]

That's why Azur Lane, a popular mobile game available for iOS and Android, presents the ships of World War II in the form of girls. Why are we bringing it up again? The cooperation between the World of Warships team and Azur Lane developers is continuing!

[table][tr][th][b]Azur Lane in World of Warships ● New Combat Missions ● Themed Port ● Collection ● About Azur Lane in a nutshell[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[previewyoutube=2X9fF_MG6rw;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]We've prepared new Commanders, ships, containers, and combat missions. If you're interested in a special combat mission chain with commander Nelson as final reward, click the "I like Azur Lane" button![/list]

[list][i]Attention! If, for whatever reason, anime is not your cup of tea, you can disable the display of themed content via the "Additional Content" panel in the bottom-right corner of the screen, where Azur Lane can be found in the Custom Ships section.[/i][/list]
[h2][b]Azur Lane in World of Warships[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]The bundles are available until:[/b] [b]Fri. 21 Aug. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[h2]All in One[/h2]
For those who want it all and want it now, there are two large bundles:
[list][*]A bundle with all the Azur Lane ships, a commemorative flag for each of them; a large number of Azur Lane camouflages; and a bundle with Commanders both old and new, including the unique Commander Azuma.
[*]A bundle with all the Azur Lane permanent camouflages and Commanders, including [b]Azuma[/b].[/list]
[list][i]If you already have the ships or permanent camouflage patterns from the bundles, you'll receive compensation in the form of doubloons in an amount that's equal to the cost of each duplicate.[/i][/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/273710ec-ccfa-11ea-8b0f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The bundle includes 22 Commanders from the popular Azur Lane mobile game (including Azuma) and unique permanent camouflages for ships [b][b]VII Nelson[/b][/b], [b][b]VII Hood[/b][/b], [b][b]VIII Admiral Hipper[/b][/b], [b][b]VIII Cleveland[/b][/b], [b][b]VIII Enterprise[/b][/b], [b][b]VIII Atago[/b][/b], [b][b]VII Belfast[/b][/b], and [b][b]VI Dunkerque[/b][/b].

[h2]Details[/h2]
[h1][i][h3][b]AL Yukikaze[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[b][b]VIII AL Yukikaze[/b][/b] is a Japanese Tier VIII destroyer with a unique permanent camouflage designed in the style of the popular Azur Lane mobile game. The ship is notable for her higher speed and greater damage characteristics of her torpedo armament.

[h3][b]Key features:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Powerful torpedo armament. Two quadruple-tube torpedo launchers. Range—8 km; speed—76 knots; damage—21,367 HP; and reload time—104 seconds
[*]Impressive concealment characteristics. Base spotting range by sea is 6.84 km
[*]She earns more credits per battle, and her permanent camouflage adds a 50% XP bonus per battle and reduces the cost of the ship's post-battle service by 10%[/list]
For a detailed look at the ship's technical specifications, follow this [url=https://wiki.wargaming.net/en/Ship:AL_Yukikaze]link[/url].

[h1][i][h3][b]AL Montpelier[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[b][b]VIII AL Montpelier[/b][/b] is an American Tier VIII light cruiser with a unique permanent camouflage designed in the style of the popular Azur Lane mobile game. The ship is modeled after researchable American cruiser Cleveland, but differs from her by having a more extensive HP pool and more accurate artillery.

[h3][b]Key features:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Effective, rapid-firing artillery. Twelve guns placed in four turrets. Firing range—15.6 km, reload time—7 seconds
[*]HP pool—37,500 points
[*]She earns more credits per battle, and her permanent camouflage adds a 50% XP bonus per battle and reduces the cost of the ship's post-battle service by 10%[/list]
For a detailed look at the ship's technical specifications, follow this [url=https://wiki.wargaming.net/en/Ship:AL_Montpelier]link[/url].

[h1][i][h3][b]AL Littorio[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[b][b]VIII AL Littorio[/b][/b], modeled after Italian battleship Roma, has great firepower and reliable side armor. While the battleship's guns cannot boast of having the kind of long firing range that is usually typical of the ship type, AL Littorio excels in close- and medium-range artillery duels due to her superb ballistics. Another advantage is provided by the ship's concealment, which is pretty good for a battleship. AL Littorio can go undetected for longer periods, allowing her to take the first shot in duels against hostile battleships.

[h3][b]Key features:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Her main battery consists of nine 381 mm guns with good ballistics and a high initial shell velocity
[*]Great torpedo protection and reliable armor
[*]Superb concealment for this ship type
[*]She earns more credits per battle, and her permanent camouflage adds a 50% XP bonus per battle and reduces the cost of the ship's post-battle service by 10%[/list]
For a detailed look at the ship's technical specifications, follow this [url=https://wiki.wargaming.net/en/Ship:AL_Littorio]link[/url].

[h1][i][h3][b]AL Sovetskaya Rossiya[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[b][b]IX AL Sov. Rossiya[/b][/b], modeled after battleship Sovetsky Soyuz, stands out by her impressive dimensions and excellent armament system. The ship received her maneuverability parameters from battleship Sovetsky Soyuz (B), but retained the hull and AA defense features of Sovetsky Soyuz (A).

[h3][b]Key features:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Nine 406 mm guns with flat-trajectory ballistics and a high initial shell velocity. Unlike the researchable Soviet battleships, shells launched by AL Sovetskaya Rossiya have standard accuracy parameters for the ship type
[*]Large HP pool
[*]Good armor protection
[*]The Damage Control Party consumable she carries has a reduced cooldown time between uses, but a limited number of charges
[*]She earns more credits per battle, and her permanent camouflage adds a 100% XP bonus per battle and reduces the cost of the ship's post-battle service by 20%[/list]
For a detailed look at the ship's technical specifications, follow this [url=https://wiki.wargaming.net/en/Ship:AL_Sov._Rossiya]link[/url].

[list][*]One of eight Azur Lane Commanders with unique voiceovers (Azuma, Baltimore, Roon, Jean Bart, Littorio, Shōkaku, Yat Sen, or Sovetskaya Rossiya), 10 skill points, and specializations for their same-name ships
[*]10x special signals of the same type (Basilisk, Wyvern, Hydra, Dragon, Red Dragon, Leviathan, Scylla, or Ouroboros).
[*]5x "Azur Lane – Siren" camouflages[/list]
[list]Each container is guaranteed to drop one of eight Azur Lane Commanders with a unique voiceover (including Azuma), 10 skill points, and a specialization for their same-name ship, as well as special signals and camouflages.[/list] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3cb0778e-cd08-11ea-8b0f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list]These offers are also available in the Armory.[/list]
[url=https://armory.worldofwarships.eu/category/event_3?force_login=true]Go to Armory[/url]

[h2][b]New Combat Missions[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Start:[/b] [b]Fri. 24 Jul. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]End:[/b] [b]Mon. 31 Aug. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[b]Reward:[/b]1x container of the Azur Lane collection

[b]Reward:[/b]1x container of the Azur Lane collection

[b]Reward:[/b]1x container of the Azur Lane collection
[/td][/tr][/table]
[list][b]Final Reward:[/b] Commander Nelson with 10 skill points and the Manjuu commemorative flag.[/list]
[list][i]You can complete the chain of combat missions playing Tier V–X ships in Operations, Random, Ranked, and Co-op Battles.[/i][/list]

Azur Lane containers include the following rewards:
[list][*]Azur Lane — Siren expendable camouflage
[*]1x Dragon special signal or 5x Zulu Hotel signals
[*]1x item of the Azur Lane collection[/list]

[h1][i][h3][b]Bonuses of the "Azur Lane – Siren" camouflage[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[list][*][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/camouflage/PCEC057_AzurLane_48612dbfefa8e33f10840dd3a22763fdee6fa34b3aa8ba7657598870c51c2b32.png[/img][b]−3%[/b] to your ship's detectability range by sea
[*][b]+4%[/b] to the dispersion of shells fired at your ship
[*][b]+50%[/b] to Commander XP per battle
[*][b]+100%[/b] XP per battle[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cf0179ee-cd8a-11ea-b9eb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Themed Port[/b][/h2]
It might not be the most canonical interior of a Commander's cabin, but that's just how it is. Here, you can also hear music that will be familiar to all Azur Lane fans.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5d25308a-cd09-11ea-8b0f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Collection[/b][/h2]
Collect all 36 avatars of Azur Lane Commanders. The first item of the collection can be obtained from Azur Lane containers. The rest will appear in Azur Lane containers and, with a certain probability, daily containers. All you need to do is activate the subscription on the collection screen by enabling the "Collecting" option.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9122697a-cd27-11ea-9993-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/91a02ebe-cd27-11ea-85a7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/91823f08-cd27-11ea-a6c4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9188f24e-cd27-11ea-8313-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/914e0f80-cd27-11ea-8ea7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/918f8a82-cd27-11ea-be92-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list]You will receive the flags of nations from Azur Lane as rewards for completing thematic sub-sections, and a unique Commander, [b]Azuma[/b], as a reward for completing the entire collection.[/list]
[list][i]You'll be able to exchange duplicates for any missing items of the Azur Lane collection at the exchange rate of 5 : 1. You can select the element to receive in exchange for your duplicates. When you complete the collection, all remaining duplicates on your account will be exchanged for credits at the rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]15,000[/b].[/i][/list]
[h2][b]About Azur Lane in a nutshell[/b][/h2]
The Azur Lane mobile game has been developed as a shooting RPG based on "shoot'em up" mechanics.
[list][*]Players participate in intense shooting by taking command of a Division that includes several naval warships turned humanoid.
[*]Enemies deliver a squall of fire, and the player's main task is to avoid the shells, minimize damage, and blast away foes by shooting back.
[*]There are more than 400 ships, or rather "Ship-Girls," in Azur Lane. They are based on ships of different nations from the World War II era.[/list]
More information is available on [url=https://www.azurlane.jp/]the official website[/url] of the Azur Lane game (in Japanese).

Commanders, thank you for participating in the Public Test for Update 0.9.7! Your feedback helps us to improve the version and to fix errors. Check out the changelog and join the second session of the Public Test!

[h3][b]Сhangelog[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Rewards for completing the German Navy collection were changed to the ability to mount two flags and alternative camouflage patterns on German ships.
[*]New features of Naval Base became available: additional expansions for the Treasury, Research Institute, and ships and vessels in the water area.
[*]Spotlights were added to ships in Port of Hamburg.
[*]An option to skip the intro video by clicking mouse button was added.
[*]The volume level of horn and music in the intro video is now set by the General volume level setting.
[*]Fixed a bug causing transaction error.
[*]Fixed several other bugs.[/list]

[h2]Special Features of the Test[/h2]
The rewards for activities on the Public Test server may differ from those on the live server. German carriers are not available to research on the Public Test server.

notes.title: Sound Changes in Update 0.9.6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/478cf65304925d2061fdba6380ae16ac2ffbf84a.jpg[/img]
[b]Update 0.9.6 has brought some major changes to the in-game audio. We’ve updated the [b]Wwise[/b] sound engine, added new sound effects, and changed a number of audio settings.[/b]

Today we'll explain in detail how to customize the in-game audio to meet your preferences.

[table][tr][th][b]Basic Audio Settings ● Fine Audio Settings ● Other Settings[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]Basic Audio Settings[/b][/h2]
We recommend using default volume settings, where all the parameters are set to maximum volume. With these settings, you'll experience every detail of the sound effects and get the best experience from the game.

If the sound seems too loud, navigate to [b]General volume level[/b] to adjust the volume of all in-game sounds.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d555557c-c759-11ea-8033-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Fine Audio Settings[/b][/h2]
If the general volume controls are insufficient, you can change the [i]fine settings[/i] in the audio customization window. These controls manage the different sound effects in our game:
[list][*][i][b]NEW[/b][/i] [b]Damage audio volume:[/b] covers the sounds that indicate hits of the ship, aircraft, water, islands, and other surfaces, as well as sound effects for fire and flooding.
[*][b]Gunfire volume:[/b] is the volume of all shots.
[*][b]Interface volume:[/b] is the volume of the sound effects that are produced when you click icons, tabs, and notifications, as well as when you activate equipment, etc.
[*][b]Music in the Port[/b] and [b]Music in Battle:[/b] regulate music volume in the Port and in battle correspondingly, as well as the volume of the horn when you launch the game client.
[*][b]Ambient sound volume:[/b] accounts for the sounds of nature on maps and background sounds in the Port.
[*][b]Engine sounds:[/b] determines how loud ship and aircraft engines are.
[*][b]Voice message volume:[/b] accounts for voice messages during battle, such as phrases from the quick commands chat, notifications about the remaining battle time, and other voice messages.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d55c7974-c759-11ea-acb3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]Please note: we've removed the [b]SFX volume[/b] setting. It managed all non-music sounds in the game, except voice messages, thus duplicating certain fine settings options and causing confusion.[/i][/list]
[h2][b]Other Settings[/b][/h2]
Let's take a look at some additional options that also deserve your attention.
[list][*][b]Sound quality[/b]: the default value of this parameter is set by the game automatically, depending on your PC's characteristics. This parameter affects the game's performance.[/list]
Setting the sound quality to [b]High[/b] is optimal for most devices. [b]Low[/b] quality supports all the key sound elements of the game, leaving out minor details and reducing the load on the system. When the sound quality is set to [b]Ultra[/b], your sounds will be at their most intense and detailed. However, make sure your PC is powerful enough to handle it. It's also advisable to have high-quality speakers or earphones; otherwise you won't be able to appreciate the game's sounds on maximum settings.
[list][*][b]Voiceover language[/b]: from this list, you can select any voiceover language that’s available in the client. The default choice is the selected language of the client.
[*][b]Voiceover modifications[/b]: from this list, you can select one of a few modifications for the voiceover. There are user modifications and those offered by the game's developers. The latter include Alexander Ovechkin, ARP Commanders, Bad Advice: Cap, and other modifications with Commanders who have unique voiceovers. If you select one of these modifications, the Commander's voice will be used as the voiceover for all your battles.[/list]
[list][i]If you pick the [b]National[/b] modification, your Commander will speak the language of the ship's nation, provided that this language is supported by the client. With [b]National voiceover +[/b], this rule is applied to all Commanders in battle. Commanders with unique voiceovers (i.e. those from the Fleet of Fog, Ovechkin, and others) speak only one language.[/i][/list]
[list][*][b]Music mode[/b]: allows you to switch the modes of music played during battle.
[list][*][b]Original[/b]: in this mode, you'll hear only brisk battle tracks, played one after another.
[*][b]Dynamic[/b]: in this mode, you'll hear custom-made tracks that evolve dynamically, depending on the distance to the enemy and battle situation.
[*][b]Mixed[/b]: is the most diverse mode, which combines the advantages of both the Original and Dynamic modes.
[*][b]War Drums[/b]: is a special music mode for those who prefer an epic yet laconic music experience.[/list]
[*][b]Choose audio source[/b]: shows the available sound sources. The audio settings are slightly different in the [b]Earphones[/b] and [b]Speakers[/b] modes.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f90d5802-c759-11ea-bb1d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f9201104-c759-11ea-98c8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f9167d10-c759-11ea-acc2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f91ef896-c759-11ea-b72d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f91717f2-c759-11ea-a604-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]If you use a surround sound system (5.1, 7.1, or higher), the game's audio settings will adapt to it automatically. But this audio setting must be selected at the operating system level.[/i][/list]
[list][*][b]Quick messages voiceover[/b] [b](enabled by default):[/b] turn this option off if you don't want Commanders to pronounce quick messages in the game.
[*][b]Wide dynamic range[/b] [b](enabled by default):[/b] turn this option off if you want all sounds to be equally loud. Dynamic range is the difference between the loudest and the quietest sounds in the game. The broader the range, the more natural and realistic the game will sound. We advise you to disable this option if you use internal laptop speakers or small speakers that can't reproduce the full audio frequency range.[/list]
[list][b][b]Note:[/b] if you disable the [b]Wide dynamic range[/b] option, don't forget to return all fine settings regulators back to 100%, as all the sounds will have the same volume, and the regulators will only turn a certain group of sounds on or off.[/b][/list]
[list][*][b]Loudness compensation[/b] [b](disabled by default):[/b] use this option if you want to play with a low audio volume and hear the sounds more distinctly.
[*][b]Voice Assistant (enabled by default):[/b] turns the announcer in the Port on or off. The announcer helps you understand new interface elements and informs you about achieving new Access Levels.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2a7c8624-c75a-11ea-98c8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[b]Voice Chat[/b]: in this menu section, you can customize the settings of the in-game voice chat.

Take note of the [b]Radio communication effect[/b] setting, which also affects the voice chat. You can also select a radio effect variant in the [b]Voice chat processing[/b] drop-down menu.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2a85b1a4-c75a-11ea-acc2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The game event in Update 0.9.7 is presented by Directives, Daily Shipments, and a new collection dedicated to the German Navy.

You can get [b]German Navy containers[/b] as rewards for completing Directives, as well as from Daily Shipments. Each container contains two elements of the new collection, as well as other rewards.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a2a35414-c5e5-11ea-872a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/403e59e6-c5e9-11ea-b91b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Ranked Sprint[/b][/h2]
Update 0.9.7 brings with it a new Ranked Sprint with a 3 vs. 3 format, playing Tier IX ships.

[h2][b]Changing Keys for Consumables[/b][/h2]
An option to set the order of consumables for each ship is going to be added in 0.9.7. The order of consumables is saved on the server, so you won't need to set it again if you're playing on different computers.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/92a9a924-c5e4-11ea-944c-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Unique Upgrades[/b][/h2]
We're continuing to work on making changes to the existing Unique Upgrades, and also adding some new ones.  The current concept provides an additional opportunity to mount an upgrade with special-but-balanced bonuses in comparison with regular upgrades.

These changes will balance the effectiveness of unique upgrades, and at the same time preserve the unique gameplay of each ship.
[list][i]You can view the detailed list of changes on the [url=https://blog.worldofwarships.com/blog/44]Development Blog[/url], and in the article about Update 0.9.7.[/i][/list]
[h2][b]Naval Base Update[/b][/h2]
[list][*]Added improvements for the Treasury, which will allow Clan leaders to regularly exchange Oil for rewards for the Clan.
[*]The Research Center, which applies a bonus to the amount of received XP, has been renamed "Naval institute." A new building named "Research Institute" has been added. It increases the amount of Research Points received.
[*]Depending on the Clan's activity in Clan Battles, the water area of the Naval Base will be filled with a proportionate number of ships. As more Random, Co-op, and Ranked Battles are played by Clan members, more vessels will appear.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0fe9c88e-c5e9-11ea-80b1-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0fbcd0d6-c5e9-11ea-b91b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0feab8d4-c5e9-11ea-b1ca-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0fb90c76-c5e9-11ea-a333-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Other Improvements[/b][/h2]
Two new battle signals, which can be obtained in exchange for credits, coal, and Research Points, have been added to the Armory.
[list][*][b]X-Ray Papa Unaone[/b]: increases the action time of Smoke Generator by 15%.
[*][b]Sierra Bravo[/b]: increases the action time of Hydroacoustic Search by 10% and reduces the cooldown period of Defensive AA Fire by 10%.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e987c914-c5e5-11ea-8cf6-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
They will be added to the "More Signals and Camouflages" daily container at a later point in time.

When entering the game for the first time after the update, a short video will play back. It can be skipped by double-clicking any keyboard button. Another video will play back on the login screen. This video can be paused.

Updated the upgrade icons.

notes.title: Public Test Now Available via Steam!
notes.content:
[url=https://promo.worldofwarships.com/public_test_steam/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/1ee9136ce277193eb069c577a745dba5d3df8118.jpg[/img][/url]
Each World of Warships Update goes through many test phases before it hits the Live Servers. The Public Test is one of the final phases of testing any updated game features. The results of all the tests allow the developers to maintain the highest possible quality of the game on the Live Servers.

Sometimes the results of the Public Test affect the developers' decisions on whether or not to introduce certain changes on the Live Server, or postpone them and roll them out during a later Update. Some test phases cannot be carried out without a large number of players, even if we use a lot of special testing bots, because no machine can imitate the behavior of a real player. Your participation in the Public Test is very important to us, as well as your comments about any new features prior to the release of each Update.

[quote]Active participants of the Public Test are eligible for special rewards that get added to their accounts on the Live Server. [/quote]

[h3]How do I access the Public test?[/h3]
If you want to join the Public Test for the first time:
[olist][*]Use [url=steam://run/1248250]this link[/url].
[*]The Public Test account is created automatically upon the first launch. You only need to choose any available nickname.[/olist]
After doing that, you have the option to link an email address to your Public Test account inside the game, as long as it's not in use for another PT account. [b]Your main World of Warships account doesn't necessarily have to be linked to an email address. You can receive rewards on your main account as long as it is linked to the same SteamID as your Public Test account.[/b]

Please note: if you have previously participated in a Public Test outside of Steam (i.e. via the WGC), you'll have to create a different Public Test account for linking to your SteamID. Therefore if you wish to receive remaining PT season rewards — you'll have to do that using the WGC account. Apologies for inconvenience.

If you've participated in a previous Public Test on Steam, simply update the client, launch it, and you will be logged in automatically upon launching.
[list][b]Please note the following: Player Support does not accept complaints about violations committed on the Public Test server.[/b][/list]
[h3]When will I receive my rewards?[/h3]
The rewards will be added to your main account after several working days [b]of the release of the respective Update on the Live Servers[/b], not immediately after you fulfill the criteria.

[b]Important: the Public Test server is available only during special test rounds, which usually last from Thursday to Monday on some weeks. You won't be able to connect on the other days.

You can get the details about the Public Test's time, as well as its combat missions and rewards, in a special news article on the website that is published before every round of the Public Test.[/b]

[*]German bombers carry armor-penetrating bombs. Squadrons fly at high altitudes, and an attacking flight immediately goes into a dive. As it is rather difficult to adjust the position of the target reticle during an attack, their bombs are most effective when dropped on slower targets.
[*]German carriers are armed with accurate long-range secondary guns.[/list]

[h2][b]Ranked Battles[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/b5bb2bbc-bfa0-11ea-b7d8-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Start:[/b] [b]Wed. 22 Jul. 11:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[b]Rewards:[/b] up to [b]4,800[/b] Steel and many additional rewards
