[h2][b]Unique Upgrades[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0515cbcc-a97b-11ea-9b0e-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In 0.9.5, we're starting the process of updating the unique upgrades. The current concept provides an additional opportunity to mount an upgrade with special-but-balanced bonuses in comparison with regular upgrades.

These changes will balance the effectiveness of the various unique upgrades, while preserving the unique gameplay of each ship.

[h1][i][h3][b]List of changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[h3][b]Enhanced Armaments (Yueyang, fifth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The bonus that reduces the main battery reload time has been increased from 10 to 15%.
[*]Removed penalties on the action time of ship consumables.
[*]Added a bonus increasing the action time of Surveillance Radar.
[*]Added a bonus increasing smoke screen dispersion time by 20%.
[*]Removed a bonus that reduced the torpedo tube reload time.[/list]
The older version of this upgrade was unpopular because of low competitiveness with other upgrades in the slot. The new variant of the upgrade offers more aggressive gameplay with an accent on consumables and main battery instead of the concealment upgrade which involves a safe playstyle.

[h3][b]Heavyweight Artillery (Khabarovsk, fifth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Removed a penalty that reduced the traverse speed of her main turrets.
[*]The bonus applied to the main battery’s firing range increased from 8 to 10%.
[*]Added a 20% penalty to the action time of the ship’s consumables.[/list]
The upgrade now places much stronger emphasis on aggressive gameplay due to the enhanced main battery guns and reduced effectiveness of consumables.

[h3][b]Enhanced Countermeasures (Worcester, sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Moved from the fifth to the sixth slot.
[*]Removed all bonuses on the action time of her consumables.
[*]Added a bonus reducing the reload time of the Priority AA sector by 20%.
[*]Added a bonus reducing the reload time of ship consumables by 20%.
[*]Added a bonus increasing the number of the ship's consumable charges by one.[/list]
The upgrade moved from the fifth to the sixth slot, which means that it no longer has to compete with other upgrades that provide bonuses to maneuverability and detectability. The new parameters emphasize the role of this ship as a versatile cruiser.

[h3][b]Enhanced Propulsion (Des Moines, sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Reduced the bonus to engine power. Now, with the unique upgrade and the “Propulsion Modification 1” upgrade, it’ll take the cruiser 21% more time to reach maximum forward speed, and it’ll take three times more time to reach maximum backward speed. The ship will still be gaining speed faster with these two upgrades compared to having just one of them. At the same time, the time it takes the ship to reach 1/2 and 3/4 of her speed remains almost the same.
[*]Removed a penalty on the action time of Surveillance Radar.[/list]
The bonus to engine power was lowered to reduce the excessive effectiveness of the upgrade. The penalty to the duration of Surveillance Radar didn’t affect the use and effectiveness of the upgrade. Players will now choose between this unique upgrade and an upgrade that increases firepower.

[h3][b]Enhanced Main Armaments (Großer Kurfürst, sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The bonus reducing the main battery’s reload time has been decreased from 15 to 10%.
[*]Removed a penalty that reduced the traverse speed of her main turrets.[/list]
[h3][b]Enhanced Damage Control System (Montana, fifth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The bonus reducing fire extinguishing time has been decreased from 15 to 10%.
[*]The bonus reducing flooding recovery time has been decreased from 30 to 10%.[/list]
[h3][b]Additional Main Battery Loader (République, sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Removed a penalty that reduced the traverse speed of her main turrets.[/list]
[h3][b]Accelerated Torpedo Tube Reload (Shimakaze, sixth slot)[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The penalty reducing the torpedo tube traverse speed has been decreased from 80 to 70%.[/list]
[list][i]Concerning [b]X Großer Kurfürst[/b], [b]X Montana[/b], [b]X République[/b], and [b]X Shimakaze[/b], balance changes designed to compensate for the excessive or insufficient effectiveness of their unique upgrades were made.[/i][/list]
Expect changes to the unique upgrades of other ships in the coming updates.

[h2][b]Changes in the Soviet Cruiser Branch[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/8877e198-a99a-11ea-aa34-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Update 0.9.5 will see the Soviet cruiser branch split into two sub-branches. [b]X Moskva[/b] is a heavy cruiser, and she is going to leave the light cruiser branch and acquire the status of special ship that's available in exchange for Coal. She'll be replaced in the tech tree by light cruiser [b]X Alexander Nevsky[/b]. [b]V Kirov[/b] will also leave the branch to become a Premium ship. She'll be replaced by [b]V Kotovsky[/b]. The Premium version of Kirov is based on her standard hull that historically existed. The ship’s AA armament is the same as for her standard hull, while all of her other characteristics are same as for her researchable hull. At the same time, it will be possible to choose between the Spotting Aircraft and Fighter consumables.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/452a0bc2-aa5e-11ea-98f7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h1][i][h3][b]Details on changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[list][*]Cruiser [b]X Moskva[/b] will acquire the status of being a special ship. This means that the base cost of the post-battle service of this ship will be reduced from [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]180,000[/b] to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]90,000[/b] credits, and Commanders from other ships of the same nation can be assigned to her without any penalties or retraining requirements.
[*]You'll receive cruiser [b]X Moskva[/b] under the following circumstances: if you've already researched but haven't yet purchased her; if you sold her; or if you’ve had the branch reset through the Research Bureau.
[*]If your progress through the Soviet cruiser branch has been reset, the Research Point bonus will be transferred to [b]X Alexander Nevsky[/b].
[*]The unique upgrade and combat mission for cruiser [b]X Moskva[/b], as well as any permanent camouflages you’ve purchased, will be preserved. If the Type 20 permanent camouflage hasn't yet been purchased, it will be added.
[*]The Commander of cruiser [b]X Moskva[/b] will preserve his specialization.
[*]Cruiser [b]X Alexander Nevsky[/b] can be obtained only after she has been researched and purchased in the Tech Tree.
[*]The same rules apply to cruiser [b]V Kirov[/b] and her tech tree replacement [b]V Kotovsky[/b], except that Kirov will become a Premium ship instead of a special ship.[/list]

[list][*]Ships [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VIII Ignis Purgatio[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VIII Ragnarok[/b][/b], which are the copies of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_01624cacb82f39f77a4e677a7b9fdf4df20dafd61f971f4b2d3e54c3065e2892.png[/img][b]VIII Amagi[/b][/b] with unique permanent camouflages.
[*]Commanders Justinian Lyons XIII and Arthas Roqthar the Cold.
[*]Protector of the Faith and Primordial Annihilator expendable camouflages.
[*]Iron Halo, Imperial Aquila, The Chaos Star, The Mark of Chaos patches.
[*]Imperial Navy and Khorne flags.
[*]"Warhammer 40,000 — Chaos" and "Warhammer 40,000 — Imperium" containers.[/list]
[list][i]Details on how to get these new items will be announced later.[/i][/list]
[h1][i][h3][b]Other Changes and Improvements[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/05915558-a97b-11ea-9cc3-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Now when the game client is launched, a video about the Update will be played once. To play the video again, select "Play video at startup" in the Game Settings.
[*]Small changes to the geometry and textures of the following ships: [b]VI Weser[/b], [b]IV Klas Horn[/b], [b]III Romulus[/b], [b]IX Drake[/b], [b]VIII Cheshire[/b], [b]VIII Ochakov[/b], [b]VII Scharnhorst B[/b], [b]VII Scharnhorst[/b], [b]VIII Siliwangi[/b], [b]IX Bajie[/b], [b]VIII Atago[/b], [b]VII Gorizia[/b], [b]IV Alberto di Giussano[/b], [b]V Genova[/b], [b]VI Trento[/b], [b]VI Farragut[/b], [b]VI Devonshire[/b], [b]VIII Amagi[/b], [b]VII Sinop[/b], [b]X Hayate[/b], [b]X Minotaur[/b], [b]VIII Roma[/b], [b]V Raimondo Montecuccoli[/b], [b]X Marceau[/b], [b]VIII Bismarck[/b], [b]VII Zara[/b], [b]VIII Amalfi[/b], [b]V Hawkins[/b], [b]VI London[/b], [b]VII Surrey[/b], [b]V Krasny Krym[/b], [b]I Orlan[/b], [b]V Visby[/b], [b]IX Sovetsky Soyuz[/b], [b]II Tátra[/b], [b]VIII Baltimore[/b], [b]X Conqueror[/b], [b]X Moskva[/b], [b]VIII Kidd[/b], [b]X Salem[/b], [b]X Gearing[/b], [b]X Zaō[/b], [b]X Des Moines[/b], [b]X Daring[/b], [b]X Thunderer[/b], [b]VIII Enterprise[/b], [b]IX Friedrich der Große[/b], [b]X Großer Kurfürst[/b], [b]VIII Tirpitz[/b], [b]IX Roon[/b], [b]X Z-52[/b], [b]VIII Le Fantasque[/b], [b]VIII Z-23[/b], [b]VIII Asashio[/b], [b]VIII Benson[/b], [b]VIII Hsienyang[/b], [b]X Kléber[/b], [b]VIII Richelieu[/b], [b]VIII Gascogne[/b], [b]IX Alsace[/b], [b]X République[/b], [b]IX Jean Bart[/b], [b]VIII Mogami[/b], and [b]IX Z-46[/b].
[*]All supported game client localizations are now available in all regions.
[*]Bot-piloted aircraft carriers no longer launch air squadrons without having at least one full attack flight.
[*]The "Ultra" client option has been removed from the Wargaming.net Game Center. "Ultra" sound settings are now available to all players. The size of the game is unaffected.
[*]Added a special message informing Clan members about their selected prime time. The message contains information about the selected prime time and who performed the action.
[*]Fixed an error that resulted in an incorrect acquisition range for the Hydroacoustic Search consumable on [b]VIII Pyotr Bagration[/b]. The range of assured acquisition of enemy ships increased from 4 to 5 km. The range of assured acquisition of torpedoes increased from 3 to 3.5 km.
[*]Fixed an error causing the aim point to move to the maximum range with a locked target in the Binocular View upon activating Spotting Aircraft.
[*]Fixed an error causing the marker for the gun aiming point on the Minimap to disappear.
[*]Fixed an error causing the torpedo range of aircraft carrier squadrons not to appear in the Minimap settings.
[*]Fixed an error causing shell models to keep moving, even after colliding with landscape elements.
[*]Fixed an error causing the game client to close when connecting to a battle that had just ended.
[*]Fixed an error causing the window where ship bots are added in the Training Room to close when attempting to add several ship bots at once.
[*]Fixed an error causing the game client to terminate unexpectedly during the loading stage.
[*]Fixed an error that prevented the playback of audio messages about torpedo hits for certain voiceover modifications.
[*]Fixed an error causing the [b]NEW[/b] marker not to disappear from the "Tech Tree" tab and player name in the Port.
[*]Fixed an error causing the autopilot to work incorrectly after a tangential collision with an island.
[*]Fixed an error causing ship XP not to be shown in the Spectator Mode.
[*]Fixed an error that resulted in upgrades mounted on ships still being displayed after they had been sold.
[*]Fixed errors on the following maps: Sleeping Giant, Crash Zone Alpha, Greece, Northern Lights, Hotspot, Operation Killer Whale, Riposte, Shards, Northern Waters; as well in as the Saint Petersburg and Fjords Ports. Removed the decorations in Novorossiysk Port.
[*]Changed the name of the torpedo module on [b]V Mikoyan[/b] from 53-36 mod. 2 to 53-36 mod. 1.
[*]Fixed an error causing the text on the submarine depth indicator to be truncated.
[*]Fixed an error causing the audio of attack aircraft rocket explosions and aerial torpedoes hitting water’s surface to be excessively loud.
[*]Fixed an error causing mounted upgrades to be displayed on sold ships.
[*]Fixed an error causing ships’ main guns to reach an elevation angle that was too high when aiming at islands beyond their maximum firing range.
[*]Fixed an error causing Co-op battles fought on the Greece map in Domination mode with four Key Areas to commence with an incorrect number of points.
[*]Fixed an error causing the camouflage of cruiser [b]VI Admiral Makarov[/b] to be different on the icon in the ship carousel compared with the ship model in the Port.
[*]Fixed an error causing the battle type icons to overlap each other when a low screen resolution had been selected.
[*]Fixed an error that allowed the selection of more than one aircraft carrier when creating a Division in Submarine Battles.
[*]Fixed an error causing the game client to freeze when the player was redirected to another server during maintenance.
[*]Fixed the incorrect armor thickness of [b]VIII Amagi[/b]’s conning tower. It is now 356 mm thick.
[*]Fixed incorrect aiming angles for [b]IX Alsace[/b] and [b]VI Normandie[/b]’s secondary guns.[/list]

notes.title: Hamburg Dockyard: Build a Ship
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2e9915ab617732b2594d9c2ca4967e5b96875097.jpg[/img]
[b]The main feature of Update 0.9.5 is the Dockyard in the Hamburg Port, where two German ships will be constructed simultaneously:[/b]
[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VI Admiral Graf Spee[/b][/b]—the famous "pocket battleship." A formidable warrior armed with torpedo launchers and powerful 283 mm caliber artillery.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VIII Odin[/b][/b]—a new battleship. An excellent medium- and close-range fighter, carrying nine 305 mm guns that reload quickly for a battleship, a trademark German secondary battery, torpedo launchers, and the Hydroacoustic Search consumable.[/list]
[table][tr][th][b]Rules of the Event ● Directives ● Rewards[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[previewyoutube=KzOxDnSBA6M;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]Rules of the Event[/b][/h2]
We've simplified the rules of this iteration of the Dockyard:
[list][*]The event will span two updates—0.9.5 and 0.9.6.
[*]The construction process of the Dockyard is comprised of 20 phases.
[*]Each shipbuilding phase can be completed by finishing Directives or spending [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,750[/b] per phase.
[*]The reward for reaching phase 10 is [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VI Admiral Graf Spee[/b][/b] with her War Paint camouflage.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3e60a5d2-a73c-11ea-9f45-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3ed09900-a73c-11ea-b191-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3ed88f0c-a73c-11ea-a7a0-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3ed5058a-a73c-11ea-bdcb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[list][*]In total, you can complete 18 out of 20 shipbuilding phases by finishing Directives without using doubloons.
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VIII Odin[/b][/b] and her War Paint camouflage awaits you upon completing the 20th phase.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cd8d9544-a73c-11ea-89c3-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cdaafe90-a73c-11ea-bdcb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cd2b90ec-a73c-11ea-ad63-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cd6e90fe-a73c-11ea-9f45-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]


For completing all the Directives, players can obtain [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VI Admiral Graf Spee[/b][/b], a multitude of other Dockyard rewards, and earn an excellent discount on [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VIII Odin[/b][/b].
[list][i]If you already have [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VI Admiral Graf Spee[/b][/b] in your Port, you will receive compensation in the form of credits, as well as the camouflage, Commander, and a Port slot.[/i][/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/8855cba6-a753-11ea-8d9f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/883b9bfa-a753-11ea-9260-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/883be34e-a753-11ea-bb48-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/883b8c50-a753-11ea-864e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]


[h2][b]Directives[/b][/h2]
The new game event has 73 missions spread across six Directives. The first Directive will become available with the release of Update 0.9.5, while those that follow will be unlocked each week. The Directives are available from June 11 through August 4.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/78b46e5e-a763-11ea-af59-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]
Each Directive will allow you to complete three shipbuilding phases:
[list][*]Two shipbuilding phases can be completed by finishing specific missions that form part of the Directive.
[*]One shipbuilding phase can be completed by finishing the entire Directive.[/list]
[list][i]Detailed information about the Directives is available in the game client.[/i][/list]
[h2][b]Rewards[/b][/h2]
By only finishing missions of the Directives, players can complete 18 out of 20 shipbuilding phases and obtain the corresponding rewards at the Dockyard.

By playing and finishing the first two Directives, you can complete up to six shipbuilding phases and obtain the following rewards:
[list][*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]7,500[/b] Coal
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Warships Premium Account[/b]
[*]15x Hunter camouflages
[*]2x Gift containers[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/72e0e2fc-a748-11ea-b7af-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Finishing four out of the six Directives will result in you completing up to 12 shipbuilding phases and obtaining [b]Admiral Graf Spee in the War Paint camouflage, as well as a 10-skill-point Commander[/b] and other valuable items, which when combined with previous rewards gives you a total:
[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VI Admiral Graf Spee[/b][/b] in the War Paint camouflage with a 10-skill-point Commander
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]7,500[/b] Coal
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]4 days of Warships Premium Account[/b]
[*]10x each of the following signals: Hydra and Basilisk
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]10,000[/b] Free XP
[*]15x Hunter camouflages
[*]5x Gift containers holding five special signals each[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/72f33df8-a748-11ea-9953-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
Finishing all of the event's Directives will result in you completing up to 18 shipbuilding phases and provide you the [b]maximum 90% discount on Odin[/b], as well as some additional signals, giving you a grand total of:
[list][*]90% discount on [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VIII Odin[/b][/b]
[*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VI Admiral Graf Spee[/b][/b] in the War Paint camouflage with a 10-skill-point Commander
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]7,500[/b] Coal
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]4 days of Warships Premium Account[/b]
[*]10x each of the following signals: Hydra, Basilisk, Scylla, Leviathan, Dragon, Red Dragon, and Ouroboros
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]10,000[/b] Free XP
[*]15x Hunter camouflages
[*]5x Gift containers[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/726db2aa-a748-11ea-801b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
In order to complete the 19th and 20th phases, apart from finishing all the event's Directives, you'll need to purchase any two shipbuilding phases by spending doubloons. It doesn't matter when you purchase these two phases: at the end of the building process or at any other time.
[list][*]Сompleting the 19th shipbuilding phase will bring you [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]10,00[/b]0 Coal.
[*]Battleship [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]VIII Odin[/b][/b] awaits you upon completing the 20th phase.[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/7265d882-a748-11ea-83e2-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]You can purchase all the shipbuilding phases in exchange for doubloons and receive all the available rewards without waiting. If you decide to complete shipbuilding at the Dockyard by using doubloons, you can still progress through the Directives. However, in that case, instead of the usual rewards for completing the shipbuilding phases, you'll get [b]250[/b] Steel for each completed phase. In total, you can earn up to [b]4,500[/b] Steel.[/i][/list]
[list]Those who want to purchase the shipbuilding phases at a discount can obtain the Starter Pack, which includes the first eight shipbuilding phases, in exchange for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]8,000[/b] doubloons. However, you can only purchase it prior to completing the first shipbuilding phase by any other means.[/list]

notes.title: WoWS Show: Funny Moments – My Ship Will Go On
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/0165993615306bee3005f81661a122d1d9addea5.png[/img]
[b]Captains![/b]

We've prepared a compilation of the most interesting and funny moments sent in by our players.
[previewyoutube=oKqAzPzkxQg;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]Are you enjoying the show? Subscribe to our channel to stay informed about the next instalments![/list]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/user/worldofwarshipscom?sub_confirmation=1][i][/i] Subscribe to the Channel[/url]

[h3][b]How does one send a replay to our show?[/b][/h3]
You need to log in to the website [url=https://replayswows.com]https://replayswows.com[/url] using your Wargaming account credentials. Then click the "Upload Replay" button and share your in-game stories! Don't forget to write the names of the show and your ship in the "Title" section, to ensure that we don't miss your replay. [b]Example:[/b] [b]#WOWSHOW (Tirpitz)[/b].

[h3][b]How do we select replays for our show?[/b][/h3]
To be approved for our show, a replay should correspond to the following criteria:
[list][*]Duration of an episode or a pack of mini episodes shouldn't exceed one minute.
[*]Episodes should be funny, interesting, or just plain epic. The more entertaining; the better![/list]
[list][i]Any player can send us an unlimited number of replays. Players will receive a reward for every replay chosen for the show![/i][/list]

notes.title: Skulls for the Skull Throne 4 - WoWS × Warhammer 40,000 Themed Pre-Sale Pack
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d21483d809d0c4001251ae6b5572972930c23061.png[/img]
[b]Commanders![/b]

We are happy to announce that World of Warships is partnering up with Games Workshop in a brand-new collaboration using Warhammer 40,000! The 41st Millennium hits the World of Warships universe in a unique celebration, bringing a lot of in-game themed stuff for your naval battles.

[list][i]More details about the collaboration will be announced later. For now, you can get your hands on unique flags and patches that will help you to get more special Warhammer 40,000 containers in Update 0.9.5 before the official start of the collaboration.[/i][/list]
[table][tr][th][b]Flags and Patches ● Combat Missions ● What is Warhammer 40,000?[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]Flags and Patches[/b][/h2]
Show your devotion! Will you mount the Imperial flag or the Chaos flag? Will you fight for the Emperor, or will you bring more Blood for the Blood God?

Players who purchase the Warhammer 40,000 pre-sale package will get a special mission to earn Warhammer 40,000 containers in Update 0.9.5 before the official start of the collaboration.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Bundles will be available until:[/b] [b]Wed. 19 Jun. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

Combat missions of the chain can be completed only in the specified sequence—you can start the next part only after all missions of the previous parts have been completed.[/i][/list]
[b]In Warhammer 40,000 containers players can find one of the rewards: special themed expendable camouflages or other different in-game goodies. You also have a chance to get premium battleship with distinctive themed permanent camouflage and 10-skill-point Commander.[/b]
[h2][b]What is Warhammer 40,000?[/b][/h2]
Warhammer 40,000 is the pinnacle of tabletop wargaming, produced by Games Workshop. Today, the universe has expanded to video games, novels, comics, and more, garnering a huge following around the globe.

Together with Games Workshop, we’ve created something that stays true to the renowned fantasy IP while resonating within our naval battles.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15138/Battlefleet_Gothic__World_of_Warships_BUNDLE/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7d3d4259490f504b57596fc4693b77e7bc88a47e.png[/img][/url]
We're excited to unveil an exclusive partnership with Focus Home for the release of the [b]Battlefleet Gothic + World of Warships Bundle[/b], including Battlefleet Gothic: Armada 2 base game, World of Warships base game, and the newly released World of Warships x Warhammer 40,000 Themed DLC.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15138/Battlefleet_Gothic__World_of_Warships_BUNDLE/]Get both games together at a discounted price and lead your fleets to victory![/url]

[h3]Battlefleet Gothic: Armada 2[/h3]
[b]Battlefleet Gothic: Armada 2[/b] is the real-time strategy game adapted from Games Workshop’s famous tabletop game that portrays the epic space battles of the Warhammer 40,000 universe.

Expanding on the groundwork laid out by the first game, Battlefleet Gothic: Armada 2 is a full-blown sequel - bigger, richer, more impressive and more ambitious than the original game. It includes all 12 factions from the original tabletop game and its expansions it is based on: the Imperial Navy, Space Marines, Adeptus Mechanicus, Necrons, Chaos, Aeldari Corsairs, Aeldari Craftworld, Drukhari, the T’au Merchant and Protector Fleets, Orks, and finally, the Tyranids.

[h3]World of Warships[/h3]
Experience epic, free-to-play naval combat when you helm one of over 300 historic vessels in the exciting balance of strategy and real-time combat that [b]World of Warships[/b] offers. Outfit your fleet with flags, camouflages, modifications, talented Commanders, and more!

[h3]World of Warships x Warhammer 40,000 Themed DLC[/h3]
In the grim darkness of the far future, there is only war! Prepare yourself—soon you'll take command of the imposing ships themed to Warhammer 40,000 in World of Warships. In the meantime, use the new flags and patches to show everyone which side you belong to—the Imperial Navy, bringers of order; or the bloodthirsty followers of Chaos.

notes.title: Submarine Battles: Free Submarine Rentals
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d87ae9baa6e52ee6f4bcc4248d24681685d1505e.jpg[/img]
[b]Submarines have come a long way and changed significantly since the first tests, but a lot of work still remains to be done before they can become a full-fledged unit type.[/b]

While we continue configuring the submarines, you're welcome to try them out in Submarine Battles.

[b]Key Points[/b]
[list][*]Submarine Battles are a separate battle type for Tier VI ships, available from May 27 through June 24.
[*]You'll receive Submarine Tokens for your first login each day.
[*]The Tokens can be exchanged in the Armory for random bundles, one of which contains three rental submarines.
[*]New game mechanics: dive and ascend, sonar pings, battery charge, depth charges, and Hydrophone.
[*]A special combat mission that will reward you with XP and credits for cruisers, destroyers, battleships, and aircraft carriers.[/list]
[table][tr][th][b]Submarine Battles ● Playing Submarines ● Playing Against Submarines[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[previewyoutube=gN0O54IHdHQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]Submarine Battles[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Wed. 27 May 06:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Wed. 24 Jun. 06:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

Select Submarine Battles, select any Tier VI ship, and fight against submarines!

To stand at the helm of a submarine yourself, you need to collect and use Submarine Tokens. These Tokens will be credited upon your first login each day during the run of Submarine Battles. You can exchange Submarine Tokens for random bundles in the Armory. One of the seven available random bundles will drop three 21-day rental submarines, each with a special 19-skill-point Commander. The remaining bundles will drop 500 Coal each.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/64222cda-9e6f-11ea-8ffc-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list]A special combat mission for all ship types, with the exception of submarines, is available in Submarine Battles. It will grant you +100% XP and +25% credits for the first five battles each day.[/list]
[list][i]The rental submarines will be removed from your account once the rental period expires, or with the release of Update 0.9.6.[/i][/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4c8015c0-9e69-11ea-99ae-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4c87ee44-9e69-11ea-85b7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4c68ce7e-9e69-11ea-bf2a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4ccef104-9e69-11ea-b90b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4ccfe38e-9e69-11ea-816f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4cbe0394-9e69-11ea-ae5e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4c81fd9a-9e69-11ea-bbba-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/4c838ad4-9e69-11ea-8df7-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Playing Submarines[/b][/h2]
Submarines are fragile and cautious hunters. Diving depth affects their detectability, viewing range, and interaction possibilities with other submarines and ships. Maneuver, change your diving depth, hide from your enemies, and surprise them with stealth attacks from the flanks.

Submarines have a small HP pool, so stick to the flanks and attack your opponents from afar or while submerged.

Keep an eye on all enemy destroyers, and cruisers such as [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]VI Dallas[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]VI Budyonny[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]VI Leander[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Commonwealth_abdc3eb3f8c9b1c0421b3aed2f550ac45b78602942f9a4a2cdd438835720edc7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VI Perth[/b][/b], as they are carrying depth charges. Change position often, try to enlist the support of your teammates, and use the Maximum Depth consumable in case of immediate danger.

The primary targets for submarines should be sluggish ships—any agile targets that are capable of making anti-torpedo maneuvers are difficult to hit.

[h3][b]Submarine Controls[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The [b]W[/b], [b]A[/b], [b]S[/b], and [b]D[/b] keys control horizontal movement.
[*]Press [b]F[/b] to ascend.
[*]Press [b]C[/b] to dive.
[*][b]Ctrl+F[/b] and [b]Ctrl+C[/b] lock the horizontal rudders to either ascend or dive.
[*][b]1[/b]—sonar pings.
[*][b]2[/b]—torpedoes.
[*]Press [b]1[/b] again to choose between two sonar ping options: wide and slow, or narrow and fast.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/63f118f2-9e6f-11ea-a66c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Surfaced and Submerged Submarines[/b][/h3]
Submarines can move between two operational levels: surfaced and submerged (6 meters and deeper).

A submarine on the surface can be hit with shells, ship- and airborne torpedoes, aerial bombs, and rockets. Emitting sonar pings while on the surface increases the submarine's detectability more significantly than while underwater. Capturing Key Areas is only possible when surfaced.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bb800b14-9e6f-11ea-b45f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

When a submarine dives deeper than 6 meters, her speed drops significantly, visibility reduces twofold, and viewing range decreases to the value of her torpedo range. While submerged a submarine can detect ships only within a certain radius, provided that they are within her direct line of sight, and can't detect aircraft.

A submarine at depths of 30 meters and greater can be detected only by ships with Hydroacoustic Search and other submarines, while the Hydrophones on destroyers allows them to determine the approximate location of a submarine.

The Maximum Depth consumable enables you to temporarily dive to 50–80 meters. At this depth, the damage of depth charges is reduced, and the submarine's location cannot be determined by Hydrophone anymore.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/baf9996c-9e6f-11ea-8836-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Acoustic Homing Torpedoes[/b][/h3]
The main armament carried by submarines is [b]acoustic homing torpedoes[/b]. New mechanics—[b]sonar pings[/b]—will help you increase the potential effectiveness of your torpedo salvos. Hit special indicators located at the bow and stern of an enemy ship with your sonar pings. By doing so, your torpedoes will be guided to the target and deal more damage if they strike. Torpedoes can ascend from the depths and hit an enemy only with the help of an active effect from a sonar ping.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/6562b470-9e6f-11ea-bc26-8cdcd4b147d4.gif[/img]
[list][*]A sub can fire torpedoes and emit sonar pings from any depth. When submerged, a sonar ping can be emitted in any direction, even at targets above or below the sub.
[*]After selecting sonar pings, you'll see two indicators appear at the bow and stern of the target ship. Aim for these indicators, take a lead on the target, and click the left mouse button. Please note: unlike when firing shells, the camera won't follow the targeted ship automatically.
[*]Emitting sonar pings temporarily increases a submarine's visibility.
[*]A successful hit on one of a ship’s two indicators will make the torpedo home in on the target.
[*]If you hit both indicators, torpedoes will assume the optimal depth to hit vulnerable spots and will be able to inflict more damage to citadel or anti-torpedo defenses.
[*]The effect of a successful ping hit remains active for 20–30 seconds, depending on the exact submarine. Hitting an indicator with another sonar ping will reset its action time.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/64394fbe-9e6f-11ea-b40c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
If you attack a ship from afar, keep emitting sonar pings to refresh their effect while your torpedoes are traveling to their target. Remember that guiding your torpedo to its target with the help of sonar pings doesn't guarantee a hit.
[list][*]Torpedoes have very poor maneuverability. They lose speed when turning and are not capable of catching up to a ship that's actively maneuvering.
[*]Upon approaching the target to a distance of approximately 1 km, torpedo homing gets disabled and it will travel straight ahead. If the enemy changes speed or course during this time, your torpedo might miss it.[/list]
[h3][b]Battery Charge[/b][/h3]
Battery charge is needed to emit sonar pings. The submarine’s battery charge is depleted with each ping, as well as when moving underwater at speeds higher than 1/4.
[list][*]To restore battery power, ascend to the surface, or reduce your speed to 1/4.
[*]If you deplete your battery charge, you won't be able to emit sonar pings, but you will still be able to move at any speed.[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/6b118426-9e67-11ea-99da-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Playing Against Submarines[/b][/h2]
[list][i]All destroyers, and cruisers [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]VI Dallas[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]VI Budyonny[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]VI Leander[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Commonwealth_abdc3eb3f8c9b1c0421b3aed2f550ac45b78602942f9a4a2cdd438835720edc7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VI Perth[/b][/b] are armed with depth charges. This countermeasure can hit submerged submarines.[/i][/list]
[list][*]At depths of up to 6 meters, a submarine can be hit with shells, ship- and airborne torpedoes, aerial bombs, and rockets.
[*]High-explosive shells are the most effective shell type to deploy against submarines. They will inflict damage to a submarine even when not directly striking it. Falling in the sub's vicinity is enough, thanks to the shell's fragmentation damage area.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bb5200f2-9e6f-11ea-86eb-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Constantly change course and try to keep your bow or aft pointed towards a submarine. This will make it more difficult for them to hit the second point on your ship's hull with a sonar ping.
[*]If a submarine is detected with the help of the Fighter or Spotting Aircraft consumables, the planes will start to follow it. They will circle over its last spotted location if the submarine dives.
[*]The Hydroacoustic Search consumable can detect a submarine at any depth.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/64789da4-9e6f-11ea-816f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Hydrophone and Depth Charges[/b][/h3]
[list][*]A destroyer's Hydrophone will track the movements of a submarine within a radius of 4–5 km around the ship. The sub's approximate location is shown with a special marker. The closer the ship is to the submarine, the more frequently all incoming information will be updated.
[*]Cruisers don't have Hydrophone, but they are equipped with Hydroacoustic Search, which is capable of detecting submarines at any depth.
[*]Approach the approximate location of the submarine and release your depth charges using the [b]G[/b] key.
[*]You have several charges at your disposal that can be activated consecutively. Keep in mind, however, that depth charges take time to reload. You won't be able to hit a submerged submarine during this time.
[*]If a submarine hides at the maximum depth of more than 50 meters, the damage from depth charge hits will be reduced, but still remains quite considerable.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bb3f50b0-9e6f-11ea-8ffc-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/recommended/recommendgame/552990][list]Try out the new unit type in the game and share your impressions![/list][/url]

notes.content:

[list]What a special week it is for us at Wargaming![/list]
The World of Warships team has the phenomenal opportunity to host retired Navy Captain, [b]Bob Batterson[/b], for our weekly NA [b][b]Twitch stream[/b][/b] this Friday at [b][b]21:00 UTC[/b][/b]. Captain Batterson is a Pearl Harbor survivor who flew F6F Hellcats during WWII.

He served his country for 26 years, and he continues his service as a volunteer on board the [url=https://www.usslexington.com/]USS Lexington[/url] museum since it opened in 1992! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Stream starts: [/b] [b]Fri. 15 May 23:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[b]Captain Batterson[/b] recently celebrated his 99th Birthday May 8th, and we all wish him a very happy belated birthday and thank him for his years of service.

[h2][b]Soviet Cruisers[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/071bb1ca-9297-11ea-be30-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Soviet Tier VIII–IX heavy cruisers are coming to Early Access!

[h3][b]Features of the new Tech Tree branch[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Effective AP shells with excellent armor penetration capabilities, good ballistics, fewer over-penetrations, and enhanced ricochet angles.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0777f4c6-9297-11ea-9b1a-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Wed. 27 May 06:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Wed. 24 Jun. 06:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

Submarines are arriving and will be playable in a separate battle type! This will enable us to continue testing the new ship type while we adjust the balance and mechanics on the live server by involving more participants, and won’t affect the other battle types. Only once we're done with all these steps will we be able to decide on the final fate of the new unit type.
[list][i]Players will be able to enter Submarine Battles playing submarines and Tier VI ships.[/i][/list]
Submarines are fragile but stealthy hunters, capable of traveling not only horizontally, but also diving into the depths. The diving depth of a submarine affects her detectability, viewing range, and range of possible interactions with other submarines and ship types.

The main armament carried by submarines is acoustic homing torpedoes. You can launch an attack from any depth, and submarine-specific mechanics—sonar pings—will help you increase the potential effectiveness of your torpedo salvos. Keep an eye on your battery charge and use sonar pings wisely. Torpedoes can ascend from the depths and hit an enemy only with the help of an active effect from a sonar ping. If you run out of battery charge, reduce your speed to 1/4 or ascend to the surface level to recharge it.

Keep an eye on enemy destroyers and cruisers. All destroyers, as well as cruisers [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]VI Dallas[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]VI Budyonny[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]VI Leander[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Commonwealth_abdc3eb3f8c9b1c0421b3aed2f550ac45b78602942f9a4a2cdd438835720edc7.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VI Perth[/b][/b] carry depth charges. [*]Small corrections have been made to textures and models of the following ships: [b]VIII Mainz[/b], [b]VI Guépard[/b], [b]VII Skåne[/b], [b]X Småland[/b], [b]X Venezia[/b], [b]VIII Vladivostok[/b], [b]X Daring[/b], [b]X Hayate[/b], [b]X Ohio[/b], [b]IX Brindisi[/b], [b]I Eritrea[/b], [b]X Halland[/b], [b]VI Trento[/b], [b]IX Georgia[/b], [b]VII Sims[/b], [b]VIII Amalfi[/b], [b]VII Zara[/b], [b]X Minotaur[/b], [b]V Visby[/b], [b]VIII Siliwangi[/b], [b]V Raimondo Montecuccoli[/b], [b]X Marceau[/b], [b]II Enseigne Gabolde[/b], [b]VIII Lightning[/b], and [b]IX Östergötland[/b].
[*]Fixed a bug that caused a string of lights of the New Year permanent camouflage on aircraft carriers to be lit up from bow to stern, when they should light up from stern to bow.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused [b]X Smolensk[/b] to be displayed as a Premium ship, and not as a special one.
[*]Fixed bugs on maps Archipelago, Estuary, Polar, Haven, and Tears of the Desert; and in Ports New York, Marseille, and Fjords.
[*]Fixed a bug due to which, when inserting text with characters [b]<[/b], [b]>[/b], or [b]^[/b] into a chat message in the Port, cause the text to be cut off. Now these characters will be removed.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused players to not automatically be disconnected from the server after 3 hours of inactivity.
[*]Fixed the display of tooltips when hovering over the “Ready” and “Not Ready” buttons in the Training Room and on the Division screen.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused battle modes in the Training Room to be called "Battle Type."
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the sizes of windows to be changed incorrectly when the value of the Increase UI Scale setting was higher than 100%.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the game client to shut down when pressing the [b]ESC[/b] button while opening the window displaying patches.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused talent and skill icons to overlap each other in the Personal File window of Commander Günther Lütjens.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the reticle to show incorrect information about the readiness of guns for firing with the Reduce GUI Refresh Rate option enabled.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused autopilot to switch off when dragging autopilot waypoints on top of each other.
[*]Fixed a bug that made it impossible for the overview camera in the Port to switch from one gun to another gun of the same type.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the interface text to be partially blurred.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the secondary/AA guns indicator, information about fixing guns, and fire and floo[b]din[/b]g timers to not be displayed after reentering a battle.
[*]Fixed a bug that made it impossible to plot an autopilot route on a specific area of the Tactical Map.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the reload timer to reload for a second longer when the reload time was longer than 1 minute.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the icon of a completed mission of a Campaign to move down if the mouse was hovered over it.
[*]Fixed a bug where secondary guns could shoot at the enemy through allied ships.
[*]Fixed a bug that made it possible to confirm the "Ready" status in a Division for Clan Battles with an unsuitable ship selected.
[*]Fixed a bug where the torpedo alarm indicator, collision alert indicator, and the Radio Location indicator didn’t allow players to select a priority target for their secondary battery guns.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the buoys indicating the boundaries of Key Areas to be displayed only at close range.
[*]Fixed a bug where a squadron’s reticle before the start of an attack was not displayed in the spot where it was fully aimed.
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented players from mounting the Ship Consumables Modification 1 upgrade on [b]VII Belfast[/b] and [b]VII Z-39[/b].
[*]Fixed the incorrect naming of the AA guns on [b]III Romulus[/b].
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the names of items in collections to be written in capital letters.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused a marker above a torpedo to appear before the torpedo was armed.
[*]Fixed a bug due to which, when switching to another ship, ships with the “Coming Soon” field displayed the “Test Ship” field.
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented a squadron from attacking immediately after taking off.
[*]Fixed a bug due to which, with the 1366x768 resolution selected, icons of unavailable missions were displayed incorrectly in the Campaigns window.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused aerial bombs to deal damage later than the point when they hit the target.[/list]

notes.title: Soviet Cruisers: Early Access
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/977de1637d89a92579242bd8bfd3e8cc0e7ad044.jpg[/img]
[table][tr][th][b]Early Access ● Directives ● Soviet Сontainers ● Rewards for Soviet Tokens ● Combat Missions ● Random Bundles ● Daily Shipments[/b][/th][/tr][/table] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/24a7d842-9128-11ea-9b6a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Early Access[/b][/h2]
Researchable Soviet cruisers [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]VIII Tallinn[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]IX Riga[/b][/b] are arriving in Early Access. To obtain them, you can exchange Soviet Tokens for bundles in the Armory that are opened in sequential order.

[b]Soviet Tokens:[/b] a themed temporary resource that can be obtained from Soviet containers or random bundles.

[b]Soviet containers:[/b] obtained by completing Directives or received in Daily Shipments.

[b]Bundles that provide Early Access to Soviet cruisers[/b] can be obtained in the Armory in exchange for Soviet Tokens. There are a total of six bundles that are opened in sequential order. In these bundles, you'll find cruisers [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]V Mikoyan[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]VIII Tallinn[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]IX Riga[/b][/b], as well as the Soviet permanent camouflage for cruisers Tallinn, Riga, and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]X Petropavlovsk[/b][/b].

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/fde616b4-912d-11ea-941b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d30e7004-9127-11ea-9b6a-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d2d3b7f2-9127-11ea-941b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]What are the new Soviet cruisers’ distinctive features?[/b][/h3]
[list][*]One of the main features of the new sub-branch is their effective armor-piercing shells with good ballistic properties, high penetration, and a short fuse-arming delay time, the latter of which will significantly decrease the number of overpenetrations. Salvos fired from these ships are effective against both battleships and cruisers.
[*]An average reloading time and special accuracy settings: the new ships have a larger dispersion ellipse at long distances in comparison to other cruisers.
[*]When these ships are positioned wisely, they will demonstrate their decent ability to absorb hits thanks to the good armor protection they enjoy for their type.
[*]As with most cruisers, you can choose between Hydroacoustic Search and Defensive AA Fire.
[*]Cruisers of Tier IX and above have the Repair Party consumable at their disposal.
[*]The combination of their accuracy settings and the Surveillance Radar consumable with a 12 km operating range makes the new cruisers most efficient in medium-range encounters.[/list]
[list][i]Cruisers [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]VIII Tallinn[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]IX Riga[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]X Petropavlovsk[/b][/b] will become available to research in Update 0.9.6.[/i][/list]
[h2][b]Directives[/b][/h2] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/0b70628c-9113-11ea-a95c-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
The new game event tasks you with completing 42 missions spread across four Directives. The first Directive will become available with the release of Update 0.9.4, while those that follow will be unlocked on a weekly basis. Completing the event’s missions and Directives will bring you signals, expendable camouflage patterns, credits, and Soviet containers, as well as other rewards.

[b]Reward for completing all Directives:[/b] the Soviet permanent camouflage for cruiser [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]V Mikoyan[/b][/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]The Directives can be completed until[/b] [b]Tue. 09 Jun. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[list][i]Detailed information on the Directives and Hall of Fame rewards can be found in the game client.[/i][/list]
[h2][b]Soviet Сontainers[/b][/h2] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/06db9a24-9114-11ea-ac4d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
Players will be able to obtain Soviet containers from Daily Shipments (up to six containers) and by completing Directives (up to 54 containers).

Each Soviet container includes 5, 10, 15, 25, or 300 Soviet Tokens.
[list]Once you've obtained all the available containers from Daily Shipments and for completing Directives, you're guaranteed to have collected enough Tokens to obtain cruiser [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]V Mikoyan[/b][/b].[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d37bbd6c-9127-11ea-ba11-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Rewards for Soviet Tokens[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Bundles that provide Early Access[/b][/h3]
All available rewards will be visible in advance of making an exchange. After making an exchange for one bundle, the contents of the next bundle will become visible to you.
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/23134cf0-9128-11ea-941b-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]All ships are added with a Commander with 3 skill points and a Port slot.
[*]If you already have [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]V Mikoyan[/b][/b] in your Port, the bundle will provide you with a Commander, Port slot, and compensation for the ship in the form of doubloons.[/list]

[h3][b]Other rewards[/b][/h3]
You can also exchange Soviet Tokens for the following rewards in the Armory:
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/238a681c-9128-11ea-ba11-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][i]With the release of Update 0.9.5, Soviet Tokens will only be obtainable from random bundles available for doubloons. After Update 0.9.6 goes live, all Soviet Tokens will be converted into credits at the rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]9,000[/b].[/i][/list]

[h2][b]Combat Missions[/b][/h2]
Cruisers [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Ochakov[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Pyotr Bagration[/b][/b] will be available in the Armory in exchange for doubloons. While playing these ships, as well as cruiser [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]V Mikoyan[/b][/b], you can complete special combat missions that will bring you between 15–30 Soviet Tokens for victories in battles, depending on the ship. More details on combat missions are available in the game client.

[h2][b]Random Bundles[/b][/h2] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f2966778-9114-11ea-a95c-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
The Soviet Cruisers section of the Armory has been stocked with random bundles. Each of them can be obtained for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]500[/b] doubloons.
[list][*]All the rewards are visible in advance: the bundles’ contents and their amounts are displayed when viewing the currently available bundle.
[*]After each exchange, the contents of the next random bundle will become available to exchange.
[*]Having collected all the bundles, you're guaranteed to have obtained all the available rewards.[/list]

[h2][b]Daily Shipments[/b][/h2] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/23055bfe-9128-11ea-9b1a-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
During Update 0.9.4, enter the game in the period between May 14 and 28, inclusive, to start getting valuable rewards from the Daily Shipments section.

You can get a total of 10 rewards, while the shipments are available for 14 days. Thus, you can skip 4 days out of 2 weeks and still claim all the valuable rewards.

notes.title: Armistice in Europe: 75th Anniversary Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9571c1552ccf526af159b91f5eb2daa1c4c32ee8.jpg[/img]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LqMAt9nCotg
[b]Captains![/b]

Three quarters of a century have passed since World War II in Europe officially came to an end and hostilities ceased. In celebration of this solemn 75th anniversary, we’ve prepared a special event to honor the European nations that helped bring an end to the deadliest conflict in modern history through their unfailing valor and sacrifice. 

We’ll be giving away a full [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]360 days of Premium Account[/b] to 75 participants who achieve high base XP scores playing British, French, European, or Commonwealth ships. Read on for the full details.

[h2]Duration[/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Fri. 08 May 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Mon. 11 May 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Prizes credited by:[/b] [b]Sat. 16 May 01:59 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[h2]How to Participate[/h2]
[list][*]Make sure to click the Participate button in the article of your region or in the News inside the game. 
[*]During the event, fight as many battles as possible playing Tier V–X British, French, European, or Commonwealth ships. 
[*]Battle types: Scenarios, Random, Coop, Ranked and Clan Battles[/list]
[b]Participate[/b]
[table][tr][th][h3][url=https://worldofwarships.ru/news/event/fleet_of_winners/]CIS(Ru)[/url][/h3][/th][/tr][tr][th][h3][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/sales-and-events/v-e-day-event/]EU[/url][/h3][/th][/tr][tr][th][h3][url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/sales-and-events/v-e-day-event/]NA[/url][/h3][/th][/tr][/table]
[list][b]All participants will receive a [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9a626166a901987dc67dd822133e592b3e322a81.png[/img][b]Sierra Mike[/b] signal to confirm their participation. It will be added to your account immediately after you click the button. [/b][/list]

[h2]Prizes[/h2]
[list][*]We'll raffle off 75 sets of [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]360 days of Premium Account[/b] among all participants who manage to earn [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9d43348869eb4ac094288dad196925d8f6d9d89b.png[/img][b]19,450 XP[/b] or more. Only XP earned while playing British, French, European, or Commonwealth Tier V–X ships during the event will be taken into account.
[*]After the event, for [b][b]destroyers, cruisers, and battleships[/b][/b], we’ll reward the top-20 base XP earners in each category—a total of 60 winners across the three ship types. As with the raffle, participation will only count for those playing either British, French, European, or Commonwealth Tier V–X ships.[/list]
[table][tr][th][b][b]Position by Amount of base XP Earned[/b][/b][/th][th][b][b]Reward[/b][/b][/th][/tr] [tr][td]1–6[/td] [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]360 days of Premium Account[/b][/td][/tr] [tr][td]7–13[/td] [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]180 days of Premium Account[/b][/td][/tr] [tr][td]14–20[/td] [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]90 days of Premium Account[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
[list][*]For [b][b]carriers[/b][/b], we'll select and reward the top-15 participants by the total amount of base XP earned during the event.[/list]
[table][tr][th][b][b]Position by Amount of base XP Earned[/b][/b][/th][th][b][b]Reward[/b][/b][/th][/tr] [tr][td]1–5[/td] [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]360 days of Premium Account[/b][/td][/tr] [tr][td]6–10[/td] [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]180 days of Premium Account[/b][/td][/tr] [tr][td]11–15[/td] [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]90 days of Premium Account[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
[list][i]To improve your chances at getting one of these prizes, you may want to consider focusing on playing a particular type (destroyer, cruiser, or battleship). Doing so will certainly help you achieve your objective of ending up in the top-20 for one of the categories.[/i][/list]

[h1]Weekly Combat Missions: V-E Day[/h1]
[b]Take part in the marathon to obtain festive camouflages![/b]

[table][tr][th][b]Discounts and bonuses ● Victory Salute ● Combat missions[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]Discounts and bonuses[/b][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Fri. 01 May 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Mon. 11 May 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

The festive victory bonus is still available. The first victory of the day playing each ship will bring you an additional 200% XP.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Fri. 08 May 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

notes.title: Matchmaking: The Basics Making Teams
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/0f289e868046b9f28371fe9c07c776045e134a8e.jpg[/img]
[b]The matchmaker is a system for distributing players between teams that ensures the teams are balanced in terms of ship types and tiers.[/b]

The main parameter considered when distributing ships is the battle tier—the highest tier of ships in an individual battle. For example, a battle that involves Tier V–VII ships is a Tier VII battle. The maximum battle tier in which ships can participate is set for each ship.

[h3][b]The matchmaker follows a specific set of rules when creating Random Battles[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The teams have an equal number of players. An ideal battle is played in a 12 vs. 12 format, but the required number of players can be reduced in cases where the waiting time spent by the first player in the queue exceeds 3 minutes.
[*]There is a maximum difference of one tier between ship tiers in battles involving Tier II–IV ships.
[*]The maximum ship-tier difference in a single battle is two tiers for Tier VII battles and above.[/list]
[list][i][b]Please note:[/b] this article explains how the matchmaker works in Random Battles. The rules it follows in other battle types can differ due to the specifics of each battle type. This information is relevant to Update 0.9.3.1.[/i][/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c46322b0-8abb-11ea-808a-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Features of the Matchmaker[/b][/h2]
[b]The matchmaker[/b] is integral to World of Warships, and we are constantly making efforts to improve its algorithms. It's designed to assemble the most effective and balanced team lineups while having as little adverse impact on the battle queue waiting times as possible.

[h2]Types and Tiers[/h2]
In addition to the ship's tier, the matchmaker also takes each ship's type into account. The following rules are applied for these two parameters:
[list][*]The matchmaker initially tries to assemble exactly mirrored team lineups in terms of ship tiers and types. If the matchmaker isn't able to assemble a battle in this way, it then proceeds to match ships of lower tiers while ignoring the ship-type parameter. For example, in a Tier VIII battle, it's possible for a Tier VI battleship to be matched to a Tier VI cruiser, or even a Tier VI destroyer. This rule doesn't apply to aircraft carriers.
[*]The matchmaker limits the numbers of ships of specific types in a battle. While teams consisting of only battleships would probably be able to fight in a very efficient manner, such a battle would hardly be interesting or diverse. For example: the number of destroyers and battleships in a team won't exceed four and five ships, respectively, provided that the matchmaker's queue has a normal number of players waiting. The number of aircraft carriers won't exceed two ships in a team for any battle tier.
[*]There are certain tier restrictions in place: in Update 0.9.3 we added a soft restriction on the minimum number of ships allowed that are two tiers lower than the battle tier, and also on the maximum number of ships of the highest tier in the battle. For example: even in a Tier X battle in which you're playing a Tier VIII ship, you'll meet several enemies of the same tier as yours. For Tier X battles, a team should include at least three ships of Tier VIII, if such ships are waiting in the queue, and a maximum of five ships of Tier X, if the matchmaker's queue has a normal number of waiting players.
[*]If possible, ships of different nations are distributed between teams on an even basis.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-sg.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3cbe95e-8abb-11ea-9e1d-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]The rules described above constitute the soft restrictions. For each battle tier, several sets of settings are used that replace each other, depending on the waiting time in the queue—the longer the battle waiting time, the softer the restrictions.[/i][/list]
[list][b]The matchmaker doesn't take into account such parameters as the upgrades and modules mounted on a ship, the number of skills and talents a Commander has, or a player's combat statistics.[/b][/list]
[h2]Battle History[/h2]
When matching teams, the algorithm also takes your battle history into account, i.e. the number of battles you've played with ships of the same tier as yours and lower, with ships one or two tiers higher, and where all ships were of the same tier. We also collect separate statistics for each battle type and ship tier you play. After a short calibration period, the matchmaker will ensure that the percentage of battles with ships of the specified tier doesn't exceed the set limits, so as to prevent long series of battles fighting against ships of higher tiers. When a player joins the queue for their next battle, the algorithm takes the player's previous 20 battles into account when assembling their team, thus ensuring that the set limitations are met.

[b]Example:[/b] for Tier VIII ships, there's a maximum limit of 40% of battles with ships two tiers higher. If you played Tier VIII ships in your 20 most recent battles, a maximum of eight battles would have included Tier X ships.

[h2]Playing in a Division[/h2]
The following rules apply when you play in a Division:
[list][*]The difference between ship tiers within a Division must not exceed one tier. This means that when playing Tier VII ship, you can only enter battle with Division mates playing ships of Tiers VI–VIII.
[*]A Division can have only one aircraft carrier.
[*]The matchmaker rules ensure that a player cannot encounter ships that are outside of the player's tier range in Random Battles. However, when a player is a member of a Division, the matchmaker ignores this rule for ships of lower tiers. For example, when you're playing a Tier VII ship in a Division and your Division mate is playing a Tier VIII ship, you might find yourself in a battle involving Tier X ships.
[*]There is a maximum difference of one Division between opposing teams within a single battle.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-sg.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c39e4198-8abb-11ea-ac52-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Matchmaker for Newcomers[/h2]
World of Warships has a special queue for novice players entering battle—a so-called Sandbox.
[list][*]When playing ships of Tier I–IV, newcomers are put into a special queue that excludes players who have fought more than 70 battles.
[*]If a player's waiting time in the queue exceeds 60 seconds, and the matchmaker has at least one enemy of a suitable ship type and tier, a battle will be assembled. If necessary, the teams can be complemented with bot ships.
[*]If the matchmaker fails to assemble a battle after the player has spent more than 60 seconds waiting in the queue, the player is placed in the general queue without leaving the sandbox queue.
[*]Players from the same Division can be placed in the queue for newcomers only if all the players meet the requirements specified above.[/list]

The Update is bringing our new [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Hayate[/b][/b] to the game, and she’ll be available for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]2,000,000[/b] Free XP.
[h2][b]History[/b][/h2]
Hayate is a variant of a Japanese destroyer project developed during World War II. The ship is imagined with a main battery consisting of the modern 127 mm Type 1 dual-purpose guns in twin-turret mounts. In reality, Japanese designers only managed to produce one such gun before the end of the war, which was found by the Americans among the debris of the gun mount workshop at the Kure Naval Arsenal in December 1945.

In World of Warships, we’ve recreated this mount in 3D and designed a ship based on a Shimakaze-class destroyer to carry it.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7412d7be-888c-11ea-9499-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/34c1a10a-887b-11ea-8a4d-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/899e8582-8888-11ea-a060-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
