notes.title: Armada: Orkan
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f10255baa49a66b30456ef0dfadcb1ff3f06e8e6.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=sjb_Sy_TKHE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]History[/b][/h2]
In November 1939, a naval agreement was concluded between the Polish government-in-exile and the British government. One of its clauses stated that the Polish Navy, which was participating in the war as part of the Royal Navy, would have the opportunity to strengthen itself with British ships that would be provided on a rental basis. After the end of the war, they were to be returned. The Polish Navy received a total of ten ships, among which ORP Orkan was the last destroyer and penultimate large ship.

The ship's construction was carried out at Fairfield, the famous Scottish shipyard in Glasgow. It was started in 1939 and finished in 1942. Initially, the vessel was named HMS Myrmidon, after the mythical ancient Greek nation of Myrmidons. Upon her transfer to the Polish Navy on December 5, 1942, the destroyer received a traditional name, that of a weather phenomenon—Orkan (Polish for "storm"). Her crew was composed of Polish volunteers, half of whom had never served on a warship before.

The destroyer debuted in combat in winter, 1943, when she participated in escorting Arctic convoys JW-52 and JW-53 from Iceland to Murmansk, and subsequently—returning convoys RA-52 and RA-53. Orkan fended off 17 German submarine attacks and 12 German aircraft raids. The ship received no damage, but many of her crew members suffered due to the Arctic Ocean’s severe winter storms.

In September 1943, Orkan, together with various British destroyers, started escorting convoys to Canada and back. In the morning of October 8, the Polish ship spotted German submarine U-378 while escorting convoy SC 143. The enemy was the first to attack. The acoustic torpedo hit Orkan and caused the destroyer's fuel tanks to explode. The ship became engulfed in flames, which led to her ammunition detonating. Orkan quickly sank. Just 1 hour later, Musketeer—a destroyer of the same class—managed to pick up 43 out of more than 240 people that had been aboard.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bcd0c1ce-84ad-11ea-9363-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Modeling the Ship[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/99f1142c-84b4-11ea-8192-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

[b]Dual-purpose artillery:[/b] three 120 mm/50 QF Mk XI twin artillery mounts and one 102 mm/45 Mk V AA gun.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/99f73136-84b4-11ea-beda-8cdcd4b147d4.png[/img]

[b]Torpedo armament:[/b] one quadruple-tube 533 mm QR Mk IV torpedo launcher.

[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9a6a1eb2-84b4-11ea-a016-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.png[/img]

[b]Anti-aircraft armament:[/b] four 40 mm/39 QF Mk VII automatic AA guns and six 20 mm Oerlikon Mk IV automatic AA guns.

[h2][b]Orkan in Combat[/b][/h2]
Destroyer [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_6c2bac10ec2bec5799e117af8aa6298d1647a6b0d3ae7ea9b78983e78d13e14e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]VIII Orkan[/b][/b] was built in Britain, but fought under the Polish flag during World War II. She escorted polar convoys and was eventually sunk by submarine U-378 in the North Atlantic. In World of Warships, the ship represents Europe. Orkan is efficient at hunting down enemy destroyers. Her main advantages are provided by her rapid-firing artillery, fast torpedoes, and the Surveillance Radar consumable she carries—a rare feature for destroyers.

[h3][b]Key features[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Six 120 mm guns placed in three turrets. Reload time—4.5 seconds. Her HE shells have good chances of causing fire on targets for their caliber — 9%.
[*]Orkan is one of just a few destroyers that have secondary armament. With her 102 mm gun, you can surprise everyone by earning the Close Quarters Expert achievement while playing the destroyer.
[*]One quadruple-tube torpedo launcher. Her torpedoes have a high speed of 76 knots and fast reload time of 70 seconds.
[*]The Repair Party consumable she carries compensates for her 15,700 HP, which is mediocre for the ship's tier.
[*]Her Surveillance Radar consumable provides ample opportunities to confront enemy destroyers.
[*]She earns more credits per battle, and her permanent camouflage adds a 50% XP bonus per battle and reduces the cost of the ship's post-battle service by 10%.[/list]

notes.title: Dry Dock: HMS Hood
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d0301ded53899d315fca3649ccb84132bca6f5cc.jpg[/img]
[b]World of Warships is the largest virtual shipyard in the world.[/b]

The quality of the work done by our artists improves each year, and the requirements for the accuracy of the models they create grow respectively. Unfortunately, the in-game camera doesn't allow you to see all the finer details up-close. In the Dry Dock show, you'll be able to see the refined beauty of our in-game models and duly appreciate the carefully-placed objects on their decks.

Today, we're focusing on the British Premium Tier VII battleship, HMS Hood. She's a British naval legend and the historic rival of the equally famous German battleship Bismarck. For a long time, this swift-going battleship was the biggest, and arguably most powerful, ship in the Royal Navy.

notes.content:
[url=https://youtu.be/YTegxCoiRzE][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e95990f079faa36b76c870a22678b967a80fa675.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]Georgios Detsis is fond of history and warships—he enjoys spending his spare time making ship models, including ultra-realistic ones. In 2019, he was invited to the Wargaming Studio in St. Petersburg to meet fellow warship enthusiasts among our colleagues and to build a model of Yamato for the interior design of our office. The battleship model was to be built with the maximum level of detail (at a scale of 1:200).[/b]

Japanese battleship Yamato is one of the most famous ships in history. Even those who are unfamiliar with the details of her wartime career have at least heard about this ship; her monumental appearance and the fact that she was equipped with the largest naval guns in history are features that have afforded her a lot of well-deserved attention. In the new episode of the 1:42 Scale series, Georgios is going to tell us about the difficulties he faced in crafting the model of this elegant ship.

notes.title: Campaigns in World of Warships
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/c5c91b3df6f97aecd476403b389c47837eabc73e.jpg[/img]
[b]One of the highlights of the European Arc is a new temporary Campaign called "Strong-Willed." At this time, we thought it might be handy to give you a rundown of World of Warships Campaigns, what Campaigns are available in the game, and why they are worth your time.[/b]
[list][i]To take up a Campaign, go to the "Campaigns" tab in the Port, and click on an available mission. Within that mission you can select the tasks that best suit your ship's type.[/i][/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c3cc3734-7a48-11ea-a3d4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

Permanent Campaigns are divided into standard ones (e.g. "Science of Victory" and "Honorable Service") and historical ones. Historical Campaigns are dedicated to famous naval battles or the biographies of distinguished naval commanders. For example, if you want to follow the path of Admiral William Halsey—one of the key figures of the U.S. Navy during World War II—embark on the "Hit hard! Hit fast! Hit often!" Campaign. If you’re interested in how the career of an Admiral of the Imperial Japanese Navy developed after the attack on Pearl Harbor, the "Yamamoto Isoroku" Campaign would be your first choice.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/df1f5516-7a48-11ea-872e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

By completing standard tasks, you get rewards and earn the Stars that are required to unlock the final task. For accomplishing the final task, you get a unique reward.
[list][i]If one particular task becomes your favorite, or if other tasks seem too difficult, just keep on completing the same task. Keep in mind though, that you’ll earn Stars each time you complete the task, but you'll be issued the reward for that task only once.[/i][/list]
With Premium Account, you can undertake three tasks at a time; without Premium Account, you can complete only two tasks simultaneously. Besides this, if you haven't completed a task and canceled it for some reason, then you'll have to start it from scratch next time you select the task.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/e1026416-7a4a-11ea-a538-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/cee971a2-7a4a-11ea-9bc4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bc268708-7a4a-11ea-9bc4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a938e51e-7a4a-11ea-9bc4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]The "Strong-Willed" Temporary Campaign[/b][/h2]
The Campaign is split into five missions, with the first one already available and the following ones opening with each passing week.
[list][b]Main reward[/b]: a unique historical European Commander—Jerzy Świrski—with 10 skill points and a specialization for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_6c2bac10ec2bec5799e117af8aa6298d1647a6b0d3ae7ea9b78983e78d13e14e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]I Gryf[/b][/b].[/list]
The Campaign will remain available for 6 months after the release of Update 0.9.3.

[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/65047a9a-7a43-11ea-8414-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

Half a year after the end of the Campaign, we plan to make Jerzy Świrski available in exchange for Coal in the Armory. Thus, you'll be able to get this Commander at a later date, even if you don't manage to finish the Strong-Willed Campaign.

[h2][b]Permanent Campaigns[/b][/h2]
[h1][i]Science of Victory[/i][/h1]
[list][b]Main reward:[/b] 7 days of Premium Account[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/531f2e60-7a52-11ea-a0b7-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h1][i]Honorable Service[/i][/h1]
[list][b]Main reward:[/b] destroyer [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_9ffc494df739f989c98f2dd3a4e40887299a30d3dfd5b146e85d7ddd08f63744.png[/img][b]VI Shinonome[/b][/b] and a Commander with 11 skill points[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ff1139e8-7a43-11ea-8e79-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h1][i]Yamamoto Isoroku[/i][/h1]
[list][b]Main reward:[/b] a unique historical Japanese Navy Commander—Yamamoto Isoroku—with 15 skill points and a specialization for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]I Hashidate[/b][/b][/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/20fa9ae0-7a44-11ea-8e79-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h1][i]Hit hard! Hit fast! Hit often![/i][/h1]
[list][b]Main reward:[/b] a unique historical U.S. Navy Commander—William Halsey—with 15 skill points and a specialization for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-st.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]I Erie[/b][/b][/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/442aa9e2-7a44-11ea-8e79-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[b]If you haven't done so yet, select several tasks from the Campaign that you like, and earn extra prizes in Random Battles.
[/b]

notes.title: European Destroyers: Branch Review
notes.content:
[url=https://youtu.be/-zX5EJf6xf4][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f458e25f0aebf8b644add7c23842dec79ff1b776.png[/img][/url]
[table][tr][th][b]Features of the New Tech Tree Branch ● Tactics ● Commander Skills and Upgrades[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]Features of the New Tech Tree Branch[/b][/h2] [img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/0c7d11ea-7988-11ea-8078-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Their torpedoes' long range, fast reload, and high speed are balanced by the relatively limited damage they can inflict. The torpedoes can be set to fan out in two spreads: narrow or super narrow.
[*]Good AA defenses with a solid reach.
[*]Destroyers of Tier VIII and above are equipped with the Defensive AA Fire consumable.
[*]Ships of Tier VII and higher are equipped with rapid-firing main battery guns that are effective at short distances. Exchanging fire over long distances is less comfortable due to the arcing trajectory of the shells and the guns’ limited firing range.
[*]Despite lacking Smoke Generator, they enjoy good concealment—Halland's is as low as 6 km.
[*]Destroyers of Tier V and above have access to the Repair Party consumable. It restores 1% of any lost HP per second and has an action time of 10 seconds. At Tiers VIII–X, the active duration of the consumable is 14 seconds.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2f928390-7988-11ea-8922-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3026a8b8-7988-11ea-8464-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3037551e-7988-11ea-98f7-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2f483420-7988-11ea-973c-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2e5bd53a-7988-11ea-98f7-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2f0550e2-7988-11ea-8464-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/302f1868-7988-11ea-b3f7-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2f27c604-7988-11ea-8078-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2e724e0a-7988-11ea-af68-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]


[h2][b]Tactics[/b][/h2]
Don't jump straight into capturing a Key Area at the very beginning of the battle! Your ship's relatively small HP pool combined with the lack of Smoke Generator will make you an easy target for the enemy team.

Take advantage of your good concealment and your main weapon—fast torpedoes. Help your team detect enemy ships, and carry out surprise attacks.

Keep in mind that your torpedoes’ excellent range and speed, as well as their fast reload time, are compensated for by their low damage. You may need to conduct several attacks in order to destroy a battleship.

Towards the end of a battle, rush to capture Key Areas.

The ships’ good artillery and access to the [b]Repair Party[/b] consumable will help if you get into any brawls with your opponents. However, you would be well-advised to avoid engaging several ships at once.

It's usually wise to stay closer to your allies when you come under attack from enemy aircraft, but that's not the case for European destroyers! The ships’ good AA defenses, together with [b]Defensive AA Fire[/b] when playing ships of Tier VIII and above, will allow you to effectively fend off any enemy squadrons.

[h2][b]Commander Skills and Upgrades[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]For a Commander with 10 skill points we recommend:[/b][/h3]
[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/MeticulousPreventionModifier_bdab0122be3f41c4449309fd653987c254326c92a894bde26c7712be3b454e44.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/LastChanceModifier_08c69996db12c0caa1dacc5aa9c2c9dc1139371a3248c9d0c98a79822ec3b103.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/SuperintendentModifier_377444942b28914f815944fd2a86e21a23387d4b743827a79ac2813d8011282a.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/VisibilityModifier_59d3bb84996e8f66039e6103dd58dccad99fa0c607b3e3375afcfc35fbb9fe71.png[/img]
[list][*]Preventive Maintenance 
[*]Adrenaline Rush
[*]Superintendent
[*]Concealment Expert[/list]
[h3][b]For a Commander with 19 skill points we recommend:[/b][/h3]
[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/SurvivalModifier_ed5be93ece41dcbe30b65408b8437ac3c7313a11c9cf6f573a95a1d79c1f3a3d.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/TorpedoReloadModifier_0b00165b8ec1673c40d9b9a97b8f10afccd77fef8d35f1962959289a3bddf408.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/LastEffortModifier_df0ca0625c66be31566cb59352647b0a7a6347d8b6042eb4344bb5c1d208c129.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/crew_commander/perks/PriorityTargetModifier_ffcc52036d210f6f22c4ea7ad44db3baf8ec256b54f5a471c3b342e852599a59.png[/img]
[list][*]Survivability Expert
[*]Torpedo Armament Expertise

[h3][b]The following upgrades will be useful:[/b][/h3]
[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/modernization/icon_modernization_PCM030_MainWeapon_Mod_I_96030a0457a0354806c48d85ce6676be5f6497b87f22bcb3e2ebb61e2d072914.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/modernization/icon_modernization_PCM069_Movement_Mod_I_bb4cf51f510df3fff7c12b47d360f7ec1657443a32adbcdf8fe3a84cb8d5868c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/modernization/icon_modernization_PCM070_Torpedo_Mod_IV_1942d142eb0821e76a2961dc1f0b8dd80e9397c62a8fd137f23ecebea5bd5156.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/modernization/icon_modernization_PCM024_Engine_Mod_II_202d90f14ead1f1ebd586ec32d5e84466b8c1a488a228557987ae726a29021d0.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/modernization/icon_modernization_PCM027_ConcealmentMeasures_Mod_I_7367fbd25992d8b50a7587f1728cdd52f53687cfca44ef1c5933c517a2697182.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/modernization/icon_modernization_PCM014_Torpedo_Mod_III_3dfb15f689f13919bfe1adbb558188f6271a3038a12e9c272b4cda92983815b4.png[/img]

If there are problems with downloading or launching the update—please [url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=2037-QEUH-3335]perform files integrity check[/url].

[table][tr][th][b]European Destroyers: Part 2 ● The Strong-Willed Campaign ● Random Bundles ● Daily Shipments ● Clan Battles. Warrior's Path ● Ranked Sprint ● Interface Changes in Port ● Matchmaking Improvements ● Armory ● Other Changes[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]European Destroyers: Part 2[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/64f8bdb2-7819-11ea-891f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The new line of European destroyers is now available for all players to research.

[h3][b]Features of the new Tech Tree branch[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Long-range, high-speed torpedoes that deal relatively small damage. They can be set to fan out in two spreads: narrow and super-narrow spread.
[*]Ships of Tier VII and higher are equipped with rapid-firing main battery guns that are effective at short ranges.
[*]Good AA defenses with a solid reach.
[*]Destroyers from Tier VIII and above are equipped with the Defensive AA Fire consumable.
[*]Lack of the Smoke Generator is compensated for by decent concealment.
[*]Destroyers of Tier V and above have the Repair Party consumable at their disposal.[/list]
[h2][b]The Strong-Willed Campaign[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/a07f6214-7819-11ea-90b3-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The new game event is presided over by the new "Strong-Willed" temporary Campaign.

The Campaign comprises five missions, the first of which will become available with the release of Update 0.9.3. Access to the subsequent missions will be unlocked each week.

[b]Please note:[/b] you can complete the tasks of each mission multiple times. This will allow you to continue earning Stars with each completion, but you'll only receive the reward after completing the task for the first time.

The Campaign will be available for 6 months.
[list][b]The reward for finishing the Campaign[/b] is a new unique historical Commander, [b]Jerzy Świrski[/b], with 10 skill points and a specialization for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_6c2bac10ec2bec5799e117af8aa6298d1647a6b0d3ae7ea9b78983e78d13e14e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_874a3bdc3134b8da4fd6f52186f1b2b682f13ef78688732d3016785c0649a424.png[/img][b]I Gryf[/b][/b].[/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/03f99736-783f-11ea-acd4-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The new Commander has the following talents:
[list][*][b]Torpedo Reload Expert[/b]: reduces the torpedo tube reload time by 5% for every eight "Torpedo hits" ribbons scored. The talent can be activated multiple times.
[*][b]AA Gun Aiming Expert:[/b] increases the continuous damage of AA defenses by 10% for scoring 20 "Aircraft shot down" ribbons. This talent can be activated only once per battle.[/list]
[b]Jerzy Świrski[/b] also has an improved skill:
[list][*][b]Adrenaline Rush[/b]: +0.25% (instead of +0.2%) to the reload speed of the ship's armament and squadron speed for each 1% of HP lost.[/list]
[list][i]Half a year after the end of the Campaign, we plan to make Jerzy Świrski available in exchange for Coal in the Armory. Thus, you'll be able to get this Commander at a later date, even if you don't manage to finish the Strong-Willed Campaign.[/i][/list]
[h2][b]Random Bundles[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/ced65a5a-7819-11ea-a7fd-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The European Navy 2 section of the Armory has been complemented with random bundles. Each bundle can be obtained in exchange for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]500[/b] doubloons.

[b]Bundles contain[/b]: expendable camouflage patterns, signals, Coal, Free XP, and Elite Commander XP. They also hold unique historical Commander Jerzy Świrski with 14 skill points, and European Commander Grzegorz Brzęczyszczykiewicz.

[h3][b]List of Bundles[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1ec7c02e-789e-11ea-b29f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]If you already have Jerzy Świrski, you'll get compensation in the form of [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]7,500[/b] doubloons upon obtaining the Commander again.[/i][/list]
[h2][b]Daily Shipments[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/4a9b8b22-789e-11ea-b8f5-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

During Update 0.9.3, enter the game in the period between April 9 and 30, inclusive, and start getting valuable rewards in the Daily Shipments section.

You can get a total of 10 rewards, while the shipments are available for 14 days. Thus, you can skip 4 days out of 2 weeks and still claim all the valuable rewards.

[h2][b]Clan Battles. Warrior's Path[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/1a5fc114-781a-11ea-b3c8-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Wed. 15 Apr. 13:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Mon. 08 Jun. 05:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[b]Format[/b]: 7 vs. 7, playing Tier X ships of any type.

[b]Rewards:[/b] up to [b]11,000[/b] Steel and many additional rewards.

[b]Maps:[/b] Land of Fire, North, Northern Waters, Haven, Tears of the Desert, Crash Zone Alpha, and Warrior's Path. No cyclones will appear on maps in the current Season.

[h3][b]Season Features[/b][/h3]
With aircraft carriers now being able to take part in Clan Battles, we've introduced a new restriction for the current season: a Clan must make a choice between entering a battle with one aircraft carrier or one battleship.

We realize that the presence of carriers has the potential to greatly affect the gameplay of Clan Battles. We'll watch the results of the season closely and make decisions about the further development of this battle type based on our findings.
[list][b]Please note: during the current Season, in contrast to previous seasons, there will be no discount on resetting Commander skills. This was necessary at the start of previous Clan Battle seasons because players often needed to change some of their Commanders' skills due to the fact that aircraft carriers weren't allowed in Clan battles.[/b][/list]
[h2][b]Ranked Sprint[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3503ce0c-781a-11ea-891f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Wed. 29 Apr. 11:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Mon. 11 May 10:30 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[b]Format[/b]: 12 vs. 12, playing Tier IX–X ships

[b]Mode[/b]: Arms Race

[h2][b]Interface Changes in Port[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/6ab741a0-781a-11ea-b1e2-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The restriction on the number of special and economic signals that can be mounted on a ship has been removed. You'll be able to mount up to eight combat signals, and any number of economic and special signals, simultaneously.

[h3][b]Changes to the Exterior Tab[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Mounting, demounting, or purchasing exterior elements; changing a ship's color scheme; and linking exterior elements to a ship now requires a single left-click on the corresponding element.
[*]The ability to mount/demount all economic and special signals with a single left-click has been added.
[*]The ability to instantly mount/demount all recommended (i.e. the most effective for a particular ship) combat signals has been added.
[*]The tooltips for signals, flags, and camouflages have been updated.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5e2e82da-7843-11ea-acd4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

The Tech Tree now has tooltips describing features of the ship groups in each branch—by clicking them, you’ll open a window with a detailed description.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/a4abf6e8-7843-11ea-9ca2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b6145f9c-7843-11ea-bf1e-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/91d66ac6-7843-11ea-9ca2-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/c6b38c2e-7843-11ea-9bfe-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][u]Matchmaking Improvements[/u][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/a9842740-781a-11ea-b1e2-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The changes that have been made to the matchmaker in Update 0.9.3 will provide more possibilities for effectively playing low-tier ships against high-tier ships, and also reduce the number of cases where players would find themselves with the only Tier VIII ship in a battle composed of Tier X ships, for example.

Apart from that, the number of battles with two aircraft carriers per team will be considerably reduced, while battles with three carriers per team will never occur.

[h3][b]List of changes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]For Tier VII–X battles, we've placed a limit on the minimum number of ships two tiers lower than the battle tier.
[*]We’ve placed a limit on the maximum number of ships whose tier corresponds to the battle tier, with the exception of battles where all ships are of the same tier.
[*]We’ve updated the settings that restrict the number of ships of a specific type in a battle.[/list]
For example: in Tier X battles, the team will consist of at least 3 ships of Tier VIII (if such ships are waiting in the queue), and not more than 5 ships of Tier X, provided that the matchmaker's queue has a normal number of players waiting. The number of destroyers and battleships in the team will not exceed 4 and 5 ships of each type, respectively.

For each battle tier, several sets of settings will be used that will replace each other, depending on the waiting time in the queue—the longer the battle waiting time, the softer the restrictions. The new settings will allow us to avoid a significant increase in waiting times if there aren't many people looking to play a battle in a particular moment, and at the same time, still assemble battles with the most efficient team rosters possible.

[h2][b]Armory[/b][/h2]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c72c3f3a-781f-11ea-a9e9-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Unique Upgrades[/h2]
On April 17, the Research Bureau will be complemented with unique upgrades for the following warships: [b]X Des Moines[/b], [b]X Worcester[/b], [b]X Gearing[/b], [b]X Montana[/b], [b]X Zaō[/b], [b]X Shimakaze[/b], [b]X Yamato[/b], [b]X Hindenburg[/b], [b]X Z-52[/b], [b]X Großer Kurfürst[/b], [b]X Moskva[/b], [b]X Khabarovsk[/b], [b]X Grozovoi[/b], [b]X Minotaur[/b], [b]X Conqueror[/b], [b]X Henri IV[/b], [b]X République[/b], and [b]X Yueyang[/b]. The cost of each upgrade is [b]19,200[/b] Research Points.

[list][i]Please note: we plan to change the unique upgrades in Update 0.9.5.[/i][/list]
[h2]Ships[/h2]
Warships [b][b]V Marblehead[/b][/b], [b][b]VI Anshan[/b][/b], and [b][b]X Marceau[/b][/b] have been added to the Ships for Resources section, where they are now exchangeable for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]34,000[/b]; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]40,000[/b]; and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]236,000[/b] Coal respectively.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/ffe93726-78b3-11ea-8d98-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]

[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Marceau[/b][/b] is a design variant of a "3,000-ton scout ship" that was developed in France at the beginning of World War II. She carries dual-purpose guns of a post-war design. In World of Warships, she boasts a high speed and rapid-firing artillery, as well as good AA defenses.

[b]Key features:[/b]
[list][*]Eight 127 mm guns in four turrets with a reload time of 3.5 seconds and 180-degree traverse time of just 6 seconds.
[*]Four triple-tube 550 mm torpedo launchers. The launchers are notable for having wide aiming angles, but her torpedoes are not as powerful as those of some other Tier X destroyers.
[*]Her high standard speed of 44 knots can be increased by 20% with the Engine Boost consumable activated—it pushes her speed above 52 knots.
[*]The AA defenses she carries are already decent for her ship type, but they can be further reinforced by placing the Defensive AA Fire consumable in a separate slot.
[*]Like most French destroyers, [b][b]X Marceau[/b][/b] isn't equipped with Smoke Generator. Her detectability is also higher than average for a ship of her type—8.6 km with her permanent camouflage mounted, but without upgrades and Commander skills taken into account.[/list]
[list][b]Effective as of the release of Update 0.9.3, the following ships will no longer be available in the Armory: [b][b]X Smolensk[/b][/b], [b][b]IX Jean Bart[/b][/b], [b][b]IX Neustrashimy[/b][/b], [b][b]VII Flint[/b][/b], and [b][b]IX Black[/b][/b]. Jean Bart will also be removed from the Premium Shop.[/b][/list]

[b][b]X Smolensk[/b][/b] and [b][b]IX Jean Bart[/b][/b] have become very popular for their tiers. So, in order to maintain the proper level of diversity in teams in terms of the ships they are comprised of, these ships will no longer be available to obtain for an undefined period of time.

For a number of reasons, [b][b]IX Neustrashimy[/b][/b], [b][b]VII Flint[/b][/b], and [b][b]IX Black[/b][/b] aren't currently highly sought after in exchange for Steel. Because of this, we'll temporarily remove them from the Armory. They will return and be available in exchange for Coal in 6 months' time or later.
[list]In late April, [b][b]VIII Orkan[/b][/b] will become obtainable in exchange for doubloons in the Armory. You'll be able to play this ship to complete the tasks of the Strong-Willed Campaign, which are designed specifically for the European destroyers. Stay tuned for more news![/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/32c7a54c-78b4-11ea-99b5-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
Check under the spoiler for more information on balance-related changes, content changes, and additions, as well as other improvements.

[h1][i][h3][b]Game Balance Changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/1d9274a2-7820-11ea-a74f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

In Update 0.9.3, we've made changes to the parameters of certain ships based on our analysis of their battle efficiency and feedback from players. Such changes were required in order to carefully adjust the balance of selected warships. Further changes may follow in future updates, should they be required.

[h3][b]Tier III Soviet cruiser Aurora[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Gun traverse speed has been increased from 5.1 to 5.3 deg/s.[/list]
[h3][b]Tier III British destroyer Valkyrie[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time has been increased from 5.2 to 5.4 seconds.
[*]Torpedo tube reload time has been increased from 43 to 45 seconds.[/list]
[h3][b]Tier IV British battleship Orion[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery's standard firing range has been reduced from 14.7 to 14.4 km.[/list]
[h3][b]Tier V British cruiser Hawkins[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time has been reduced from 14 to 13.5 seconds.
[*]Horizontal aiming angles of the main battery guns have been increased:
[list][*]By 32 degrees (for short distances) for the first turret.
[*]By 2 degrees for the second turret.
[*]By 5 degrees for the third and fourth turrets.
[*]By 36 degrees (for long distances) for the sixth turret.[/list]
[/list]
[h3][b]Tier VII U.S. cruiser Atlanta[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time has been reduced from 4.9 to 4.8 seconds.[/list]
[h3][b]Tier IX British destroyer Jutland[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time has been increased from 4.1 to 4.2 seconds.
[*]Torpedo tube reload time has been increased from 122 to 124 seconds.[/list]
[h3][b]Tier X British destroyer Daring[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time has been increased from 2.6 to 2.7 seconds.
[*]Torpedo tube reload time has been increased from 122 to 124 seconds.[/list]
[h3][b]Tier X Japanese aircraft carrier Hakuryū[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Maximum damage caused by a rocket has been reduced from 3,350 to 3,250.
[*]Chances of fire being caused by a rocket have been reduced from 15% to 14%.[/list]
[h3][b]Tier X French cruiser Colbert[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time has been reduced from 3.5 to 3.4 seconds.
[*]The amount of HP restored by the Repair Party consumable has been increased from +0.5% to +0.66% of the total HP pool per second.[/list]
[h3][b]Tier X Soviet battleship Kremlin[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Continuous damage caused by AA mounts has been reduced from 433 to 412.
[*]The number of AA explosions has been reduced from 10 to 9.
[*]Damage within the explosion radius has been reduced from 1,820 to 1,750.[/list]
[h3][b]Tier VI U.S. cruiser Pensacola[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The armor thickness of the ship's ends has been increased from 16 mm to 25 mm.[/list]
[h3][b]Tier VII U.S. cruiser New Orleans[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The armor thickness of the ship's ends has been increased from 16 mm to 25 mm.[/list]
[h3][b]Tier VII German cruiser Yorck[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The armor thickness of the ship's ends has been increased from 16 mm to 25 mm.[/list]
[h3][b]Aviation[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The spotting range for all aircraft has been reduced from 18 km to 17 km.[/list]

[h1][i][h3][b]Content Additions and Changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/46bb2220-7820-11ea-a9e9-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

The stock torpedo modules of European Tier V–IX researchable destroyers have become researcheable torpedo modules. The parameters of the new stock torpedo module are similar to those of the researchable torpedo module of the destroyer from the previous tier.

If you already have one of these European destroyers in your Port, a researchable torpedo module will already be mounted on this ship, while the stock torpedo module will be placed in the Inventory.

The Victory Day patch and permanent camouflage patterns have been added for the following ships:  [b]VIII Alabama[/b], [b]V Texas[/b], [b]VII New Orleans[/b], [b]VII Duke of York[/b], [b]VIII Implacable[/b], [b]VI Aigle[/b], [b]VII Minsk[/b], and [b]V Oktyabrskaya Revolutsiya[/b]. Details on how to get these items will be announced later.

Operation Narai has returned to the rotation, with a technical error in the auto-pilot system of the bot ships having been fixed.

The following ships have been added for testing by developers, volunteers, and community contributors: [b]VIII Asama[/b], [b]VIII Impero[/b], [b]VIII Champagne[/b], [b]IX Zarya Svobody[/b], [b]X F.D. Roosevelt[/b], [b]V Mikoyan[/b], and [b]V Kotovsky[/b].

[h1][i][h3][b]Changes to Economics of Operations[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/6b5ea976-7820-11ea-a74f-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]As of now, completing an Operation with an incomplete team doesn't provide any economic advantages.
[*]The amount of XP and credits you receive when playing Tier VI ships in Operations has been increased for any Operations completed with 0–3 Stars, and has been reduced for Operations completed with 4–5 Stars.
[*]Similar changes have been made to Operation Narai in terms of the XP you receive, but the amount of credits you receive has been reduced for completing it with any number of Stars.[/list]
These changes are intended to balance the amount of XP and credits that Operations can bring in comparison to other battle types, taking into account the difficulty level of Operations.

[h1][i][h3][b]Other Changes and Improvements[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/732c344c-7821-11ea-8c4c-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list][*]The rewards of the combat missions whose main prizes are unique upgrades have been changed by replacing the consumables with [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]1,125,000[/b] credits—an amount that's equal to the cost of the 50 consumables that the reward used to include.
[*]Minor changes have been made to the textures and models of the following ships: [b]VIII Cheshire[/b], [b]VII Sinop[/b], [b]IV Alberto di Giussano[/b], [b]VI Duca d'Aosta[/b], [b]VII Duca degli Abruzzi[/b], [b]V Visby[/b], [b]X Venezia[/b], [b]V Oktyabrskaya Revolutsiya[/b], [b]IV Hermes[/b], [b]III Knyaz Suvorov[/b], [b]X Kremlin[/b], [b]VIII Baltimore[/b], [b]IX Buffalo[/b], [b]VI La Galissonnière[/b], [b]VII Vauquelin[/b], [b]X Kléber[/b], [b]VII Yūdachi[/b], [b]V Hill[/b], [b]X Somers[/b], [b]X Colbert[/b], [b]IX Georgia[/b], [b]VI Anshan[/b], [b]VI Huanghe[/b], [b]VIII Irian[/b], [b]VIII Öland[/b], [b]X Småland[/b], [b]X Halland[/b], [b]IV Bourrasque[/b], [b]VI Devonshire[/b], [b]IX Bajie[/b], [b]X Henri IV[/b], [b]VIII Wukong[/b], [b]V Raimondo Montecuccoli[/b], [b]IX Izumo[/b], and [b]V ARP Kongō[/b].
[*]The aircraft carrier's spawn point on the Neighbors map has been changed in order to eliminate cases where carriers would collide with the shore when they started moving.
[*]Fixed an error where the enemy squadron's HP bar was not shown to players.
[*]Fixed an error where the bot ships failed to reach their destination points in Operations.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the ship's consumable reload time to be displayed incorrectly after a player received a buff in the Arms Race mode.
[*]Fixed an error that incorrectly added information about shot-down allied aircraft in the post-battle statistics.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the icon of a squadron from aircraft carrier Raptor to remain in place after the squadron had taken off.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the firing ranges of [b]VIII Cheshire[/b] and [b]VIII Albemarle[/b]'s secondary batteries to be incorrect. The firing range of the secondary battery has been increased from 3 to 5 km.
[*]Fixed an error that caused the detectability range to be incorrectly calculated after the main battery guns were fired for the following ships: [b]X Ohio[/b], [b]IX Lion[/b], [b]X Conqueror[/b], [b]IV Wakeful[/b], [b]IX Friedrich der Große[/b], [b]X Großer Kurfürst[/b], [b]VII Leberecht Maass[/b], [b]IX Z-46[/b], [b]VI Fusō[/b], [b]IX Azuma[/b], and [b]X Yoshino[/b].[/list]

notes.title: Clan Brawl
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/2e323a18d0e3218b98d31a52d94eef13c966e846.jpg[/img]
[b]The new Clan Brawl will take place on April 4. Don't miss this perfect opportunity to replenish your Clan's Treasury and fight for credits, Coal, and Steel![/b]

[table][tr][th][b]Rules ● Rewards[/b][/th][/tr][/table] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/53cbc254-7423-11ea-b1fb-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/cvc-7/#clan-brawl]What is a Clan Brawl? >>>[/url]

[h2][b]Rules[/b][/h2]
[b]Date:[/b] April 4

Battles will be fought playing Tier VIII ships in a 4 vs. 4 format (one ship of each type per team)

[b]Prime Times:[/b]
[list][*][b]CIS[/b] 15:00 — 20:00 UTC
[*][b]EU[/b] 17:00 — 22:00 UTC
[*][b]ASIA[/b] 11:00 — 16:00 UTC
[*][b]NA[/b] 00:00 — 05:00 UTC [i](on the following day)[/i][/list]
[list][i]Please note: once you play a battle, you will not be able to change the selected prime time in the current Clan Brawl. Unlike Clan Battles, a Clan's place in the Brawl’s Rating is determined for the battle region—the region of the selected prime time.[/i][/list]
[b]Rewards:[/b] up to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]2,500,000[/b] credits; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]3,500[/b] Coal; and [b]350[/b] Steel

[b]Mode:[/b] Domination

[b]Battle duration: [/b]15 minutes

[h3][b]Maps[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Hotspot, Shatter, Trident, and Northern Waters—all with reduced combat areas
[*]Big Race—with the standard map size: 30x30 km[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9fabc620-7422-11ea-b95f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/87e23cb8-7422-11ea-b4f8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/7005e630-7422-11ea-b4f8-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bcd10c1a-7422-11ea-9df4-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d964de1a-7422-11ea-b95f-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]


[h1][i][h3][b]Regulations[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[list][*]There are no limits on the number of teams participating from a single Clan, but the composition of the teams must conform to the aforementioned conditions.
[*]Only victories are counted towards the Rating.
[*]Since only victories are counted and defeats aren't taken into account, there’s no option to select Alpha or Bravo Ratings in the Clan Brawl.
[*]Victories in the Clan Brawl aren’t counted towards the requirements to receive Clan Battle emblems.
[*]If two teams have the same number of victories, the higher position in the Rating will be given to the Clan that played the last winning battle earlier.[/list]
[h2][b]Rewards[/b][/h2] [img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/3667abca-7422-11ea-acaf-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
More details on the rewards will be available in the game client.

[h3][b]For achieving high positions in the final Rating, Clans will receive resources for their Treasuries.[/b][/h3] [table][tr][th][b]Position[/b][/th][th][b]Coal[/b][/th][/tr] [tr][td]1[/td] [td]25,000[/td][/tr] [tr][td]2[/td] [td]22,500[/td][/tr] [tr][td]3[/td] [td]20,000[/td][/tr] [tr][td]4[/td] [td]17,500[/td][/tr] [tr][td]5–50[b]*[/b][/td] [td]16,250–5,000[/td][/tr][/table]

[b]We wish you the best of luck in the Clan Brawls! See you in battle![/b]

notes.title: Cap Takes Control of World of Warships — All Hail Cap!
notes.content:
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/all-hail-cap/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f150b3173f918b82e08cad045d39232a2b3ec5f0.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]What happened was always going to happen sooner or later—Cap, the protagonist of the Bad Advice and Naval Traditions series of educational videos, has taken over World of Warships![/b]

Having a narcissistic personality, the first decision that our “luckiest” of Captains made was, of course, to devote the April Fool's Day celebration to himself. So what has he prepared?
[list][*]A new Naval Traditions episode.
[*]A themed almanac collection exploring the adventures of Cap and Fishy, with Commander Cap himself, a commemorative flag, a patch, and an achievement as the main rewards.
[*]Twenty-three episodes of the Bad Advice and Naval Traditions animated series, carefully gathered in one playlist so that Cap's fans can watch his "films" in one go, every day.
[*]A YouTube activity where every subscriber can give a high five to Cap and complete the collection in record time without any effort![/list]
He'll start with a new episode of Naval Traditions, which will tell you about the lives of the most mysterious seamen of all—submariners!

[table][tr][th][b]Collection ● High Five Cap![/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[previewyoutube=pMcv9YCI2QY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Collection[/b][/h2]
Get the popcorn, guys! A new themed collection—"Bad Advice: Behind the Scenes"—has arrived in the game! Learn the exciting story about the courageous and high-spirited Captain who has sent so many ships with a firm hand to... their doom.

He never gave up. On the contrary, he rushed into battle again and again, even after suffering the most crushing defeats. We're pleased to present you with some short extracts from his extensive biography that couldn't fit into the animated series!

The new collection comprises 23 elements, divided into four sections. By clicking on the collected elements, you can watch episodes of the Bad Advice and Naval Traditions series.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/34f5f51a-736b-11ea-a272-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/5725efb4-736b-11ea-b18b-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/6afbe750-736b-11ea-ab34-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/802bc4a6-736b-11ea-8ddf-8cdcd4b147d4_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b]Reward for completing the first and the second sections: [/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]1 day of Premium Account[/b] for each section.
[*][b]Reward for completing the third section:[/b] 1x "Type 3 — New Year" camouflage, 1x Frosty Fir Tree camouflage, 1x "Type 3 — Halloween" camouflage, and 1x Halloween camouflage.
[*][b]Reward for completing the fourth section: [/b]4x Dragon special signals.[/list]
[b]Completing the entire collection[/b] will reward you with Commander Cap with a unique voiceover, a commemorative flag, a patch, and an achievement. You can assign Cap to British ships.
[list][i]The elements of the collection can be obtained from "Bad Advice: Behind the Scenes" containers, as well as daily containers if you've activated the subscription. Duplicates will be exchanged at a rate of 1:1.[/i][/list]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/d984fea2-7341-11ea-8f9d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]
[list]Completing the collection is voluntary! If you decide to complete it, click the button below or use a special bonus code from the episodes in the [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLVmXzlhZvJVRtnGGbzh5DbvssHizkGqEY]playlist[/url]![/list] [b]Collect[/b]
[table][tr][th][h2]Asia[/h2][/th][th][url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/general-news/all-hail-cap/]https://worldofwarships.asia/news/general-news/all-hail-cap/[/url][/th][/tr][tr][th][h2]CIS(Ru)[/h2][/th][th][url=https://worldofwarships.ru/news/general-news/all-hail-cap/]https://worldofwarships.ru/news/general-news/all-hail-cap/[/url][/th][/tr][tr][th][h2]EU[/h2][/th][th][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/all-hail-cap/]https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/all-hail-cap/[/url][/th][/tr][tr][th][h2]NA[/h2][/th][th][url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/general-news/all-hail-cap/]https://worldofwarships.com/news/general-news/all-hail-cap/[/url][/th][/tr][/table]
For Steam version the easiest way is through in-game news: [olist][*]Launch the game and click your nickname in the upper left corner of the Port [*]Click "News", find this news article, open it [*]Now just find an orange button in the text and click it[/olist]
Upon clicking the button, you'll get a special combat mission which, when completed, will reward you with a collection container.
[table][tr][th][b]Combat Mission: April Fools' Day[/b][/th][/tr] [tr][td]
Sink an enemy ship in battle.[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/tmb/f720a3ce-733e-11ea-807a-8cdcd4b147d4_330x.png[/img]

[b]Reward:[/b] 1x container of the "Bad Advice: Behind the Scenes" collection
[b]Ship restrictions:[/b] Tier V–X
[b]Battle type restrictions:[/b] Operations, Random, and Co-op Battles
[list][i]You can complete this combat mission 23 times[b].[/b][/i][/list]
[/td][/tr][/table]
[h2][b]High Five Cap![/b][/h2]
Do you want to complete the collection as quickly as possible and without much effort? We have just the solution!
[previewyoutube=wXpniZN3VEg;full][/previewyoutube]
Cap sends a storm warning for all seamen—a new activity is starting on our YouTube channel!

[b]Prize fund:[/b] 550,000 containers of the "Bad Advice: Behind the Scenes" collection

The conditions are simple: you just have to high five Cap by giving a like to each episode from the playlist below. For each [b][i][/i] 5,000[/b] likes, Cap will provide a bonus code with a container of the "Bad Advice: Behind the Scenes" collection.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Wed. 01 Apr. 09:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Wed. 08 Apr. 09:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

[h3][b]Rules[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Subscribe to the channel if you haven't done so yet, as Cap needs more subscribers!
[*]Like each episode of the Bad Advice and Naval Traditions series from the playlist below.
[*]Every day at 8:00 (UTC), Cap will check out how many "fives" he has, and then give out bonus codes for the collection containers accordingly.
[*]The number of activations for each code is limited. One player = one container via a code. Cap will give out a bonus code with 10,000 collection containers for [b][i][/i] 5,000[/b] likes under one video; 20,000 containers for the next two videos; and so on. Take a look at the diagram below for a clear demonstration! For the last—ninth—bonus code, Cap will deliver as many as 90,000 containers to the channel. But for him to do this, you'll have to give another [b][i][/i] 5,000[/b] likes to just one video—the new episode of Naval Traditions.
[*]If players don't manage to reach that number, Cap will still publish a consolation bonus code on April 8!
[*]But wait, that's not all! If players manage to high five Cap enough times under all the videos from the playlist, and the official channel gets [b][i][/i] 5,000[/b] new subscribers by April 8, Cap will publish a bonus code for 100,000 containers![/list]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/user/worldofwarshipscom?sub_confirmation=1][i][/i] Subscribe to the Channel[/url]
[img]https://wows-wowsp-global.gcdn.co/media/ceph-image/c832613e-736a-11ea-bd3d-8cdcd4b147d4.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Armory[/b][/h2]
[h2]Veterans of Naval Battles[/h2]
Random bundles for doubloons. You will get one Premium Tier VIII–IX ship for rent from each bundle, with the possible rentals including rare Tier IX ships [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Missouri[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Musashi[/b][/b], or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]IX Kronshtadt[/b][/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Bundles will be available until:[/b] [b]Wed. 15 Apr. 07:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/b]

Random bundles for credits. You will get one Tier VI–VIII Premium ship for rent from each bundle. Try some of the ships in battle that you might have been thinking about buying!

notes.title: How It Works: Spotting and Detectability System 2.0
notes.content:
[url=https://youtu.be/OgRUSmzcw2s][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/41e7ceff13545cbc479d494a011a5e84be939d0a.png[/img][/url]
[b]There have been many changes in the game since the moment we released the series of “How It Works” episodes in which we talked about the spotting and detectability system. We’ve revised the old episodes in order to keep all the information up to date with the reality of the current game version, and have also combined them into one longer episode.[/b]

How do ships spot one another? What’s the difference between detectability range and spotting range? How is it possible for a ship to fire at an enemy without being detected? Learn answers to these questions and more, in the new episode of the most practical series on our channel!

[b]Dear Captains,[/b]

We know that many of you have been impacted by the outbreak of COVID-19, and have likely implemented social distancing or self-quarantine procedures to minimize the risks for you and your families. We urge everyone to stay safe and to follow any guidelines issued by your local officials.

We’ve also been adapting to the situation over the last few days—our staff have been switching to fully remote work wherever possible in order to ensure the highest levels of health and safety for the teams.

While we’re adapting to these new and unusual conditions, we’re also working hard to keep the game running. However, we apologize in advance for any inconveniences that you may encounter in the coming weeks due to the situation.

[list]Any player choosing to spend part of this time playing World of Warships will be able to claim 14 days of World of Warships Premium Account for free. Get yours by clicking the button below.[/list]

notes.title: Naval Legends: Destroyer HSwMS Småland
notes.content:
[url=https://youtu.be/1cgxiP1Rrhw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e1ccbe59c66300302dde2a575eeddb888190d7c2.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]Today finds the Swedish Royal Navy destroyer permanently berthed in Gothenburg, where she serves as a museum ship.[/b]

The Halland-class destroyers were built after World War II, and were the first ships to be equipped with anti-ship missiles. These destroyers were the largest and most complex in the history of the Swedish Navy.

What was HSwMS Småland’s story? Watch our video to find out!

Destroyer HSwMS Småland is one of the few ships in our game to have survived until the present day. [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_6c2bac10ec2bec5799e117af8aa6298d1647a6b0d3ae7ea9b78983e78d13e14e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Småland[/b][/b] is available in the Tech Tree for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]2,000,000[/b] Free XP.
