[h2]European Destroyers[/h2]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/9e4639a6-62b5-11ea-95ac-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]

Tier V–IX European destroyers hit the high seas in Early Access!

[h3][b]Features of the new Tech Tree branch[/b][/h3]
Long-range torpedoes with high speeds are the hallmark features of the new branch. European destroyers carry rapid-firing main guns from Tier VII and, starting at Tier V, the Repair Party consumable. With their decent AA defenses and access to the Defensive AA Fire consumable at Tiers VIII–X, they can effectively fend off hostile aircraft.
[list][*]Their long-range, high-speed torpedoes deal relatively moderate damage. The torpedoes can be set to fan out in two spreads: narrow or super-narrow.
[*]Good AA defenses with a solid reach. Starting from Tier VIII, the European destroyers are equipped with the Defensive AA Fire consumable.
[*]Destroyers of Tier VII and above are equipped with rapid-firing main battery guns. They are efficient in close quarters combat, but less comfortable when exchanging fire over long distances because of their extended shell-hang time and short range of fire.
[*]While they are not equipped with Smoke Generator, they enjoy good concealment (just 6 km for Halland). Ships of Tier V and above have access to a variant of the Repair Party consumable that restores 1% of any lost HP per second, but has an action time of just 10 seconds. At Tiers VIII, IX, and X, the active duration of the consumable is 4 seconds longer.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b6c2b918-5fc8-11ea-892a-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b6b7e970-5fc8-11ea-948d-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b6badf4a-5fc8-11ea-bcc4-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b6a870da-5fc8-11ea-89f0-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b6bd22c8-5fc8-11ea-84e0-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]The entire branch of European destroyers will become available to research with the release of Update 0.9.3.[/i][/list]
To get European destroyers in Early Access, you can exchange a new resource—European Tokens—for bundles in the Armory that include [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_6c2bac10ec2bec5799e117af8aa6298d1647a6b0d3ae7ea9b78983e78d13e14e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]V Visby[/b], [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_6c2bac10ec2bec5799e117af8aa6298d1647a6b0d3ae7ea9b78983e78d13e14e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]VI Västerås[/b], [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_6c2bac10ec2bec5799e117af8aa6298d1647a6b0d3ae7ea9b78983e78d13e14e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]VII Skåne[/b], [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_6c2bac10ec2bec5799e117af8aa6298d1647a6b0d3ae7ea9b78983e78d13e14e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]VIII Öland[/b], and [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_6c2bac10ec2bec5799e117af8aa6298d1647a6b0d3ae7ea9b78983e78d13e14e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_357acc9fc0e2f7d98f047c99edffad359a8c45f2093024400fef2b9abbaf3a59.png[/img][b]IX Östergötland[/b].

You will find European Tokens in Europe containers, which in turn can be obtained by progressing through Directives or picked up from Daily Shipments. You can also receive up to ten additional containers for participating in official World of Warships streams. [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/general-news/stream-rewards/]Activate bonus codes and complete special combat missions to get them[/url].

The Tech Tree now features [img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_6c2bac10ec2bec5799e117af8aa6298d1647a6b0d3ae7ea9b78983e78d13e14e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Småland[/b]—available for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7cd25168780c111002edb566f3d9ce9a855c3bcf.png[/img][b]2,000,000[/b] Free XP. It's the first Tier X ship to be made available in exchange for this resource type.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b6c59516-5fc8-11ea-a113-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Europe_6c2bac10ec2bec5799e117af8aa6298d1647a6b0d3ae7ea9b78983e78d13e14e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/special_5d797363651721d76cdb3439cd23845b7efcb8af4c5c3f76cc41b2537b6fc415.png[/img][b]X Småland[/b] stands as one of the largest and strongest destroyers in the Swedish Navy. Just like her researchable European counterparts, Småland lacks Smoke Generator, but has access to Surveillance Radar, an efficient Engine Boost consumable, and Repair Party. She also has a rapid-firing main battery. Småland is a multi-purpose warship that can pose a real threat to Key Areas and is highly effective at chasing down hostile destroyers.

[h3][b]Key Features[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Four 120 mm main guns with a reload time of just 1.7 seconds.
[*]Eight torpedoes with a 12 km reach and speed of 76 knots, but with rather low maximum damage. The ship has one quintuple-tube and one triple-tube torpedo launcher to carry her torpedoes.
[*]The ship's unique Engine Boost consumable provides a 30% speed increase (by default: 8%), but operates for just 60 seconds. When activated, this consumable makes it possible for Småland to reach speeds of up to 45.5 knots.
[*]On Småland, the Defensive AA Fire consumable is replaced by Surveillance Radar. It has an action time of 20 seconds and is capable of detecting ships at distances of up to 7.5 km.[/list]
[h3][b]New Port[/b][/h3]
A new Port called Fjords is set to appear in the game. The Port's design is inspired by Scandinavian landscapes.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1aee37d6-62b8-11ea-a8f4-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1ad43804-62b8-11ea-8784-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1adbf152-62b8-11ea-b981-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b385334-62b8-11ea-a9db-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]New Emblems[/b][/h3]
European Fleet emblems are now available in the game. They can be obtained in the same way as the emblems of other nations, i.e. by winning a certain number of battles playing Tier VIII–X ships, and ranking among the top base XP earners on your team for those battles.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bb9f8c56-62b9-11ea-b731-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Three Crowns Camouflage[/b][/h3]
We've added a new permanent camouflage designated "Three Crowns" for [b][b]V Visby[/b], [b][b]VI Västerås[/b], [b][b]VII Skåne[/b], [b][b]VIII Öland[/b], [b][b]IX Östergötland[/b], [b][b]X Småland[/b], and destroyer [b][b]X Halland[/b] which will become available for research in Update 0.9.3. You can obtain the permanent camouflages by completing special combat missions.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bbfd7ed8-62b9-11ea-b981-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]

[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/game-updates/european-destroyers-early-access/]Read more>>>[/url]

[h2]Clan Brawl[/h2]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/9dbd55f0-62b5-11ea-814c-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]

[b]Date:[/b] 04/04/2020

[b]Prime times:[/b]
[list][*][b]CIS[/b] 15:00 — 20:00 UTC
[*][b]EU[/b] 17:00 — 22:00 UTC
[*][b]ASIA[/b] 11:00 — 16:00 UTC
[*][b]NA[/b] 0:00 — 05:00 UTC [i](on the next following day)[/i][/list]
[b]Format:[/b] Battles will involve Tier VIII ships in a 4 vs. 4 format.

[b]Restrictions:[/b] a maximum of one ship of each type per team.

[b]Rewards:[/b] up to [b]350[/b] Steel; [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]3,500[/b] Coal; and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]2,500,000[/b] credits

[b]Maps:[/b] Hotspot, Shatter, Trident, and Northern Waters with reduced action zones; and Big Race, with a standard map size of 30x30 km.
[list][i]More details will follow in a dedicated article.[/i][/list]
[h2]Changes to the Inertia Fuse for HE Shells Skill[/h2]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/9dd165ea-62b5-11ea-93a3-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Reasons behind the changes and their impact on your gameplay:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]To simplify interactions between same-tier cruisers. For example, HE shells fired by cruisers with 152–155 mm guns should be capable of penetrating the plating of same-type ships without the effects applied by any extra conditions. These changes are aimed at shifting the Inertia Fuse for HE Shells skill out of most players' first-choice set of skills.
[*]To improve the durability of cruisers in battle: changes to the thickness of cruiser plating will make these ships more resistant to battleship salvos if positioned wisely.
[*]To enhance the distinction between cruisers carrying guns with a caliber of, or exceeding, 190 mm, and cruisers with 149–189 mm guns, by changing their armor protection: the former will feature thicker armor for their central "box," while the latter will have thicker armor only for the central part of their decks.
[*]To keep the armor protection of battleships as it is: without the Inertia Fuse for HE Shells skill applied, cruisers with 152–155 mm guns will still be unable to penetrate the plating of same-tier battleships.
[*]We wanted to balance the Inertia Fuse for HE Shells skill in such a way that the combination of its positive and negative characteristics would influence players' choices, making the skill less of an ultimate "go-to" option when training Commanders.[/list]
[list][i]We'll keep a close eye on how these changes affect game balance and the battle performance of certain ships. If required, additional balance corrections will be applied to the skill and some ships to preserve their battle performance.[/i][/list]
[h3][b]Changes to the Inertia Fuse for HE Shells skill[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The bonus applied to the armor-penetration capabilities of HE shells has been changed from 30% to 25%.
[*]The skill will now reduce the chances of causing fire by half, instead of subtracting 1% or 3% from them, depending on the caliber. It is only the standard chances of a fire being caused by HE shells that are reduced by half. Other bonuses to the chances of causing fire will function as before, such as the bonuses provided by the Victor Lima signal or Demolition Expert skill.
[list][*][b]Example:[/b] the standard chances of a fire being caused by HE shells for cruiser Helena are 12%. With the Inertia Fuse for HE Shells skill mastered, the chances of causing fire are reduced to 6%. With the Demolition Expert skill, the chances increase to 8%.[/list]
[*]This skill previously provided a significant advantage with a minimal penalty, which made it too impactful. The updated version of the skill brings it more in line with the efficiency of other skills.[/list]
[b]The rules for calculating armor-penetration have been changed for all HE and SAP shells:[/b] a new rule—"a shell penetrates armor if the armor-thickness value is less than or equal to the shell-penetration value"—will now be applied instead of the old rule—"a shell penetrates armor if the armor-thickness value is strictly less than the shell-penetration value." For example, 152 mm shells fired from a Tier VII cruiser will be able to penetrate armor plating with a thickness of up to 25 mm, as opposed to the 24 mm it used to be.

[b]For Tier VIII–X cruisers carrying 152–155 mm guns[/b], the armor-penetration capabilities of their HE shells have been changed. Previously, they were calculated in accordance with the 1/6-caliber rule. Now, they will be calculated following the 1/5-caliber rule. When firing HE shells, these ships will be able to penetrate each other's armor plating, as well as the plating of Tier VIII–X cruisers that is up to 30 mm thick, without use of the Inertia Fuse for HE Shells skill.

[h3][b]Changes to cruiser and battleship armor protection[/b][/h3]
The changes to cruisers' plating will make these ships more resistant to fire from battleships when positioned wisely: AP shells will ricochet off the plating if they impact at a sharp angle (watch our How it Works video for more info how AP interacts with armor). Tier X cruisers already benefit from adopting proper positioning. At the same time, the central parts of the hulls and decks of cruisers carrying guns with a caliber of 190 mm or more now have thicker armor, while cruisers with guns of a smaller caliber have thicker armor only for the central parts of their decks. These changes emphasize the distinction between light and heavy cruisers.

Due to changes to the rules for calculating the armor penetration of HE and SAP shells, the armor plating of Tier VI–VII battleships has been changed to 26 mm in order to keep interactions between ship types consistent.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/95748220-62b9-11ea-986a-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/95742c3a-62b9-11ea-b981-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/9568cc0a-62b9-11ea-a9db-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2]Armory[/h2]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/9da17d80-62b5-11ea-b9c2-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]
[list][i]With the release of Update 0.9.2, all British Tokens will be converted to credits at a rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]4,500[/b].[/i][/list]
The cost of signals in the Research Bureau has been reduced by half. Now, experienced players can stock up on any missing signals, enabling them to focus on gathering the Research Points needed to get other rewards available via the Research Bureau.
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/bbfd64ca-62b9-11ea-a9db-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[h3][b]Game Balance Changes[/b][/h3]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/9dc9c326-62b5-11ea-b9c2-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]

In Update 0.9.2, we've made changes to the parameters of certain ships based on our analysis of their battle efficiency and feedback from players. Such changes were required in order to carefully adjust the balance of these warships. Further changes may follow, should they be required, in future updates.

[h3][b]The armor penetration values of the secondary battery guns on German ships were changed as follows:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The armor penetration of 105 mm secondary battery HE shells fired by [b]VII Yorck[/b], [b]VI Prinz Eitel Friedrich[/b], [b]VII Scharnhorst[/b], [b]VII Scharnhorst B[/b], [b]VII Gneisenau[/b], [b]VI Admiral Graf Spee[/b], and [b]VI HSF Admiral Graf Spee[/b] was increased from 18 to 26 mm.
This same change was applied in an earlier Update to the 105 mm secondary battery shells of [b]V König[/b], [b]VI Bayern[/b], [b]VIII Bismarck[/b], [b]VIII Tirpitz[/b], [b]VIII Graf Zeppelin[/b], [b]VIII Graf Zeppelin B[/b], [b]VIII Prinz Eugen[/b], [b]VIII Admiral Hipper[/b], [b]IX Roon[/b], and [b]X Hindenburg[/b].[/list]

[h3][b]Tier IV U.S. battleship Arkansas Beta:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Added access to the Ship Consumables Modification 1 upgrade.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier III Soviet cruiser Aurora:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Gun traverse speed increased from 5.0 to 5.1 deg/s.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier VII Soviet battleship Sinop:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery gun Sigma parameter reduced from 1.55 to 1.50.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier X Soviet battleship Kremlin:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery gun Sigma parameter reduced from 1.85 to 1.80.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier VII U.S. cruiser Atlanta:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time reduced from 5.0 to 4.9 seconds.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier VII U.S. cruiser Flint:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time reduced from 5.0 to 4.9 seconds.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier IX U.K. destroyer Jutland:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time increased from 4.0 to 4.1 seconds.
[*]Torpedo tube reload time increased from 120 to 122 seconds.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier X U.K. destroyer Daring:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time increased from 2.5 to 2.6 seconds.
[*]Torpedo tube reload time increased from 120 to 122 seconds.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier X Japanese aircraft carrier Hakuryū:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Damage from rockets launched by attack aircraft reduced from 3,350 to 3,250.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier X U.S. destroyer Gearing:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Researchable torpedo tube reload time reduced from 118 to 116 seconds.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier III U.K. destroyer Valkyrie:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Main battery reload time increased from 5.0 to 5.2 seconds.
[*]Torpedo tube reload time increased from 41 to 43 seconds.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier IV U.K. battleship Orion:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Stock firing range reduced from 15.18 to 14.7 kilometers.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier VIII Pan-Asian destroyer Hsienyang:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Researchable torpedo tube reload time reduced from 119 to 117 seconds.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier IX Pan-Asian destroyer Chung Mu:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Torpedo tube reload time reduced from 119 to 117 seconds.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier X Pan-Asian destroyer Yueyang:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Torpedo tube reload time reduced from 142 to 139 seconds.[/list]

[b]Tier VIII Italian cruiser Amalfi:[/b]
[list][*]The 37 mm/54 Breda 1932 anti-aircraft mounts on [b]VIII Amalfi[/b]'s Hull (A) front and rear main battery turrets were replaced with 20 mm/65 Breda 1935 mounts.
[*]The continuous damage dealt by the AA mounts on [b]VIII Amalfi[/b]'s Hull (A) was reduced from 277 to 259, while the action range of her medium-range AA defenses increased from 3.5 to 3.7 kilometers.[/list]

[h3][b]Aircraft:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The spotting range of aircraft carrier' squadrons, as well as that of fighters and spotting aircraft, was reduced from 19 to 18 kilometers (the spotting range being a parameter that determines the distance at which an aircraft can detect a hostile target).[/list]

[h3][b]The time interval between bomber attacks was changed:[/b][/h3]
The minimum time between attacks for bomber squadrons was increased depending on the specific aircraft carrier and its tier:
[list][*]U.S., German, and Japanese aircraft carriers:
[list][*]From 5 to 7.5 seconds at Tier IV
[*]From 5 to 8 seconds at Tier VI
[*]From 5 to 8.5 seconds at Tier VIII
[*]From 5 to 9 seconds at Tier X and for [b]VIII Saipan[/b][/list]

[*]U.K. aircraft carriers, except [b]VIII Indomitable[/b]:
[list][*]From 5 to 7 seconds at Tier IV and for [b]VI Ark Royal[/b]
[*]From 5 to 7.5 seconds at Tier VI
[*]From 5 to 8 seconds at Tier VIII
[*]From 5 to 8.5 seconds at Tier X[/list]
[/list]

For British bombers (except [b]VIII Indomitable[/b]'s), we increased the acceleration time and acceleration coefficient that is applied after they drop their bombs on a target. This change will make it easier to approach a target for the next attack.

[h3][b]Visual and Technical Enhancements[/b][/h3]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/9dd5363e-62b5-11ea-9d66-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Replacing Commanders or certain modules, mastering or resetting skills, fitting or mounting camouflages which don't affect ship geometry, and mounting signals will now happen faster.
[*]The Islands of Ice, Strait, Tears of the Desert, and Mountain Range maps, as well as the Ports of New York, Zipangu, and Hawaii, have been adapted for the new lighting model and enhanced HDR technology. The Port of Zipangu got back its initial spring design, while the Port of New York has returned to its summer design.[/list]

[h3][b]Content Additions and Changes[/b][/h3]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/9dc62d2e-62b5-11ea-b4ac-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]
[list][*]The game will feature a new collection dedicated to the King of the Sea tournament. More details will follow later.
[*]A Public Test (PT) Winter Season Flag has been added. The flag will be available for completing three chains of Winter Season combat missions.
[*]The following ships have been added for testing by developers, supertesters, and community contributors: [b]VIII Pyotr Bagration[/b], [b]VIII Tallinn[/b], [b]IX Riga[/b], [b]X Alexander Nevsky[/b], [b]X Petropavlovsk[/b], [b]VIII Ochakov[/b], and [b]V Voroshilov[/b]. The latter is essentially a copy of [b]V Kirov[/b], but has the following distinctive features: her main battery reload time has been reduced from 13.5 to 12.5 seconds, and her AA defenses have the same arrangement as Kirov's Hull (A).
[*]The Infernal camouflage will be available for Tier VIII–X aircraft carriers, and Tier VIII aircraft carriers will get access to the New Year camouflage.
[*]We have reworked the geometry and visuals of the stock hulls of cruisers [b]VI Budyonny[/b], [b]VII Shchors[/b], and [b]IX Dmitri Donskoi[/b], as well as the composition of their AA and secondary battery complements without any effect on their gameplay.
[*]The researchable Hull B of cruiser [b]IX Dmitri Donskoi[/b] is no longer available to research and mount. This change should make progressing through this branch of the Tech Tree easier, as the number of hulls is now reduced. If a player has researched Hull B, they will get compensation in the amount of [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9d43348869eb4ac094288dad196925d8f6d9d89b.png[/img][b]25,000[/b] Ship XP. If a player has Hull B in their Inventory, they will get compensation of [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]2,000,000[/b] credits. If Hull C is in their Inventory, the compensation will amount to [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]3,400,000[/b] credits.[/list]

[h3][b]Other Changes and Improvements[/b][/h3]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/9dd9ba42-62b5-11ea-a2b4-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Any enabled personalizations of a unique Commander will now be displayed in pop-up tips in the Port. Enabled and disabled personalizations will differ visually.
[*]The description of unique Commander talents will now contain information on how many times a particular talent can be activated in battle.
[*]We have updated the models and textures for the following ships: [b]VI Trento[/b], [b]VII Surrey[/b], [b]VIII Albemarle[/b], [b]IX Neustrashimy[/b], [b]X Conqueror[/b], [b]VIII HSF Harekaze[/b], [b]X Goliath[/b], [b]VIII Borodino[/b], [b]IX Bajie[/b], and [b]VIII Wukong[/b].
[*]The animation of the sailing vessels in the Philippines Port has been fixed.
[*]Fixed an issue which caused the free camera to automatically switch to a squadron after an attack.
[*]Fixed an issue which caused a player's own patch to be displayed for several seconds after switching to the Spectator mode once the player's ship had been destroyed.
[*]Fixed an issue which caused an erroneous notification about changes to the Clan Season rules to be sent to players when, in fact, no changes to the rules had been introduced.
[*]Fixed an issue which caused a delay in a ship model loading in the Port on the first launch of the game client.
[*]Removed the display of ship specifications in the Port when an account doesn't have any ships.
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented the ship-type icon from being displayed in notifications about consumable auto-resupply or the expiration of a ship-rental period.
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented a player on an aircraft carrier from selecting a priority target for secondary battery guns when a particular squadron was selected.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused a situation where enemy torpedoes were sometimes displayed later than they were actually spotted.
[*]Fixed an issue which caused the ship specifications window and ship carousel to be displayed above the training tip windows.
[*]In the Containers section of the Port, we fixed an issue which prevented the display of a pop-up window congratulating players upon completing a collection or its sections.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused a situation where the "Close" and "To Ranks" buttons in the Ranked Battle results window did not fit the screen with a low resolution selected.
[*]Fixed an issue which caused Spotting Aircraft not to follow the ship which had launched it.
[*]Fixed an issue which caused a tip about the AA Priority Sector selection to be displayed in every battle.
[*]Fixed an issue which caused blinking angular reflections to be displayed under a ship when Low or Medium graphics settings were selected.
[*]Fixed an issue which excluded one of the 25 mm/60 Type96 guns from the short-range AA defenses for [b]VI Aoba[/b]'s Hull (B).
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the consumable-reload timer to freeze once Andrew Cunningham's "Consumables Expert" talent was activated.
[*]Fixed an issue that prevented the display of a message about compensation for a rental ship that a player already had in the Port.
[*]Fixed [b]X Gearing[/b]'s position in the Designer Table Port.
[*]Fixed an issue in Operation Aegis that caused the marker that appears once the [b]VII Shchors[/b] bot is destroyed to be displayed in an incorrect place.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused AA defense parameters to be displayed in a pop-up tip opened by pressing [b]H[/b] for ships without an AA complement.
[*]Fixed an issue that prevented the Remembrance Night camouflage from being displayed on [b]VII Helena[/b]'s secondary battery turrets.
[*]In the Clan section of the website, we divided the Clan Battles rating and stats into Clan Seasons and Clan Brawls. Changed the numbering of Clan Brawl Seasons from 201–207 to 1–7.
[*]Updated the hull geometry for the following ships: [b]VI Warspite[/b], [b]X Conqueror[/b], [b]VI Queen Elizabeth[/b], [b]X Thunderer[/b], [b]VIII Edinburgh[/b] , [b]VII Belfast[/b], [b]VI Perth[/b], [b]VI Leander[/b], [b]VII Fiji[/b], [b]X Goliath[/b], [b]VI Trento[/b], [b]IV Alberto di Giussano[/b], and [b]VII Nelson[/b].
[*]Fixed an issue affecting camera movement when switching the view to the secondary battery guns of [b]IV Hōshō[/b], [b]VIII Kaga[/b], [b]IV Langley[/b], [b]X Midway[/b], [b]VIII Graf Zeppelin[/b], [b]VIII Graf Zeppelin B[/b], [b]IV Hermes[/b], and [b]VI Furious[/b].
[*]The Chinese (Simplified) language is now available in the game across all regions.[/list]

notes.title: Everything You Need to Know About Commanders
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/01b132fea3e4e2e46933f8c4aab6659fc84441b5.jpg[/img]
[b]Our game has featured many different Commanders throughout its development. Commanders offer you a way to reinforce your ships by improving their specifications and adding valuable bonuses. Commanders are nation-bound and can be assigned only to the corresponding ships.[/b]

To unlock Commanders, newcomers to World of Warships will need to play 11 battles. In this article, we'll remind you what Commanders XP and skills are, and list the unique Commanders that you can obtain in the game by completing various missions, finishing Campaigns, assembling Collections, or by exchanging resources for them in the Armory.

[table][tr][th][b]Commander XP ● Commander Skills ● Unique Commanders ● Unique Historical Commanders[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2]Commander XP[/h2]
[list][*]Commanders earn XP in battle. Upon accumulating a certain amount of XP, they receive a skill point that can be spent on their training.
[*]The more ship XP you earn in battle, the more XP that will go to your Commander. Use signals and camouflages to accelerate the XP-earning process.
[*]Once a Commander has the maximum number of skills, all the XP they earn becomes Elite XP.
[*]Elite Commander XP can be converted into Free XP, spent on resetting skills, or used to train other Commanders.
[*]Commanders are always specialized for a specific ship. If you assign them to another researchable ship, you won't be able to profit from all the bonuses they provide at once—some skills will have 50% efficiency, while others will stop working entirely.
[*]If you reassign a Commander to a Premium or Special ship, they won't require additional retraining. All the skills you've learned will function at maximum efficiency, regardless of the number of skill points.
[*]If you reassign a Commander to a researchable ship, they'll need to earn a certain amount of XP on the new ship in order to use all of their skills effectively. You can also do it instantaneously for doubloons, skip halfway for credits, or spend Elite Commander XP on doing it.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/235b7d90-5ca3-11ea-8e84-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/23693534-5ca3-11ea-869c-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/23693534-5ca3-11ea-9ec6-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2]Commander Skills[/h2]
Commander skills improve ship parameters and provide you with new possibilities.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/2361dcd0-5ca3-11ea-b633-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][*]In total, the skill matrix has four lines, according to the number of points you need to research a certain skill, from 1–4.
[*]Skills are learned sequentially: in order to learn a skill in the fourth line, you need to learn at least one skill from all the preceding lines first.
[*]You can learn any number of skills, as long as you have enough points.
[*]Some skills are more effective on specific ships.
[*]Are you dissatisfied with you current Commander skills? You can redistribute them in exchange for Elite Commander XP or doubloons. The cost depends on the number of skill points you reset.
[*]The maximum possible number of skill points is 19.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/23703ff0-5ca3-11ea-9acd-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2]Unique Commanders[/h2]
[h3][b]Features of Unique Commanders[/b][/h3]
[list][*]They can be obtained by completing various missions, finishing Campaigns, assembling collections, or by exchanging resources for them in the Armory.
[*]They are displayed in Port with a special ribbon.
[*]They have improved skills—enhanced versions of standard skills that are displayed with a "+" icon in the matrix. In order to use a special skill, you first need to learn it.[/list]
[h3][b]List of Unique Commanders[/b][/h3]
[h1][i]Germany[/i][/h1]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/70cd6676-5ca1-11ea-b633-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b]Franz von Jütland[/b]
[*][b]Reinhard von Jütland[/b][/list]
[h3][b]Skills[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Vigilance:[/b] [b]+35%[/b] to the acquisition range of torpedoes by sea (by default: [b]+25%[/b])
[*][b]Jack of All Trades[/b] [b]−10%[/b] to the reload time of all mounted consumables (by default: [b]−5%[/b])[/list]
[h1][i]U.S.S.R.[/i][/h1]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/70faf06e-5ca1-11ea-be4c-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b]Vasiliy Znamensky[/b]
[*][b]Viktor Znamensky[/b][/list]
[h3][b]Skills[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Preventive Maintenance:[/b] [b]−45%[/b] (by default: [b]−30%[/b]) to the risk of module incapacitation
[*][b]Expert Marksman:[/b]
[list][*][b]+3[/b] deg/s to the traverse speed of guns with a caliber up to and including 139 mm (by default: [b]+2.5[/b] deg/s)
[*][b]+1[/b] deg/s to the traverse speed of guns with a caliber above 139 mm (by default: [b]+0.7[/b] deg/s)[/list]
[*][b]High Alert:[/b] [b]−20%[/b] (by default: [b]−10%[/b]) to the reload time of the Damage Control Party consumable[/list]
[h1][i]U.S.A.[/i][/h1]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/70d5a908-5ca1-11ea-aaa5-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b]George Doe[/b]
[*][b]John Doe[/b][/list]
[h3][b]Skills[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Expert Loader[/b]: [b]−75%[/b] to the reload time of guns when switching shell types (by default: [b]−50%[/b])
[*][b]Expert Marksman[/b]:
[list][*][b]+3[/b] deg/s to the traverse speed of guns with a caliber up to and including 139 mm (by default: [b]+2.5[/b] deg/s)
[*][b]+1[/b] deg/s to the traverse speed of guns with a caliber above 139 mm (by default: [b]+0.7[/b] deg/s)[/list]
[/list]
[h1][i]Great Britain[/i][/h1]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/70fa3a84-5ca1-11ea-b3eb-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b]Bert Dunkirk[/b]
[*][b]Jack Dunkirk[/b][/list]
[h3][b]Skills[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Jack of All Trades[/b] [b]−10%[/b] to the reload time of all consumables mounted on your ship and squadrons (by default: [b]−5%[/b])
[*][b]Expert Marksman:[/b]
[list][*][b]+3[/b] deg/s to the traverse speed of guns with a caliber up to and including 139 mm (by default: [b]+2.5[/b] deg/s)
[*][b]+1[/b] deg/s to the traverse speed of guns with a caliber above 139 mm (by default: [b]+0.7[/b] deg/s)[/list]
[*][b]Smoke Screen Expert:[/b] [b]+30%[/b] to the radius of smoke screens (by default: [b]+20%[/b])[/list]
[h1][i]Pan-Asia[/i][/h1]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/70dcfc30-5ca1-11ea-9a3b-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b]Quán Róng[/b]
[*][b]Dà Róng[/b][/list]
[h3][b]Skills[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Demolition Expert:[/b]
[list][*][b]+3%[/b] to the chance of setting fire to a target when hitting it with HE shells (by default: [b]+2%[/b])
[*][b]+2%[/b] to the chance of setting fire to a target when hitting it with rockets (by default: [b]+1%[/b])
[*][b]+6%[/b] to the chance of setting fire to a target when hitting it with HE bombs (by default: [b]+5%[/b])[/list]
[*][b]Survivability Expert[/b]
[list][*][b]+400[/b] HP for each ship tier (by default: [b]+350[/b])
[*][b]+30[/b] aircraft hit points for each tier of the ship (by default: [b]+15[/b])[/list]
[/list]
[h1][i]France[/i][/h1]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/70eb05fa-5ca1-11ea-8bb8-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b]Charles-Henri Honoré[/b]
[*][b]Jean-Jacques Honoré[/b][/list]
[h3][b]Skills[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Adrenaline Rush:[/b]
[list][*][b]–0.25%[/b] to the reload time of main battery guns, torpedo tubes, and secondary armament for each 1% of HP lost (by default: [b]–0.2%[/b])
[*][b]+0,25%[/b] to squadron speed for each 1% of HP lost (by default: [b]+0.2%[/b])[/list]
[*][b]Expert Marksman:[/b]
[list][*][b]+3[/b] deg/s to the traverse speed of guns with a caliber up to and including 139 mm (by default: [b]+2.5[/b] deg/s)
[*][b]+1[/b] deg/s to the traverse speed of guns with a caliber above 139 mm (by default: [b]+0.7[/b] deg/s)[/list]
[/list]
[list][i]All the Commanders listed above can be obtained from the Armory in exchange for resources. [b]Jean-Jacques Honoré[/b] and [b]Jack Dunkirk[/b] can be earned by assembling the Vive la France! and Dunkirk collections.[/i][/list]
[h2]Unique Historical Commanders[/h2]
[h3][b]Features of unique historical Commanders[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Once you meet specific requirements during a battle, a talent will kick in and remain active until the end of that battle.
[*]Apart from their talents, unique historical Commanders have bonuses for some skills.
[*]They boast special decorative personalization features: alternative colors for main battery shell tracers, a broad pennant, and a signal flare or firework that gets launched when one of their talents activates.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/591a385e-5ca3-11ea-8e84-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]List of Unique Historical Commanders[/b][/h3]
[h1][i]Germany[/i][/h1]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/4830c0c2-5ca2-11ea-b633-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b][b]Günter Lütjens[/b][/b][/list]
[h3][b]Skills[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Preventive Maintenance:[/b] [b]–45%[/b] to the risk of modules being incapacitated (by default: [b]–30%[/b])
[*][b]Expert Marksman:[/b] [b]+1[/b] deg/s to the traverse speed of guns with a caliber above 139 mm; [b]+3[/b] deg/s to the traverse speed of guns with a caliber up to and including 139 mm (by default: [b]+0.7[/b] deg/s and [b]+2.5[/b] deg/s)
[*][b]Improved Engine Boost[/b] [b]+12.5%[/b] to the engine boost action time for the aircraft carrier's squadrons (by default: [b]+10%[/b])[/list]
[h3][b]Talents[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Secondary Armament Expert:[/b] upon earning 100 "Secondary battery hits" ribbons, the secondary battery reload time reduces by 15%. This talent can be activated only once per battle
[*][b]Iron Strike:[/b] upon earning 140 "Main battery hits" ribbons, the main battery reload time reduces by 7.5%. This talent can be activated only once per battle
[*][b]Exemplary Reconnaissance:[/b] upon earning three "Spotted" ribbons restores 300 HP of your ship per second. The action time is equal to the tier of your ship (i.e. 3 seconds for Tier III ships; 10 seconds for Tier X ships). This talent can be activated multiple times
[*][b]Air Superiority:[/b] Upon earning 30 "Rocket hits," "Bomb hits," or "Torpedo Hits" ribbons, aircraft servicing speeds up by 10%. This talent can be activated only once per battle[/list]
[list][i]Commander Günther Lütjens is available in the Armory for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]175,000[/b] Coal.[/i][/list]
[h1][i]U.S.S.R.[/i][/h1]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/48302072-5ca2-11ea-958a-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b][b]Nikolay Kuznetsov[/b][/b][/list]
[h3][b]Skills[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Jack of All Trades[/b] [b]−10%[/b] to the reload time of all consumables mounted on your ship and aircraft (by default: [b]−5%[/b])[/list]
[h3][b]Talents[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Emergency Reserve:[/b] upon earning the "First Blood" achievement, a ship with Nikolay Kuznetsov at her helm receives one additional charge for all mounted consumables until the end of the battle
[*][b]Will to Victory:[/b] when the ship's HP is below 10%, it provides the following bonuses for 30 seconds: Damage Control Party activates without spending a charge of the consumable; Repair Party kicks in and restores up to 7.5% of the ship's HP (again, without using a charge of the consumable); the dispersion of shells fired by enemy ships at you increases by 20%[/list]
[list][i]Commander Nikolay Kuznetsov is available in the Armory for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]175,000[/b] Coal.[/i][/list]
[h1][i]Japan[/i][/h1]

notes.title: Dry Dock: Warship Size Comparison
notes.content:
[url=https://youtu.be/WkVvPpmM1r8][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/fa0d11977c0d7ec8f6b07cff55e8a9b47bfcffec.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]World of Warships is the largest virtual shipyard in the world.[/b]

The quality of the work done by our artists improves each year, and the requirements for the accuracy of the models they create grow respectively. Unfortunately, the in-game camera doesn't allow you to see all the details and beauty. In the Dry Dock show, you'll be able to see the refined visuals of our in-game models.

Warships are some of the largest and most complex technical objects in existence. Their monumental appearance and vast guns are enough to impress everyone. To our regret, it's hard to communicate the sheer scale of these steel giants in the game. In this Dry Dock episode, we compare the sizes of all the Tier X ships in World of Warships: from the smallest destroyers to the largest battleships!

notes.title: Ranked Battles: the Fifteenth Season
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3ebe49b1cf4dae9b367b9d9155c18c7406af05f7.jpg[/img]
[table][tr][th][b]Key Rules of the Season ● Rewards ● Arms Race[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d3bbc93e-57bb-11ea-a983-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2]Key Rules of the Season[/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Wed. 26 Feb. 10:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Tue. 24 Mar. 09:30 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

[b]Format:[/b] 7 vs. 7 playing Tier X ships.

[b]Restrictions:[/b] no more than one aircraft carrier and three battleships per team. If there aren’t enough suitable ships to complete the teams, and the time the first player in the queue has waited exceeds 4 minutes and 10 seconds, then each team can be completed with up to four battleships.

[b]Rewards:[/b] up to [b]5,500[/b] Steel, one Ranked Token, and many additional rewards.

[b]Mode:[/b] Arms Race.

[b]Maps:[/b] Trident, Warrior's Path, Sleeping Giant, Mountain Range, and Islands of Ice.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/da61d40c-57bd-11ea-a7a0-38eaa735f4cc_1920x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/daa005b0-57bd-11ea-a18a-38eaa735f4cc_1920x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/da6defda-57bd-11ea-a983-38eaa735f4cc_1920x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/da691e6a-57bd-11ea-88d2-38eaa735f4cc_1920x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/daa025a4-57bd-11ea-a03d-38eaa735f4cc_1920x.jpg[/img]

[h1][i][h3][b]Ranked Battles Features[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[list][*]A total of 18 Ranks split into three leagues: Second, First, and Premier.
[*]Those who are new to Ranked Battles will start the Season from Rank 18. Those who participated in the previous Season will receive bonus Stars: one for each rank attained.
[*]Players earn the Stars needed to climb the ranking ladder by winning battles. At the majority of ranks, a defeat means a lost Star.
[*]Ranks 18–15 and 12 are irrevocable. You cannot lose a Star for a defeat at Ranks 18–17. If you are first on your team in terms of XP earned, you get to keep your hard-earned Star—even if your team lost the battle.
[*]A bonus Star is granted for reaching a new rank at Ranks 18-11.
[*]Only Stars obtained for the first time are counted for progress towards the Ranked Battles emblem. Bonus Stars for the previous Season are included in this count if you play at least one battle in the new Season.
[*]You'll receive the Flag of the First League for reaching Rank 10. Upon reaching Rank 5, it will be replaced with the Flag of the Premier League.
[*]Flags given for reaching Leagues will be removed from player accounts once the Season ends.
[*]You’ll receive a commemorative achievement for reaching Rank 1 in the Fifteenth Season.
[*]All those who reach Rank 15 will receive a commemorative flag which will remain in their collections.[/list]
[h2]Rewards[/h2]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0d400394-57be-11ea-8603-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list]The League Flags reduce the cost of servicing your ships by 10% and 20% until the end of the Season.[/list]
[h2]Arms Race[/h2]
Arms Race is a battle mode in which special areas that provide buffs spawn on the map. If you can make it to a special area and activate it before your opponents do, your entire team will get a bonus to their combat abilities till the end of that battle. If you capture more than one of the same buff, the bonuses provided by them stack up.

Eight minutes after a battle starts, a Key Area appears in the center of the map. The diameter of this area then shrinks over time. The team that captures it will be able to quickly gain an advantage in points and ultimately win.

[h3][b]How do the areas with buffs work?[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Each buff area activates 2 minutes after spawning.
[*]When you enter one of these areas after its activation, you will receive the buff instantly.
[*]If you are within a buff area together with any enemy ships at the moment of its activation, the team with the most ships within the area gets the bonus. If the ship numbers are equal, the area remains in an uncaptured state until the balance of power inside it shifts one way or another.
[*]In addition to the buffs, each captured area grants victory points to your team and deducts points from the enemy team.[/list]
[h3][b]Which buffs are available?[/b][/h3]
Increased maximum ship speed and a faster rudder-shift time, as well as a reduced aircraft engine boost cooldown time:
[list][*][b]+3%[/b] to the maximum ship speed and rudder-shift time.
[*][b]−20%[/b] to the engine boost cooldown time of an aircraft carrier’s squadrons.[/list]

Continuous restoration of HP as a percentage of the maximum HP pool for ships or aircraft:
[list][*]Restoring [b]+0.05%[/b] of ship HP per second.
[*]Restoring [b]+0.3%[/b] of aircraft HP per second.[/list]
Faster reload time of the main battery and torpedo armament, or faster aircraft restoration time on a carrier's deck:
[list][*][b]−5%[/b] to the reload time of the main battery and torpedo armament.
[*][b]−5%[/b] to the aircraft restoration time.[/list]
Faster reload time of ship and squadron consumables:
[list][*][b]−5%[/b] to the reload time of ship consumables.
[*][b]−10%[/b] to the reload time of squadron consumables.[/list]

notes.title: British Cruisers: Obtain Cruiser London
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d0911486aaff41ad4cc758dc0aa51778de64def1.jpg[/img]
[table][tr][th][b]Rewards ● Andrew Cunningham ● Directives ● Royal Tokens ● Random Bundles ● Daily Shipments[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[h2]Rewards[/h2]
[list][*]Cruiser [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VI London[/b][/b]: the main reward for completing four Directives of the event.
[*][b]Royal Tokens[/b]: a themed temporary resource which can be obtained by completing Directives and Daily Missions, or received from Daily Shipments. You can earn more of them by gaining victories on [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_d1cf4f9cd1a11834d9343d2908ab077c1553163d495f6b3d837e7b2d29a69886.png[/img][b]VIII Albemarle[/b][/b] or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VI London[/b][/b]—up to 10 Tokens per day.
[*]Commander [b]Andrew Cunningham[/b], whom you can find in the Armory in exchange for 1,000 Royal Tokens.[/list]
If you complete four missions from each of the first two Directives, as well as collect the rewards from Daily Shipments, you can obtain up to 300 Royal Tokens. These can be exchanged for one of the following rewards in the Armory:

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/7216896c-4be0-11ea-bfc2-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]

If you complete all four Directives and collect the rewards from Daily Shipments, you’ll receive cruiser [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VI London[/b][/b], a permanent camouflage for her, and up to 600 Royal Tokens. These can be exchanged for one of the following rewards in the Armory:

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/71867bba-4be0-11ea-80b5-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]

If you log in to the game regularly and actively progress through the Daily Missions, complete all four Directives, collect all the available rewards from Daily Shipments, and complete the Daily Challenges on [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_d1cf4f9cd1a11834d9343d2908ab077c1553163d495f6b3d837e7b2d29a69886.png[/img][b]VIII Albemarle[/b][/b] or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VI London[/b][/b], you can obtain up to 1,380 Royal Tokens. These can be exchanged for a unique Commander— Andrew Cunningham—or one of the following rewards in the Armory:

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/71924530-4be0-11ea-aeb9-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]

[h2]Andrew Cunningham[/h2]
[h3][b]Talents:[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Lightning Fast:[/b] the speed of your ship and squadrons increases by 5% after scoring two "Caused flooding" ribbons.
[*][b]Consumables Expert:[/b] adds one charge for each of your ship’s consumables after you destroy two enemy ships.
[*][b]"Sink, Burn, Destroy!":[/b] the reload time of your ship’s main battery guns and torpedo launchers, as well as aircraft restoration time, are reduced by 10% after earning the Witherer achievement.[/list]
[list][i]These talents can be activated only once per battle, and aren’t available in Clan or Training Battles.[/i][/list]
[h3][b]Enhanced skills:[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Jack of All Trades[/b]: reduces the reload time of all ship consumables by 10% (instead of 5%).
[*][b]Aircraft Armor[/b]: reduces the continuous damage dealt by AA mounts by 11.5% (instead of 10%).[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/7216348a-4be0-11ea-a648-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]

[list]Commander [b]Andrew Cunningham[/b] is available in the Armory in exchange for 1,000 Royal Tokens. He comes with 10 skill points and a specialization for [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_d1cf4f9cd1a11834d9343d2908ab077c1553163d495f6b3d837e7b2d29a69886.png[/img][b]I Black Swan[/b][/b].[/list]
[list][i]In Update 0.9.7, we're planning to make [b]Andrew Cunningham[/b] available in exchange for Coal in the Armory. Thus, you'll still be able to get this Commander in future if you didn't manage to do so in Update 0.9.1. The exact amount of Coal required will be announced later.[/i][/list]
[h2]Directives[/h2]
The new game event tasks you with completing 36 missions spread across four Directives. The first Directive will become available with the release of Update 0.9.1, and the following Directives will open each subsequent week. Completing the missions will reward you with signals, expendable camouflages, Free XP, credits, and other desirable items. The main reward is cruiser [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VI London[/b][/b], which comes with the Victorian White permanent camouflage and a Commander with 3 skill points. You can obtain her by completing four out of nine missions of the last Directive.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/71f30280-4be0-11ea-a3ac-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]
[list][i]If you already have [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VI London[/b][/b] in your Port by the time you complete the final Directive, you'll get a Commander, Port slot, and compensation for the ship in the form of doubloons.[/i][/list]
You can expect the missions of the Directives to be more diverse than they have been in the past. Experienced players who have collected large numbers of ships in their Ports will have the opportunity to select the ideal ships for particular missions, and thus complete the Directives faster.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Directives can be completed until:[/b] [b]Tue. 10 Mar. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[list][i]Detailed information on the Directives and Hall of Fame rewards can be found in the game client.[/i][/list]
[h2]Royal Tokens[/h2]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/71a14c60-4be0-11ea-85fd-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]You can obtain Royal Tokens in the following ways:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Completing all four Directives of the "British Cruisers: Part 2" event will grant you up to [b]550[/b] Tokens.
[*]Completing the Daily Missions from February 13 through March 8 will bring you [b]20[/b] Tokens per day. You can obtain up to [b]500[/b] Tokens in total.
[*]Daily Shipments will deliver you up to [b]50[/b] Tokens.
[*]Completing Daily Challenges on [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VI London[/b][/b] or [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_d1cf4f9cd1a11834d9343d2908ab077c1553163d495f6b3d837e7b2d29a69886.png[/img][b]VIII Albemarle[/b][/b] during Update 0.9.1 will bring you [b]10[/b] Tokens per day (up to a total of [b]280[/b] Tokens). You'll also be able to complete the Challenges on [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Cheshire[/b][/b] after she becomes available at the end of February. In order to obtain the available rewards, gain victories in Random, Co-op, or Scenario Battles.[/list]
[list][b]In total[/b], you can earn up to [b]1,380[/b] Tokens.[/list]
Royal Tokens can also be dropped from random bundles that are available in exchange for doubloons in the Armory.

[h3][b]You can exchange these Tokens for the following rewards:[/b][/h3]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/718a4a4c-4be0-11ea-a078-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]

[list][i]With the release of Update 0.9.2, Royal Tokens will be obtainable only from random bundles that will be available in exchange for doubloons. After Update 0.9.3 goes live, all Royal Tokens will be converted into credits at a rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]9,000[/b].[/i][/list]
[h2]Random Bundles[/h2]
The "British Navy 2" section of the Armory has been stocked with random bundles. Each of them can be obtained in exchange for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d67bbc1cffa5fd8c0d25eddcb8666a90b3177331.png[/img][b]1,000[/b] doubloons.
[list][*]All the rewards are visible in advance: the bundles’ contents and their amounts will be displayed to you when viewing the currently available bundle.
[*]After each exchange, the contents of the next random bundle will be visible to you.
[*]Having collected all the bundles, you're guaranteed to have obtained all the available rewards.[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/72187862-4be0-11ea-9a74-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]

[h2]Daily Shipments[/h2]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/7175dcd8-4be0-11ea-9a74-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]

During Update 0.9.1, log in to the game between February 13 and 27 to start getting valuable rewards via the Daily Shipments section.

You can get a total of 10 rewards, while the shipments are available for 14 days. Thus, you can skip 4 days out of 2 weeks and still claim all the valuable rewards.
