[h2][b]British Cruisers: Part 2[/b][/h2]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/ce4c7ffe-4cab-11ea-b5f6-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]
A new line of British heavy cruisers has become available for all players to research.

[h2]Unique Features of the Ship Branch[/h2]
[list][*]Their powerful artillery can cause significant damage per salvo, but the guns have a relatively short firing range and arcing shell trajectory.
[*]In contrast to light British cruisers, these ships have high-explosive shells in their arsenal that can cause heavy damage and have good chances of setting targets on fire.
[*]Their ability to fire torpedoes one-by-one opens additional tactical options.
[*]Strong armor protection for the central parts of the decks of ships of Tier VI and above, increases their survivability compared to other cruisers, with [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_d1cf4f9cd1a11834d9343d2908ab077c1553163d495f6b3d837e7b2d29a69886.png[/img][b]X Goliath[/b][/b]'s deck armor reaching a thickness of 40 mm.
[*]Efficient Repair Party consumable.[/list]
Decent survivability, thanks to their durable armor and effective Repair Party. Their powerful guns with relatively short firing ranges predispose British heavy cruisers to medium-range artillery encounters.
[list][i]You'll be able to learn more details about the British heavy cruisers later in a dedicated article on our website.[/i][/list]
[h2]Directives[/h2]
The new game event tasks you with completing 36 missions, spread across four Directives. The first Directive will become available with the release of Update 0.9.1, right after the necessary technical work has finished. Those that follow will be unlocked each week. The ultimate reward for completing all Directives is cruiser [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VI London[/b][/b].

Completing missions will reward you with signals, expendable camouflage patterns, credits, Coal, and Free XP. Completing Directives will reward you with [b]Royal Tokens[/b].

[h2]Royal Tokens[/h2]
You can exchange Royal Tokens for doubloons, signals, Union Jack camouflage patterns, credits, days of Premium Account, and the main reward—the new unique British Commander, [b]Andrew Cunningham[/b]!

You can get Royal Tokens for completing the event's Directives, Daily Missions, and Daily Challenges for warships [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VI London[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Cheshire[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_d1cf4f9cd1a11834d9343d2908ab077c1553163d495f6b3d837e7b2d29a69886.png[/img][b]VIII Albemarle[/b][/b]. You can also obtain Royal Tokens from random bundles that are available in exchange for doubloons in the Armory.
[list][i]With the release of Update 0.9.2, Royal Tokens will only be obtainable from random bundles in exchange for doubloons. When Update 0.9.3 hits the servers, Royal Tokens will be converted into credits at the rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]9,000[/b].[/i][/list]
[h2]A new unique Commander[/h2]
[h3][b]Andrew Cunningham has the following talents:[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Lightning Fast:[/b] the speed of your ship and squadrons increases by 5% after scoring two "Caused flooding" ribbons.
[*][b]Consumables Expert:[/b] the number of consumable charges for your ship increases by one after destroying two enemy ships.
[*][b]"Sink, Burn, Destroy!":[/b] the reload time of your ship’s main battery guns and torpedo launchers, as well as aircraft restoration time, reduces by 10% after earning the “Witherer” achievement.[/list]
[list][i]Each of these talents can be activated only once per battle. His talents are unavailable in Clan Battles or Training Rooms.[/i][/list]
[h3][b]This British Commander also has two enhanced skills:[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Jack of All Trades[/b]: [b]−10%[/b] to the reload time of all mounted consumables, instead of the standard [b]−5%[/b].
[*][b]Aircraft Armor[/b]: [b]−11.5%[/b] to the continuous damage of AA guns, instead of the standard [b]−10%[/b].[/list]
[url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/game-updates/british-cruisers-london/]Read more>>>[/url]

[h2][b]The Fifteenth Season of Ranked Battles[/b][/h2]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/c3376d18-4cab-11ea-9734-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b]Dates[/b]: from February 26 till March 24
[*][b]Format:[/b] Tier X ships in a 7 vs. 7 format
[*][b]Battle mode:[/b] Arms Race[/list]
[b]Arms Race[/b] is a game mode in which special buff areas appear on the map. If you manage to enter an area and capture it before the enemy does, your entire team will receive a bonus to their combat characteristics that will last until the end of the battle. When you capture another area with the same buff, its efficiency increases further.

At a certain point in time after the start of a battle, a Key Area will appear in the center of the map. Its diameter will shrink over time, and the team that captures it will be able to quickly gain a point advantage and ultimately win.
[list]We've reworked the bonuses given by buffs. They now also apply to carrier squadrons and provide:[/list]
[list][*]Increased ship speed and a faster rudder-shift time; reduced aircraft engine boost cooldown time.
[*]Continuous restoration of HP as a percentage of the maximum HP pool for ships and aircraft.
[*]Faster reload time of the main battery and torpedo armament; faster aircraft restoration time on a carrier's deck.
[*]Faster reload time of ship and squadron consumables.[/list]
[h2][b]Updates to Upgrades[/b][/h2]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/c2d2b440-4cab-11ea-9064-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]

In Update 0.9.1, many old upgrades will be updated and some new ones will be added. These changes will make the selection of upgrades more interesting and diverse.

We've also removed all type and tier restrictions for any special upgrades that improve the efficiency of ship consumables, provided that the ship has the respective slot.

Some upgrades will be replaced with new ones. If you have any of these upgrades already mounted on your ships, they will be replaced with their new versions. You will get compensation in the form of credits for any upgrades in your Inventory that are removed from the game, and the amount of credits provided will be equal to the removed upgrade's full cost.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/01428faa-4cb3-11ea-9689-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]

[h1][i][h3][b]Detailed list of changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[h2]New upgrades[/h2]
[h3][b]Engine Room Protection (second slot):[/b][/h3]
This upgrade combines the bonuses provided by the Propulsion Modification 1 and Steering Gears Modification 1 upgrades which are scheduled to be removed from the game:
[list][*][b]−20%[/b] to the chances of critical damage to the engine and steering gears
[*][b]−20%[/b] to the repair time of the engine and steering gears[/list]
[list][i]This upgrade cannot be mounted on an aircraft carrier.[/i][/list]
[h3][b]Torpedo Tubes Modification 1 (third slot):[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]+20%[/b] to the traverse speed of torpedo tubes
[*][b]−40%[/b] to the chances of critical damage to torpedo tubes
[*][b]+5%[/b] to the speed of shipborne torpedoes[/list]
[list][i]This upgrade cannot be mounted on an aircraft carrier.[/i][/list]
[h3][b]Aerial Torpedoes Modification 1 (third slot):[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]+5%[/b] to the speed of torpedoes dropped from the air[/list]
[list][i]This upgrade can be mounted on an aircraft carrier only.[/i][/list]
[h3][b]Torpedo Lookout System (fifth slot):[/b][/h3]
Replaces the Target Acquisition System Modification 1 upgrade and provides the following bonuses:
[list][*]Increases the range of assured acquisition of torpedoes to a fixed value of 1.8 km (this range can be further extended by learning the Vigilance skill)[/list]
[list][i][b]Please note:[/b] the upgrade doesn't extend the torpedo acquisition range for the Hydroacoustic Search consumable.[/i][/list]
The Target Acquisition System Modification 1 upgrade was rarely used by players, and wasn't as efficient as the Concealment System Modification 1 upgrade. We've introduced changes to this upgrade in order to make it more relevant.

The bonus of [b]+20%[/b] to the acquisition range of torpedoes heavily depended on their detectability range: this bonus was ineffective against torpedoes with low detectability, and very effective against torpedoes with high detectability.

The new bonus doesn't depend on the characteristics of any approaching torpedoes. You will always be able to spot torpedoes at a fixed distance of 1.8 km without taking the effects of the Vigilance skill into consideration. This change will allow your ship to actively counter the torpedo armament of your enemy.
[list]We wanted to set a fixed assured acquisition range of 2 km and totally eliminate situations where the enemy detects you when you haven't spotted them. That's why we've replaced the bonus for the range of assured acquisition of ships in the game.[/list]
[list][i]This upgrade cannot be mounted on an aircraft carrier.[/i][/list]
[h3][b]Ship Consumables Modification 1 (fifth slot):[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]+10%[/b] to the action time of ship consumables[/list]
This upgrade cannot be mounted on an aircraft carrier.

[h3][b]Squadron Consumables Modification 1 (fifth slot):[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]+50%[/b] to the action time of squadron consumables[/list]
[list][i]This upgrade can be mounted on an aircraft carrier only.[/i][/list]
[h3][b]Auxiliary Armaments Modification 2 (sixth slot):[/b][/h3]
This upgrade will replace the AA Guns Modification 2 and Secondary Battery Modification 2 upgrades that are scheduled to be removed from the game:
[list][*][b]+15%[/b] to the continuous damage of AA guns
[*][b]+15%[/b] to the damage within the explosion radius of shells fired by AA defenses
[*][b]−20%[/b] to the secondary battery reload time
[*][b]+2[/b] explosions in AA salvos when the Defensive AA Fire consumable is active[/list]

[h2]Changes to upgrades[/h2]
[h3][b]Defensive AA Fire Modification 1 (special upgrade; second slot):[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Added a bonus reducing the cooldown time of the Defensive AA Fire consumable by 10%[/list]

[h3][b]Main Battery Modification 2 (third slot):[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Removed the penalty to the main battery gun reload time[/list]

[h3][b]AA Guns Modification 1 (third slot):[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The bonus providing additional explosions in AA salvos has been replaced with a 20% reduction in the preparation time of the priority AA sector.[/list]

[list][i]This upgrade cannot be mounted on an aircraft carrier.[/i][/list]

The bonus providing a certain number of explosions was ineffective for most ships whose AA defenses produce a lot of explosions, and for some ships—especially destroyers—it didn't work at all. The new bonus reducing the AA priority sector preparation time will be effective on any ship that has AA armament. This is because the priority sector, in addition to reinforcing the continuous AA damage, deals damage as a percentage of the enemy squadron's current HP. The exact percentage depends only on your ship's tier.

[h3][b]Enhanced Countermeasures (a unique upgrade for cruiser Worcester; fifth slot):[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The bonus applied to the action time of the Surveillance Radar consumable has been increased from 10% to 20%[/list]

This bonus has been improved in order to highlight the difference between [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_d1cf4f9cd1a11834d9343d2908ab077c1553163d495f6b3d837e7b2d29a69886.png[/img][b]X Worcester[/b][/b]'s unique upgrade and the new Ship Consumables Modification 1 upgrade, which provides a similar bonus, is situated in the same slot, and is available on other ships.

[h2]Unique Upgrades[/h2]
As the opening move towards the changes that have been promised for unique upgrades, we've updated the way in which they are obtained. With the release of Update 0.9.3, unique upgrades will appear in the Armory's Research Bureau. The combat missions for unique upgrades will also change.
[list][*]With the release of Update 0.9.1, you cannot get combat missions for unique upgrades.
[*]The end date for any combat missions you have already received will be December 31, 2020.[/list]

[list][i]We're going to revamp the existing upgrades and also add new upgrades in future. Stay tuned for more news![/i][/list]

[h2][b]Updates to the Service Record[/b][/h2]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/c30785c6-4cab-11ea-b5f6-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]
[list][*]The order in which in-game possibilities unlock has been changed.
[*]The number of battles required to reach the majority of Service Record levels has been reduced.
[*]The rewards granted for opening various levels of the Service Record have been updated.[/list]
You can learn more details about the changes to the Service Record in the game client.
[list][i][b]Please note:[/b] all players who started playing before the release of Update 0.9.1 will receive all the newly added rewards for the levels they have already reached, minus the rewards they had received in the old version of the Service Record.[/i][/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0a68427e-4cb2-11ea-a574-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]

[b]Thus, any players who have already reached the final level in their Service Record by the time that Update 0.9.1 is released will receive 15,000 Coal, 4 days of Premium Account, a supercontainer, and nine daily containers (with five More Resources containers among them), as well as upgrades, expendable camouflage patterns, and economic and special signals.[/b]

[h2][b]Armory[/b][/h2]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/c2c4a9f4-4cab-11ea-9689-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]

[list][i]When Update 0.9.1 hits the servers, [b]Shipbuilding Tokens[/b] will be converted into credits at the rate of 1:[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]7,500[/b].[/i][/list]

The unique historical Commander, [b]Philippe Auboyneau[/b], has been added. He's available in exchange for for [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]175,000[/b] Coal. He has the unique Sparks of Resistance, Fully Armed, and Speed and Composure talents, as well as the enhanced Survivability Expert skill.

[list][b]Effective as of the release of Update 0.9.3, the following ships will no longer be available in the Armory: [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/special_333a61069a325ba8314cbbae96c1a345c7b03ce9dd6c10cd486cc53c1855ef68.png[/img][b]X Smolensk[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/premium_1d0cabf1997104fd727039ab9c09819260343ab3a9e862f361434d7f42270eb3.png[/img][b]IX Jean Bart[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_f94cc0f538869ccfc9adb669febfa7f44774c5858165eea6702b960845987e60.png[/img][b]IX Neustrashimy[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VII Flint[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/premium_f94cc0f538869ccfc9adb669febfa7f44774c5858165eea6702b960845987e60.png[/img][b]IX Black[/b][/b].[/b][/list]

Smolensk and Jean Bart have become very popular warships for their tiers. In order to maintain the proper level of diversity in teams in terms of the ships they are made up of, these ships will no longer be available to obtain for an undefined period of time, but may return in future.

For a number of reasons, Neustrashimy, Flint, and Black are not currently strongly sought after in exchange for Steel. That is why they will no longer be available in exchange for Steel, but will later become available in exchange for Coal. However, this will be after 6 months at the earliest.

[list][i]We understand that accumulating resources for ships is a long process, which is why we wanted to warn you in advance so that any interested players can still steer these ships into their Ports before Update 0.9.3 goes live.[/i][/list]

[h2][b]New Northern Waters Map[/b][/h2]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/c2e186d2-4cab-11ea-b5f6-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]

The map is designed for Tier VIII–X battles in the Epicenter and Domination modes, with three Key Areas.

Battles will be fought in the harsh Northern territories, among snow-blanketed islands where the sun appears for only several hours each day.

[h3][b]The map is divided into three parts:[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The western part is an open-water space with several large islands, providing good possibilities for battleships and destroyers to maneuver.
[*]The central part is also open water, but at the same time it contains islands that will allow you to find shelter from any fire from the flanks. Besides that, the location of islands and their landscapes make it possible to push through the center into the flanks.
[*]The eastern part has many islands behind which cruisers and destroyers can find shelter from enemy fire. This part is suitable for those players who prefer inflicting sudden attacks on the enemy, and who can skillfully make use of limited shelter.[/list]

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/01e12c70-4cc0-11ea-b753-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d6ec660e-4cb2-11ea-a915-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d76725b0-4cb2-11ea-af83-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d6c27f56-4cb2-11ea-a932-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/d6d51ddc-4cb2-11ea-a557-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Other Changes[/b][/h2]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/c2ffad7e-4cab-11ea-9689-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]

You can find even more information about what’s going in the game by clicking the spoiler:

[h1][i][h3][b]Interface Changes and Improvements[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/c300911c-4cab-11ea-bdd9-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Changes to Armament Panel in Battle[/b][/h3]
[list][*]For ships and squadrons, we've changed the icons and exterior view of the indicators on the armament panel.
[*]When in battle, UI elements can now be hidden using [b]Ctrl+J[/b].
[*]Reworked the icon for the destroyer ship type.[/list]
[h3][b]Display of AA defense characteristics[/b][/h3]
The display of AA defense characteristics in the Port has been updated:
[list][*]AA defense parameters that are displayed in the Port have been changed: Now the players can view the following parameters:
[list][*]Average continuous damage
[*]Damage per second within a shell's explosion radius
[*]Maximum priority sector reinforcement
[*]AA gun maximum firing range[/list]

[*]A pop-up tooltip with detailed parameters has been added for each position in the AA defense characteristics.
[*]The information you can view during battle on the tooltip called by pressing the [b]H[/b] key has been changed.[/list]
[list][i]Please note: average damage is calculated by summing up the damage dealt by all AA defense zones. The damage dealt by each AA defense zone, taking into account its accuracy, is multiplied by the "weight" coefficient of the particular AA defense zone in relation to the ship's overall air defense capabilities. This coefficient is equal to the ratio between the firing range of a particular AA defense zone and the maximum firing range of the ship's AA defenses. With this in mind, to calculate the average continuous damage we use the total damage dealt by the long-range AA defenses (as this range extends over the entire AA firing range of the ship), and part of the damage dealt by the medium- and short-range AA defenses—depending on their firing range.[/i][/list]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/tmb/0238f1e4-4cb1-11ea-a574-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h1][i][h3][b]Game Balance Changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/c2e62b4c-4cab-11ea-94d9-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]
In Update 0.9.1, we've changed the characteristics of several ships, having analyzed their combat performance and taken player feedback into account. Such changes were required in order to carefully adjust the balance of selected warships. We'll continue to introduce changes in the updates that will follow, if deemed necessary.

[h3][b]Tier X Japanese aircraft carrier Hakuryu[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Fixed a bug that caused an inconsistency between the accuracy of her standard attack aircraft and that of her researchable attack aircraft. The accuracy of her standard attack aircraft has now been reduced to the level of her researchable type.
[*]The damage dealt by rockets from attack aircraft has been reduced from 3,450 to 3,350.[/list]
[h3][b]British Tier IX cruiser Neptune[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Her main battery reload time has been reduced from 5 to 4.8 seconds.[/list]
[h3][b]American Tier X destroyer Gearing[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Standard torpedo reload time has been reduced from 106 to 103 seconds.
[*]The reload time of her researchable torpedoes has been reduced from 122 to 118 seconds.[/list]
[h3][b]Soviet Tier VII battleship Sinop[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The sigma parameter for her main battery guns has been reduced from 1.6 to 1.55.[/list]
[h3][b]Soviet Tier X battleship Kremlin[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The sigma parameter for her main battery guns has been reduced from 1.9 to 1.85.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier X destroyer Yueyang[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Torpedo speed has been increased from 68 to 69 knots.
[*]Torpedo reload time has been reduced from 146 to 142 seconds.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier IX destroyer Chung Mu[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Standard torpedo speed has been increased from 55 to 56 knots.
[*]Standard torpedo reload time has been reduced from 122 to 119 seconds.
[*]Researchable torpedo speed has been increased from 66 to 67 knots.
[*]The reload time of her researchable torpedoes has been reduced from 122 to 119 seconds.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier VIII destroyer Hsienyang[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Researchable torpedo speed has been increased from 55 to 56 knots.
[*]The reload time of her researchable torpedoes has been reduced from 122 to 119 seconds.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier VIII cruiser Irian[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Torpedo speed has been increased from 68 to 69 knots.
[*]Torpedo reload time has been reduced from 136 to 133 seconds.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier VIII cruiser Wukong[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Torpedo speed has been increased from 63 to 64 knots.
[*]Torpedo reload time has been reduced from 110 to 107 seconds.[/list]

[h3][b]Tier VIII destroyer Siliwangi[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Torpedo speed has been increased from 61 to 62 knots.
[*]Torpedo reload time has been reduced from 131 to 128 seconds.[/list]
[h3][b]British Tier VI cruiser Devonshire[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Continuous damage of long-range AA defenses has been reduced from 95 to 53 HP per second
[*]Continuous damage of medium-range AA defenses has been increased from 151 to 161 HP per second
[*]Continuous damage of short-range AA defenses has been increased from 158 to 165 HP per second
[*]Number of AA shell explosions has been reduced from four to two
[*]Damage within the area of AA shell explosions has been reduced from 1,400 to 1,120[/list]

[h3][b]Aircraft[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The viewing range (being the parameter that shows the distance at which an aircraft can spot the enemy) of aircraft carriers' squadrons, as well as that of fighters and spotting aircraft, has been reduced from 20 to 19 km.[/list]

[h1][i][h3][b]Content Additions and Changes[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/c2e56590-4cab-11ea-a557-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]
Added a flag for the Recruiting Station referral program.

The following ships have been added for testing by developers, volunteer testers, and community contributors: [b]IX Ägir[/b], [b]X Yashima[/b], [b]VIII Arashi[/b], and [b]VIII Orkan[/b].

Operation Narai has been removed from rotation due to technical issues.

[h1][i][h3][b]Other Changes and Improvements[/b][/h3][/i][/h1]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/c2f13ece-4cab-11ea-8c64-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]
[list][*][b][b]VIII HSF Harekaze[/b][/b]: hull geometry updated.
[*][b]VII Z-39[/b], [b]VI Trento[/b], [b]X Venezia[/b], and [b]X Kremlin[/b]: fixed the designations of her gun fire control system modules.
[*][b]VIII Irian[/b]: changed the designation for her torpedo module.
[*][b]X Puerto Rico[/b]: fixed the display of secondary battery data in the ship's technical specifications.
[*][b]X Midway[/b]: changed the designation of her torpedoes.
[*][b]IX Bajie[/b] and [b]IX Izumo[/b]: fixed the armor protection of the conning tower. 
[*][b]IX Roon[/b]: the armor protection for the barbette of the fore 150 mm secondary battery turret is now displayed in the Port.
[*][b]VIII Mogami[/b] and [b]V Yahagi[/b]: updated the geometry of their main battery turrets.
[*][b]V Gremyashchy[/b]: added a second color scheme for the camouflage.
[*][b]VIII ARP Takao[/b]: fixed the exterior view of turrets when the ARPEGGIO RED camouflage is applied.
[*]Updated sounds in the Designer's Table Port.
[*]Fixed a glitch which disabled the sound of aircraft flying by in the sky in the London Port.
[*]Fixed a bug which disabled gunfire sounds when the sound quality was set to "Low" in Audio Settings.
[*]Removed visual artifacts on the Neighbors and Land of Fire maps, as well as in the Taranto Port.
[*]Fixed a number of glitches affecting the display of containers in the Port.
[*]Fixed a bug preventing the language bar from being displayed in the game client.
[*]Fixed an issue which in certain cases prevented players from receiving bonuses provided by Clan structures.
[*]Fixed a glitch which prevented the display of smoke trails from rockets fired by attack aircraft.
[*]Fixed an issue causing the "Your Rewards" window header to move outside of the screen border.
[*]Fixed an issue which caused game login errors on computers with non-typical names in the OS settings.
[*]Fixed an issue causing the incorrect icon of the reticule to be displayed when a player was controlling a squadron from an aircraft carrier.
[*]Now the tooltip informing players about the possibility of reloading a torpedo tube isn't displayed if the main battery guns are selected.[/list]

notes.title: Dry Dock: Jean Bart
notes.content:
[url=https://youtu.be/5eRjYv9vSbo][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/7ddea7719d34d07e5039564704adf97325613c8f.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]World of Warships is the largest virtual shipyard in the world. The quality of the work done by our artists improves each year, and the requirements for the accuracy of the models they create grow respectively.[/b]

Unfortunately, the in-game camera doesn't allow you to see all the details and beauty. In the Dry Dock show, you'll be able to see the refined beauty of our in-game models and duly appreciate the immaculate details of the various objects on their decks.

Today, we're focusing on the French Tier IX Premium battleship, Jean Bart. Built under the 1935 shipbuilding program, this Richelieu-class battleship was commissioned after World War II. The battleship resisted the Allied landings near Casablanca in 1942, and was badly damaged by airstrikes and artillery fire. The ship was finally completed after the war. She received the most advanced AA artillery available for her time, which significantly enhanced her AA defenses.

ARP ships are Premium ships. This means that they earn more credits per battle, and their permanent camouflages provide bonuses to XP, as well as reduce the cost of their post-battle service. You can reassign Commanders from any Japanese ships to ARP ships without having to retrain them. XP earned on ARP ships can be converted into Free XP. ARP ships have a special set of unique visual effects for shell and torpedo hits, fires, and flooding.
[list]Each ship comes with her respective same-name Commander with a unique voiceover from the anime series.[/list]
[list][i]You can disable the display of additional content anytime. Starting from Update 0.9.0, all camo bonuses remain active even when their display is disabled. In this case, the standard permanent camouflage or, in the case where a ship doesn’t have one, the Type 5 camouflage will be displayed.[/i][/list]

If you already have [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VII ARP Myōkō[/b][/b], you'll receive [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]6,375,000[/b] credits as compensation for the ship.[/i][/list]
[h2]ARPEGGIO OF BLUE STEEL -ARS NOVA-[/h2]
The anime and manga are set in the near future, at a time when the mysterious Fleet of Fog has seized control over the World Ocean. An enigmatic invincible squadron is made up of the reincarnations of legendary ships from the first half of the 20th century, with Kongō, Kirishima, and Takao being among them.

Equipped with a mysterious superweapon, and led by battleship Yamato, the new masters of the oceans block the humans from accessing the seas—destroying anything that dares to move offshore. Many corners of the earth, including Japan, find themselves isolated and cut off from the rest of the world.

Ships of the Fleet of Fog are commanded by their human-like Mental Models. Iona, the Mental Model of Japanese submarine I-401, chooses to defect across to the humans in a bid to turn the tide of the war against the Fleet of Fog.

notes.title: CCP × Wargaming DLC Bundle
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/9253/CCP_x_Wargaming_Bundle/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/9fe7aa999a8a9ae0ea4ddca122265a545d2d59bd.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/9253/CCP_x_Wargaming_Bundle/][b]Capsuleers of EVE Online and Commanders of World of Warships, prepare yourselves for the CCP × Wargaming Bundle, giving you DLC for both games with just one purchase![/b][/url]

[h2]The EVE Online DLC will provide you with:[/h2][list][*]7 days of the Omega premium subscription, giving you access to all ships and skills in EVE
[*]Praxis Battleship with the Praxis Icecloud Investigators SKIN
[*]250,000 Skill Points to boost your training![/list]
[h2]The World of Warships DLC will provide you with:[/h2][list][*]7 days of Warships Premium Account, giving you bonuses of +65% XP and +50% credits per battle
[*]Battleship Texas for 7 days and a special Space Commander with 3 skill points
[*]10 Sci-Fi Space camouflages[/list]
Are you wondering what these two titles have in common? EVE Online and World of Warships are two of the biggest spaceship and warship MMO games of all time, respectively. They also both have huge dedicated player communities, and are renowned for their epic-scale player battles!

EVE Online and World of Warships allow their players to choose between a variety of ship classes, and there is a degree of similarity in the division of classes across the games. The available choices enable tactical diversity to flourish for players in both game worlds. Destroyers, cruisers, battleships, and carriers are examples of the ship types that players can use to employ a wide range of strategies—including tactical fitting—on the seas of World of Warships and among the stars of New Eden.

There's never been a better time to try EVE Online and World of Warships, so grab the CCP × Wargaming Bundle today to get off to an explosive start in both New Eden and out on the open virtual seas!

[h1][i]Wukong[/i][/h1]
[b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Pan_Asia_3b66d1136c736e56c9f2f7cda2f1220c46a1bb8c8240ba11dff0035e91639e83.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/premium_1114542bcd311c388080eea3a4d54a7ea6fdc8706b019fcbf16ace9951f3a000.png[/img][b]VIII Wukong[/b][/b] is a cruiser named after the Monkey King—one of the main mythological characters in Chinese culture. Sun Wukong is an immortal demon who acquired extraordinary powers after long years of wandering in the pursuit of spiritual perfection. His adventures are described in the Chinese classical novel "Journey to the West." In World of Warships, the cruiser represents Pan-Asia at Tier VIII. She carries a combination of French artillery and Pan-Asian long-range deepwater torpedoes.

[h1][i]Key features:[/i][/h1]
[list][*]Nine 203 mm guns placed in three turrets. The cruiser can boast of having artillery with a good range and a fast reload time for the caliber
[*]Two triple-tube torpedo launchers. The deepwater torpedoes of this ship have a low detectability range; good torpedo range for her tier—12 km; and a high maximum damage of 18,400 HP per hit, but they are not capable of striking destroyers
[*]The Torpedo Reload Booster consumable, placed in a separate slot, allows her to launch one torpedo salvo 8 seconds after another several times during the course of a battle
[*]The Spotting Aircraft consumable temporarily extends the firing range of her main guns
[*]She earns more credits per battle, and her permanent camouflage adds a 50% XP bonus per battle and reduces the cost of the ship's post-battle service by 10%[/list]
For a detailed look at the ship's technical specifications, follow this [url=https://wiki.wargaming.net/en/Ship:Wukong]link[/url].

notes.content:

[h1][b][i]Rules[/i][/b][/h1]
[list][i]Please note: combat missions of the “Sea of Fortune” Season will be available [/i][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]from[/b] [b]Wed. 22 Jan. 07:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]through[/b] [b]Mon. 09 Mar. 08:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

[list]Play one Clan Battle between January 22 and February 5 to redistribute Commander skill points for free.[/list]
[list][*][b]Format: [/b]Tier X ships in a 7 vs. 7 format.
[*][b]Restrictions:[/b] no aircraft carriers allowed and no more than one battleship per team.
[*][b]Rewards:[/b] up to [b]11,000[/b] Steel and many additional rewards.
[*][b]Maps:[/b] Hotspot, Sea of Fortune, Tears of the Desert, Crash Zone Alpha, Mountain Range, Land of Fire, and North.
[*][b]Mode: [/b]Domination.
[*][b]Season Features:[/b] a cyclone is guaranteed to appear on each of the following maps: Mountain Range, Land of Fire, and North.[/list]
[list][b]Spotting range during a cyclone is 12 km instead of the usual 8 km for a Random Battle. The point in time at which a cyclone appears, as well as its duration, are strictly predetermined and don't change.[/b][/list]

[h1][b][i]Dates[/i][/b][/h1] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Wed. 22 Jan. 12:30 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]Ends:[/b] [b]Mon. 09 Mar. 04:30 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

[b]Gaming sessions are available on:[/b] Wednesday, Thursday, Saturday, and Sunday.
[list][i]On the days of any update releases, Clan Battles are held only during the prime time of your server.[/i][/list]
[h1][b][i]Rewards[/i][/b][/h1]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/265e4744-3934-11ea-8023-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]
[list][i]Detailed information on the rewards and conditions for the combat missions can be found in the game client.[/i][/list]
[h1][b][i]Clan Treasury[/i][/b][/h1]
Clans with Ranks 1–50 in the Global Rating will receive between [b]5,000[/b] and [b]25,000[/b] Steel.
[table][tr][th][b][b]Place in the global rating[/b][/b][/th][th][b][b]Steel[/b][/b][/th][/tr] [tr][td]1[/td] [td]25,000[/td][/tr] [tr][td]2[/td] [td]22,500[/td][/tr] [tr][td]3[/td] [td]20,000[/td][/tr] [tr][td]4[/td] [td]17,500[/td][/tr] [tr][td]5-50[b]*[/b][/td] [td]16,250-5,000[/td][/tr][/table]
[i][i][b]*[/b] Each following step brings 250 less Steel.[/i][/i]

Clans that don't enter the Top 50 will receive amounts of Steel and Coal in their Treasury that correspond to their League and Group.
[table][tr][th][b][b]League, Group[/b][/b][/th][th][b][b]Steel[/b][/b][/th][th][b][b]Coal[/b][/b][/th][/tr] [tr][td]Hurricane, 1[/td] [td]2,500[/td] [td]25,000[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Typhoon, 1[/td] [td]1,500[/td] [td]25,000[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Typhoon, 2[/td] [td]1,000[/td] [td]20,000[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Typhoon, 3[/td] [td]—[/td] [td]15,000[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Storm, 1[/td] [td]—[/td] [td]12,500[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Storm, 2[/td] [td]—[/td] [td]10,000[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Storm, 3[/td] [td]—[/td] [td]7,500[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Gale, 1[/td] [td]—[/td] [td]5,000[/td][/tr][/table]
[h1][b][i]Season features[/i][/b][/h1]
[h1][i]On all maps, the following rules apply:[/i][/h1]
[list][*]Number of Key Areas: 3
[*]Capture time: 40 seconds
[*]Points from a captured Key Area: 3 points per 4 seconds[/list]
The main feature of the Season is a guaranteed appearance of the cyclone on the Mountain Range, Land of Fire, and North maps. Unlike Random Battles, cyclones work according to strict rules in the new Clan Battles Season:
[list][*]They appear in five minutes after a battle begins
[*]The visibility range drops to 12 km in 1 minute
[*]A cyclone rages for 6 minutes, after which the visibility gradually returns to standard values within a period of 2 minutes[/list]
These settings, coupled with the strictly defined conditions of the cyclone’s occurrence, will make team tactics and gameplay more varied by reducing the engagement distance between opponents. The visibility range of 12 km will prevent cruisers equipped with the Surveillance Radar consumable from discovering enemy ships while remaining undetected themselves.

[h1][b][i]Clan Ships[/i][/b][/h1]
When the Season starts, any player who plays a Clan, Co-op, or Random Battle steering a Tier VIII–X ship, will be given a set of three special Tier X ships for temporary use: To obtain them, exchange the new event resource—British Tokens—in the Armory for random bundles which can drop the new ships.
[list][i]With the release of Update 0.9.1, Tier V–X British heavy cruisers will become available for all players to research in the Tech Tree.[/i][/list]

[h1][i]What are the distinctive features of British heavy cruisers?[/i][/h1]
[list][*]Their guns can cause significant damage per salvo, but have a relatively short firing range and arching shell trajectory.
[*]Unlike British light cruisers, the nation’s heavy cruisers can use high-explosive shells.
[*]Tube-by-tube torpedo launching capabilities.
[*]Durable armor in the central part of their decks for Tier VI ships and higher give representatives of the new branch greater survivability in comparison to other cruisers.
[*]Efficient Repair Party consumable: restores 50% of citadel damage, as opposed to the standard 10% for this ship type. Starting from Tier VIII, Repair Party restores 2% of the ship’s maximum HP per second instead of the standard 0.5%.
[*]All researchable British heavy cruisers can choose between Hydroacoustic Search and Defensive AA Fire.[/list]
Cruisers [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_d1cf4f9cd1a11834d9343d2908ab077c1553163d495f6b3d837e7b2d29a69886.png[/img][b]IX Drake[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_d1cf4f9cd1a11834d9343d2908ab077c1553163d495f6b3d837e7b2d29a69886.png[/img][b]X Goliath[/b][/b] have even more powerful artillery: main guns with a caliber of 234 mm and high-explosive shells that can penetrate armor up to 58 mm thick. Additionally, their Repair Party consumables are capable of restoring 60% of non-citadel damage.

Completing missions will bring you signals, expendable camouflages, and credits; completing Directives will reward you with British Tokens.

[h1][i]German Tier X cruiser Hindenburg[/i][/h1]
[list][*]The reload time of her main guns has been reduced from 10.5 to 9.8 seconds.[/list]
Boosting her reload speed will improve the cruiser's combat performance.

[h1][i]American Tier X battleship Montana[/i][/h1]
[list][*]The amount of HP restored by her Repair Party consumable has been increased from 0.5% to 0.66% of the maximum HP pool per second.[/list]
The parameters of [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b]X Montana[/b][/b]’s Repair Party are now equivalent to those of the same consumable on other researchable U.S. battleships.

[h1][i]Soviet Tier X battleship Kremlin[/i][/h1]
[list][*]The HP pool of her AA mounts has been reduced by half.[/list]
In addition to her good armor and large HP pool, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Russia_6ce701e1c2f2ac3909a68a0a7b23be515f09aa699a2d8bed2efc47d69e326e5c.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Battleship/standard_1468cf2ed1dc129ec4db4d9d18306bd06abb0d6b08c805dc94fe23ce6187c119.png[/img][b]X Kremlin[/b][/b] has highly efficient AA guns that were previously too hard to destroy. This meant that the battleship was able to enjoy solid protection against aircraft for the duration of an entire battle. The change will make it easier for aircraft carriers to attack the battleship in the middle stages of a battle, at the point when some of her AA mounts have been destroyed.

[h1][i]European Tier VII destroyer Błyskawica[/i][/h1]
[list][*]The horizontal aiming angles of her main guns have been extended on both sides:
[list][*]First turret: by 10 degrees
[*]Second turret: by 1 degree
[*]Fourth turret: by 15 degrees[/list]
[*]The traverse angles of her torpedo tubes have been extended by:
[list][*]8 degrees to the bow
[*]2 degrees to the stern[/list]
[/list]
The new angles will make shooting and torpedo launching more comfortable.

[h1][i]French Tier III destroyer Fusilier[/i][/h1]
[list][*]The HP pool of her standard hull has been reduced from 9,300 to 7,900.
[*]The HP pool of her researchable hull has been reduced from 10,900 to 9,300.[/list]
These changes will reduce the overall battle efficiency of the ship and balance it with that of other Tier III destroyers.

[h1][i]French Tier IX destroyer Mogador[/i][/h1]
[list][*]The ship's detectability range has been increased:
[list][*]By sea: from 9.04 to 9.54 km
[*]By air: from 4.35 to 4.59 km
[*]After firing her main guns while in smoke: from 3.7 to 3.96 km[/list]
[*]The detectability range of her torpedoes has been increased from 1.4 to 1.8 km[/list]
[h1][i]French Tier X destroyer Kléber[/i][/h1]
[list][*]The ship's detectability range has been increased:
[list][*]By sea: from 8.88 to 9.88 km
[*]By air: from 4.83 to 5.38 km
[*]After firing her main guns while in smoke: from 3.63 to 4.15 km[/list]
[*]The detectability range of her torpedoes has been increased from 1.4 to 1.8 km[/list]
Their detectability parameters and high speeds previously enabled [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_e63ad0ec80732b1c0dde479b466999b068c3fc355e7d674864a0a8cb35f9443c.png[/img][b]IX Mogador[/b][/b] and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Destroyer/standard_e63ad0ec80732b1c0dde479b466999b068c3fc355e7d674864a0a8cb35f9443c.png[/img][b]X Kléber[/b][/b] to perform surprise attacks without giving the enemy enough time to respond. This ability, combined with the main strength of French destroyers—their efficient main guns—made these ships too powerful in comparison with other destroyers.

[h1][i]French Tier X cruiser Henri IV[/i][/h1]
[list][*]The time it takes for her engine to reach full power has been increased.
[*]The acceleration parameters with the Engine Boost consumable activated have been changed.[/list]
Due to her Engine Boost consumable and high standard speed, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_France_1b45875fe2166c392a4b0801c9faa6d375a18f3f9644a726f5dcc721f3b36580.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/Cruiser/standard_d1cf4f9cd1a11834d9343d2908ab077c1553163d495f6b3d837e7b2d29a69886.png[/img][b]X Henri IV[/b][/b] was able to avoid enemy fire by reducing or increasing her speed. Now the ship will accelerate and stop more smoothly. With Engine Boost activated, her acceleration will be approximately the same as her standard acceleration without the effects of the consumable prior to the change.

[h1][i][h1][i]Visual and Technical Enhancements[/i][/h1][/i][/h1]

We've also improved the water reflections and rendering of shadows cast by static objects.
[list][b]We've updated the Additional Content settings. Now you can enjoy the bonuses provided by camouflages even when their display is disabled. notes.title: Armada: Indomitable
notes.content:
[url=https://youtu.be/ZnqrdpHVgzw][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/e37a5cd647013da44df00ee70e035af5d3ff135e.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]The jewel atop the crown of Britain’s undisputed sovereignty over the European seas, forged in an age of rapid evolution for the Royal Navy.[/b]

HMS Indomitable, with her armored flight deck, expanded aircraft facilities, and heavy anti-aircraft artillery, strove to be a jack of all trades in the midst of a war that would put every conceivable aspect of naval combat to the test.
[previewyoutube=ZnqrdpHVgzw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b][i]History[/i][/b][/h1]
In April 1937, the first of four planned Illustrious-class aircraft carriers was laid down at the Vickers-Armstrong shipyards at Barrow-in-Furness, England. This first, fully-fledged, class of modern British carriers was meant to serve as the proving ground for a new Royal Navy doctrine that called for maximizing carriers’ fixed defenses, both active and passive. Lacking effective radar, fighter planes couldn’t be expected to scramble in time to intercept an incoming attack in conditions of poor visibility. As a result, the Illustrious-class ships sacrificed plane capacity for an armored “box” that encased their hangars, including 76 mm of plating on the flight deck. This feature was a true rarity for its time, and one that wouldn’t be replicated abroad until 1941 with the Japanese aircraft carrier Taiho.

By November 1937, the fourth and final ship of the Illustrious series—Indomitable—was laid down at the same English shipyard. Due to delays in the delivery of required materials, construction was put on hold and the Admiralty took the opportunity to modify Indomitable’s design. The new requirements called for an increase in airplane capacity from 36 to 48, while keeping her weight in line with her three unmodified sister ships. To achieve this, an additional hangar was added above the originally planned one, and some armor was shaved off the sides and lower decks around the “box,” while the flight deck plating was left untouched.

Indomitable was completed and entered service in 1941, shortly before the Japanese Empire joined the war on the side of the Axis. In January 1942, she was assigned to the Eastern Fleet—based in the Indian Ocean—to curtail the rapid advance of the Japanese Navy in the East Indies. Before leaving the Indian Ocean, Indomitable would provide air support for the invasion of Madagascar.

With the Battle of Midway sending any chances of further carrier threats to the bottom of the sea, Indomitable was freed up to be sent to the Mediterranean in July 1942 to partake in Operation Pedestal—a heavily armed resupply convoy for the crucial island of Malta. Air cover was essential to the mission’s success, so it’s no surprise that Indomitable became the focus of German and Italian bombers from the outset. The ship was hit with two armor-piercing bombs, one of which struck an unarmored section of the flight deck, starting fires below-decks. Nevertheless, Indomitable’s squadrons of Hawker Sea Hurricanes performed well against the bombers, with fighter ace Lt. Richard Cork shooting down five enemy aircraft.

In 1943, Indomitable found herself again in a large-scale operation in the Mediterranean, as the Allies prepared for the invasion of Sicily, providing important air cover for the amphibious assault. Shortly after midnight on July 16, a lone bomber approached Indomitable undetected, dropping a single torpedo which struck the ship under the belt on the port side amidships. The damage was heavy, but quick and effective damage control, as well as counter-flooding, allowed her to sail back to Malta for repairs under her own power.

After undergoing extensive repairs and refitting at Norfolk, she was assigned to the Pacific theatre in 1944, where she would serve out the rest of the war. She survived three kamikaze attacks on May 4, 1945. One of the aggressors hit the deck, but the armor withstood the blow and only a few aircraft and sailors were lost as a result; the second kamikaze attack resulted in the plane bouncing off Indomitable's deck and exploding in the water; and the third attacker was shot out of the sky by the ship’s anti-aircraft batteries.

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/3458a4c0-2d72-11ea-a221-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][i]Modeling the Ship[/i][/b][/h1]
In terms of her aircraft squadrons, Indomitable flies the twin-engine De Havilland Sea Hornets, first operated by the Royal Navy Fleet Air Arm in 1946.

[b]Aircraft[/b]: De Havilland Sea Hornets in one squadron of four level bombers and one squadron of six attack aircraft.

These twin-engine, multi-role planes were developed as land-based fighter/bombers in the twilight years of the war, but were also adapted for carrier operations with a ‘Sea’ variant, complete with foldable wings to fit in the cramped carrier hangars.

[b]Secondary battery[/b]: 16 113 mm/45 Mk II BD dual purpose guns in eight enclosed double turrets, situated on four separate sponsons located on either side of the ship, both fore and aft.

[b]Anti-aircraft armament[/b]: 21 twin and 16 single 20 mm Oerlikon machine guns; four double 40 mm Bofors mounts; six quad 40 mm Vickers 2-pounder Mk VII “Pom-poms.”

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/342b51fa-2d72-11ea-9480-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]

The ship has five slots for upgrades. We consider the following combinations to be most effective:
[list][*]Air Groups Modification 1
[*]Aircraft Engines Modification 1
[*]Attack Aircraft Modification 1
[*]Attack Aircraft Modification 2 or Bombers Modification 2

Like all other carriers, [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_United_Kingdom_c1f75d7cca85dc4b48208e9ff7f96c35c7002b584a1081fa4633022e48ca5676.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/premium_4516ee494bb0396e51796cebff5e45c3f448d9790e0a58082057b8949ed9a3f8.png[/img][b]VIII Indomitable[/b][/b] has the standard Damage Control Party I and Fighter I on auto-activation. Her planes—both the rocket and bomb-equipped varieties—come with two charges of Engine Cooling I to speed up your squadrons’ movement, and four charges of Patrol Fighters I to deploy strategically on the map.

[h1][b][i]Indomitable in Combat[/i][/b][/h1]
One of the first aircraft carriers with an armored flight deck in naval history. The ship's game version carries two types of aircraft on her deck: twelve attack aircraft and eight bombers, making it two full squadrons of each. Thanks to this, you can launch a full squadron even if the previous one of the same type hasn't returned from an attack yet, or went down during their assault. All aircraft aboard Indomitable have a high cruising speed for this Tier, allowing you to quickly reach any part of the battlefield and carry out vicious attacks against enemy ships.

[h1][i]Key features:[/i][/h1]
[list][*]Attack aircraft: six aircraft in a squadron, with two planes on an attack run. Each aircraft carries eight rockets. Maximum rocket damage—2,100 HP; armor penetration—27 mm; chances of setting a target on fire—9%. Cruising speed—188 knots.
[*]Bombers: four aircraft in a squadron, with two planes on an attack run. Each bomber can drop six HE bombs. Maximum bomb damage—4,700 HP; armor penetration—32 mm; chances of setting a target on fire—27%. Cruising speed—182 knots.
[*]Extra credits per battle and 50% more XP provided by the permanent camouflage.[/list]

notes.title: Season’s Greetings from the World of Warships Team
notes.content:
[url=https://youtu.be/Tn2v5MCJUik][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/62fbc2a8de4ee91fddc34f4b8031242c65beeef5.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]Captains![/b]

Another year has come and gone, and the World of Warships fleet has swelled and is sailing strong! As we do every December, we’d like to take a moment to wish you—our players—a happy holiday season in the company of your loved ones, and to thank you for the countless action-packed battles we’ve fought together throughout the outgoing year. Without you to command history’s mightiest warships, our game would merely be a calm sea dotted with tranquil islands!

2019 saw us take to the skies from British aircraft carriers, set new water speed records aboard French destroyers, fight off fuel-hungry bandits in the grim world of the Post Apocalypse, and welcome a new nation—Europe—to the Tech Tree, amongst other things! We hope that you’ve enjoyed every moment of it as we have, and hope to meet you again in 2020, either on—[i]or beneath[/i]—the high seas!
[previewyoutube=Tn2v5MCJUik;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]World of Warships: 2019 Results[/h3]
The year 2019 is coming to an end—it's time to sum it up and recollect what happened in World of Warships. New game modes, ship branches, the official announcement of submarines, and much more. Let's remember the brightest moments in a new video!

[b]If there are problems with downloading or launching the update—please [url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=2037-QEUH-3335]perform files integrity check[/url]. [/b]

[h2]Brace yourselves for heated naval action in a new Ranked Sprint that will be fought with Tier VIII ships in a one-on-one format.[/h2]
If you haven’t yet participated in a Ranked Sprint and want to know more about them, our article will answer your questions.

[table][tr][th][b]Key Rules ● Maps ● Rewards[/b][/th][/tr][/table]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/b3c39b26-26f0-11ea-bcee-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][i]Key Rules[/i][/b][/h1]
For the first time in our game, you can demonstrate your skills in a real duel. You’re in for a short and dynamic Season of Ranked Battles in a 1 vs. 1 format with Tier VIII ships.

But what makes a Ranked Sprint different from a regular Ranked Battles season? The answer is simple: a easier competition format with a reduced duration. The new Sprint will run for only 1 week, with all Ranks and Stars being irrevocable. For participating in the Sprint, you can obtain a huge number of signals and [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/5c621e67cc47237e35201fe7de304e294f539ebb.png[/img][b]500,000[/b] credits. The reward for achieving Rank 1 is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2a834d5cd113949cdb3f44cc7802c875a87e8ce.png[/img][b]10,000[/b] Coal for use in the Armory.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Season starts:[/b] [b]Fri. 27 Dec. 10:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]Season ends:[/b] [b]Fri. 03 Jan. 09:30 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[list][*]Only Tier VIII ships are allowed in these battles.
[*]Battles are held in a 1 vs. 1 format.
[*]Battle maximum duration: 15 minutes.
[*]A ship's type won’t be taken into account during the matchmaking process. For example, when playing a battleship, you might find yourself opposing a cruiser, destroyer, aircraft carrier, or another battleship.
[*]Players earn the Stars needed to climb the ranking ladder by winning battles.
[*]The number of Ranks is 10—less than in a regular season.
[*]All players start battles at Rank 10.
[*]This Season, all Ranks and Stars are irrevocable.
[*]All Ranks are divided into two leagues: Ranks 10–6 and Ranks 5¬–1.
[*]To attain Rank 1, you must earn 40 Stars.
[*]Players who reach Rank 1 can no longer participate in any further battles of the current Season.
[*]Ranked Sprint achievements aren’t inherited from previous Ranked seasons, and won’t transfer to those that follow.
[*]Stars earned in Ranked Sprints aren’t counted as the Stars required to obtain Ranked Battle emblems.
[*]Due to the specifics of the format, there will be no battle achievements.[/list]
[h1][b][i]Maps[/i][/b][/h1]
Battles will be fought in Domination mode on the following maps with a reduced combat area: Islands of Ice, Land of Fire, Sea of Fortune, Trident, Loop, and Greece.

notes.title: Holiday Recruiting Station Bonanza!
notes.content:
[url=https://friends.worldofwarships.eu/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/f90af8ad79040903caf24db6516db64899fd38d1.jpg[/img][/url]
[h1][b]On the first day of Shipmas, my Shipmate gave to me...[/b][/h1]
[i][img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b8084a4-1cf1-11ea-b1b5-38eaa735f4cc_200x.png[/img]x2 Recruitment Points per battle, and a Santa's Gift under my tree![/i]

[h3][i]The Recruiting Station is going into overdrive for the holidays: for the next three weeks, battles played with your Shipmates in a division will grant you [b][b]DOUBLE[/b] the Recruitment Points[/b]! Aside from that, you can get bonus rewards for additional activity:[/i][/h3]
[list][*]For each milestone reached and for each new recruit enlisted, [b]bonuses of up to 300 Recruitment Points[/b] will also be paid out.
[*]Play in as many division battles as you can with your Shipmates, and you'll also earn a chance to win a [b]Santa's Gift container[/b] each week for yourself and your Shipmates![/list]
[table][tr][th][b]Battle bonuses ● Milestone and Recruitment bonuses ● Weekly Santa's Gift Community Goal[/b][/th][/tr][/table]    [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Event starts:[/b] [b]Mon. 23 Dec. 15:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]Event ends:[/b] [b]Sun. 12 Jan. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]Prizes credited by:[/b] [b]Sat. 18 Jan. 00:59 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

[h1][b][i]Battle bonuses[/i][/b][/h1]
For the duration of the event, ALL battles you play in a division with shipmates will grant you double the Recruitment Points you would normally get. This rule also applies to the victory bonus which is then added to the base reward:
[table][tr][td]
[h1][i]Scenario[/i][/h1][/td] [td]
[h1][i]Recruiter's reward[/i][/h1][/td] [td]
[h1][i]Shipmate's reward[/i][/h1][/td][/tr] [tr][td]
[b][b]Play a battle with 1 shipmate[/b][/b]
[/td] [td][strike]18[/strike] [b]36[/b] [img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/0a1ff67a-83a6-11e9-8c24-38eaa735f4cc.png[/img][/td] [td][strike]5[/strike] [b]10[/b] [img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/0a1ff67a-83a6-11e9-8c24-38eaa735f4cc.png[/img][/td][/tr] [tr][td]
[b][b]Play a battle with 1 shipmate [b]and win[/b][/b][/b]
[/td] [td][strike]26[/strike] [b]52[/b] [img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/0a1ff67a-83a6-11e9-8c24-38eaa735f4cc.png[/img][/td] [td][strike]10[/strike] [b]20[/b] [img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/0a1ff67a-83a6-11e9-8c24-38eaa735f4cc.png[/img][/td][/tr] [tr][td]
[b][b]Play a battle with 2 shipmates[/b][/b]
[/td] [td][strike]22[/strike] [b]44[/b] [img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/0a1ff67a-83a6-11e9-8c24-38eaa735f4cc.png[/img][/td] [td][strike]5[/strike] [b]10[/b] [img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/0a1ff67a-83a6-11e9-8c24-38eaa735f4cc.png[/img][/td][/tr] [tr][td]
[b][b]Play a battle with 2 shipmates [b]and win[/b][/b][/b]
[/td] [td][strike]34[/strike] [b]68[/b] [img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/0a1ff67a-83a6-11e9-8c24-38eaa735f4cc.png[/img][/td] [td][strike]10[/strike] [b]20[/b] [img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/0a1ff67a-83a6-11e9-8c24-38eaa735f4cc.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
[h1][b][i]Milestone and Recruitment bonuses[/i][/b][/h1]
Have any Shipmates who haven't reached their milestones yet?

During the event, each time one of your Shipmates reaches their Recruiting Station milestones, a bounty of [b]300 Recruitment Points[/b] will be paid out to both you and the Shipmate. These milestones are:
[list][*][b][b]If the Shipmate is a new player[/b][/b]: Play one battle in a researchable Tier VI ship
[*][b][b]If the Shipmate is a returning player[/b][/b]: Win 25 battles on Tier IV–X ships[/list]
[list][i]This bonus applies to any recruits who reach their milestones, whether they were recruited during, or before the start of the event.[/i][/list]
Aside from this, Shipmates can expect to receive the standard rewards for reaching their milestones:

[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/4b6ae244-1c0c-11ea-9c2f-38eaa735f4cc.jpg[/img]

[list]Want your Shipmates to reach their milestones as soon as possible? Read up on some easy tips and tricks in our [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/game-guides/tiers-of-joy/]10-step guide[/url].[/list]
[h1]Don't have any Shipmates yet?[/h1]
Then there's never been a better time to recruit!

Every time you recruit a new Shipmate, you and your Shipmate will receive [b]100 Recruitment Points[/b]. So even if your new recruits don't manage to hit their milestones in time, you'll be taking home a hefty haul!

So get recruiting! [list][b]Please don't forget that recruits who wish to use Steam version should [u]first create their accounts by logging into the Port[/u] instead of creating account through the website and only after that join your invitation link by logging to website using "Steam" option.[/b][/list]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/1592499063132217547

[h1][b][i]Weekly Santa's Gift Community Goal[/i][/b][/h1]
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/tmb/1b8084a4-1cf1-11ea-b1b5-38eaa735f4cc_200x.png[/img]For each of the three weeks the event lasts, we will be holding a random draw of valuable packs of [b]Santa's Gift containers[/b]. A pack is awarded to a Recruiter, and contains a Santa's Gift for themselves, as well as for each of the Shipmates that played in a division with the recruiter over the course of the previous week.

The number of packs given out per week will depend on the number of battles played in Recruiter-Shipmate divisions across the server: [b]for every 200 battles[/b], one pack will be added to the prize pool for the current week.
[list][i][b]E.g.[/b] If 8,000 Recruiter-Shipmate divisions play battles during a week, the prize pool for that week will consist of 40 Santa's Gift packs (8,000 / 200 = 40).[/i][/list]
In order to be eligible to win one of these weekly random draw prizes, a Recruiter must have played [b]at least 5 battles[/b] in a division with Shipmates during the previous week. From then on, every 5 of these battles you play during the week will increase your chances of winning a prize.
[list][b]Random draw prizes will be credited after the end of the event.[/b][/list]

[h1][b][i]Discounts and bonuses[/i][/b][/h1]
The holidays are bringing large discounts to our game!

[h1]Discount for Warships Premium Account:[/h1] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Starts:[/b] [b]Fri. 20 Dec. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

[list][*][b]−50%[/b] to the cost in doubloons of [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]360 days of Warships Premium Account[/b] in the game client.[/list]

As you celebrate the New Year, drop by the Premium Shop for the traditional festive offer—a whole year of [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/d2b68f7b0bdd7def79c6c7568ce03fad45f6e0c0.png[/img][b]Warships Premium Account[/b] at half the price! Premium Account will bring you those ships you desire earlier, earn you additional Commander skill points, and even bring you more credits in battles. You can also stock up on special signals by getting a bundle with 360 days of Warships Premium Account and 50 special signals of each type.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Bundles are available for purchase until:[/b] [b]Fri. 10 Jan. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

[h1]Details[/h1]
Warships Premium Account applies only to World of Warships. It brings you more credits and XP that can facilitate your progress in the game, and brings you more XP per battle than Wargaming Premium Account.

[h1][i]Warships Premium Account offers you the following bonuses:[/i][/h1]
[list][*]+65% XP per battle
[*]+50% credits per battle
[*]The possibility to simultaneously undertake three tasks in World of Warships Campaigns[/list]
Please note: the bonuses provided by Warships Premium Account and Wargaming Premium Account do not sum up. If you have both types of Premium Account active, you will enjoy only the bonuses associated with Warships Premium Account.

If you only have Wargaming Premium Account active, activating Warships Premium Account will bring you additional doubloons: 25 for each day when both types of Premium Accounts are simultaneously active.

[h1]Other discounts and bonuses:[/h1]
[list][*][b]+100%[/b] XP bonus for the first win of the day
[*][b]−80%[/b] to the cost in doubloons of training a new Commander
[*][b]–50%[/b] to the cost in doubloons of retraining a Commander for a new ship
[*][b]−50%[/b] to the cost in doubloons of a place in the Reserve
[*][b]−60%[/b] to the cost in doubloons or Elite Commander XP of resetting Commander skills[/list]
[h1][b][i]New Year Camouflage[/i][/b][/h1]
Make your ships stand out against the crowd for the New Year! The New Year permanent camouflage can be applied to the majority of Tier VIII ships for an elegant festive look—plus a dedicated holiday horn sound!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31013613/3e6535636dc39a0fd9993464040e04a90bb6c087.png[/img] [b]Bundles are available for purchase until:[/b] [b]Fri. 17 Jan. 06:00 CET (UTC+1)[/b]

[h1]Details[/h1]
The New Year permanent camouflage adds a unique Christmas horn for the ship. This permanent camo can be mounted on any Tier VIII battleship, cruiser, or destroyer, except for Tier VIII ARP Takao, Tier VIII HSF Harekaze, Tier VIII AL Yukikaze, and Tier VIII AL Montpelier. Once mounted on a ship, the camouflage acquires the properties of a typical permanent camouflage and is assigned to this ship.
You can have any number of New Year permanent camouflage patterns.

[h1][i]Features of the New Year permanent camouflage for Tier VIII ships:[/i][/h1]
[list][*]Unique Christmas horn
[*]–3% to the ship's detectability range by sea
[*]+4% to the dispersion of shells fired by enemies at your ship
[*]+50% XP per battle
[*]–10% to the cost of the ship's post-battle service[/list]
[img]https://wowsp-wows-eu.wgcdn.co/dcont/fb/image/tmb/af1a2120-1cce-11ea-b5d2-38eaa735f4cc_1200x.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][i]Armory[/i][/b][/h1]
[h1]The "Camouflages" Section[/h1]
We’ve added New Year permanent camouflages for Tier VIII ships that are available in exchange for doubloons.

[h1]The "Containers" Section[/h1]
[list][*]"Belle Époque" containers with collection elements of the same name are now available in exchange for Coal.
[*]Shipbuilding collection containers are available in exchange for doubloons. The containers will be available in the Armory until the release of Update 0.9.0.[/list]
[h1]The "Ships for Doubloons" Section[/h1]
[list][*][b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Japan_740b57e1da9b5d3fe46b61e09e3dcda1f34dfd7afdafe98714cb20012d5c1f0e.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/premium_4516ee494bb0396e51796cebff5e45c3f448d9790e0a58082057b8949ed9a3f8.png[/img] [b]VIII Kaga[/b][/b], [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_USA_dd9fc06d19a8638f4077ab2fe200d227bf8ac8784efe8f3313be33ebbf37ae19.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/premium_4516ee494bb0396e51796cebff5e45c3f448d9790e0a58082057b8949ed9a3f8.png[/img] [b]VIII Saipan[/b][/b], and [b][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/nation_flags/tiny/flag_Germany_18970d883c7758b53538983bd09ad0732491aaf593f95649ca630e16ab3fef30.png[/img][img]https://glossary-wows-global.gcdn.co/icons/vehicle/types/AirCarrier/premium_4516ee494bb0396e51796cebff5e45c3f448d9790e0a58082057b8949ed9a3f8.png[/img] [b]VIII Graf Zeppelin[/b][/b] have been added.[/list]
[h1][b][i]Coupons[/i][/b][/h1]
The replenishment date of the "Ships for Doubloons" coupon has been changed from March 14, 2020, to December 26, 2019. If you use your coupon prior to and including December 26, you'll be able to moor a new ship in your Port with a discount before the New Year.

As a New Year gift, we’ve added three single-use coupons for the "Ships for Doubloons" category, which grant 10%, 15%, and 20% discounts. The coupons will become available on December 26, and remain active until January 8.
