[b]Ship restrictions:[/b] Tier V–X.
[b]Battle Modes:[/b] Twilight Battle, operations, as well as Random, Co-op, and Clan Battles.
 [i]You can complete the combat mission once.[/i]

[h1] Black Friday Combat Mission: Part 4[/h1]
 In battles, earn 50,000 base XP.
[b]Reward:[/b] A Black Friday container.
[b]Ship restrictions:[/b] Tier V–X.
[b]Battle Modes:[/b] Twilight Battle, operations, as well as Random, Co-op, and Clan Battles. [i]You can complete the combat mission once.[/i]
You can complete the combat mission chain only once, and only in the specified sequence.
[b]Final reward:[/b] A Black Friday container.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/9ea8c53768a5ca1c44ffeb2a10230037735c6e56.jpg[/img]

[h1][b] Discounts and offers in the Premium Shop[/b][/h1]
[h1] Black Ships[/h1]
 This year, we welcome Black Friday with really black ships! Take advantage of our offer and purchase Tirpitz, Asashio, Atago, and Massachusetts with unique black camo patterns. Each of these bundles will contain a combat mission, by completing which you will earn additional doubloons.

 Please note that after you purchase bundles with black ships, these missions can only be completed on standard Tirpitz, Asashio, Atago, and Massachusetts ships.
[table][tr][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/b70ab916279e36f4a96523be356ebdc1a7e21757.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/b70ab916279e36f4a96523be356ebdc1a7e21757.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/206326c0637c9fc1c2abe8fb26c43d37e87696ea.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/206326c0637c9fc1c2abe8fb26c43d37e87696ea.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/55293ae8b8f09e65f56902d33cd7e20350f43b78.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/55293ae8b8f09e65f56902d33cd7e20350f43b78.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/8bf1e51cc4a5ba7b11b80524560745d10e1bd217.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/8bf1e51cc4a5ba7b11b80524560745d10e1bd217.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
 You can also purchase bundles with Premium Account time and doubloons, which will allow you to receive expendable black camouflage bundles as a gift!

 Please take note of the bundles with Mutsu and Perth ships that come with expendable camouflage patterns!

 Bundles are available for purchase until 6:00 (UTC) on December 7.

[h1] Collection Containers[/h1]
 Are you fond of collecting things? Then you might be interested in our offer of five containers from the previous collection, which you can get at a discounted price!

 Bundles are available for purchase until 6:00 (UTC) on December 7.

[h1] Black Friday Containers[/h1]
 For Black Friday, we prepared special themed containers. They will allow you to get a black ship!

A container can contain the following rewards:
[list][*]Black Tirpitz, Asashio, Atago, or Massachusetts ships
[*]10 "Type 59" camouflage patterns
[*]1,250 doubloons
[*]14 Premium days
[*]35,000 Free XP
[*]20 expendable black camo patterns.[/list]
 Those who have the bundle with 24 Black Friday containers will immediately get access to the mighty battleship Rasputin in the new Twilight Battle PvP mode! You can find more information about the new mode in a separate publication.

[quote] Note that battleship Rasputin will be removed from players' accounts after the release of Update 0.7.12.[/quote]

 Bundles are available for purchase until 6:00 (UTC) on December 7.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/7d3d10270475d2db308100ed960221a2f2753435.jpg[/img]

[h1] The Large Armada Bundle. The Greatest Offer![/h1]
 Do you want it all and now? We've sold various ship bundles since the release of this project. We decided, why not take advantage of an appropriate event such as Black Friday and give our players the opportunity to get almost all Premium ships?

 67 Premium ships, 67 slots, and huge discounts.

 Do you already have some of these ships? Don't worry! You will receive doubloons IN FULL for each Premium ship that you already have in your Port as compensation!

 Additionally, those who purchase this bundle will receive a commemorative flag as a gift!

 Gather your Armada!

 Bundles are available for purchase until 6:00 (UTC) on November 30.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/2d818de4782dd35550e67a6509d9f0493c87a33f.jpg[/img]

[h1] Black camouflage patterns + 30 Premium days[/h1]
 Stock up on black camouflage patterns and get 30 days of Premium Account time as a gift!

 Bundles are available for purchase until 6:00 (UTC) on November 30.

[h1] Thanksgiving Day Camouflage Patterns[/h1]
 Black Friday isn’t just about big discounts. It's also the first Friday after Thanksgiving Day—one of the most important holidays in the USA. For this reason, from November 22 to November 30, you have the chance to purchase bundles with fall camouflage patterns, which will give you the opportunity to get one or seven days of Premium Account time as a gift!

 Bundles are available for purchase until 6:00 (UTC) on November 30.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/6264e10ba4df56dfba445349d17722dd1bc6efcf.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Game Expert? Win Your Prize!
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/552990/discussions/8/1742226629854837325/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/99da16ba446d6131f4227781a9f9e8e2794a1a37.jpg[/img][/url]
Greetings, talented Captains!

Many Steamers have already been playing World of Warships for quite some time. If you happen to count yourself as one of these, we have a special contest for you. Whoever you might be, whether a celebrated sea dog, a competent game strategist, or a passionate ship collector—we invite you to join our quiz in a special [url=https://s.team/chat/WKlialR4][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/3ff5ce138630a38b7e370d6f72dcb847fb8906fe.jpg[/img]World of Warships Steam Chat[/url]!

[h1]The quizzes are scheduled for:[/h1]
[url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/converter.php?iso=20181122T160000&p1=1440][b]November, 22 16:00 UTC[/b][/url]
[url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/converter.php?iso=20181123T070000&p1=1440][b]November, 23 07:00 UTC[/b][/url]

Each quiz consists of 10 questions with varying levels of difficulty. The prize for each question is mentioned in brackets alongside it, as well as a code (Steam code or Wargaming code—to claim the second type you need to [url=https://wargaming.net/personal/]complete[/url] the registration of your Wargaming account). Steam codes are redeemable only within Steam.

You can win a code that grants you consumables or Steam DLC! And don’t be quick to leave our chat: it is the perfect place to find company to play with, or even get useful gameplay tips from some of our seasoned sea dogs!

Please read the full rules and discussion [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/552990/discussions/8/1742226629854837325/]here[/url].

Good luck!

notes.title: Update 0.7.11: Rule, Britannia!
notes.content:
[url=https://youtu.be/8lnFNZjSWQc][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/df6b3a7f1f3804defecb2ed834e794fd853a0546.jpg[/img][/url]
Please note that the servers will be temporarily unavailable due to the release of an update. The schedule is available below.

Maintenance times are tentative and subject to change. Please accept our apologies for any inconveniences.
[table][tr][td][b][url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/game-updates/update-0711-rule-britannia/]Asia[/url][/b][/td][td]22.11.2018 05:00—8:00 UTC+8[/td][td]2018-11-21 21:00—23:59 UTC[/td][/tr][tr][td][b][url=https://worldofwarships.ru/news/common/update-0711-rule-britannia/]CIS(Ru)[/url][/b][/td][td]21.11.2018 05:00—08:00 MSK (UTC+3)[/td]
[td]2018-11-21 02:00—05:00 UTC[/td][/tr][tr][td][b][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/game-updates/update-0711-rule-britannia/]EU[/url][/b][/td]
[td]22.11.2018 07:00—10:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/td][td]2018-11-22 05:00—08:00 UTC[/td][/tr][tr][td][b][url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/development/update-0711-rule-britannia/]NA[/url][/b][/td][td]21.11.2018 02:00 AM—05:00 AM PT (UTC–08)[/td][td]2018-11-21 10:00—13:00 UTC[/td][/tr][/table]
https://youtu.be/8lnFNZjSWQc
[h1][b]The Royal Navy Event[/b][/h1]
The upcoming version of the game includes the three final Stages of the Royal Navy event. The rules remain the same, with each Stage lasting for a week. The Stages consist of four Directives in which you need to complete a specified number of missions. Having completed a Stage, Directive, or mission, you will receive appropriate rewards that include game items, Guineas, and new Royal Navy containers with elements from the collection that we'll tell you a bit about later.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/499492ce238652d092d20cb585542b676ecd2cce.jpg[/img]
You can climb to the next Directive only upon the completion of a certain number of missions from the previous one, and not prior to its scheduled opening. You can complete the missions simultaneously and in any number of battles, unless otherwise indicated. So, don't worry if you are unable to get something done on the first attempt! All Directives will remain available to you until the respective Stage is over.

Once you’re through with all of the Directives, you'll be able to cross swords with other players in the Hall of Fame, to fight for the right to be heralded the "Best of the Best"!

[b]Royal Navy missions can be completed in any battle starting before the summing-up of the final scores in the Hall of Fame begins. Final scores are summed up once a week.[/b]

Each completed Directive brings you one Guinea, the currency required to get Premium Tier VIII destroyer Cossack. You can grab any missing number of Guineas that you might need in the Premium Shop.

[b]The rewards granted for entering the Hall of Fame remain the same.[/b]
Learn more about [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/game-updates/royal-navy/]the Royal Navy event and the Hall of Fame.[/url]

[h1][b]Collection[/b][/h1]
For the grand finale of the British Arc, players will be offered the chance to complete the Royal Navy Destroyers collection, which tells the story of the British Navy throughout the 20th century. Elements of the collection include the badges of British destroyers, episodes of battles and operations, and camouflage schemes. The collection consists of 16 elements divided into 4 thematic sections.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/b1c9c2c1054b0c149c363fd511e8a8be59160f47.jpg[/img]
[b]The elements of the collection can be obtained in two ways:[/b]
[list][*]From British containers issued for the completion of missions during the Royal Navy event.
[*]From daily containers, provided that you enable the relevant subscription in the collection tab after receiving your first element.[/list]
Once you are through with each of the collection’s sections, you will be given a chance to mount a second flag on British destroyers, cruisers, battleships, and ships of the Commonwealth.

The ultimate reward for completing the entire collection is a permanent camouflage scheme for VII Haida and VIII Lightning, as well as a special achievement.

[b]Camouflage features:[/b] [list][*]–10% to the cost of the ship's post-battle service
[*]+50% XP earned per battle
[*]–3% to detectability range by sea
[*]+4% to dispersion of shells fired by enemies attacking your ship[/list]
Take a closer look at [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/game-updates/rn-dd-collection/]the Royal Navy Destroyers collection[/url].

[h1][b]Twilight Battle[/b][/h1]
Commanders, we invite you to take part in naval clashes in a new battle type, based on a reworked version of the "Battle Royale" format.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/320c43346896399f02de6bdaf43dfdcb8d6cfbab.jpg[/img]
Battles will be held in a 7x7 format on the map from Operation "Sunray in the Darkness". Twilight Battles will be available for players who have reached Level 12 or higher in their Service Record. The primary objective is to destroy all enemy ships. But stay alert! The Filth will be seizing more and more of the sea’s surface, narrowing the safe zone for your ships. Beyond the safe zone, ships rapidly lose their HP!

You can take part in the battle with one of the eight ships of the Forces of Darkness that you are probably familiar with from the Halloween-themed Operations. Battle it out with Razorworm, Ghoul, Octopus, Leviathan, Scarab, Steel Rat, Varg, and the ferocious and mighty battleship Rasputin!
[table][tr][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/8d3af501687a3df4bfa83dd6c89dd87aa91134bd.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/8d3af501687a3df4bfa83dd6c89dd87aa91134bd.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/7dd9dad2624b81c3310861cc15f9a2323ac608dd.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/7dd9dad2624b81c3310861cc15f9a2323ac608dd.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/5a1da27fd9c4eed6c07b0ebf2d1d8a7e4e7a1f0f.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/5a1da27fd9c4eed6c07b0ebf2d1d8a7e4e7a1f0f.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/9e5fbbf7dcb54ffb24dde6fe71fb197bfb8ca4e6.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/9e5fbbf7dcb54ffb24dde6fe71fb197bfb8ca4e6.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/db5a500e180cddc3f4902179a8a9243e0b65b695.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/db5a500e180cddc3f4902179a8a9243e0b65b695.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/b955a387108ad9e0c2e0d8eb1e9d454d3e1edded.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/b955a387108ad9e0c2e0d8eb1e9d454d3e1edded.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/02a315f7cd44f0ac5eb3e7d412502bb86cafaa01.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/02a315f7cd44f0ac5eb3e7d412502bb86cafaa01.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/2d5ef04200d8a07b0795021706fcbc8a091a20d2.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/2d5ef04200d8a07b0795021706fcbc8a091a20d2.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
Initially, only three of these ships will be available: Ghoul, Octopus, and Leviathan. From November 26, the remaining steel monsters will manifest in your Ports at twilight, once you've secured a number of victorious Twilight Battles. Expect a Combat Mission to get Rasputin to be available right from the start!

By the way, your first win with Rasputin will bring you a special achievement!

As a pleasant bonus, each ship comes with their own unique consumables. For example, restore your HP by damaging opponents, or avoid dangerous encounters by reducing your detectability. Come to the aid of your allies by providing them with an extra charge of consumables, or turn your ship 180 degrees in a single moment! And these possibilities form just part of the opportunities in combat that are set to open up for you in Twilight Battles!
[i]For more details on the new battle type, read a dedicated article set for release tomorrow. The article also contains the conclusion of the story that puts an end to the chronicles of the Silver Spear Archipelago.[/i]

[h1][b]Clan Battles: "North" Season[/b][/h1]
Season 4 of Clan Battles is about to kick off! Secure your victory by clashing at sea—and get Steel for the Arsenal in return!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/185492d407e9e8d7f571c4d321d4fc58eb56b3ba.jpg[/img]
[quote][b]From November 28 until December 4, all players who join at least one Clan Battle will be able to redistribute the skill points of their Commanders for free.[/b][/quote]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/9030731ca73c0232e2d5539e1ab04bd0a514fe89.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/9030731ca73c0232e2d5539e1ab04bd0a514fe89.jpg[/img][/url]
Learn more about [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/game-updates/clan-battles-north/]Season "North"[/url].

[h1][b]Arsenal Overhaul[/b][/h1]
[quote]With the new Update, we are set to remove all items from the Royal Navy category in the Arsenal, except for British DD VIII Cossack. Sovereigns will be exchanged for credits at a rate of 1:25,000.

Guineas will be available in the game client until Update 0.7.12 reaches its conclusion, after which they will be exchanged for credits at the rate of 1 Guinea = 100,000 credits.[/quote]
In Update 0.7.11, the Arsenal is set to offer players a new ship, French BB X Bourgogne. Grab it for 30,000 Steel!
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/49186ec19f11dce7c8fb70c681a778344e9a9d8f.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/49186ec19f11dce7c8fb70c681a778344e9a9d8f.jpg[/img][/url]
The French steel monster carries three 380 mm quadruple turrets. Despite her relatively small caliber, Bourgogne takes her toll with her efficient main gun reload time in combination with the Main Battery Reload Booster consumable she carries on board. In terms of her standard rate of fire, at present Bourgogne comes second only to her fellow ship République. However, compared against her peers, Bourgogne carries a relatively moderate HP pool, and weaker armor protection. The battleship's secondary battery has a standard reach of 7.5 km which will certainly help you in close-range combat. The AA mounts onboard are efficient enough to make any hostile aircraft carrier think twice before targeting the French ship. Apart from these features, Bourgogne is equipped with the Engine Boost consumable typical of French battleships, allowing her to make over 37 knots!
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/824196cdb122b1e6414c0b355a986a157bd75d55.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/824196cdb122b1e6414c0b355a986a157bd75d55.jpg[/img][/url]
Get this warship at the Arsenal along with a Commander with three skill points, a Port slot, and a special permanent camouflage that provides the following bonuses:
[list][*]–3% to your ship's detectability range by sea
[*]+4% to dispersion of shells fired by enemies attacking your ship
[*]–50% to the cost of your ship's post-battle service
[*]+20% credits earned per battle
[*]+100% XP per battle[/list]
[h1][b]Thunderstorm Front in Random Battles[/b][/h1]
In Operation Hermes, we tested the Thunderstorm Front, a new mechanic that affects events happening within a particular region of the map. The mechanics received a warm welcome from players, so we decided to test it further in Random Battles.
[table][tr][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/ecf5a41d4fcbcdf70d891c14045b17bc87235c82.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/ecf5a41d4fcbcdf70d891c14045b17bc87235c82.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/8af491e44fd5a0cb5dc8283f8c322de68e924864.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/8af491e44fd5a0cb5dc8283f8c322de68e924864.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/740c857549ae7e256483698474d997df873e7b6e.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/740c857549ae7e256483698474d997df873e7b6e.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/4fa30ccb25ca5bcaefd0eb93f7246aa26f1f6ee8.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/4fa30ccb25ca5bcaefd0eb93f7246aa26f1f6ee8.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr]
[tr][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/34ee4df2237117350805f06dde675dcdb121f488.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/34ee4df2237117350805f06dde675dcdb121f488.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/b581989e2f7c2ac7d3e8a67b7cff7253f546e0a7.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/b581989e2f7c2ac7d3e8a67b7cff7253f546e0a7.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/617a94d67de88368ea3a559c07150fa5861534dd.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/617a94d67de88368ea3a559c07150fa5861534dd.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
[b]The Thunderstorm Front will appear only in Tier X battles on the following three maps:[/b]
[list][*]"North" (Domination mode)
[*]"Hotspot" (Domination mode)
[*]"Islands of Ice" (Epicenter)[/list]
However, the Cyclone effect will no longer be present on these maps.

[b]Battles featuring the Thunderstorm Front will only be available for ships of Tier VIII, IX and X.[/b]

The visual appearance of the Thunderstorm Front varies depending on the terrain and weather—but we can tell you that you’re in for rain and blizzards!

On the Minimap, the Thunderstorm area is depicted as a gray circle. A special indicator notifies you upon approaching and entering an area affected by the Thunderstorm Front. The changing weather conditions will make it harder to detect ships both by air and by sea: with the detectability range of destroyers and the other types of ships reduced by 10% and 20%, respectively. The visibility range is reduced to 30 km; the period of increased detectability of a ship after firing the main guns is also reduced, returning to normal in 7 seconds instead of 20 seconds; and the maximum dispersion of shells in the area affected by the foul weather increases by a multiple of 1.3. The Thunderstorm Front does not have any effect on the operation of a ship's consumables.

If there is an area of foul weather between ships, their detectability is calculated taking into account the visibility modifier. However, this does not affect potential third observers whose line of sight doesn't cross (or run through) the Thunderstorm Front zone.

In Epicenter mode, bad weather can move along the map left to right, or vice versa, or can even stay motionless in the center of the map.

[h1][b]Matchmaker Optimization[/b][/h1]
In response to numerous requests from our players, we are improving the matchmaker and enhancing the algorithms responsible for creating teams. This change will be more relevant to Tier VIII–X ships. [u][b]Tier X battles will have fewer Tier VIII and IX ships as these will more often be matched to Tier VIII and IX battles.[/b][/u]

[h1][b]Game Mechanics[/b][/h1]
In Update 0.7.11 we are changing the damage mechanics of AP shells, to prevent rare cases where large-caliber shells inflicted excessive damage to destroyers. This occurred when a shell hit destroyer's armor at a sharp angle. The thickness of the effective armor allowed the shell to arm and cause considerable damage inside the ship's hull.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/ebe5676a06ff7406becb39afc8c76266b07c40f2.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/ebe5676a06ff7406becb39afc8c76266b07c40f2.jpg[/img][/url]
The standard damage that destroyers normally receive from a heavy shell hitting their hull should be equal to the damage caused by an over-penetrating shell. However, in the situation mentioned above, the received damage value exceeded that of an over-penetration, amounting to approximately 1/3 of a shell's maximum damage. Thus, a tiny destroyer with a pool of HP that could hardly be called impressively large, had the potential to lose most of her health points as a result of a single hit.

In Update 0.7.11, we introduce a limit on the maximum damage that an AP shell can cause to all destroyers, with the exception of Khabarovsk and Harugumo. Damage to a ship's HP caused by an AP shell with a caliber of 280 mm and larger, will no longer exceed 10% of the maximum possible damage that such shell may cause. Although 10% might seem to be rather a small value, a hit of this type will still inflict significant damage to destroyers.

This change won’t affect destroyers Harugumo and Khabarovsk, because the damage they currently take is already within expected limits. Any further reduction would make these two ships too powerful.

This adjustment will certainly change the course of encounters between destroyers and larger ships carrying main battery guns with a caliber of 280 mm and above. Now, their Captains will have to be more cautious when selecting which shell type to use, being sure to take into account the circumstances of a given situation in battle. A close-range salvo with AP shells will still cause considerable damage to a destroyer, making her think twice before mounting a close quarters torpedo attack upon an enemy ship.

We have also changed the mechanics of the torpedo damage dealt to a completely destroyed part of a ship. Now, a torpedo hitting a ship in any such part will cause guaranteed damage of 10% of the maximum damage it could potentially cause. This will prevent situations in which a destroyer could suffer multiple torpedo hits, but stay afloat simply because the affected part of her hull had no HP left to lose.

[i]The specified changes may, of course, affect the combat performance of ships. But rest assured, we will carefully monitor player statistics and take all required measures should the combat performance of any ships drop below established limits.[/i]

[h1][b]Game Balance Changes[/b][/h1]
[i]Please see full list of ship changes on the website.[/i]

[h1][b]Distinctive Insignias[/b][/h1]
Emblems show both your skill and combat experience. Previously, World of Warships featured emblems attributable only to ship types and nations.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/d6f692ecc186d1ca7948fdcdbf580cb0c7e6dfc4.jpg[/img]
Update 0.7.11 brings the new emblems: "Ranked Battles Expert" and "Clan Battles Expert".

Both emblems represent your skills and gaming experience earned in the two competitive modes: Ranked and Clan Battles.

[b]Ranked Battles Expert I–IV[/b]
[table][tr][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/ba846c352eed56406a0471df1e0fa33c43a81a4d.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/ba846c352eed56406a0471df1e0fa33c43a81a4d.png[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/228993eb4bc54bd70b3d60542fde9b8eb92d54f9.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/228993eb4bc54bd70b3d60542fde9b8eb92d54f9.png[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/496ce12bc13b756c3fdae10255eea5474a2a9f72.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/496ce12bc13b756c3fdae10255eea5474a2a9f72.png[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/8dc130a6c4c05d1fa680806fa4df6a4985355bd3.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/8dc130a6c4c05d1fa680806fa4df6a4985355bd3.png[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
Earning conditions:
[list][*]Ranked Battles Expert I: Earn 30 unique stars in Ranked Battles
[*]Ranked Battles Expert II: Earn 70 unique stars in Ranked Battles
[*]Ranked Battles Expert III: Earn 140 unique stars in Ranked Battles
[*]Ranked Battles Expert IV: Earn 210 unique stars in Ranked Battles.[/list]
[i]A unique star is a star you get for the first time in a victorious Ranked Battle. Subsequent receipt of the same stars is not taken into account. Any stars you receive in Ranked Battle Sprints are not taken into account.[/i]

[b]Clan Battles Expert I–IV[/b]
[table][tr][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/de5b687bd59402818bf20f39c18905146dc906e4.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/de5b687bd59402818bf20f39c18905146dc906e4.png[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/1c517cc5e5d5e448792e2d01cd3550c67f9fc276.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/1c517cc5e5d5e448792e2d01cd3550c67f9fc276.png[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/d3dfee5c6d51b8c7f614d06c0b562f9bf009c103.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/d3dfee5c6d51b8c7f614d06c0b562f9bf009c103.png[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/467992ad32a41c0d9672d9c1f2de5cf63690866c.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/467992ad32a41c0d9672d9c1f2de5cf63690866c.png[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
Earning conditions:
[list][*]Clan Battles Expert I: Win 90 battles in the Gale League or any of the higher leagues
[*]Clan Battles Expert II: Win 90 battles in the Storm League or any of the higher leagues
[*]Clan Battles Expert III: Win 90 battles in the Typhoon League or any of the higher leagues
[*]Clan Battles Expert IV: Win 90 battles in the Hurricane League.[/list]
Any previous achievements will not be counted. Once Update 0.7.11 goes live, all players will have an equal chance in the "race" for the new emblems.

For more details about the insignia, read [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/en/news/game-updates/salty-sea-dog/]a dedicated article.[/url]

[h1][b]Port of Zipangu[/b][/h1]
In Update 0.7.11, we'll enhance the visuals of the Port of Zipangu. The town at the bottom of Fuji is covered with snow, and night has descended in the wait for the New Year’s. Light snowflakes are falling on trees and nearshore ice-floats.

We also added decorations and new sound effects.
[table][tr][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/998e5e05dd6509690aafc300ce387f39daefbded.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/998e5e05dd6509690aafc300ce387f39daefbded.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/60fb317e7b3160bdb33a4c7a6ba5b8efef09dc29.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/60fb317e7b3160bdb33a4c7a6ba5b8efef09dc29.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/a232a14e24c0e8f9096341799da0e77b6d9741ce.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/a232a14e24c0e8f9096341799da0e77b6d9741ce.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/fe0c7e32ea19ac4b2e5565fd41ac28e34902a185.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/fe0c7e32ea19ac4b2e5565fd41ac28e34902a185.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]

[h1][b]Daily Shipments[/b][/h1]
All players who enter the game during the period from November 23 to December 6 will find that they have access to shipments codenamed "Black Friday"! You can receive the following rewards simply for logging into the game on a regular basis:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/d587a910e5569e131c5d77afb3810fa2aab4ac85.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/d587a910e5569e131c5d77afb3810fa2aab4ac85.jpg[/img][/url]
[list][*]3x "Shadow Lurker" camo
[*]50,000 credits
[*]50,000 credits
[*]500 Coal
[*]1x standard Black Friday container
[*]50,000 credits
[*]5x "Shadow Lurker" camo
[*]500 Coal
[*]50 doubloons
[*]2x standard Black Friday containers[/list]
You can get a total of 10 rewards, with shipments delivered to your Ports for a period 14 days. Thus, you can skip 4 days out of two weeks, but still be able to get all of the rewards! Daily Shipments for Black Friday will be available to players who have reached Level 9 in their Service Record.

[h1][b]Content Additions and Changes[/b][/h1]
[h1]Musashi and Kronshtadt[/h1]
[quote]Starting from [b]update 0.8.0[/b], Tier IX ships Musashi and Kronshtadt will no longer be available to purchase with Free XP and also cannot be obtained for Coal in the game client.[/quote]
These ships are becoming extremely popular for their tier, and to avoid Tier IX battles becoming packed with them, as well as to maintain diversity, we decided to remove the possibility of purchasing or obtaining these ships for an indefinite period. As such, they have already been replaced with French Tier IX battleship Jean Bart, with plans in progress to introduce another ship of the same tier in future.

We understand that accumulating resources for these ships is a long process, which is why we wanted to warn you in advance so that those of you who are interested can steer these ships into your Ports before Update 0.8.0 goes live. You have approximately two months remaining to get Musashi and Kronshtadt.

[h1]Test Ships[/h1]
The following ships were added for testing by developers, supertesters, and community contributors:
[list][*]Soviet Tier VII cruiser Lazo
[*]Pan-Asian Tier VIII cruiser Irian[/list]
[b]In the game client, the following ships are now available for purchase in exchange for doubloons: Admiral Graf Spee, Z-39, Hood, Texas, Sims, Indianapolis, Ishizuchi, Mutsu, Atago, Okhotnik, Dunkerque, Duca degli Abruzzi, and Anshan.

The following ships will no longer be available for doubloons in the game client: Prinz Eugen, Duke of York, Arizona, Katori, Kii, and Aigle.[/b]

[h1]Patches, Emblems, and Flags[/h1]
We added the Mod Maker, Alpha and Beta Tester, W. Virginia 1941, and Czechoslovakian Legion patches, as well as the Supertester and Mod Maker emblems.

Added a Collectors Club emblem with 4 grades as well as a patch and a background.

Added a flag, patch, camouflage, and containers for WG Fest participants.

[h1]Black Friday[/h1]
Black Friday containers are coming to the game! They can bring you one of the following items:
[list][*]Tirpitz B
[*]Atago B
[*]Asashio B
[*]Massachusetts B
[*]2x "Type 59" camo
[*]250 doubloons
[*]1 day of Premium Account time
[*]5,000 Free XP
[*]4x "Shadow Lurker" camo[/list]
The Premium Shop will offer Black Friday Premium Containers with the following loot options:
[list][*]Tirpitz B
[*]Atago B
[*]Asashio B
[*]Massachusetts B
[*]10x "Type 59" camo
[*]1,250 doubloons
[*]14 days of Premium Account time
[*]35,000 Free XP
[*]20x "Shadow Lurker" camo[/list]
The following four ships were added: Tirpitz B, Atago B, Asashio B, and Massachusetts B. The ships can be distinguished by the color schemes of their permanent camo, and are completely identical to the "original" ships in terms of combat characteristics;
[table][tr][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/b70ab916279e36f4a96523be356ebdc1a7e21757.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/b70ab916279e36f4a96523be356ebdc1a7e21757.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/206326c0637c9fc1c2abe8fb26c43d37e87696ea.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/206326c0637c9fc1c2abe8fb26c43d37e87696ea.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/55293ae8b8f09e65f56902d33cd7e20350f43b78.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/55293ae8b8f09e65f56902d33cd7e20350f43b78.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/8bf1e51cc4a5ba7b11b80524560745d10e1bd217.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/8bf1e51cc4a5ba7b11b80524560745d10e1bd217.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]

[h1]Other[/h1]
[list][*]Added an option to switch language in the game client to Dutch.
[*]Since the event dedicated to Alexander Ovechkin is now over, the "Four-Goal Haul" achievement is no longer available.
[*]The following warships may now appear in Supercontainers: Kronshtadt, Missouri and Musashi.[/list]
[h1][b]Diagnostic improvements[/b][/h1]
[h1]Creating Replays[/h1]
With the release of Update 0.7.11, you will be able to record replays of your battles in World of Warships. Every player will have their 30 most recent battles recorded and stored in the /replays folder. Any previous, "older" replays will be overwritten. This feature will allow players to provide more details of any occurring issue when contacting Player Support. You can adjust the number of recorded replays using the maxReplaysToSave setting in the configuration file.

[h1]Crash Reports[/h1]
In Update 0.7.10 we introduced a system that generates a special report every time a critical error occurs. All such reports are stored in the /reports folder. With the launch of Update 0.7.11, such reports will be sent directly to the World of Warships Dev Team, so that we can have access to all information relating to any incidents that occur.

[i]Technical data is collected in accordance with Clause 4 of [url=http://legal.eu.wargaming.net/en/privacy-policy-new/]the Privacy Policy in effect at Wargaming[/url], solely with the purpose of analyzing a particular incident; no personal data of any player will be used for any purpose whatsoever.[/i]

[table][tr][th][h1][b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/552990/discussions/8/3020122487791997422/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/3ff5ce138630a38b7e370d6f72dcb847fb8906fe.jpg[/img]Discuss the update here[/url][/b][/h1][/th][/tr][/table]

notes.title: Ranked Sprint: Season 2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/5998d9e6c274c7aaa3278deac00a70e064b54734.jpg[/img]
A short and dynamic season on [b]Tier V ships, with the ability to form a Division.[/b] One of the features is that the duration of the sprint season will be significantly less time than usual. The Sea Wolves' League will be unavailable.

[b]The new format is designed more for newcomers, however all players can test their strength in the sprint. Show what you've got and fight together with your friends![/b]

[h1][b]Basic Rules[/b][/h1]
[h1]The Second Season[/h1]
[b]Start:[/b] Thu. Nov. 01
[b]End:[/b] Tue. Nov. 13

[h1]Rules[/h1]
[list][*]Players need to have Service Record level 14 to participate in Ranked Battles.
[*]By winning battles, players earn the stars needed to climb the ranking ladder. At the majority of ranks, a defeat means a lost star.
[*]The player with the most base XP in a team doesn't lose a star upon a defeat.
[*]Team lineups are mirrored in terms of ship types and tiers.
[*]The number of ranks is 10, which is less than in a regular season.
[*]The ranks are combined into two leagues: the first league is from rank 10 through rank 6, and the second league is from rank 5 through rank 1.
[*]Players can fight only on Tier V ships.
[*]All players start battles in rank 10.
[*]Ranks 10, 9, 8, 5, and 3 are irrevocable. Players can't lose stars in ranks 10 and 9.
[*]Players receive a bonus star for each new rank acquired.
[*]The first season is played 6 vs. 6.
[*]The second season is played 8 vs. 8.[/list]
[i]Ranked Sprint doesn't inherit achievements from previous Ranked Seasons and doesn't affect those in future.[/i]

[h1][u]Divisions[/u][/h1]
[list][*][b]Players can form Divisions in the Ranked Battles.[/b]
[*]Maximum number of players in a Division is 2.
[*]A Division can enter battle only if the opposing team also has a Division.
[*]Depending on the season, a team can have 3-4 Divisions maximum.
[*]Players from different leagues can't play in a single Division.
[*]There is a maximum of one aircraft carrier for a team and a Division.[/list]
[table][tr][th][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/552990/discussions/8/1734343428035047628/][h1][b][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/da8a344f302497e3a49a0dc860f7c52b481ba719.png[/img]Find division mates here[/b][/h1][/url][/th][th][url=https://s.team/chat/WKlialR4][h1][b][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/3ff5ce138630a38b7e370d6f72dcb847fb8906fe.jpg[/img]Or in Steam game chat[/b][/h1][/url][/th][/tr][/table]

[h1]The First Rank[/h1]
[list][*]The first rank is the final achievable one.
[*]Players who reach the first rank can no longer participate in further battles of the current season.
[*]The Sea Wolves' League is unavailable.[/list]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/369a0595a77f9e81cfd7194e0f06ae17eda60b2e.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/369a0595a77f9e81cfd7194e0f06ae17eda60b2e.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Maps[/b][/h1]
Battles will be fought on the following maps:
[list][*]Archipelago
[*]Ring
[*]Strait
[*]Big Race (Epicenter)
[*]New Dawn
[*]Trident[/list]
On all the maps, the following parameters will be applied:
[list][*]Number of key areas: 3
[*]Capture time: 40 seconds
[*]Points for capturing key areas: 2 points per 3 seconds[/list]

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/969f7de57e0d5722353dac1c7aa75d77abb65b5c.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/969f7de57e0d5722353dac1c7aa75d77abb65b5c.jpg[/img][/url]
+ improvement of your skill level. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Premium Shop: New Halloween Items
notes.content:
[url=https://youtu.be/I9DtHEKpXFI][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/f880bf791452d7b8e292fafaa7de0a6db7c26406.jpg[/img][/url]
Halloween has come, enshrouding World of Warships with a macabre atmosphere.
https://youtu.be/I9DtHEKpXFI
Submarines are the long-awaited new type in World of Warships. However, they will be available exclusively in the new operation. While steering this new type, you have to master a new dimension—depth. You will be able to maneuver freely between the water’s surface, periscope depth, and deep waters. Every change in depth will affect your visibility and attack capabilities. You will get a chance to see the beauty of the underwater world and use submersion as a tactical maneuver—you can attack the enemy with your bow armament, and, on some submarines, having passed your enemy underneath, deliver a salvo from the stern.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/dcabee42a4f8d42f9589cd577828b53807db4857.jpg[/img]
Become familiar with the new type, and break into the World of Darkness. Complete all challenges, with each challenge more difficult than the previous one and face the ultimate foe—Battleship Rasputin. You’ll have a choice of standard or more difficult modes. Select the standard mode if you’d like to get familiar with the new submarine mechanics, while a more difficult variant will allow you to truly immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the game.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/493e4e324afa8aa289a7d2b4744edc07f0fbe62e.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/493e4e324afa8aa289a7d2b4744edc07f0fbe62e.jpg[/img][/url]
[h1]For this operation we have introduced five submarines with special commanders featuring 19 skill points:[/h1]
[list][*][b]Barracuda (Commander: Victor F. Einstein)[/b]: a submarine with the biggest oxygen reserve. It also features the best survivability and is equipped with the most efficient secondary guns.

It will become available in your Port, when Operation "Terror of the Deep" becomes Operation of the Week.

[*] [b]Zipper Sub (Commander: Mina Hurray)[/b]: dives and surfaces faster then any other submarine. It suddenly attacks enemies and vanishes without a trace.

    Zipper Sub with Commander Mina Hurray will become available if you get five stars in Operation "Saving Transylvania" or earn 5,000 Experience in Operation "Terror of the Deep".

[*] [b]Gerfalcon (Commander: Ivan K. Ulibin)[/b]: features the best speed compared to other submarines and can surprise its enemies with the torpedo tubes mounted at the stern.

    Gerfalcon with Commander Ivan K. Ulibin will become available if you get five stars in Operation "Sunray in the Darkness"/"Sunray in the Darkness (Hard difficulty) or earn 10,000 Experience in Operation "Terror of the Deep".

[*] [b]Seelöwe (Commander: Lazarus Centurio)[/b]: equipped with the most powerful bow armament.

    Seelöwe with Commander Lazarus Centurio will become available if you earn five stars in Operation "Terror of the Deep"/"Terror of the Deep (Hard difficulty)".

notes.title: Le Terrible
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/dfc8502cc294e4481d09548b6159ca0e03f8abba.png[/img]
Named using a 17th century French naval convention, Le Terrible would see action on the Allied side during both the first and last years of the war, but was also set against the Allies in the service of the Vichy French state between 1940 and 1942. At the outbreak of the Second World War, Le Terrible was part of the most powerful squadron of the French Navy—the Force de Raid, based in the Atlantic Port of Brest. This fleet, under the command of Admiral Gensoul, included the modern battleships Dunkerque and Strasbourg, aircraft carrier Béarn, three La Galissonnière-class cruisers, and eight superdestroyers.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/402a2307cdd093fddf483e7b27cf977c0fbe7ef5.jpg[/img]
Le Terrible is a relatively large destroyer with a good pool of HP, powerful main guns, and decent torpedo armament. During her sea trials, this contre-torpilleur reached a top speed that remains unsurpassed by any destroyer since. In the game, the ship retains that feature: Le Terrible is lightning fast, letting her set the pace of any naval encounter. The ship focuses on conducting purely offensive operations: she carries an Engine Boost consumable as well as a Main Battery Reload Booster, mounted in place of a Smoke Generator, a feature not typically found on destroyers. Feel the ride!

[h1]Key features:[/h1]
[list][*]Effective main battery guns: five 139 mm guns with a 12.3 km reach. Rate of fire: 12 shots per minute; maximum damage for an HE shell: 2,000 HP; maximum damage for an AP shell: 2,700 HP.
[*]Three triple-tubed torpedo launchers with a torpedo range of 8 km. But, although that distance is pretty average, the maximum damage the ship's torpedoes can deal is an astounding 18,400 HP.
[*]A high stock speed of 43 knots. Potentially, the ship can be boosted even further to reach an eyebrow-raising 53.8 knots.
[*]Lack of smoke is compensated by an ability to temporarily buff the ship's firepower using the Main Battery Reload Booster consumable. With an operation time of 15 seconds, the consumable provides a twofold increase in the ship's rate of fire.
[*]Standard detectability range is 8.5 km.
[*]Extra credits per battle and 50% more XP provided by the permanent camouflage.[/list]
https://youtu.be/U1ovY0HumY4
If you already have this ship in your Port, you will receive 8,075 doubloons as compensation.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/ae648a3138e37065f9da00d2e16422adaf1a65d5.jpg[/img]
Please note the following: through to December 31, 6:00 (UTC), owners of this bundle will have access to a special combat mission that enables faster progress through the game. The first 25 battles played with destroyer Le Terrible in any battle type will bring you three times as much XP than usual. You can receive this combat mission only once per account.

Learn more about the ship on our website or through our in-game browser!

notes.title: Update 0.7.10: British destroyers and Halloween
notes.content:
[url=https://youtu.be/OGkpn7pWqbs][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/1a87c880839cf95b35466f1fa7f45c5f7b099a52.jpg[/img][/url]
Please note that the servers will be temporarily unavailable due to the release of an update. The schedule is available below.

Maintenance times are tentative and subject to change. Please accept our apologies for any inconveniences.
[table][tr][td][b][url=https://worldofwarships.asia/news/game-updates/update-0710-halloween/]Asia[/url][/b][/td]
[td]18.10.2018 05:00—8:00 UTC+8[/td]
[td]2018-10-17 21:00—23:59 UTC[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][b][url=https://worldofwarships.ru/news/common/update-0710/]CIS(Ru)[/url][/b][/td]

[td]2018-10-17 02:00—05:00 UTC[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][b][url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/game-updates/update-0710-halloween/]EU[/url][/b][/td]
[td]18.10.2018 07:00—10:00 CEST (UTC+2)[/td]
[td]2018-10-18 05:00—08:00 UTC[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][b][url=https://worldofwarships.com/news/development/update-0710-halloween/]NA[/url][/b][/td]
[td]17.10.2018 03:00 AM—06:00 AM PT (UTC–07)[/td]
[td]2018-10-17 10:00—13:00 UTC[/td][/tr][/table]
https://youtu.be/OGkpn7pWqbs Subtitles can be enabled in the video player separately.

[h1][b]Royal Navy[/b][/h1]
[h1]British Destroyers[/h1]
The British Arc frenzy gains momentum in World of Warships as Update 0.7.10 brings in a complete tech tree of U.K. destroyers. These ships all come with a feature to boast: the ability to fire torpedoes individually, one at a time; unique smoke screens; and the Hydroacoustic Search and Repair Party consumables for high tiers. 
More details about the new ships and the equipment they carry are available [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/game-updates/royal-navy-destoryers-ammunition/]in a dedicated article.[/url]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/044befc42b6fa82f5649fafedb7ea8caf55d88b1.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Royal Navy Event[/h1]
Update 0.7.10 will last for as long as five weeks instead of the standard four. Therefore, the Royal Navy event will comprise five Stages instead of four. Update 0.7.11, however, will consist of three Stages only.[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/3e0c4dab8340c38bc93e573d3325c0e072685461.jpg[/img]
Update 0.7.10 brings new Stages for the Royal Navy event. Each Stage will last for a week and each of them will be broken down into four Directives, with each of these containing a predetermined number of missions. Complete Stages, Directives and missions to get the respective rewards, ranging from in-game loot to Guineas and new Halloween-themed containers.

To climb to the next Directive, complete a certain number of missions from the preceding Directive. Missions can be accomplished simultaneously and in any number of battles, unless indicated otherwise, so don't worry if you are unable to get something done on the first attempt! All Directives remain available to you until the respective Stage is over.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/477badabb37568639e132aad86241fb1e4cbfcfc.jpg[/img]
[quote]When Update 0.7.10 goes live, Sovereigns will no longer be issued for completing missions, but will still be available in Premium and standard containers throughout Update 0.7.10. Exchange your well-deserved resources for a wide variety of valuable rewards in the Arsenal until the end of the current update.[/quote]
Right now, you can continue to collect Guineas to gain a solid discount for UK tier VIII DD Cossack and acquire any missing number of Guineas [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/952390/World_of_Warships__10_Guineas/]at the Premium Shop[/url].

The tech tree with British destroyers is now available for research, and accordingly we have changed the rewards for places in the Hall of Fame:
[table][tr][td][b]Top League[/b][/td][td]Top 5% best players[/td][td]3x Mosaic camo[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][b]Diamond League[/b][/td][td]5%-10% best players[/td][td]3x Asian Lantern camo[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][b]Golden League[/b][/td][td]10%-25% best players[/td][td]3x Spring Sky camo[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][b]Silver League[/b][/td][td]25%-50% best players[/td][td]3x Type 59 camo[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][b]Bronze League[/b][/td][td]Players who earned at least 1 point by the Hall of Fame rules[/td][td]3x Union Jack camo[/td][/tr][/table]
In the new update, the majority of the missions for the Royal Navy event will be available for completion in Random, Co-op and Ranked Battles. Some part of the missions can also be completed in the operations dedicated to Halloween!

[h1][b]Halloween[/b][/h1]
[i]Please note that any stars you earned previously for completing Operations "Saving Transylvania" and "Sunray in the Darkness" will be reset, and you will be able to earn the rewards again![/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/9b8078a1bc8c155697748e8a0ff7cf675a2ce315.jpg[/img]

[h1]Saving Transylvania and Sunray in the Darkness[/h1]
On the night of October 31–November 1, vast hordes of dismal evil creatures squeeze out of their shelters to creep around the globe, with the objective of conquering new lands. We invite you to take part in the past operations to keep the evil at bay! Save Transylvania and defend the waters of the Silver Spear Archipelago from the invading forces of darkness in Operation "Sunray in the Darkness". We should also mention that the operation we've just spoken of is now available in Hard Difficulty mode. If you feel like you are a pro-hunter and can put together a team strong enough to accomplish this, try your luck and do it the hard way!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/5b365a906d47cb1eecb9f8c3ad54f3ccb086a699.jpg[/img]
For Operation "Saving Transylvania", we'll provide players with the following ships, manned by Commanders with 19 skill points:
[list][*]Destroyer Blade (Commander: Abraham V. Hellsinger)
[*]Battleship Jackal (Commander: Henry J. Hide)
[*]Cruiser Igor (Commander: Victor F. Einstein)[/list]
Commanders may be freely moved between any special ships but may not be placed at the controls of other regular ships.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/32c9fd54d2c451a0132ca2d09329fe9ec034136a.jpg[/img]
In Operation "Sunray in the Darkness", players will get the following ships manned by Commanders with 19 skill points:
[list][*]Destroyer Urashima (Commander: Mina Hurray)
[*]Cruiser Svyatozar (Commander: Ivan K. Ulibin
[*]Battleship Magnu-S (Commander: Klaus V. Teslau)
[*]Aircraft carrier Nobilium (Commander: Lazarus Centurio)[/list]
Commanders may be freely moved between any special ships but may not be placed at the controls of other regular ships.
[list][*]Operation "Saving Transylvania" will be available as Operation of the Week from October 18 till October 25. Before that date, the operation will be unavailable; afterwards, this operation will only be available to Divisions.
[*]Operation "Sunray in the Darkness" will be available as Operation of the Week from October 25 till November 1. Before that date, the operation will be unavailable; afterwards, this operation will only be available to Divisions.
[*]Following the release of Update 0.7.10, Operation "Sunray in the Darkness" (Hard Difficulty) will only be available to Divisions.[/list]
[h1]Terror of the Deep[/h1]
The new operation gives you a unique opportunity to test submarines, a totally new type of warship in the game!

Especially for this Operation, we've crafted five submarines: Barracuda, Zipper Sub, Gerfalcon, Seelöwe, and Killer Whale. These ships will be helmed by the glorious captains who featured in the past operations: Victor F. Einstein, Mina Hurray, Lazarus Centurio, Ivan K. Ulibin and Klaus V. Teslau.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/493e4e324afa8aa289a7d2b4744edc07f0fbe62e.jpg[/img]
Be mindful that initially you get only one submarine—Barracuda—to put your luck and skills to the test in Operation "Terror of the Deep". Active participation in Operations "Saving Transylvania", "Sunray in the Darkness" and "Terror of the Deep" will let you get your hands on the other unique submarines. They will be added to your accounts immediately before the new operation becomes available, i.e. on November 1!

Specifically for the new type of warship, we've added a new dimension, depth. Submarines will be able to change depth by moving between the water’s surface, periscope depth, and deep waters. Each move a submarine makes will affect its detectability and its ability to mount an attack. Press the "F" and "C" keys to dive and resurface, respectively.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/dcabee42a4f8d42f9589cd577828b53807db4857.jpg[/img]
Submarines rely on torpedoes as their primary weapons. In fact, they can be equipped with several models of torpedo. In the new operation, two torpedo models will be available: standard "metal fish" with a decent speed, similar to those carried by destroyers, and "freezing" torpedoes that move faster, deal less damage but, when delivered right on target, cripple all of the target ship's systems for a limited period of time.

Don't forget about your oxygen reserve, another vital parameter that we advise you to keep an eye on at all times! Your submarine will replenish its oxygen reserves on the water’s surface and then use it underwater. Remember that oxygen reserves are limited, and once used up, your submarine will initiate an emergency blow and automatic surfacing that can easily turn your ship into a sitting target, surrounded by foes.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/4eaa08824138ecd001d35247b4b11718b17af96d.jpg[/img]
Keep a sharp lookout for catapults and ballistas. You’ll be familiar with catapults from the first operation themed around Halloween. They will attack with giant burning balls that are able to hit your submarine when it’s on the surface. Ballistas will operate on a similar principle but their fiery balls turn into depth charges once they touch water surface.

Depth charges pose the main threat for submarines underwater. Dropped by hostile ships or launched by ballistas, these charges detonate when hit by a submarine, or explode automatically after some time and at a certain depth. A large destruction radius makes them a deadly weapon. Once you get within that area, your boat will take damage.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/a84e646cec22c1a00c79f52af40597763defc99e.jpg[/img]
[b]Explore the new type of warship—and destroy battleship Rasputin! The operation will be available in both Normal and Hard Difficulty modes.[/b]
[list][*]Operation "Terror of the Deep" will be available as Operation of the Week from November 1 till November 15. Before that date, the operation will be unavailable. Afterwards, the operation will be available for completion only within a Division until the end of Update 0.7.10.
[*]Operation "Terror of the Deep" (Hard Difficulty) will be available as Operation of the Week from November 15 till November 22. Before that date, the operation will be unavailable.[/list]
During the Halloween celebrations, you can get as many as two new achievements:
[list][*][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/d334b1c93bb40a14ffffc7e4c0a8f0c53b9143c0.png[/img]"Terror of the Deep" for successfully completing the Halloween 2018 operation
[*][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/5a6ecf3358d33c4f0c7ec91023d3dc74e195a786.png[/img]"Warrior of the Light" for completing all three Halloween-inspired operations (2016, 2017 and 2018) with 5 stars. To claim it, you need to complete all three operations this year.[/list]
[h1]Halloween Containers[/h1]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/88283448f6571a02379d892decc81e8f8fe5bf1c.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/9e760504704064133cdd1ca0f8ded6ab85b82688.png[/img][/url]We continue the good old tradition of offering dedicated containers inspired by Halloween. Apart from expendable camouflages, Free XP and doubloons (in Premium containers), Halloween containers may, with a certain chance, reward you with unique permanent camouflages. Most of them are well-known to you from previous years, but the following four will be new to you:
[list][*]Leviathan, a special camouflage for battleship North Carolina
[*]Razorworm, a special camouflage for destroyer Kiev
[*]Steel Rat, a special camouflage for destroyer Z-23
[*]And the first animated special camouflage for cruiser Mogami—Octopus[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/f4beafebff2392330b3fa72045a737956459c425.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Matchmaker[/b][/h1]
In response to numerous requests from players, the forthcoming Update will introduce a "soft" limit on the number of destroyers in Random Battles to a maximum of four per team. The rule will be triggered if matchmaking for a battle takes less than three minutes for the first player in the queue for that battle. If the timer passes that point, the "old" matchmaking rules will apply.

No more than four battleships and no more than four destroyers helmed by players will now be allowed in Co-op Battles.

[h1][b]Ranked Battles: Sprints[/b][/h1]
Update 0.7.10 will introduce a new format for Ranked Battles. We'll offer two short, dynamic seasons for Tier V ships with an option to play in a Division. One of the key features of the sprint season will be a significantly reduced duration when compared with that of a standard season. There will be a total of 10 Ranks and two Leagues, with Rank 1 being your ultimate objective. The League of Sea Wolves will not be accessible.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/369a0595a77f9e81cfd7194e0f06ae17eda60b2e.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/969f7de57e0d5722353dac1c7aa75d77abb65b5c.jpg[/img]
For more details about the new season, rewards and other peculiarities, please refer to [url=https://worldofwarships.eu/news/game-updates/ranked-sprint/]a dedicated article[/url] on Ranked Battle Sprints.

[h1][b]Game Balance Changes[/b][/h1]
To make it easier to keep in mind the parameters of consumables, we've harmonized the operation time of the Smoke Generator for all U.S. ships as well as the reach of the Hydroacoustic Search consumable.

Reworked parameters will be as follows:
[list][*]Standard Hydroacoustic Search consumable: at Tier IV to VII, the acquisition range of ships and torpedoes will be 4 km and 3 km, respectively; at Tier VIII to IX, it will be 5 and 3.5 km, respectively.
[*]Enhanced Hydroacoustic Search consumable: at Tier IV to VII, the acquisition range of ships and torpedoes will be 5.5 km and 3.75 km, respectively; at Tier VIII to IX, it will be 6 and 4 km, respectively.
[*]The Smoke Generator operation time for all U.S. ships is set at 30 seconds.[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/536b9c4a7b7f95d219c83ad14061a9983c49f200.jpg[/img]
The following ships will carry a Hydroacoustic Search consumable with "unconventional" characteristics:
[list][*]Karlsruhe, Königsberg, Nürnberg, Yorck, Graf Spee and Loyang (the acquisition range of ships and torpedoes will be 5.5 km and 3.75 km, respectively).
[*]Friedrich der Große, Großer Kurfürst, Hipper, Roon, Hindenburg, Prinz Eugen and Z-52 (the acquisition range of ships and torpedoes will be 6 km and 4 km, respectively).
[*]Apart from that, the characteristics for the Hydroacoustic Search consumable aboard carrier Graf Zeppelin and destroyers Ernst Gaede, Leberecht Maass and T-61 will be 4 km and 3 km for the acquisition range of ships and torpedoes, respectively.
[*]German ships Bismarck, Z-23, Z-46 and Z-39 will be equipped with the Hydroacoustic Search consumable with the following parameters typical of other Tier VIII-X ships: 5 km for the acquisition range of ships, and 3.5 km for the acquisition of torpedoes.[/list]
We have also fixed the cooldown time for the standard Smoke Generator consumable for researchable British destroyers and destroyer Cossack. When the British destroyers first appeared in the game carrying a unique Smoke Generator, the difference between the standard and Premium versions of this consumable equated to 29% (i.e. 90 and 70 seconds for Smoke Generator I and Smoke Generator II, respectively) instead of the intended 50%. In Update 0.7.10, we fix this issue, adding more consistency to the cooldown time of Smoke Generator I. Now, it will be equal to 105 seconds. However, this change will not affect the Smoke Generator II consumable that will retain a cooldown time of 70 seconds.

We've changed the characteristics of the Engine Boost consumable mounted on British destroyer Cossack. This will fix an issue which caused a bigger drop in speed when turning with the Engine Boost consumable activated when compared to the ship's speed when that consumable was off.

Tier I Cruiser Black Swan: increased reload time of the ship's main guns from 4 to 6 seconds. The fix brings the ship in line with the same-type ships in terms of combat efficiency.

U.S. Tier IX cruiser Seattle and Tier X cruiser Worcester: the operational radius of the Surveillance Radar consumable is reduced from 9.45 and 9.9 km, respectively, to 9 km for both ships.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/da71c88c2f313ac9bc7db4af4e31a1ce9869cfc3.jpg[/img]
The rationale behind this change stems from the fact that both cruisers possess a mix of short detectability distance, Surveillance Radar with a long reach, HE shells, and fast main guns reload. With all these factors combined, the two cruisers emerge as overly efficient destroyer hunters. Any destroyer detected within the operational radius of the consumable practically has no chances of escaping from the detection zone and will most likely be lost. Despite this reduction in the operational reach of the Surveillance Radar Consumable, Seattle and Worcester will continue to be dangerous adversaries, but now leaving destroyers with at least the chance for a timely evasive maneuver to leave the detection zone, knowing what ship they are about to face.

[h1][b]Daily Shipments[/b][/h1]
With the release of Update 0.7.10, a new section will appear in the game called "Daily Shipments". Access it to view the list of rewards that you can get for simply logging into the game on a regular basis.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/1647674d7a1731639b443d2bbf6a625baa4fb787.jpg[/img]
[b]Daily Shipments will come from several sources:[/b]
[list][*]During the period from October 31 till November 9, Daily Shipments will be inspired by the Halloween event. You can get a whole range of gifts during the period that include: Halloween-themed containers, credits, camo, Coal and doubloons. You can always check which reward will be yours on the next day and find out about your ultimate reward for completing the entire list.
[*]Novice players will have access to Daily Shipments, divided into four stages with each offering three gifts. Every stage will last for one week, during which players will need to log in to the game at least three times. The following stage becomes available either after all rewards have been collected, or when the week expires. You get: credits, doubloons, a Premium ship, containers, one day of Premium Account time and one Supercontainer. This type of Daily Shipment will only be available to players that reach Account Level 2 in their Service Record after the point that Daily Shipments hit the live servers. If you are already at Level 2 or higher when Daily Shipments are launched, you will have no access to this type of Daily Shipment.
[*]Looking for a lucrative offer? A special one-off shipment called "Business is thriving" will be available in the Premium shop. Stay tuned for more details on this offer on our official portal![/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/0a467d51c71c2d729067118bd321bf200dc61eb1.jpg[/img]
Switch between the available types of Daily Shipments and keep an eye on what will be coming your way tomorrow. You can enable or disable the display of the Daily Shipments window upon login, using the checkbox in the lower-right corner of the section.

[h1][b]Interface[/b][/h1]
We are pleased to announce a new mechanic that will allow for more accurate awareness of the danger posed by incoming torpedoes. Its primary objective is to minimize the number of false alarms triggered by torpedoes which obviously pose no danger. We hope that more accurate warning of incoming torpedoes will increase the efficiency of your maneuvering in battle.

The new algorithm calculates the probability for a ship of a particular type being hit by an approaching torpedo (e.g. a deepwater torpedo passing close to a destroyer), and takes into account the speed and direction of the movement of ships and torpedoes.
[img]https://worldofwarships.eu/dcont/fb/image/7f7eb4d2-d12d-11e8-883c-ac162d8bc1e4.gif[/img]
[b]All in all, there are two levels of incoming torpedo threat alerts:[/b]
[list][*]Info alert (yellow): activated to warn you of an incoming torpedo that is three kilometers away from your ship.
[*]Danger alert (red): activated if a torpedo is on a course to hit, or if it will pass within a radius that is unconditionally dangerous for your ship if you maintain your current course.[/list]
[b]We also added several new options to the ship filtering carousel:[/b]
[list][*]A filter to pick out ships which are not yet at Elite status. This will help players that are actively researching new warships to quickly find the desired ship in the carousel.
[*]Added a filter which, when enabled, will display only ships designated as "Primary".[/list]
[b]Armament and consumables panel:[/b]
[list][*]Depending on the type of a torpedo (conventional or deepwater), the ‘armament and consumables panel’ will now display a corresponding icon in battle.[/list]
[h1][b]Clan Battles[/b][/h1]
We are now in the final stages of testing a new feature that will allow players to enter Clan Battles during the prime time of any server. The Command officers can set a single prime time that would be most convenient for all their clanmates. The desired prime time can be changed each day during an active season of Clan Battles.

[b]With the release of Update 0.7.10, a test season called "North" (test) kicks off.[/b]
[list][*]The season will last from October 22 till October 28.
[*]All in all, there will be 4 sessions accessible on Monday, Tuesday, Saturday and Sunday.
[*]Prime time hours: 19:00-23:00 CEST
[*]During the test season, Clan Battles will be available to teams of five players each and Tier VI ships only.[/list]
[b]Pool of maps:[/b]
[list][*]Ring
[*]Strait
[*]New Dawn
[*]Trident[/list]
[b]On all maps, the following parameters will be applied:[/b]
[list][*]Number of key areas: 3
[*]Capture time: 40 seconds
[*]Points for capturing Key Areas: 3 points per 4 seconds.[/list]
Assemble a team, select any prime time convenient for your clan—and dive into naval combat! Play 10 battles during the test season and get 500 Steel and 15,000 Coal added to your accounts as a reward. Please bear in mind that 5 battles must be played during the prime time of another realm.

[i]The statistics for the test season will be available only for the duration of Update 0.7.10.[/i]

[h1][b]Content Additions and Changes[/b][/h1]
The following ships were added for testing by developers, supertesters and community contributors:
[list][*]U.S. Tier VIII cruiser Wichita
[*]U.S. Tier III cruiser Charleston
[*]British Tier III battleship Dreadnought
[*]British Tier VIII battleship Vanguard
[*]U.S. Tier VI battleship West Virginia’41[/list]
The following camouflage patterns will be available for purchase for doubloons in the game client:

[b]Ashitaka: Kobayashi[/b]
[list][*]–3% to detectability range by sea;
[*]+4% to dispersion of shells fired by enemies attacking your ship;
[*]+100% to XP earned per battle
[*]–50% to the cost of the ship's post-battle service;
[*]+20% to credits earned per battle
[*]Cost: 6,000 doubloons[/list]
[b]Kii: Kobayashi[/b]
[list][*]–3% to detectability range by sea;
[*]+4% to dispersion of shells fired by enemies attacking your ship;
[*]+100% to XP earned per battle
[*]–50% to the cost of the ship's post-battle service;
[*]+20% to credits earned per battle
[*]Cost: 7,000 doubloons[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/d74a3b2630d6e2c0dc68e0da83f58704bc59caf9.jpg[/img]

[h1]Arms Race[/h1]
In Update 0.7.10 we disable the Arms Race type of battles. Thank you for your involvement in testing the new mode and game mechanics, your feedback is very valuable to us. We’ll analyze every message received and try to incorporate your wishes in the future. We hope you liked Arms Race and are already waiting to see it back in the game! We, on our part, will make all efforts to roll out the new game with all remarked improvements incorporated.

[h1]Collaboration with Alex Ovechkin[/h1]
We've added four versions of the unique Commander Alexander Ovechkin:
[list][*]A Soviet Commander with a Russian voiceover
[*]A U.S. Commander with an English voiceover
[*]Dual-nation Commander Alexander Ovechkin dressed for Halloween
[*]Dual-nation Commander Alexander Ovechkin in hockey outfit[/list]
Those last two commanders may be assigned both to Soviet and U.S. ships.
[table][tr][th][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/95c67b4684081147f687ee32b3ac48ff2b057009.png[/img][/th][th][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/d895b4d564ead321980de91b7119b0723ddb1667.png[/img][/th][th][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/a9ab3910ff28a80bb07f0442f541c0081603c0b2.png[/img][/th][th][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31013613/9f59baa9318a164e381a66668cd33b5285e7d6bf.png[/img][/th][/tr][/table]
Full info here: https://steamcommunity.com/games/552990/announcements/detail/3240794524087910023 Wait for October 19 to be able to activate respective mission chain.

[h1][b]Error reporting[/b][/h1]
Any critical error that occurs whilst the client is running will generate a special report that will be stored in a Reports folder. After that, you will be prompted to restart the client or close it.

This is the first stage in a process of implementing a new system for the collection of critical errors. In Update 0.7.10, such reports will be stored locally on players' computers but in future updates a special archive will be sent directly to the Dev Team to give them all required information about any occurring incident. In the near future, this system will let us decrease the amount of "manual" operations required from a player when contacting Player Support, or in other instances when more detailed information is required to handle an incident.

[h1][b]Other Changes and Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Fixed an issue with the list of consumables not fitting in the screen at small screen resolutions, in cases when there is a selection of more than four types of consumable that could be placed in one slot.
[*]Removed the price of consumables in doubloons. If you need consumables and do not have enough credits to buy them, but do have doubloons, you can exchange the doubloons for credits using the feature available in the upper-right corner in the Port.
[*]Fixed an issue when installation of the Damage Control System Modification 1 upgrade affected the "Torpedo Protection. Damage Reduction" parameter.
[*]Fixed an issue that displayed extra separator bars between the text lines in the Summary.
[*]Fixed an issue with no clarification displayed for battle results in certain cases.
[*]Fixed a bug on battleship Giulio Cesare, which caused the guns of the second turret to run through the first turret.
[*]Fixed an issue with a destroyed ship getting a "Spotted" ribbon.
[*]Fixed an issue which prevented the information contained in the "Ranks" section of the "Profile" tab from getting updated.
[*]Fixed an issue which, depending on the camera view angle, caused an incorrect display of the distance to ships.[/list]
[b]Also now Dutch localization is supported in the game.[/b]

[table][tr][th][h1][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/552990/discussions/8/3276824488732459442/]Discuss the update here[/url][/h1][/th][/tr][/table]
